1.description: This hotel is located about 150 metres from the fine sandy beach. The lively centre of Cambrils is approximately 10 km away and can be easily reached by the public bus services. There is a stop for public transport right in front of the hotel. The immediate vicinity offers a diverse range of shopping and entertainment facilities including boutiques, restaurants and bars. This hotel comprises a total of 260 rooms spread over 5 floors. Dining options include a café, a bar and an air-conditioned buffet restaurant with highchairs for infants. The tastefully decorated, cosy rooms come with a balcony and satellite TV.

11.description: This modern hotel revels in its prime setting, lying amidst the exciting tourist area of Salou. The hotel is situated on Europe Square, allowing for ease of access to the main attractions that the area has to offer. Guests will find themselves just 1 km away from Port Aventura, which guarantees fun for all the family. The villages of Tarragona and Reus are just a short driving distance away. This charming hotel enjoys an attractive architectural design. The guest rooms offer space and warmth, providing the perfect setting in which to completely relax and unwind at the end of the day. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. The hotel affords guests a wide range of excellent facilities and services, such us a large swimming pool with a sun lounger area and jacuzzi, ensuring that each and every traveller enjoys a memorable stay.

13.description: The Suite Apartments Arquus are located in the centre of the lively city of Salou, in the famous Costa Dorada, only 400 m away from the beach. The apartments are fully equipped and can accommodate up to 6 people. They all feature a private balcony, and there is also a seasonal common outdoor pool. It is the perfect holiday destination for families and groups of friends who wish to enjoy the lively Costa Dorada, its nightlife and entertainment venues. The theme parks of Port Aventura and Aquopolis La Pineda are only 3 km away from the complex, and there are plenty of restaurants, bars and shops nearby. The beautiful beach of Cala de la Font is really close to the hotel, and the neighbouring towns of Cambrils, Reus and Tarragona are just a quick ride away. Reus airport is accessible by bus or a short taxi ride, and Barcelona's El Prat Airport is roughly 80 km away.

56.description: This attractive hotel is ideally located in Salou's tourist centre, just 200 metres from the nearest beautiful sandy beach. The town centre is only minutes away and offers plenty of shopping and entertainment opportunities. There is a bus stop directly in front of the hotel (100 m away). The hotel offers 199 exceptional, discerningly furnished rooms. The guests can rest in a spacious lobby, a homely bar or in an air-conditioned restaurant. It also provides a car park as well as a kids' club and a children's playground. The travellers can enjoy a pool in the garden with a separate children's pool, a snack bar and a sun terrace with sun loungers. An indoor swimming pool, a gym and a spa area are all available. A daily entertainment programme ensures that there is never a dull moment whilst staying at this hotel. The nearest golf course is located about 1. 5 km from the hotel.

90.description: The Negresco Hotel offers a stunning beachfront location, perfect for those seeking a seaside escape. Guests can enjoy panoramic views of the swimming pool and the sparkling sea. Its 407 rooms provide a functional and pleasant environment for a relaxing stay. Families are welcome, with amenities and entertainment options available for young children. Two inviting swimming pools offer refreshing dips.

91.description: The Best Cambrils Hotel, located in Vilafortuny just 80 meters from the beach, offers comfortable rooms with balconies and fully fitted bathrooms. Amenities include a hairdryer, telephone, satellite TV, fridge, security lock, heating, air conditioning, and an optional safety deposit box. Enjoy a buffet-style restaurant with show cooking, featuring national and international cuisine, as well as a bar-cafeteria, TV lounge, and a poolside snack bar. The hotel boasts outdoor pools for adults and children, a games room, children's area, kid's club, and a varied day and night entertainment program. Optional services include a spa, gift shops, internet corner, fitness center, massage, ping pong, and billiards.

422.description: Ideal for active vacationers, families and young people, this hotel is situated in Cambrils, in a quiet area right by the sea. The center can be reached within about 1 mile and tourist attractions within around 2 miles. The hotel has 472 rooms, including 8 junior suites, 8 suites and 372 double rooms, which are located on 4 stories and are reachable by 4 elevators. The multilingual staff at the reception desk in the lobby are ready to assist you with check-in and check-out. A baggage storage service and a safe are available. Wireless internet access (no extra charge) allows guests to stay connected while on vacation. The tour desk offers assistance with booking excursions. Wheelchair-accessible facilities are available. A number of shops, including a souvenir shop, are great for shopping or just browsing. The grounds of the hotel feature a playground and a lovely garden. Additional amenities include a TV room and a playroom. Parking spaces are available to guests traveling by car (for a fee). Other services include a wake-up call service and a hairdresser. Bicycle storage is available to guests. There is a bike rental service as well. Rooms are equipped with air conditioning and central heating. Guests can relax and enjoy partial sea views from the balcony or private terrace of some rooms. Guests are sure to get a good night's sleep in the queen-size bed. Separate bedrooms are available. Children's beds can be provided at no extra charge upon request. A safe, a minibar and a desk are also available. Guests will also find a mini fridge included among the standard features. A direct dial telephone, a television with satellite/cable channels and WiFi (no extra charge) are provided as well. Bathrooms are equipped with a shower and a bathtub, as well as a hairdryer. Guests can also reserve wheelchair-friendly rooms with wheelchair-accessible bathrooms. The hotel has 100 family rooms and non-smoking rooms.

424.description: This cosy hotel is conveniently located right in Tarragona's city centre, within easy reach from many sightseeing attractions, such as the Roman amphitheatre, Tarraco Arena bullring and other main points of interest. In the surrounding area, visitors will find plenty of bus and railway stations to get to other nearby destinations. The white sandy beach is also within easy reach from the property. The welcoming guest rooms are smartly fitted with everything that guests may need during their stay, including a minibar, air-conditioning and a television with international channels for guests to relax at the end of the day with their favourite programme. Guests may enjoy a daily varied and delicious breakfast buffet at the hotel and taste Mediterranean specialities with local wines at the on-site restaurant. Business travellers may appreciate the meeting rooms and facilities available.

429.description: This superb complex is located in the resort of La Pineda in Salou. The hotel is situated a mere 250 metres from the beach and just 2 kms from Salou, offering guests a relaxing retreat close to the heart of the entertainment. This modern hotel tempts guests with the promise of excellent service, first-rate facilities, warm hospitality and comfortable accommodation. The guest rooms enjoy a classic style and come complete with modern conveniences for guests' pleasure. The rooms offer the ideal sanctuary in which guests can relax and unwind in comfort at the end of the day. Guests will be impressed by the hotel's extensive leisure amenities, which have been designed to ensure that visitors enjoy the ultimate relaxation. Guests are invited to enjoy the delectable delights that the restaurant has to offer.

432.description: The Best Club Cap Salou, located in Salou, is perfect for a relaxing family holiday. Guests can enjoy panoramic views of the swimming pool and unwind in one of the hotel's 497 comfortable rooms after a day of activities. The hotel is well-equipped to meet the needs of families with young children, offering dedicated facilities and services. After an energetic day, guests can take a refreshing dip in one of the hotel's pools.

434.description: This hotel is located in Salou's tourist centre roughly 200 m away from Capellans and just 3 km from PortAventura. An abundance of shops and cultural venues are located in the surroundings. Public transport departs from stops located directly in front of the hotel. Guests have a choice of 265 rooms located in two 6-storey buildings with lifts. The multilingual staff at the reception desk in the lobby are ready to assist you with check-in and check-out. The hotel provides a safe, a TV room, a playroom, medical assistance, an alarm call service and a smoke alarm. Wireless internet access (no extra charge) allows guests to stay connected while on holiday. The tour desk offers assistance with booking excursions. The hotel has wheelchair-accessible facilities. There are a number of shops as well. Children can enjoy the playground. Parking facilities available to guests include a garage (for a fee) and a car park. A bicycle hire service provides all the necessary equipment for exploring the surrounding area. Air conditioning and central heating ensure that rooms maintain comfortable temperatures. A balcony is among the standard amenities of some rooms. Rooms include a queen-size bed. A safe, a minibar and a desk are also available. A direct dial telephone, a television with satellite/cable channels and WiFi (no extra charge) provide all the essentials for a comfortable holiday. Bathrooms are equipped with a shower and a bathtub, as well as a hairdryer. 5 wheelchair-friendly rooms can be booked. The hotel has non-smoking rooms.

435.description: The modern aparthotel Cye Holiday Centre enjoys an excellent central location in the heart of Salou, just a few steps away from the marvellous sandy beach, the marina and the train station. Plenty of shops, restaurants, bars and cafés can be found in the surrounding area. Within a 30-minute walk, guests can reach the spectacular Port Aventura theme park; alternatively, it can be reached by train. The hotel offers bright, spacious and tastefully furnished apartments with fully-fitted kitchens; the apartments can sleep up to 6 adults and some are fitted for disabled guests. Guests will appreciate a variety of services and amenities such as an outdoor pool, a separate children's pool, a kid's room, a mini-club in the summer months as well as a restaurant with both buffet and à la carte service. This is a perfect place for a beach holiday for families with children and groups of friends.

437.description: This beach hotel is situated in Salou just 200 metres from the bustling tourist hub of the town. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the town's shops, restaurants and entertainment venues. Just 700 metres from the hotel lies the sprawling sandy beach which offers guests the perfect place in which to relax and unwind, or to sit back and revel in the beautiful sunset and sunrise. Guests will be impressed by the warm atmosphere and friendly service that greets them once they walk through the doors. The hotel offers a host of leisure and recreational facilities to ensure that every member of the family enjoys an entertaining stay. Guests are invited to relish the delectable delights that the restaurant has to offer, which are sure to tempt the taste buds of even the most discerning traveller.

438.description: This friendly apartment complex is centrally situated in the tourist centre of Salou, close to an attractive sandy beach (500 metres away). There are several shopping areas surrounding the complex where guests may explore the different shops, boutiques, bars, restaurants and nightclubs. Public transport departs for the centre from a stop approximately 50 m from the complex. The beach complex was built in 2001 and consists of a main building with 5 floors. Various facilities are available to guests including a foyer with a lift, a currency exchange desk, an Internet connection and a safe. There is also a café, a bar and an air-conditioned restaurant. Outside, the complex offers parking facilities for those arriving by car.

442.description: This delightful aparthotel is located between Salou and Cambrils, just steps from the beach and a variety of shops and entertainment venues. The Cambrils train station is also nearby. Each apartment offers a comfortable home-away-from-home experience with modern amenities such as TVs, coffeemakers, and seating areas with sofa beds. Kitchenettes and terraces are also standard, while upgraded apartments boast dining areas and some offer scenic views. Guests can enjoy an on-site buffet restaurant, swimming pool, and indoor playground. The complex caters to every member of the family with its wide range of excellent facilities and services.

450.description: This attractive hotel is located in the heart of Salou, just 10 min away from the sandy beach. In a close proximity guests can find plenty of shopping venues, restaurants, bars and nightclubs. Port Aventura Park is just 3km from the hotel. Public transport can be found directly in front of the hotel. The beach hotel comprises a spacious lobby with reception and a TV room. There is also a coffee bar and an air-conditioned restaurant. Outside, the hotel offers a playground with a kids' club. All tastefully furnished rooms include an en-suite bathroom, optional safe box and a terrace. This charming hotel also offers a freshwater pool with sun loungers and parasols and a pool bar. The hotel also offers an entertainment programme. The restaurant tempts with national and International cuisine.

456.address: Placa De La Corona D Arago, S/N
456.description:
This hotel is conveniently located in the modern area of Tortosa, with excellent connections it is very close to the commercial and cultural center of this beautiful city. 

Offering all of the necessary services for a comfortable stay, this chic and stylish hotel houses functionally furnished, cozy and contemporary accommodation that consists of rooms and apartments equipped with modern conveniences and everything you may need. 

If you are looking for a quiet place to hold a meeting, conference or event, there are rooms perfect for your requirements, which include direct outside access. The hotel also features a tranquil garden, an outdoor swimming pool and a children’s play area. Do not forget to take advantage of the restaurant which serves traditional cuisine.

457.description: This aparthotel is located in the heart of the town of Salou. The complex offers the ideal base from which travellers can explore the delightful sights and sounds the town has to offer. Guests will find a selection of bars, restaurants, boutiques and the beach within easy access of the hotel. The apartments are tastefully-decorated and offer guests a veritable home away from home. The units come complete with modern amenities for guests' convenience. Guests can spend dreamy days relaxing by the pool or can take the opportunity to enjoy a refreshing swim. Leisurely strolls on the beach, shopping trips and fine dining are all at guests' fingertips.

647.description: This attractive hotel enjoys a perfect setting directly on the seemingly endless sandy beach of Cap de Sant Pere in Vilafortuny on the Costa Dorada, separated from the beach by the promenade only. The centre of the popular holiday resort of Salou with its shops, restaurants, bars and cafés is just a short stroll away. The exciting Port Aventura theme park can be reached within a short drive. All of the hotel's rooms boast extraordinary panoramic views over the eternal blue of the Mediterranean Sea. The hotel features a large terrace with a solar heated outdoor pool surrounded by sun loungers, children's pool as well as direct access to the wonderful beach. An ideal choice for couples and groups of friends. Show cooking at dinner (high season).

648.description: This charming beach hotel enjoys a prime location in the heart of Salou's bustling tourist centre. The hotel is situated on Europa Square just 350 metres from the sprawling golden, sandy beach. The town centre is just a few minutes' walking distance away and the hotel is well-connected to other parts of the area with a bus stop just 150 metres from the door. The hotel appeals to business and leisure travellers alike with its selection of excellent facilities. The guest rooms offer a peaceful escape from the bustle of daily life and are well equipped with modern amenities for visitors' convenience. Guests will enjoy the hotel's choice of recreational activities which have been designed to ensure that visitors of all ages enjoy an entertaining stay.

650.address: Carrer D Alfons V El Magnanim, 9
650.description: This attractive hotel is ideally located in Salou's tourism centre, just 200 m from the nearest beautiful sandy beach. The town centre, offering plenty of shopping and entertainment opportunities, is only a few minutes' walk away. There is a bus stop directly in front of the hotel. The building consists of 95 rooms spread over 6 floors. Guests are offered a pool and terrace area, and the considerable lobby includes lift access and houses many services. Drink and dinner options come in the form of a café, a cosy bar, a pub and an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant with highchairs for children. Business guests may make use of the conference facilities and the Internet terminal. The hotel features a swimming pool and a sun terrace with sun loungers where guests can enjoy the sun. An indoor swimming pool and a sauna are also available.

653.description: This attractive hotel is ideally located in Salou's tourist centre, just 100 metres from the nearest beautiful sandy beach and around 200 m from the lively palm tree lined promenade. The town centre, offering plenty of shopping and entertainment opportunities, is only a few minutes' walk away and there is a bus stop directly in front of the hotel. The famous Port Aventura Park is just a 10-minute drive away. The impeccable en suite rooms are fitted with all the necessary amenities to make guests' feel right at home. Facilities include parquet floors, modern décor, air-conditioning and a private balcony. Guests may sample an extensive choice of International cuisine as well as Spanish specialities at the buffet-style restaurant. There are also three different bars, including a fantastic snack bar, ideal for a pleasant poolside lunch. There is a kids' club and a playground available for children, as well as a well-equipped fitness area for those more active guests.

654.description: This attractive hotel is located in the northern outskirts, right in the small bay of Cala de la Font. It is about 2 km to an abundance of shops and other entertainment venues. Guests are offered a large pool and garden area, a tasteful lobby with lifts and a games room, amongst other necessary facilities at this hotel. Guests can dine in style at the on-site café with a terrace, a cosy bar or air-conditioned restaurant with a separate non-smoking area and children's highchairs. Business guests may also make use of the conference room and the public Internet terminal. Travellers will find en suite rooms which are cosily furnished awaiting them. For those who are driving, a car park is available.

656.description: This pleasant hotel lies directly beside the local sandy beach about 6 km from the lively centre of La Pineda where guests will discover an abundance of shopping and entertainment venues. It is well worth paying a visit to the Universal Port Aventura leisure park, which can be found approximately 2 km away. This fully air-conditioned hotel comprises 8 floors with a total of 410 rooms. Guests have access to a fabulous pool and garden complex and facilities include a cosy bar and an air-conditioned restaurant. Each of the tastefully decorated rooms comes with a bathroom with a hairdryer, a telephone, air conditioning, central heating, a hire safe and a balcony or terrace. Guests can take advantage of the swimming pool in the outdoor complex. There is also a sumptuous breakfast buffet for guests every morning.

994.description: Boasting a unique location in Cambrils, this hotel offers the perfect place where to enjoy a relaxing holiday experience with the whole family. It is just 250 metres from the beach and 100 metres from the harbour, while Port Aventura theme park and the vibrant city of Salou are just a 10-minute drive away. The property offers a choice of fully-equipped apartments including a private balcony ideal to enjoy the morning coffee while breathing the sea breeze. All come with cable/satellite TV and a bathroom with hairdryer. Designed with younger guests' needs in mind, this hotel provides a choice of outstanding facilities and services including a children buffet, nightly entertainment for adults and children and a mini club where the little ones will have the time of their lives. Close to the beach, this charming hotel is the ideal accommodation for a comfortable stay in Costa Daurada. There is daily and nightly entertainment for adults and children. This includes live shows every night. The mini club features films, a Nintendo Wii Console, storytelling and workshops. The bar/cafe has a large projector screen. Guests can access WiFi for free in the lobby. WiFi is available in the apartments for an extra cost.

995.description: ** ADULTS ONLY HOTEL FROM 2023**This superior beach hotel enjoys an idyllic location on Plaza Europa in the lively tourist hub of Salou. The renowned Levante beach is a mere 400 metres from the hotel, while a myriad of entertainment venues, shops and restaurants lie in close proximity. The hotel enjoys a sleek, sophisticated style drenched in natural light. The guest rooms are sumptuously appointed, featuring vibrant colours complemented by crisp white features. The rooms offer a serene haven in which to reflect and unwind in comfort at the end of the day. Guests will be impressed by the hotel's selection of recreational and leisure facilities, which have been designed to fully cater to visitors' entertainment needs to the highest degree of excellence. Guests can dine in style amidst the elegant surrounds of the restaurant where delectable culinary delights are the order of the day. There is a nice bar called The Sixth Pool & Drinks roof Terrace, with a plunge pool and a Despacio Beauty Centre with sauna, treatments and gym. There is a a complete programme of leisure activities. This hotel is suitable for cycling breaks and welcomes cyclists from all over the world. The hotel boasts facilities to support both the leisure and professional cyclist.

998.description: This holiday hotel is conveniently situated in the renowned tourist resort of Salou on the Costa Dorada, just an hour's drive from the city of Barcelona. The beautiful beaches of Levante and Capellans can be reached within a 10-minute stroll. The restaurants, bars and shops of the centre of Salou are within walking distance. The thrills of the Port Aventura theme park are just a few minutes' drive away. The hotel features a lovely pool area with two outdoor pools and a children's pool as well as a playground. The buffet restaurant with show cooking serves national and international cuisine. Guests can have a drink or sip on a cocktail in the bar-cafeteria or at the pool bar. A spa area with sauna, Turkish bath and hot tub offers maximum relaxation. This hotel is an ideal choice for couples and families with children who wish to spend a beach holiday under the sun.

1000.description: This superb beach hotel is centrally located in the vibrant Spanish tourist hub of Salou on the Costa Dorada. The hotel is situated just 100 metres from the popular resort of La Pineda and from the sprawling sandy beach, affording guests the opportunity to enjoy romantic moonlight strolls, or to simply sit back and revel in the beautiful sunsets. The hotel boasts an elegant interior design with a 16 metres high transparent dome, drenching the surroundings with natural light. The guest rooms are beautifully-appointed, featuring warm earthy tones creating a serene, tranquil ambience. Guests will be impressed by the hotel's expansive grounds and vast array of leisure and recreational amenities. For added relaxation, guests can unwind in the Turkish bath or indulge in a massage. Guests are invited to enjoy the delights of the restaurant's ample buffet with something to tempt every palate.

1003.description: Located just 800 meters from PortAventura and close to the beach and several golf courses, the H10 Salauris Palace is a modern hotel offering a comprehensive range of services and facilities for a memorable stay in Salou. Built in 2000, this 5-story hotel features 351 contemporary-style rooms and numerous amenities, including an air-conditioned restaurant, game room, TV lounge, and internet access. Guests can enjoy a swimming pool with a waterfall and jacuzzi, a garden area, and a solarium with jacuzzi overlooking the Costa Daurada and PortAventura. Children are welcome and have access to a dedicated kids' club and playground. Comfortable en-suite rooms are thoughtfully appointed with a variety of amenities. The hotel also boasts the Despacio Beauty Centre with an indoor pool, sauna, gym, and Turkish bath. An outdoor pool and poolside bar provide relaxation during the summer months. A full schedule of daily activities is available for both adults and children, in addition to the kids' club. For added convenience, the hotel provides an electric vehicle charging station.

1004.description: These apartments are located near the tourist center of Salou, about 500 meters from the beach. Bars, restaurants, attractions, and nightlife are within 350 meters, and a public bus stop is just 150 meters away. This modern apartment complex features a large terrace, panoramic lifts with pool views, and a quiet, green setting. Two-bedroom apartments accommodate up to six people, with one double bed and two single beds. Each includes a fully equipped bathroom, a kitchen with a washing machine, a living room with a sofa bed, and a terrace. TV rentals are available. Bed linens and towels are provided, and cleaning is done upon arrival and departure. The complex also has a swimming pool.

1006.description: This family-friendly hotel is excellently located in the town of Salou, just a short stroll from the sandy beach and close to the fantastic Port Aventura theme park. The hotel features 2 outdoor pools, one of them with children's section, a restaurant, a bar and a poolside bar as well as a playground and a kids' club. The airport of Reus is within a 10 minutes' drive, the city of Barcelona can be reached within one hour. Our 2 bedroom apartments are located off site of the main hotel a 2-3 min walk away

1017.description: This sublime beach hotel enjoys an idyllic setting in the heart of the tourist centre of Salou. The hotel is located just 100 metres from the beautiful sandy beach yet is only a few minutes' walking distance from the bustling shopping and entertainment venues of the centre. The hotel enjoys a warm, inviting ambience and friendly service, ensuring that guests are afforded a relaxing, pleasant stay. The guest rooms are tastefully-decorated and come fully equipped with modern amenities for visitors' convenience. The hotel offers a selection of leisure and recreational facilities that will appeal to guests of all ages. The hotel also provides a seasonal entertainment programme for guests' enjoyment.

1020.description: This wonderful complex is conveniently situated in the tourist centre of Salou, within a short stroll from the gorgeous sandy beach offering a comfortable base for all those looking for relaxing sunny holiday in Costa Daurada. Travellers may find copious shops, dining options and wide offer of entertainment venues in the immediate vicinity and links to public transport are to be found within 250 metres from this lovely property. This attractive establishment has spacious and tastefully decorated self-catering apartments. The en-suite units are generously filled with natural daylight and come complete with commodious furniture and modern amenities to make guests' stay as pleasant as possible. Visitors may also make use of the shimmering pool at the partner establishment and those arriving by car may leave their vehicle at the on-site garage upon request and direct payment.

1025.address: Carrer Del Prat D En Carbo, S/N
1025.description: This apartment hotel is situated in the tourist centre of Salou, around 300 metres from the beach and 100 metres from Europa Square. There are several shopping and entertainment venues located in the area surrounding the hotel. This lovely establishment is the perfect place for travellers looking for a relaxing place to unwind. This hotel also has its own laundry service and medical assistance. In addition, car parking facilities in the form of a garage and a car park are available for those arriving by car. The functional apartments are fitted with a bathroom, an integrated living room/bedroom and modern amenities to ensure guests are comfortable throughout their stay.

1027.description:
Centrally located in Imperial Tarraco Square, this hotel features 24-hour room service, and a rooftop pool and hot tub. It is next to Tarragona Bus Station, offering direct airport connections. The beach and Roman Amphitheatre are a 20-minute walk away. 

The modern, climate-controlled rooms according to the season (heating or cooling) at the Hotel SB Ciutat Tarragona, have marble floors and flat-screen satellite TV. There is a minibar and safe, and the private bathroom comes with a bath or shower and hairdryer. 

A varied buffet breakfast is offered at the Hotel SB Ciutat Tarragona, there is a café-bar and the restaurant serves Mediterranean cuisine. 

There is a 24-hour front desk, and on-site parking is available for an extra charge. A car hire service is also available. 

A varied buffet breakfast is offered at the Hotel SB Ciutat Tarragona, There is a café-bar and the restaurant serves Mediterranean cuisine.

1034.address: Carrer De La Ciutat De Reus, 5
1034.description: This lovely beach hotel is situated in the tourist center of Salou, steps from shops and restaurants. Public transport is easily accessible, and the nearest sandy beach is about 700 meters away. The hotel is a short, half-hour walk from the town center. This seven-story hotel offers modern rooms with en-suite bathrooms, air conditioning, satellite TV, and private balconies. The on-site restaurant features a delicious and varied buffet for both children and adults. Guests can also enjoy relaxing massages and beauty treatments at the spa (for guests over 16). Additional amenities include an internet corner, a sparkling outdoor pool, a children's pool, and a varied entertainment program. Families with children are welcome in the spa from 10:00 to 11:00 am. Check-in begins at 4 pm to ensure thorough disinfection.

1036.description: This beachfront hotel sits alongside a beautiful sandy beach and the turquoise waters of La Pineda. Public transport, restaurants, and bars are conveniently located nearby, as are a water park and nightclub. Recently renovated, the hotel features a welcoming foyer, a currency exchange desk, and a TV room. Guests can also enjoy a café, a bar, and an air-conditioned restaurant offering a delicious buffet and nightly show cooking. Each uniquely designed room includes a terrace with sea views, modern amenities, and comfortable furnishings for a home-away-from-home feel. Rooms also have a full bathroom with a separate WC. Guests are welcome to use the swimming pool and enjoy the seasonal entertainment program for adults.

1049.description: These modern beachfront apartments are located in the city of Cambrils just 1500 metres from the Salou's marina. The apartments are perfect for business or leisure travellers due to its close proximity to public transportation. The complex has a swimming pool with solarium, garden area and direct access to the beach, perfect for families and groups as all the apartments are two bedroom units. These cosy contemporary designed apartments come equipped with everything needed for extended vacations right on the beach. Guests will feel right at home with a fully stocked kitchen, private balcony and two spacious bedrooms with comfortable bedding and natural lighting. Patrons can spend the day at the beach or relax by the pool soaking in the Mediterranean sunshine. There are several restaurants, bars and markets within close proximity to the apartments. Some of the local attractions include the House of Illusion, Ferrari land, and PortAventura all within 3 kilometres from your doorstep.

1342.description: This aprthotel is located in the tourist heart of Salou, just 150 meters from the seafront of Jaime I and about 2 km from the Portaventura World theme park. Numerous restaurants, bars can be found nearby. A bus stop can be reached within 5-minute walk, only 100 meters away. The hotel features spacious rooms and studios decorated in a Mediterranean-style offering the panoramic views of the swimming pool. Guests can also unwind at the Outdoor Summer Terrace. Reus Airport is 20-minute drive away.

1349.description: Situated in the heart of the tourist center, this hotel is a mere 50 meters from a beautiful sandy beach. Shops, restaurants, bars, and nightclubs are all within easy walking distance, as are public transport connections. The charming towns of Cambrils and Salou are just a short drive or bus ride away, located 3 km and 4 km from the hotel respectively. This air-conditioned hotel offers guests a TV room, a restaurant, and a public Internet terminal. On-site parking is also available. Each of the welcoming, air-conditioned rooms features a private bathroom, a double or twin bed, and a balcony. Guests can enjoy the outdoor complex, complete with a swimming pool, separate children's pool, and sun loungers. A variety of sporting activities and a bicycle station are also available. For evening entertainment, the hotel offers a seasonal program including dance evenings.

1350.description: This studio apartment is part of a six-story complex located 150 meters from Alboran Beach. Discos, public transport, bars, pubs, and restaurants are all within 250 meters. The studio features two single beds separated by a screen, a double sofa bed in the living area, a small kitchen, a full bathroom, and a terrace. Televisions are available for rent. Linens are included, but bath towels are not. Cleaning is provided upon arrival and departure. Guests can enjoy the complex's swimming pool, open from mid-June to September.

1358.description: The Hotel Olympus Palace is situated in the tourist center of Salou, 300 meters from the beach. The hotel is fully air-conditioned and heated. Rooms are equipped with a bathroom, a private terrace, a hairdryer, a telephone, LCD satellite TV, a free safety deposit box, and a free mini-fridge. Accessible rooms are available subject to availability. On the rooftop, guests can enjoy a solarium, spa, fitness area, and bar. The main floor features a large swimming pool with a fountain and a separate children's area, along with a playground. The hotel also offers a bar/coffee shop, a buffet restaurant with themed dinners and gala dinners on Fridays, free Wi-Fi throughout, an internet corner, and a game area. A conference room and optional garage parking are available subject to availability. With a wide range of entertainment, including live music and various shows throughout the week, the Hotel Olympus Palace is the perfect place to enjoy your holiday. Standard rooms are available on the first floor only. Superior rooms are available on the second, third, fourth, and fifth floors only.

1359.description: This modern beach hotel is situated in the centre of Cambrils. The hotel is idyllically situated just 150 metres from the pristine, sandy beach and is within easy access of an array of shops, restaurants, bars and pubs, offering guests the perfect setting from which to enjoy a relaxing seaside holiday close to the pulsating heart of the action. The hotel boasts a sleek, sophisticated architectural style with the inviting lobby featuring wooden elements and delightful designs. The guest rooms offer a quiescent sanctuary of peace and tranquility in which to enjoy a restful night's slumber. Guests can take advantage of the hotel's leisure facilities, lounging by the pool on the sun terrace or enjoying a refreshing swim. Guests are invited to enjoy the sumptuous delights the restaurant's buffet has to offer.

1363.description: This attractive beach hotel enjoys a central setting in San Carlos de la Rápita. The property is located just 200 metres away from the beach. The Delta del Ebro nature reserve can also be found nearby. A wide choice of shops, restaurants, bars and entertainment opportunities can be found nearby. Links to the public transport network can be found just 500 metres away. This charming hotel greets visitors with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms offer comfort and charm. The hotel features a restaurant, where guests can enjoy a delightful meal. The hotel offers facilities and services to ensure a comfortable stay for every type of traveller.

1372.description: This hotel is Ideally situated in the heart of Salou, close to the Plaza de Europa square, the popular laid-back apartment hote is just a few steps away from the golden sandy Levante beach, the beach promenade Jaime I, the Calle Zaragoza street and the large variety of shops, restaurants and bars in the surroundings. The train station and the thrilling Port Aventura theme park are both within a short stroll. There are one, two and three bedroom apartments offered by this comfortable hotel, sleeping up to eight persons. The bright relaxed apartments feature equipped kitchens, living rooms with flat-screen TVs and furnished terraces with free Wi-Fi. The front desk has multilingual staff standing by 24 hours a day to assist with tours/tickets and securing valuables. Additional amenities include an arcade/game room, a garden, and an ATM. Children will love the on-site mini-golf course and other features of the hotel include an extensive sun terrace with sun loungers, as well as a large outdoor pool with a separate children's play area. Families with children and groups of friends wishing to spend a lovely beach holiday under the Mediterranean sun have found the perfect place.

1377.description: Boasting a spectacular location in the centre of Salou, this hotel is a mere 100 metres from the beach and only a few steps away from public transport links. Port Aventura, an exciting theme park, is located some 5 km away, while Barcelona Airport is some 90 km from the hotel. This hotel exudes comfort and affordability. Coupling stylish, modern furnishings with decadently designed rooms, this hotel ensures that guests have an enjoyable stay. Guest rooms are spacious yet elegant offering essential amenities so that guests can fully enjoy their stay. Guests can enjoy a swim on the rooftop swimming pool which offers endearing views of the port and Salou itself. The hotel bar offers a range of snacks, whilst the restaurant serves a Mediterranean menu. Whether travelling for business or for pleasure, this hotel offers guests a memorable stay.

1378.description: This cozy and quiet hotel, located 50 meters from Racó Beach on the La Pineda seafront, was renovated in 2021. It offers a range of activities and facilities ideal for children, including two swimming pools surrounded by gardens accessible to both adults and children. The Hotel Sol d'Or provides the perfect setting for an unforgettable vacation surrounded by nature and the sea. Guest rooms are equipped with a full bathroom, terrace, telephone, satellite TV, heating, air conditioning (June 15th to September 15th), and an optional safe. The hotel offers a buffet restaurant featuring national and international cuisine (formal attire required) and a bar for enjoying cocktails. Guests can also relax in a lounge with satellite TV or the large garden area with children's games. Garage parking and bicycle rentals are available. (Catalonia tourist tax not included).

1379.description: This charming hotel sits just a few steps away from the beach in Cambrils. The hotel is situated within easy access of a number of attractions in the area, and is just a 15 minutes' walking distance from the heart of Salou. The hotel is also located just 2 km away from the Cambrils Par 3 Golf Course. Enjoying an attractive architectural design, the hotel welcomes guests with charm, elegance and warm hospitality. The guest rooms are tastefully appointed, offering a relaxing setting in which to completely unwind at the end of the day. The rooms are completely renovated. Guests are invited to dine in style in the restaurant, and to savour the delights of the buffet-style meals. For the perfect way to unwind, guests can enjoy a refreshing swim in the pool.

1382.description: Blaumar is located in a quiet part of Salou, overlooking Levante Beach and the seaside promenade. PortAventura theme park is just 5 minutes' drive away, while Salou's lively centre is 500 m away. Rooms are the Suite Mediterranea recently renovated and comprising a single, very spacious area with a dressing room, a bathroom with shower and a large terrace. The hotel also offers family apartments that are specially equipped to accomodate large families in comfort, up to 5 people (maximum 4 adults). The Blaumar's buffet restaurant offers authentic regional dishes made with local produce, as well as Spanish food and themed nights. There is also a popular à la carte restaurant, Arena.

1385.description: MedPlaya Hotel Calypso, in Salou, is reknowned for the quality and services it offers, its pools, all-inclusive package, and family-friendly environment. The Calypso offers recently renovated rooms, modern, bright, and comfortable double and family rooms, spread across two buildings. All rooms have a private bathroom, balcony, flat-screen satellite TV, air conditioning, safe, and telephone. Guests can enjoy the incredible pools, playground, games room, bars, lounges, buffet restaurant, and the “Al Fresco” restaurant. During the summer, entertainment is guaranteed with an animation programme for all ages. Other services provided by the hotel include free internet available throughout the hotel, 24-hour reception, bicycle parking, luggage storage, and a gift shop. The hotel is located within walking distance of Capellans Beach, one of the most beautiful beaches on the Costa Dorada. The Port Aventura theme park, Aquopolis water park, and Port Aventura golf course are also nearby. The cities of Tarragona (a UNESCO World Heritage site) and Reus (a modernist city and the birthplace of the famous architect Antoni Gaudí) can be easily reached by public transport. Reus Airport is just 10 km away. This hotel in Salou is ideal for a fun filled sunny family holiday. Don't miss out on everything that MedPlaya Hotel Calypso and its surroundings have to offer. You'll be captivated!

1391.description: The popular hotel is in an ideal location for reaching the tourist centre of Salou. It is only 150 metres to the nearest beautiful beach and Capellans. Countless shops and entertainment venues are located in the immediate vicinity. Built in 1973 the hotel was completely renovated in 2006. It offers a games room, a TV room, a newspaper stand and a shop. Dining options include a café and an air-conditioned restaurant with national and international 'show cooking' buffet. Younger guests may enjoy the play area or in the kids club. The tasteful en-suite rooms are equipped with a complete bathroom, air conditioning and an optional safe box. The hotel offers a swimming pool, a snack bar, sun loungers and shades as well as a solarium. The hotel organises a diverse entertainment programme, night and day.

1394.description: This delightful hotel is situated at the heart of the bustling tourist resort of Salou. Guests will find themselves just 500 metres away from the sprawling sandy beach. The hotel is located within easy access of a wide range of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. The hotel enjoys an attractive architectural design, welcoming guests into the relaxing surroundings of the interior. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, and come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Guests are sure to appreciate the wide range of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

1395.description: This 4-star hotel is located in a vibrant area of Salou, offering panoramic views of the promenade. Its 228 rooms provide the perfect retreat after a day of activities. Families will appreciate the amenities for both parents and children. Guests can also enjoy the outdoor summer terrace and billiards room.

1649.description:
Set in Tarragona’s modern district, this hotel offers soundproofed rooms with free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs. The A-7 motorway is just 200 metres away, while the historic centre is 10 minutes away. 

The rooms have air conditioning, hairdryer, safe and telephone. 

The hotel has a café open all day, serving coffee, breakfast and light meals. It also has a terrace. 

Tarragona’s famous Roman remains are just 900 metres away. The El Corte Inglés department store is just 450 metres away. PortAventura Theme Park is about 8 km away, and can be reached easily by car.

1650.description: Since it opened, the 4**** TERMES MONTBRIO has had a family-oriented clientele, proving its commitment to this public. Of particular note are the panoramic views of the garden. Its 214rooms have been designed to provide the right environment for a welcome rest. A bellboy service is available to guests. We also have Reading Room and Outdoor Summer Terrace.

1723.description: A family-friendly complex located within walking distance of the Port Aventura theme park. OVERVIEW: The Sol Costa Daurada is within walking distance of the iconic Port Aventura attraction offering a comfortable stay in a convenient location. For those travelling to the theme park, the hotel offers a free transfer throughout the high season. The hotel features plenty of activities and amenities with families in mind. There are two swimming pools, with a sun terrace, as well as a spa featuring gym, sauna and hot tub and an extensive treatment menu. Aside from Port Aventura, local attractions include Aquopolis water park as well as excursions for hiking and quad biking. Levante Beach is just a 10-minute walk away and some of the best golf courses in Catalonia can be found nearby. THE BEST BIT: Ideal for those travelling with kids, Sol Costa Daurada has a family-friendly ethos. The large outdoor pool is ideal for little ones, surrounded by a sun terrace with plenty of loungers. There is a designated children's pool with a playground and the kids' club hosts a range of activities. Parents can sit back and relax and enjoy the luxurious spa and wellness centre. ROOMS: There are various room types to cater for all guests, with standard double and twin rooms available as well as specially designed family rooms. Interconnecting rooms for families are available on request. All rooms feature their own private balcony. Rooms include: - Air conditioning - Satellite TV with international channels - Bathroom, complete with shower, toiletries and hairdryer. FOOD & DRINK: Sol Costa Daurada offers its own on-site restaurant, with all food served buffet-style. Guests can enjoy light snacks at the poolside bar or cool off with a refreshing drink at the British pub located on site. Breakfast, lunch and dinner are served daily in the main restaurant.

1725.description: Enjoy Cambrils from this hotel with an outdoor pool, sauna, and fitness center. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy on-site dining and room service. Relax at the poolside bar or one of two lounges. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel offers a business center, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning services. Host your event in one of the hotel's meeting rooms, totaling 2, 573 sq ft (239 sq m). Self-parking is available (fee applies). Each of the 156 guestrooms features a minibar, LCD TV, private balcony or patio, and satellite programming. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include several beaches (Regueral, Cambrils, La Llosa), Fisherman's Park, the History Museum of Cambrils, Pinaret Park, and La Llosa Roman Villa. Reus Airport (REU) is 9. 5 mi and Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) is 64. 2 mi away.

1735.description: This apartment complex is located in the tourist centre of Salou. Countless shopping venues, bars, restaurants and nightclubs are located close to the complex. Public transport departs from stops just 100 m away. The beach is some 500 m from the complex. Built in 1988, the apartment complex comprises a total of 96 apartments spread over 6 floors. Facilities include lifts, swimming pool and a garage. The simple apartments, which can hold up to 6 people, include a combined living/bedroom with a sofa bed, a separate bedroom with a double bed and an en-suite bathroom. It also has a kitchenette with a fridge and a furnished terrace. Final cleaning service is included in the price for the apartments. Bed sheets and hand towels are available for each of the bed and are changed on a weekly basis.

1815.description: This sublime beach hotel enjoys an idyllic setting close to Plaza Europa and the exciting Port Aventura Theme Park in the vibrant tourist hub of Salou. The hotel is a mere 300 metres away from the tourist centre of the town, where guests will discover a myriad of shops, bars, restaurants and entertainment venues. The sprawling sandy beach is located a mere 500 metres away from the hotel, offering guests the ideal location from which to enjoy leisurely, moonlit strolls, or to simply lie back and revel in the beauty of the stunning sunset and sunrise. The guest rooms are tastefully decorated and offer a calming environment in which to relax and unwind at the end of the day. Guests will appreciate the hotel's selection of leisure and recreational facilities which make for a truly unforgettable experience.

2667.description: Surrounded by a typically Mediterranean forest, this hotel is located in the quietest area of Salou, approximately 150 m from the inviting beach. It is close to the centre where guests will find a number of shops, bars and restaurants. This 6-storey hotel consists of 246 double rooms. An air-conditioned restaurant with highchairs for infants, a bar and a café are located on site. Guests can make use of the games room and TV room and Internet access is also on offer. In addition, there is a kids' club and a playground provided for younger guests.

2938.description: This hotel is located in the tourist centre and separated from the fine sandy beach by just a promenade. Countless shops, bars, restaurants and cafés are located in the immediate vicinity. The lively town centre, which is only 5 km away, offers plenty of shopping and entertainment venues. This modern beach and apartment hotel was built in 2001 and consists of 5 floors with a total of 113 apartments. The hotel's facilities include a refined lobby and a 24-hour reception with a currency exchange desk and lifts. A café, bar, newspaper stand, public Internet terminal and a small supermarket also feature. Furthermore, there is a TV lounge, games room and an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant with highchairs for children. Room and laundry and room service and medical assistance are provided. Younger guests can let off some steam in the hotel's children's playground. Car parking facilities in the form of a garage and a car park are available for those arriving by car. The inviting apartments are furnished with an en suite bathroom. A hairdryer, direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV and a safe also feature, and a kitchenette and a fridge come as standard. The hotel staff clean the rooms when guests have vacated them. The hotel has a swimming pool as well as a solarium. The hotel also provides an entertainment programme.

3156.address: Carrer Del Castell De La Suda, S/N
3156.description:
Enjoy the recreational facilities, which include a seasonal outdoor pool, or admire the view from the terrace and garden. Complimentary wireless internet access is provided. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks offered by the café. A buffet breakfast is served daily for a fee. You will have access to a business center and a 24-hour front desk at your disposal. Free self-parking is available. Feel at home in one of the 72 air-conditioned rooms, featuring a minibar and LED television. 
The Parador de Tortosa would like to inform you that it is not currently fully accessible, as access to the seasonal swimming pool is via stairs.

3217.description: This apartment complex is located in the tourist and commercial center of Salou, a 10-minute walk from Llevant Beach and conveniently close to Port Aventura World and Ferrari Land (1-2 miles). Salou Port Aventura Station is a 20-minute walk away. Situated along the mesmerizing Costa Dorada, the complex offers easy access to a wide array of attractions, activities, shopping, dining, and entertainment. The tastefully designed apartments are well-equipped with modern amenities, providing comfort and convenience complemented by attentive service. Guests can enjoy climate control, Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs with digital cable channels, and mobile phone network access. The complex also features a casino, a sunbathing terrace, and an outdoor pool. For active guests, diving, golfing, canoeing, and sailing are available.

3227.description: The hotel is in a prime location, close to the centre of Salou, Levante Beach, and Port Aventura. The hotel offers excellent accommodation and a wide range of services, as well as numerous activities and entertainment options for the whole family. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, currency exchange and lift access. The hotel includes a games room, TV lounge, children's playground and kids' club. There is a café, bar and restaurant. Conference facilities are available and wireless Internet access is provided.

3268.description:
Immerse yourself in a tropical oasis with Europe’s largest white-sand swimming pools surrounded by Caribbean-style gardens. The hotel recreates an authentic island atmosphere with themed buildings, palm trees and relaxing areas. 

It includes unlimited access to PortAventura Park during the stay and 1-day access to Ferrari Land per person (according to opening calendar). Guests also benefit from priority booking for table-service restaurants inside the parks and Pick-Up service in PortAventura Park and Ferrari Land shops. 

The exclusive Club San Juan offers a private reception, a restaurant with outdoor terrace and a reserved pool area.

3478.description: This charming beach hotel is located in the lively center of Salou. The property is only 150 meters from the well-known Plaza Europa and the golden sand and warm blue sea of the endless beach of this holiday resort. Port Aventura and the town center are within easy reach, while Reus airport is just 10 kilometers away. This modern hotel welcomes guests with a warm welcome and provides wonderful service in a relaxing environment. The rooms are very well laid out, providing guests with a peaceful environment in which to relax and unwind at the end of the day. In addition, the establishment offers a wonderful selection of quality facilities and services. ***The elevator only goes up to the 6th floor and the penthouses are located on the 7th floor ***

3536.description: An invitation to experience a typical colonial-style Mexican Hacienda where strict attention has been paid to settings and detail. Its rooms are distributed over 6 buildings around a central area with spectacular gardens and irresistible crystalline water swimming pools, one of which features a sunken galleon where the kids will have hours of fun. This hotel, located at the gates of PortAventura Parks, has unlimited access to PortAventura Park throughout the stay and 1-day access to Ferrari Land included per stay and person (according to parks opening dates and times). Also offers preferential booking for table service restaurants in the parks via the hotel's Guest Service Desk and Pick-Up service at PortAventura Park and Ferrari Land shops. PortAventura Parks main entrance is just a 5-minute walk from the hotel. It has its own train station and it is just 20 minutes' drive from the high-speed train station, 3. 5 km from the A-7 motorway and 10 minutes' drive from Reus airport. The all-inclusive rate offers lunch and dinner menus in the hotel's Mexican restaurant or in PortAventura Park and Ferrari Land, applicable to designated food outlets and subject to opening hours.

3537.address: Avda. Alcalde De Pere Molas, S/N
3537.description: The hotel is a reproduction of a town on the Catalan coast with its 'plazas', streets, bars… creating a perfect and tranquil environment. There is no better place to stay than the Hotel PortAventura, a replica of a charming fishing village. Stroll through its streets surrounded by lakes, waterfalls and extensive vegetation and experience the calm of the Mediterranean. This hotel, located inside PortAventura Park, has unlimited access to PortAventura Park throughout the stay and 1-day access to Ferrari Land included per stay and person (according to parks opening dates and times), discount on Caribe Aquatic Park tickets, preferential booking for table service restaurants in the parks via the hotel's Guest Service Desk and Pick-Up service at PortAventura Park and Ferrari Land shops. Relax with the whole family and bathe in the hotel's swimming pools to the backdrop of the Mediterranean and enjoy the local cuisine in its restaurants. Grand refusbisment in 2019.

3546.description: The Ametlla Mar Hotel **** situated in a pintoresque cove at the south of Costa Dorada, offers 243 rooms, most of them with seaview. At your disposal you will find the best and fully equipped facilities, which let you enjoy of relaxing days next to the sea, in a privileged environment. Marvellous for families, the Ametlla Mar Hotel is also perfect for a weekend breakaway with your friends or partner. For more information, please take a look to our offers section. You will be able to spend some romantic days with your mate, relax in our Spa, sunbathe at the beach from which you will be able to acceed from the hotel gardens', or just enjoy the best gastronomy of the zone in our restaurant with Show Cooking. Facilities:Swimming pools for adults and childrenWide terraces and gardensBuffet Restaurant with Show CookingCafeteria, Snack Bar in the PoolPlayground, Miniclub, Junior ClubTV and Games RoomSPA: sauna, Turkish bath, swimming pool, jacuzzi, gym** Surcharge ¬ 7, 00 per roomMassages and treatmentsFree WIFIMeeting and Conference roomsBoutiqueParking

3575.description: This stunning beach hotel is situated in La Pineda de Salou, not far from the town centre. Many public transport links are to be found in the surrounding area. Scores of shops, bars and restaurants are within easy reach, within 150 metres of the hotel. Built in 2002, this beach hotel offers a total of 260 rooms, together with a wide range of facilities that will ensure guests are comfortable throughout their stay. Guests can enjoy a lovely dining experience in the on-site café and an air-conditioned buffet restaurant with a separate non-smoking area and highchairs for infants. The comfortable rooms which await guests comprise an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer and modern amenities. During the day, guests can laze in the indoor swimming pool or enjoy refreshments from the snack bar next to the outdoor swimming pool.

3783.description: This splendid hotel enjoys a fabulous location in Calafell, within only 350 metres from the railway station and within a few paces from the gorgeous sandy beach. Surrounded by a wide variety of restaurants, shops and vibrant nightlife, this elegant property is a perfect place for relaxing and fun-filled holiday. Within a short car ride travellers may find the popular theme and the historic city of Tarragona. The hotel's rooms are carefully designed and feature spacious surroundings fitted with charming furniture and modern amenities. The in-house restaurant offers sumptuous and rich buffet-style meals and show cooking. On warm days, adults may freshen up at the sparkling outdoor pool while the youngest ones romp at the paddling pool. Additionally, guests may also make use of children playground, games room, sauna and lounge as well as on-site parking.

3786.description: This delightful city hotel enjoys a great setting, lying at the heart of El Vendrell's tourist area. Guests will find themselves just 4 km away from Sant Salvador and Coma Ruga beaches. The hotel is located just a short distance away from links to the public transport network, as well as a host of attractions, shopping opportunities and dining options. This charming hotel welcomes guests with the promise of an enjoyable stay. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, offering a haven of peace and serenity in which to unwind in comfort at the end of the day. The hotel offers a wide range of excellent facilities, meeting the leisure and dining needs of every type of traveller.

3787.description: This hotel enjoys a great setting on the Comarruga Beach in Tarragona. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to many of the exciting attractions and areas of natural beauty that the region has to offer. The hotel is located just 3 km from El Vendrell Golf Course, and offers the perfect setting for guests who are eager to enjoy the exciting activities that are available in the area. Enjoying a charming architectural style, the hotel greets guests with warm hospitality and the promise of a memorable stay. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, and feature soothing tones and luxurious furnishings. The hotel affords guests a number of exemplary facilities, catering to the needs of every type of traveller to a high level of excellence.

3788.description: Hotel Ibersol Playa Dorada is located 150 meters from San Salvador Beach and offers a swimming pool, seasonal entertainment program and sports facilities. The spacious rooms at the Ibersol Playa Dorada have a telephone, balcony, private bathroom with shower or bathtub and air conditioning. The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool for adults, another for children, an area with sun loungers and parasols, and a children's water park. In our hotel you can relax and enjoy a peaceful stay as a couple or as a family, as well as practice various sports or play table tennis and billiards. The hotel has a large garden area and has a bar near the swimming pool as well as a magnificent buffet restaurant serving a wide variety of Spanish and international dishes. The nearest golf course is about 5 km away. The Hotel is pet friendly (with supplement).

3812.description: This wonderful hotel is situated in the heart of the tourist center of L'Hospitalet de l'Infant, just a 10-minute walk from the beach and the town center. Numerous shops, cafés, bars, and restaurants surround the hotel. Guests will enjoy a comfortable stay with the facilities available at this hotel. Those looking to work on their tan can make use of the sun loungers by the pool or on the solarium. Cycling and mountain biking are also available, as well as billiards. In the evenings, guests can retire to their comfortable, well-equipped rooms featuring modern amenities. The on-site restaurant serves a buffet for all three meals for those who prefer to dine at the hotel.

3830.description: MedPlaya Hotel Pino Alto, in Miami Platja, is the perfect place to enjoy a sunny holiday on the Costa Dorada. Pino Alto offers spacious rooms with private balconies, satellite TV, minibar, air conditioning, safe, telephone, and free WiFi, ensuring all the necessary comforts. The extensive facilities of the establishment include beautiful gardens, a playground, and two outdoor pools, one of which is for children. The buffet-style restaurant offers a wide variety of national and international dishes catering to all tastes. During the summer, entertainment is guaranteed with the animation programme. Additionally, there is also a poolside bar and other amenities such as a gym and games room. Hotel Pino Alto is conveniently located just 150 metres from the magnificent Playa Cristal in Miami Platja. This Costa Dorada establishment is close to highly attractive tourist spots such as the PortAventura theme park or the Ebro Delta. Don't miss out on everything that MedPlaya Hotel Pino Alto and its surroundings can offer you. You'll be captivated!

3845.description: MedPlaya Hotel Vistamar, in Hospitalet de l'Infant, is a family hotel by the sea that brings you the best of Costa Dorada. With magnificent views of the beachfront, Vistamar offers fully equipped rooms decorated in cheerful colors and WiFi. Discover its pool by the sea, restaurants, terrace, bar, and game room. Enhance your stay with a pizza at Pizzeria Vistamare or take a dip in the beach of l'Hospitalet, right in front of the hotel. Don't miss out on everything that MedPlaya Hotel Vistamar and its surroundings can offer you. You'll be captivated!

3869.description: These holiday homes are well-located in the front line, near the sea promenade that joins the towns of Cambrils and Salou (at a distance of 1 kilometre), in the heart of the Costa Daurada. The establishment is only a few kilometres from Port Aventura theme park and Cambrils' gastronomic centre. All the apartments can sleep from two to four people and come equipped with excellent services for a comfortable stay such as air-conditioning and a fully appointed kitchenette. All services are offered at the Augustus Hotel, where guests will be able to access to all its facilities, including an outdoor pool and a pool bar, where they will enjoy with the whole family and both adults and children will appreciate the entertainment programme available.

4154.description: This great hotel, built in 1974 and surrounded by a garden, is strategically situated in the very centre of the touristic city of Salou and is within a 10 minute walk from the closest local beach. Guests will be able to find in the immediate vicinity a number of bars, pubs and nightclubs. The nearest public transport stops 500 m from the hotel. This is a great place to spend a few days under the bright sun and by the crystal clear Mediterranean waters.

4155.description: This modern hotel is located in the heart of “Costa Dorada” in the popular tourist area of Salou. The property is just 250 metres from the beautiful golden sand beaches and a few minutes from the ludic area. Hotel amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the property, restaurant and swimming pool. The guest rooms are comfortable, relaxing, and decorated in beautiful shades of blue. Some of the room amenities include a private balcony, air conditioning and cosy bedding. The onsite restaurant offers patrons buffet style dining with traditional dishes along with continental fare. Enjoy a refreshing cocktail with friends at the hotels bar and lounge after a day at the pool. Guests will enjoy live flamenco dancing, karaoke and live music performances. Some of the local attractions include PortAventura, Salou Train Station, Aquopolis la Pineda and Ferrari land all within 2 kilometres from your doorstep.

4156.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as an outdoor pool, a terrace, and a garden at this all-inclusive hotel. Wireless internet access is complimentary, and guests can also enjoy an arcade/game room and a television in the common area. Meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments are included in all-inclusive rates, with some exceptions applying to specific restaurants, special dinners and dishes, select beverages, and other amenities. The hotel offers a restaurant, a coffee shop/cafe, and a bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). The hotel's 161 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, private furnished balconies, complimentary wireless internet access, satellite programming, and private bathrooms with deep soaking bathtubs. Nearby attractions include Llarga Beach (0. 2 mi), Capellans Beach (0. 2 mi), Llevant Beach (0. 6 mi), and Municipal Park (0. 5 mi). The nearest airports are Reus (REU) - 8. 4 mi and Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) - 61 mi.

4157.description: This hotel is beautifully situated in the village of Coma Ruga, in Tarragona. It is ideally set overlooking the sea, just 10 metres away from the beach. Surrounded by natural beauty and splendour, the hotel is just a short walking distance away from the marina. Tarragona is located just a 30 minutes' driving distance from the hotel. The hotel enjoys close proximity to Reus and El Prat airports. Port Aventura can be found just a 30 minutes' drive away. This wonderful hotel blends superbly with its surroundings. The tastefully-styled guest rooms feature soothing tones, for a peaceful ambiance. The hotel offers buffet-style dining, with local and international cuisines sure to impress .

4159.description: This campsite is located in Cambrils (Tarragona), 500 m away from the town centre. The beach is some 400 m from the bungalows. The Port Aventura theme park is nearby. The good weather coming off the Costa Daurada and the sea ensure cool weather in the summer and a pleasant temperature all year round. The campsite features lush vegetation and many different species of trees, creating a special ambience and ensuring a very enjoyable stay. The campsite has a total of 200 bungalows. A wide range of amenities and services are on offer, such as complimentary hot water. There is also a restaurant and a bar on site. Those arriving by car can make use of the car park. The rooms are spacious and cool. There are 2 swimming pools within the campsite, one of which is 50 m in length and has lanes. Guests can play tennis or take advantage of the varied entertainment programme.

4215.description: This hotel enjoys a stunning setting, lying at the heart of the historical centre of Tarragona. Guests will find themselves just a few steps away from the amphitheatre and within easy access of a host of attractions. The hotel lies in close proximity to a number of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. This wonderful hotel appeals to business and leisure travellers alike, welcoming them into the relaxing surroundings of the interior. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, and feature modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Guests can enjoy a leisurely swim in the pool, or enjoy an energetic game of tennis on the court.

4376.description: Located near the beach in Tarragona, the AC Hotel Tarragona by Marriott is within a 15-minute drive of PortAventura World and Plaza Imperial Tarraco. This upscale hotel is also conveniently close to Tarragona Port and provides easy access to other attractions. Enjoy amenities such as a fitness center and rooftop terrace with stunning views. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. The hotel's 115 guestrooms feature minibars, flat-screen televisions, and private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Conveniences include safes, desks, and complimentary cribs/infant beds upon request. Enjoy a bite at the snack bar/deli, room service (limited hours), or relax at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available weekdays and weekends for a fee. For business travelers, the hotel offers a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event planning is made easy with conference space and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

4414.address: Urbanización Cap Roig, Carrer de Marinada
4414.description: Situated in the heart of the Costa Dorada, this hotel is 200 metres from Cap Roig Beach and 3 km from the Ampolla. The modern and comfortable complex comprises a total of 139 well-appointed apartments. All accommodation units feature an integrated living room/bedroom and a separate bedroom, as well as an en-suite bathroom and a kitchenette. A mini-bar and central heating and air conditioning units are also standard features in all apartments. There is an indoor heated swimming pool and a freshwater pool at guest's disposal. Fitness enthusiasts are welcomed to take advantage of the on-site gym, and the hotel also offers the use of a solarium and sauna.

4762.description: This modern hotel complex is conveniently located near the sandy beach, just 50 meters from the shore, in the town center. Guests can enjoy a variety of amenities including a café, hairdresser, bar, and restaurant. Children will appreciate the playground and kids' club, while adults can relax in the expansive garden featuring two swimming pools, a poolside snack bar, a sun terrace, a hot tub, and a sauna. Games and entertainment programs are available for both children and adults. Ample parking is provided. The comfortable rooms are well-equipped, and buffet-style breakfast, lunch, and dinner are served.

4842.description: This building is situated in the centre of Salou, only 200 m from the beach. The property is located in the shopping and recreational centre and is just 200 m from the main promenade, Jaime I. The whole family is sure to enjoy a visit to Universal's Port Aventura theme park, which is situated just 5 minutes from the complex, and can be easily reached by bus. The homely hotel comprises 60 apartments and offers personal attention and a warm welcome. It is an ideal accommodation choice for families and the perfect place to spend an unforgettable holiday. Guests are welcomed to take advantage of the TV lounge and games room or enjoy a drink at the café and bar. They can also make use of the outdoor swimming pool with children's swimming area and relax at the sun loungers.

4951.description: This fascinating and centrally located establishment enjoys a fantastic location at only 200 m from the beach, in Salou, close to Port Aventura and set in the most popular shopping area of the city. This hotel is the perfect choice for those who search for a unique environment to unwind and relax in couple or enjoy a fantastic friend's holiday. With a modern, elegant and cosy atmosphere, the property boasts a large amount of activities offered by a professional entertainment team. Likewise it provides comfortable rooms with a contemporary décor, which are equipped with all the necessary amenities to enjoy a pleasant stay. The hotel features an on-site buffet-style restaurant with show cooking as well as three different bars, where guests may sample delicious cocktails and light snacks. The sparkling outdoor pool, with its hot tub and solarium, is the perfect place to relax and leave all the stress behind. Enjoy our new plunge pool and sun loungers at the hotel´s roof top.

4964.description: This luxurious property boasts an ideal location in Salou, just 150 metres from Cala Penya Tallada beach. Guests will find themselves close to Port Aventura theme park, situated just 7 kilometres from this modern property. Featuring magnificent views over the Costa Daurada, it provides a host of rooms and fully-equipped apartments ideal for those travellers seeking a self-catering accommodation. The spacious rooms include a large terrace where guests can sunbathe, relax or enjoy a refreshing drink. As for the apartments, they all come with a fully-equipped kitchen area and a living room.   Travellers will appreciate the wide range of services and facilities on offer, including a full entertainment programme, a kid's zone and water attractions to help the little ones to enjoy a memorable holiday. This resort also offers different dining options such as à la carte restaurant ' The Masia', a pizzeria 'Il forno' , children's buffet and show cooking. Special conditions for apartment cleaning service: Towel change frequency: 2 times weekly. Linen change frequency: 1 time weekly*. * Beds only made with the linen change

5081.description: This hotel is beautifully located in Tarragona, just a few steps away from the historical centre of the city. An abundance of shops and entertainment can be found close by. Guests can enjoy a stroll along the nearby beach, or simply lie back and unwind. The hotel is conveniently located just 14 km away from the nearest airport. This hotel features contemporary guest rooms, which have been designed in a minimalist style. The hotel features an outdoor pool, where guests can enjoy a leisurely swim. Guests can lie back and relax amidst the serene surroundings of the hotel's garden. This hotel offers the ideal setting in which to completely escape the bustle of daily life.

5421.description: The Rentalmar Blue Beach apartments enjoy an excellent location in the tourist center of Salou. The complex offers accommodation complemented with a solarium terrace and an outdoor pool that also has a bar where you can relax while enjoying the bath. The promenade and the beach are located a few meters from the apartments, as well as Port Aventura where you can walk in about 20 minutes. The Guinness Tavern and The Cotton Club Restaurant & Cocktails are a 5-minute walk from the property. Capellans beach is also within walking distance from the apartment and Reus airport is a 20-minute drive away. All units are equipped with balcony, TV, air conditioning and kitchen.

5445.description: The Tesoro Manzanillo All Inclusive is a great family-friendly hotel which enjoys a great beachfront location in the renowned area of Manzanillo, on the southern coast of Mexico and boasts a private access to its own secluded beach in La Audiencia. The hotel provides unlimited services and great facilities, such as a pool bar with ocean views. Within a few minutes' walk guests will reach the centre where a good selection of nightclubs, bars and restaurants can be found. Backed by Sierra Madres Mountains, this idyllic setting will guarantee its guests a delightful stay.

6244.description: The fully renovated Dukes' Academie, a four-star hotel established in 1988, is located in Bruges city center, next to the Lake of Love and a short walk from the train station. Guests can enjoy the hotel's bar and fitness center. All 90 rooms are equipped with a hairdryer, safe, and air conditioning. Parking and baby cots are available upon request for an additional fee of €25 and €12 per night, respectively. Guests are encouraged to specify bedding preferences for their classic or triple rooms prior to arrival by contacting the hotel at Info@dukesacademie. com or +32 50 33 22 66.
