6245.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Bruges and was established in 1998. It is close to the market square and the nearest station is 10 min away by car. The Hotel has a offers a very extensive breakfast buffet and has a bar. All 46 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe and air conditioning.

6378.description: The 3*** star superior Derby Hotel in Grindelwald is situated in a central location directly at the train station. The traditional hotel is a home of familial hospitality and offers the ideal departure point for all kinds of summer and winter sports, as well as an excursion to the legendary Jungfraujoch. Our 69 comfortably furnished rooms provide the right atmosphere to relax. After an eventful day outside in the fresh alpine air you are welcome to relax in our sauna which is free of charge, or use the indoor swimming pool at the sports centre in 300 m walking distance, where you get free admission with your guest card. The delicate Bernese cuisine can be enjoyed in our à la carte restaurant Föhrenstube. During the winter season our cosy cellar restaurant 'Cava' invites you as well to taste a fondue or raclette in rustic ambience. Please note that our parking possibilities are limited, vary by size of the vehicle and therefore cannot be reserved in advance. In order to be able to offer a parking space at no charges for our guests, we kindly ask to deposit the car keys at the reception desk on arrival. Our porters will be pleased to take care of placing all vehicles. Bookings for the same day are possible until 10. 00pm.

6379.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the on-site spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Recreational opportunities include a nightclub, an outdoor pool, and a spa tub. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, ski storage, and a hair salon. Enjoy a meal at the Rotisserie restaurant with garden views or take advantage of room service (during limited hours). Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A train station pick-up service is provided at no charge, and self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Make yourself at home in one of the 44 guest rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions with satellite programming. Complimentary Wi-Fi is provided. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. The hotel is located near First Cable Car (0. 2 mi), Oberer Gletscher (0. 2 mi), and Gletscherschlucht (0. 2 mi). The preferred airport is Bern (BRN-Belp).

6380.description: Indulge in a relaxing spa treatment, including massages, at the Eiger Guest House Grindelwald aparthotel. Enjoy the sauna and fitness center, as well as complimentary Wi-Fi, an arcade/game room, and ski storage. Savor a meal at Barry's restaurant and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available daily (7 AM to 11 AM, for a fee). The aparthotel offers dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and on-site self-parking (subject to charges). The 7 guestrooms feature kitchens equipped with refrigerators and ovens, complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, desks, and daily housekeeping. Located in Grindelwald, a short walk from Oberer Gletscher and Gletscherschlucht, the Eiger Guest House is also convenient to First (10. 3 km) and Eiger (14 km).

6381.description: This 3 star hotel is located in the city centre of Grindelwald and was established in 1960. It is 20.0 Km from the Interlaken and the nearest station is Grindelwald. The Hotel has 2 restaurants and a conference room. All 40 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer and safe.

6382.description: The hotel is located in Grindelwald in the beautiful Bernese Oberland. The centre of the village and the train station are about 500 m away. Mountain railways and cablecars, which take you to the various skiing and hiking areas in the region, are about 1 km from the hotel. You can reach the mountain railways in about 15 minutes on foot or in about 5 minutes with the free local bus. The hotel has two buildings, the main building 'Jungfrau' and the annex 'Crystal'. The friendly furnished rooms of the hotel are each equipped with a private bathroom/WC. Further facilities include a TV and hairdryer.

6416.description: This 4-star hotel is located in the center of Wengen, 20 meters from the train station, surrounded by breathtaking mountain views visible from every balcony. The hotel boasts two restaurants, a bar, a sun terrace, indoor and outdoor Jacuzzis, a sauna, and a fitness room. The cable car station, just 100 meters away, whisks you up to the Männlichen summit (2, 222m) in five minutes, offering stunning alpine panoramas. Wengen also features a cinema and a 25m outdoor pool.

6502.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, tour/ticket assistance, and a banquet hall. Enjoy Irish cuisine at Lock Four Restaurant, a fine-dining restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Limited parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 260 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

name.content: Temple Bar Hotel by the Unlimited Collection

6503.description: This charming hotel boasts an enviable setting in the vibrant city of Dublin. The hotel is situated close to O'Connell Bridge, in the bustling Temple Bar area. Guests will find themselves in the ideal setting from which to explore and experience the rich culture and heritage of this exciting city. Guests can stroll along the cobblestones of the renowned Temple Bar, enjoy traditional Irish dancing shows, or simply sit back and enjoy the lively Irish music for which the country is renowned. This wonderful hotel comprises beautifully-appointed accommodation options, which offer a relaxing setting in which to escape the bustle of the city. Guests are invited to dine in style in the restaurant, and to take advantage of the host of facilities that the hotel has to offer.

name.content: The Morrison Dublin, Curio Collection by Hilton

6505.description: The 5-star Morrison Dublin, located on Lower Ormond Quay in Dublin's city centre, overlooks the River Liffey. This design-led hotel offers a warm ambiance and friendly service. Enjoy easy access to transport links, with the Jervis Street Luas stop directly behind the hotel, connecting you to train stations, The O2, IFSC, and the Dublin Convention Centre. Explore the vibrant Temple Bar area just across the river, and find shopping at Jervis Street and Henry Street nearby. The hotel features 157 guest rooms and suites, including a spacious penthouse with city views. A newly added fitness centre complements the hotel's amenities. Dine at The Morrison Grill, featuring a charcoal-burning Josper grill and locally sourced produce, or enjoy bespoke cocktails in the retro-chic Quay 14 bar. High-speed internet access is available throughout the hotel, and rooms include 40-inch HD TVs, air conditioning, minibars, and laptop safes.

6519.description: The Aberdeen Douglas Hotel, built in 1848, is a beloved landmark in Aberdeen's city center. This historic, privately-owned hotel offers contemporary style and a warm welcome. A short walk from the train and bus station, it features 98 rooms, conference facilities for up to 400 guests, and a bistro. Business travelers will appreciate its central location and complimentary Wi-Fi. Leisure travelers can enjoy easy access to nearby attractions like the Aberdeen Maritime Museum and shopping center. The hotel blends personal service with genuine hospitality for a memorable stay. Please note: Check-in for Apartment Executive rooms is at the Royal Athenaeum Suites, a 5-minute walk from the main hotel building at 15 Union Street.

6522.description: Conveniently located near the International Convention Centre, National Indoor Arena, National Exhibition Centre (NEC), Edgbaston Cricket Grounds, and major business centers, this hotel offers easy access to the M5 and M6 motorways, Birmingham International Airport, and the NEC. The hotel features 126 bedrooms and extensive meeting and function facilities, along with free Wi-Fi and ample free parking. A £100 security deposit is required upon check-in, either as a pre-authorization on a card or as a cash deposit.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel & Spa Chester

6530.description: A timeless luxury hotel in Cheshire, set on the outskirts of historic Chester and surrounded by twelve acres of landscaped gardens, the elegant Doubletree by Hilton Chester hotel provides luxurious accommodation only a few minutes from the city centre. This carefully restored 18th-century manor house beautifully combines the past and the present, offering modern comforts and conveniences with traditional styling and decor, resulting in a stylish yet classical ambience. The Doubletree by Hilton Chester Hotel's outstanding facilities include a full-service luxury spa. Well connected to the city and only a 40-minute drive from both Manchester and Liverpool's airports, the hotel is an ideal venue for unforgettable weddings, business conferences and luxurious leisure breaks. A first class experience awaits you at the Doubletree by Hilton Chester hotel. The following services and amenities are available, but with **reduced service**: Fitness Center, Pool, Spa. Our spacious and comfortable Guest Rooms and Suites are elegantly decorated and feature Super King Size beds with Sweet Dreams Pillow, 32' flat screen HDTV with 58 channels, air conditioning, complimentary high speed internet access, Tea and Coffee making facilities, Mini Fridges (stocked upon request), Hairdryers, Iron and Ironing Boards, Electronic Safes, luxury bathrooms with Neutrogena body and bath products. The hotel also features beautifully designed Accessible and Family Rooms for your convenience.

6531.description: From Robert Burns to Sir Walter Scott, our landmark hotel has hosted the bold and curious for over 200 years. Now, it’s your turn to experience our warm Edinburgh welcome. Our iconic building on one of the capital’s most prestigious streets offers the perfect location for exploring the city. With our insider knowledge, you’ll take in spectacular views and cultural curiosities. Set the scene for remarkable memories in our luxurious suites, world-class restaurant and other unique spaces.

6532.description: Nestled perfectly between Edinburgh's Old and New Towns, Hotel Indigo Edinburgh - Princes Street offers guests the best of both worlds. Explore the unparalleled historic attractions of Old Edinburgh, then step into the heart of the world-famous New Town, renowned for its unique shops, champagne bars, designer boutiques, and independent retailers showcasing Scottish produce. The hotel's design draws inspiration from Edinburgh's rich history as a meeting place for great thinkers, literary pioneers, poets, and authors—a legacy that continues to inspire artists and creators today. Hotel Indigo Edinburgh - Princes Street aims to ignite your imagination with thoughtfully designed rooms reflecting the city's vibrant spirit. Our stylish bedrooms feature air conditioning, a 40' LCD TV, an invigorating rainfall shower, luxurious toiletries, and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. Many rooms offer perfectly framed views of Edinburgh Castle, a majestic landmark dominating the skyline since the 12th century. Savor Scotland's finest meat and seafood at our multi-award-winning restaurant, Twenty Princes Street, and enjoy handcrafted cocktails, wines, and coffees in the Juniper cocktail lounge.

6534.description: Relax in the full-service spa, enjoying massages, body treatments, and facials. For recreation, you'll find a health club, indoor pool, and sauna. This hotel also offers complimentary wireless and wired internet access, concierge and wedding services, and a 24-hour business center. Dine at One Square restaurant and bar/lounge, or enjoy room service (limited hours). Full breakfasts are served weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (fee applies). For events, the hotel boasts 16, 641 square feet (1546 square meters) of space, including conference areas and 14 meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (fee applies). The 269 guest rooms feature minibars and LCD televisions.

name.content: Radisson Blu Hotel, Edinburgh City Centre

6535.description: Enjoy a luxurious stay at the Radisson Blu Hotel in Edinburgh City Centre, steps from the Royal Mile. Indulge in the full-service spa with body treatments and facials, or take advantage of the health club, indoor pool, and sauna. Savor a meal at the restaurant, a snack in the cafe, or a drink at the bar/lounge. 24-hour room service is also available. The hotel's 238 guestrooms feature LCD TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms. Business amenities include a business center and conference space. Self-parking is available (charges apply). Nearby attractions include Edinburgh Castle, St. Giles' Cathedral, and the Edinburgh Dungeon.

6536.description: Nestled in the beautiful Victorian district of Edinburgh, this charming hotel is just over a 10-minute walk from the city centre and the main entertainment areas. Its guests will be a short 15-minute stroll away from the old town, the Royal Mile and the famous castle, and there are convenient links to the public transport in the immediate vicinity. The small, friendly and independent hotel hides a modern interior behind its Victorian façade. The designer furniture, modern bathrooms with Parisien Metro tiles and Hansgrohe power showers are just part of the comforts which make it the perfect place for relaxing. Those who need to escape from the noise of the city can enjoy a beautiful courtyard garden, while the modern lounge is a great place where to sip a chilled drink at the end of the day. For its perfect start guests can savour the cooked-to-order daily full Scottish breakfast.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Edinburgh - City West

6537.description: Welcome to Holiday Inn Express® Edinburgh City West. Just off the A90 and a quick taxi from Haymarket Station. Edinburgh Waverley Station is a 15-minute drive away for catching trains to Glasgow and Newcastle. Edinburgh Airport is a 10-kilometre drive from the hotel. Explore the history of Edinburgh Castle, a 15-minute drive away and enjoy panoramic views of the city. Catch a rugby match at Scottish Gas Murrayfield Stadium and cheer on your favourite team, just a 5-minute drive away. Discover over 200 species at Edinburgh Zoo, from giant pandas to penguins or enjoy a fun day out at Camera Obscura’s World of Illusions, both a 10-minute drive. Dive into modern and contemporary art at National Galleries of Scotland: Modern One, a 20-minute walk from the hotel. Shop for souvenirs and grab a bite to eat in the luxury St James Quarter or stroll through Princes Street and Edinburgh’s Old Town. Take a hike up Arthur’s Seat for breath-taking views of Edinburgh’s skyline and wander through the Royal Botanical Gardens, a short drive from our hotel. Relax after a busy day in your room with a flat-screen TV and en-suite with shower. Enjoy a free buffet breakfast each morning before heading out for the day. Order light bites and coffees throughout the day and grab a bite to eat in the evening from our snack menu. Relax with drinks from the bar in our Great Room and catch up with free Wi-Fi.

6538.description: Enjoy a central Edinburgh stay at the eco-certified Apex City of Edinburgh Hotel, steps from Grassmarket and a short walk from Edinburgh Castle. This hotel offers 122 guestrooms equipped with LED TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, designer toiletries, and in-room safes. Start your day with a full breakfast (available for a fee), and utilize convenient amenities such as concierge and wedding services, dry cleaning/laundry, and a 24-hour front desk. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). The hotel is also conveniently located near Princes Street and the Royal Mile.

6539.description: This 3 star hotel is located within the city of Edinburgh and was established in 1998. It is a short drive away from the Edinburgh Castle. The Hotel has a restaurant, a bar, a conference room and a coffee shop. All 66 rooms are equipped with hairdryer, safe, trouser press and ironing set.

6540.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Complimentary Evening Social, Executive Lounge, Fitness Center, On-site Restaurant(s). Situated just 10 minutes from Glasgow Queen Street and Glasgow Central railway stations, DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Glasgow Central is a stylish hotel with wonderful, characterful interiors. Nestled in the heart of the city centre, we're within easy walking distance of the main shopping district and a host of top attractions including the famous Glasgow City Chambers and iconic Glasgow Cathedral. Fully refurbished in 2016, DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Glasgow Central boasts 300 elegant guest rooms and suites, all offering the comforts of home. Each guest room features complimentary WiFi, a 40-inch LCD TV, work desk, and 24-hour room service. Should you require even more space, choose a suite with separate living area and kitchenette. Upgrade for access to the Executive Lounge, complimentary continental breakfast and evening refreshments. Sample a variety of delicious British and European dishes for breakfast and dinner in our onsite restaurant. Following a long day, unwind with a cold drink and light bite in our stylish bar. Anything from a small meeting to a large conference or award ceremony can be held in our 13 event rooms – our Grand Ballroom is the largest hotel ballroom in Scotland, seating up to 1, 500 guests. Other fantastic facilities include a fully-equipped gym.

6541.description: lyf George Square Glasgow is a 4-star lifestyle hotel located in the heart of Glasgow city centre, just moments from George Square, Merchant City, shopping districts, restaurants and cultural attractions. Offering 91 modern rooms, the hotel combines comfort, convenience and social living with coworking spaces, a restaurant and bar, and vibrant communal areas. Ideal for both business and leisure travellers looking to experience Glasgow's dynamic atmosphere from a central location.

6543.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. To-go breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 247 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Grosvenor Casino Glasgow, Riverboat - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Buchanan Street - 0.

6544.description: Situated in the heart of Inverness' vibrant City Centre, Mercure Inverness Hotel boasts a dramatic Highlands backdrop overlooking the peaceful River Ness. This newly refurbished, modern 4-star hotel with its locally inspired interior, is just six miles from world famous Loch Ness, 10 miles from Inverness Airport and only 200 metres from Inverness railway station, making it the perfect base-camp for guests looking to immerse themselves in Scottish culture.

name.content: Atlantic Tower Hotel Liverpool By Sunday

6545.description: The incredible Liverpool Atlantic Tower hotel is a 12-story, 225 bedroom hotel that contributes to the city's stunning skyline. Set on the edge of the city's commercial district, opposite the Royal Liver building, the hotel is within walking-distance to some of Liverpool's best attractions. Liverpool Lime Street station is less than a mile away, while back at the hotel guests can enjoy spacious modern rooms with some of the best views in the city.

6546.description: The Crowne Plaza® Liverpool John Lennon Airport hotel, housed in a stunning Grade II listed building, offers convenient access to Liverpool and Manchester via the nearby M57 and M62 motorways. Leave your car in the ample parking and take a direct train to the city center from Liverpool South Parkway station, just an eight-minute bus ride away. Liverpool John Lennon Airport is a mere five-minute drive. Need to organize an event? Our Crowne Plaza® Meetings Concierge is here to assist. Host social dinners and corporate functions in the spacious Aerial Suite and Blenheim De-Havilland Room, or utilize our 12 modern meeting rooms equipped with smart TVs. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Explore Liverpool's many attractions, including Goodison Park and Anfield Stadium, within a half-hour drive. Enjoy shopping and dining at Liverpool ONE, or experience the iconic Cavern Club. Dine in our brand new restaurant, 'spk. ', featuring delicious local cuisine. Relax with a cocktail in our comfortable lounge bar. Steeped in history, the hotel resides within the 1930s Speke Aerodrome building, allowing you to glimpse vintage aircraft while enjoying breakfast in the former arrivals hall. Guests also have access to the David Lloyd Leisure club, complete with swimming pools, a sauna, steam room, and gym.

6547.description: One of London’s most iconic hotels, The Royal Horseguards features over 280 bedrooms and suites with stunning views over the River Thames. Walking distance from Charing Cross, Westminster & Embankment stations. The hotel is only 43 minutes from Heathrow. Perfectly located close to Westminster, the London Eye & Trafalgar Square. After a busy day enjoy dinner at One Twenty One Two Restaurant or a drink at the Equus Bar. In the summer, the outdoor terrace can be booked for private events. This impressive building is also home to 16 meeting rooms including One Whitehall Place, which is one of the most unique banquet and conference venues in West London. TripAdvisor Traveller’s Choice 2024 & Greenage ECOSmart 2023 Gold Accreditation.

name.content: Millennium Ht & Conference Ctr. Gloucester London

6548.description: Located in stylish Kensington, the Hotel London is 350 feet from Gloucester Road Tube Station and just a short walk from the Victoria and Albert Museum. Feel free to expand this box if requiredIdeally located in the beautiful neighbourhood of Kensington, just minutes away from Gloucester Road station, Millennium Gloucester Hotel is the perfect place from which to explore London. With 611 bedrooms, our hotel offers a seamless blend of personalised service with unrivalled comfort. Enjoy Korean cuisine at Korean Grill Kensington (KGK) or grab a bite to eat throughout the day at Humphrey's Bar. Take a stroll to nearby Kensington Palace Gardens and Hyde Park or explore London's iconic museums from The Natural History Museum and The Victoria and Albert Museum all within walking distance from the hotel. London Heathrow Airport is only 45 minutes away and is easily accessible via the London underground.

6550.description: On school or national holidays, this hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has kids amenities available on requestClose to Olympia Exhibition Centre and the fashionable Kensington High Street, Hilton London Olympia is the perfect base for business or leisure. For those looking to host conferences and events, our dedicated events team will work closely with you to understand your needs. Kensington has many nice destinations to visit and things to do for all ages. From historic architecture and stunning art to hands-on activities for kids, we are in the perfect place to see it all. With excellent bus, train and airport connections close by, traveling further afield will not be a problem, which makes us a go-to destination for your next family break. Our rooms are designed with your comfort and convenience in mind, providing a place to unwind or catch up on work. Whether you are here on business or for a city break, we are here to help you make the most of your stay by offering fantastic dining and first-class services. We have everything you need for a truly memorable stay in the capital. Hilton London Olympia Hotel rates are now inclusive of all taxes.

6553.description: The hotel is surrounded by the best London has to offer. Set in the heart of London, the hotel is a mere moment from Covent Garden, Trafalgar Square and the Thames, making it the perfect location for discovering cultural icons and for those travelling on business. With so much to do right on the hotel's doorstep and excellent transport connections to whisk across the city or further afield, a stay at the hotel puts guests at the centre of the action. The nearest Airport is London City Airport, located about 17 km away. With that in mind, all rooms are fully furnished to ensure downtime is as comfortable as possible. In-room amenities include air-conditioning, a minibar, a large HD TV, coffee facilities and toiletries. The hotel offers a guest service centre and gym for guest use. The hotel has launched its brand new in-house restaurant and bar which is the perfect place to enjoy great food, cocktails and more in the heart of London. Guests can enjoy British-inspired cuisine with modern art deco décor throughout the restaurant, bar, afternoon tearoom and private dining room.

6554.description: Central stay within a mile of Hyde Park and Paddington Station. Enjoy onsite bars and restaurants, a gym, executive lounge, and a range of room types. 'Located in the heart of London, Hilton London Metropole offers everything you need under one roof. Our 1, 100 bedrooms include a range of room types, from suites and executive rooms to king deluxe rooms with views of the London skyline. We offer four uniquely themed bars and restaurants. Tyburn Kitchen, our neighborhood restaurant, kicks the day off with a grazing-style breakfast and concludes with dinner, where our show-stopping Josper Charcoal grill takes center stage. Experience our East London inspired Bow Bar for unique cocktails created by our expert mixologists. Grab and go or sit and enjoy ready-to-eat dishes from Tyburn Market. Lastly, enjoy our relaxed, family friendly atmosphere at Tyburn Kitchen Bar. Did we mention our fully equipped gym or our refurbished executive lounge yet? Our prime London location means you’re centre to all the action, just a short stroll from Hyde Park and Oxford Street, and only 15 minutes from Heathrow Airport via the Heathrow Express. We also have four tube lines right on our doorstep at Edgware Road underground station. All of this walks hand in hand with our spacious and versatile event space. We offer more than 35 event rooms, including three huge ballrooms, and have received three sustainability accreditations. Our event services include bespoke catering menu options, tech and audiovisual equipment, and room blocks for your attendees.

6555.description: This hotel offers guests a convenient location, near some of the city's best known attractions, such as Madame Tussaud's, Paddington, and King's Cross railway stations. This luxury city hotel is located some 35 km from both Heathrow and Gatwick international airports. The property was built in 1936 and comprises a total of 581 rooms on 8 floors. Guests will find a unique ambience and a number of facilities in the establishment. Dining options include an inviting bar and an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant with a separate non-smoking area and highchairs for infants. The modish, debonair rooms come with an en-suite bathroom, satellite and cable TV and Internet access.

6556.description:
This refined city hotel revels in its prime setting at the heart of London. The hotel is located just a short distance away from Piccadilly Circus and the underground station. This charming hotel offers guests a great location from which to explore the exciting sights and sounds that this vibrant city has to offer. The hotel features an attractive architectural design, tempting guests into the relaxing surroundings of the lobby. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, and come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Guests will appreciate the wide range of facilities and services that this wonderful hotel has to offer. 

You may also wish to note that, as we approach our 120th year, The Dilly is delighted to announce the beginning of an extensive renovation programme that will restore our hotel as one of Piccadilly’s most iconic landmarks. 

Our new entrance and lobby is now open and we have now started phase 1 of our major bedroom refurbishment. We appreciate your cooperation and understanding whilst we undergo this exciting transformation. 

We remain fully committed to ensuring every stay feels seamless and memorable, and we look forward to unveiling our beautifully transformed spaces and sharing this exciting journey with you.

name.content: The Marble Arch Hotel, by Thistle

6557.description:
Located at the west end of Oxford Street and just a 2‑minute walk from the green open spaces of Hyde Park, The Marble Arch Hotel offers a prime London base in the heart of the city. The hotel is exceptionally well‑connected, situated only a 2‑minute walk from Marble Arch Station and a 10‑minute walk from Bond Street Station, making it effortless to explore London’s top attractions. 
Perfectly positioned close to the elegant Park Lane district and moments from the world‑famous Selfridges, the hotel is ideal for guests looking to experience London’s best shopping, dining and sightseeing. 
Inspired by its prestigious location, the hotel welcomes guests with newly unveiled Italian marble flooring and a refreshed atmosphere designed to help you unlock your London adventure. Each room features a stylish and supremely comfortable Hypnos bed for a restful night’s sleep, along with thoughtful amenities for a relaxing stay. Guests can enjoy tea and coffee making facilities, complimentary bottled water and bathroom toiletries, fast free unlimited Wi‑Fi, and an HD‑ready TV with Freesat. Rooms also include a full-length mirror, professional hairdryer, and convenient USB and international plug sockets. 
Overlooking the vibrant energy of Oxford Street, Archy’s Bar & Lounge is the perfect place to unwind after a day of shopping, sightseeing or meetings, serving cocktails, wines, mocktails and a menu of small plates and hearty favourites. Cucina by Archy’s brings the flavours of Italy with simple ingredients, bold dishes and regional wines, while The Deli offers Starbucks Coffee, Yarde Farm ice cream and light grab‑and‑go meals.

6558.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Grab a bite to eat at JW Steakhouse, a steakhouse which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 5449 square feet (506 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 23 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 496 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed.

6559.description: At Kimpton Fitzroy London, we have stories galore to tell. From the outside, the palatial 19th-century landmark building, which occupies a full block in Bloomsbury, looks the part of grande dame. Inside are contemporary creature comforts like roomy, art-filled suites with views over Russell Square, and destinations restaurants and bars that'll take your breath away. Fitz's, a glamorous drinking den that keeps the cocktails flowing; Burr & Co. , a casually cool coffee shop; the light-filled, foliage-adorned Palm Court; and Galvin Bar & Grill, a modern British restaurant by Michelin-starred brothers Chris and Jeff Galvin. All of these details beckon modern travelers to settle in, and stay a while.

6560.description: This hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has a range of kids amenities available upon request. Expect a warm welcome the moment you arrive at Hilton London Kensington. We’re located in the leafy district of Holland Park, 30 minutes from Heathrow Airport, with excellent transport links into Central London. Each spacious guest room at the Hilton London Kensington hotel is light and modern, with a coffee maker, flat-screen TVs, and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries. Guests can also make use of daily newspapers and magazines in the room. Enjoy your time at the WestEleven Restaurant, serving a breakfast buffet every morning in a setting decorated with modern art. Our Avenue Bar & Lounge is in the lobby and offers an á la carte menu, a wide selection of drinks, and computer terminals with internet access. Our London Kensington hotel has everything you need for a remarkable stay in the capital.

name.content: St James Court A Taj Hotel

6561.description: St. James' Court, a Taj Hotel, epitomizes classic English charm. A short walk from St. James Park Tube Station, this Victorian masterpiece, with its renowned Shakespearean courtyard, is nestled between Buckingham Palace and the Houses of Parliament. Nearby attractions include Westminster Abbey, Big Ben, and the London Eye. Guests enjoy proximity to premier shopping destinations such as Harrods, Selfridges, and Harvey Nichols. The hotel offers 'Tajness, ' a commitment to authentic Indian hospitality with enhanced safety and hygiene measures. The attentive staff strives to exceed expectations, creating memorable experiences in this blend of historic elegance and contemporary comfort.

6564.description: Located in the heart of London's vibrant Bloomsbury district, known for its distinctive architecture and cultural attractions, The Bloomsbury offers a luxurious stay just steps from Covent Garden, Soho, and the British Museum. This beautifully restored neo-Georgian hotel boasts modern amenities including the elegant Coral Room, the stylish Bloomsbury Club Bar with its all-season terrace, and a sophisticated restaurant. Guest rooms range from elegantly appointed Classic and Deluxe options to lavish Studio Suites featuring chic, earthy tones, parquet floors, and Italian marble bathrooms with freestanding baths. All accommodations include free high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a Nespresso machine, a 55-inch TV with Chromecast, and tea and coffee-making facilities. Guests also enjoy complimentary access to the fitness suite and the highly Instagrammable Dalloway Terrace, offering all-day dining and a sumptuous afternoon tea.

6565.description: This sophisticated and elegant hotel is located in Vauxhall Bridge Road in London. The hotel is ideally located near many tourist attractions including the West End Theatres, Hyde Park, Buckingham Palace, and Big Ben. The hotel is situated just two minutes from Victoria railway station with fast links to London Gatwick Airport, and the London Underground network, and bus terminals. This is the perfect starting point to explore this extraordinary and unforgettable city. This hotel offers 299 air-conditioned rooms with contemporary design and modern amenities. Each room comes with free Wi-Fi, 49-inch TVs with complimentary Sky channels, and coffee and tea facilities to suit the needs for both leisure and business travellers. Guests can also relax at the sauna and steam room to eliminate the tiredness after a long day.

6566.description: This ultra-luxury hotel on High Holborn combines English heritage with contemporary sophistication in the heart of London. Nestled in the very centre of English capital, near Covent Garden, the City and West End theatres, it is perfect for business and sightseeing in London. Visitors will be impressed by imposing Edwardian architectural design, opulent interiors and high quality service with attention to detail. This stunning establishment boasts a variety of accommodation options including fabulous individually designed rooms and suites. Each unit offers spacious and peaceful surroundings, where guests may completely unwind and recharge batteries. The unique dining venues deliver exceptional cuisine and service. After a long day of work or touring into the city, patrons may balance body and soul at the spa and fitness centre. The younger guests may revel in the varied on-site entertainment programme. The hotel is pet friendly and offers a business centre.

6567.description: Enjoy a central London stay at the Wedgewood Hotel, located within a 10-minute walk of both Kensington Gardens and the vibrant Portobello Road Market. This hotel offers 60 guestrooms equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi and cable TV. Guests can also take advantage of amenities such as a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and room service. Tea and coffee making facilities are provided in each room, and housekeeping is offered weekly. Irons and ironing boards are available upon request. Nearby attractions include Kensington Palace (0. 7 mi) and Kensington High Street (1 mi). Heathrow Airport (LHR) is the preferred airport for the hotel.

6573.description:
Set in the heart of central London at Marble Arch, where Oxford Street meets Park Lane and Hyde Park is just a few steps away, The Cumberland puts you right at the lively end of the city. We are also home to the Gordon Ramsay Hell’s Kitchen, bringing one of the world’s most iconic dining experiences under our roof. 
With museums, landmarks and the Tube on your doorstep, it’s the perfect starting point for exploring London. Inside, contemporary design and calming spaces give you room to breathe, reset and shake off the day. Whether you’re here for business, exploring or a mix of both, everything clicks into place the moment you arrive. 
Start your day with our fresh and generous breakfast. Coffee lovers can count on our baristas for fast, expertly brewed drinks. Lirica brings Mediterranean flavour to life with bold tapas dishes and a relaxed rhythm from day to night. Come evening, Sound Bar turns up the energy with cocktails and colourful beats – a brilliant spot to unwind before or after an unforgettable dining experience at Gordon Ramsay Hell’s Kitchen.  
The Cumberland isn’t just a hotel. It’s an icon of London life – where the city’s heart beats, and where icons belong.

6581.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting at the heart of Newcastle. Set overlooking the River Tyne, the hotel is located within easy access of a host of attractions, shops, entertainment venues and dining options. Guests will find themselves just a short walking distance away from the train station and the high street. Stunning beaches are to be found just 15 km away. This wonderful hotel enjoys a charming, contemporary design. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, exuding classical beauty and refined style. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. This wonderful hotel features a delightful restaurant, where sumptuous culinary creations are the order of the day.

6587.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center and bicycles to rent. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. You can enjoy a meal at Cast Iron Bar & Grill serving the guests of Sheraton Heathrow Hotel, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available 24 hours) and a bus station shuttle. Stay in one of 426 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

6605.description: Royal Lancaster London stands proudly on the border of Hyde Park, featuring 411 guestrooms impeccably designed to combine style, comfort and breathtaking views of the famous London skyline. Restaurants and bars include the award-winning Nipa Thai, serving the most authentic Thai food outside of Bangkok and Hyde Cafe, serving an indulgent Afternoon Tea. Breakfast is served in the beautiful Park Restaurant alongside floor to ceiling views of Hyde Park and in the afternoon; enjoy cocktails and relaxed dining in the cosy Park Lounge Bar. The hotel is conveniently located adjacent to Lancaster Gate Station with Paddington Station just a 5 minute walk away, offering easy access to Heathrow Airport and the newly-opened Elizabeth line. ***A 5% discretionary accommodation service fee will be added to your room bill. ***

6607.description: This modern hotel is centrally located within walking distance from attractions such as the British Museum, Covent Garden, Oxford Street, Piccadilly Circus or Regent's Park. It is the largest hotel in the centre of London, offering more than 1, 600 rooms. In addition there are 3 restaurants, a bar and a cosy London pub. Russell Square underground station is just 2 minutes away, offering access to all areas of the city.

6609.description: Located in one of London's most sought-after districts, the hotel London Kensington is a short walk from the boutique shops of Kensington High Street and the natural beauty of Kensington Gardens. Guests can dine on site in the Artist Corner, offering modern British and European cuisine. The property also features a brasserie with Asian-style dishes and the Cafexpress cafe. Olympia exhibition centre is within walking distance and so are Hyde Park, the Royal Albert Hall and the world-famous museums on Cromwell Road.

6611.description: This hotel, nestled in the middle of Bloomsbury, enjoys a great location with views to Russell Square. Guests will be able to find, within the area a number of touristic sites and cultural attractions, including the British Museum, Covent Garden and the West End. The closest underground stations can be reached on foot, Euston, St Pancras and Kings Cross stations are all close to Russell Square.

6612.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Enjoy local and international cuisine at Pavillion Grill, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 6265 square feet (582 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 10 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 360 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions.

6613.description: The Savoy is the only luxury hotel on the River Thames, perfectly located in the heart of all that London has to offer, just steps away from vibrant Covent Garden. At the forefront of the luxury hotel scene for over 130 years, The Savoy boasts 267 rooms and suites accompanied by some of the best restaurants and bars in London, welcoming guests for an experience that continuously evolves to meet the desires of the modern traveller.

6614.description: This hotel enjoys a delightful location, lying close to Oxford Street in London's West End. The hotel is situated just 200 metres away from Paddington Underground Station. This charming hotel is surrounded by an abundance of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. Guests will find themselves in a great location from which to explore the attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. The hotel is located just 25 km from Heathrow Airport and 50 km from Gatwick Airport. This Victorian-style hotel boasts a delightful architectural design. The guest rooms are superbly appointed, and feature modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Guests are assured of an enjoyable stay at this hotel.

6615.description: Designed by James Thomas Knowles and opened in 1862, this is our beautiful and historic Grade II listed railway hotel in Victoria station. It boasts direct access to Victoria Station from the concourse and links to the Circle, District and Victoria underground lines. You can get to Gatwick on the express in half an hour. The Apollo Victoria Theatre by foot in just seconds. And London's most famous landmarks including Buckingham Palace, Hyde Park, Big Ben, Houses of Parliament and Westminster Abbey in mere minutes. Our restaurant, the Soak, is now open. The Clermont Restaurant & Bar is open for breakfast and afternoon tea is served in the Tea Lounge.

6616.description: On school or national holidays, this hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has kids amenities available on requestConnected by footbridge to Paddington station, Hilton London Paddington is just a 15-minute roof to roof connection to Heathrow Airport via Heathrow Express. Hilton London Paddington offers a wide range of 422 guest rooms from standard to executive rooms and suites, including 59 premium rooms in the GWR Tower which includes executive lounge access. All bedrooms have free WiFi. The hotel also features fully equipped gym. Connected with Paddington Station and with four London Underground lines on the doorstep, the hotel is the ideal point to explore London. Head to Oxford Street and the West End just 10 minutes away. See Buckingham palace and stroll through nearby Hyde Park.

6617.description: Situated in the heart of Kensington, this elegant 19th-century townhouse hotel offers luxurious accommodations mere steps from Gloucester Road Tube Station. The property is conveniently located near Kensington High Street, Knightsbridge, and South Kensington's shopping districts, with Harrods a short 15-minute walk or tube ride away. Guests are within a 10-minute walk of Kensington Gardens, Hyde Park, the Royal Albert Hall, and renowned museums such as the Natural History Museum, the Science Museum, and the Victoria and Albert Museum. Stylishly restored in 2016, the hotel retains its original Victorian charm, from the grand staircase to the stained-glass windows. The spacious and inviting rooms feature flat-screen TVs and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and slippers. Guests also enjoy complimentary bottled water, coffee, tea, and biscuits, replenished daily.

6618.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool, an indoor pool, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at Cedric Grolet or snacks in the 2 coffee shops/cafes. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. English breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to noon for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and limo/town car service. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours).

6619.description: This elegant hotel is situated on Sloane Street at the heart of London. The hotel is situated just a short distance away from the many attractions that this impressive city has to offer. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to Buckingham Palace, Hyde Park and Knightsbridge underground station, which offers ease of access to other areas of the city. This wonderful hotel enjoys a charming architectural design, blending effortlessly with its refined surroundings. The guest rooms are superbly designed, oozing character and charm. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Business and leisure travellers will appreciate the host of facilities that the hotel has to offer. Heathrow Airport from Knightsbridge is 44-minute drive away from the hotel.

6620.description:
This modern, luxury hotel is pleasantly situated overlooking the Thames. Links to the public transport network nearby enable easy access to the plentiful tourist attractions as well as numerous shops and entertainment venues that the city of London has to offer. The nearest underground station is Temple and is just across the road from the hotel.

The hotel was renovated in 2002 and has a number of facilities. It offers it's guests an elegant foyer with lifts, a cloakroom, a safe and a 24-hour reception. Additional facilities include a bar and an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant, which overlooks the lovely garden courtyard. Conference rooms with Internet access are also included within the facilities.

All 189 elegant rooms include an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, as well as a telephone, satellite TV, Internet access, minibar, central heating, a safe and an espresso machine.

Jaan Restaurant is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

6621.description: This stylish hotel enjoys a central location in Bayswater. Paddington underground station is to be found just 150 metres away from the hotel. This charming hotel is located within easy access of the most famous attractions for which this city is renowned. The hotel enjoys a charming architectural design, blending effortlessly with its refined surroundings. The guest rooms offer a haven of peace and serenity, in which to work and rest in comfort. Guests are invited to enjoy a delightful breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to explore the sights and sounds of the city.

6622.description: Enjoy a luxurious stay at The Park Tower Knightsbridge, a Luxury Collection Hotel, situated near Hyde Park. This hotel offers a fitness center, bicycle rentals, and a variety of dining options, including a restaurant and 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge or enjoy a full breakfast for a fee (7 AM - 11 AM daily). The hotel also provides concierge and babysitting services (surcharge), a business center, limo service, and express check-in. Event facilities include conference space and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (surcharge). Each of the 280 guestrooms features an iPod docking station, a minibar, a 49-inch LCD TV with satellite programming, Wi-Fi (surcharge), a private bathroom with separate bathtub and shower, complimentary toiletries, a hairdryer, a phone, a safe, and a desk. Nearby attractions include Harrods, Hyde Park Corner, Park Lane, Green Park, Piccadilly, and Sloane Square. The closest airports are London City (LCY), Heathrow (LHR), Gatwick (LGW), Luton (LTN), and Farnborough (FAB), with Heathrow (LHR) recommended.

6623.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Grab a bite to eat at Mercante Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 305 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and plasma televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

6625.description: A London landmark, this luxurious property has been home to thousands of discerning guests since 1906. It features a prime position on Piccadilly, in the heart of the city. This outstanding hotel offers the ideal accommodation for those travellers wishing to enjoy the ultimate in style, service and sophistication. The beautiful bedrooms and suites feature fully restored period interiors and whichever room guests choose, they will experience the best in luxury accommodation and attention to detail. To dine at the hotel’s restaurant is to experience some of the best cuisine available anywhere in the world, at one of the most beautiful dining rooms in London. The menu utilizes the best of British seasonal produce prepared with the finest classical French culinary techniques, and of course the service is exemplary. Afternoon tea in London at this property is an institution in itself, served in the spectacular Palm Court to a soundtrack of soft piano music, this is an unforgettable experience.

6626.description: This elegant city hotel lies at the heart of London in one of the city's most exclusive districts. Green Park and Piccadilly Circus underground stations lie just a few minutes walk away and various sights including Trafalgar Square, the national art gallery, Buckingham Palace and Hyde Park are all to be found in the vicinity. This hotel comprises 15 floors with a total of 228 rooms including 3 suites. Facilities include a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, a lift, 2 bars and a restaurant with a non-smoking area. It is possible to take advantage of the car parking facilities (additional fees apply). The welcoming rooms each come with a bathroom, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, a TV, a minibar/ fridge, tea and coffee making facilities and a hire safe.

name.content: Radisson Blu Hotel, London South Kensington

6627.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center and complimentary wireless internet access. The hotel also offers concierge services for added convenience. Savor British cuisine at Scoff and Banter, a restaurant with a bar/lounge, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. The hotel boasts a conference center and 12 meeting rooms, making it ideal for events. The 215 guest rooms feature espresso makers, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include designer toiletries and hair dryers. Additional conveniences comprise phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. The hotel is located near the Natural History Museum, Imperial College London, and other popular attractions.

name.content: Radisson Blu Hotel, London Tottenham Court Road

6628.description: Radisson Blu Edwardian Kenilworth, part of Edwardian Hotels London, is a luxurious hotel in Bloomsbury opposite the British Museum, one of London's most popular attraction. Situated within minutes of the stylish shopping districts of Oxford St, Regent St, Bond St and Covent Garden, and within a short walk of Soho and the West End Theatre. The hotel's light, airy lobby makes guests feel instantly relaxed and at home, while the 24 hour fitness room is perfect for relaxing and revitalising. Guests in need of a private space can choose from 8 meeting rooms, able to host up 110 people. From comfortable singles and doubles to spacious family rooms, all 186 of The Kenilworth's stylish bedrooms feature modern comforts, such as 350 thread count Egyptian cotton bedding, down pillows, REN toiletries and Italian marble bathrooms. Cutting-edge in-room technology is perfect for work or play, including free high speed Wi-Fi up to 150 mbps on unlimited devices and international sockets. For an extra dose of luxury and spectacular views across London's skyline, guests can book one of the hotel's four studio suites. Scoff and Banter serves a superb menu of traditional Modern European cuisine using only the finest locally sourced, seasonal produce. Guest-favourites range from tasty classics like beer-battered fish and chips, shepherd's pie and Eton mess, to indulgent afternoon teas, all of which can be washed down with a superb selection of wines and cocktails. The nearest tube station is Tottenham Court Road on the Central and Northern Lines. Holborn Tube station is minutes away giving direct access to the City Financial District, and nearby Eurostar at King's Cross St Pancras. Please provide a valid credit card upon arrival at the hotel.

6630.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include wedding services and a banquet hall. Enjoy Mexican cuisine at Madera, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Make yourself at home in one of the 95 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment.

6634.description:
This friendly hotel is excellently situated in London overlooking lovely Russell Square and just a few steps from the British Museum. It features a restaurant, a bar and a café. The River Thames, Regents Park and Hyde Park are reachable within a short stroll; Russell Square underground station is within two minutes, offering easy access to all parts of the city. Kings Cross train station is within walking distance. 

The renovation works are ongoing at our sister hotel next to the President Hotel from 08:00 AM to 05:00 PM. Some noise may be heard during these hours. The works are expected to finish by late July or early August 2026

6635.description: This city hotel nestled in the centre of London offers its guests a strategic location very close to many touristic sites of cultural and historic interest. Guests will also find within the immediate vicinity a wide range of shopping and entertainment venues, as well as restaurants and bars. Convenient public transport, both underground and bus, is easily reachable on foot, and Heathrow Airport is about 19 kilometres from the hotel. The accommodation units are spacious and have been decorated in a functional and simple style, but also very comfortable. They all come with a private bathroom with bathtub of shower and include tea and coffee making facilities for guests’ convenience. The onsite facilities and services include free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, a full English breakfast served every morning and a meeting room which can accommodate up to 150 people. (Refurbishment until 2025)

name.content: Thistle London Hyde Park Kensington Gardens

6636.description: This stylish hotel enjoys a strategic setting in the captivating city of London. The hotel is situated on Bayswater Road, lying just a short distance away from Hyde Park. The hotel boasts stunning views over Palace Gardens and the park. The renowned district of Notting Hill is to be found just a short distance away. Oxford street is also easily accessible from this hotel. Guests will find themselves in the perfect setting from which to explore the attractions that this wonderful hotel has to offer. This charming hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality and style. The guest rooms are elegantly designed, featuring classical beauty and refined sophistication. The hotel features a wide range of excellent facilities, ensuring that each and every traveller enjoys a truly memorable stay.

6638.description: This first-class hotel enjoys a prime setting on Regent Street in London. The hotel is located close to Oxford and Bond streets, enjoying a great setting from which to explore the host of attractions, shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues that this vibrant city has to offer. This charming hotel enjoys a long history, dating back to the mid-19th century. The hotel enjoys a charming architectural design, blending in seamlessly with its refined surroundings. The guest rooms are luxuriously appointed, offering a peaceful setting in which to escape the bustle of the city which lies just outside. The hotel features a host of exemplary facilities, meeting the needs of discerning travellers to the highest level of excellence.

6639.description: Chic and central, Hilton London Euston is ideally located in the heart of the capital. Set in a stunning restored Victorian building, the hotel boasts seven meeting rooms, a bar and a restaurant set in a beautiful Victorian conservatory. Euston station is just 5 minute walk away and the Eurostar service at St Pancras Station is only a 10-minute walk away. Start the day with breakfast at Mulberry's Restaurant. Hire a bicycle at Waterloo and ride along the Thames to London attractions such as the Tate Modern. See the lights come up over the city from the London Eye before dinner at the hotel's Woburn Place Dining Room. Experience our enticing outlets, host a banquet on the Woburn terrace and finish with a nightcap at the hotel's bar. Book a modern Hilton Room at Hilton London Euston hotel or upgrade to a spacious Deluxe Room. All rooms offer wireless internet access.

6640.description: The Landmark London, a five-star hotel in Marylebone, offers a luxurious escape in the heart of London. Steps from vibrant Marylebone High Street, Chiltern Street, and Bond Street, this hotel is ideal for exploring the city's best shopping, dining, and cultural attractions. The Landmark London boasts spacious rooms (40-70 sq m), a spa with an indoor pool and gym, and multiple restaurants and bars serving British and European cuisine. Enjoy a classic afternoon tea in the stunning eight-story Winter Garden atrium. Families are welcome, with interconnecting rooms and suites available. The hotel has enhanced health and safety procedures for a safe and enjoyable stay.

6641.description: Thistle Holborn is perfectly situated for exploring the city, whether your stay is for business or pleasure. Just a stone’s throw away from Covent Garden, Soho, and Oxford Street, you’re also within easy walking distance of a plethora of London Underground stations, making your journey to, from, and around London, a breeze. The hotel itself offers comfortable boutique-style bedrooms, a relaxed bar, and an all-day restaurant serving breakfast, lunch, dinner, and afternoon tea. The rooms offer plenty of space with ensuite bathrooms, comfortable beds, air-conditioning, and sleek furnishings, with fast & free Wi-Fi available throughout. Each room also comes equipped with a flat screen TV, tea & coffee making facilities, work desk, hair dryer, iron & ironing board, complimentary toiletries, and room safe. The in-house restaurant, Kingsley Two Brasserie, opens at 7am with an impressive breakfast buffet of continental and full-English options. From 12pm, enjoy delicious international cuisine from our all-day dining menu. The relaxed Kingsley Bar opens from 11am offering a morning coffee & brunch menu. Afterwards, an informal dining and drinks menu is available until 11pm, perfect for a pre-theatre dinner, or nightcap before bed. Thistle Holborn also offers a selection of impressive meeting & event spaces, please contact the hotel directly if you would like to enquire about booking one of these spaces.

6642.description: Nestled in the heart of London's vibrant West End, this boutique hotel offers a warm, traditional welcome. Enjoy complimentary broadband internet, mood lighting, and a choice of standard, queen, or king-sized beds with crisp cotton linens. Amenities include international plug access, interactive satellite TV, 24-hour room service, and a daily newspaper. An in-room safe, coffee/tea service, iron, hairdryer, and telephone with voicemail are also provided. Most rooms feature climate control, bathroom televisions, and heated mirrors. Complimentary toiletries are included, and bathrobes and slippers are available upon request. A mini-fridge and electronic door locks add to your comfort and security. Payment is taken upon arrival, with a pre-authorization for the first night's stay applied 48 hours prior. The hotel is conveniently located within the London Congestion Charge zone (applicable Monday-Friday, 7 am-6:30 pm).

6643.description: Situated in London's city centre, the Phoenix Hotel is a short walk from Kensington Gardens and Portobello Road Market. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a shared TV area. The 125 guestrooms feature private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, safes, and desks. Guests can dine at the hotel restaurant or enjoy a snack at the deli. A bar/lounge is also available. Additional amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Nearby attractions include Kensington Palace and Hyde Park.

6645.description: A stunning boutique hotel, Mercure London Hyde Park has recently undergone a major refurbishment and boasts 72 well-appointed guest rooms with original Victorian windows, high ceilings, and a welcoming townhouse feel throughout. Tucked away in a peaceful garden square, the hotel perfectly encapsulates traditional English charm with a modern twist. Each room is brimming with technology and style, including free Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy several amenities, such as an on-site bar and restaurant and a 24-hour fitness center. Just a stone's throw from the hotel, you'll discover London's largest Royal Park, Hyde Park, home to attractions like the Serpentine Gallery, the Boating Lake, and the Albert Memorial. Oxford Street, with its designer outlets and prestigious flagship department stores, is also nearby.

6646.description: The Marylebone Hotel offers a superb location in central London, nestled in the heart of Marylebone Village, a bustling neighborhood brimming with fashionable boutiques and eateries. Guests enjoy easy access to London's best attractions, with Selfridges and Liberty a short 5-10 minute walk away, and the elegant green spaces of Regent's Park and Hyde Park within a 15-minute stroll. A luxury lifestyle hotel, The Marylebone boasts an array of on-site amenities. Discover the local charm of 108 Brasserie, explore a world of gin and wines at 108 Bar, or indulge in exciting cocktails at the hotel's glamorous cocktail bar. Guests also enjoy complimentary access to the exclusive on-site Third Space gym, featuring an 18-meter swimming pool (a rarity in central London), a state-of-the-art gym, and expert trainers. Accommodation options range from elegantly appointed classic and deluxe rooms to luxurious studio and rooftop terrace suites, some with retractable roofs. Spacious family rooms comfortably accommodate two adults and two children up to 12 years old.

6647.description: Just a 2-minute walk from Earls Court Station, Ellen Kensington blends stylish, eclectic design with warm Asian hospitality. Inspired by legendary British actress Ellen Terry, the hotel features artwork and cultural accents throughout. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi throughout, a terrace for views, and easy access to Kensington's museums, shops, and parks. Ideal for leisure or business stays in one of London's most affluent areas.

6649.description: Perfectly located in London, this property offers ease of access to Hyde Park, Oxford Street, Marble Arch and Kensington Gardens. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby, at Paddington train station, Bayswater and Queensway underground station. This property offers the utmost in luxury and comfort. The stylish guest rooms place an emphasis on relaxation and convenience. Guests are invited to avail of the seemingly boundless range of first-class facilities and services that the hotel has to offer. This property delivers an unrivalled level of comfort and convenience, complemented by exemplary service.

6650.description: Located in London's Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, this boutique-style hotel is near iconic attractions, including Kensington Palace, the Victoria and Albert Museum, the Royal Albert Hall, the Design Museum, Hyde Park, and the Knightsbridge shopping district, home to Harrods and Harvey Nichols. The hotel blends Victorian grandeur with contemporary comfort. High ceilings, open fireplaces, and heritage décor create an elegant atmosphere. Accommodation options range from classic and deluxe rooms to luxurious studio, signature, Brompton, and Knightsbridge suites. All rooms and suites offer complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, fine linens, TVs, and marble bathrooms. The Town House restaurant serves fresh, seasonal dishes and a renowned afternoon tea. A discreet cocktail bar provides a sophisticated setting for drinks.

name.content: Premier Inn London Hammersmith - Ravenscourt Park

6651.description: Get a bird's eye view of the capital from Premier Inn London Hammersmith, with incredible views across the Thames to the Shard and Southbank. Just hop on a tube and the city's at your feet, from Hyde Park to Oxford Street, with direct public transport links via the District Line. And you needn't venture far from your nest to see Hammersmith's own bright lights - the Apollo, Westfield Shopping Centre, Olympia and Earl's Court are minutes away. Based just outside of the capital's congestion zone, near the M4, with limited parking on site, we're extra-easy to get to. And once you've arrived, you'll find everything you need for a dream stay: a tasty restaurant, peaceful rooms and oh sso-comfyeds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

6652.description: This hotel is located close to Hyde Park, in London. The Heathrow Express terminal at Paddington Station, Oxford Street, Marble Arch and Queensway are also situated close by. This property is ideally situated from which to explore the host of intriguing attractions and points of interest that this mesmerising city has to offer. This modern hotel offers luxury and style, in a convenient setting. Beautifully-designed guest rooms ooze grace and classical elegance. The property offers complimentary internet access for the convenience of business and leisure travellers alike. The hotel's staff are on hand to ensure that the needs of every type of traveller are fully met.

name.content: Queens Park Premier London Hyde Park Hotel

6653.description: Welcome to the Queens Park Hotel our stunning Victorian building, dating back to the 1900's is set on the tranquil street of Queensborough Terrace. We are superbly located near Paddington Station, Queensway and Bayswater Tube Stations in Central London. We are easily accessible through the District, Central and Circle lines. Queensway is a bustling cosmopolitan street in Bayswater. An area of west London with many restaurants cafés, pubs, souvenir shops and a few high-street retail chains.

6656.description: Enjoy your stay at the Garden View Hotel, located in the heart of London, a short drive from the Natural History and Victoria and Albert Museums. The hotel offers 61 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, safes, and coffee/tea makers. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and tour/ticket assistance. The Science Museum and Kensington Palace are also within easy reach.

6831.description: This wonderful beach hotel is situated in the recreational area of Manzanillo. The hotel is located just a short distance away from the town centre, allowing for ease of access to the many attractions, shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues that it has to offer. The stunning beach, with its pristine sand and turquoise-blue sea is situated just 1 km away. This wonderful hotel enjoys a stunning Mediterranean style, featuring stunning villas and rooms, which are elegantly appointed and well equipped with modern amenities. The complex features an impressive selection restaurants, as well as leisure and recreational facilities. This complex is sure to impress even the most discerning traveller.

6891.description: This attractive hotel is located in a peaceful cul-de-sac. A small, fine sandy bathing bay is located 100 m away and may easily be reached down a flight of steps, and there is also a larger beach located along the same route. The centre of Salou, where guests will find an abundance of shops and entertainment venues, is only about 2 km away. There is a regular bus service to the latter that departs from a stop outside the hotel, and the nearest train station is Salou. This beach hotel consists of 100 rooms spread over 5 floors. The facilities include a spacious lobby with 24-hour reception, 2 lifts, games room, TV lounge and Internet access (for a fee). There is also a cosy café, a bar and an air-conditioned restaurant within the hotel. Room and laundry services round off the offerings (additional fees apply). For children, there are organised activities in a kids' club, and a playground, and first aid medical assistance is available to guests daily. Parking facilities are also available. The comfortably furnished rooms are all en suite and come equipped with a hairdryer as well as a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, minibar, a safe (for an additional fee) and air conditioning/heating. Two swimming pools, one of which is for children, and a sun terrace with a poolside snack bar, sun loungers and parasols are located on the hotel grounds. Additional leisure options include table tennis, aerobics sessions, archery, billiards, bocce and a seasonal entertainment programme. Guests can make use of gym and sauna facilities in the Hotel Negrosco Princess. Sun loungers and parasols are available to guests on the beach. The entertainment programme is especially worth mentioning and features daytime and evening activities and entertainment including professional shows, which take place a few times a week. Breakfast and the evening meal may be selected from a buffet; lunch may be selected from a set menu. In addition, the hotel restaurant also offers special dishes.

7134.description: Take advantage of recreational opportunities offered, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access and a reception hall. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 94 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Sint Jakobsstraat - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- St. James's Church - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Bruges Market Square - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Bruges Christmas Market - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Friet Museum - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Menen - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Historium - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Historic Centre of Brugge - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Dali Xpo Gallery - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Bruges Belfry - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Bruges City Theater - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Jan van Eyckplein - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Noordzandstraat - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Choco-Story Museum - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Basilica of the Holy Blood - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi. The nearest airports are: Ostende (OST-Ostend-Bruges Intl. ) - 36. 6 km / 22. 7 mi Brussels Airport (BRU) - 109. 3 km / 67. 9 mi The preferred airport for Hotel Navarra Brugge is Brussels Airport (BRU).

7136.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of this Bruges hotel, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Dine at the on-site restaurant or cafe, and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Each of the 45 individually decorated guestrooms offers a minibar, flat-screen TV, and complimentary toiletries. The hotel also provides wedding services, a fireplace in the lobby, and convenient express check-out. Located near the Gruuthuse Museum and Brewery Bourgogne des Flandres, it's a short walk to major attractions. An airport shuttle is available (surcharge).

7137.description: Explore the lovely city of Bruges and relax in one of our rooms we offer in the historical centre. The ibis Styles Brugge Centrum is located in a pretty medieval building, which really adds an authentic touch to your trip!
