Moments from Harrods, Harvey Nichols, and the embassies of Belgrave Square, the hotel provides easy access to London's airports, the City, and its finest attractions. Each contemporary room and suite is beautifully appointed and features amenities such as a Nespresso coffee machine, complimentary internet access, and Temple Spa products. Some rooms overlook the tranquil Lowndes Square. The vibrant Lowndes Restaurant and Bar serves breakfast and all-day dining. Guests typically enjoy access to The Peak Health Club & Spa at our sister hotel, Jumeirah Carlton Tower.

name.content: The Welbeck Hotel London, an IHG Hotel

8900.description: The Welbeck Hotel is a stunning Edwardian gem offering contemporary luxury in the heart of Marylebone. Located on iconic Welbeck Street, rich in medical history, the hotel blends historic charm with modern elegance. Our motto is Stay Well, Be Well, Travel Well, providing a seamless, refined experience in one of London’s most fashionable neighbourhoods. Start your day at The Welbecker Bar and Lounge, with coffee and pastries, and enjoy free breakfast for children under 12. The hotel also features a restaurant, bar, new meeting rooms, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy a mini-gym with complimentary water to stay refreshed during their workout. The Welbeck Hotel is a 5-minute walk from Bond Street tube station, with easy access to Oxford Street, West End theatres, and London Paddington Station, offering fast rail service to Heathrow. Gatwick is easily reachable via the Gatwick Express from Victoria Station. Nearby, you’ll find attractions like Wigmore Hall, The Wallace Collection, and Selfridges, as well as the British Museum, West End theatres, and Madame Tussauds. Hyde Park is just under a mile away. The hotel features six new, air-conditioned conference rooms, accommodating up to 35 guests. With the US Embassy, BBC headquarters, and the University of London all within a 20-minute walk, The Welbeck Hotel is ideal for both business and leisure.

name.content: The Chelsea Harbour Hotel & Spa London

8901.description: The Chelsea Harbour Hotel, a five-star all-suite hotel, offers a tranquil harborside haven within easy reach of London's city center. Overlooking Chelsea Harbour, it's one of the few hotels in London with a river view. Located near the Saatchi Gallery, home to contemporary artworks from Charles Saatchi's private collection, and a short walk from the shops of King's Road, the hotel combines urban convenience with a peaceful retreat. Imperial Wharf Station, a two-minute walk away, provides direct access to Kensington Olympia in just five minutes.

8903.description: Enjoy amenities like a sauna and fitness center at the London Marriott Hotel Maida Vale. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, or make use of the concierge and babysitting services (surcharge). Dine at Carluccio's, the hotel's restaurant, for lunch or dinner, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (surcharge). The hotel offers a business center, express check-in/check-out, and four meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (surcharge). Each of the 239 guestrooms features a flat-screen TV, pillowtop bed with premium bedding, Wi-Fi (surcharge), and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. The hotel is conveniently located near Lord's Cricket Ground, Regent's Park, and Paddington Central, with easy access to Heathrow Airport.

8906.description: This pretty hotel with Spanish and Mediterranean architecture offers comfort, value and first class facilities. The fabulous courtyard with a fountain and landscaped gardens are the perfect place to sit and relax. The warm and inviting reception is spacious and has a mezzanine floor where the restaurant is situated. The on-site bar is cosy, with a feature fireplace and houses a modern snack menu, and leads out onto the courtyard. All 211 traditional styled bedrooms are en-suite. There is a health and leisure club where visitors can make the most of their stay. The 13 conference rooms have first-class facilities and can hold up to 132 people. WIFI is free to all guests and available in all public areas around the hotel.

8907.description: Less than a 10-minute drive from the airport, Best Western London Heathrow Ariel Hotel provides the ideal stopover for holidaymakers and business travelers alike. This unique ring-shaped hotel – the first to be built at Heathrow – was opened by the Her Majesty The Queen in December 1960. There's short and long-stay onsite parking available with Park, Stay and Go options, and you can catch the Hoppa Bus airport shuttle service from outside the hotel. All our 184 modern air-conditioned rooms come with double glazing and blackout curtains to help you get a good night's sleep before your flight or meeting. They also have invigorating power showers, free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs with satellite channels and on-demand movies. Some rooms also come with runway views and our executive rooms have bathrobes, slippers and Bluetooth sound systems. We have spaces for meetings and training sessions, and you can relax in the contemporary bar and restaurant while watching the spectacular sight of planes coming in to land. If you have some spare time for sightseeing or entertainment, there's plenty to see and do in the area within a 30-minute drive. Thorpe Park and Legoland Windsor are brilliant fun for families, while at Windsor Castle you can have a nosy around the state apartments. At Twickenham Stadium, just 5 miles away, revel in the atmosphere of an international rugby match or take a stadium tour. If you're heading into Central London, hop on the Heathrow Express.

8908.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features shopping on site, wedding services, and a television in a common area. Enjoy Indian cuisine at Madhus Heathrow, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Hayes? This hotel has 18148 square feet (1686 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 17 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 350 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions.

8933.description: A comfortable Birmingham hotel with a conference centre, a gym, and an indoor pool. Set in a pretty garden, Holiday Inn® Birmingham M6, Jct. 7 hotel is only six miles from Birmingham city centre. Close to the M6 motorway, our hotel is a great jumping-off point for family holidays to the Midlands and the South West via the M5 and M42. You can drive to Birmingham Airpor (BHX) in 20 minutes. Nearby Birmingham New Street station has regular direct trains to Leeds, Manchester, and London. Big-name gigs at the Arena Birmingham are within easy reach. You can go underwater without getting wet at the National SEA LIFE Centre or indulge your sweet tooth at the Cadbury World chocolate factory, a short drive away. If you’re planning a conference or a wedding, you can host up to 340 guests in our 16 air-conditioned, naturally lit meeting rooms. At this hotel you can enjoy: Free Wi-Fi, free parking, 24-hour room service and Kids Stay and Eat Free!Our smart rooms and suites all have high-quality bedding and a choice of pillows for your comfort. Tuck into a buffet breakfast or international dishes for dinner at Traders Restaurant, work out or swim laps at our You Fit Health & Fitness Club, or wind down in the sauna. Enjoy a pint with friends in the Open Lobby Bar & Lounge, or sip a latte in the garden.

8937.description: A stylish Edinburgh hotel next to Edinburgh Zoo, with an indoor pool and a fitness centreNear the M8 motorway, Holiday Inn® Edinburgh hotel is handy for the city centre and all its attractions. You can take a tour of the 16th-century, antique-furnished rooms at Holyrood Palace, official Scottish residence of the Queen, just a 20-minute bus ride from the hotel, or cheer on a game at Murrayfield Stadium, which hosts Scotland's rugby union home matches. The high street shops of the modern Gyle Shopping Centre are 10 minutes away by bus, from the stop just outside the hotel. Haymarket train station, also a short bus ride away, is served by trains across Scotland and the north of England. Here for work? You're a 10-minute drive from Edinburgh Park–based companies, or you can host meetings at the hotel in 14 flexible conference spaces with panoramic views. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- Limited free on-site parking- 24-hour room service- Kids stay and eat freeEach welcoming room has a flat-screen TV and a pillow menu. Look forward to an invigorating power shower in the morning, or get energised with a visit to the well-equipped fitness room or indoor pool. Relax at day's end in the spa or sauna, then dine on European cuisine in the hotel's casual restaurant and chat over drinks in the relaxed lounge bar.

8938.description: voco™ Edinburgh - Royal Terrace is nestled within historic gardens at the edge of Edinburgh's New Town. The voco™ Edinburgh - Royal Terrace is a 10-minute walk from Edinburgh Waverly station, and a 25-minute taxi ride from Edinburgh Airport. You'll be just a 20-minute walk from Edinburgh Castle. The National Museum of Scotland, the Palace of Holyrood house and the city's main shopping streets are on our doorstep, along with the new St. James Quarter. Captivating exteriors & stylish interiors, our warm and genuine hosts offer true Scottish hospitality; making our hotel your ‘home away from home’ with unique spaces to share and connect. The hotel is home to the Terrace Restaurant and Garden, where guests can take in a piece of nature in the city. Additionally, showing off Scotland's whisky scene, The Nook, showcases boutique cocktails and an extensive whisky menu.

8941.description: This hotel enjoys a great setting in London. The hotel is situated close to the British Museum, lying between the West End and Covent Garden. Guests will find themselves surrounded by a wealth of attractions, as well as shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. Links to the public transport network are available nearby, offering ease of access to other areas of the city. This charming hotel enjoys a delightful architectural design, blending effortlessly with its historical surroundings. The guest rooms are elegantly designed and offer a peaceful setting in which to work and rest in comfort. Guests can enjoy traditional dishes in the relaxing surroundings of the restaurant. This hotel offers a wide range of facilities, for guests' comfort and convenience.

name.content: The County Hotel and County Aparthotel

8942.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features wedding services and a banquet hall. Enjoy British cuisine at The Hudson Bar & Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. This hotel has 6 meeting rooms available for events. Self-parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 114 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers.

8943.description: At the heart of Newcastle's Quayside, this hotel is an ideal base from which to explore the city of Newcastle, as well as the heritage of Northumberland. A central hub for trade in North England, Newcastle and the surrounding areas host a vibrant business community. With the Northumbrian coastline and Hadrian's Wall both within easy reach, the city is also a perfect destination to visit for leisure and relaxation.

8951.description: Enjoy terrace views and amenities like complimentary Wi-Fi and wedding services. This hotel also features a common area television, discounted access to a nearby fitness center, and a banquet hall. Dine at the hotel's RBG Bar and Grill or enjoy room service (limited hours). Relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfast is served weekdays from 6:30 to 9:30 AM and weekends from 7:00 to 10:30 AM (for a fee). The hotel offers 146 guest rooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Safes and desks are provided, and housekeeping is daily. Located near Cardiff International Arena, the hotel is also a short distance from the University of South Wales and various city center attractions. The nearest airports are Cardiff International (CWL) and Bristol International (BRS).

8952.address: Rye Hill Allesley - West Midlands, na
8952.description: The hotel is situated in a quiet residential location within the village of Allesley, just off the A45 main dual carriageaway that connects Coventry and Birmingham. The hotel has a bright, airy restaurant and bar, combining a relaxed atmosphere and friendly service, with excellent food. A range of refurbished meeting and interview rooms, together with the ease of access make this an excellent location for meetings, be they large or small. There is free on site parking for 200 cars. The Coventry Hill Hotel forms an ideal base for exploring nearby Warwick (8 miles), Stratford upon Avon (14 miles), Royal Leamington Spa (8 miles) and the many other attractions in the heart of England. It is only 2 miles from Coventry City centre, 5 easy miles from the National Exhibition Centre (NEC) and Birmingham International Airport.

8953.description: The Novotel Coventry, conveniently located near M6 Junction 3, is a 10-minute drive from Coventry City Centre and within walking distance of the Coventry Building Society Arena (CBS Arena). This modern hotel offers comfortable guest rooms, an on-site restaurant and bar, eight meeting and event rooms, and pleasant gardens. All bedrooms are equipped with a plasma TV with Freeview channels, tea and coffee making facilities, a safe, a mini-fridge, and ironing facilities.

9007.description: Located in the heart of Dublin, The Westbury Hotel is steps from Grafton Street and the Phil Lynott Statue. This luxury Art Deco hotel offers 201 air-conditioned rooms with minibars, espresso makers, and pillowtop beds with premium bedding. Enjoy on-site amenities such as a fitness center, terrace, two restaurants including WILDE serving Irish cuisine, a bar/lounge, and 24-hour room service. Complimentary Wi-Fi and cable TV are provided. For business travelers, the hotel features a 24-hour business center and meeting facilities. Self-parking is available (charges apply).

9008.description: The Clarence is Dublin's original rock n' roll hotel situated right in the heart of Dublin. This boutique hotel offers rooms with super king-size, wrought-iron beds and velvet drapes. Located right in Dublin's centre, the hotel boast River Liffey views. Each individually designed room features custom-designed and hand-crafted furnishings, and stained glass bedside lamps. There is free Wi-Fi in all rooms, along with American White Oak floors and a private bathroom with limestone flooring. The hotel's Therapy area offers a range of relaxing massages and aromatherapy treatments. The Octagon Bar serves award-winning drinks and cocktails in Art Deco surroundings. Dublin's lively Temple Bar District is just a 2-minute walk from The Clarence, while O'Connell Street and Grafton Street are both 10 minutes' walk away.

9009.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and wedding services. Additional amenities at this hotel include tour/ticket assistance, barbecue grills, and complimentary use of a nearby fitness facility. Enjoy Irish cuisine at T3 Bar & Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is complimentary (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 229 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

name.content: The College Green Hotel Dublin, Autograph

9010.description: Located in the heart of Dublin, The College Green Hotel, Autograph Collection, is just a five-minute walk from Grafton Street and Trinity College. This luxury hotel offers a fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. Each of the 191 air-conditioned rooms features a minibar, LCD television, and a pillowtop bed. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Enjoy a meal at one of the hotel's two restaurants, including The Mint Bar, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. A full breakfast is available for a fee. Additional amenities include babysitting services, wedding services, a fireplace in the lobby, a business center, limo/town car service, express check-in, conference space, meeting rooms, and self-parking (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include EPIC The Irish Emigration Museum (1 km) and Jameson Distillery Bow St. (1. 7 km).

name.content: Cambridge Bar Hill Hotel BW Signature Collection

9012.description: Boasting an 18-hole golf course, indoor swimming pool and beautiful grounds to explore, Cambridge Bar Hill Hotel, BW Signature Collection really is a place to unwind, let your hair down and enjoy some valuable 'me' time. If you want to switch off completely, simply park up and leave your car in its space for a few days. While there's plenty to keep you occupied at the hotel, there's a wealth of attractions nearby if you fancy exploring the world around you. We're situated on the A14, just a mile from the M11, so getting around is a breeze. There's also a bus stop just around the corner with regular services into the centre of Cambridge. The famous academic city is 5 miles away, with its mesmerising colleges and museums including the Fitzwilliam, home to over half a million artworks. One of the best ways to take in the sights is on a punt along the River Cam and, in the evening, see the city from a different perspective as it comes alive with cocktail bars and clubs. Elsewhere, Duxford's Imperial War Museum has more than 300 aircraft on display, while Newmarket beckons for a day at the races. Our 136 contemporary bedrooms have comfortable mattresses and plump pillows to help you get a great night's sleep. We have something for every budget, from classic twin rooms to superior doubles with king-size beds, iPod docks and extra snacks. You can relax in the Gallery Bar, which shows BT and Sky Sports and has a decked area overlooking the golf course – pleasant in the warmer months. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Swimming Pool, Sauna and Steam Room. These will remain closed until further notice.

9013.description: On school or national holidays, this hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has kids amenities available on requestExplore London's West End from the iconic Waldorf Hilton hotel in Theatreland, five minutes' walk from fantastic shopping in Covent Garden. Savor modern European cuisine in stylish surroundings at the Homage Grand Salon restaurant, enjoy afternoon tea in Homage Private Bar, or sip a cocktail in Good Godfrey's bar. Visit top London attractions within a mile radius of this central London hotel, including the London Eye and Trafalgar Square, or enjoy a play or musical at the theater. Situated 2 miles from London's financial centre, The Waldorf Hilton hotel has an Executive Lounge, a 24-hour business centre and 7 meeting rooms for up to 400 with wireless internet access. All guest rooms have high-speed internet access. Upgrade to a Deluxe Room or choose an Executive Room for Executive Lounge access.

9014.description: Located close to the West End, this upscale hotel sits proudly in London, surrounded by stylish shopping districts, leafy Royal parks and thriving business centres. The city's wealth of intriguing attractions can be found close by. This elegant hotel greets visitors with the promise of a comfortable, enjoyable stay. Rich in grandeur and timeless elegance, the guest rooms come complete with first-class amenities. Guests are invited to dine in style in the restaurant, or enjoy the property's renowned afternoon tea. Guests can indulge in the ultimate relaxation in the health centre and spa. This luxurious hotel also offers the perfect setting for conferences and events.

9015.description: Indulge in a relaxing experience at the full-service spa, offering a variety of massages. Take advantage of the hotel's recreational amenities, including an indoor pool, sauna, and fitness center. This hotel also provides complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy lunch or dinner at Carluccio's, the hotel's restaurant, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 11 AM and on weekends from 7 AM to 11 AM (for a fee). Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in London? This hotel offers 5, 231 square feet (486 square meters) of space, including conference space and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Make yourself comfortable in one of the 311 guest rooms, each featuring a minibar and a flat-screen television. Your pillowtop bed includes premium bedding, and rooms have private balconies or patios. Wireless internet access is available (surcharge), along with satellite programming. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. The hotel is conveniently located near Primrose Hill, Regent's Park, and ZSL London Zoo. The nearest airport is London City Airport (LCY).

name.content: Radisson Blu Edwardian Hampshire Hotel London

9016.description: The Radisson Blu Edwardian Hampshire Hotel, part of Edwardian Hotels London, is located in the heart of the city's iconic film and theatreland. The building itself is a striking combination of classic red-brick architecture and a sleek, contemporary interior. Guests can enjoy incredible views from their rooms, taking in the London Eye, Nelson's Column, and Leicester Square Gardens—a fabulous vantage point during movie premiere nights. A 24-hour fitness room and six private meeting spaces (hosting between 2 and 120 people) complete the hotel's outstanding facilities. The 127 bedrooms include doubles, family rooms, and suites, featuring luxurious 350-thread-count Egyptian cotton bedding, down pillows, REN toiletries, Italian marble bathrooms, elegant decor, and cutting-edge technology. Samsung TVs offer up to 300 channels in multiple languages, and free high-speed Wi-Fi (up to 150mbps) is available on an unlimited number of devices. For a real treat, book one of the hotel's stunning square-facing rooms or suites and feel as if you are floating above the bustling Leicester Square. Leicester Square Kitchen offers superb food in effortlessly cool surroundings. Contemporary furnishings and a relaxed atmosphere provide the backdrop to a fabulous fusion of Peruvian-Mexican sharing plates, all prepared on-site. The Hampshire Lounge Bar and al fresco terrace offer afternoon tea and light snacks. Always on trend, the Lounge Bar also regularly collaborates with some of the world's finest food and drink brands. Famous sights and attractions, such as Soho, Piccadilly Circus, Chinatown, Covent Garden, Mayfair, Regent Street, Trafalgar Square's National Gallery and National Portrait Gallery, Fortnum & Mason, and the Embankment, are all minutes away, as is Leicester Square Underground station (linking to London Waterloo). Please provide a valid credit card upon arrival.

9018.description: This charming property is located just off Cromwell Road, in London. Guests can explore the nearby Natural History Museum, the Science Museum and the Victoria and Albert Museum. Kensington Gardens are located nearby. This property offers close proximity to public transport links, which provide ease of access to many of the city's renowned attractions. This charming hotel welcomes visitors with warm hospitality and the promise of a memorable stay. Stylish, comfortable guest rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. Excellent facilities are available to ensure that the needs of every type of traveller are fully catered for.

9019.description: A modern Newcastle hotel in quiet grounds just outside the city the Holiday Inn® Newcastle - Gosforth Park hotel sits in a peaceful setting close to the junction of the A1/A19 roads. Direct trains run to Newcastle from Cramlington Station, seven minutes' away by car. Business guests are within 15 minutes' drive of Nelson Industrial Estate, Apex Business Village, Quorum Business Park and Cobalt Business Park. The hotel's 10 meeting rooms hold up to 400 people. There's free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Eight electric charging points have been installed supplied by Project EV. Enjoy Newcastle's nightlife, watch the football at St. James' Park or catch the races at Newcastle Racecourse, all an easy distance from the hotel. Alnwick Castle, where the first two Harry Potter movies were filmed, is 30 minutes' away by car and Bamburgh Castle where Indiana Jones 5 has recently been filmed is 40 minutes' away by car. Enjoy a walk in the sprawling grounds, clock a few laps in the leisure club's indoor pool or wind down in the spa bath. Residents must book for spa treatments. Please call direct at 0191 2019965. Linger with a coffee or snack in the comfortable Open Lobby, or sip a cool beer on the patio. The formal dining serves an English and continental buffet breakfast and bistro meals. In this family-friendly hotel, you can chill out and Kids Stay and Eat Free.

9020.description: This hotel enjoys close proximity to the M23, in London. Just a few minutes' driving distance away from Gatwick Airport, this hotel offers convenience to suit business and leisure travellers. This stunning property boasts a magnificent architectural design, dating back to 1600. Beautifully retaining its heritage style, this former country manor is sure to impress. Stunningly-designed rooms respect the grace and classical grandeur of the building. An extensive range of first-class facilities and services can be availed of onsite. The property features a health centre, as well as many sports options. Guests can dine in style in the elegant surroundings of the restaurant. Conference rooms and a public internet terminal will assist visitors with their business needs.

9021.description: Travel stress-free at Sofitel London Gatwick with direct corridor access straight from the hotel lobby to Gatwicks North Terminal. Savour culinary delights as you choose from 4 delicious restaurants and refreshing hot buffet breakfast is served daily in Le petit reveur. Club Millesime rooms boast runway views and access to the exclusive Club Lounge with all-inclusive bites and drinks. The Park and Fly package offers stress-free travel with the ability to park, stay, travel and return home in style.

9022.address: West Park Road Copthorne, West Sussex
9022.description: Built around a historic and charming country house, the Copthorne Hotel Effingham Gatwick is a 4 star hotel set amidst a picturesque parkland estate that dates back to 1841. It's distinct character sets it apart from many of the local hotels, yet we are a very convenient 10-min drive away from Gatwick International Airport. Very close to The Hawth Theatre, The Bluebell Railway, The British Wildlife Centre and local hiking trails, we are also within easy reach of the South Coast, meaning there is plenty to do and see during your stay with us. Enjoy a round of foot golf, floodlit tennis courts, and a well-equipped gym too - a perfect balance of activities and relaxation. Those staying before setting off to the airport or in transit will have a perfect base to refresh, rest and prepare - making their trip even more relaxing and convenient.

9034.description:
A modern, art deco stylish hotel located off Grafton Street in Dublin 2, a popular and safe area to stay in Dublin due to its proximity to all the major attractions in Dublin City. 
Known as one of the cool hotels Dublin has to offer, The Grafton Hotel is your perfect home-from-home in the heart of Dublin. The Trinity College, Grafton Street, and The Guinness Storehouse are all within easy walking distance from the hotel. Stop by Temple Bar and enjoy a pint before heading off to Croke Park, Aviva Stadium or 3Arena for a gig.

9037.description: The Copthorne Hotel Aberdeen, a premier 4-star hotel, is nestled in the quiet West End of Aberdeen city centre, within easy walking distance of shops, attractions, and nightlife. Behind its historic granite facade, this charming hotel combines traditional elegance with modern amenities and impeccable service. The spacious rooms feature satellite TV, complimentary tea and coffee, and a trouser press. Each bathroom includes a hairdryer, and some offer bathrobes. Guests can enjoy delicious meals at the 122 Steak & Grill Room, which also serves a tasty breakfast, or relax with light meals and drinks at the friendly Mac's Bar. With three golf courses within a 10-minute drive and several bars and restaurants just a short stroll away, the Copthorne offers something for everyone. Aberdeen Rail Station is conveniently located less than a mile from the hotel.

9040.description: A smart central Birmingham hotel with a restaurant and extensive meeting spaceThe Holiday Inn® Birmingham City Centre hotel is a two-minute stroll from Birmingham New Street station. We’re steps away from the theatre district and the city’s vibrant Chinatown, and only 10 minutes by car from the M6 motorway. Shoppers are spoiled for choice with the high-end Mailbox, the vast Bullring and the Grand Central shopping centre within a short walk. For business guests, the cutting-edge Birmingham Conference & Events Centre is right next door, the International Convention Centre (ICC) is a 5-minute drive away, and you can host up to 600 people in our flexible meeting rooms. Catch a live show at the O2 Academy, just down the road, or enjoy exhibitions at nearby Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery. For a night out, head to the bars on buzzing Broad Street. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- Parking at daily rates- All Day Dining- Kids stay and eat free Step into our multifaceted social space, the Lobby on Hill Street, to sip Starbucks coffee in a comfy retro chair, watch a movie in the Media Lounge or hold an informal meeting. The E-Bar provides power sockets for your devices, and laptop work space. Our welcoming guest rooms and suites all have desks and Smart TVs, blackout shades and a choice of pillows to help you sleep.

9043.description: A family-friendly Chester hotel with free parking, plus a health club with a heated poolHoliday Inn® Chester - South hotel is just off the A55, 3 miles from Chester city centre. You can get a train to London from Chester station, a 10-minute drive away, and the M53 and M56 motorways are close by. Catching a flight is easy, with both John Lennon Liverpool Airport (LPL) and Manchester Airport (MAN) within a 35-minute drive. The whole family can spot gibbons and rhinos at Chester Zoo, or stroll along the River Dee, not far from the hotel. Explore medieval Chester Cathedral, or discover the North Wales coast, both within easy reach. If you’re looking for a conference or wedding venue, our 3 light-bathed meeting spaces are perfect for gatherings of up to 70 people. Business guests are only a short stroll from meetings at Chester Business Park. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- A pillow menu- Kids stay and eat freeStart the day with a hearty buffet breakfast, or grab a Starbucks coffee from the To Go Café in our vibrant Open Lobby. The You Fit is the perfect place for a weights session or a few laps in the pool, and you can wind down in the sauna. Our comfortable bedrooms all have handy USB charging points, quality bedding and bathrooms fitted with power showers or relaxing baths.

9044.description: Holiday Inn Coventry M6 Jct. 2 is a contemporary hotel close to the city centre with multipurpose meeting and event facilities and an onsite bar and restaurant. Enjoy a full English breakfast or a hearty dinner in our Open Lobby restaurant, have a drink in the lounge bar, or order room service 24/7. Our Academy conference centre has 15 meeting rooms that can host meetings for up to 250 people: perfect for business meetings, company away days and special occasions, including weddings. Cross Point Business Park is next door, and Coventry University Technology Park is only five miles away. The Holiday Inn Coventry is less than a mile from the M6 and M69 motorways, giving you easy access to the Midlands and the North. You can drive to Birmingham Airport in 20 minutes, and a bus into Coventry City Centre takes half an hour. Walk to Showcase De Lux cinema and ten-pin bowling alley in less than 10 minutes, while Birmingham's NEC and the neighbouring Resorts World leisure complex are 20 minutes' drive away. Warwick Castle is a great local attraction, and Stratford-upon-Avon is half an hour away by car.

9053.description: Hotel Portinari offers the best of both worlds: experience modern Bruges and the city's rich history in one and the same hotel. Our subtle mix of classic luxury and contemporary design will make you feel at home straight away. Situated in a historic building on the city's central square, it is just a stone's throw away from Bruges' foremost attractions. With its charming palette of minimalist elements and natural lighting, this boutique hotel is the ultimate base camp. Book a room, come on in and enjoy the spaciousness and freedom of Hotel Portinari. Enjoy the hospitality and a warm welcome that you will find only in a family-run hotel!

9125.description: Overlooking one of Edinburgh’s prettiest private garden squares, Kimpton Charlotte Square Hotel consists of seven interconnected Georgian townhouses. Outside is where you’ll find the New Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that’s delightfully removed from the city’s tourist hubs. But it’s inside where things really get interesting. The interior blends handsome woods, plush fabrics, and rich pops of color—and, yes, just a touch of tartan—to luxurious effect. And with a magnetic inner courtyard, an acclaimed Middle Eastern restaurant and award-winning Scottish restaurant , it’s no wonder the hotel has become a natural meeting point.

name.content: Hotel Du Vin @ One Devonshire Gardens

9126.description: Enjoy on-site massages and facials at this Glasgow hotel, along with complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and wedding services. Dine at Bistro du Vin, specializing in British cuisine, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. The hotel also offers a business center, express check-in/check-out, conference space, meeting rooms, and limited on-site parking. Each of the 49 guestrooms features a plasma TV, complimentary Wi-Fi, cable programming, a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer, a phone, a safe, and a desk. Nearby attractions include the Cathedral of St. Luke, Botanic Gardens, Cottiers Theatre, University of Glasgow, Kelvingrove Park, and Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum. The nearest airport is Glasgow International Airport (GLA).

9127.description: The Queens is an iconic landmark hotel located in the heart of Leeds. Welcoming guests since 1937, the hotel features a private entrance to Leeds Train Station and offers breathtaking views of City Square. Recently the hotel has undergone a massive £16 million renovation to update its facilities, while still honouring its rich and iconic history. The Queens is a central haven for events and stays with 13 exceptional event spaces that vary in size and functionality, and 232 sophisticated bedrooms complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience.

9131.description: A convenient Heathrow Airport hotel with meeting rooms, a leisure club and a choice of restaurantsCrowne Plaza® London - Heathrow hotel is a quick taxi ride from Heathrow Airport (LHR). We’re just off the M4, and Park, Stay & Go packages let you leave your car onsite and travel to the airport on the Hotel Hoppa bus. We’re only 15 miles from central London, and if you don’t want to drive, the Heathrow Express train gets you there in 20 minutes. Our 21 conference rooms can host up to 200 guests, and our Crowne Plaza Meetings Director is on hand to help arrange everything. A free shuttle runs to the business parks at Stockley Park and Bedfont Lakes. If you have time off, explore Windsor Castle or take the kids to LEGOLAND® Windsor Resort, both a short drive away. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Complimentary WiFi- 24-hour room service- Club Rooms with access to a private loungeOur welcoming bedrooms are designed with comfort in mind, and our Sleep Advantage® programme provides quiet zones and premium bedding. While you’re waiting for a flight, you can work out in the gym or relax in the pool, steam room and sauna. Savour sophisticated Indian cuisine in ERIKI Restaurant or modern British dishes in Orwell's Brasserie, and relax with a pint in Dr. O'Driscoll's Irish Bar.

9143.description: Located on one of the seven hills of Edinburgh, only 8 km from the city centre and close to the airport, this hotel provides spectacular panoramic views of the area. Public transport links are easily accessible, a mere 40 metres from the hotel doorstep. Offering refreshing, rejuvenating interiors, this hotel boasts quintessential Scottish style. Guests are sure to enjoy traditional architecture, coupled with modern comforts. The hotel guest rooms are spacious and endearing, inviting guests to fully relax and enjoy their stay. Rejuvenating facilities include a top of the range fitness centre, swimming pool and golf course, a mere 1 km from the hotel. The Westview restaurant provides delectable dishes sure to please even the most discerning guest. Guests are invited to sit back and enjoy the lavish surroundings which this hotel has to offer.

9144.description: A stylish hotel at Glasgow Airport with conference facilities and on-site parking. The Holiday Inn® Glasgow Airport hotel is a short walk away from the main terminal. The city centre is a 20-minute drive away on the M8 motorway, and buses run to central Glasgow 24 hours a day from the stop opposite the hotel. Business guests can host up to 250 delegates in the hotel's 18 flexible meeting rooms, while events at the Scottish Exhibition and Conference Centre are just a 15-minute drive away. You can browse for bargains or catch a movie at the intu Braehead shopping and leisure complex and cheer on Britain's top ice-hockey players in matches at Braehead Arena, all just a short drive away. For music lovers, a 15-minute drive from the hotel, the SSE Hydro arena hosts a vibrant international programme of concerts and shows. At this hotel you can enjoy the following benefits: Free Wi-Fi throughout, On-site and secure off-site parking at a daily rate, Kids stay and eat free, Stylish guest rooms feature comfortable beds and pillow menus to ensure restful nights. In the hotel's restaurant, you can enjoy a traditional full Scottish breakfast buffet and dine on a juicy steak or burger. After a long day, relax in the lounge bar and catch live sports on two widescreen TVs, or kick back in your room and order from the 24-hour room service menuPlease note that this hotel does not accept cash payments.

9145.description: Indulge in a relaxing experience at the full-service spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Take advantage of the hotel's recreational amenities, including an indoor pool, sauna, and fitness center. This hotel also provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy dinner at the on-site restaurant, Cast Iron Grill, or grab a quick bite at the coffee shop/cafe. 24-hour room service is also available. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. For business travelers, the hotel offers a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event? The hotel boasts over 18, 000 square feet of event space, including a conference center and 12 meeting rooms. Self-parking is available on-site (subject to charges). The hotel offers 302 air-conditioned rooms, each featuring an LED television, a pillowtop bed with down comforters and premium bedding, and a 49-inch flat-screen TV with satellite programming. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, deep soaking bathtubs, and designer toiletries. Nearby attractions include St. Vincent Street Church (0. 4 mi), The Mitchell Library (0. 5 mi), and Buchanan Street (0. 6 mi).

9146.description: This city hotel is located close to the centre of Leeds. A variety of shops, restaurants, bars and entertainment venues lie within easy access of the hotel. Links to the public transport network are to be found nearby. This wonderful hotel enjoys a charming architectural design, welcoming guests with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, offering a relaxing setting in which to completely unwind at the end of the day. Guests can enjoy delightful dining in the restaurant, followed by a refreshing drink from the bar. Those travelling for work purposes will appreacite the business and conference facilities that the hotel has to offer.

9148.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a 24-hour health club or take in the view from a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy international cuisine at Market Garden Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. English breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Hounslow? This hotel has 18665 square feet (1734 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge at scheduled times, and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.

9151.description: Newly redeveloped, the Royal Court Hotel is set within 11 acres of landscaped gardens and parkland. It offers discerning guests peaceful and tranquil surroundings in a rural setting, yet is only 3 miles from Coventry city center and 9 miles from the NEC. While the hotel has the setting of a country house, it boasts the extensive facilities of a major hotel, including an international-style reception and a baronial restaurant in the original manor house. Built in 1894 as a private residence for William Hillman, the motor manufacturer, the manor house features en suite bedrooms, each individually furnished, some overlooking the gardens. The cozy bar looks out onto rolling lawns, while the reception bar overlooks the large indoor swimming pool.

9154.description: Holiday Inn® Leeds - Garforth hotel is 15 minutes drive from Leeds city centre. There's free parking, and Garforth Station, a mile and a half away, has direct lines to Leeds,  York and Scarborough. The M1 motorway is close by, and Leeds Bradford Airport (LBA) is half an hour drive away. Six miles away, in Leeds city centre, you can see jousting re-enactments at the Royal Armouries Museum or come face to face with the Leeds Tiger at the Leeds City Museum.  If you prefer the countryside, you're only an hour drive from the Yorkshire Dales and North Yorkshire Moors. The hotel's 19 meeting rooms can host up to 300 delegates. The free WiFi throughout the hotel helps you keep up with work.  Thorpe Park, home to IBM and Northern Foods, is just over a mile from the hotel, and the local Cross Flats Industrial Estate is also close by. Swim in the indoor pool,  work out at the Fitness Centre or unwind in the spa. The Open Lobby Restaurant serves a buffet breakfast and a full evening menu. Enjoy a nightcap beside the fire in Open Lobby Bar and Lounge or on the patio in summer. You can order snacks at any time thanks to 24-hour room service. Kids stay and eat free.

9155.description: Situated just 4 miles from London Gatwick Airport, Sandman Signature London Gatwick Hotel is also just 30 minutes from central London via the Gatwick Express train. With free Wi-Fi throughout, the Sandman Signature offers a discounted fixed price taxi service to both airport terminals for guests, when booked at reception. Each of the 151 bedrooms at the hotel near Gatwick airport has air conditioning, an en-suite bathroom, microwave and fridge on request. Additional benefits include a flat-screen LCD TV featuring Freeview channels. The hotel has parking available at an overnight charge. There is a choice of 12 meeting rooms, the largest of which has a capacity of 200. Guests can also make use of a 24-hour front desk. Contemporary, modern food is served in the stylish Brasserie Restaurant and in the relaxed Club Bar. There is also an on-site gym, a pool and a steam room. Crawley is a 5-minute drive from the Sandman Signature. The seaside town of Brighton is 25 miles away and features beaches, shops and a Sea Life aquarium.

9200.description: The Hotel Jungfrau Mürren is situated next to the ski school with its own exercise area for children and offers direct access to slopes around the car-free village of Mürren. South-facing rooms have balconies and offer superb mountain views. All you can hear at night are the sounds of the nearby waterfalls and creeks. There is a large sunny terrace, a restaurant offering Swiss and international cuisine, a small hotel bar, a library and a cozy lounge with a fireplace. In summer, the meadows behind the Hotel Jungfrau Mürren are an ideal playground for children and they also give you access to the many hiking paths around Mürren. As a guest of the Hotel Jungfrau Mürren you enjoy free access to the public bath including a jacuzzi, to the ice rink, as well as discounts for other facilities in the local sports center. Both train stations are only an 8 to 10 minute walk away.

9202.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Wengen and was established in 1894. It is a short drive away from the Jungfraujoch and the nearest station is Wengen. The Hotel has 3 restaurants, a bar, a conference room and a fitness centre/gym. All 100 rooms are equipped with minibar and hairdryer.

9207.description: This hotel enjoys a central location in Dublin. The hotel is located parallel to St. George's Street, offering the ideal starting point from which to explore the delights that the city has to offer. Guests will find themselves within easy access of Trinity College, as well as the artistic quarter of the city and Temple Bar. This stylish hotel greets guests with traditional hospitality and charm. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, and come complete with modern amenities. Guests will be impressed by the wide range of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer. Guests can enjoy delectable dining in the elegant surroundings of the restaurant.

name.content: Hilton Garden Inn Dublin City Centre

9208.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with **reduced service**: Business Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Room Service. Explore the city from our family-friendly Hilton Garden Inn Dublin Custom House hotel, just 5 minutes from the city centre. You'll be within walking distance to a variety of public transportation options as well as dining, shopping and businesses. Stroll down Grafton Street – Ireland's most famous shopping street. Unwind in a spacious room with large, comfortable beds, a 40-inch HDTV, mini-refrigerator and laptop safe. Get work done with complimentary WiFi in your room while seated at the workstation with ergonomic chair. Dine at Oly's Bar & Restaurant, our on-site bar and restaurant. Food is served throughout the day until 10pm with options for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The kids will enjoy a menu designed just for them. Enjoy a pint of Guinness at the comfortable bar while watching sports on the large screen TVs. Stay committed to your workout routine in the fitness centre with cardio equipment and free weights. Be productive in the business center with complimentary WiFi and printing.

9209.description: In central Dublin, the hotel offers luxurious accommodation and a Michelin starred restaurant. There is a gym, and the hotel's interior design is by Sir Terence Conran. Rooms have baths and power showers, anti-mist mirrors, luxurious bathrobe, slippers and H20 toiletries. They also feature LCD TVs, iPod compatible music systems and free internet connections. The Michelin-starred Thornton's Restaurant offers fine dining in an elegant atmosphere overlooking St. Stephens Green. On the mezzanine level, Citron serves modern Mediterranean cuisine. The gym is equipped with modern equipment whilst the Spirit Treatment rooms offer many treatments including pedicures, massages and nail work. The city's Temple Bar area is just a 5-minute stroll away, as is Trinity College. The Fitzwilliam is just 9. 7 km from Dublin Airport and Heuston Train Station is 2. 4 km away. This is our guests' favorite part of Dublin, according to independent reviews.

9210.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace at the Arlington Hotel O'Connell Bridge, located in the heart of Dublin, steps from O'Connell Street and a short walk from Trinity College. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Dine at one of the two on-site restaurants, enjoy room service (limited hours), or relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available weekdays and weekends for a fee. The hotel also provides dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Each of the 131 guestrooms features a private bathroom with shower/tub combination, complimentary toiletries, and a hairdryer. Conveniences include a phone, safe, and desk.

name.content: Crabwall Manor & Spa BW Signature Collection

9220.description: This cozy establishment guarantees a quiet stay with just eight accommodation units. Guests can enjoy Wi-Fi throughout the property and a 24-hour reception. Cots are not available at Alchymist Prague Castle Suites. An airport transfer service is also offered. Guests can take advantage of the health and wellness services available on-site. Please note that some services may incur a fee.

name.content: Radisson Blu Edwardian Bloomsbury Street London

9221.description: -A neighbourhood boutique hotel located in the capital's literary heritage quarter, this Bloomsbury hideaway is next to The British Museum, within walking distance of Oxford Street, Tottenham Court Road and Covent Garden. -Social spaces are available for work and relaxation, featuring designer furniture and beautifully crafted Assouline books. -Its proximity to the life of London is contrasted by tranquil, comfortable bedrooms and suites featuring complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi up to 150Mbps, handcrafted Vispring mattresses and plush bedding, as well as award-winning amenities from REN Clean Skincare. -Discover a distinguished sunrise to sunset destination at Bloomsbury Street Kitchen, serving an exquisite selection of contemporary Mediterranean and Japanese small plates, complemented by a diverse variety of wines, sake and signature cocktails. - Nine private meeting rooms can host anything from an intimate meeting to a large-scale event for 300 people. Radisson Blu Edwardian Bloomsbury Street has a prime location in the heart of Bloomsbury, the literary district of London. Set just 50 metres from the famous British Museum, the hotel is also within easy walking distance of Oxford Street, Covent Garden, Fitzrovia and Soho. The nearest tube station is Tottenham Court Road on the Central and Northern Lines. Holborn tube station is minutes away giving direct access to the financial district, and nearby Eurostar at King's Cross St Pancras station connects you to Paris and Brussels.

name.content: Four Seasons Hotel London at Park Lane

9222.description: Situated in the heart of Mayfair, Four Seasons Hotel London at Park Lane offers a tranquil escape on a quiet street, yet is moments from Hyde Park, Green Park, and St. James's Park. World-class shopping on Bond Street and Knightsbridge, along with the West End theatres and Buckingham Palace, are just a short stroll away. This five-star hotel boasts 193 luxurious guest rooms and suites, some with fireplaces and private terraces offering stunning park and city views. The chic, contemporary design by Pierre-Yves Rochon blends classic British elegance with modern sophistication. Guests can enjoy high-style dining, a skilled concierge team, and a glass-walled rooftop spa and lounge with a state-of-the-art fitness centre. The tenth-floor spa sanctuary features nine treatment rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows and private relaxation pods, creating a haven for total relaxation and well-being.

9223.description: Indulge in a luxurious spa experience with massages, body treatments, and facials. Maintain your fitness routine at the indoor pool, steam room, and fitness center. This hotel offers complimentary wired and wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Savor French cuisine at Helene Darroze, one of the hotel's three restaurants, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Lighter fare is available at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind with a drink at one of the four bars/lounges. English breakfasts are served daily (7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee). For business travelers, the hotel provides express check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and four meeting rooms. Each of the 122 individually decorated guestrooms features iPod docking stations, minibars (stocked with some free items), private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, bidets, phones, safes, and desks. Located near Selfridges, Hyde Park, and Bond Street, the hotel offers convenient access to London's premier shopping and entertainment districts. Nearby airports include London City (LCY), Heathrow (LHR), Gatwick (LGW), and Luton (LTN).

9224.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy French cuisine at Alain Ducasse, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Make yourself at home in one of the 250 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. Flat-screen televisions with premium TV channels are provided, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

name.content: Radisson Blu Hotel, London Euston Square

9225.description: The Grafton, part of Edwardian Hotels London, is the perfect base from which to explore famous London attractions, such as Regents Park, London Zoo, Madame Tussauds, Oxford St, Charlotte St, and the British Museum all of which are minutes away. The hotel itself merges incredible history - it was the home of the Aston Martin Owners Club - with a stylish, contemporary look and feel. The Grafton's 330 bedrooms include elegant single, double and family rooms, as well as 10 deluxe suites. Thanks to the building's 19th century heritage, no two rooms are the same but they all feature luxurious furnishings, Italian marble bathrooms, premium branded complimentary REN toiletries, 350 thread count Egyptian cotton bedding and down pillows. Cutting edge in-room technology is available, including free high-speed WiFi up to 150mbps on unlimited devices. A 24 hour fitness room is available for guests needing to revitalise while 11 meeting rooms provide a range of spaces to suit anything from 2-150 guests. Steak and Lobster delivers the finest steak and freshest lobster to your plate. We believe simplicity is key and let the food speak for itself. With freshly caught lobster and steak from County Antrim in Northern Ireland, we understand the importance of provenance and quality. Celebrating the finest from land and sea, our signature cuts and lobsters can be enjoyed in their purest form straight from the charcoal grill, on a baked brioche roll or through other exquisite combinations. It is also a few minutes' walk to Euston mainline station and prestigious London academic institutions UCL, LSE and Royal Academy of Dramatic Arts. The Wellcome Trust biomedical research facility, British Library and Fitzrovia's many media companies, are nearby, as is Kings Cross St Pancras' Eurostar link to Paris and Brussels. Please provide a valid credit card upon arrival at the hotel.

9227.description: CHARM & COMFORT IN A COSMOPOLITAN SETTINGThe Victorian splendour of the 19th century townhouse has been incorporated into the contemporary design of the 21st century to create an intimate atmosphere while retaining its elegance. The Queen's Gate London Hotel is ideally situated at the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. Surrounded by several places of interest like the Royal Albert Hall, Hyde Park, Natural History Museum, Science Museum, Victoria & Albert Museum, Kensington Palace, Imperial College and the famous shopping area of Knightsbridge. All 90 bedrooms have been designed to offer the maximum in comfort and relaxation and to create a unique experience. The recently re-designed bar/restaurant offers a selection of food & drinks throughout the day and it is the ideal place to relax after a busy day in London. While the hotel's two meeting rooms can accommodate up to 30 people each. A fully equipped fitness centre is also at our guests disposal.

9228.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Breakfast, Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Business Center, On-site Restaurant(s). Feel welcome the moment you arrive at DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel London – Chelsea with a warm, chocolate chip cookie at check-in. Enjoy an attractive location moments from the banks of the River Thames, in the heart of Chelsea's prestigious Imperial Wharf. Take advantage of easy access to the Chelsea and Fulham Football Clubs and London's most popular attractions, including Kensington Palace and the Victoria and Albert Museum. From our contemporary hotel in Chelsea, guests can easily discover the stylish restaurants and bars, independent shops and designer boutiques of Kings Road. The Imperial Wharf Train Station is located just across the road from our stylish Chelsea hotel; Fulham Broadway tube station is 15 minutes' walk away and the River Bus can be taken from nearby Chelsea Harbour. All of the inviting guest rooms at this Chelsea hotel feature beautiful Laura Ashley décor and contemporary amenities designed to help you relax and stay productive. Watch Freeview channels on the 26-inch flat-screen TV, check emails with complimentary WiFi at the large, well-lit desk and refresh in the spacious bathroom with complimentary toiletries. Upgrade to a bright and comfortable suite, offering additional living space and wonderful city views. Start your day with a delicious breakfast in our stylish onsite restaurant and recharge with your favorite hot drink and a sweet treat in the coffee bar. After a busy day, unwind with a glass of wine and a tasty snack in our relaxed bar.

9238.description: This modern city hotel is centrally located on Camden Street, a 5-minute walk from St. Stephen's Green and Grafton Street, Dublin's premier shopping destination. Offering a 24-hour reception, conference and leisure facilities, and internet access, this hotel is ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Guests can dine in the hotel's restaurant or enjoy a drink in the bar. The bright, comfortable en-suite rooms are tastefully decorated and equipped with a direct-dial telephone, television, and tea/coffee making facilities. For relaxation, guests can indulge in the hot tub and sauna or enjoy a variety of treatments in the beauty room. A breakfast buffet and à la carte dinner are available.

9239.description: This elegant and charming hotel boasts a privileged position to discover a wide range of interesting attractions as well as learn about the culture and history of this region of Scotland. Boasting a great position, this hotel is the ideal choice of accommodation for both business and leisure travellers wishing to explore the Granite City or Aberdeen. The completely appointed and lavishly decorated guest rooms are the best spaces in which guests can rest at the end of a busy day's sightseeing or working. They are ample, luminous, and well equipped with complimentary wireless Internet connection and champagne on arrival for extra convenience and comfort. Among the excellent on-site facilities available, visitors may indulge themselves with a special treatment at the health and spa centre with an indoor pool. Corporate travellers may take advantage of the meeting rooms.

9240.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities including an indoor pool and a steam room. Additional features at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, a television in a common area, and a banquet hall. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Birmingham? This hotel has 9688 square feet (900 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 14 meeting rooms. A train station pick-up service is provided at no charge, and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 241 guestrooms featuring Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature hair dryers and toothbrushes and toothpaste. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and coffee/tea makers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. National Exhibition Centre - 3. 5 km / 2. 2 mi- National Motorcycle Museum - 3. 8 km / 2. 3 mi- Birmingham Business Park - 4. 9 km / 3 mi- Resorts World Birmingham - 4. 1 km / 2. 6 mi- Santai Spa - 4. 2 km / 2. 6 mi- The Vox Conference Centre - 4. 3 km / 2. 7 mi- Pendigo Lake - 4. 4 km / 2. 8 mi- Resorts World Arena - 4. 5 km / 2. 8 mi- The Bear Grylls Adventure - 5 km / 3. 1 mi- Touchwood Shopping Center - 5. 5 km / 3. 4 mi- Tudor Grange Park - 6. 1 km / 3. 8 mi- Acocks Green Bowl - 6. 5 km / 4 mi- O2 Institute - 10. 8 km / 6. 7 mi- Shopping District - 11 km / 6. 9 mi- Birmingham City University - 11. 1 km / 6. 9 mi. The nearest airports are: Birmingham Airport (BHX) - 3. 9 km / 2. 4 mi Coventry (CVT) - 26. 1 km / 16.

9242.description: At the gateway to Cardiff, the Premier Inn Hotel Cardiff North opens up the whole city for you - from prime business locations to top entertainment and sports venues. On a key bus route, you'll be able to zip off for a great day's shopping and sightseeing. Then take your pick from hundreds of top-notch bars and restaurants. Or get in on the live action at the Motorpoint Arena or Millennium Stadium. Whatever you're up to out and about, our on-site restaurant and comfy rooms will be right here waiting. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

9244.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. Additional features at this hotel include concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), and wedding services. Guests can get around on the complimentary shuttle, which operates within 2 km. Enjoy Italian cuisine at Charlie's, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a 24-hour business center, and express check-in. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 2702 square feet (251 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 115 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. Your Select Comfort bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets.

9304.description: Centrally located in Edinburgh, The Balmoral Hotel is steps from Princes Street and a short walk from Calton Hill. This luxury hotel is 0. 4 miles (0. 7 km) from Edinburgh Playhouse Theatre and 0. 5 miles (0. 8 km) from the Royal Mile. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Guests can also enjoy the indoor pool, sauna, and fitness center. This Edwardian hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and wedding services. The 187 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars and Smart televisions with satellite programming. Private bathrooms include showers, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences such as phones, safes, and desks are also provided. Dine at Number One, one of the hotel's three restaurants, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a drink at one of the two bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are served on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (for a fee). Express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk are available. The hotel also offers ten meeting rooms for events.

9305.description: Enjoy a stay at the Delta Hotels by Marriott Edinburgh, featuring a health club, indoor pool, and spa tub. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services, and an on-site restaurant, Cast Iron Grill, plus a coffee shop/cafe and 24-hour room service. Unwind at the bar/lounge, and start your day with a continental breakfast (fee applies). Business amenities include a business center, express check-out, and a 24-hour front desk. The hotel boasts over 7, 000 square feet of event space, including 12 meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (charges apply). The 245 guest rooms feature flat-screen TVs, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Located near the Gyle Shopping Centre, Edinburgh Park, and Edinburgh Zoo, the hotel is a convenient base for exploring the city. Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is just a short drive away.

9307.description: This hotel is located in Edinburgh's Old Town, just off the famous Royal Mile and just a short walk away from Edinburgh Castle. The Edinburgh Zoo, the Palace of Holyrood, St Giles' Cathedral, the National Museum of Scotland and the Scottish Whisky Heritage Centre are some of the attractions in the area. Edinburgh Airport is approximately 13 km from the hotel. The hotel offers elegant guestrooms, beautifully appointed and equipped with all the necessary amenities to provide a pleasant stay. Business guests will appreciate the well-equipped conference rooms and the hotel's proximity to the International Convention Centre. Dining options include a restaurant and bar serving international dishes and a coffee bar.

9308.description: Set in a desirable location on North Bridge, The 4 star Scotsman Hotel is nestled between the hustle and bustle of the New Town and the historical Old Town, the hotel is perfectly located to explore Edinburgh. Just off the famous Royal Mile, Waverley Train Station and Princess Street are within 2 minutes' walk from the hotel. Tourist attractions, entertainment venues, restaurants, bars and shopping are all conveniently near-by, making The Scotsman Hotel the ideal base to explore the our great city. Many of the original features and layout remain intact from the former national newspaper of Scotland printing house, bringing historical character to this luxury boutique hotel. The Marble staircase, now the centre of the hotel, retains its imposing stained glass window and glows magnificently by candle light each evening. Within the heart of the historic and iconic building is our comfortable bar and lounge area which serves a wide variety of drinks to suit all tastes, a luxurious afternoon tea and a great range of bar snacks. A high quality Scottish breakfast with superb service is served daily in our dedicated breakfast restaurant. With discounted parking at local secure car park, complimentary Wi-Fi and all the little extras you would expect from a 4 star boutique hotel, we look forward to welcoming you soon to The Scotsman Hotel.

name.content: Radisson Hotel & Conference Centre London Heathrow

9312.description: Take advantage of recreational opportunities offered, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite at Filini Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge at scheduled times, and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 637 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Stockley Park - 4. 2 km / 2.

9437.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at this Grindelwald hotel, offering complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Amenities include ski storage, on-site shopping, and a banquet hall. Dine at the hotel's restaurant, with bar/lounge and alfresco options, or enjoy room service. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Further amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and multilingual staff. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Each of the 39 individually decorated guestrooms features a minibar, flat-screen TV, and satellite programming. Bathrooms include a bathtub or shower and a hairdryer. A safe and desk are also provided for your convenience. The hotel is steps from Bussalp and a short walk from Sportzentrum Grindelwald.

9455.description: The award-winning Conrad Dublin is located at the heart of the city, standing moments from the gardens of St Stephen's Green and overlooking the majestic National Concert Hall. Heavily inspired and influenced by Dublin's rich literary culture and local heritage, Conrad Dublin features 192 beautifully refurbished guest rooms and suites. Join us on a voyage of discovery at Lemuel's, relax and enjoy a tasty meal in The Terrace Kitchen & Social House or take a seat in the stylish surroundings of Anna Haugh at Conrad Dublin, and experience a modern Irish fine dining experience. The hotel's fitness center is equipped with state-of-the-art cardio machines and weights, and the jogging routes around the picturesque St Stephen's Green are also yours to be enjoyed. Conrad Dublin's prestigious Ballroom and 9 conference rooms make it the perfect venue to host your bespoke event, with a capacity of up to 350 guests. The unique and impressive Iveagh Suite is the ultimate venue for exclusive gatherings, combining recent restoration with cutting-edge technology to guarantee a lasting impression on your guests. By placing the very latest state-of-the-art equipment at your fingertips as standard: you have the opportunity to convene with confidence.

9461.description: The stylish 4* Aberdeen Dyce Hotel offers fine accommodation in the thriving port that is the Granite City. All 155 rooms feature air conditioning, work space and wireless internet . Caskieben creates wonderful Scottish and International dishes and offers an informal setting for a catching up with family, friends and colleagues. There is a fully equipped fitness and leisure centre, with indoor pool, a range of cardio equipment and free weights. Beyond the hotel itself, a dizzying array of pursuits are available within easy striking distance, including horseback riding, sailing, hiking, scuba diving, rock climbing and many other options besides.

9463.description: Your comfort and convenience are our priority at the historic Copthorne Hotel Cardiff-Caerdydd. With our large, complimentary car park and easy access to the Cardiff International Airport, only 5 minutes away from Junction 33 on the M4, you can rest assured that your trips will be made more comfortable by enjoying our hospitality. Our traditional 4 star hotel in Cardiff ideally located between the City Centre and the Coast of Barry Island, serves as a perfect base with all the facilities you need at your disposal, free Wi-Fi and modern in-room amenities. Guests can also enjoy cosy drinks and alfresco dining at Lakeview lounge & Bar.

9464.description: Situated just 3. 2 km from Chester city centre, this 3-star country house hotel is set within lovely grounds. The historic Brook Mollington Banastre Hotel & Spa, dating back to 1853, offers comfortable rooms with work desks, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each room includes an en suite bathroom, and some boast garden views. Free Wi-Fi and parking are also available. The Garden Room Restaurant, overlooking the gardens, serves modern cuisine. Guests can enjoy afternoon tea, light snacks, and drinks in either the lounge bar or the casual brasserie located in the health club. Conveniently located near the M56 motorway, the Brook Mollington Banastre is a 5-minute drive from the Cheshire Oaks Shopping Outlet, where guests receive a 10% discount. Ellesmere Port, Chester Train Station, and Chester Zoo are all within a 10-minute drive, while Chester Racecourse is just 5 minutes away.

9466.description: This hotel is located in Edinburgh's Princes Street, lying just a short distance away from a number of restaurants, bars, pubs and entertainment venues. The hotel is set opposite the Princes Street exit of Waverly station, enjoying ease of access to other areas of the city. The hotel offers a great setting from which to explore the many attractions that this wonderful city has to offer, including Princes Street Gardens and Edinburgh Castle. This historical hotel tempts visitors into a world where traditional and contemporary designs are combined. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, featuring a style of classical elegance. Guests can enjoy delightful dining in the restaurant, where delectable dishes are sure to impress.

9469.description: Kingsmills Hotel is a 4-star hotel in Inverness with a rich and diverse heritage dating back to the 18th century. Complete with spa and conference facilities, it is the perfect retreat for leisure holidays and corporate events, and a world-class destination in its own right. Our hotel rooms combine the perfect mix of classic and contemporary features. With six unique room types – all designed with your comfort and relaxation in mind. We've raised the bar in luxurious, stylish Inverness accommodation. Our Patio Rooms open out onto our beautiful, picturesque gardens. While our Luxury Rooms provide an elegant setting for a truly luxurious Highland retreat. Dedicated to providing exceptional customer service, we're proud to host Inverness’ best stocked Whisky Bar. As well as two outstanding eateries – the Inglis Restaurant and the Conservatory Restaurant. Combining the freshest local produce with traditional and contemporary ingredients, the Kingsmills Hotel creates an eclectic mix of Scottish and International cuisine. Our sumptuous restaurants and traditional hospitality set us apart from other hotels in Inverness. Like all great hotels in Inverness, the Kingsmills Hotel provides the perfect combination of rest and relaxation in our rejuvenating spa facilities. With our very own indoor pool to hand, as well as a fully equipped gym. There's never been a better time to indulge in deep rest and relaxation. Equipped with the very best in R&R, our luxurious spa and specially trained therapists and masseuses are dedicated to ensuring your health and well-being. With a vast variety of spa packages, such as natural Italian therapies, there's something for even the most seasoned spa-goer. With a business built on hospitality and warmth, the Kingsmills Hotel is undoubtedly one of the best hotels in Inverness. The premier destination for guests from all walks of life.

9470.description: Liverpool is the ideal location for a city break, whether that’s to do a little sightseeing, shopping or a night at the theatre. There’s so much to see and do, the only problem might be deciding what to do first! A 21-minute walk from the Adelphi Hotel will take you to Liverpool Waterfront.
