With an idyllic setting, it has beauty, history, culture, art, music, food and drink. Tate Liverpool, Merseyside Maritime Museum, Albert Dock, Open Eye Gallery and the Museum of Liverpool are all within a stone’s throw of one another on the waterfront. You could always hop aboard a ferry trip for some stunning scenery across the River Mersey. A tour is a brilliant way to experience the city, and there are plenty of tour guides who offer a wide range of services. City Sights is one, located 0. 8 miles away, where you can take the City and Beatles Tour, travelling through this beautiful city and visiting key locations of The Beatles. Liverpool Cathedral is a 12-minute walk, also the hotel is only 8 minutes away from the Walker Art Gallery. The Adelphi Hotel is in a prime location, and shopping is literally on its doorstep. A short walk will take you to well-known department stores such as Next, River Island, Marks & Spencers and John Lewis, as well as many other high street stores. Liverpool is vibrant and energetic with live music, comedy nights and theatre shows. The Adelphi yet again proves the best choice for hotels as it’s no more than a mile away from the Echo Arena, Liverpool Playhouse Theatre and the Liverpool Comedy Central Club. Football is popular in the city, with Liverpool being home to two big teams, Liverpool and Everton. The hotel is less than 3 miles from both stadiums, meaning it’s a great stopover for away fans. From the 1st June 2025, all guests staying in Liverpool City Centre are required to pay a City Visitor Charge; a supplementary £2. 40 inclusive of VAT Charge per room per night

name.content: Holmes Hotel, London - A Park Plaza Hotel

9471.description: This hotel has been created for curious minds. This delightfully original hotel is the ideal home from which to investigate the rest of the city. Comprised of four beautifully restored Georgian buildings, the hotel is inspired by Baker Street's most famous resident – Sherlock Holmes. It boasts an enviable location in London's Marylebone Village, surrounded by high-end fashion boutiques, cafés and restaurants. Nearby highlights include Regent's Park and The Wallace Collection, while Marylebone and Baker Street stations, just a few minutes' walk away and is well connected by Tube. The hotel is a witty blend of heritage and playfulness, with 118 guest rooms and luxurious loft suites, a sumptuous lounge, tranquil library and a gym. All-day casual dining is enjoyed at Kitchen at Holmes, where London's melting pot of culinary cultures can be explored. Holmes is filled with a mix of antiques, curiosities and artefacts, nestled alongside contemporary furniture by leading luxury designers.

9472.description: Situated in the heart of Knightsbridge, one of London’s most exclusive neighbourhoods, and towering high over world-class shopping destination Sloane Street, The Carlton Tower Jumeirah is a beacon of sophistication where heritage meets contemporary luxury. The hotel has been completely reinvented late for a new generation of discerning guests with elegant, timeless interiors complemented by the most spectacular views. The 186 beautifully appointed guest rooms have all been renovated to the highest standard with classic and timeless décor, designed to offer a sense of tranquillity with an emphasis on light and space. 87 of the rooms and suites have the fantastic benefit of a balcony, taking advantage of the stunning views across London. All bedrooms and suites have floor to ceiling marble bathrooms with toiletries by Grown Alchemist and cutting edge in-room technology. The hotel’s flagship restaurant ‘Al Mare’ offers a sophisticated yet informal dining experience. Al Mare, which translated from Italian means ‘at the sea’ offers light and modern Mediterranean dishes alongside a carefully curated wine list and artisanal cocktails. Al Mare allows a convivial, gastronomic experience, taking guests on a journey around Italy and features a theatre kitchen, private dining room and al fresco dining. The Peak Fitness Club & Spa is spread over two floors. Occupying a stunning double height glazed space, the 20 meter pool is bathed in natural light and the spa offers five elegant treatment rooms and a relaxation area as well as a dedicated consultation room. The Peak Fitness Club located on the 9th floor is an equally light filled space benefitting from panoramic London views and Technogym equipment. In addition, hotel guests and members have access to the private Cadogan Gardens and its two all-weather macadam tennis courts.

name.content: Radisson Blu Edwardian Bond Street Hotel

9474.description: Radisson Blu Edwardian, Bond Street is the perfect place to relax after a day of culture, shopping and sightseeing in central London. Our contemporary bedrooms and suites complete with handcrafted Vispring beds and luxury bathroom amenities, while further opportunities to relax are offered on the refurbished ground and first floors. Enter through the refurbished lobby and take a seat in the elegant Bond St. Lounge Bar.  Furnished with comfortable sofas, armchairs and social seating, the Lounge Bar serves an Italian menu of cicchetti, antipasti, pasta and secondi, as well as a refreshing selection of aperitivi and wines.  Alternatively, if you are looking for a moment of indulgence,  we invite you upstairs to enjoy a British afternoon tea with a twist in the wood-panelled Bond St. Tea Rooms.   From the exclusive boutiques on New Bond Street to the art galleries of Marylebone Village,  the city's top attractions are right on your doorstep.  The newly reopened Bond Street station is located directly opposite the hotel, providing easy access to Canary Wharf and Heathrow Airport on the Elizabeth Line.

name.content: Radisson Blu Hotel, London Marble Arch

9476.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy British cuisine at Steak & Lobster, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 161 square feet (15 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 2 meeting rooms. Stay in one of 101 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Selfridges - 0. 1 km / 0.

9499.description: Mercure Aberdeen Caledonian is an elegant Victorian hotel overlooking Union Terrace Gardens in the city centre. The locally-inspired design, with its Renaissance style of architecture in white Kemnay granite with stained glass windows, reflects Aberdeen's rich and varied heritage - from the harbour and beach to the many beautiful castles with their colourful histories. Located in the city centre, the hotel is ideal for guests attending for both business and leisure.

9500.description: Located only 10 km away from Birmingham International Airport, and a short walk from New Street station, the The Royal Angus Hotell really is in the hub of the Midlands. All 133 guestrooms offer excellent comfort ! Additionally, guests can enjoy the in-house restaurant and bar and free overnight car-parking facilities. The hotel also has 12 meeting rooms the largest seating 200 delegates. Also on offer is "Meeting Plan", a new branded meeting and conference product offering only the highest levels of customer care. Rates are not valid for nationals or passport holders of the following countries; United Kingdom, Ireland.

9505.description: A peaceful Cambridge hotel near the city’s Business and Science parks, with a restaurant and leisure club. Holiday Inn® Cambridge hotel is just off the A14, within easy reach of the city centre. Set by a lake in Impington, the hotel offers a relaxing stay in rolling countryside just 2 miles from central Cambridge’s colleges, shops, museums and theatres. It’s also a 40-minute drive from Stansted Airport. Offering 10 versatile rooms, the hotel's Academy Conference Centre can accommodate up to 120 people. Alternatively, the 15-acre field is ideal for hosting team-building activities. Business guests are 10 minutes’ drive from Cambridge Science Park and Cambridge Business Park. Visiting Cambridge with family or friends? You can leave your car in the hotel car park and hop on a bus to the city centre to tour the colleges of Cambridge University or go punting on the River Cam. The Imperial War Museum Duxford is a 20-minute drive away. At this hotel you can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, a Business Centre and on-site parking. Enjoy a refreshing swim in the indoor pool, a workout in the Fitness Centre or a beauty treatment in Spirit Health Club. Enjoy our open lobby, the bar serving drinks by the fire, while the Restaurant is available for all day dining specializing in hearty British cuisine. There’s an outdoor playground for families and kids stay and eat for free.

9506.description: This hotel is located at the heart of Cardiff, lying within easy access of a host of attractions. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from Cardiff Castle and the city's main shopping street. The train station is located just 1. 2 km away, offering ease of access to other areas to be explored. Guests will find themselves just a 20 minutes' driving distance from Cardiff Airport. This wonderful Victorian hotel enjoys a stunning designed, immersing visitors in history and culture. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, combining traditional and contemporary elements in the design. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests will appreacite the wide range of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

9507.description: A modern, accessible hotel near Cardiff Castle and the Principality Stadium. Centrally located opposite Cardiff Castle, Holiday Inn® Cardiff City Centre hotel is ideal for either a business trip or a leisure visit. It's 12 miles from Cardiff International Airport and five miles from the M4 motorway. For a fee, you can leave your car in a hotel parking space.  Cardiff Central train station is less than 10 minutes' walk away. Sports fans are five minutes' walk from the Principality Stadium, the home of Welsh rugby, and 15 minutes from the Swalec Stadium. You can walk to Cardiff Castle in two minutes, and the shops in central Cardiff are right outside the hotel door. The 200 outlets of St. David's Dewi Sant Shopping Centre is a 10-minute walk away. You can also tour the town with ease aboard a hop-on, hop-off sightseeing bus – there's a stop opposite the hotel. Get up to speed before a meeting using free Wi-Fi, and check the news on two computers in the lobby. The hotel's dedicated Academy Conference Centre makes it easy to organise a training session or event to suit all your requirements, for up to 150 delegates. Enjoy modern British fare or relax with a coffee in the newly renovated open lobby area. Watch the game over a beer or sit back and enjoy the sun in the large, sunny Beer Garden. Kids stay and eat free.

9511.description: Located on George Square in the heart of Glasgow's vibrant city center, the Millennium Hotel is as iconic as the city itself. Boasting an impressive Georgian façade lined with glass conservatories, this distinctive hotel combines modern elements and historic style. With 65 bedrooms, the hotel has a spacious feel, excellent transport links, and fantastic restaurants nearby. Conveniently located next door to Queen Street Station, less than a 10-minute walk from Glasgow Central Station, and just a short drive from some of the finest whisky distilleries and castles in Scotland, the Millennium Hotel is ideal for business travel, with event facilities all boasting natural daylight, or a relaxing weekend break.

9515.description: Experience an upscale London hotel designed to flow between local experiences and business. Located near St Pancras International Station, and Farringdon Station, Crowne Plaza® London - Kings Cross is a short walk to the Eurostar trains, Elizabeth Line, and London Underground at Russell Square and King's Cross St. Pancras to Heathrow Airport (LHR). Walk out to discover our trendy King’s Cross neighborhood with restaurants, shops, entertainment, and attractions such as the British Museum, and Covent Garden. Plan a meeting or gathering in our flexible events space. Catch up over cocktails and conversation at the Bloom Bar and Lounge. Get a great night’s sleep in sophisticated guest rooms with contemporary décor. Connect, unplug, or explore your way.

9622.description: This contemporary hotel is the perfect destination for those visiting Londonderry for business or leisure. Ideally situated for exploring the historic old town and the northwest of Ireland, the hotel is just a five-minute walk from the tourist center and a 15-minute walk from the train station. Elegant facilities and warm hospitality cater to all travelers. Spacious, light-filled rooms offer a relaxing retreat after a day of meetings or exploring the city. The signature restaurant provides refined cuisine and excellent service. Guests can also enjoy the indoor pool and a well-equipped gym. Corporate travelers have access to functional meeting rooms, and secure parking is available for those arriving by car.

9639.description: The comfortable hotel lies directly on the banks of River Foyle somewhat outside of the picturesque walled city of Londonderry and its numerous historical buildings. Links to the transport network are about 900 m away, whilst the closest shops, bars and nightclubs are roughly 1. 6 km away. The splendid beaches and hills of Donegal are just a short drive away. This elegant establishment boasts lush surroundings, spacious and beautifully appointed surroundings and warm and amazing staff. The luminous rooms feature stylish design combining soothing natural tones and warm hues. The units come with all the necessary amenities to ensure a truly enjoyable stay. Guests may indulge in rich and savoury breakfast and dine on refined cuisine at the hotel restaurant. There is also a welcoming bar and business centre with exceptional meeting facilities.

9750.description: This pet-friendly establishment is located at the heart of Tortosa's centre area, just a few steps from Alfonso XII square and Teodor Gonzalez Park. Close to an area plenty of shops and different dining options, this charming property offers the ideal base from which to explore all this beautiful region has to offer. Nature lovers may appreciate this prime location just 20 kilometres from Els Ports National Park and the Ebro Delta while those who like a special combination of adventure, imagination and strong emotions may visit Port Aventura theme park, situated a 34-minute drive away. Designed with guests' comfort in mind, the air-conditioned guest rooms feature all the necessary services and amenities for guests' to feel right at home. A delicious breakfast buffet is served daily at the onsite dining room while those travelling on business may take advantage of the fully-equipped meeting facilities.

13789.description: This hotel is located in Deltebre. The property is located just 300 metres away from the Ebro Delta Nature Reserve. Guests can enjoy boat and bicycle tours around the delta. Guests can explore the beauty and the splendour of the area with ease. The nearest beach is just 7 km away. Guests are extended a warm, friendly welcome upon arrival. The guest rooms offer comfort and a peaceful ambiance, in which to completely unwind. The hotel features a wonderful restaurant, where traditional and international dishes are served. Guests are invited to take advantage of the many facilities and services that this charming hotel has to offer, and are assured of a comfortable, enjoyable stay.

13791.address: Av Canal Cami De L'Illeta, S/N
13791.description: 'Enjoy a relaxing stay at the Delta Hotel in Deltebre, conveniently located near the beach. Take advantage of our outdoor pool, bicycle rentals, and on-site restaurant and coffee shop. Guest rooms feature flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms. A business center, complimentary newspapers, and luggage storage are also available. Explore nearby attractions like the Ecomuseu and Riu a L'ebre, both within a 5-minute drive. Port del Fangar and Delta de l'Ebre Natural Park are also easily accessible. '

13800.description: This apartment complex is located in La Pineda, about 250 meters from the beach and 500 meters from the town center. The city of Salou is approximately five kilometers away. Shops, bars, pubs, and restaurants are within a 250-meter radius, and public transport is accessible 500 meters away. Renovated in 2002, the complex comprises two five-story buildings offering 968 studio apartments. Amenities include a 24-hour reception with currency exchange, elevator, bar, pub, cafeteria, hair salon, disco, game room, and an air-conditioned restaurant with a non-smoking area and highchairs. Guests can utilize the garage or on-site parking. Room service, laundry, and medical assistance are also available. Each comfortable studio apartment features a combined living/sleeping area, a separate bedroom, a bathroom with a hairdryer, direct-dial telephone, cable/satellite TV, mini-fridge, central heating, and a safe. All apartments have a balcony and cleaning is included. Until December 7, 2024, check-in will be at OASSIUM. From December 8, 2024, check-in will be at the Euro Sport reception (open until 10 PM). For inquiries, please contact +34 977 37 04 10. For arrivals after 10 PM, please call +34 693 48 57 07.

13885.description: Independent, award-winning and one of a kind, The Athenaeum Hotel & Residences is London's foremost family-run five-star hotel. An original Art Deco building located in the heart of Mayfair, The Athenaeum Hotel & Residences is the ideal base for your city stay. Following a multi-million-pound refurbishment and with Michelin-starred chefs The Galvin Brothers now at the culinary helm, this Mayfair icon is poised to begin a new era. The Athenaeum Hotel & Residences offers a choice of spacious rooms, suites and a spectacular rooftop Penthouse with private balcony and 180-degree views of the city skyline. Adjoining the hotel are 18 private residences accessed via your own private entrance, with kitchens, living areas and 24-hour In Room Dining.

13889.description: The 3-star Best Western Corona Hotel in London offers comfort and convenience for both business and leisure travelers. Guests will appreciate amenities such as 24-hour room service, complimentary Wi-Fi, taxi service, and express check-in/check-out. The well-appointed guest rooms include amenities to ensure a restful stay. Select rooms feature non-smoking options, air conditioning, heating, and wake-up service. Discover all that London has to offer by making the Best Western Corona Hotel your base.

name.content: Hyde & Seek, part of Tribute Portfolio

13890.description: Hotel will be offering a Grab and Go Breakfast delivered to guest room. Great location for London's city centre attractions. The bright lights of London beckon with a stay at the Corus Hotel Hyde Park. We're in a prime spot for exploring Central London, whether you're shopping for luxury brands at Harrods, rowing a boat across the Serpentine or having a night out in the West End. Just a stone's throw from Lancaster Gate Tube Station, it couldn't be easier to experience the sights and smells of the UK's glittering capital. This elegant 200-year-old Grade II-listed Georgian mansion in Bayswater overlooks Hyde Park, where you can go for a pre-breakfast stroll or jog around this vast open space and dip your toe into the water at the Diana Memorial Fountain. Good food and drink is an important part of our culture, and our conservatory brasserie serves delicious flavours.

13891.description: This hotel enjoys a delightful setting in Compton Place, lying close to the bustling nightlife and shopping districts of London. Guests will find themselves in a great location from which to explore the wonderful attractions, shopping opportunities and entertainment venues that this wonderful city has to offer. The hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality and the promise of a relaxing stay. The guest rooms are tastefully designed, offering peaceful setting in which to unwind in comfort at the end of the day. Guests will be pleased by the range of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer. Conveniently located by King's Cross St Pancras station for major rail links and the Eurostar.

name.content: Hotel Indigo London K West Shepherd’s Bush

13893.description: This great hotel, located in Notting Hill, enjoys a nice location in a romantic and trendy area of the city. Guests will be able to reach a variety of shopping streets, such as Kensington High Street and convenient transport connections can be reached on foot. The hotel offers guests a large leisure centre with a hot tub. It is perfect for tourists as well as business travelers.

13894.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include babysitting (surcharge) and a banquet hall. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Reform Social and Grill, for lunch, dinner, or brunch. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 484 square feet (45 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Make yourself at home in one of the 142 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring DVD players and LCD televisions.

13895.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a garden. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Grab a bite at Gordon Ramsay Bar And Gri, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 2216 square feet (206 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 10 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 237 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and minibars. 32-inch LCD televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while wireless internet access (surcharge) keeps you connected.

13896.description: Enjoy London from this conveniently located hotel near Hyde Park and Marble Arch. The hotel offers a fitness center, terrace, and garden for your recreation. Savor British cuisine at The Pickled Hen restaurant and bar, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy the convenience of concierge and wedding services. The 240 guest rooms feature flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms, and laptop-compatible safes. For business travelers, a business center and express check-in/check-out are available, along with ample meeting space. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include Baker Street, Selfridges, and Kensington Gardens.

name.content: Doubletree by Hilton London - Marble Arch

13897.description: The Doubletree by Hilton London Marble Arch, located in the heart of London's West End near Oxford Street, offers contemporary accommodations and attentive service. Our hotel features modern amenities for business travelers and a prime location ideal for leisure guests. Spacious guest rooms and suites include generous workspaces, comfortable beds, and WiFi in public areas. Guests can enjoy our fitness center, with jogging paths and tennis courts nearby. Relax in the Indigo lobby lounge, or dine at the Fire and Spice Restaurant. Our flexible meeting and event facilities are housed in the historic Bryanston Suite. We look forward to welcoming you with our signature warm Doubletree chocolate chip cookie at check-in.

13898.description: This property sits just a few steps away from Hyde Park, in London. Guests will appreciate close proximity to a wide range of attractions, as well as a host of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. The Heathrow Express rail service at Paddington is just a short distance away, offering ease of access to Heathrow Airport. London's lively West End, with its range of theatres and attractions, can be found just a 10 minutes' walk from the hotel. Guests can relax and unwind in the calming surroundings of the rooms, which offer modern amenities for added convenience. The hotel's staff are on hand to cater for the needs of every type of traveller.

13900.description: This hotel has a convenient location in a quiet, tree-lined residential street near the elegant neighbourhood of Kensington and Chelsea, just metres from Earl's Court London Underground Station. Numerous historical tourist attractions, parks, museums and shopping areas such as Kensington and Knightsbridge can be reached within several minutes. In the vicinity, there are banks and restaurants. Hyde Park, Earl's Court Exhibition Centre and Olympia are all within easy walking distance. The hotel features 25 comfortable guest rooms with modern amenities including complimentary Wi-Fi Internet, fridge, air conditioning, complimentary coffee and tea making facilities and a hairdryer.

13904.description: This hotel offers 393 guest rooms, each equipped with a Smart TV, pillowtop bed, and private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer. While Wi-Fi is available for a surcharge, satellite programming is included. Guests can enjoy Italian cuisine at Carluccio's restaurant and bar/lounge, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Recreational facilities include an indoor pool, spa tub, and sauna. The hotel also offers a 24-hour business center, express check-in/check-out, concierge and wedding services, and extensive meeting and conference space. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Located near Stockley Park and just 3 km from Heathrow Airport (LHR), this hotel provides convenient access to Brunel University, Twickenham Stadium, and various other attractions.

13905.description:
Holiday Inn London Gatwick Worth is a convenient Gatwick hotel that has recently undergone a £9 million refurbishment and extension, transforming nearly all areas, including the reception, restaurant, and event suites. The extension added 40 new bedrooms, many of which are family rooms for up to 5 guests, making this one of the few hotels in the area to offer such accommodation. 

Located in Crawley, the hotel is perfect for both business and leisure travellers, with onsite car parking and excellent transport links. We are just 10 minutes from Gatwick Airport (LGW), and our Park, Stay & Go packages allow you to leave your car at the hotel and arrive at the airport feeling relaxed. Three Bridges station, nearby, provides trains to London Victoria in 40 minutes, while Brighton is only a 35-minute drive away. Local attractions include Wakehurst Place and Tulleys Farm, ideal for family days out. The Manor Royal Business District, home to over 500 companies including Thales, L3Harris, and Elekta, is also close by. 

Guests can enjoy free WiFi and a 24-hour reception desk. Our modern, spacious bedrooms feature tea and coffee making facilities and individual temperature control. Family rooms include sofa beds, while accessible rooms are also available. For extra comfort, our suites offer a separate lounge area and super-king-size beds.

13907.description: These wonderful apartments are situated directly above the pleasant bay of Cala de las Sirenas, some 500 metres from the centre of Miami Playa with its shops and bars. The 6-storey apartment complex offers guests a multitude of facilities such as a terrace solarium and a swimming pool for them to enjoy. Each of the spacious apartments has been designed to accommodate up to 6 people and they come with a living room with a sofa bed, an en suite bathroom and a well-equipped kitchen, ideal for those who enjoy preparing their own meals. This stunning aparthotel is suitable for both business and leisure travellers and they are sure to have a memorable stay here.

name.content: Taj 51 Buckingham Gate Suites and Residences

14004.description: Located a short walk from St. James Park and Victoria Stations, Taj 51 Buckingham Gate Suites and Residences places you minutes from iconic landmarks like Buckingham Palace, Westminster Abbey, and the London Eye. This five-star hotel offers 86 contemporary suites, ranging from one to nine bedrooms, including specialty options like the Jaguar and Cinema Suites. Guests enjoy signature Taj excellence, including butler service, the Michelin-starred Quilon Restaurant, and a stunning award-winning courtyard garden. Families appreciate the children's amenities and impeccable five-star service. For further details about our commitment to safety and hygiene, please visit www. taj51buckinghamgate. co. uk/commitment-restrengthened/

14014.description:
One day just isn't enough! Let the fantabulous fun continue with an amazing short break at Alton Towers Resort!
Set in over 500 acres of beautiful Staffordshire countryside, the Alton Towers Resort offers three fantastically themed hotels (Alton Hotel, CBeebies Hotel and Splash Hotel), Stargazing Pods, an Enchanted Village, Wacky Waterpark, Extraordinary Golf, Rollercoaster Restaurant and of course, not forgetting over 40 world class rides and attractions! It's the ultimate UK family holiday!

14015.description: Great Western Hotel Aberdeen is a welcoming hotel in Aberdeen, offering warm Scottish hospitality just under two miles from the historic city centre and 6. 5 miles from Aberdeen Airport. Perfectly positioned for business travelers, cultural explorers, and guests visiting the oil and gas hubs or Aberdeen’s beautiful coastline, our 22-room hotel combines everyday convenience with a friendly local welcome. Each of our 22 rooms is designed to keep your stay simple, relaxed, and stress-free. Our location keeps business and industry guests close to major employers and connections. We’re also within easy reach of key services and institutions.

14017.description: Hilton London Gatwick Airport is adjacent to the South Terminal and just 10 minutes from the North Terminal by free monorail, with access to the M23 and M25 motorways. Located just 30 minutes from central London by Gatwick Express, the hotel is a short train ride away from the city’s shopping, dining and entertainment scene. Visit nearby Brighton for the day or catch a ride on the Blue Bell railway to enjoy the English countryside. After a day of exploring, relax in a spacious guest room, including 22 family deluxe rooms, fully renovated in June 2021. All rooms include WiFi access and are sound-proofed for your comfort. Upgrade to an Executive Room for more space and exclusive access to the prestigious Executive Lounge. Our Gatwick hotel offers complimentary WiFi in public areas, a 24-hour fitness center, 24-hour Concierge and a business center. The Crew Lounge, newly refurbished in June 2021, offers complimentary WiFi, newspapers, magazines and tea and coffee. Unwind with a meal or cocktails at one of our bars or restaurants or enjoy the privacy of 24-hour room service. Start the day with a delicious breakfast in the family friendly Garden restaurant. Light lunch or snack in Amy’s Lobby Bar, or watch the game in Charlie Fry’s Sports Bar. Plan your next event for up to 450 people in our flexible meeting and event space, with 21 conference rooms including the versatile and fully renovated Ascot Suite.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Oxford - Kassam Stadium

14030.description: The Holiday Inn Express Oxford - Kassam Stadium is less than five miles from Oxford's city center bus and train stations, with discounted flat-rate taxis making travel to the university's historic colleges easy and affordable. Free parking is available, and a bus stop is conveniently located right outside the hotel. For leisure, the charming villages of the Cotswolds are a 30-minute drive away, and the Ozone Leisure Park, featuring restaurants, a ten-pin bowling alley, a Vue Cinema, and the Park Leisure Club pool and gym (with special rates for hotel guests), is a five-minute walk away. Business travelers will appreciate the hotel's proximity to the Kassam conference and event center (capacity 700) and the BMW Mini plant (two miles away). The hotel offers a naturally lit meeting room for up to 18 guests and free WiFi throughout. Enjoy an inclusive buffet breakfast with sausages, scrambled eggs, and baked beans in the Great Room, and unwind in the lounge bar with evening drinks and views of the surrounding countryside.

14033.description: Choose Holiday Inn Express Cambridge, a convenient hotel three miles from the city centre. The hotel is near the M11, 35 minutes from Stansted Airport and Cambridge train station is close by for trains to London. We’re ideally located for a city break. The infamous University of Cambridge, famous for its stunning architecture and world-renowned academics, is a 15-minute drive away. Beside that is the Fitzwilliam Museum; wander around the exhibitions and galleries and admire art from across the world. Cheer on your favourite music and comedy acts at Cambridge Corn Exchange or watch iconic aircrafts take to the skies at the Imperial War Museum. Enjoy the sights of Cambridge with a traditional punting tour. Spot King’s College Chapel, Trinity College and the Bridge of Sighs during a chauffeured punt tour along the River Cam. For some fresh air, walk around Cambridge University Botanic Garden. Or, if you fancy some shopping, take your pick from the popular Grand Arcade or the Grafton Centre. After busy days sightseeing, kick back and relax in the comfort of the hotel. With handy conveniences free Wi-Fi, a TV and blackout curtains in your room, you’ll feel right at home. In the evenings, order simple dishes to satisfy hunger cravings and grab a drink from the bar.

14034.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Pool, Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Airport Shuttle, Business Center, Complimentary Evening Social, Concierge, Fitness Center, Spa. Welcome to DoubleTree by Hilton Edinburgh Airport, where we'll greet you at check-in with a warm chocolate chip cookie. Our hotel is five minutes from EDI Airport. We're just 20 minutes from city centre and landmarks like Edinburgh Castle, Edinburgh Zoo and Princes Street. Catch a show at the EICC or Royal Highland Showground with ease during your stay. Our spacious guest rooms are styled in cool, calm tones and offer WiFi access, a 32-inch LCD TV, large work desk, USB charging ports, and daily newspaper. Upgrade to a Deluxe room to enjoy a welcome plate, mineral water, plush bathrobe, cosy slippers, and a later check-out time. Gather with friends and co-workers at The Space, a modern venue that merges restaurant, bar and lounge. Savour the diverse menus with locally sourced ingredients, and stay connected with WiFi access, charging stations and Bluetooth connectivity. For your convenience, our Edinburgh hotel also has 24-hour room service. Go for a swim in the heated indoor pool, take a class in the fitness centre, or book a beauty appointment in our spa. Planning an event in Edinburgh? Our hotel provides 22 fully equipped meeting rooms, all with WiFi access, natural daylight and air-conditioning. Host a meeting, social gathering or wedding reception for up to 250 people. The hotel is also pleased to offer event catering, a business centre and ample car parking.

14040.description: Novotel Leeds Centre hotel is the right choice for guests who are searching for a combination of style, simplicity and comfort. With a prime location in the heart of Leeds city centre, guests are within walking distance to the best shopping, dining and entertainment destinations in the area. Whether you're here for business or pleasure, our friendly and accommodating staff are here to help make your stay a memorable one.

14051.description: Check-in & Check-outRooms are available from 3 PM (Sun–Fri) and 1:30 PM (Sat). For early arrivals, contact reservations to check availability. AccessibilityDue to the historic nature of the building, there is no lift. If you need luggage assistance, ask reception. If stairs are an issue, request a ground-floor room when booking. Late ArrivalsFor arrivals after midnight, ring the doorbell to alert the Night Porter. Check-outCheck-out is 10:30 AM (Mon–Sat) and 11 AM (Sun & bank holidays). For late check-out, confirm with reception. Parking: £18 per night

14062.description: Strategically positioned at the heart of Knightsbridge, this superb establishment offers visitors a prestigious setting from which to explore the city. The property offers close proximity to public transport links, which ensure ease of access to many of the city's must-see attractions. This award-winning property has been awarded a Tripadvisor Certificate of Excellence, as well as the Gold Award for excellent accommodation, by Enjoy England. Stunningly-designed, self-contained apartments offer a home away from home. Well equipped with modern amenities, the accommodation options ensure the utmost in comfort and convenience. Professional, friendly staff are on hand to aid guests with ticket bookings and restaurant reservations, delivering a high level of customer service.

name.content: Beaufort Park Hotel and Conference Centre

14075.description: Located a short drive from the historic market town of Mold in the beautiful North Wales countryside, this hotel is perfect for a romantic getaway or a family break. Its convenient access to motorway networks and the city of Chester makes exploring the region easy. Relax in the comfortable hotel or visit the charming historic attractions of Cheshire and North Wales. The Arches Bar and Coffee House offers a relaxed family atmosphere where you can enjoy seasonal British dishes made with the finest local produce. Alternatively, unwind with local ales and a selection of wines, beers, and spirits. For a more formal dining experience, the renowned Orchard Restaurant provides exquisite cuisine in a refined setting. As an independent hotel, the dedicated staff can tailor any occasion, from weddings to banquets, to your individual needs, ensuring a memorable experience within the hotel's wonderful setting.

14080.description: Just 1969 feet from Victoria Coach and Railway Station, The House on Warwick has a 24-hour front desk elegant rooms with Free WiFi access. Buckingham Palace is a 15-minute walk away. Set in an elegant Georgian terrace, the cozy bedrooms at The House on Warwick have rooms with attached bathroom. There is a great range of international restaurants and Cafes just a short walk away. The hotel is located just a 20-minute walk from central Westminster, home to the Houses of Parliament, Big Ben and Westminster Abbey. Stylish Knightsbridge is a 20-minute walk away.

14084.description: Guests will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at The Balkan Lodge as it counts with a total of 10 guest rooms. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. The Balkan Lodge does not offer 24-hour reception. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

14091.description: The Hotel Indigo® London Kensington is situated in the heart of the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, our London hotel blends beautifully into this boutique neighbourhood. We’re also located close to the Earl’s Court tube station, placing all of London’s destinations and major transport hubs like Heathrow (LHR) and London City Airports (LCY) within easy reach.

14104.description: This hotel is located in the centre close to Hyde Park and 400 m away from Lancaster Gate tube station and it has great access to all of London's attractions. London Heathrow Airport is approximately 17 km away. With a range of services, this newly refurbished hotel now resembles a more luxurious property with all the trimmings including gold tinted marble flown in from Italy and all furniture hand crafted to create a unique space to relax and unwind. The restaurant houses a stunning conservatory style seating area with floor to ceiling windows, a creative cocktail bar and a beautiful terrace to enjoy some al fresco dining in the summer months. The establishment has 3 fully air-conditioned conference and function rooms a fully renovated lobby with 24-hour reception and wireless Internet. The 168 generously sized guest rooms with large comfy beds and contemporary design offer a restful space away from the fast city pace.

14106.description: Set just a stone's throw away from the British Museum, the charming Grange Blooms Hotel enjoys a privileged location in the heart of literary Bloomsbury. Exclusive shopping venues on Oxford and Regent's Street, Covent Garden and The Brunswick shopping centre are within a short stroll, while famous attractions such as Buckingham Palace, St. Paul's Cathedral, Westminster Abbey, Houses of Parliament, Big Ben or the London Eye are within easy reach. The elegant boutique hotel is situated in an 18th century townhouse, and period features have been restored to their original condition. The beautifully appointed rooms are individually decorated, some with four-poster or canopy beds, and all feature modern amenities such as high-speed WIFI or LCD satellite-TV. With a nod to the area's literary background, the hotel offers a Malt Whisky Library, with a select choice of more than 30 malt whiskies. A true gem in a perfect location.

14107.description: Enjoying a convenient location in the West End of Edinburgh, close to many local attractions and surrounded by beautiful Georgian streets, this luxurious boutique hotel offers a combination of traditional hospitality and modern comforts, where guests can spend a relaxing holiday. Edinburgh's New Town is a beautiful area to explore and the friendly staff of the hotel will be more than happy to suggest some great places to visit. Boasting a Victorian façade, the hotel offers spacious accommodation, all with a stylish décor and especially designed with guests' comfort in mind. Characterised by a sophisticated urban styling, the on-site restaurant is an ideal place to enjoy a pleasant dinner, while sampling delicious local specialities as well as a fine selection of wines. The bar is popular for its light lunches, delicious cocktails and typical afternoon teas.

name.content: Le Meridien Ra Beach Hotel & Spa

14131.description: Located in the heart of El Vendrell, Le Meridien Ra Beach Hotel & Spa is a short walk from both El Vendrell Beach and Platja de les Madrigueres. This luxury hotel is also conveniently close to Calafell Beach and Calafell Aventura. Guests can enjoy a range of amenities, including a spa offering massages, body treatments, and facials, an indoor pool, sauna, and 24-hour fitness center. The hotel also provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (for a surcharge). Each of the 144 air-conditioned rooms features a minibar, Smart TV, and private bathroom with a rainfall showerhead. Guests can dine at one of the hotel's two restaurants, including La Terrassa del Mar, which offers Mediterranean cuisine, or enjoy 24-hour room service. A coffee shop/cafe is available for snacks. Daily complimentary receptions provide opportunities to socialize, while the bar/lounge and poolside bar offer relaxing evening drinks. Additional amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk.

name.content: Mercure Dartford Brands Hatch Hotel & Spa

14140.description: The 4-star Mercure Dartford Brands Hatch Hotel & Spa is set amongst beautiful countryside, making it a great option for those looking to relax and explore. Brands Hatch Motor Racing Circuit is a short drive away, and London Golf Club can also be reached in just a few minutes. After a busy day of exploring, guests are welcome to unwind in the health club, which features an impressive indoor pool and a modern gym. Our Classic, Superior and Privilege room options are designed with style and comfort in mind.

14141.description: This charming London hotel offers a tranquil escape within walking distance of Hampstead Village, St. John's High Street, Primrose Hill, and Belsize Park, renowned for their shops, continental cafes, bars, and restaurants. Easy access to London's West End theaters and attractions is provided by public transport. Enjoy fine dining in the hotel's conservatory-style restaurant, or relax in the adjoining lounge bar, a favorite among guests and locals. The 135 well-appointed bedrooms feature modern comforts, including tea and coffee making facilities and private bathrooms with hair dryers. Limited paid parking is available under the hotel.

14162.description: The Hotel Gran Claustre is a unique and exclusive hotel on the Costa Dorada. Located in the medieval village of Altafulla, Tarragona province, it's just 1km from the beach and 15km from Tarragona city. Housed in a building dating back to the 18th century, this monument hotel, declared a cultural asset of national interest, seamlessly blends traditional architecture with modern decor. Its 39 unique rooms are spread across two buildings. The hotel's gastronomic restaurant, Bruixes de Burriac by Jaume Drudis, offers a taste of local cuisine. Guests can also relax and rejuvenate in the welcoming spa (reservations required). From exploring coastal coves and the city of Tarragona to golfing, cycling, hiking, or enjoying PortAventura World, the Costa Dorada offers a wealth of activities. The nearby Altafulla Maritime Club provides opportunities for windsurfing, paddle surfing, catamaran rides, tennis, and more. The Hotel Gran Claustre is associated with the Seal of Gastronomic Hotels, Affiliates of the Catalan Tourism Agency. Reception hours are from 10:00 am to 8:00 pm, with check-in from 3:00 pm to 8:00 pm.

14170.description: This modern, glass-fronted hotel is situated in the heart of London's Docklands, offering magnificent views of Canary Wharf. Close to the O2 Arena and London City Airport (a mere ten-minute drive), the hotel provides easy access to the West End via the DLR and tube. Guests can enjoy on-site amenities such as air conditioning in public areas, a bar, two restaurants, and Wi-Fi (for a surcharge). Chargeable parking is also available. Spacious en-suite bedrooms feature TVs and tea/coffee making facilities, while upper-floor rooms boast spectacular views of the Thames and London skyline.

14205.description: This apartment complex sits on the seafront, halfway between Salou and Cambrils. Both resorts are within a short 5-minute drive and offer plenty of restaurants, shops and bars, but the most important thing for any summer holiday - the endless blue sea and the warm sand, are just steps away. Onsite there is also an outdoor pool and a sun terrace, perfect for those who want to work on that healthy tan in a little more privacy. Other leisure options include a golf course, just 2km away, Children's playground for the youngests patrons of the venue and a relaxed bar for the grown-ups. The onsite restaurant treats to a large variety of mediterranean and Spanish specialities, plus freshly-caught sea delicacies.

14359.description: Located in the heart of Hol, Geilo Hotel offers ski-in/ski-out access and a complimentary ski shuttle, placing you just steps from slopes like B Fugleleiken and Arnetrekket. This hotel features 72 guestrooms with pillowtop beds and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy on-site amenities including a snack bar/deli, bar/lounge, and concierge services. For events, the hotel boasts over 2, 600 square feet of conference space. Free self-parking and daily housekeeping are also available. Nearby attractions include Kikuttoppen (0. 3 mi) and Geilo Ski (0. 4 mi).

14401.description:
Bruntsfield Hotel, WorldHotels Elite is a townhouse hotel just a short walk from Edinburgh city centre, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It’s perfectly located for both leisure breaks and business in the city and enjoys open views across Bruntsfield Links park and the Meadows park. The hotel is within walking distance of Edinburgh Castle, Princes Street and The Royal Mile, and only a short drive from the panoramic views on offer at Arthur's Seat. With this abundance of sights and shops nearby, be rest assured you'll never be met by a dull moment during your stay. 

Limited parking spaces are available on a first come first serve basis at a charge of GBP 12. 50 per day payable locally. A per person pre-authorization taken of 30GBP on arrival. Please note our restaurant will be closed on Mondays and Tuesdays. The bar will open for drinks only on Monday and Tuesday evenings from 5 p. m.

14403.description: Enjoy a central London stay at the Brunel Hotel, a short walk from both Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast, served from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM, and later dine in our on-site restaurant. The hotel offers 40 guestrooms equipped with LCD TVs, digital programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each room also features a private bathroom with designer toiletries and a hair dryer, along with convenient amenities such as a laptop-compatible safe and a desk. Business travelers will appreciate our business center and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Additional services include concierge assistance and dry cleaning/laundry. Marble Arch is 1 mile away, while Kensington High Street is 1. 5 miles from the hotel.

14406.description:
Blending timeless British charm with modern sophistication, The Byron Hotel offers a stylish boutique experience in the heart of London. Perfectly suited for both leisure travelers and discerning business guests, our property provides a peaceful, welcoming retreat from the bustling city while keeping you just moments away from London's most iconic attractions. 

Each of our thoughtfully designed rooms features contemporary amenities, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, and plush bedding tailored for ultimate relaxation. With exceptional transport links right on our doorstep, exploring the West End, world-class shopping districts, and historic landmarks is completely effortless. 

Whether you are visiting for a weekend getaway or an extended stay, our dedicated team is committed to delivering personalized hospitality and a quintessential London experience. Book your stay at The Byron Hotel and discover your home away from home.

14414.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features wedding services, a picnic area, and barbecue grills. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 175 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is available. Bathrooms have shower/tub combinations and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

14417.address: In the hills above Contin, Contin, By Strathpeffer
14417.description: Nestled in the hills above Contin, just 25 minutes from Inverness, this family-run country house hotel offers scenic surroundings, fine dining, and a relaxing atmosphere. Built in 1821, this unique building exudes traditional charm, complemented by eight acres of woodland and gardens with unspoiled mountain views. Each en-suite room is individually designed and varies in size and shape. The octagonal restaurant specializes in contemporary Scottish cuisine using fresh, local produce. Located in the Northern Highlands, it's an ideal base for exploring attractions like Dunrobin Castle, Rogie Waterfalls, Cawdor Castle, and the Glen Ord Whisky Distillery. Different policies and supplements apply for group bookings. To arrive, follow the A9 north over the Kessock Bridge, take the second left at the Tore roundabout onto the A835 towards Dingwall and Ullapool. At the next roundabout, take the second left to stay on the A835. Contin is about six miles further on. In Contin, the hotel's driveway is the third right after the petrol station, about 200 yards. The hotel is at the end of the half-mile gravel driveway.

14550.description: Nestled in London's elegant Bayswater neighborhood, this charming hotel occupies a beautiful 19th-century building, seamlessly blending classic design with modern amenities. A stay in this unique hotel offers a special experience, inviting guests to unpack amidst intimate Victorian surroundings. The hotel boasts convenient access to London's main attractions, points of interest, international airports, railway, and underground stations. Kensington Gardens, renowned for Kensington Palace, the Italian Gardens, the Peter Pan statue, and more, is a mere three-minute walk away. The onsite restaurant delights guests with specialty Malaysian cuisine and beverages. Each of the 111 thoughtfully furnished rooms and suites promises a blissful and relaxing stay.

14613.description:
greet London Harlow is perfectly positioned for both business and leisure travellers. Just 11 miles, around a 16-minute drive from Stansted Airport, the hotel offers easy access via the nearby M11 and convenient on-site parking. Direct rail links to Central London make it an ideal base for weekend city breaks. We can not wait to greet you. 

The hotel has four flexible meeting rooms, perfect for business conferences, training and team building events and social gatherings of up to 180 guests. Spaces are air-conditioned with modern equipment, Wi-Fi and catering options. Our function spaces can host your weddings, proms, graduations, celebrations of life, birthdays and anniversaries. Plus, the hotel offers plentiful breakfasts and delicious dinner options in our comfortable restaurant. 

Harlow is known as a "Sculpture Town" with over 100 pieces for you to explore nearby. Slightly further afield, our hotel also offers a great base to explore the open green spaces of Essex with Epping Forest reachable in under 30 minutes by car. 

Your comfort is our priority, and our dedicated team is here to ensure your stay is truly memorable. Enjoy every moment of your time with us at greet London Harlow.

14636.address: C-422 a 2,5 km del paso elevado de la C-14
14636.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 3 spa tubs, a sauna, and bicycles to rent. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and a communal living room. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 8:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and multilingual staff. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 24 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring minibars and DVD players.

name.content: Hotel y Apartamento Sercotel Villa Engracia

14645.description: In a strategic location only 6 km from the motorway, 48 km from Tarragona, and 35 km from Reus. Located in the small settlement of Les Masies de Poblet, belonging to the municipality of L'Espluga de Francolí and inside the Poblet Wildlands (declared Natural park) it is only 500 m from the Monastery of Poblet, heart of the Route of the Cistercian Order. This historic building was built in 1888 and completely renovated in 2009. The hotel's facilities include a pleasant restaurant La Font de Ferro, a cozy fireplace, lobby bar and a nice terrace. In addition there is a sport court, a gym and a beautiful outdoor swimming pool. The accommodations are equipped with full kitchen, bathroom, living room with a fireplace and outdoor terrace. In addition to all the sports facilities there is an outdoor pool which has a nice grassy area for sunbathing and a small snack bar to cool down.

14835.description: Novotel London Tower Bridge is a 4-star hotel at the heart of the British capital, just metres from the world-famous Tower Bridge and the Tower of London. With London's landmarks within walking distance and sitting in the shadow of its famous skyline, visitors to London will struggle to find a location better than this. On the doorstep of the City and a couple of stops from Canary Wharf, those visiting on business will love the location and can also take advantage of our excellent on-site facilities.

name.content: Holiday Inn London - Kensington High St

14836.description: Kensington High Street Hotel in the heart of London's Museum &Gallery DistrictHoliday Inn® London Kensington High Street, our London hotel is moments away from High Street Kensington Tube Station. There is an on-site car park with limited chargeable spaces. Local bus stops are two minutes' walk away provide easy access to the city. The Heathrow Express from Paddington Station, two miles away, whisks you to the airport in 15 minutes. The boutique shops of Kensington High Street are just around the corner, and the Science, Natural History and Victoria &Albert museums are all within a mile of our Kensington hotel. The South Bank, Buckingham Palace and central London's galleries and museums are also within easy reach. You can host an intimate event or a conference for up to 300 guests in the hotel's 13 flexible meeting rooms. The private garden is ideal for outdoor events. Printing facilities are available in the on-site e-bar. There's free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Wake up to a buffet breakfast at the Boulevard Restaurant, or finish the day with a taste of contemporary European cuisine. Access to the gym is free and, for a fee you can swim laps in the indoor pool. Grab a light lunch, afternoon tea or a glass of wine with friends in the relaxed Lounge Bar. Kids stay and eat free.

14875.description:
"Located in Salou, just 3 km from PortAventura World, this complex is ideal for families looking for a fun-filled holiday. The Ponient Marinada (4*) has 222 double and family rooms, all with a balcony, free Wi-Fi and safe, while the Ponient Aparthotel Marinada (2*) offers 81 fully equipped studios with kitchen, table and chairs, private bathroom and balcony for 2, 3 or 4 people. 

Younger guests will love the kids' club with Splash Park, soft play area, children's pool, and playground, as well as day and night entertainment and a meet and greet with PortAventura World characters. Adults can enjoy two outdoor pools and a wide range of activities. 

The buffet restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner with a dedicated children's buffet, alongside vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options. Guests can also relax at the pool and lobby bar. 

All rooms and studios feature flat-screen satellite TV, air conditioning, safe, and free Wi-Fi. The Aparthotel studios also include a fully equipped kitchen, perfect for families who prefer a home-away-from-home experience. 

As a guest, enjoy exclusive discounts of up to 50% on PortAventura World tickets, plus a free shuttle service to the parks from April to October. "

14917.description: The multi-award-winning Astor Court Hotel offers exceptional value in the heart of London's West End. Located on a quiet street, it's just a five-minute walk from Oxford Circus, Regent's Park, and Great Portland Street tube stations. Refurbished Superior rooms boast a stylish blend of modern comfort and Victorian architecture. Standard rooms on the lower floors provide an excellent base for business and leisure travelers, accommodating one to three guests. A complimentary continental breakfast is included. The hotel also features well-equipped, air-conditioned meeting rooms with natural daylight, ideal for various events. Experience a warm welcome and exceptional service from our dedicated hospitality team.

14919.description: The London Town Hotel is a converted Victorian townhouse, just 100 metres from Earls Court Underground Station. The hotel is situated in the heart of Earls Court in the Royal Borough of Kensington & Chelsea. Rooms at the London Town Hotel have an en suite shower and toilet with a selection of toiletries. They also feature a flat-screen TV, free Wi-Fi, a hairdryer, a safe and a telephone. All rooms are non-smoking. Continental breakfast is available on pre-order and is served in the breakfast room. Free tea and coffee is available in the guest lounge, which leads onto the terrace overlooking the garden. Olympia Exhibition Centre is a 15-minute walk away. The famous shopping districts of Kensington and Knightsbridge are nearby and the Tube provides easy access to the West End and Central London.

14923.description: Boasting an excellent central location in London, this convenient and delightful hotel is within easy reach from several points of interest either for business and leisure travellers alike. The establishment is well-serviced with public transport links and a few steps from one of the city's main shopping districts such as Oxford Street and the Kensington area. Hyde Park is also within easy reach from the premises, allowing its guests to enjoy leisurely walks. Built in a Victorian-style building, this hotel's guest rooms are nicely decorated and offer comfortable amenities for a peaceful stay in the British capital. In addition, guests can taste a complimentary, delicious breakfast every morning at the on-site facilities.

14967.description: This comfortable hotel lies amidst peaceful gardens and is situated close to the centre of London where there are countless shopping and entertainment venues just waiting to be explored. Links to the public transport network (Earls Court underground station) lie about 100 m away and restaurants and bars are to be found some 800 m from the hotel. This 6-storey hotel was built in 1860, renovated in 1998 and comprises a total of 18 double rooms, 2 twin rooms and 3 suites. Amongst the facilities count a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, lifts and a cloakroom. There is also a café, a bar and free public wifi. Laundry and room services round off the offerings. Each of the well-equipped rooms comes with a bathroom, a hairdryer, a safe, a direct dial telephone, Internet access and satellite/ cable TV. Guests may select their breakfast from and bag to-go breakfast. .

14968.description:
The Edwin Hotel 

Located in the favoured neighbourhood for the rich and famous over the years (Freddie Mercury, Alfred Hitchcock, a young Diana, Princess of Wales and currently Gary Barlow), our boutique townhouse hotel marries period architecture and design with all the contemporary comforts. 

The Edwin Hotel offers the perfect retreat whether travelling alone, on business, or with the family. Earls Court Underground Station, Olympia Exhibition Centre, Harrods, Chelsea and various attractions such as the Natural History Museum and Science Museum are all nearby.

14969.description: Located close to the centre of London, between the districts of Bayswater and Notting Hill, this hotel lies just 1 km from restaurants, bars and various shopping venues. Links to the public transport network lies about 200 m away and Bayswater is the nearest underground station. Built in 1880 and renovated in the year 2000, this hotel comprises 5 floors with a total of 37 double rooms and 7 suites. Facilities include a 24-hour reception desk, lifts, safes and a cloakroom. The rooms come with a bathroom, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV and central heating. Guests may select their breakfast from an ample buffet.

14975.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at Sidney Hotel London Victoria, including Wi-Fi (surcharge), concierge services, and a television in the common area. Take advantage of discounted access to a nearby fitness center and our reception hall. Dine in our restaurant and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 9:00 AM. We also offer wired internet access (surcharge), a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge at scheduled times. Our 80 guestrooms feature LCD televisions with satellite programming, and wired/wireless internet access (surcharge). Private bathrooms with bathtubs include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Each room also provides a phone, safe, and desk.

14982.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). For lunch or dinner, stop by XX-XXVIII Restaurant, a restaurant that specializes in international cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-out. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 139 square feet (13 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 3 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 86 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment.

14985.description: This charming 4 Star boutique hotel is an ideal option for business and leisure stays in the heart of London, only a few minutes from Hyde Park and within walking distance of Oxford Street and Notting Hill shopping areas. Located in a typical and recently remodeled Victorian building, enjoy this peaceful setting in a residential area with privileged views of Queens Gardens. A tranquil oasis to unwind from the city's frantic rhythm. Its classic English style front is in contrast with the modern and minimalist interior, decorated with fascinating Roman mosaics. The hotel features 140 stylish fully refurbished guest bedrooms, with warm comfortable atmospheres and modern amenities. With a gymnasium, sauna, business room and two unique gastronomic areas, enabling you to savor creative Spanish cuisine in the heart of England's capital.

14986.description:
Situated near the iconic Tower Bridge and Tower of London, Leonardo Royal Hotel London City is the perfect destination for leisure, business, and family travellers seeking to explore the heart of the capital. With a prime city centre location, it offers convenient access to some of London's top attractions, including Petticoat Lane Market, The O2, and St Katharine Docks. 

The hotel is just a two-minute walk from Tower Hill tube station, while Fenchurch Street station and Tower Gateway DLR are only four minutes away. These nearby stations provide quick access to London City Airport and other parts of the city. 

 Guests can enjoy an afternoon at the historic Tower of London, home to the Crown Jewels, or visit the Whitechapel Gallery, just a 15-minute walk from the hotel. Covent Garden, Oxford Street, and Carnaby Street are easily accessible by tube for shopping enthusiasts. 

Leonardo Royal Hotel London City features 317 spacious and comfortable guestrooms, all with modern décor and DREAM beds by Leonardo, ensuring a restful stay. Executive rooms offer additional amenities for those seeking extra comfort. The hotel also offers rooms designed for wheelchair access, meeting the highest accessibility standards. 

Families are well catered to, with rooms accommodating up to four adults or two adults and two children, making it an ideal choice for a family visit to London. In-room amenities include free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and luxury bedding for a great night’s sleep. 

Guests can enjoy a variety of dining options onsite. Leo’s Bar and Restaurant serves Mediterranean cuisine in stylish surroundings, while Corvo Bar & Café offers more casual dining with a selection of sandwiches, soups, and salads. Whether you’re looking for a hearty breakfast or a cocktail after a long day, both venues provide excellent choices for dining and relaxation.

14990.description: With the Gloucester Road subway station just across the road, our hotel is in a great location for exploring London. Located in the museum district, we are within a mile of Kensington Palace, Hyde Park, and the Natural History Museum. Knightsbridge luxury shops and eateries are just a mile away. Unwind in our private garden after a busy day.

14991.description: This modest hotel, built in the mid-19th century, is situated in a quiet area within walking distance of London's city center. Guests will find public transport conveniently located nearby, providing easy access to the city's many tourist attractions and cultural sites. Perfect for both couples and groups, this hotel offers flexible accommodations ranging from single rooms to family rooms with a mix of single and bunk beds, sleeping up to seven people. Rooms are clean, fresh, and simply decorated in a minimalist style. While a budget hotel, it prides itself on offering a little something extra. Guests can expect warm rooms with comfortable beds, private en-suite showers, flat-screen TVs, and Wi-Fi.

14993.description: Novotel London Bridge is a 4-Star hotel in an ideal location. Guests will find great tourist attractions such as the Shard, the Tate Modern, St. Pauls Cathedral and Borough Market - all within walking distance. Those looking to travel further afield can do so easily with multiple tube stations located nearby.

14994.description: A stay at Novotel London Waterloo places you in the heart of London, within a 15-minute walk of Westminster Abbey and London Eye. This upscale hotel is 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Westminster Bridge and 0. 9 mi (1. 5 km) from Big Ben. Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center and bicycles to rent. This Art Deco hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 187 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers with rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Elements, for lunch, dinner, or brunch. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 2153 square feet (200 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. St. Thomas' Hospital - 0.

14995.description: This modern hotel is located in London, lying within easy access of a host of shopping and entertainment venues. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to many of the city's most prominent attractions. London Heathrow Airport lies within easy access of this hotel. This charming hotel enjoys a delightful architectural design. The guest rooms are exquisitely designed, bathing visitors in luxury and classical elegance. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests will appreciate the wide range of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer. Guests can enjoy delightful dining in the mornings, for a great start to the day.

14997.description: This charming hotel is situated at the heart of London near to the Royal Albert Hall and Hyde Park. The shopping quarter of Knightsbridge with the famous department store Harrods is only a few minutes away. Links to the public transport network are within 150m of the hotel.Bars, pubs, and restaurants are to be found in the vicinity.The hotel additionally offers a bar, an à la carte restaurant and a conference room. Room and laundry services are also offered.The comfortably furnished rooms come with an en-suite bathroom. All of them come fully-equipped as standard. Guests may make use of the sauna and the gym for those wishing to keep fit.Guests may select their breakfast and midday meals from ample buffets. Lunch and dinner may alternatively be taken à la carte or chosen from a menu.

14998.description: This elegant hotel is wonderfully situated in Covent Garden, within easy walking distance of several attractions, including the British Museum, Trafalgar Square, and Leicester Square’s entertainment district. From this ideal location, guests can readily explore the captivating city, with Kingsway Hall, popular theaters, and the Covent Garden metro station nearby. The hotel offers elegantly designed guest rooms, each richly appointed in classic style. Guests can also enjoy a delightful dining experience in the hotel restaurant.

name.content: Sanderson London, A Morgans Originals Hotel

15006.description:
Step off the busy streets of Fitzrovia and into a world where reality loosens its grip. 

Hidden behind an unassuming façade, Sanderson has spent decades blurring the line between hotel and fantasy. Designed by Philippe Starck, Sanderson is one of London's most imaginative destinations, where surreal design, playful details and unexpected moments wait around every corner. 

While the city hums away outside, life inside moves to its own rhythm. Drift between long lunches, hidden cocktails and late-night conversations, while the hotel's iconic spaces invite curiosity at every turn. From the famous Long Bar and enchanting Courtyard to bedrooms designed to view your retreat from a new perspective, Sanderson offers a London experience unlike any other. 

Located moments from Oxford Street, the hotel places some of London's most exciting neighbourhoods within easy reach, yet there's something about Sanderson that makes leaving feel entirely optional.

15007.description: Viewed through a classic British lens with a dash of eccentricity, designer Philippe Starck conceived St Martins Lane London as a surreal wonderland. Elegant and edgy meet decadent in our social spaces, featuring gold tooth seating, life-sized chess pieces, and a boutique tea façade hiding something special. Fittingly situated in Covent Garden's bustling Theatre District, the hotel is pure drama.

15015.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as bicycle rentals, a terrace, and a garden at this Victorian hotel. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, an arcade/game room, and ski storage. Dine at the hotel's restaurant, The Boat Country Inn, for lunch or dinner, or enjoy room service (during limited hours). Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee (7:30 AM to 10:00 AM). The hotel also offers a business center, express check-in/check-out, a conference center, and two meeting rooms. Free self-parking is available onsite. The 34 guest rooms feature flat-screen televisions with digital programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, desks, and coffee/tea makers. Housekeeping is provided daily. Nearby attractions include Boat of Garten Golf Club (0. 2 mi), Loch Vaa (2. 3 mi), and the Loch Garten Osprey Centre (2. 7 mi). The preferred airport is Inverness (INV), 34 mi away.

15017.description: Indulge in a rejuvenating experience at the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Stay active with outdoor tennis courts, an indoor pool, and a steam room. This hotel also provides complimentary Wi-Fi and wedding services. Savor local cuisine at Hickory, the on-site restaurant and bar/lounge, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. The hotel offers 42 comfortable guest rooms, each equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, digital programming, and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hair dryer. Additional conveniences include desks, hair dryers, and daily housekeeping. Located in Nairn, the Golf View Hotel & Spa is next to a golf course, just a short walk from Moray Firth and Nairn Golf Club. Nairn Beach and Nairn Museum are also nearby. Free self-parking and a 24-hour front desk are available.

15018.description: This delightful aparthotel is nestled in Edinburgh's cultural heart, steps from the historic Royal Mile and a short 5-minute walk from Princes Street. Edinburgh Castle and Camera Obscura are also within easy reach. Ideal for exploring this captivating city, the contemporary aparthotel offers relaxing accommodations with elegant, streamlined wooden floors and modern amenities. Nearby public transport links add to the convenience.

15019.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center, complimentary wireless internet access, and wedding services. This Edinburgh hotel also features tour/ticket assistance, a banquet hall, and a vending machine. Dine at Brasserie, specializing in British cuisine, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served weekdays from 7:00 to 10:00 AM and weekends from 8:00 to 11:00 AM (fees apply). The hotel offers dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. With 1, 926 square feet (179 square meters) of event space, including conference and meeting rooms, it's ideal for hosting events. Free self-parking is available. Each of the 100 guest rooms features a flat-screen television with digital programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer, a coffee/tea maker, and an iron/ironing board.
