Nearby attractions include Edinburgh Port, Ocean Terminal Shopping Centre, Leith Links, and the Royal Yacht Britannia. The preferred airport is Edinburgh Airport (EDI).

15020.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at this Glasgow hotel, including complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and even wedding services. Dine at Chez Mal, specializing in British cuisine, or order 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Weekday breakfasts are served from 7:00 to 10:00 AM, and weekend breakfasts from 7:30 to 10:30 AM (fee applies). The hotel also offers dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. With 527 square feet (49 square meters) of event space, including conference and meeting rooms, it's ideal for business events. The 72 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Additional conveniences include phones, desks, and coffee/tea makers. Located near St. Vincent Street Church, Sauchiehall Street and the Glasgow School of Art, the hotel is approximately 8. 6 miles from Glasgow International Airport (GLA).

15021.description: This impressive hotel enjoys a quiet setting in Edinburgh's beautiful and historic city center. Located midway between Haymarket railway station and Edinburgh Zoo, both less than two kilometers away, it's ideal for exploring the area. Guests find themselves in a cosmopolitan and historic downtown, with Edinburgh Castle and the National Museum of Scotland a short ride away. This charming establishment boasts Victorian design and warm Scottish hospitality. Its comfortable and beautifully decorated rooms offer a relaxing retreat after a day of meetings or sightseeing. Guests will delight in the home-cooked dishes and unique ambiance of the hotel restaurant and afterward, they may enjoy a drink in the beer garden. A meeting room is available for business travelers, and complimentary parking is provided.

15022.description: The Newton Hotel, a charming castle-style retreat nestled on 21 acres of secluded grounds, offers magnificent views overlooking the Nairn Golf Course, Moray Firth, and the Ross-shire hills. A modern extension provides additional bedrooms and impressive conference facilities. Choose from a variety of double, twin, master, and family rooms, each tastefully decorated and spacious. All rooms feature a refreshment tray, TV, direct-dial telephone, and 24-hour room service. Well-behaved dogs are welcome for a fee of £15. 00 per stay, but they are not permitted in public areas and must not be left unattended in guest rooms. Cancellations must be made by 12 pm the day before arrival; otherwise, the first night's stay will be charged.

15023.description: A welcoming atmosphere prevails at this popular Employee Owned hotel which occupies a prime position in the village square. Bedrooms are large and comfortably modern in appointment and offer a good range of amenities. The tasteful open plan public areas include a relaxing Coffee Lounge and a spacious restaurant. Staff are friendly and efficient and offer a warm Highland Welcome. The hotel deserves its reputation as one of the North's premier hotels.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Edinburgh City Centre

15026.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: On-site Restaurant(s). Stylish, modern conveniences meet old-world charm at DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Edinburgh City Centre. Set in the center of the city, this 1892 listed building offers a fantastic location within walking distance of many of Edinburgh's famous attractions. We look forward to welcoming you to the hotel and to Edinburgh with a warm chocolate-chip cookie at check-in. Make yourself comfortable in an elegant guest room with amenities for work and relaxation, including WiFi access. Select a spacious suite or deluxe room for spectacular views of Edinburgh Castle. Dine, for breakfast, lunch and dinner in the Bread Street Brasserie. With a focus on fresh, quality ingredients, this Edinburgh restaurant offers a delightful menu with options to suit any occasion and palate. After a busy day exploring the city, unwind with a refreshing cocktail in Monboddo Bar or reinvigorate with a workout in the complimentary 24-hour fitness center. With its central location steps from the financial district, our dedicated glass-fronted Conference Venue is ideal for meetings in Edinburgh. Allow our events staff to lend a hand, providing the latest A/V equipment rental and professional services. Choose the stunning Penthouse for a memorable, bespoke Edinburgh wedding or celebration. The Penthouse offers a truly exceptional experience with its outdoor decking area and views of the city skyline, the castle and the River Forth on the horizon.

15027.description: Located in Glasgow's heart, steps from Argyle and Buchanan Streets' shopping, dining, and nightlife, this hotel offers beautifully designed guest suites ideal for work and relaxation. Queen Street and Central Station are within a 5-minute walk. A £250 security deposit is required via our online portal before arrival. Please contact reception 48-72 hours in advance with your details.

15038.description: Enjoy a complimentary local breakfast daily from 7:00 to 9:00 AM at the Luna Simone Hotel, a centrally located guesthouse in London's City Centre, just a short drive from Westminster Abbey and Hyde Park. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and make use of convenient amenities such as tour/ticket assistance. The 36 guestrooms feature Smart TVs, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, safes, and desks. Housekeeping is provided daily. Victoria Station is just 0. 5 miles away, and Buckingham Palace is 1. 2 miles from the hotel. Heathrow Airport (LHR) is the preferred airport for the hotel.

15068.description: This attractive hotel is located in the heart of Tarragona, near the famous Mediterranean Balcony viewpoint and the main Roman monuments, offering an ideal base not only for tourists but also for those travelling on business purposes. Tarragona train station is easy reachable within 10 minutes' walk from the property and an array of restaurants and shops can be found in the surrounding area. The accommodation units range from standard to deluxe rooms, all offering a charming interior design as well as excellent facilities such as a flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi access. Those travelling with children can take advantage of a more spacious family room. After a busy day of work or sightseeing, guests may relax in the common lounge area or take a refreshing dip into the sparkling outdoor pool, which is equipped with sun loungers, ideal to enjoy the Mediterranean sun.

15087.description: This charming hotel is situated between Salou and Cambrils, at the heart of the Costa Daurada. It is some 2 km to the nearest beautiful beach and an array of shops and entertainment venues are located within 3 km of the hotel. The hotel was built in 1995 and consists of 40 rooms on 2 floors. Guests are offered a spacious lobby with a 24-hour reception desk and a TV room. There is cosy café, a bar and an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant. Additionally, conference rooms as well as room and laundry services are at guests' disposal. And there are parking facilities and a play area for children outside of the hotel. The tastefully furnished rooms are all well-equipped as standard. The hotel offers guests an outdoor pool as well as an indoor one and a sauna. In the mornings, guests are invited to serve themselves from the breakfast buffet.

15101.description: This establishment offers luxurious private apartments that are well-placed for Hyde Park, Notting Hill and Kensington Palace. All apartments have modern, open-plan kitchenettes and are fully furnished with high-quality modern appliances. They are ideal if you require independence, space and serviced accommodation. Grand Plaza is 5 minutes’ walk from Paddington Train Station and is a short walk from Whiteley's shopping centre. Bayswater and Queensway Tube stations are a short distance away. Complimentary high-speed broadband internet is available. The apartments, holding up to 6 people, have a double room and the rest of the guests sleep in the living room. The bathroom is inside the master bedroom.

15102.description: This attractive apartment complex enjoys a prime location in Knightsbridge's shopping district, just a short walk from Kensington Palace and Hyde Park. Nearby attractions include the Natural History Museum, the Victoria and Albert Museum, and Harrods. Public parking and transport links are easily accessible. Numerous shops, bars, pubs, and restaurants are within a 2 km radius. Built in 1950 and renovated in 2001, the eight-story complex houses 89 apartments. Guests enjoy a 24-hour reception with safe and currency exchange, a cloakroom, lift, café, casino, restaurant with highchairs, internet terminal, laundry, and room service. The modern apartments feature tiled en suite bathrooms with hairdryers, direct dial telephones, satellite/cable TV, radios, internet access, kitchenettes, fridges, double beds, carpeting, central heating, and safes.

15103.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Additional amenities at this aparthotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli serving guests of Fraser Suites Queens Gate. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Make yourself at home in one of the 105 air-conditioned rooms featuring kitchenettes with refrigerators and microwaves. 40-inch LCD televisions with digital programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Cromwell Road - 0. 1 km / 0.

15107.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. At Fraser Suites Glasgow, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7 AM to 10 AM and on weekends from 8 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Make yourself at home in one of the 98 guestrooms, featuring kitchenettes with refrigerators and stovetops. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed. LCD televisions with digital programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. The nearest airports are: Glasgow International Airport (GLA) - 16. 4 km / 10. 2 miGlasgow (PIK-Prestwick) - 53. 3 km / 33. 1 mi Located in Glasgow (City Centre Glasgow), Fraser Suites Glasgow is within a 10-minute walk of Glasgow Green and Buchanan Street. This eco-certified aparthotel is 0. 5 mi (0. 8 km) from George Square and 2. 8 mi (4. 6 km) from OVO Hydro.

15126.description: This hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has a range of kids amenities available upon request. Hilton London Heathrow Airport is well connected to transport hubs, with direct access into Heathrow Airport’s Terminal 4 via a covered walkway. The hotel is located less than 15 minutes from Heathrow Terminals 2, 3, and 5, and our guest service team will be happy to assist with your connection. Paddington Station in Central London is 30 minutes away via Heathrow Express. Windsor Castle, and LEGOLAND® Windsor Resort are within 12 miles of our door. With 398 guest rooms, which includes executive rooms and stylish suites for the ultimate in luxury, the hotel also offers guests a whole host of amenities. Along with an onsite gym, fitness lovers can take advantage of the running and walking trails in the parklands around the hotel, or enjoy a meal, snack, or drink in one of the three OXBO dining experiences, which are available from early morning until late at night. The hotel boasts an OXBO Café, OXBO Bar, and OXBO Kitchen, each offering their own distinct menu – but all offering responsibly sourced, comforting, and generous dishes. The hotel has extensive conference, events, and meeting facilities, with 15 meeting rooms which can easily accommodate numbers from one to 300. The event spaces include the Concorde Atrium, with floor to ceiling windows, allowing natural light to infiltrate the space with a fantastic view over the hotel pond. It can easily accommodate up to 140 people and is versatile enough to accommodate everything from a drinks reception to a product launch.

15128.description: Ideal for those travellers eager to enjoy a relaxing holiday close to the beach, this enchanting property offers the perfect base to explore and discover all Costa Daurada has to offer. It features a prime location in the picturesque town of Cunit, some 30 metres from a long sandy beach and a 35-minute driving distance from Reus Airport. Only a few kilometres from Barcelona and Tarragona, travellers staying at this beautiful region cannot miss L'Aquarium de Barcelona, situated in Port Vell, and Port Aventura theme park. Guests will find themselves close to a wide range of restaurants, bars and nightlife venues. Designed with guests' needs in mind, the establishment provides a choice of modern conveniences including Wi-Fi internet connection, air conditioning and a chill out area ideal to share moments with the family or friends. As for the onsite guest rooms, they all feature a minimalist style that will delight even the most discerning travellers.

name.content: Radisson Blu Hotel & Conference Centre, London LHR

15142.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a sauna and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Steak & Lobster Heathrow, a restaurant which specializes in international cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 6:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Hayes? This hotel has 0 square feet (0 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 42 meeting rooms.

15147.description: Mercure London Bridge is a flagship Mercure hotel located in the centre of London. Enjoy famous nearby attractions such as Borough Market and the Shard, whilst being surrounded by nearby shops and art galleries. On entering this charming hotel, you'll sense its unique atmosphere, making you feel at home. Every detail in the hotel has been carefully considered with your comfort in mind. Experience the hotel restaurant, Marco's New York Italian, courtesy of celebrity Chef Marco Pierre White.

15155.description: Contemporary chic and glamorous, Delano London Hotel offers the ultimate experience in the heart of London. Located opposite Hyde Park and overlooking Kensington Gardens and Palace, the hotel boasts an exclusive location close to the Royal Albert Hall , world renowned museums, and Knightsbridge. Set in an original Victorian building, the hotel flawlessly blends traditional style with modern elegance.

15166.description: A modern hotel near Gatwick Airport with secure parking and a shuttle bus to the airport Holiday Inn® London - Gatwick Airport hotel offers sleek, comfortable rooms just five minutes drive from Gatwick Airport. Guests can take the convenient 24-hour airport shuttle bus from the hotel, which runs every 15–30 minutes, and every hour from 00:00-03:00. *chargeable, card only. If you book a Park, Stay & Go package, you can leave the car in the hotel's secure car park for four, eight or 15 days while you enjoy your holiday. Whether you're taking the family to the beaches of Tenerife or the ruins of Rome, you can have a good night's sleep knowing you're only five minutes from Gatwick Airport.  To start the holiday early, take the kids to Chessington World of Adventures, about a 30-minute drive from the hotel, or catch the Gatwick Express for a half-hour journey to London. Business guests can catch up on work in the modern rooms, thanks to the free Wi-Fi and comfortable work desk. You can hold a conference for up to 220 delegates in one of 11 fully equipped meeting rooms.  Set up your presentation with the digital projector, or improvise with a whiteboard. Lunchtime meeting? You can order salads or hot food for your team. Have a relaxing night with a tasty meal from the stylish restaurant. Kids stay and eat free, and they can choose from a delicious menu.  You can check in for your flight with free Wi-Fi.

15170.description: A 5-star hotel in the heart of Knightsbridge London, near Harrods and Harvey NicholsAs one of London's first boutique hotels we are proud members of Pride of Britain and Small Luxury Hotels of the World. The Capital hotel, Apartments & Townhouse prides itself on being epitome of authentic British hospitality, through our passionate staff who are dedicated to meeting your every need throughout your stay. The 5-star hotel near Harrods was awarded Best Hotel and Best Business for Customer Service at the Royal Borough of Kensington & Chelsea Business Awards 2018. At The Capital Hotel all of its elegant rooms are individually designed and classically decorated with original art and antique furniture adding to the already quintessentially British atmosphere of the hotel. For guests choosing to stay a little longer you can experience our Capital Apartments with en-suite facilities and self-catered kitchens making our 5-star hotel apartments the perfect London residence, with the added benefit of being able to access all hotel facilities. Choose from our studio apartments or go all out and treat yourself to our three bedroom penthouse. For the more modern traveller our twelve key Capital Townhouse offers unmatched comfort, style and convenience from its off the street entrance separate to the main hotel. Discover the award-winning Restaurant at The Capital, the hotels famous English Afternoon Tea or our extensive whiskey collection at The Capital Bar. With Knightsbridge tube station only a stone's throw away from the hotel we are in a fantastic location for you to get to all of London's landmarks and attractions. Come experience London living at The Capital hotel, Apartments & Townhouse.

15176.description: Enjoy a central London stay at the Duke of Leinster Hotel, just a short walk from Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park. This hotel offers 36 guestrooms equipped with LCD televisions, digital programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast, served weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Additional amenities include a business center, concierge services, and limo/town car service.

15177.description: Centrally located in London, Edward Hotel Paddington is a short walk from Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. This hotel offers 46 air-conditioned rooms with LCD TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with showers and complimentary toiletries. Guests can enjoy room service during limited hours, concierge services, and convenient on-site parking. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk and multilingual staff. Nearby attractions include Marble Arch, Royal Albert Hall, and Kensington Palace.

15178.description: Enjoy a central London stay at the Kensington Court Hotel, conveniently located a short walk from Kensington High Street and the Design Museum. The hotel offers 35 guestrooms equipped with minibars, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, and in-room safes and desks. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. Additional amenities include concierge services, a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include Olympia Conference and Exhibition Centre and the Natural History Museum.

15214.description: 'Located just 13 miles from Inverness, the family-run Drum Hotel offers a warm welcome to Loch Ness and the Scottish Highlands. Situated a quarter of a mile from the loch itself, the hotel is part of the world-famous Loch Ness Exhibition Centre. During the summer, guests can enjoy convenient access to shops and hourly Loch Ness cruises directly from the hotel. Our 29 en-suite rooms include single, twin, double, and family options, with two rooms specifically designed for guests with disabilities. All rooms feature comfortable Sleepeasy beds, TVs, hairdryers, and tea and coffee making facilities. The Loch Ness Cafe serves a variety of lunch options, including packed lunches perfect for Nessie hunting or sightseeing excursions. For evening dining, the Loch Ness Bistro offers à la carte and bar supper menus prepared by our experienced chefs. Enjoy your meal while taking in the stunning views of Drumnadrochit, the surrounding hills, and the Great Glen. '

15771.description: The Evenia President Hotel is highly recommended for those seeking a comfortable setting near the sea. Its 56 rooms offer guests a functional and pleasant environment. The communal areas provide ideal spaces for relaxing with friends. Breakfast and dinner service are available. Guests can also utilize the external car park.

15774.description: A welcoming London hotel near Hoxton and Shoreditch with free WiFi and breakfast includedHoliday Inn Express® London - City hotel is just steps from Old Street Tube station. The restaurants and buzzing nightlife of Hoxton and Shoreditch are a 5-minute walk. You can catch the Stansted Express train to London Stansted Airport (STN) at London Liverpool Street station. Shops and restaurants at Spitalfields Market and world-class performing arts at the Barbican Centre are a 15-minute walk away. St. Paul's Cathedral is also within easy reach, and buses whisk you to Oxford Street shopping and the London Eye in no time. Business guests are a short walk from the City of London financial district. Hosting an event? The hotel’s 5 naturally lit, flexible meeting rooms can hold up to 80 people. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- Express Start™ Breakfast included in the room rate- Discount passes to the nearby Nuffield Health gym- On-site parking (limited)- A Business CentreInviting rooms have blackout curtains to help you sleep soundly. Start the morning with a hot breakfast of sausages, scrambled eggs and baked beans. At day's end, you can meet with friends over drinks in the lobby bar.

15775.description: At COMO The Halkin, Italian design meets contemporary simplicity, creating a haven of tranquility. Its 41 guest rooms and suites offer a relaxed atmosphere and generous space paired with five-star service. Indulgent amenities include Egyptian cotton linen, interactive E-TV (with over 60 free channels), internet radio, and an extensive music jukebox. Complimentary WiFi is available throughout the hotel. The Halkin Bar provides afternoon tea, tapas, and cocktails. The intimate space also offers a relaxed all-day dining menu featuring Western classics and impeccably crafted comfort food, including pasta, steak, salads, and sandwiches. COMO The Halkin is a discreet insider's address in London's exclusive Belgravia.

15777.description: The hotel boasts a vibrant Park Lane location, combining attentive service with contemporary design. Created by leading names in music, cuisine, and interior design, it caters to travelers drawn to London's electrifying energy. Nobu restaurant offers an essential dining experience, serving award-winning Japanese-Peruvian cuisine. Signature dishes include black cod with miso, sashimi salad with Matsuhisa soy sauce dressing, Hamachi sashimi with jalapeños, and squid pasta with light garlic sauce. 24-hour room service offers both Nobu specialties and late-night comfort options. Standard room check-in is 3 PM, check-out is 12 PM. Two-bedroom apartments have a 4 PM check-in and 10 AM check-out.

15780.description: Wonderfully situated in London, this hotel is the perfect base for visiting London. The property is located just a short walking distance away from Paddington train station, on Craven Road. Furthermore Lancester Gate station is 5 minutes walk from the hotel. Having 2 hotel is ideal for touriest going to their final destination. The hotel is well located for many of London's top attractions, including Hyde Park, Notting Hill Gate and Buckingham Palace. The property comprises stylishly-appointed guest rooms, which have been designed to a high standard. Excellent facilities are available at this property, delivering a high level of comfort and convenience. Business and leisure travellers are sure to appreciate the exemplary service that this property has to offer.

15781.description: The Hotel has been family-run since 1962 and we are constantly upgrading to meet the demands of the modern traveler. The hotel is ideally located, offering easy access to all of London's most important districts. Whether wishing to visit the city's attractions, simply go shopping or spend a pleasant evening at the theatre, this hotel offers the perfect stopover point. Since its opening in 1900, the hotel has been renovated and modernized several times, whenever quality specifications made it necessary. The nearest underground station, Paddington, is just 500 m from the hotel.

15798.description: This charming hotel boasts a strategic setting in London. The property is just a 3 minutes' walking distance away from Finchley Road underground, which offers ease of access to many areas of the city. The property is just a 2 minutes' walk from Finchley and Frognal rail station. ExCel Exhibition Centre and London City Airport are located just a short train journey away. Ideally positioned to suit business and leisure travellers, this hotel is sure to impress. The guest rooms provide a high level of comfort and convenience. Guests are invited to enjoy a hearty, English breakfast in the mornings, for a superb start to the day. A spacious lounge and bar area is available, where guests can sit back and unwind at the end of the day.

15812.description: This charming hotel housed in a beautiful Victorian building is conveniently situated just metres away from Paddington underground and train station. Renowned Hyde Park with Kensington Gardens and Princess Diana Memorial Playground can be reached within a 5-minute walk. Guests will find themselves close to a choice of famous sights such as Buckingham Palace, Big Ben and Trafalgar Square. The hotel features a wide choice of different room types ranging from single rooms to five-bedded rooms, ideal to enjoy a pleasant stay with family or friends. Ideal for leisure travellers wishing to discover this vibrant city, this hotel offers affordable rooms in a great location. The bunkbeds and single bed configuration can not be guaranteed. There is no rate difference and the configuration is upon request subject to availability.

15813.description: Housed in a beautiful 1850s building overlooking charming Norfolk Square, this city hotel offers an ideal location near Paddington Station and a wide array of amenities. Just moments from Paddington Train and Underground Station, and a short 5-10 minute walk from Oxford Street, the Shakespeare Hotel caters to both business travelers and romantic getaways. With a range of rooms from singles to family and multi-bed accommodations, it remains a popular budget-friendly choice in London. Please note that bunk and single bed configurations are available upon request and subject to availability.

15838.description: This lovely hotel full of character combines Victorian charm with modern comfort and is excellently located on the north side of Hyde Park. Marble Arch is within walking distance; the Lancaster Gate underground station is just a 3-minute walk away, providing easy access to all areas of London. The Paddington train station can be reached within a 10-minute walk, offering a direct link to Heathrow International Airport.

15847.description: Located in London (Acton), Holiday Inn London - West, an IHG Hotel is within a 10-minute drive of Westfield London Shopping Centre and Portobello Road Market. This upscale hotel is 3. 4 mi (5. 5 km) from London Designer Outlet and 3. 6 mi (5. 8 km) from OVO Arena Wembley. Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a rooftop terrace. Additional amenities at this Art Deco hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and discounted use of a nearby fitness facility. Make yourself at home in one of the 225 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Restaurant, for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10 AM and on weekends from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 248 square feet (23 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 7 meeting rooms.

15894.description:
Hyatt Regency London Blackfriars is located in the heart of the historic Square Mile directly outside Blackfriars station, close to St Paul’s Cathedral, the Tate Modern and Shakespeare’s Globe Theatre. The Grade II listed hotel is steeped in regal history, residing on the former grounds of King Henry VIII's Bridewell Palace. The hotel is ideal for corporate, leisure and family stays. 
All rooms and suites can accommodate maximum three occupants (children/infants included). Please note that there is an extra bed charge at £100 per night. A deposit is required on check-in for incidental charges.

15895.description: A family-friendly London hotel with meeting rooms, a restaurant and excellent transport linksHoliday Inn® London - Brent Cross hotel is only half a mile from the M1 motorway. We’re just off the North Circular Road and 20 miles from Heathrow Airport (LHR). It’s a quick hop by Tube to central London, with a free shuttle bus to and from Brent Cross station, so it’s simple to visit major museums, West End theatres or the London Eye. Sporting matches and concerts at Wembley Stadium are a short drive away, and it’s easy to take the kids to discover the world of Harry Potter at the Warner Bros. Studio in Leavesden. They’ll also love the vintage aircraft at the RAF Museum in nearby Hendon. If you’re visiting on business, you can host up to 100 guests in our well-equipped meeting rooms, with on-site parking for your clients and a convenient Business Centre in the hotel. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- Rooms with a sofa bed for families- Kids stay and eat freeOur spacious rooms have satellite TV and a handy desk for work. A pillow menu, blackout shades and adjustable air conditioning help you sleep in peace. Executive rooms have extra space, bathrobes and a minibar. Our Junction Restaurant offers a full English breakfast and meals throughout the day, and you can enjoy a cocktail and light snacks in the lounge.

15897.description: These apartments are located in a complex, in the heart of the small beach resort of Calafell and 60 km from the fascinating city of Barcelona. The complex is located 35 km from Salou and Port Aventura theme park. Guests will find themselves just 50 m from a beautiful, gently sloping sandy beach and a palm-lined promenade, in an area full of shops, restaurants and entertainment. Direct access by highway. Public transport is 150 m away. Reus and Barcelona airports are 35 and 45 km from the apartments, respectively.

15901.description: Less than 10 minutes’ walk from Hyde Park and 2 miles from Buckingham Palace, the Prince William Hotel is centrally located in Paddington and only 7 minutes' walk from the station. There is free WiFi throughout the hotel, and a 24-hour reception. Guests at the Prince William Hotel can enjoy breakfast each morning in the dining room. A continental breakfast of croissants and pastries, toast and bread rolls, fruit, yoghurts, cornflakes, cheese etc. Breakfast can be included in your stay by selecting a rate that includes breakfast or purchased separately at the hotel. The hotel is situated in an 18th-century corner period-listed building that combines Victorian and modern design. Each room contains modern features, tea and coffee making facilities and a TV. Every room also comes with its own en suite bathroom. London’s major attractions are all easy to reach on the Tube. Lancaster Gate Underground Station is just 4 minutes' walk. The Prince William is close to Marble Arch, Oxford Street, and Kensington. Madame Tussauds is 1. 2 miles away and Portobello Market is 1. 4 miles away. Westfield Shopping Centre is 2. 1 miles away.

15903.description:
This simple bungalow complex is situated in a campsite and is only 1 km from the nearest sandy beach. In a number of minutes guests will reach an array of shopping venues and Altafulla, just 1 km away, offers plenty of restaurants, bars and nightclubs. Convenient public transport links are only 100 metres from the complex.

The complex was built in 1982 beside a main road and consists of 200 rooms. Various facilities are available to guests including a 24-hour reception, a safe and a currency exchange facility. In addition, a café, a small supermarket, a games room, a TV room, an air-conditioned restaurant with highchairs for infants, as well as an Internet terminal, a car park, a garage and a children's playground are all facilities available within the hotel complex. It also offers its own laundry service and medical assistance if necessary. Children are supervised and cared for in the kids' club.

The simply-furnished rooms come with an en suite bathroom. Moreover, they are fitted with satellite/ cable TV, a kitchenette, a fridge, tiling, central heating and a lounge area. The apartments are cleaned on departure.

The bungalow complex offers guests a swimming pool, sun loungers and water aerobics. Sports enthusiasts are offered table tennis, aerobics, basketball, billiards, minigolf and golf. The superb entertainment programme rounds off the hotel's offerings.

16057.description: Located in the Bloomsbury area of London, this hotel revels in the peace and serenity of its surroundings in the city's West End. Oxford Street and Covent Garden can be reached by just a short underground ride. The hotel is just a few minutes' walking distance away from many renowned theatres, as well as countless attractions and sights. The British Museum, as well as Russell Square and Holborn stations are situated nearby. This hotel occupies an elegantly-restored Georgian townhouse, which provides an intimate, inviting setting in which to unwind. Luxurious studios and suites offer a welcoming escape from the bustle of daily life. This property prides itself on its attention to detail and the utmost in comfort.

16061.description: Perfectly located on Southampton Row in the Midtown area between the City and London's West End. The hotel is just a ten-minute walk away from top attractions like the British Museum and fifteen minutes' walk from the vibrant Covent Garden and Soho areas. Holborn underground station is less than 5 minutes' walk from the hotel and Russell Square underground station is also within walking distance. King's Cross, Euston and St. Pancras International rail stations provide access to the rest of London and beyond. It offers 201 stylish and comfortable bedrooms, all fitted with modern amenities, including air conditioning, flat screen TV, en-suite bathrooms and tea and coffee making facilities. Health and Fitness club is based on-site, giving guests access to a range of luxury fitness and spa services during their stay.

16063.description: This hotel enjoys a prime setting at the heart of the beautiful district of Bloomsbury. The hotel is situated close to Covent Garden, Oxford Street, the West End and many of London's top attractions. The hotel is also located just a short distance away from stylish shopping opportunities, delightful dining options and exciting entertainment venues. This luxurious, boutique-style hotel enjoys an intriguing design. The guest rooms are lavishly appointed, bathing visitors in grace and poise. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests are invited to take advantage of the exemplary facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

16069.description: On school or national holidays, this hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has kids amenities available on requestHilton Cardiff is located in the heart of the city, directly opposite Cardiff Castle. We’re minutes from St David's shopping centre, a 10 minute walk from the Principality Stadium and a short drive away from Cardiff Bay. Step inside the hotel and you’ll find beautifully styled guest rooms, fantastic dining options and a host of amenities for work, rest and recreation — everything you need for a fantastic stay in the Welsh capital.

16072.description: 'Enjoy convenient amenities such as complimentary wired and wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Dine at the onsite restaurant or enjoy a snack in the coffee shop/cafe. 24-hour room service is also available. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. For business travelers, the hotel offers a business center, complimentary wired internet access, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. The hotel's 77 guestrooms feature flat-screen televisions with satellite programming, and complimentary wired and wireless internet access. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. The hotel is conveniently located near Cromwell Road (0. 2 km). '

16076.description: Enjoy convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. The hotel's restaurant, Langham Brasserie, offers lunch and dinner, while the coffee shop/cafe provides additional dining options. 24-hour room service is also available. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM (fees apply). Business amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. The hotel offers conference space and two meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 56 guestrooms featuring complimentary wired and wireless internet access, private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, phones, safes, and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

16078.description: This 5-story hotel offers 108 comfortable rooms, some recently refurbished for a more spacious and inviting feel. Guests enjoy free Wi-Fi and on-site parking. Amenities include a 24-hour reception desk, a relaxed restaurant and bar, an indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, and gym. Each room features a private bathroom with hairdryer, direct-dial telephone, mini-fridge, and safe. Public transport is conveniently located 1. 6 kilometers away.

16079.description: This hotel enjoys a unique location on Montague Street close to the spot where the Duke of Montague erected a big villa, which is now the British Museum. In spite of being quietly situated, the hotel is within minutes of the theatres of the colourful West End. The shops of Oxford Street and Covent Garden can be reached in around 15 minutes' walk from Grange White Hall. The hotel comprises a total of 52 rooms and features a cosy restaurant. The English Garden Restaurant looks out onto immaculate lawns. Guests can also relax in Elgin Lounge Bar, which is open 24 hours a day. All of the elegant rooms come en suite and well – equipped as standard. Some of the rooms have a view to the garden.

16105.description: Located in London's City Centre, Olympic House Hotel is a short walk from Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. This hotel offers 40 guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with showers and complimentary toiletries. Guests can enjoy a bar/lounge, garden views, and convenient amenities like a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and on-site parking (subject to charges). Marble Arch is 1. 2 km away, and Oxford Street is 2. 1 km from the hotel.

16106.description: Located in London City Centre, the Orchard Hotel is within a 15-minute walk of Hyde Park and Marble Arch. This hotel is conveniently located 1. 2 miles from Oxford Street and 2. 4 miles from Buckingham Palace. The hotel offers 46 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Desks are provided, housekeeping is offered weekly and irons/ironing boards are available upon request. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast served daily between 7:30 AM and 9:00 AM. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk and an elevator.

16108.description: The hotel is a comfortable, intimate hotel, located within the heart of London's West End, within easy walking distance of London’s lively and famous streets and activities like Oxford Street, Bond Street, Museums, Art Galleries and a wide choice of some of the best restaurants that London has to offer. With its 72 en suite, air cooled bedrooms and suites, the hotel provides the perfect base for the business and leisure visitor to London and provides a convenient, comfortable and tranquil haven amidst the pace of London's bustling environment.

16117.description: This beach apartment complex prides itself on its location in Salou. Public transport is easily accessible in allowing for ease of access to attractive tourist points. Located just 500 metres from the beach and 2 kms from the adventure park of PortAventura this complex is the perfect choice for a family holiday. This complex exudes grandeur with its sophisticated architectural style. Guests can enjoy an evening coffee in the relaxing surroundings of the hotel café or enjoy up a refreshing snack in the hotel restaurant. The apartments offer an insight into the culture of the area. Designed with simplicity and a touch of elegance, visitors can relax and unwind in the brightly coloured spacious apartments. Active guests may enjoy a round of golf or a relaxing swim in the pool. Ideal for a relaxing getaway, families and individuals alike will thoroughly enjoy their stay here.

16118.description: This hotel is situated in a central location, in a green area and is only 50 m from the beach. Convenient public transport links are only 50 metres away. Barcelona is just 1 hour's drive away. Guests are welcomed in the lobby with a 24-hour reception. In addition, the hotel offers a café, a TV room, an à la carte restaurant. Conference facilities are also available. The comfortably furnished rooms are en suite and come fully equipped. The hotel has its own swimming pool with a poolside snack bar, a sun terrace with sun loungers and parasols. A sauna, a steam room, a massage service and a spa pool are also available. Sports enthusiasts may take advantage of the gym and there is a golf course located 15 km away. In the mornings, guests are invited to serve themselves from the breakfast buffet. In the evenings there is an à la carte menu on offer.

16205.description:
Ten miles away from Oxford, yet a world away from the din of daily life in Bicester, The Jersey Arms Hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western is arguably one of England's finest country inns, and indisputably the best located. On the edge of the Cotswolds which boasts plenty of old inns, but few can rival the charms of this one... or its standards of friendly service! 
Good food and wine will settle you into your stay, Bicester Village discount shopping centre lets you nip back to normality for a short while just three minutes away by car, before you rejoin us in a tranquil retreat to enjoy peace and quiet once again. Picturesque villages, rolling countryside and market towns all wait, as do the beautiful colleges of Oxford, exciting cultural attractions and the birthplace of Winston Churchill, Blenheim Palace!

16206.description: As the closest hotel to the arrival and departure terminals, the 4-star Novotel Birmingham Airport hotel blends style with convenience. Just a minute's walk from the airport, the hotel is the perfect choice for your family or business trip. The airy sound-proofed rooms provide enough space to stretch out and relax, while the 24-hour bar is perfect for a pre-flight snack or well-deserved drink. Exclusive to our guests: discounted NCP parking tickets £12 for 24 hours in NCP : CP 1, 2&3 all next to the hotel.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Edinburgh - Leith Waterfront

16210.description: Holiday Inn Express Edinburgh – Leith Waterfront is located on the outskirts of the city, in the cool harbour neighbourhood of Leith, also known as The Shore. Edinburgh Waverley train station is within easy reach and Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is 25 minutes away. Catch trams into the city centre from opposite the hotel. On-site parking is 11 GBP per night and spaces are limited. Stroll along to the Royal Yacht Britannia and explore the former yacht of Queen Elizabeth II. Delve into Scotland’s rich history at the magnificent Edinburgh Castle, then wander through the cobbled streets of the Old Town to visit the Scott Monument and the National Museum of Scotland. Watch live debates and MSPs questions at the Scottish Parliament Building or tour the Palace of Holyroodhouse, The King’s official residence in Edinburgh. Ocean Terminal shopping centre is a short walk away, while Princes Street and St James Quarter offer the best from high-street to luxury fashion and beauty. Multrees Walk is home to the iconic Harvey Nichols. For entertainment, catch a comedy or theatre show at the Edinburgh Playhouse, two miles away. Relax after a busy day in your room with a flat-screen TV and en-suite with shower. Enjoy a free buffet breakfast each morning before heading out for the day. Order light bites and coffees throughout the day and grab a pizza in the evening from our menu. Relax with drinks from the bar in our Great Room and catch up with free Wi-Fi.

16211.description: Located in the heart of Glasgow, Arthouse Hotel Glasgow offers upscale accommodations within a 15-minute walk of Buchanan Street and George Square. This hotel provides 76 guestrooms equipped with LCD televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Enjoy cooked-to-order breakfasts (fee applies), concierge services, and discounted access to a nearby fitness center. Additional amenities include a banquet hall, dry cleaning/laundry services, and on-site self-parking (for a fee). Nearby attractions include Sauchiehall Street, Willow Tearooms, and the Royal Conservatoire of Scotland. Glasgow International Airport (GLA) is 9. 4 miles from the hotel.

16212.description: Holiday Inn Express® Glasgow - City Ctr Theatreland is right in the heart of Glasgow, just across from Buchanan Bus Station. Glasgow Central and Queen Street train stations are a 10-minute walk away, and Glasgow Airport (GLA) is only 15 minutes by car. Catch sell-out performances at Glasgow Royal Concert Hall or enjoy comedy and drama at King's Theatre, Pavilion Theatre and Theatre Royal, all a short walk away. Watch live acts at the OVO Hydro arena, from concerts to musicals and grab a pre-show meal at the Clydebuilt bar and Kitchen. Shop your favourite brands at Buchanan Galleries shopping centre and Buchanan Street, both packed with a range of stores. Hop on a bus to Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum or the Riverside Museum for a bit of culture and explore the history of Glasgow. Explore the Gallery of Modern, a 10-minute walk from our hotel for engaging displays and exhibits. Discover Glasgow Cathedral, a 20-minute walk from our hotel, or cheer on Celtic FC at Celtic Park and take a behind-the-scenes tour of the stadium. Relax after a busy day in your room with a flat-screen TV and en-suite with shower. Enjoy a free buffet breakfast each morning before heading out for the day. In the evening, you can dine at La Bonne Auberge Brasserie and charge it to your room. Relax with drinks from the bar in our Great Room and catch up with free Wi-Fi.

16213.description: In a beautiful, tranquil location in the picturesque village of Drumnadrochit, beside one of the most famous and romantic stretches of water in the world, this traditional Scottish hotel dates back to around 1740. Set in acres of delightful woodland, the Loch Ness Lodge Hotel is just 14 miles (23 km) from the city of Inverness. With walks and cycle trails to nearby Urquhart castle, the hotel makes a great base from which to explore the highlands. The hotel is within the grounds of the Nessieland Castle Monster Centre. facilities include Cinema, Exhibition, Coffee Shop and Children's Activity Centre. Children's Activity Centre free to hotel guests. This original Highland lodge is now a privately owned 3-star hotel offering 50 well-appointed rooms, rich in original character and traditional charm. All of the en suite rooms have telephones, TVs and tea/coffee making facilities. Free wireless internet access is available in all public areas. With traditional real log fires, the Pibroch Bar and the hotel’s restaurant offer elegant and traditional cuisine, including carefully prepared Scottish produce, from hill venison and lamb to salmon and mussels from the West Coast.

16224.description: Hilton Cambridge City Centre is perfectly located for you to explore the best of Cambridge. The hotel is set in the heart of the city, just moments from the University of Cambridge colleges, and is the largest central hotel in Cambridge. The building is directly connected to the shops of the Grand Arcade, and is a short stroll from King’s College Chapel, punting tours of the River Cam, and the Fitzwilliam Museum. The hotel features 198 spacious and bright guest rooms, including queen, king, deluxe and two double bed rooms. Connecting rooms for families and suites are also available, as well as accessible rooms. Guests can also choose an executive room that includes access to the perks of the relaxing executive lounge. Pets are welcome, so feel free to bring your dog, who can even dine from the special Bone Appetit menu. An extensive breakfast buffet is served every morning with hot and cold breakfast items for every taste. Lunch and light bites are available all day in the Piano Bar with a broad wine selection, specialities coffees, and a delicious afternoon tea service. Guests can relax in the evening and reconnect with friends and family with signature cocktails and small plates at the Piano Bar or go for a hearty dinner at Bull & Bass Restaurant, featuring both British favourites and international flavours. Gluten free, vegetarian and vegan items are available. Host your next event in their self-contained, pillar-free conference space. The hotel has five flexible meeting rooms, each benefiting from HD equipment, controlled air conditioning, catering packages, and free Wi-Fi. Hilton Cambridge City Centre also features an on-site fitness centre. Guests who want to keep up with their fitness programme will enjoy the selection of cardio and strength training equipment in the gym. And those who enjoy taking their exercise outside, will enjoy the nearby riverside trails and gardens, perfect for a leisurely stroll or a run.

16229.description: This superb manor is located in Coulsdon, amidst 140 acres of landscaped parkland. London and Gatwick are just a 20 minutes' driving distance away, offering visitors the best of both worlds. This superb property was designed and built for the Byron family in the 1850s. Showcasing classical style and elegance, the property features stunningly-designed rooms, which are complemented with modern amenities. The surrounding golf course was developed in 1937, designed by the renowned H S Cold. Guests can enjoy an invigorating workout in the fitness centre, followed by relaxation in the steam room and sauna. A delectable dining experience awaits in the restaurant. The elegant terrace bar offers a peaceful setting in which to sit back and relax.

16231.description: Hylands Hotel offers a warm and comfortable base next to Coventry train station, 5 minutes' walk from the city centre. The comfortable lounge bar is open 24 hours a day and offers free wireless internet access. The Hylands Hotel has friendly, professional staff available 24 hours and is only 10 minutes' walk from the Central Bus Station. There are 4 well-appointed meeting rooms and a dedicated coordinator.

16233.description: On school or national holidays, this hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has kids amenities available on requestJust 17 minutes by train to London, Hilton London Croydon offers a great location to explore London city center attractions, as well as Croydon city center shopping, restaurants, nightlife, and family activities. The newly refurbished hotel with all new rooms, lobby, lounge, and bar, offers comfortable family rooms and kids dining options, wellness rooms, and suites for guests who are seeking an exceptionally relaxing experience, with plenty of space to catch up on your laptop in your room or in the lounge bar. Add on a private session in the Hilton Private Wellness Area to recuperate from your travels, feel your best and sleep well. With 15 meeting rooms for up to 300 guests and unique wellness meeting themes, a 24-hour Gym with weights and cardiovascular machines, and dining at The Larder Restaurant or in the Lounge Bar, serving dishes inspired by the best local comforts and tastes from around the world, guests are sure to enjoy their stay.

16234.description: This hotel is centrally located, just 100 metres from a public transport connection. Bars, restaurants and shopping venues lie within 500 metres of the hotel. And the nearest nightclub is located a mere 800 m from the hotel. The city hotel was built in 2001 and consists of 240 double rooms on 12 floors. Various facilities are available to guests including a foyer with a 24-hour reception, a safe and a currency exchange facility. In addition, Internet access, a small supermarket and shops are also available. Furthermore a conference room, a TV room and a laundry service are available to guests. There is also an à la carte restaurant. All of the comfortable rooms come with an en suite bathroom with hairdryer, a double bed and central heating. Guests may choose their breakfast from individual buffets. When dinner is included in the booking, vouchers will be provided which can be exchanged for meal in the restaurant.

16235.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Complimentary Evening Social, Fitness Center, Breakfast, Pool, Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently not available: On-site Restaurant(s), Spa. Welcome to DoubleTree by Hilton Dartford Bridge, a stylish hotel at the ‘Gateway to London. ' Located just 4 miles from the premier Bluewater Shopping Centre, we're also just off the M25 motorway, making exploring the Kent countryside a breeze. Travel to central London in 17 minutes from the Ebbsfleet International rail station, just 5 miles away. We'll greet you at check-in with a warm DoubleTree chocolate chip cookie. Settle into a spacious guest room with modern decor, an LCD TV, work desk and WiFi access. Deluxe rooms offer indulgent extras like a welcome plate, sparkling mineral water, bathrobes and slippers. Suites provide a separate living area, coffee machine, and a later check-out time. Enjoy international cuisine and views of the Dartford Bridge at QE2 Restaurant – perfect for celebrating special occasions or catching up on business. Our QE2 Bar has an extensive wine, beer and spirits list, and the QE2 Lounge is a great spot for specialty coffees, pastries and sandwiches. Exercise body and mind with a fully equipped fitness centre plus leisure facilities including a 15-meter swimming pool, spa bath, sauna and steam room. Planning an event? Guests have a choice of eight meeting and conference rooms, all well-equipped, air-conditioned and newly refurbished. The Swanley Suite is particularly impressive for larger events, boasting natural light and a private bar. Ask our friendly staff about event packages and catering options. Highlights:-Dartford hotel near the M25 with on-site parking-179 oversized and recently renovated guest rooms-QE2 Restaurant, bar, lounge and 24-hour room service-Fitness centre, large indoor pool and wellness facilities-Fresh and modern event venues for up to 250 guests

16239.description: Nestled in peaceful landscaped gardens, the 4-star Holiday Inn Dover is conveniently located just 10 minutes from the bustling Dover Ferry Port and the iconic White Cliffs. Guests enjoy free parking and a 24-hour fitness center. The elegant rooms feature ensuite bathrooms with power showers and complimentary Wi-Fi. Situated along the A2 between Dover and Canterbury, the hotel is a short drive from Dover Castle and just four miles from the Eastern Docks Ferry Terminal. Whether staying for a night or exploring the area, the hotel provides comfortable, affordable accommodations. Newly refurbished, the open lobby offers complimentary Wi-Fi and Starbucks coffee. The contemporary Junction bar serves a variety of beverages, and the all-day dining menu features international dishes. While breakfast is currently grab-and-go, room service for dinner and drinks is available daily.

16250.description:
The Holiday Inn® Hull Marina is in the heart of the city, with an unrivalled setting overlooking the marina. Just a short stroll from the city centre attractions and a short drive from the A63. 

At this hotel you can enjoy; free WiFi, 24-hour room service, secure on-site parking and a waterside location. Plus, kids stay and eat free. 

Welcoming guest rooms include flat-screen TVs, blackout curtains and pillow menus, and you can upgrade to a room with a Marina-View or a Premium Room with a balcony. Sofa beds are available for the kids. 

Enjoy breakfast or dinner in our Marina View Restaurant, which also features sustainable British ingredients. End your evening with a drink at the Marina View Bar & Lounge or out on the terrace. 

We are located less than 15 minutes' walk from Hull Paragon Interchange and a variety of attractions including Hull's Old Town, the Museums Quarter, Ferens Art Gallery, Hull Minster, Hull New Theatre and you can also find the Connexin Live Arena opposite the hotel. 

For a spot of light shopping, visit Princess Quay or St Stephen's Shopping Centre. 

If you're here with family, take on Hull Fish Trail, visit the Humber Bridge Country Park, or delight your kids with fascinating sea creatures at The Deep aquarium.

16254.description:
Crowne Plaza Leeds is a stylish, upscale hotel located in the heart of Leeds city centre, offering a premium experience for both business and leisure travelers. It stands out as the only hotel in Leeds City Centre with a swimming pool, and also features a fully equipped gym, relaxing sauna, and a range of modern amenities. 

Guests can unwind in chic, comfortable rooms outfitted with queen-size beds, flat-screen TVs, and the Sleep Advantage® program, which includes premium bedding and designated Quiet Zones for a restful night’s sleep. 

On-site, the TAP Restaurant serves a diverse menu of food and drinks, complemented by a relaxed bar area and outside terrace. 
For business needs, the hotel provides seven luxurious function rooms, a breakout space, terrace, and the support of a dedicated Meetings Director, making it an excellent venue for conferences and events. 

Crowne Plaza Leeds is also a stunning wedding venue, combining elegant spaces with impeccable service. 

Conveniently located just 15 minutes from the M1 and M62 motorways, the hotel is easily accessible. Leeds train station—with direct services to London—is nearby, and Leeds Bradford Airport (LBA) is within reach via a direct airport bus that stops just outside the hotel. 

Explore local attractions within walking distance, including Trinity Leeds shopping centre, the lively Northern Quarter, and Millennium Square. For leisure, catch a match at Headingley Carnegie Stadium or enjoy the greenery of Roundhay Park.

16255.description: The Britannia Leeds Bradford Airport Hotel (formerly Holiday Inn Leeds Bradford Airport) is a modern hotel situated just 2 miles from Leeds Bradford Airport, 8 miles from Leeds city centre and 10 miles from Bradford city centre. The hotel is set in 3 acres of landscaped grounds and offers views of the Yorkshire Dales. The rooms all have hairdryer, tea/coffee making facilities as well as all the facilities expected of a good 3-star property as standard. The hotel's leisure centre features a heated swimming pool, gym, sauna, solarium, hot tub and sun terrace. The hotel restaurant is contemporary and modern whilst the hotel lounge bar offers a bar menu. Extensive car parking is available for hotel guests.

16274.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. This hotel also features an arcade/game room and wedding services. Satisfy your appetite for dinner at Billabong Bistro, a restaurant which specializes in Fusion cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 90 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Jesmond Cricket Ground - 0. 6 km / 0.

16275.description: Overlooking the River Tyne, the Hilton Newcastle Gateshead hotel is 10 minutes' walk from the city center. Relax in the Executive Lounge or unwind in the gym or pool. Dine on local dishes in windows on the Tyne Restaurant or sip cocktails in Windows on the Tyne Bar. Work out or swim in the Hilton Newcastle Gateshead hotel's health club. Outside, walk across the stunning Millennium Bridge to numerous Newcastle attractions. Visit art galleries or Europe's biggest shopping and leisure center, go to horseracing or to a top football match. All Hilton Newcastle Gateshead hotel rooms offer high-speed internet access. Executive Room and Suite guests enjoy Executive Lounge access. Twenty minutes' drive from the airport and close to the business districts, the Hilton Newcastle Gateshead hotel has 10 meeting rooms for 2-80 and a function suite for 500, all with wireless internet access, a business center, and an Executive Lounge (over 18 years old).

16276.description: *Hotel completely non-smoking*Personally operated hotel in quiet suburban area, with a consistent reputation for good food, friendly and efficient service, in a warm and congenial atmosphere. Ideally situated for commercial area, shopping, rural and historic attractions. A welcoming and comfortable base for business and tourist clientele alike. Lower rates available at weekends. Enjoy your stay.

16296.description: Conveniently located near London Stansted Airport, this stylish 4-star hotel is just a six-minute shuttle ride from the main terminal building. Whether you're heading off on a new adventure or are new to the city, it's the perfect base camp to relax and plan during your stay in the capital. With spacious rooms and a dedicated business centre, as well as 24-hour access to our on-site fitness centre, you'll have a hard time thinking of an excuse to leave!

16297.description: A stylish Sutton hotel with a welcoming Open Lobby, serving food all through the day, with a relaxing indoor pool and sauna. Holiday Inn® London - Sutton hotel places you a short walk from Sutton train station and steps from town centre shops and restaurants. At nearby Sutton station, fast trains to London Victoria take half an hour. On-site parking is available at the hotel, and Gatwick (LGW) and Heathrow (LHR) airports are both under a 45-minute drive away. Business travellers are close to several corporate HQs, and a Business Centre with printing facilities is available. A short drive away, you can enjoy horse racing at Epsom Downs. Thirty minutes by car takes you to the rides and zoo at Chessington World of Adventures, Hampton Court’s maze and palace, or Centre Court tennis at Wimbledon. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free Wi-Fi throughout- 24-hour room service- On-site parking at a daily rateStylish guest rooms feature comfy beds and pillow menus to guarantee a good night’s sleep. Start your day with a full English breakfast buffet, and enjoy lunch and dinner in our Open Lobby. Relax over Starbucks coffee or drinks in the lobby lounge. At Spirit Health Club you can enjoy the pool and gym, or pamper yourself with a spa session.

name.content: Birmingham North Moor Hall Hotel, BW Premier

16298.description: A delightful country house hotel set in parkland yet within easy reach of Birmingham, the NEC, the motorway network and attractions such as Drayton Manor Park and Cadbury World. Ideal for business or pleasure, the Birmingham North Moor Hall Hotel, BW Premier Collection offers 83 comfortable and well equipped ensuite bedrooms, including four posters, a choice of two restaurants, seven conference rooms and extensive leisure facilities including an indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, steam room, aerobics room and spa with three treatment rooms. There's ample free parking and conference and banqueting for up to 250. To complete the picture, our team of friendly and professional staff is always on hand to offer our unique brand of traditional personal service. Enjoy your stay. Main restaurant The Oak Room is closed on Sunday and Bank Holidays. Dinner rates include a 3-course Carvery instead.

16299.description: Nestled just two miles from the M4, Holiday Inn® Swindon provides an ideal blend of convenience and comfort, perfect for both leisure and business travellers. Located around an hour from both Heathrow and Bristol airports, the hotel offers seamless connections, while Swindon train station, less than four miles away, links you to the heart of London and Bristol in under an hour. Surrounded by historic landmarks, the hotel serves as a gateway to some of England’s most iconic attractions. Discover the ancient wonders of Stonehenge, just an hour’s drive away, or explore the nearby Avebury stone circle, only 12 miles from the hotel. Business travellers will appreciate the hotel’s six versatile meeting rooms, thoughtfully designed to accommodate events of any size. Guests can enjoy modern amenities, including 24-hour room service, complimentary Wi-Fi, and free parking. Families are welcomed with open arms as kids stay and eat free. For relaxation, indulge in a meal at the hotel’s restaurant, sip a Starbucks coffee in the open lobby, or catch live sports on BT Sport while enjoying the garden terrace. The You Fit Health Club, featuring a pool, gym, and sauna, offers the perfect way to unwind after a day of exploring or meetings, leaving you refreshed and revitalised.

16303.description: Holiday Inn Washington is a friendly, welcoming hotel close to Newcastle City Centre with free Wi-Fi and Carparking on-site. We are Just off the A1 motorway and only a 20-minute drive to Newcastle International Airport (NCL). We're just a 20-minute drive away from Newcastle, Durham and Sunderland Universities. History aficionados can explore a replica Edwardian village at the Beamish Open Air Museum, and sports fans can check out Sunderland's Stadium of Light. Our hotel is the perfect stopover en route to the Northumberland coast, and you can take the family to the interactive Centre for Life museum before heading off. We have three large conference suites and all are ideal for social banquets and corporate seminars, or you can chat with clients in one of our six smaller meeting rooms. At this hotel, you can enjoy 24-hour room service and Kids Stay and Eat Free. The light-filled Traders Restaurant serves breakfast and dinner, as well as hosting a weekly Indian feast. You can unwind with a freshly brewed coffee or a pint of lager in the bar area then retreat to a comfy guest room, where a pillow menu and blackout shades help ensure a good night's rest.

16308.description: Indulge in a relaxing experience at the full-service spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. For recreation, you'll find an indoor pool, sauna, and fitness center. This Victorian hotel also provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy a meal at one of the hotel's two restaurants or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at one of the two bars/lounges. English breakfasts are available on weekdays for a fee. The hotel also offers complimentary wired internet access, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. For events, four meeting rooms are available. Free self-parking is available onsite. Each of the 119 individually decorated guestrooms features a refrigerator, plasma television, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. The private bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. The hotel is conveniently located near Blairs Museum (1. 9 km), Duthie Park Winter Gardens (5. 7 km), and RGU: SPORT (5. 8 km). Aberdeen Airport (ABZ) is 18 km away.

16309.description: This hotel is situated in Ballater. The nearest public transport is located 200 m away and there are ski slopes situated 91 km away. This hotel was built in 2004 and consists of 6 rooms spread over 2 floors. The hotel's facilities include a car park and a garage. Dining options include the hotel's own restaurant. In addition, Internet access, room service and laundry services are all available. The en suite rooms are functionally furnished and equipped with a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, Internet access and central heating.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express - Edinburgh City Centre

16310.description:
A modern Edinburgh hotel in a Georgian building within walking distance of the city's top attractionsHoliday Inn Express® - Edinburgh City Centre hotel is a 10-minute walk from Edinburgh Waverley station in the city's New Town. It's a short stroll to the York Place tram stop, which has a direct connection to Edinburgh Airport (EDI). The Edinburgh Playhouse theatre and OMNI Edinburgh's restaurants and cinemas are right across the road. Princes Street and George Street's shops are a few minutes' walk away. You can ramble over the ramparts of Edinburgh Castle, 20 minutes' walk from the hotel. Or experience more royal flavour, less than a mile from the hotel, at the Palace of Holyroodhouse, the Queen's official Scottish residence. Amble through the expansive Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh, half an hour on foot from the hotel, or wander into Princes Street Gardens to spot the huge floral clock. Business guests are on the doorstep of the financial district around St. Andrew Square and George Street, while the Edinburgh International Conference Centre is less than 10 minutes' drive away. The hotel has a smart meeting rooms. Enjoy free Wi-Fi and an inclusive hot Express Start Breakfast. A nearby Fitness Centre is available to guests. Unwind after a busy day's sightseeing over a cool beer in the lounge bar. 

Please note, if parking in the nearby Q-Park Omni, the hotel does have a discount code we can provide to give our guests a 30% reduction. Please contact the hotel front desk to get this code prior to parking in the Q-Park Omni

16312.description:
Nestled in the charming village of Dinnet near Ballater, in the heart of Royal Deeside, the Loch Kinord Hotel offers a tranquil escape just 35 miles from Aberdeen. Owners Andrew and Jenny Cox welcome you to this award-winning, family-run hotel, renowned for its cozy character and exceptional value. The 19 en-suite bedrooms, many recently refurbished, feature amenities such as color TV, telephone, and WiFi. Guests can choose from standard rooms, four-poster rooms, and family suites. Relax by the warm open fires in the cozy hotel bars and lounges, and savor outstanding malt whiskies. The elegant restaurant showcases the best of local Scottish produce, from fresh game and fish to seasonal vegetables. The hotel's location provides easy access to a wealth of activities, including golfing, gliding, fishing, and field sports. Explore nearby Balmoral Castle, Royal Lochnagar Distillery, and the city of Aberdeen, just 45 minutes away. Enjoy scenic walks and bike rides, skiing at the Lecht, and the vibrant Highland Games during the summer months. 

Please note, the restaurant has limited or no availability on some dates. Please email the hotel direct at info@lochkinord. com to check availability and make a reservation for the restaurant.

16314.description: Built in 1887 on the site of Pitfodels Castle, this Victorian mansion house is now a family-owned hotel nestled on seven acres of wooded grounds, yet only three miles from the center of Aberdeen. The hotel's bedrooms are of a high standard, offering a range of styles based on the original layout of the house. The public areas are exceptional, featuring stained-glass windows and an ornate wooden staircase. The bar retains its original fireplace and gilded fixtures, while the restaurant boasts high ceilings adorned with antique paintings and furniture. All these elements combine to create a romantic setting where you can relax and enjoy life's pleasures.

16315.description: Pittodrie House is a wonderful country house hotel with bar and restaurant situated approximately 30 minutes' drive from Aberdeen. Each of the 27 bedrooms come as standard with en suite facilities with both shower and bath, satellite television, radio, direct dial telephone, wireless broadband access, trouse press, iron and board, tea/coffee making facilities, hospitality tray, hairdryer, dressing gown and slippers. The hotel provides a variety of leisure pursuits, including clay pigeon shooting, table tennis, billiards, petanque and croquet. Fishing, stalking and shooting can be arranged in the locality.

16317.description: Set in acres of private garden and lush meadowland, Thainstone House has been lovingly designed to provide superb levels of hospitality. In the very heart of rural Aberdeenshire, you find yourself in an oasis of tranquillity, in a majestic Palladian Mansion where you can relax in luxury as our friendly staff make you feel immediately at home. Whilst today Thainstone provides the ultimate in four star luxury, it is impossible to escape its impressive history. In the 18th Century, the Jacobites put Thainstone to torch, however James Wilson of Thainstone escaped the fire and fled to America, where he later put his name to the American Declaration of Independence. Under new ownership in the 19th Century, the present mansion was redesigned by renowned architect Archibald Simpson, who was responsible for shaping much of the present day city of Aberdeen. Now considered a great property, Thainstone enjoys elegant furnishings and décor, perfectly complementing the excellent facilities you would expect to find in such a hotel. With many original features and exceptional standards of service Thainstone House is renowned for offering 'luxury in the heart of rural Aberdeenshire'. From Aberdeen follow the A96 signposted Inverness. Turn left at the signpost for Thainstone and turn immediately right.

16333.description: The New Lanark Mill Hotel, nestled within a UNESCO World Heritage Site, offers spacious rooms with en-suite bathrooms. This 18th-century village, once a model industrial center, now boasts converted mill buildings, shops, museums, and the hotel itself. Enjoy stunning river views from the rooms or rooftop garden. Savor traditional Scottish cuisine in the restaurant overlooking the River Clyde, or unwind in the 52-foot pool, modern gym, sauna, and steam room. Conveniently located an hour's drive from Glasgow or Edinburgh, and just 1. 4 miles from Lanark Railway Station.

16335.address: On the A834 Dingwall To Contin/Garve Road
16335.description: The Ben Wyvis Hotel, nestled in the tranquil Ross-shire highlands, overlooks Strathpeffer, echoing the grandeur of its namesake mountain. Its architecture blends seamlessly with the village, while the serene gardens offer a peaceful retreat. Guests can enjoy a 32-seat private cinema showcasing the latest films. The stunning grounds feature a 9-hole pitch and putt with complimentary equipment. Free Wi-Fi is available in all public areas. The Ben Wyvis is an ideal base for exploring the Scottish Highlands, with day trips to Ullapool, the Isle of Skye, Inverness, Loch Ness, the Black Isle, and Dornoch. Thrilling quad biking and mountain biking trails are also available locally.

16351.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Park Hotel in Falkirk, conveniently located within a 5-minute drive of Falkirk Town Hall and Falkirk Golf Club. We offer 73 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable programming. Each room also includes a desk, coffee/tea maker, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combination and hairdryer.
