Hotel amenities include a restaurant with room service (limited hours), a bar/lounge, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and free self-parking. Nearby attractions include Callendar House (1. 4 mi), the Falkirk Wheel (2 mi), and The Kelpies (2. 6 mi). Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is 20 miles away, and Glasgow International Airport (GLA) is 32 miles away.

16416.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where massages, body treatments, and facials await. For recreation, the hotel offers a health club, indoor pool, and spa tub. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). An area shuttle is available (surcharge). The hotel's Plumpy Duck Restaurant serves lunch, dinner, and brunch. Room service is also available during limited hours. Mingle with other guests at the daily complimentary reception, or unwind at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services and luggage storage. The hotel also offers four meeting rooms and free self-parking. Each of the 22 guestrooms features a flat-screen television, premium bedding, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include Castle Semple Country Park (2. 2 mi), Kenmure Hill Temple (2. 3 mi), and Muirshiel Visitor Centre & Country Park (4. 3 mi).

16417.description: Enjoying a fabulous situation amidst beautiful and peaceful setting overlooking the charming Loch Lomond and stunning natural beauty of the Lomond National Park, the hotel is an optimal choice for all those wishing to escape from city hustle and bustle. The property lies within 32 kilometres from Glasgow and only 2 kilometres from Balloch. Housed in an impressive building dating back to 17th century, the establishment affords visitors high quality accommodation and top notch services. The rooms and suites welcome visitors in spacious and opulent surroundings fitted with comfy furniture and plush bed linens in warm and soothing hues to exude a peaceful yet elegant atmosphere. The on-site dining options will provide for a flavourful culinary experience accompanied by warm hospitality. The leisure facilities include a well-equipped spa and extensive golf courses. Corporate travellers may avail for versatile meeting rooms.

16418.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include a fireplace in the lobby and a banquet hall. Grab a bite to eat at Windows Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Make yourself at home in one of the 64 guestrooms featuring free minibar items and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, as well as phones with free local calls.

16419.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Grab a bite to eat at Beneroti, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Full breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Planning an event in Glasgow? This hotel has 538 square feet (50 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 2 meeting rooms. Stay in one of 91 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided on request.

16420.description: Holiday Inn Express® Glasgow Airport is just off the M8 and a 3-minute walk from the terminal via a covered walkway. Catch the airport express bus into Glasgow city centre or board a direct train to Glasgow from Paisley Gilmour Street station, two miles away. Need some last-minute holiday shopping? Head to Braehead Shopping Centre to find a wide range of shops and enjoy meals at various restaurants or take the kids bowling and trampolining at XSite Braehead. Watch the best acts in entertainment at The OVO Hydro or explore the exhibits and planetarium at Glasgow Science Centre, both a 15-minute drive away. Cheer on your favourite team at Celtic Park, Ibrox Stadium or Hampden Park, all 20 minutes away. Visit one of Glasgow's many museums for free. Explore Kelvingrove Art Gallery for artwork by Charles Rennie Mackintosh, Ancient Egypt and Salvador Dali, a 20-minute drive away. Discover the Riverside Museum for innovative displays from Glasgow's transport heritage and take a walk around exhibits and installations at the Gallery of Modern Art, a 15-minute drive away. Relax after a busy day in your room with a flat-screen TV and en-suite with shower. Enjoy a free buffet breakfast each morning before heading out for the day. Order light bites and coffees throughout the day and grab a bite to eat in the evening from our snack menu. Relax with drinks from the bar in our Great Room and catch up with free Wi-Fi.

16421.description: Holiday Inn Glasgow City Centre Theatreland, an IHG Hotel is in the heart of Glasgow, within a 5-minute walk of Theatre Royal and Glasgow Royal Concert Hall. This upscale hotel is 0. 5 mi (0. 8 km) from Buchanan Galleries and 1 mi (1. 6 km) from George Square. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and a television in a common area. This hotel also features discounted use of a nearby fitness facility and a vending machine. Stay in one of 113 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and coffee/tea makers. Enjoy local and international cuisine at La Bonne Auberge, a bistro which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. This hotel has 4 meeting rooms available for events. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Sauchiehall Street - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Pavilion Theatre - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Buchanan Street - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Glasgow Caledonian University - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Theatre Royal - 0. 2 km / 0.

16424.description: Located in central Glasgow, the family-run Sandyford Lodge- offers free Wi-Fi throughout and a 24-hour front desk. On Glasgow’s famous Sauchiehall Street, it is just 10 minutes’ walk from the Exhibition Center Railway Station. The spacious rooms include a flat-screen digital TV, a direct-dial telephone, and tea and coffee making facilities. Each modern room benefits from an en-suite bath or shower room with a hairdryer. In the mornings, Sandyford Lodge- serves a famous cooked Scottish breakfast. Continental options are also available. Glasgow’s main shopping district is just 1 mile away and offers a wide range of restaurants. Glasgow offers a lively nightlife, with many pubs and bars within a 10-minute walk of the Sandyford Lodge-. Glasgow Science Center is 1 mile away and George Street is 30 minutes’ stroll from the property. The HYDRO is a 10-minute walk away and Glasgow International Airport is within 7 miles.

name.content: Glasgow Westerwood Hotel, Spa & Golf Resort

16425.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Breakfast, Golf, On-site Restaurant(s), Pool, Spa. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Fitness Center. Welcome to DoubleTree by Hilton Glasgow Westerwood Spa and Golf Resort. Our contemporary property is set within acres of wooded countryside overlooked by the beautiful Campsie Hills, yet offers quick and easy motorway access to Glasgow, Stirling and Edinburgh. With luxurious leisure facilities, first-class dining, flexible conference spaces and an 18-hole golf course designed by Seve Ballesteros, we're the perfect venue for weddings, corporate events, and weekend retreats. Unwind in one of our spacious guest rooms and enjoy complimentary high-speed WiFi and a 49-inch HDTV. Upgrade to a suite for a larger TV, separate lounge area and views across the golf course. Our hotel offers an award-winning spa with 10 treatment rooms, an indoor heated pool and extensive gym facilities, so you can relax and recharge throughout your stay. Enjoy award-winning food and service in our a la carte restaurant, Flemings. We offer local Scottish produce and classic dining in a semi-formal but relaxed environment. The Grill Restaurant and Bar is open from noon until 10pm and serves classic British pub favorites, while Flemings Lounge is open from 10. 30am for a range of beverages and cocktails throughout the day. Host a meeting or conference in our contemporary hotel. We offer 10 fully flexible meeting rooms catering for over 675 delegates, and all A/V needs can be catered for. Our stunning natural surroundings make us the perfect backdrop for bespoke weddings and events.

name.content: Leonardo Hotel and Conference Venue Aberdeen

16603.description: A well designed modern 147-bedroom hotel within walking distance of the airport, yet barely 15 minutes drive from the city centre, Leonardo Hotel and Conference Venue Aberdeen Airport has everything the discerning traveller could wish for. With traditional Scottish hospitality, luxurious accommodation and a first class restaurant, the hotel is the ideal location for a stay in Aberdeen. The hotel also has a Just Gym workout room, car parking and offers an airport courtesy shuttle bus.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Aberdeen City Centre

16604.description:
Located in Aberdeen’s vibrant West End, Holiday Inn Express® Aberdeen City Centre offers a bright, modern stay with complimentary WIFI and an inclusive breakfast. 

Just a 10-minute walk from Aberdeen Rail and Bus stations and around 20 minutes by taxi from Aberdeen Airport (ABZ), the hotel is perfectly placed for exploring the city. Union Street, Aberdeen’s main shopping and entertainment destination, is just around the corner, with a lively selection of bars, restaurants and theatres. 

The hotel features two modern meeting rooms, each offering free WIFI and plenty of natural daylight, making them ideal for business events and meetings. 


Beyond the city centre, guests can discover Aberdeenshire’s famous Castle Trail and whisky distilleries, while golf enthusiasts can enjoy Royal Aberdeen Golf Club, just three miles away. Trump International Scotland is also within a convenient 30-minute drive. 

After a day of exploring Aberdeen or the surrounding area, guests can relax in the hotel’s welcoming lobby bar, which serves an excellent selection of malt whiskies, draught beers and wines—perfect for unwinding at the end of the day.

16615.description: This hotel is centrally located within a resort. It has 64 newly refurbished bedrooms, which were completed in April 2015. Next to the impressive conference centre, perfect for business travellers, this hotel is perfect for business or leisure. A taste of beautiful Mediterranean food and drinks is available at the onsite Italian restaurant, as well as drinks being available from the onsite hotel bar, both perfect locations to relax with family, friends and colleagues. Resort facilities are very accessible, with a Leisure Centre, Championship Golf Course, shopping centre and cinema all within a 2-minute walk from the hotel. Please note that children age 10 and under eat for free on same meal plan as adults (from the children's dinner menu). Children age 11 and over pay for meals as taken regardless of the rate type booked, and can choose from the adults menu, children's menu or half portions (where possible), giving you total freedom.

16616.description: Located in the heart of Cairngorms National Park in the Scottish Highlands, this stylish hotel is part of the Macdonald Aviemore Resort, offering relaxing and comfortable accommodations. Centrally located near the railway station and only 35 minutes from Inverness Airport, the resort boasts spectacular views of the Cairngorm Mountains, making it ideal for couples, families, and business travelers. Guest rooms feature traditional Scottish decor and amenities for a perfect stay. Guests enjoy direct access to resort facilities, including luxury shopping, a 3D cinema, top-class restaurants, a state-of-the-art activity center, and an impressive golf course. Children's activities and a large swimming pool with a giant flume, sauna, and steam room are also available. Children 10 and under eat free (from the children's dinner menu) when dining on the same meal plan as adults. Children 11 and over pay for meals as taken, choosing from the adult's menu, children's menu, or half portions (where possible).

16638.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at the Craigellachie Hotel of Speyside, such as complimentary Wi-Fi, wedding services, and a cozy fireplace in the lobby. Dine at the Spey Inn restaurant or enjoy room service during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at one of the two bars/lounges. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk and a library. Free self-parking is available onsite. The hotel's 26 guestrooms offer espresso makers and flat-screen televisions, along with complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with designer toiletries and hair dryers, desks, coffee/tea makers, and phones with free local calls. Located in a rural setting in Aberlour, the Craigellachie Hotel of Speyside is within a 5-minute drive of Speyside Cooperage and Sandy Hole. It's also a short drive from the Macallan Distillery and within easy reach of Cairngorms National Park.

16642.description: A total of 80 guest rooms are available for guests' convenience at Travel Inn Glasgow North East .

16645.description: Featuring a garden, restaurant, bar and free WiFi, Eagle Hotel is located in Dornoch, a 2-minute walk from Carnegie Club Skibo Castle and 0. 4 miles from Royal Dornoch Golf Club. Built in 19th century, the property is within 12 miles of Dunrobin Castle. The hotel has family rooms. At the hotel, rooms come with a desk, a flat-screen TV, a private bathroom, bed linen and towels. The rooms will provide guests with a closet and an electric tea pot. A Full English/Irish breakfast is available each morning at Eagle Hotel. Inverness Airport is 49 miles from the property.

16649.description: A stylish hotel close to Glasgow, with free Wi-Fi and a pool, hot tub and spa, plus meeting facilitiesHoliday Inn® Glasgow - East Kilbride hotel is conveniently located 15 miles from Glasgow Airport and 15 miles from central Glasgow. If you're driving, you can access the hotel in seven minutes from the M77 or in 15 minutes from the M74. Catch a train to Glasgow Central in 30 minutes from Hairmyres station, less than two miles from the hotel, or East Kilbride station, six minutes' drive away. Holiday makers are only five minutes' drive from Playsport, with its golf course, skate park and trampolining arena. Wander East Kilbride's old village, less than four miles away, or visit the National Museum of Rural Life, less than a mile away. Shoppers are just 10 minutes' drive from East Kilbride Shopping Centre. The hotel's nine well-appointed meeting rooms and function suites accommodate up to 250 delegates. A dedicated host will ensure your event runs smoothly, providing catering, equipment and support. Enjoy a meal at the cosy hotel restaurant, where kids stay and eat free. All guests enjoy free WiFi and access to the hotel's extensive health club, with its gym, pool and group fitness classes. Unwind in the spa and sauna, or pamper yourself with massage and beauty treatments.

name.content: Craigmonie Hotel Inverness by Compass Hospitality

16652.description: Nestled in a tranquil residential area just minutes from Inverness city center, this charming hotel offers the perfect blend of convenience and relaxation. Inverness train station, along with a variety of bars, restaurants, and the Inverness Museum and Art Gallery are all within a 15-minute walk. Free Wi-Fi and parking are available. Dating back to 1880, this property retains the elegance of a country house, providing a comfortable and relaxed atmosphere for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel offers 40 well-appointed en-suite bedrooms, ranging from single rooms to superior doubles and luxurious four-poster accommodations. All rooms are equipped with modern amenities. The hotel's signature restaurant offers casual dining featuring a seasonal menu and an extensive wine list. Guests can also indulge in a range of luxury spa treatments, including massage, tanning, nail services, and facials. Access to the hotel's pool, sauna, and mini-gym is complimentary for all guests.

16653.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a health club, a spa tub, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a picnic area. Enjoy British cuisine at Coast Restaurant and Bar, a restaurant where you can take in the garden view and dine alfresco. Or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. A complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. This hotel has 3 meeting rooms available for events. Stay in one of 42 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected.

16727.description: The Macdonald Houstoun House is actually three houses in one: the towerhouse complemented by an elegant country manor and charming steading. This characterful combination ensures that most rooms boast wonderful views across the hotel's gardens or beyond to the Ecclesmachan Hills. Built in the early 17th century by John Shairp, the old tower of Houstoun remained the Shairp family home for 350 years. Vaulted ceilings and open fires combine with traditional Scottish hospitality to create an atmosphere that is warm and welcoming but is still distinctly refined and discreet. All 71 guest rooms are tastefully furnished and well equipped, coming as standard with full en suite facilities, satellite television, direct dial telephone, modem point, hairdryer, iron and board, trouser press, complimentary mineral water, working area with desk and a shoe shine service. An extensive wine list, together with skilful presentation of dishes and fresh local produce, have made Houstoun one of the most outstanding restaurants in Scotland's central belt. The award winning fine dining restaurant is situated on the first floor in the historic 16th century tower. Alternatively, the Leisure Club Bistro offers more informal fare and surroundings. Leisure facilities at the Vital Leisure Club include an 18 metre swimming pool, sauna, sun shower, steam room, gymnasium, aerobics studio, beauty salon, tennis court, and golf course. These facilities are free for guest usage. tennis court, and golf course. Please note that the hotel doesn't accept any cash payments

16730.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace and garden at The Glasshouse, Autograph Collection hotel in Edinburgh. This hotel offers complimentary wired and wireless internet access, concierge and wedding services, and a television in the common area. Savor British cuisine at The Snug Lounge restaurant with garden views, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are available daily (for a fee). The hotel also features limo/town car service and express check-in. For events, there's 3, 714 square feet of space including a conference center and five meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). The 77 air-conditioned rooms include iPod docking stations, LCD televisions, and cable programming. Private bathrooms offer separate bathtubs and showers, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Nearby attractions include the Edinburgh Playhouse Theatre, Calton Hill, and St. James Quarter. Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is the preferred airport.

16734.description: This cosy boutique hotel is located in Edinburgh's fashionable West End, within easy walking distance of shopping at Princes Street, the Scottish National Gallery, and Haymarket Station. Sightseers might also visit the National Museum of Scotland and the historic Edinburgh Castle, both only two kilometres away. Guests will delight in the unique designs of the plush guest rooms as well as useful amenities such as free Wi-Fi and flat-screen cable televisions. The hotel serves a fresh, cooked-to-order Scottish breakfast prepared with local, organic produce and with traditional options such as haggis and black pudding, and the sumptuous library offers an inviting place for guests to enjoy a coffee or tea over a daily newspaper by the fire. Business travellers can also make use of the modern business centre and events room. This hotel's stylish design and great services make it no ordinary bed and breakfast.

16738.description: This vibrant international hostel is ideally located in the heart of Edinburgh's Old Town, with the historic Royal Mile at its doorstep. It's an excellent base for exploring Scotland's capital city. The hostel offers bright, clean, and comfortable accommodations ranging from 6- to 15-bed dormitories with superb city views to private double and twin rooms in a self-catering apartment with a fully equipped kitchen and bathroom. All dormitories include hot showers and free linen. Guests can enjoy the Southern Cross Café, the hostel's world-style bistro, with special discounts for residents. Additional amenities include 24-hour reception, secure storage for valuables and luggage, a booking service, a communal self-catering kitchen, email and internet access, cable TV, a pool table, and darts. Secure car parking is available a 5-minute walk away.

16741.description: This 3 star hotel is located within the city of Edinburgh. The nearest station is Haymarket.

16742.description: This luxurious 5-star retreat has a fine-dining restaurant and romantic bedrooms about 3 km from the Royal Mile. Prestonfield is surrounded by gardens and a golf course. Buses to the city centre are a 5-minute walk away. Parking is free. Each stylish room at Prestonfield House has antique furnishings, free Wi-Fi, Smart TV, a stocked minibar and views of the gardens and parkland. Rhubarb Restaurant serves excellent Scottish cuisine and traditional afternoon teas. The terraces, drawing room and gardens are relaxed, beautiful places to unwind.

16744.description: ‘Black Ivy' is situated on the south side of Edinburgh in Bruntsfield which has a relaxed village feel and a unique mix of original boutique shops, artisan bakers and chocolatiers as well as great cafes, bars and restaurants and all within walking distance of the city centre. Enter the hotel bar and you would be forgiven for thinking you had stepped into another world with Black Ivy's design ethos rich in thought and attention to detail, resulting in a bar appearance which is a treat for the eyes and simply makes you think 'wow”. Housed in 3 adjoining historic and beautiful town houses the hotel is contemporary and modern, inside and out. The welcome is warm and uniquely Scottish where you immediately feel part of the family and realise you have just discovered your new home from home. Above this coolest of bars with its live music, tank beer, table tennis games room and extensive and original cocktail list sits our boutique 22 bedroom Hotel offering divine luxurious beds, high speed WIFI, working desk and complimentary White Company Noir toiletries. The restaurant is open from 7am for the service of breakfast through to the early hours and is popular with locals and visitors alike. Our all-day menu has been created to suit all palates and cater for any dietary requirements. The South Side, as well as being a mecca for culture lovers and architecture buffs, is dominated by the vast green space of The Meadows which sits in front of Black Ivy's garden space which houses two warming and dramatic fire pits, bespoke seating and a tropical vibe whether your sipping a cooling summer cocktail or toasting marshmallow in the winter by the fire.

name.content: Garner Hotel Eight Acres Elgin by IHG

16745.description: At Garner Eight Acres Elgin, we believe travel should feel easy and uplifting. Formerly Eight Acres Hotel, our reimagined property joins the IHG Garner family - bringing you trusted standards, thoughtful amenities, and a friendly team who knows the local area inside out. We’re perfectly placed on the edge of Scotland’s stunning Speyside region - minutes from Elgin Cathedral, renowned distilleries, and scenic coastal paths. From the moment you arrive, expect a warm Scottish welcome and service that goes the extra mile without overcomplicating your stay.

16747.address: The Erskine Bridge Hotel & Spa, Riverfront, N/A
16747.description: Set within 18 acres of stunning parkland overlooking the River Clyde, this charming hotel offers a perfect retreat for leisure and business travelers. It provides easy access to both the airport (8 km) and Glasgow city center (a 30-minute drive). The hotel features comfortable, stylish rooms with modern amenities. Some boast incredible views of the Kilpatrick Hills, the River Clyde, and the Erskine Bridge. Enjoy delicious Scottish cuisine and refreshing drinks in the riverside restaurant.

16761.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an indoor pool and a sauna. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and a 24-hour front desk. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 145 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers.

name.content: Glasgow Argyle Hotel, BW Signature Collection

16762.description:
Be it sightseeing, shopping, sport or business, there are many reasons to check into Glasgow Argyle. Built on a former rice mill, tastefully blends old and new and stands out on the Glasgow skyline close to the River Clyde. Within a mile of the city center, you can walk to many of Glasgows attractions: George Square, Merchant City and Buchanan Galleries shopping center. Well-placed for the citys amazing nightlife, whether going for a wee dram in a trendy whisky bar, attending a gig at The SSE Hydro or laughing at The Stand Comedy Club. 
Glasgow is famous for its warm hospitality, and youll always get a friendly welcome at Glasgow Argyle, no matter what time of day you arrive. With super-comfy beds to sink into in our 141 bedrooms, all with free Wi-Fi, large flat-screen plasma TVs and 24-hour room service. Our 12 stunning apartments occupy the old mill and feature exposed brickwork, original ornate iron columns and abstract artworks. Some are spread over two storys with beds on a mezzanine level, making them an attractive option for families and business travelers. Were one of the few hotels in the city center to have a swimming pool and gym, so theres even more reason to stay with us if youre into keeping fit. Whilst we don’t have onsite parking, we do have a guest parking partnership with 2 car parks: Your Parking Space - 12 Washington St, G3 8AZ. Closer to the hotel, at The Old School Building. Limited and operates strictly on a first come, first serve basis. Guest tariffs only available through the kiosk at hotel reception area: Up to 9 hours - £8. 00. Up to 24 hours - £12. 00 (Will then go up in 24-hour increments)
Q-Park - 99 Waterloo St, G2 6HS offers 40% discounted parking rate for Glasgow Argyle Hotel customers pre-booked. Please click on the following link: https://www. q-park. co. uk/en-gb/cities/glasgow/waterloo-street/ Using discount code please enter ARGYLE40. Pre-booked parking must be completed before arrival; the discount cannot be applied locally.

16770.description: Mussselburgh is a quiet fishing village. Edinburgh is one of the most exciting cities in the UK. So put yourself in pole position for both destinations, at Premier Inn Hotel Edinburgh A1 (Musselburgh). Whether you're here on business or pleasure, you'll have a great stay. Musselburgh is known as 'The Honest Toun', and we can honestly say you'll have a fantastic time here. Laugh your socks off at the Edinburgh Festival, or bet your shirt at the Musselburgh races. Don plus fours and have a round of golf at Royal Musselburgh, or visit Rosslyn Chapel, one of the most remarkable buildings in Scotland. Then come back to a hearty meal at our Brewers Fayre - no need to dress for dinner - and a lovely comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

16771.description: At Strathness House, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. The front desk is staffed during limited hours. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 12 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms with showers are provided. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Inverness Cathedral - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Eden Court Theatre - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Inverness Visit Scotland Information Centre - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Inverness Museum and Art Gallery - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- University of the Highlands & Islands - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Victorian Market - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Eastgate Shopping Centre - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Bellfield Park - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Inverness Castle - 0. 8 km / 0.

16772.description: Set in 9 acres of mature parkland, with stunning views of the Moray Firth, this fantastic, upscale hotel is ideally located right in the heart of the Highlands. The establishment is only a 10-minute drive from the centre of Inverness and offers free parking for those travelling by car. Boasting a beautiful art deco charm, the hotel is an ideal place for leisure and business travellers alike. The tastefully appointed rooms offer luxurious furnishings in combination with modern facilities to provide a truly unique stay. Facilities include large comfortable beds, complimentary Wi-Fi access and a satellite TV for guests' entertainment. The award-winning restaurant has been recognized for its quality food and exceptional service and offers exquisite modern Scottish cuisine, while the lounge area is a perfect place to relax and enjoy a delicious cup of coffee and a fine lunch menu. This superb hotel is also a perfect place to celebrate corporate events with its flexible meeting spaces, high specification facilities and plenty of space for team-building activities.

16779.description: Located just two miles from Inverness, this striking Georgian building is nestled on six acres of beautiful landscape. Enjoy free Wi-Fi, a comfortable lounge, drawing room, and a terrace overlooking the gardens. A haven of tranquility and elegant comfort, the hotel boasts a 2 AA Rosette award-winning restaurant serving excellent food. The splendid interior retains its historical features while offering modern luxury amenities. Ideally located for touring Loch Ness, the Moray Firth, or the Northern Highlands, the hotel offers a variety of accommodations, from classic double/twin rooms and executive suites to family rooms situated in charming cottages on the grounds. Each room features warm décor, comfortable beds, and luxurious bathrooms, providing the quintessential country house experience. The beautifully appointed dining room, with its elegant terrace perfect for alfresco dining in warmer months, offers a unique fine dining experience. The chefs use fresh, locally sourced seasonal ingredients, including produce from the hotel's garden, to create delicious dishes with innovative twists on traditional favorites. Enjoy morning coffee, afternoon tea, or pre-dinner drinks in the main Drawing Room. Alternatively, relax in the Red Lounge, a warm and inviting space with burgundy walls, subtle art, and comfortable furnishings, perfect for a game of chess, a good book, or catching up with friends by the roaring fire in winter.

16781.description: The hotel is idyllically nestled within a mirage of tropical greenery. The architectural design of the hotel is similar to the movements of the ocean, with brilliant curves and a magnificent backdrop, this hotel is sure to please the eye of any potential guest. The layout of the rooms cater to the captivating sea front with cool greens and warm orange tones depicting the landscape surrounding the hotel. A conference room ensures that business travellers can keep up to date with their business needs, whilst the indoor swimming pool, sun-loungers and sauna cater to guests wishing to relax and unwind. Guests with a sporting streak may enjoy a game of table tennis or golf. The hotel buffet offers international and traditional cuisine sure to tantalise the taste buds of each individual guest.

16793.description: With 248 spacious rooms, the hotel caters to couples, families, and solo travellers. Each room features large beds, flat-screen TVs, free Wi-Fi, and en-suite bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Families can enjoy rooms that accommodate up to two adults and two children under twelve, while executive rooms offer extra luxury with super-king beds and an in-room coffee machine. The hotel also has a selection of wheelchair-accessible rooms with wide doorways and additional space. Leonardo Hotel Leeds is ideally situated for exploring the city. Major attractions like Leeds Town Hall, Victoria Quarter shopping centre, and the city’s lively bars and restaurants are just a short walk away. For those venturing further, Leventhorpe Vineyard provides a local wine-tasting experience. Business travellers will appreciate the hotel’s fully equipped meeting rooms, ideal for seminars, board meetings, and conferences. The dedicated events team ensures that business meetings run smoothly. Whether you’re visiting Leeds for business, leisure, or a family trip, Leonardo Hotel Leeds combines convenience, comfort, and style to make your stay memorable.

16803.description: Located in a prime setting for every type of traveller, this charming hotel is just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from Southport train station. The hotel is situated in close proximity to a wide range of attractions, as well as a myriad of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. This charming Victorian property boasts stunningly-landscaped gardens. The guest rooms have been designed to keep in with the elegance and character of the building. The restaurant offers delectable, traditional dishes. The bar has been designed in a golf style, offering a lively ambiance in which to socialise or unwind. 11 conference rooms are available for the convenience of those travelling on business or hosting a special occasion.

16804.description: Easily accessible by all modes of transport, the hotel is situated directly opposite the local railway station, whilst Manchester and Birmingham airports are both within an hour's drive. The hotel is located 20 minutes from Alton Towers Theme Park - an ideal day out for the whole family. Stapeley Water Gardens, the world's largest water garden centre and Waterworld Indoor Tropical Aqua Park, are also close by. The hotel has excellent facilities as well as en-suite guest rooms and public areas. Hotel's facilities include a café, bar and restaurant. In addition the hotel provides conference facilities and a car park. All of the en suite guest rooms have traditional décor and are fully equipped to give a feeling of comfort and of being at home. The hotel offers a buffet-style hot English breakfast and a 3-course carvery for dinner.

name.content: Oulton Hall Hotel Spa and Golf Resort

16812.description: The luxurious city hotel lies amidst fabulous scenery in Yorkshire, surrounded by Oulton Park Golf course. The centre of the city of Leeds is located around 12 km away. Leeds/Bradford airport is some 40 km from the hotel. This first-rate hotel was built in 1805 and extensively renovated in 2003 and features a total of 152 rooms spread over 3 floors. Guests may make use of the foyer with 24-hour reception desk, a public Internet terminal, a bar and an air-conditioned restaurant. Those arriving by car may take advantage of the car park or garage facilities. Room and laundry services round off the facilities on offer. The comfortable rooms come with an en suite bathroom with hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, TV, an Internet connection, a minibar/fridge, a hire safe and central heating. There is a freshwater swimming pool, an indoor swimming pool, sauna, solarium and steam room available for use

16815.description: The Hotel is just a few minutes from the M42 and has free on-site parking. Birmingham City Centre is a short drive away, and it is less than an hour to Stoke-On-Trent. Birmingham New Street Station offers regular rail services to all major destinations across the UK. Birmingham International Airport is a 15 minute taxi ride, whilst East Midlands Airport is only 35 minutes. Situated in 550 acres of beautiful countryside, this hotel offers world-class golfing, sumptuous dining, extensive health & fitness facilities, Spa and free parking. The hotel's sole ambition is to create the perfect experience for their guests, whatever they wish to do. Of course, no visit would be complete without a few rounds on one of their legendary Golf courses. Host to more Ryder Cup matches than any other venue in the world, the Hotel is steeped in tournament history. Taking refuge in one of the 324 en-suite rooms, guests are sure of a comfortable and relaxing night's stay. All of the rooms are tastefully decorated and appointed with all the necessary modern amenities, including: TV, direct dial telephone, hairdryer and tea & coffee facilities. For extra indulgence, Superior Rooms are available, most with stunning golf course views. There are also the luxurious Suites, offering king size beds and balconies in selected rooms. The Hotel is a Mecca for professional and amateur golf players alike. Play the Brabazon, the internationally recognised championship course, the PGA National, England's only PGA branded course or The Derby – a shorter, more relaxed course for players of all levels. Benefit from world-class tuition at the PGA National Golf Academy or indulge in retail therapy at Europe's largest on-course golf and lifestyle store.

16871.description: Situated in the heart of Edinburgh, this historic city hotel is just steps from Princes Street, Edinburgh Castle, the Royal Mile, and the vibrant Grassmarket area. Steeped in tradition and charm, the hotel's unique architecture features alcoves and turrets, creating a captivating atmosphere. The tastefully decorated contemporary rooms offer a relaxing retreat after a day exploring the city or attending events at the nearby International Conference Centre, located just 1. 5 km away. Start your day with the hotel's breakfast buffet, ensuring you're well-fueled for whatever adventures await.

name.content: Channings Hotel, an Ascend Hotel Collection Member

16872.description: This upscale hotel is undoubtedly one of the friendliest and most sophisticated in the city. It offers the rare charm of a country house atmosphere in an urban setting, making it ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Overlooking spectacular private gardens on a quiet, cobbled street, the hotel is just 10 minutes from the West End, with numerous shops and stunning views of Edinburgh Castle. Guests can choose from individually decorated bedrooms, including three suites and a four-poster room. Amenities include a private hot tub for a romantic stay, and a fabulous on-site restaurant is available for all guests.

16875.description: The 4-star Novotel Edinburgh Centre hotel is located in the heart of the Scottish capital. After a day exploring Edinburgh, recuperate in our heated pool & spa, and join us for cocktails and craft beers and contemporary cuisine in the Tap Kitchen & Bar. And when you're ready to relax, discover the meaning of true comfort in our newly upgraded rooms.

16876.description: Situated in the heart of the city, this luxurious hotel is the perfect place to explore cosmopolitan Edinburgh. In just a few minutes, visitors can walk to the world famous Princes Street, and the main business community, shopping and entertainment areas are all within easy reach. Rooms have been tastefully and traditionally furnished in keeping with the character of the building and offer a high standard of accommodation. The hotel also appeals to delegates meeting for a day or two, families and friends attending a city wedding, theatregoers and couples making the most of Edinburgh on a weekend break. Whether it is business or leisure, there is always time to relax amongst the comfort and warmth of this establishment.

16900.description: The Best Western Kings Manor Hotel offers an idyllic retreat in Edinburgh's quiet eastern suburbs, yet remains conveniently close to the city's vibrant attractions, shops, bars, and restaurants, just 20 minutes away. Housed in a charming 160-year-old former convent, this hotel boasts a rich history. Located just half a mile from Musselburgh's picturesque harbor and Portobello Beach's golden sands, and a short 20-minute drive from Edinburgh Castle and the Scottish National Gallery, the hotel offers easy access to key attractions. The hotel features a large leisure club, the second largest among Edinburgh hotels, and offers 100 en-suite rooms, including twin/double rooms, club rooms, and accessible accommodations. Dining options abound, from the contemporary Lauders Restaurant with its impressive à la carte menu to the relaxed Options Bistro serving classic and modern dishes, and Bar Zest for drinks and snacks. Children under 12 stay free when accompanied by two adults.

16903.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the suburbs of Edinburgh. The hotel has a gorgeous brasserie restaurant and bar on site, featuring bistro and á la carte menus. The grounds have several walking paths in the surrounding woods, a water fountain often featured in outdoor weddings, and neighbouring friendly horses.

16964.description: The Royal Scots Club is a 31-bedroom property located in Edinburgh's New Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Occupying three Georgian townhouses, the club is spread over six floors, with lift access to all levels. Located opposite a peaceful garden, the club is less than a 10-minute walk from Princes Street, with local bus routes just a 2-minute walk away. The club offers bed and breakfast, meeting and event spaces, private dining, and excellent cuisine in our dining room. With several meeting rooms catering for parties of 2 to 182, it's ideal for business trips or private events. Enjoy the stunning Queen Street Gardens during a private dinner. For GPS, use postcode EH3 6QE or W3W location: tent. odds. covers (55. 956283, -3. 197780). Breakfast is offered for £12. 50. The Royal Scots Club is Green Tourism certified.

16969.description: The Mercure Livingston Hotel is a sophisticated 3-star hotel in the city heart. Just 16 miles south of Edinburgh and close to some of Scotland's best country parks, it offers guests the perfect blend of style and convenience. With eight meeting rooms and a dedicated restaurant and bar offering international cuisine, it is the prime destination for business and leisure guests.

16970.description: Welcome to Holiday Inn Express Edinburgh Airport. With on-site parking, an airport shuttle, and a complimentary breakfast, it’s the perfect choice for a stress-free pre or post-flight stay. For travel, consider our Park, Stay & Go packages. Edinburgh's main train stations, Haymarket and Waverley, are both within a short drive. Explore nearby attractions like Edinburgh Castle, The Royal Mile, and Princes Street with a quick tram or bus ride into the city centre. Thrill seekers can visit the Edinburgh International Climbing Arena, while animal lovers will enjoy Edinburgh Zoo, just five miles away. For shopping and dining, visit the Gyle Shopping Centre or St James Quarter. If you're attending events, the Royal Highland Centre is a short walk from the hotel, and Scottish Gas Murrayfield Stadium is a 20-minute drive away. After a busy day, unwind in our lounge with a snack and a drink, or start your day with our free buffet breakfast.

16971.description: Situated to the south of Glasgow, this property sits proudly on a tree-lined avenue, immersed in peace and serenity. The hotel is just a 20 minutes' driving distance away from the bustling city centre. Hampden Stadium is a 15 minutes' drive away. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby, offering ease of access to other areas of the city to be explored. This charming property greets visitors with the promise of a memorable, enjoyable stay. The guest rooms are fully furnished and well equipped with modern amenities. Guests can enjoy a delightful meal in the restaurant, followed by a refreshing drink from the bar. The hotel also offers conference facilities for the convenience of business travellers.

name.content: The Caledonian Edinburgh Curio Collection Hilton

16973.description: Please always contact the property if you require a connecting room. The Caledonian is one of Edinburgh’s most significant landmarks. Standing proudly at the West End of Princes Street, this former Victorian railway building hotel nestles in the shadow of the imposing Edinburgh Castle. Its reputation for style and excellence has attracted international visitors and notable personalities for over one hundred years. Admire some of the best views in Edinburgh from our 231 guest rooms and suites and dine at Dean Banks at The Court. The Caledonian Edinburgh, experience the grandeur of The Lounge, formerly the station concourse and ticket office, now a haven for afternoon tea and elegant evening drinks. Treat yourself to some of the finest Scottish whiskies and signature cocktails at The Caley Bar, or indulge at the Spa at The Caledonian, a sanctuary of luxury and relaxation, home to a luxurious swimming pool, sauna, steam room, whirlpool, and two gyms. The Caledonian Edinburgh is one of the most splendid venues Edinburgh has to offer for meetings, events and weddings. Since opening in 1903, The Caledonian Edinburgh has staged many prestigious events, from extravagant wedding celebrations and star-packed parties to lavish corporate gatherings and grand banquets.

16974.description: Located in Edinburgh's stylish West End, this luxurious hotel seamlessly blends its 1860s heritage with chic, modern interiors. Guests will appreciate original features like ornate staircases and detailed coving alongside contemporary decor. Just 200 meters from Haymarket station and a short walk from Edinburgh Castle, Princes Street, and the Royal Mile, it's an ideal base for exploring Scotland's capital. A range of spacious guest rooms, suites, and deluxe rooms, all filled with natural daylight, await. For corporate travelers, the hotel offers three conference suites and five elegant meeting rooms, accommodating up to 500 delegates with state-of-the-art technology and support. After work, unwind with a meal at the hotel restaurant or savor a Scotch whisky at the contemporary bar while enjoying live sports.

17050.description: This charming and unique hotel consists of a striking Victorian-style building with sprawling grounds and gardens as well as wonderful views of the Cairngorm mountains. Nature lovers will definitely want to explore the area with beautiful forests, mountains and rivers nearby, and after a long day of exploring guests can relax by the one of the hotel's roaring fireplaces. Loch Ness and the Urquhart Castle are about an hour's drive away, and many of the famous distilleries of Scotland's ‘whiskey trail' can be found within a half-hour drive. The hotel's elegant rooms feature contemporary décor with traditional charm, and each comes with modern amenities such as a coffee and tea tray and free bath amenities. Guests can enjoy hearty Scottish dishes in the restaurant and a breakfast or tea of scones in the bar or sun lounge, or in the privacy of the room, all for a wonderful, relaxing holiday in Scotland.

name.content: Apollo Ht London–Near Hyde Park & Paddington Stati

17122.description: 'This affordable, family-run hotel offers comfortable accommodations in a quiet residential street near London's Hyde Park. A short walk from Queensway and Bayswater tube stations, it provides convenient access to central London. All guest rooms feature private bathrooms, color TVs, direct-dial telephones, and tea/coffee making facilities. Wi-Fi is available for a fee. Breakfast is included, and chargeable street parking is managed by Westminster Council. Guests are required to provide credit card details upon check-in as security for incidentals. Reception is open from 7 am to 11 pm. '

17123.description: The Beverley House Hotel, located in the heart of London, is a short walk from Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. The hotel offers 23 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with showers. Guests can enjoy room service (limited hours), complimentary newspapers, and the convenience of a 24-hour front desk and multilingual staff. Marble Arch and Oxford Street are within a short distance, making this hotel an ideal base for exploring the city.

17125.description: The Shaftesbury Premier London Paddington, nestled in a private terrace just two minutes from Paddington Station, offers a tranquil escape from the bustling city center. This 4-star hotel boasts all the amenities expected of a premier London accommodation, including a stylish bar stocked with a wide selection of beverages. The spacious, airy, and quiet rooms, decorated in warm colors with quality furnishings, provide an ideal base for exploring London's many attractions.

17126.description: Discover London from our recently renovated and rebranded hotel in the heart of the city. Close to landmarks like Hyde Park, Royal Albert Hall, and Oxford Street, Europe's favorite shopping destination, our stylishly original rooms offer supreme comfort. Each boasts fashionable Italian furniture, vibrant chairs, and contemporary chandeliers, creating a perfect haven of convenience.

17127.description: The Troy Hotel, a privately owned boutique hotel, is ideally situated on a quiet terrace just west of London's Hyde Park. Offering convenient access to Oxford Street and the West End via public transport, and a direct bus route to Heathrow Airport just two minutes away on Bayswater Road, its location is unbeatable. The hotel's 33 elegant, contemporary suites, classified as Deluxe and Executive, have been recently renovated to the highest standards. All rooms feature Sky TV, pay-per-view movie channels, mini-fridges, and direct-dial telephones. Executive rooms additionally offer air conditioning and a choice of shower, shower and bath, or jetted tubs. The Troy Hotel also provides fully equipped conference facilities to meet all your business needs. Please note: Triple rooms may consist of either three single beds or one double bed and one folding bed.

17128.description: This hotel is well served by public transport and is an ideal starting point for those wishing to explore London's many sights. Numerous tourist attractions such as Kensington Palace, Buckingham Palace and Hyde Park are all to be found in the hotel's immediate vicinity. Heathrow airport is approximately 30 km away. There are a total of 50 appealing rooms are spread over 4 floors. The hotel's facilities include a reception hall, which is open 24 hours and a lift. The standard rooms are all en suite and come equipped with a hairdryer, a telephone, satellite TV, Internet access and central heating. Each morning there is a continental breakfast on offer for guests. By Car: From London Heathrow Airport - Depart. At the roundabout, take the first exit onto Bolton's Lane. Turn left onto Bath Road A4. At the roundabout, take the first exit onto The Parkway A312. At the roundabout, take the fourth exit onto Slip Road (M4 J3). Continue onto M4. Continue onto Great West Road A4. At the roundabout, take the second exit onto Great West Road A4. Continue onto A4. Turn left onto Warwick Road A3220. Turn right onto Pembroke Road A3220. Turn left onto Earl's Court Road B316. Turn right onto Kensington High Street A315. Bear left onto Kensington Church Street. Turn right onto Notting Hill Gate A40. Continue onto A40. Turn left onto Saint Petersburgh Place. Continue onto Ilchester Gardens. Turn right onto Prince's Square. Arrive.

17130.description: Nestled on the edge of Cardiff, this attractive hotel is a perfect place for a family holiday, weekend gateway or a business travel. Provided a quiet yet still convenient situation, the property guarantees a memorable stay in a contemporary setting and hospitality to meet expectations of even the most discerning visitors. The hotel is close to the M4 Motorway and the A48M and 8 km away from Cardiff city centre. Cardiff Airport can be reached within 35-minute drive. Shopping centre, bars and restaurants can be found in the nearby area. Guests will have the opportunity to completely wind down in charming rooms filled with natural light and well-appointed with modern furniture and all the necessary amenities like a flat screen free view televisions, telephones, tea and coffee making facilities and hairdryers to provide all the necessary means for an enjoyable stay.

17141.address: Wigston Road, Walsgrave / Iff Junt.2 M6, 4
17141.description: Premiere Classe Coventry is located just 30 min from Coventry City centre, 15 minutes from Birmingham International Airport , less than 15 minutes drive from Coventry Airport and the NEC. Ricoh Arena is less than 5 miles away. Locally is a leisure centre, cinema, bowling, bingo and major retailing shops. Coventry University Hospital is less than 5 minutes away. We have now got BT Sports showing all football matches in the reception area. Come and watch a game while enjoying a drink. Wi-Fi available throughout the hotel, charges apply. Contact hotel for additional details. All our bedrooms are on-suite and with the choice of using the power shower or having a luxury bath to relax at the end of the day , there are complimentary tea & coffee making facilities and TV with Freeview channels in all rooms, Reception is open 6.30 am - 11pm Mon - Fri, 7am - 11pm on Weekends and Bank Holidays. No check-ins after 11pm. We also have a purpose built room can seat to 30 delegates and can be hired for all occasions and events, Meetings, Seminars, Staff Training, Christenings.

17144.description: Nestled in Newcastle-upon-Tyne, just 18 kilometers from Newcastle International Airport, this modern hotel is perfect for weekend getaways, family holidays, or business trips. Its convenient location just off the A167 motorway and only 5 kilometers from the city center makes it an ideal base for exploring the area's historical heritage. Twin, double, and accessible rooms are available to meet all guests' needs. Each room features elegant décor in natural tones, cozy furnishings, a flat-screen television, a desk, tea and coffee making facilities, a private bathroom, and a hairdryer. The on-site restaurant offers delicious local specialties and excellent service. Guests can also enjoy a beverage from the bar or read a newspaper on the terrace.

17145.description: This property is perched on the tip of the renowned Causeway Coastal Route, facing the soft, sandy beaches of Ballygally Bay and offering magnificent views over the surrounding landscape. Ideal for nature lovers, this charming property offers the perfect base from which to explore all this vibrant region has to offer, including the famous Giant's Causeway, Whitepark Bay and Glenariff Forest Park. A wide choice of outdoor activities is to be found on the Antrim Coast Ardclinis Outdoor Activity Centre, and Belfast International Airport is a 40-minute drive away. Designed with relaxation and comfort in mind, each of the rooms has been tastefully decorated, combining a modern décor with the charm of the castle. The onsite restaurant serves up a wide range of delicious dishes based on the finest local produce. Full of character, this beautiful establishment also includes meeting rooms ideal for corporate travellers.

17146.description: This luxurious hotel is ideally situated in the suburbs of Belfast. Immersed in the rich culture and history of the city, this hotel is just a short distance away from a wide range of attractions. A number of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can be found just a short distance away. This upscale hotel enjoys a mesmerising design. Dating back to 1876, it offers well-established, longstanding appeal and charm. The luxurious guest rooms immerse visitors in unrivalled elegance and comfort. Guests will be spoilt for choice with the hotel's 2 restaurants. They can enjoy an energetic workout in the gym, followed by a refreshing swim in the pool. Business travellers can avail of the conference room.

17147.description: Featuring a prime location in Belfast city centre, this luxurious hotel is a short distance from many of the most important attractions in the city, including Ulster Museum, Grand Opera House, City Hall, Titanic Belfast and the Odyssey Arena, a large sports and entertainment centre. Belfast International Airport is to be found some 30 kilometres from this outstanding property. Guests will find a wide choice of tastefully decorated and superbly furnished rooms featuring a charming atmosphere in which to completely unwind. This superbly appointed property features an excellent service and is equally suited to a short break, residential conference or a grand event. The onsite dining options serve a wide range of delicious dishes elaborated with fresh local produce as well as tasty snacks and pastries, while corporate travellers can take advantage of the state-of-the-art conference facilities.

name.content: Radisson Blu Hotel London Stansted Airport

17149.description: Take advantage of recreational opportunities offered, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy American cuisine at Station 169, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Bishop's Stortford? This hotel has 13993 square feet (1300 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 15 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 500 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions.

17217.description: Atholl Hotel is quiet, friendly and has a popular restaurant, and rooms with free broadband internet access. It is a short west of central Aberdeen. Atholl Hotel is located off Anderson Drive, which is one of Aberdeen's main roads. There is easy access to Aberdeen Airport, train station and the city. Traditional Scottish food is served in the restaurant and lounge bar.

17311.description: This beautiful building from 1900 is situated in the heart of elegant Paddington, a few minutes from Hyde Park near Oxford Street and Marble Arch, near Paddington and Lancaster Gate metro stations. There is a plethora of shops, restaurants and bars in the surrounding area and the nearest night club is 2 km away. Madame Tussaud's wax museum is just 1. 6km away. Both Stansted and Gatwick airports are easily accessible by train from Paddington. The closest airport is London City Airport, 15 km away. Rooms are decorated in traditional style, equipped with everything that guests will need during the stay.

17394.description: This small and friendly hotel enjoys a fantastic location in the heart of London, perfect for sightseers looking for modest accommodation as well as easy access to city sights. Russell Square tube station is just a stone's throw away, and visitors will be able to reach the British Museum, Covent Garden, and Leicester Square all within an easy 20-minute walk. Madame Tussauds, Regents Park, and the shops of Oxford Street are also within walking distance. London City Airport is located 12. 7 km away. The hotel features a 24-hour reception and a bar. Each room comes with a television and tea and coffee making facilities. Refrigerators, irons and hairdryers are available upon request. There is one bathroom for every four rooms. This hotel's superb location makes it a great choice for a sightseeing weekend in London.

17396.description: Located beside a lake opposite Brentford Street. This hotel is within easy reach of Heathrow Airport.

17397.description: Located in the heart of London, the Travelodge London Kings Cross Royal Scot Hotel is within a 15-minute walk of Russell Square and University College London. This hotel is conveniently located near several key attractions: 1. 3 miles from the British Museum, 1. 4 miles from St. Paul's Cathedral, and 0. 7 miles from the British Library. The nearest airport is London City Airport (9 miles).

17411.description: Situated less than 1 kilometre from both Kings Cross Thames Link and St Pancras International, this smart urban hotel is ideal for visitors seeking accommodation that is close to major transport links in London. A short walk will take travellers to the world famous British Library, with its immense collection of over 13 million books. Those interested in art and culture, can take a trip to the British Museum and discover a global collection of art and antiquities that are sure to inspire them. With convenient amenities and services like the early check-in/late check-out option, the complimentary Wi-Fi Internet access and the cash machine on the premises, this hotel will satisfy the requirements of even the most demanding travellers.

17414.description: This hotel boasts a delightful setting in London, lying close to the River Thames. The hotel enjoys close proximity to Clapham train station, which is just 600 metres away. Guests can enjoy a range of exciting activities nearby. Sitting on the pleasant York Road, a host of attractions are located in close proximity to this charming hotel. The hotel is located close to Hurlingham Park, lying just 16 km away from London City Airport. This wonderful hotel tempts visitors into the comfort and style of the lobby. The guest rooms are superbly designed, offering a serene setting in which to unwind. This hotel prides itself on its homely ambiance, exemplary service, and dedication to customer satisfaction.

17415.address: Belgrave Road, Lillington and Longmoore Gardens, 53-57
17415.description: This popular hotel, built-in 1800 and housed in a traditional Victorian building, is located in the centre of the city, very close to Piccadilly Circus, the London Eye, Buckingham Palace and the famous Big Ben and other touristic sites of cultural and historic interest. Guests will also be able to find, countless shopping and entertainment sites reachable on foot. The public transport stops are also within walking distance. Victoria Station is approximately 5 minutes away and Westminster Abbey, the Houses of Parliament, as well as the Tate Gallery, are only a few minutes away. The modern rooms are beautifully decorated and equipped with wooden elements and parquet flooring. Each has a private bathroom with toiletries.

17455.description: This enchanting hotel enjoys a convenient location just 1 kilometre from the city centre and the railway station in the lively Liverpool. John Lennon Airport is just 12 kilometres away. Featuring magnificent views over the Queen's Dock and Mersey River, the hotel's welcoming rooms are comfortable and provide a functional décor with parquet floors and a large desk ideal for business travellers. Other in-room amenities include flat Screen TV with free view channels, en-suite with shower, telephone, tea and coffee facilities and hairdryer. A breakfast buffet is available every morning and guests staying at this charming property may have the chance to enjoy à la carte dishes for lunch and delicious specialities for dinner at the onsite restaurant. Ideal for a leisure or business stay, this property offers the perfect base to explore this stunning region.

17456.description: Located only 8 km from Belfast city centre, this hotel stands in 12 acres of beautifully secluded gardens and woodland. It is adjacent to Stormont Castle and situated within only 900 m from shopping venues, bars, nightclubs and public transport. The hotel offers luminous and well-appointed rooms, where guests may completely unwind after all day of work or venturing into the city. The units are en-suite and come complete with state-of-the-art amenities. There is a small gym located on-site offering a combination of cardio and weights - free for guests to use. There are a variety of dining options to suit all tastes. Guests can enjoy the cosmopolitan atmosphere of the bistro, or simply relax in the stylish lounge and reception area by the log-burning fire. Corporate travellers may avail for functional meeting facilities and afterwards while away at the welcoming bar.

17483.description: Work, relax, eat, and explore at the Holiday Inn® Oxford. Just off the A34, our hotel is three miles from Oxford City Centre and five minutes from Oxford Parkway, with trains to London and high-end shopping at Bicester Village. Explore the historic University of Oxford and its Ashmolean Museum. See the baroque Blenheim Palace, the birthplace of Winston Churchill, a 10-minute drive from the hotel. Our Oxford hotel offers a modern blend of work and leisure with comfortable rooms, an open lobby, and a casual restaurant serving British pub fare. Enjoy a workout in the gym, stay connected with free Wi-Fi, and unwind in our lounge. Host events in our Academy Conference Centre with 11 meeting spaces, catering, and a team to bring it together.

name.content: Columba Hotel Inverness by Compass Hospitality

17500.description: This charming establishment enjoys a convenient location in the Scottish Highlands city of Inverness. Guests will find the railway station just 1 kilometre away, while the airport is around 16 kilometres from this enchanting property and nature lovers will find Cairngorms National Park some 48 kilometres away. Visitors staying at this luxurious hotel can take a stroll to Inverness Castle or to St. Andrew's Cathedral, set alongside the world-renowned River Ness. The en-suite guest rooms have been tastefully decorated and many feature breathtaking views over the river or to the castle. Each combines a rustic historic-style design with a large choice of modern conveniences such as complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection. The onsite dining options offer a restaurant, a bar and a bistro serving delicious specialities, all for a memorable stay in United Kingdom.

17501.description: Located in the suburbs of Glasgow, this upscale property enjoys close proximity to the centre of the city. A wealth of attractions are just waiting to be explored nearby. The hotel is located just a short distance away from the Princes Mall shopping centre. This hotel is a great choice for business and leisure travellers alike. Guests are greeted with warm hospitality and the promise of a memorable stay. Comfortable, elegantly-styled guest rooms offer a peaceful space in which to unwind. Guests are invited to take advantage of the many facilities and services that this sophisticated property has to offer. Please note that the hotel doesn't accept any cash payments

17503.address: Culloden Rd, Balloch, Culloden, Inverness, N/A
17503.description: 'Indulge in a relaxing stay at Culloden House Hotel, nestled in the historical district of Inverness. Enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials at the hotel's spa. Savor delicious meals at Adam's Dining Room, or order from the 24-hour room service. The hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, a business center, and free valet parking. Each of the 28 guestrooms offers a pillowtop bed with premium bedding, an LCD television with satellite programming, and a private bathroom with designer toiletries. Culloden House Hotel is conveniently located within a 10-minute drive of Inverness Castle and Castle Stuart, and a short distance from Culloden Battlefield and Culloden Visitor Centre. '

17670.description: With a stay at Novotel London ExCeL in London (Docklands), you'll be within a 5-minute walk of ExCeL Exhibition Centre and Royal Victoria Bridge. This upscale hotel is 0. 2 mi (0. 3 km) from IFS Cloud Royal Docks Station and 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from The Crystal. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Make yourself at home in one of the 257 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Upper Deck, for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 4532 square feet (421 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. ExCeL Exhibition Centre - 0. 2 km / 0.

17679.description: This comfortable, 5-star hotel, dating back to 1881, is nestled in the heart of Birmingham, within walking distance of the city center and many top attractions. A variety of bars and pubs are just 500 meters away, and public transport is easily accessible on foot. Following renovations in 2003, the hotel now offers 112 rooms, including five suites. Guests can enjoy the air-conditioned lobby with a 24-hour reception desk, a stylish bar, and a restaurant serving both traditional English and international cuisine. Rooms feature a unique blend of Victorian and minimalist design, adorned with exclusive works of art. All rooms are equipped with standard amenities. Please note: the hotel is cashless. Discounted parking is available at two nearby car parks: Grand Central (B5 4DQ) and B4 (B4 6DG). Please inquire at reception for details.

17732.description: Indulge in relaxing massages, body treatments, and facials at this hotel, boasting a health club, indoor pool, and sauna. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services, and on-site dining at the restaurant or via 24-hour room service. A bar/lounge and full breakfast (fee applies) are also available. For business needs, there's a computer station, complimentary newspapers, dry cleaning/laundry services, conference space, and meeting rooms. Free self-parking is provided. The 72 guestrooms feature LCD TVs, cable programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, phones, desks, and electric kettles. Nearby attractions include Antrim Castle (3. 7 mi), Antrim Forum Leisure Centre (3. 7 mi), and The Junction Shopping Complex (5. 2 mi). The closest airport is Belfast International Airport (BFS), 5. 8 miles away.

17734.description: This charming hotel is located just steps away from Belfast International Airport. It enjoys close proximity to the vibrant city centre, where a number of cultural and historical attractions can be found. The property offers visitors an insight into the rich heritage of the city. This establishment enjoys a modern style. The guest rooms are classically styled, featuring modern amenities that offer comfort and convenience. Guests can enjoy exquisite specialities in the onsite restaurant, followed by a refreshing drink in the bar. This wonderful hotel is ideal for business and leisure travellers alike. Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification.

17735.description: The Crowne Plaza Belfast offers a refined, modern experience within Lagan Valley Regional Park, just a 15-minute drive from Belfast city centre. This hotel is ideal for both business and leisure travelers, with convenient access to Titanic Belfast, city centre shopping, and major road networks. Both city airports are within a 30-minute drive, and Dublin is reachable in 2 hours by car. The hotel features 21 meeting rooms, including a 900-seat ballroom, making it a premier conference venue. Contemporary rooms offer air conditioning, flat-screen TVs, and free Wi-Fi. Executive rooms provide access to the Club Lounge with complimentary snacks, beverages, and continental breakfast. Guests can enjoy a seasonal menu at the signature Green Room restaurant, authentic Indian cuisine, or relaxed, family-friendly dining at The RiverBar Lounge & Bistro. The hotel's health club features a gym, 20m swimming pool (booking recommended), sauna, and steam room, and complimentary car parking is provided.

17737.description:
Perfectly positioned on Malone Road, innbelfast is smart choice for travellers looking for a hotel near Queen's University Belfast and within walking distance of top attractions. 
Just 2 minutes from Queen's, 4 minutes from Ulster Museum and Botanic Gardens and a 15-minture stroll to Belfast City Hall and Ulster Hall, you'll be right in the heart of it. St. George's Market, Limelight Belfast and Ormeau Park are all nearby, while easy access to direct bus and train routes puts Titanic Belfast, SSE Arena, and Boucher Playing Fields within quick reach. 
From the historic Crumlin Road Gaol to the buzzing Cathedral Quarter, Custom House Square, and Waterfront hall, innbelfast connects you to the best of the city - without the fuss. At innbelfast, every room is designed for one thing - a smart night’s sleep in the heart of the city. Whether you’re travelling solo, with friends, or in a group, our rooms keep it simple: comfy beds, private bathrooms, free Wi-Fi, and a location that’s minutes from Queen’s, Botanic Gardens, and Belfast city centre.

17744.description: Located in Aberdeen's elegant West End, a short taxi ride from the city center train station, these suites offer more than just a hotel room. Within walking distance of restaurants and shops, and a short bus ride from the city center and nightlife, each of the 49 one and two-bedroom suites in this impressive granite building features a fully fitted kitchen and a private lounge with a widescreen television. Public transport is easily accessible, with a stop just 300 meters away. Check-in is available from 8:30 am to 7:00 pm Monday to Friday, 10:30 am to 7:00 pm on Saturday. The reception is closed on Sunday. For arrivals outside these hours, please contact The Spires reception. A £250 security deposit is required before arrival via our secure online payment portal. Please contact The Spires reception 48-72 hours before your arrival to provide your details.

17784.address: Restoroute Rose De La Broye, A1/E25
17784.description: This hotel is located on the southern shores of the Lac de Neuchatel in West Switzerland, around 5 km from the centre. It is surrounded by the beautiful countryside in the Lake Murten region. Shopping facilities can comfortably be reached on foot and bars, clubs as well as links to the public transport system can be found within 5km. Opened in 2001, this hotel comprises a 2-storey main building with a total of 80 rooms. This air-conditioned building is located on a main road and comprises a lobby area with reception (24 hours) and other facilities that guests need during the stay. There is also a bar, a kiosk, shops and an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant available for use. The welcoming rooms come with a bathroom/WC, and other standard amenities. Sports enthusiasts may like to work out in the hotel's fitness studio.

17793.description: One of Scotland's best-loved hotels The Royal Highland Hotel is situated right in the heart of Inverness. All the rooms boast furnishings and fittings of the highest quality with free (45 minutes) wireless internet access available in all public areas. The majestic staircase, which inspired the designers of the Titanic's interior, forms the focal point of the building. ASH is the a la carte restaurant/bar within the hotel, and the Gallery is a more traditional eatery, both offering fresh local produce. There are spa and health suite facilities nearby, or canoeing, tennis, hiking or fishing for the more active.

18218.description: This award-winning 3-star hotel is located in the heart of Liverpool, just a minute's walk from Liverpool Lime Street Train Station.
