Situated within St. George's Quarter, the hotel is perfect for exploring the city, with easy access to the Liverpool Empire Theatre, St. George's Hall, Anfield (home of Liverpool Football Club), and the world-famous Albert Dock. Its convenient location near Liverpool's Knowledge Quarter makes it an ideal base for both business and leisure travelers.

18220.description: This unique property is beautifully located in Crawfordsburn. It is located just a 10 minutes' driving distance away from Belfast City Airport. Bangor is also just a short car journey away. This property offers visitors the perfect setting in which to enjoy golfing, scenic walks, historical sights, sailing and shopping. It enjoys a unique style and a long history, dating back to 1614. The original thatched roof of this old coaching inn has passed the test of time. The guest rooms are individually styled and named, with many showcasing period furnishings and four-poster beds. Guests can enjoy superb cuisine in the restaurant, where award-winning chefs deliver a feast for the senses.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London - Vauxhall Nine Elms

18223.description: A modern London hotel with free WiFi and breakfast included, plus easy access to London's sights and businessesHoliday Inn Express® London - Vauxhall Nine Elms hotel lies south of the River Thames, in central London. It's half a mile from Vauxhall station, where you can hop on a Victoria Line Tube to Victoria or Oxford Circus or catch an overland train to London Waterloo. Buses to Parliament Square stop near the hotel. London City Airport (LCY) is less than 10 miles away, and it's 18 miles to Heathrow Airport (LHR). Limited parking is available. Business guests are within easy reach of meetings, convention centres and exhibitions in the capital. The hotel's bright,  spacious lobby makes a good working space for informal meetings, with the hotel staff on hand to assist with photocopying and printing. The hotel is just four Tube stops from shoppers' heaven on Oxford Street. Half an hour's walk along the river takes you to the London Eye for panoramic city views, while a stroll over Vauxhall Bridge brings you to Tate Britain's exhibitions in 20 minutes. It's just over a mile from the hotel to concerts at the O2 Academy Brixton and a 15-minute walk to cricket at The Oval, and a 12 min walk to American Embassy. Use free WiFi to plan your day's activities over the inclusive Express Start Breakfast featuring scrambled eggs, sausages, bacon, croissants, Porridge, cereals.

18224.description: The hotel is situated around 3 km from the city centre, on the outskirts of Birmingham, with shopping opportunities, nightclubs and bars lying 2. 4 km away. Birmingham airport is a short distance away, only 14 km. The nearest train station is Birmingham New Street, which is around 2. 4 km away. The hotel includes its own professionally landscaped garden. The 24-hour reception, bar and the conservatory were modernised in summer 2006. Conference facilities are available. The restaurant offers a typical English meat buffet as well as an à la carte menu. The comfortable rooms come with an en suite bathroom and are well-equipped as standard. The well-tended grounds include a sun terrace. Guests may select their typical English breakfast and evening meals from varied (meat) buffets. Lunch and dinner may be selected from the menu. Snacks are available the whole day from the lounge menu.

18225.description: Situated in a peaceful rural setting just off the A45 on the cusp of Coventry city centre, this modern 3-Star hotel boasts the harmonious combination of convenience and accessibility with an equally impressive commitment to value and customer service. With a wealth of on-site amenities, including free Wi-Fi and parking, restaurant, bistro, banqueting and conference facilities as well as a sauna and steam room, guests have everything they need to ensure a relaxing and comfortable stay. The Quality Hotel Coventry is renowned for its warm, welcoming atmosphere and its round-the-clock dedication to customer care. With its centralised location and versatile approach to guest’s requirements, it’s no wonder that it has become a popular venue for hosting a wide array of different events. For corporate functions, there are five spacious conference rooms, with a maximum capacity of 150 delegates. With flexible room layouts and a range of multimedia equipment these are perfect for hosting training sessions, meetings, presentations and other corporate events. The hotel has also garnered an impressive reputation as a venue for Weddings and other special occasions. Everything from room hire to menu selection can be tailored to a guest’s individual specifications or budget. Whether it’s a lavish party with dinner and dancing or a smaller more intimate celebration it is guaranteed to be a memorable affair. The hotel's events team are experienced, attentive and thoroughly professional. A member of the team will be on hand throughout the planning and execution of the event to ensure that it is a success. Each of the 80 en-suite guest rooms at the Quality Hotel Coventry offer a charming blend of contemporary style, comfort and convenience. All rooms are specially designed with the interests of the guest in mind, providing all the necessary amenities to guarantee a pleasant and stress-free stay.

name.content: Best Western Stoke on Trent City Centre Hotel

18228.description: City style in the heart of Potteries' country. An iconic former railway hotel, the Best Western Stoke on Trent City Centre Hotel is perfectly placed for exploring Stoke-on-Trent's top attractions, from the Potteries Museum to the Heritage Canoe Trail. The UK's only monkey forest is also a 25-minute drive away. In addition to its great location, the hotel has some first-rate facilities, including a health club with heated indoor pool, sauna and gym, Charges do apply. There's free Wi-Fi in the bar and lounge, where you can also enjoy a game of pool. The hotel has an on-site car park which is chargeable at £7. 50 for 24 hours. Our 135 rooms include suites and family rooms. All have a flat-screen television, tea and coffee-making facilities and a hairdryer. Our food menu is available throughout the hotel, a snack while watching football in the bar or a relaxing meal in the comfort of your own room. The hotel's city centre location makes it handy for retail and entertainment venues, including the Potteries Shopping Centre and Regent Theatre, while a host of other brilliant attractions are within seven miles. Watch potters at work at the World of Wedgwood, walk among Barbary macaques at Trentham Monkey Forest or cheer on your team at the Bet 365 Stadium. Slightly further afield, Alton Towers and the Peak District National Park also offer amazing days out.

18317.description: This hotel is the ideal base for adventure holidays in the Highlands. With 108 family rooms, refurbished in April 2015, which sleep up to 4 people and include complimentary Wi-Fi and extra storage for skis, this hotel is the perfect choice for social events and family gatherings. With a family bar and small children's playground, there is plenty to keep everyone entertained. The hotel also plays host to the Kids Club and evening entertainment. The 18-hole Spey Valley Championship Golf Course with its breathtaking vistas is only 5 minutes' drive away. Located just 200 yards from the resort's own shopping centre, Carvery restaurant and Cinema, all the resort facilities are on the doorstep. Please note that children age 10 and under eat for free on same meal plan as adults (from the children's dinner menu). Children age 11 and over pay for meals as taken regardless of the rate type booked, and can choose from the adults menu, children's menu or half portions (where possible), giving you total freedom.

18329.description: Conveniently located close to the airport in Glasgow, The Normandy is the ideal place to stay before setting off on your holiday or business trip. Our ‘Stay, Park and Fly' service allows you to spend a night at The Normandy Hotel before reaching the airport in plenty of time using our airport shuttle service. The Normandy Hotel offers nearly 750 on-site parking spaces and competitively priced parking & transfer packages are available. This hotel offers a great choice for every type of traveller visiting the city and the city centre is just a short driving distance away, where guests will find a myriad of attractions, as well as a wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. Links to the public transport network are readily accessible nearby. The stylish guest rooms offer comfort and convenience. The restaurant and bar offer a wide range of dishes and drinks from early till late.

18336.description: The Inn on The Mile located on The Royal Mile in the heart of the city centre, offers an alternative boutique and luxury hotel experience in one of Edinburgh's most prestigious historic landmarks. Built in 1923 as the British Linen Bank, we have preserved, conserved and renovated our historical building into a place where you feel at home. Fully refurbished in 2013. A full Scottish and continental-style breakfast is served within The Inn on The Mile pub on the Royal Mile. Rooms at the hotel are situated across three floors and accessed by stairs only. If you require a lower floor please contact us directly in advance of your stay on 0131 556 9940.

18337.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 10 guestrooms featuring minibars and LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, as well as phones with free local calls. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Royal Botanic Garden - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Charlotte Square - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Georgian House - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- George Street - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Dean Village - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Assembly Rooms - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Princes Street - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Princes Street Gardens - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Johnnie Walker Princes Street - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Edinburgh Gin Distillery - 1. 7 km / 1 mi- Scottish National Gallery of Modern Art One - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- St. Andrew Square - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Western General - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Usher Hall - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Scottish National Gallery - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi. The preferred airport for The Raeburn is Edinburgh Airport (EDI) - 12. 9 km / 8 mi Located in Edinburgh (Stockbridge), The Raeburn is within a 5-minute drive of Princes Street Gardens and Royal Botanic Garden. This upscale hotel is 1. 1 mi (1. 8 km) from Scottish National Gallery of Modern Art One and 1. 4 mi (2. 3 km) from St. Giles' Cathedral.

18537.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a spa tub and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy local cuisine at Dungeon Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary English breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 35 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

18541.description: Beautifully restored Tulloch Castle dates back to the 12th century; Mary Queen of Scots and many other rich and famous guests have stayed in this imposing fortress. Its elevated position proudly guards over the colourful market town of Dingwall just 15 miles north of Inverness, and the views of the surrounding area are magnificent. Many of the ancient castle features still exist including the dungeons and the original mantelpiece with its roaring open fire. One of the Highlands' top chefs skilfully prepares fresh local produce that is served in the exquisite restaurant. For those who prefer a more relaxed atmosphere then retreat to the Green Lady bar for a drink or home-cooked bar meal - available throughout the day. The bedchambers, most furnished in a traditional style to befit a castle, are spacious, comfortable, full of character and all come with private facilities, TV and tea and coffee station.

18545.description:
Village Hotel Birmingham Dudley is just 8 miles from Birmingham city centre and 6 miles from Wolverhampton.   The hotel is handy for the M6, M5 and M42 motorway links with easy access to the whole of the West Midlands and for exploring the Black Country. 

The hotel has everything you'd need under one roof including new look, fully refurbished bedrooms with big cosy beds, huge TVs and great showers, pool and state-of-the-art gym with all the latest tech and Village Pub and Grill where you can tuck into delicious food and drink. 

Access to the Leisure facilities is charged at £5 per day per room. Club Room guests receive access free of charge. 

Parking charges apply Monday - Sunday, 24 hours a day
Parking is free for up to 4 hours Monday - Sunday
Parking is charged at £7. 50 for 24 hours then £7. 50 per day thereafter Monday - Thursday
Parking is charged at £5. 00 for 24 hours then £5. 00 per day thereafter Friday - Sunday

18550.description:
Village Hotel Newcastle is located at the Cobalt Business Park sitting between the city centre and the stunning beaches at Longsands and Whitley Bay. Newcastle city centre is a 20 minute drive away with the main A19 and A191 roads just around the corner from the hotel.   If you would rather leave the car, the Northumberland Park Metro stop is a short walk from the hotel. Newcastle International Airport is 14 miles, the North Shields Ferry Terminal is 4 miles and Central Station is 7 miles away from the hotel. 

The hotel has everything you'd need under one roof including new look, fully refurbished bedrooms with big cosy beds, huge TVs and great showers, pool and state-of-the-art gym with all the latest tech and Village Pub and Grill where you can tuck into delicious food and drink. 

Access to Leisure facilities is charged at £5 per day per room. Club Room guests receive free access. 

Parking charges apply Monday - Sunday, 24 hours a day

Parking is charged at £10. 00 for 24 hours then £10. 00 per day thereafter Monday - Thursday

Club Room guests park free for the duration of their stay.

18553.description:
Village Hotel is located in the town of Bromborough and close to Liverpool, Chester and North Wales.   The hotel is one mile from Port Sunlight train station, with a regular rail service into Liverpool and Chester.   Liverpool Lime Street train station is 5 miles away and Liverpool John Lennon Airport is 14 miles from the hotel. 

The hotel has everything you'd need under one roof including new look, fully refurbished bedrooms with big cosy beds, huge TVs and great showers, pool and state-of-the-art gym with all the latest tech and Village Pub and Grill where you can tuck into delicious food and drink. 

Access to Leisure facilities is charged at £5 per day per room. Club Room guests receive free access. 

Parking charges apply Monday - Sunday, 24 hours a day
Parking is free for up to 4 hours Monday - Sunday
Parking is charged at £7. 50 for 24 hours then £7. 50 per day thereafter Monday - Thursday
Parking is charged at £5. 00 for 24 hours then £5. 00 per day thereafter Friday - Sunday

 Club Room guests park free for the duration of their stay.

18554.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy a meal at Collage, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 194 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Liverpool Town Hall - 0. 7 km / 0. 5 mi- Royal Liver Building - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Cavern Club - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Cunard Building - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Pier Head and the Three Graces - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Port of Liverpool Building - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Liverpool ONE - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Liverpool Pier Head Ferry Terminal - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Royal Court Theatre - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Chavasse Park - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Museum of Liverpool - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Liverpool Playhouse - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Stanley Dock Tobacco Warehouse - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- World Museum Liverpool - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- St. George's Hall - 1. 4 km / 0. 8 mi. The nearest airports are: John Lennon Airport (LPL) - 15. 3 km / 9. 5 miChester (CEG-Hawarden) - 57. 4 km / 35. 6 miManchester Airport (MAN) - 59. 6 km / 37. 1 miThe preferred airport for Radisson Blu Hotel Liverpool is John Lennon Airport (LPL).

18603.description: This upscale hotel is situated in Chester's historic city center, near shopping and entertainment, and a short drive from Manchester. Renovated in 2002, the hotel features two floors with 35 double rooms, two single rooms, and a suite. Guests enjoy a 24-hour reception, bar, and à la carte restaurant. Comfortable rooms include well-equipped bathrooms. The hotel offers an indoor pool (with children's swim times from 9:00-11:00 and 15:00-18:00), a pool bar, gym, spa, and wellness area. Aerobics sessions are also available. A breakfast buffet is served daily, while dinner options include à la carte and set menus. Please note: the hotel is cashless.

18608.description: Brandon Hall Hotel and Spa is set in the beautiful Warwickshire countryside, surrounded by 17 acres of tranquil grounds. This 4-star Coventry hotel is perfect for a weekend getaway, where guests can enjoy full leisure facilities before retreating to the comfort of their rooms. Brandon Hall also has 10 fully-equipped meeting rooms, welcoming up to 180 guests, ideal for business meetings or parties.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Belfast City Ten Square

18613.description: Across from Belfast City Hall, our historic hotel puts you in the heart of the city centre, just steps from top attractions. Titanic Belfast is 10 minutes away, and several theatres, restaurants, and shops are within walking distance. Enjoy our relaxing rooms, fitness center, and onsite steakhouse serving memorable meals for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

18614.description:
This hotel is located in Belfast, right opposite Botanic Railway Station, offering convenient transport from the crossing between Lower Crescent and Botanic Avenue. Plenty of entertainment opportunities, such as bars and restaurants are only steps away from the hotel. Queens University takes around 5 minutes to reach and the centre of the northern Irish metropolis is a 15-minute walk away. The city airport lies roughly 1.5 km away.

Renovated in 2003, this city hotel comprises a total of 17 double rooms spread over 3 floors. Guests may make use of the foyer with a 24-hour reception desk. An air-conditioned à la carte restaurant and a conference room are also to be found within the hotel. Room and laundry services can be taken advantage of.

The rooms come with a bathroom with hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, wireless Internet access, a plasma TV with multi channels, a radio alarm clock, a double bed, carpeting, central heating and tea and coffee making facilities. A trouser press, work station and turndown service also feature.

Bed and breakfast is offered. Lunch and dinner may be taken à la carte.

18818.description: Cairn Hotel Newcastle is a modern, boutique hotel located in the affluent area of Jesmond, less than a mile from the centre of Newcastle. Featuring award-winning dining and an entirely relaxing atmosphere, this is the perfect venue for your city break. The 78 beautifully styled rooms are located across two buildings, benefiting from modern amenities and comforts such as flatscreen TVs, free Wi-Fi and parking. Head out to explore independent shops and bars on your doorstep or dine in one of the two onsite restaurants or our bar. The contemporary Asian fusion at Sohe is well renowned with an exciting menu to tantalise the senses. The gastro pub 97 & Social, serves Californian-inspired cuisine alongside an innovative, extensive cocktail menu, and Spy Bar serves a wide selection of drinks and burgers. When booking more than 2 rooms, different policies and additional supplements may apply.

18827.description: Enjoy everything Newcastle has to offer from this classic hotel in the city centre. Providing a traditional, elevated design with a contemporary touch, the Royal Station Hotel is the perfect base from which to explore. You’ll love the features that make this a grade I listed building whilst enjoying all the modern amenities, from free Wi-Fi to flat-screen TVs. The iconic quayside and a host of theatres, art galleries, restaurants, and bars are situated just a short walk away. For attractions that are a little further afield, you’ll only need to walk for a minute to reach Newcastle’s central train and metro station; you’ll also inevitably enjoy spending plenty of time back at the hotel. Unwind in the swimming pool and sauna and stay on top of your exercise routine in the fitness centre. With 10 magical function rooms, Royal Station Hotel is also the perfect venue for weddings and events. Filled with Victorian architecture, each room is adorned with features to fall in love with. You’ll delight in everything from chandeliers to ornate fireplaces.

18917.description: At voco® hotels, we're all about the warmest of welcomes and providing our guests with those locally inspired touches. Our rooms provide a characterful space to unwind and spend some ‘me time’. Whilst the POMO Restaurant & Bar, allows guests to indulge in authentic local flavours. Superbly located with a scenic view, in the historic Gasworks district beside the tranquil banks of the river Lagan. voco® Belfast is within walking distance to the heart of Belfast city centre. Here you will be able to explore shops, restaurants, historic venues and fun family activities and attractions. Belfast offers an unforgettable experience for everyone, whether you're here for business or leisure, voco® Belfast promises a stay that is warm, inviting, and full of charm.

18998.description: A haven for outdoor enthusiasts, spa-goers and golfers alike. This seaside escape boasts views of Bass Rock and the Firth of Forth and sits within putting distance of North Berwick Golf Club. Our thoughtfully-curated rooms pay homage to the ancient Scottish Linksland, its beauty and glorious colour palette. Warm woods, pops of blue and heathery hues abound, while chocolatey burgundy and pink help to create a sumptuous space for guests to relax and unwind. Selected rooms boast stunning scenic views of the West Links golf course, Firth of Forth estuary and islands, while all offer an abundance of amenities for an enjoyable and fuss-free stay. The Lawn Restaurant offers all-day dining, showcasing the very best of British and Scottish dishes. We've made a solid commitment to Scottish produce and provenance, so expect to find outstanding local beef, game and freshly-landed seafood on the menu. Bass Rock, our famous neighbour - is the inspiration behind our Bass Rock Bar, after all it offers unrivalled views, providing a wonderful ambience in which to spend some down-time. A place of immense natural beauty to reflect, unwind and just ‘be', the Marine North Berwick Spaoffers guests a range of facilities including an indoor-outdoor spa with heated 18m swimming pool, hydro pool and state-of-the-art fitness centre, plus sauna and steam rooms. The destination spa is available to all, for those looking to relax after a day on the links or those seeking to escape the everyday.

name.content: Aberdeen Airport Dyce Hotel, Sure Collection by BW

18999.description: The Aberdeen Airport Dyce Hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western provides the ideal stopover, whether you are jetting off abroad or in the area for business. We are just a 10-minute walk from Dyce Railway Station and only two miles from the Aberdeen International Airport. The hotel is also a handy base if you are attending a gig or exhibition at Aberdeen’s newest events venue P and J Live, as it is only a five-minute drive away. If you have some spare time, head into the city centre for a wander around the silver stone buildings that give the Granite City its nickname or get some fresh air in Duthie Park by the banks of the River Dee. Styled in warm tones, our 200 bedrooms offer a welcome retreat after a busy day of activities. From great-value doubles to family rooms and deluxe rooms with king size beds, we have a range of accommodations to help you get a comfortable night’s sleep. Business guests will also welcome our large writing desks for any last-minute prep or meeting follow-ups.

19356.description: Thriller, mystery or romance? With the Earls Court and Olympia Exhibition Centres on your doorstep and the must-see museums just minutes away, we promise a fairytale city break. Follow in the footsteps of Hitchcock and Agatha Christie and explore the beautiful streets (and stylish shops) of Kensington. See dinosaurs and experience earthquakes at the Natural History and Science Museums. Stroll to the latest show or cheer on your team at Chelsea's Stamford Bridge Stadium. And, with our friendly team, spacious rooms and extra-comfy beds, you can be sure of a winning night's sleep. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

19570.address: Hagley Road, Five Ways, Birmingham, England, 12
19570.description: The Delta Hotels by Marriott Birmingham offers upscale accommodation in the heart of Birmingham, a short walk from Broad Street and fifteen minutes from Utilita Arena. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center, a terrace with city views, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services. The 104 guestrooms feature smart TVs, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, and private bathrooms with designer toiletries. The hotel's restaurant, The Brew Bar Lounge, serves British cuisine and also offers 24-hour room service. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available for a fee. Other amenities include a business center, express check-in/check-out, and on-site self-parking (for a fee).

19572.description: Thoughtful touches and discreet charm make your stay at voco™ St John’s Solihull different right from the start. A stylish yet unstuffy hotel with conference facilities. Birmingham NEC a convenient 10 minutes away. Close to Birmingham Airport and the Midlands motorway network. With 13 flexible events spaces and dedicated staff, we can deliver the ultimate corporate event or your dream wedding. Here to relax? Dive into the pool. Steam in the sauna, get a massage or hit the treadmill in the health club. Dine on seasonal dishes in Brasserie six5one and order a nightcap in the bar.

19726.description: Delta Hotels by Marriott Newcastle Gateshead is located in Gateshead's Swalwell area, a short 2-minute drive from Intu and 7 minutes from the Life Science Centre. This upscale hotel is 5 miles from St. James' Park and 5. 5 miles from Quayside. Guests can relax at the full-service spa, enjoying massages, body treatments, and facials. Recreational opportunities include a health club, an indoor pool, and a spa tub. The hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a hair salon, and wedding services. Each of the 150 guestrooms features a Smart TV, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. Dine at the Cast Iron Bar & Grill, featuring a bar/lounge, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in and check-out. The hotel offers 5, 586 square feet of event space, including conference space and 9 meeting rooms. Free self-parking is available onsite.

19727.description: This hotel in Great Dunmow is conveniently located with easy access to the M11. It is just 7 miles from Stansted Airport and close to the historic City of Cambridge. Built in 1600, this is a historic coaching inn situated opposite the old market place on Great Dunmow's High Street and has been welcoming visitors for nearly 400 years. There are 31 guest rooms in total, spread over a 4-storey main building and a 2-floor annexe block. There are various facilities on offer including a 24-hour reception desk and 2 function rooms. The a la carte restaurant with highchairs for infants invites guests to stop off and indulge in some top cuisine featuring fresh local produce. All rooms include an en suite bathroom, a hairdryer, central heating, a direct dial telephone and Internet access. All rooms are carpeted. Breakfast may be selected from a buffet. Lunch and dinner may be chosen from a menu. Furthermore, special dietary requirements can be catered for as well as the preparation of individual-specific dishes.

19756.description: Located in the historical market town of Dunstable, this stylish hotel is perfect for travellers who are eager to unwind. The property is just a short walking distance away from the centre of the town. Luton is a 10 minutes' drive away. Luton Airport is also located nearby. This charming hotel enjoys a rich heritage, oozing warm, old-English charm. The spacious guest rooms are stunningly designed, exuding rustic elegance and luxury. This property offers visitors a boundless range of facilities and services, to meet guests' individual needs. The hotel features spaces for special occasions and events. The property also offers a gym, for those who like to keep in shape while away.

19759.description: Located in the heart of Cardiff, this hotel offers a wealth of amenities, including a 24-hour fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. Enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant or 24-hour room service, and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). For business travelers, there's a business center and express check-in/check-out services. The hotel also boasts extensive event space, with over 5, 000 square feet of meeting and conference rooms. The 205 air-conditioned guest rooms feature flat-screen TVs, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, and private bathrooms. Nearby attractions include Cardiff International Arena, St. David's Hall, and Cardiff Castle. Cardiff International Airport (CWL) is the nearest airport.

19837.description: The Leonardo Hotel offers a prime location in Belfast, just steps from the Grand Opera House and a short walk from Victoria Square and Castlecourt Shopping Centre. A 20-minute stroll takes you to the Titanic Visitor Centre, while Queens University, the Botanical Gardens, and the Ulster Museum are within a 15-minute walk. The hotel features 190 spacious rooms equipped with flat-screen TVs with Freeview, free WiFi, and en-suite bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Each room comfortably accommodates up to three adults or two adults and two children under twelve. Enjoy relaxing in a bubble bath after a busy day exploring the city. *Full names are required for each room when booking two or more rooms.

19877.description: The The Crown London, WorldHotels Distinctive offers 152 tastefully decorated guest rooms, each providing a contemporary yet homely feel. Guests can choose from a variety of room types, including double, twin (double with a single bed), family, superior, suites, and wheelchair-accessible rooms. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Guests can enjoy breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and access the hotel's leisure facilities. The Crown Pub, a beloved local Irish bar, offers a wide selection of beverages and a diverse bar menu.

name.content: Delta Hotels by Marriott Liverpool City Centre

20056.description: This Liverpool hotel offers 146 guest rooms with flat-screen TVs, pillowtop beds, and premium bedding. Complimentary Wi-Fi and digital programming are available. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Enjoy on-site amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center, garden, and The Brew Bar Lounge, serving lunch and dinner. Room service is available during limited hours, and a buffet breakfast is offered weekdays and weekends (for a fee). The hotel also features 6458 sq ft of event space, including nine meeting rooms. Dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk are available. Self-parking is available for a fee. Nearby attractions include St. George's Hall, Liverpool Central Library, and several theaters. John Lennon Airport is approximately 10 miles away.

20057.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and a banquet hall. Enjoy Italian cuisine at Gino D'Acampo, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. This hotel has 14 meeting rooms available for events. Make yourself at home in one of the 244 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

20058.description: This hotel is situated outside of the centre, right by Newcastle Racecourse. The public transport network is easily reached on foot. Set on 12 acres of parkland near the vibrant city centre and Newcastle International Airport, the hotel offers the ideal setting for short breaks and business travel. The chic lobby leads to spacious, beautifully renovated guest rooms. Exquisite dining awaits at the Park Restaurant, winner of one AA Rosette. It offers a superior conference facility for up to 600, with catering and an executive lounge. The charming rooms include an en suite and are all fully - equipped as standard. The hotel offers its own pool, an indoor pool, a pool bar, a hot tub, a solarium, a steam room, gym and a sauna. Guests are invited at the breakfast buffet. At lunchtime and in the evenings, guests may select dishes from a set menu.

20176.description: Crowne Plaza® Liverpool City Centre hotel overlooks the waterfront in the vibrant centre of Liverpool. Guests can park at the hotel for low daily rates in the onsite car park. Liverpool Lime Street Station is 10 minutes away. A short stroll down the River Mersey takes you to the iconic Royal Albert Dock with its restaurants, bars,  The Beatles Story attraction and Tate Liverpool Art Gallery. When you are done with sightseeing, you can work out in our well-equipped Fitness Centre and relax in our 18-metre swimming pool, spa pool, steam room and sauna. For our corporate guests there is WIFI throughout. The hotel is within walking distance of the Arena and Convention Centre Liverpool and the new Bramley dock stadium as well as a short drive from events at Anfield Stadium home to Liverpool Football Club. Our Crowne Plaza Meetings Director can help you plan anything from a board meeting to a gala dinner for 480. When work is done, you can enjoy cocktails with colleagues in our sleek Lounge Bar with its dock view terrace. Our lounge menu is ideal for guests on the go. But do take time to enjoy the huge buffet breakfast at The Restaurant.  It serves grill-style dinners – ideal for a client entertaining or a romantic meal – and there is 24-hour room service for added convenience.

20184.description: Canon Court Apartments offer stylish 4-star accommodations conveniently located within a mile of Edinburgh's vibrant Princes Street and Waverley Rail Station. A large supermarket is a mere 150 meters away, and the surrounding local shops, restaurants, and bars create a charming village atmosphere. The 41 contemporary apartments, spread across two four-story buildings, are brightly decorated and feature separate living rooms, kitchens, and bathrooms. All apartments offer complimentary Wi-Fi, a 32-inch TV with Freeview channels, a DVD player, a dining area, and a tiled bathroom with a shower/tub combination. Bedrooms can be configured as a double bed or twin beds upon request. A convenient on-site car park is available (chargeable). For stays of 7 days or longer, a complimentary weekly refresh service includes a change of bed linen and towels. Additional services are available for a fee. Local bus services to Princes Street are located directly outside the apartments. Edinburgh International Airport is 8 miles away and easily accessible by shuttle, taxi, or airport bus. The railway and bus station are a 15-minute walk or a 5-minute taxi ride away.

name.content: Premier Inn Glasgow City - George Square

20297.description: It's all go in Glasgow and, at the Premier Inn Hotel Glasgow City George Square, you're just a short stroll from all the sights and sounds. Located in the city's historic heart, you're also well placed for key business destinations like the SECC and Strathclyde University. Cheer on your team at Hampden Park, or shop 'til you drop in Glasgow city centre. Eat, drink and party in trendy Merchant City, or see the stars at the SSE Hydro. And, whether it's work or play, you're just two miles from the huge events at the Scottish Exhibition and Conference Centre. Then recharge in our tasty restaurant and relax in our spacious rooms and extra-comfy beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

20298.description: The hotel is located in the historical heart of the city, right next door to Haymarket station and only 4 minutes away on foot to Edinburgh International Conference Center. Varied selection of cafes, bars and restaurants are situated next to the hotel. Explore the numerous sights and events of the city such as Edinburgh Castle, Edinburgh Zoo, Murrayfield Stadium and much more. The hotel offers many modern rooms equipped with free Wi-fi. Have a refreshing start to the day with a an abundant Scottish breakfast buffet and enjoy traditional and modern dishes at the restaurant. Modern and well-equipped meeting room venues are available for business meetings.

21800.description: Two minutes from the M9 between Stirling and Edinburgh, this old Manor House has been lovingly transformed into a comfortable modern hotel with all the facilities that the modern day traveller would expect from a luxury four-star residence in the heart of central Scotland. Set in its own 44 acres of ground, the Inchyra Grange hotel is in the ideal location to explore the lands where some of the most pivotal moments in Scotland's rich and vibrant history took place. The Wallace Monument, Stirling Castle, Bannockburn Heritage Centre, Edinburgh Castle and the Falkirk Wheel are a few examples of the attractions that lay just a short drive away. Their 98 rooms are all en-suite and come as standard with WiFi access, satellite television and still/sparkling mineral water, as well as all the regular amenities you would expect from a quality hotel. Superior rooms also offer complimentary fruit bowl, slippers and bathrobes. Newspapers, interconnecting bedrooms and dry cleaning / laundry services are also available on request. With excellent chefs and the finest freshest produce, the Priory Restaurant offers a new flavour of Scottish Cuisine, called OPUS 504. Fine, traditionally prepared Scottish beef and wild, fresh fish are the centre-pieces of their mouth-watering menu, with other Scottish favourites like cullen skink and Stornoway black pudding making a welcome appearance. Please note that the hotel doesn't accept any cash payments

21868.description: Kincraig Castle Hotel is a luxurious, award-winning 4-star hotel overlooking the Cromarty Firth, just outside Inverness and close to Tain and Dornoch. From the moment you arrive, you'll appreciate the Scottish Highland setting of this hotel, once the family home of the Mackenzie clan. The building is listed for its architectural importance, with outstanding character largely unchanged since its construction in the 1800s. The hotel has been awarded a 4-star rating from both the AA and the Scottish Tourist Board. Bedrooms at Kincraig Castle Hotel offer comforting tradition and luxurious furnishings with carefully chosen fabrics and furniture. Guests can relax amid warm wood paneling as fires crackle throughout the hotel under ornate ceilings. Unwind after a long day with fine dining in Kincraig's 2 AA Rosette restaurant or sip a Dalmore malt in the lounge, far from the hustle and bustle of city life. Informal dining is also available in the cozy Highland Bar, serving wholesome meals reflecting the same attention to detail. The hotel is ideally located for visiting some of Scotland's best golf courses, beaches, distilleries, castles, and stunning scenery. Kincraig Castle offers a unique experience in the Inverness, Tain, and Dornoch area, distinguished by its friendly comfort, beautifully appointed bedrooms, and elegant public rooms.

21898.description: Mar Hall is recognized as one of Scotland's top five-star golf and spa resorts. Its secluded woodland setting on the banks of the River Clyde, combined with its proximity to Glasgow Airport, makes it a popular destination for visitors. Guests enjoy first-class golf, a destination spa, luxurious suites, and fine dining, all just twenty minutes from Glasgow's main shopping and business districts. The 18-hole Earl of Mar championship golf course, with spectacular views of the River Clyde and Kilpatrick Hills, is a must for any golf enthusiast. Located within the grounds of the five-star resort, the course is only ten minutes from Glasgow Airport. Directions from the M8: Exit at Erskine Bridge following signs for Bishopton/Erskine. At the first roundabout, turn left towards Bishopton. Continue past HP Compaq, straight through the mini-roundabout, and past Bishopton Parish Church. Turn right at the Gatehouse, following the road into Mar Hall.

22058.description: A 500-year-old converted Scottish castle, this hotel is in the center of Durnoch, across from a 13th-century cathedral. It has period features throughout the property, as well as fine dining and quiet walled gardens. Bright rooms all have a TV, tea/coffee and a private bathroom, while some also include a sitting area and a four-post bed. Many rooms have views of the hotel’s walled garden, Dornoch Firth or Dornoch Cathedral. The award-winning Garden Restaurant has original 15th-century stone walls and hardwood floors. It offers traditional Scottish dishes using local produce including local seafood, Aberdeen Angus beef and Highland venison. Dornoch Castle Hotel is a 15 minute walk from the seashore and a 10 minute walk away is Royal Dornoch Golf Club. Pubs and restaurants are just a few minutes’ walk.

22438.description: Located in a prominent position on Shoreditch High Street, One Hundred Shoreditch is an independent hotel and home to 258 bedrooms and suites, five places to eat and drink, plus six meeting and event spaces. Blending modernity with East End charm, this dynamic district, nestled in the heart of Shoreditch, epitomises contemporary city living. From Lobby Lates and Seed Library, to their Eastern Mediterranean rooftop bar & kitchen, Kaso - there is much to see in this iconic contemporary hotel.

22508.description: This family-friendly hotel in central Salou is ideal for families with children and groups seeking a unique experience. Located just 10 kilometers from Reus Airport and steps from the beach across from the Yacht Club, it offers a variety of bright, comfortable rooms with modern, functional decor. Many rooms boast magnificent sea views from their balconies, while others offer pleasant exterior outlooks. Guests can savor traditional Mediterranean cuisine in the onsite restaurant or enjoy a delicious buffet breakfast. Additional amenities include an outdoor swimming pool and a social room with a TV and board games, perfect for quality time with family and friends.

22522.description: Make yourself at home in one of the 193 guestrooms. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Royal Mile - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Edinburgh Vaults - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Museum of Edinburgh - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Real Mary King's Close - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Festival Theatre - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Parliament House - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- St. Giles' Cathedral - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- City Art Centre - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Holyrood Park - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Calton Hill - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Edinburgh Dungeon - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Scottish Parliament - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- National Museum of Scotland - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- University of Edinburgh - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Potterrow Student Centre - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi. The preferred airport for Travelodge Edinburgh Central is Edinburgh Airport (EDI) - 13. 2 km / 8. 2 miWith a stay at Travelodge Edinburgh Central, you'll be centrally located in Edinburgh, just a 4-minute walk from Royal Mile and 8 minutes by foot from University of Edinburgh. This hotel is 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Edinburgh Castle and 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from St. Giles' Cathedral.

22963.description:
This hotel is located right in the centre of town, around 250 m from the beach. There are scores of shops in the surrounding area.

The air-conditioned hotel was renovated in 2003 and includes a total of 31 rooms, of which 18 are double rooms and 13 are single rooms. There is a lobby with a 24-hour reception and a hotel safe. Further facilities include a café, a TV room, a public Internet terminal and a telephone booth. Furthermore, laundry services are available and around 50 m away guests will find car parking facilities.

The appealing air-conditioned rooms are equipped with an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV and central heating.

The Hotel offers a complete Buffet Type Continental Breakfast, with local products and a new speciality, the Snack Xpress Carte, which offers the possibility to eat at anytime

22976.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a health club, an indoor pool, and a steam room. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy local cuisine at Laguna Kitchen and Bar, a restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge and dine alfresco. Or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and a meeting room. Make yourself at home in one of the 129 air-conditioned guestrooms. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment.

22997.description: This luxurious property enjoys a convenient beachfront location in L'Ampolla, an important tourist centre in Catalonia, Spain. Ideal for nature lovers and sports enthusiasts, the nearby surroundings offer a wide choice of options for physical activities in the heart of nature. This eco-friendly property provides comfortable and fully-equipped facilities to guarantee a memorable stay, including some different room types to suit all clients' needs. They all come with air conditioning, a private bathroom and minibar. They all have been decorated in soothing colours to create a relaxing atmosphere where to unwind after a long day of sightseeing. The onsite facilities include a cosy restaurant serving a wide choice of delicious culinary creations based on local cuisine and fresh produce as well as an outdoor terrace, ideal to enjoy the sunset while relishing a tropical cocktail.

23136.description: This hotel is located at the heart of the tourist centre of the town approximately 100 m from the nearest beach. Countless shopping venues, bars, restaurants and nightclubs are to be found in the vicinity. The airport can be reached on public transport in just 15 minutes. Renovated in 2001, this hotel offers a total of 315 rooms of which 7 are wheelchair accessible. A café music bar, a TV room, a games room, a restaurant and a public Internet terminal feature amongst this hotel's many facilities. Furthermore, there is medical assistance, a kids' club and a playground on offer. The air-conditioned rooms come with a bathroom, satellite/cable TV and a balcony. There are two swimming pools in the garden complex. Sports opportunities include aqua aerobics, football, archery, mini golf and table tennis. Guests can also enjoy darts or bocce and use the bowling and billiard facilities.

23221.description: Book into the 4-star Mercure Hull Grange Park Hotel; a 19th-century manor house nestled in 12 acres of landscaped gardens tucked within the countryside of East Yorkshire and winner of Hotel of the Year at the East Yorkshire Tourism Awards in 2019. Just a short drive from Hull city centre and Beverley Racecourse, the hotel is the ideal location for guests looking for a relaxing weekend. Enjoy international cuisine at The Brasserie or relax in the steam room at the onsite Feel Good Health Club.

23283.description: Enjoy garden views at this Oxford bed and breakfast, with amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. A snack bar/deli offers quick bites, and room service is available during limited hours. Continental breakfast is served weekdays and weekends from 8:30 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. The property also provides dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Free self-parking is available onsite. The 17 guestrooms feature kitchenettes equipped with refrigerators and microwaves, flat-screen TVs with cable programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, desks, and minibars. Housekeeping is provided daily. Located in North Oxford, Marlborough House Hotel is within a 5-minute drive of Port Meadow and the Ashmolean Museum, 2 miles from the Oxford University Museum of Natural History, and 2. 5 miles from Oxford Castle.

23377.description: Enjoy stunning garden views at the Loch Maree Hotel in Achnasheen, just a short drive from Loch Maree and Beinn Eighe Nature Reserve. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, an on-site restaurant with room service, and a bar/lounge. Each of the 16 guestrooms features a shower/tub combination, bathrobes, and coffee/tea making facilities. Daily housekeeping is provided. The hotel also offers a 24-hour front desk and luggage storage. Inverness Airport (INV) is approximately a 1 hour 45-minute drive away.

23497.description: The 300 welcoming guest rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. All guests staying at this property will appreciate the 24-hour reception. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

23520.description:
The hotel is located at the heart of Dublin just 2 km from the nearest beach and 15 km from the airport.

This partly renovated city hotel comprises a total of 20 rooms spread over 4 floors. Amenities on offer to hotel guests include a 24-hour reception, a safe, a currency exchange facility, a lift, a nightclub, a bar and a car park. The air-conditioned restaurant is fitted with a non-smoking area and highchairs for children. A laundry service is also available.

The rooms come with an en suite bathroom, a hairdryer, a telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a radio, Internet access and central heating. All rooms come with carpeting as standard.

Breakfast is available to guests each morning. A breakfast buffet is available every morning. For lunch, guests may select dishes from the set menu. In addition, the hotel caters for guests with special dietary requirements.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Glasgow City Riverside

23576.description: Located in the heart of Glasgow, the Holiday Inn Express Glasgow City Centre Riverside places you within a 5-minute drive of George Square and Glasgow Cathedral. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a TV in the common area, and a vending machine. The 128 air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with showers and hair dryers. Desks and electric kettles are also provided, and housekeeping is daily. Enjoy a satisfying meal at the hotel restaurant and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. The hotel also provides dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk with multilingual staff. Nearby attractions include Merchant City, St. Enoch Centre, and Glasgow Green. The nearest airport is Glasgow International Airport (GLA).

23697.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden, and stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. Savor lunch or dinner at the Conservatory Restaurant, or enjoy room service during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary full breakfast is served weekdays from 7:00 AM to 9:30 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. This hotel offers a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and free self-parking. Each of the 22 guestrooms features a flat-screen television with digital programming and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer. Coffee/tea makers and desks are also provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Located in Dornoch, the Royal Golf Hotel is next to a golf course and within a 5-minute drive of Dornoch Cathedral and Historylinks. Dornoch Beach is 0. 9 miles away, and Royal Dornoch Golf Club is 1 mile away.

23841.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of this Victorian hotel in Edinburgh. With complimentary Wi-Fi, iPod docking stations, and flat-screen TVs, our 71 individually decorated guestrooms offer a comfortable retreat. Savor British cuisine at the 1886 Restaurant with garden views and alfresco dining, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Amenities include a bar/lounge, full breakfasts (fee applies), a 24-hour business center, free self-parking, and extensive conference space. Nearby attractions include Braid Hills Golf Course (0. 5 mi), Napier University (1. 2 mi), and The Meadows (2 mi). Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is 10. 4 miles away.

name.content: Holland House Hotel Cardiff By Sunday

23965.description: The Mercure Cardiff Holland House and Spa is a modern 4-star hotel situated in the vibrant capital city of Wales. Holland House is perfectly suited to your business and leisure needs, with the biggest conference facility in Cardiff capable of seating up to 700 guests. The hotel also boasts excellent transport links and is within walking distance of the iconic Millennium Stadium and Cardiff Castle, ideal for sightseeing in the city.

23979.description: 'Nestled within magnificent grounds, the Macdonald Linden Hall Golf and Country Club offers peace and comfort in a beautifully preserved 18th-century manor house. Classically furnished rooms blend traditional comforts such as plush beds with modern amenities like digital televisions. Each room boasts unique character and a spacious en-suite bathroom. Upgrade to an Executive or Feature Room for enhanced space and stunning countryside views. An accessible room is also available. Please note that the Dobson Restaurant is closed on Mondays during the summer months and the hotel operates a cashless payment policy. '

24396.description: This accomodation offers a total of 21 rooms. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. This hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

24656.description: This modern hotel is located on the outskirts of Glasgow. The property is just 8 km away from the centre of the city, where guests will find a number of theatres, the Hydro, the Scottish Exhibition and Conference Centre and a shopping centre. Stirling is just a 25 minutes' driving distance away, providing a gateway to the Highlands of Scotland. This wonderful hotel comprises tastefully-designed guest rooms, which offer a peaceful ambiance, perfectly conducive to work and rest. The hotel's friendly, professional staff strive to meet guests' every need, providing them with a truly relaxing, carefree stay. The hotel comprises conference and meeting rooms, as well as a charming restaurant.

24696.description: Overlooking Hyde Park in prestigious Knightsbridge, The Lanesborough stands as an elegant example of London's Regency architecture. Ideally located near Buckingham Palace, Harrods, and the boutiques of Sloane Street, this landmark hotel offers guests a luxurious experience. Following a meticulous renovation by the world-renowned Alberto Pinto studio, The Lanesborough, now part of the Oetker Collection, features 93 sumptuously decorated rooms and 46 suites. Guests can enjoy elegant dining at Apsleys, set within a beautiful, naturally lit conservatory, or savor a rare cognac in the Library Bar. The Garden Room, London's most luxurious cigar bar, offers an impressive selection of Cuban and pre-Castro cigars. Each guest is pampered with personalized butler service, ensuring a truly unforgettable stay.

24824.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at Hotel Ceilidh-donia, located in Edinburgh's Prestonfield area, a short drive from the Royal Mile and the University of Edinburgh. This hotel offers 17 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can relax in the bar/lounge and make use of convenient amenities such as a picnic area and barbecue grills. A 24-hour front desk and luggage storage are also available. Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is 13. 1 miles away.

24878.description: This charming hotel sits amidst the culture and history of the captivating city of Edinburgh. The hotel is situated in the city centre, close to Princes Street. The nearest station, Waverley, offers ease of access to other areas of the city to be explored. This wonderful hotel enjoys close proximity to a wealth of attractions in this charming city. The hotel enjoys a sophisticated design. The guest rooms offer comfort and functionality in a peaceful setting. The hotel offers an unprecedented choice of facilities and services, attending to the needs of every type of traveller to a high level of excellence.

24916.description: Holiday Inn Belfast City Centre is conveniently located close to the city’s retail and entertainment districts. The hotel is adjacent to Belfast’s main transport interchange and is easily accessible to the main road network, providing a perfect base for visiting Titanic Belfast and Game of Thrones attractions. This modern 4-star hotel features an ‘Open Lobby’ concept which provides a relaxed multi-use space for guests to enjoy all-day dining, Starbucks coffee and full bar service. During your stay you can enjoy free Wi-Fi throughout and secure discounted overnight parking nearby. The hotel features full dining options, 24-hour room service and a fitness centre. All bedrooms are air-conditioned and feature a flat-screen TV, a pocket sprung mattress, a safe, modern bathroom, and tea and coffee making facilities. Executive Rooms are also available with additional features of Nespresso coffee machine, a mini-fridge with complimentary soft drinks, a bathrobe and slippers. The complimentary fitness centre includes a range of cardiovascular, free weights and multi gym equipment. You can also work in the E-Bar, which features power points and a wireless printer. The To Go Café, serving Starbucks drinks, offers quick take-away food and drinks 24 hours a day. Our meeting room has air conditioning, natural light and enough space for 50 people. The hotel's meeting organisers will help ensure your event is a success.

25064.description: 'LocationGeorge Hotel, Burslem, Stoke-on-Trent is based in the quiet, quaint town of Burslem, near attractions like Westport Lake Visitor Centre. Burslem is known for its pottery manufacture in the 1900s. Special featuresThis 17th-century hotel boasts of a restaurant and beautiful banquet hall, making it an idyllic spot for weddings and other events. The old-school decor throughout makes the hotel very atmospheric, taking its guests back through time. AmenitiesAmenities include en-suite bathrooms, flat-screen TVs and free WiFi, as well as tea & coffee making facilities and daily housekeeping. The hotel also boasts free parking, a traditional restaurant, guest lounge, on-site bar, plus a ballroom for special occasions. What's nearbyThere's plenty to explore within easy reach of the hotel, including the Dudson Museum, New Victoria Theatre and Titanic Brewery. 'Note-The property don't ask for security deposit. Alcohol can be purchased from the reception and can be consumed in the bar or room, guests can use the Bar for sitting purposes.

25097.description: This pleasant city hotel lies in Hatton Garden, just a stone's throw from the city centre. Within the hotel's vicinity, guests will be able to find an abundance of shopping venues, bars, nightclubs and restaurants. Liverpool Lime underground station is within 5 minutes of the apartments and a bus stop is located around 2 minutes away. The stadiums of both home football teams as well as the famous sightseeing attractions, such as the historical harbour, Albert Docks or the Merseyside Maritime Museum, are just a few minutes drive from the apartments. Liverpool's John Lennon airport is 12 km away and easily reached within 20 minutes in public transport. Bright and contemporary in style, 63 apartments with a mix of one and two bedrooms, with open plan living and kitchen. Guests will find everything they need to really feel as though they are 'home from home'. A mix of one and 2-bedroom apartments are available. Each apartment features a fully furnished lounge, a kitchen/diner, a bedroom and a bathroom. Every apartment is designed to suit the modern lifestyle, with facilities including LCD flat-screen TVs with Freeview channels. Follow signs for Liverpool City Centre (Birkenhead Tunnel). From the Birkenhead tunnel entrance, turn left onto Dale Street and continue along in right hand lane and bear right onto Hatton Garden. Continue along Hatton Garden for 200 yards, the apartments are located on the left-hand side.

25199.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy British cuisine at Cast Iron Grill, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Bexleyheath? This hotel has 0 square feet (0 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 8 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 142 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets.

25200.description: Located on the riverwalk in Aviemore, the upscale Coylumbridge Hotel is within a 15-minute walk of the Rothiemurchus Estate Visitor Centre and Speyside Wildlife. Enjoy convenient access to Cairngorms National Park (25. 7 km) and the Strathspey Steam Railway (2. 9 km). The hotel boasts two indoor swimming pools, a health club, and an outdoor tennis court. Guest rooms feature LCD televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable programming. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Coffee/tea makers and irons/ironing boards are also provided. Dine at the Inverdruie Restaurant, grab a snack at the coffee shop/cafe, or relax at one of the two bars/lounges. Buffet breakfast is available (fee applies). Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, an arcade/game room, ski storage, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, ATM/banking services, and free self-parking. The hotel also offers extensive meeting and conference facilities.

25457.address: Circuito de los Marinos No. exterior SN
25457.description: 'Nestled on a lush 480-hectare island teeming with coconut trees and fountains, this hotel offers a tranquil escape just two minutes from Barra de Navidad's beach and town center. Located on Mexico's Costa Dorada, it's conveniently situated 85 km from Colima and 35 minutes from Manzanillo International Airport. The hotel features 199 rooms spread across two buildings, adorned with original artwork and modern amenities, including air conditioning, 24-hour reception, currency exchange, and internet access. Guests can enjoy a variety of dining options, from the casual 'El Gran Café' with bay views to the vibrant 'La Plazuela' with its Mexican-inspired decor. The 'Tequilas' bar offers an extensive selection of tequilas, while 'El Faro' lobby bar provides cocktails and live piano music. Additional amenities include a pool with an aqua bar, kids' club, room and laundry services, and medical assistance. The spacious rooms boast classic-modern decor in earthy tones, complemented by light wood furnishings and ornate tilework. Each room features a king-size or two double beds, en-suite bathroom, hairdryer, and private balcony or terrace with mountain views. Modern conveniences include a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, minibar, coffee machine, and individually controlled air conditioning. A valid credit card is required upon registration. '

25496.description: Located near iconic landmarks like Big Ben and the London Eye, Park Plaza London Riverbank offers a perfect starting point for exploring London. Guests can maintain their fitness routines in the state-of-the-art fitness center or enjoy the heated indoor pool with natural daylight. The hotel also features the award-winning Chino Latino Pan-Asian Restaurant & Bar with stunning Thames views, and an Executive Lounge on the 12th floor offering panoramic cityscapes. Its 489 deluxe guestrooms and suites include amenities such as TVs and a pillow menu, with select rooms boasting impressive river views.

name.content: Hilton Garden Inn London Heathrow Airport

25682.address: Eastern Perimeter Rd, Hatton Cross, London
25682.description: This hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has a range of kids amenities available upon request. Hilton Garden Inn London Heathrow offers you the perfect location near the airport, with easy access to central London. Located in central Heathrow, our hotel is within a 10-minute drive of Terminals 2, 3, 4, and 5. Our property also is within the free Heathrow underground travel zone, meaning you can travel for free between Hatton Cross and all Heathrow Airport terminals. Reach some of London’s must-see attraction, such as Hyde Park, the British Museum, and other destinations on the Piccadilly line from Hatton Cross underground station, situated a five-minute walk from our hotel. Relax at Jack’s Restaurant & Bar and enjoy crowd-pleasing British cuisine with an international twist from our chef. Our bright hearted team members are here to create memorable experiences for you and look forward to making you feel welcomed, recognized, cared for, and wowed when you leave our hotel.

25858.description: Situated moments from the Barbican Centre, Europe's largest arts venue and home to the London Symphony Orchestra and Royal Shakespeare Company, Citadines Barbican London offers a prime location for exploring the city. St. Paul's Cathedral is within a 15-minute walk, while the Globe Theatre and Tate Modern are a short trip across the Thames. Covent Garden is easily accessible, less than a 10-minute drive away. This aparthotel features 129 studio and one-bedroom apartments, each equipped with a separate kitchen (stove, microwave/grill, fridge, dishwasher), bathroom, TV, and safe. Weekly housekeeping is included, with additional cleaning available upon request. Explore the vibrant neighborhood's diverse restaurants, traditional pubs, historic Smithfield area, and Sadler's Wells Theatre. Major attractions like the Tower of London and Tower Bridge are also within walking distance. Citadines is committed to high hygiene standards through its 'Ascott Cares' program.

25859.description: Situated a short walk from Covent Garden and the West End, Citadines Holborn-Covent Garden London offers convenient access to the financial district, traditional pubs, international restaurants, art galleries, and churches. Nearby attractions include the British Museum and the Old Bailey. Excellent transport links are provided by the Holborn tube station, just 400 feet away. The aparthotel features studios and one-bedroom apartments, each with a fully-equipped kitchenette, stylish living area, and en suite bathroom. Guests enjoy weekly housekeeping, laundry and concierge service, versatile meeting rooms, a breakfast room, and an exercise room. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available in public areas. As Citadines is eco-friendly, e-car charging station is available for our guests. Please contact reception to book your space and your charging slot.

25860.description: Situated in the heart of London's chic Kensington and Chelsea districts, Citadines South Kensington London offers contemporary apartment-style accommodations. Refurbished in 2010, this aparthotel boasts a prime location surrounded by Victorian architecture and charming tree-lined streets. Enjoy free internet access and proximity to Kensington Palace, Hyde Park, renowned museums, and Harrods. Each studio and one-bedroom apartment features a bathroom and a separate, fully-equipped kitchen area. One-bedroom apartments include a dishwasher. All apartments offer a stove, microwave/grill, fridge, TV with satellite channels, a direct-line phone, hairdryer, safe, and air conditioning. Citadines is also committed to high hygiene standards through its Ascott Cares program.

25861.description: With a stay at Citadines Trafalgar Square London, you'll be centrally located in London, steps from The Strand and 3 minutes by foot from Charing Cross. This 4-star aparthotel is 0. 2 mi (0. 3 km) from Trafalgar Square and 0. 2 mi (0. 3 km) from National Gallery. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 187 guestrooms, featuring kitchenettes with refrigerators and microwaves. Wired and wireless Internet access is complimentary, and flat-screen televisions with digital programming provide entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

25876.description: With a stay at Marcliffe Hotel and Spa in Aberdeen, you'll be 3. 1 mi (5 km) from Duthie Park Winter Gardens and 3. 1 mi (5 km) from Aberdeen Maritime Museum. This 5-star hotel is 3. 4 mi (5. 4 km) from Aberdeen Arts Centre and 3. 4 mi (5. 5 km) from His Majesty's Theatre. Relax and unwind with massages, body treatments, and facials. This hotel also features complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Enjoy local cuisine at Conservatory Restaurant, a fine-dining restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. A complimentary full breakfast is served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Make yourself at home in one of the 40 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily.

25879.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this accomodation.

name.content: Best Western Plus Dunfermline Crossford Keavil Hou

25880.description: Best Western Plus Dunfermline Crossford Keavil House Hotel provides a gorgeous getaway, near Edinburgh. Found in the scenic village of Crossford, the country house hotel and spa offers rural relaxation just two miles away from Dunfermline (where Robert the Bruce, King of Scots is buried). Nearby you’ll also find several beaches, Knockhill Racing circuit, Deep Sea World and many scenic walks and cycling routes. However, if you’re looking for some city fun, you’ll be just 10 minutes away from the motorway network and half an hour from Edinburgh. Whilst in Edinburgh, why not visit the Royal Botanic Gardens, the Scottish National Gallery, Arthurs seat, or some of the splendid shops found on Princes Street. This Best Western Plus hotel in Dunfermline boasts state of the art leisure facilities, all waiting to be taken advantage of. A gym, 15 meter pool, sauna, steam room, Jacuzzi® spa, sunbed and tanning cabin can all be found, for plenty of well-deserved you-time. An abundance of beauty and spa treatments are also available, if you’re in need of some pampering. Here at Best Western Plus Dunfermline Crossford Keavil House Hotel we are proud to offer the most efficient service, the best customer care and facilities, and the most delicious cuisines of available in a Best Western Plus property, as you can expect nothing but style and comfort during your stay.

name.content: Summer Stays at The University of Edinburgh

25916.description: This inviting university complex is an ideal starting point for guests wishing to explore the city. From the complex, guests are offered a stunning view of the historical hill with Arthur's Seat. The Royal Mile, the Scottish Parliament and the Palace of Holyrood are all within easy reach of the complex. Restaurants, a train station, bars, pubs and public transport are within 500 m of the university complex, shopping facilities and nightclubs are within 1 km and the city centre is 3 km away. Edinburgh airport is located 12 km from the complex. Built in 2004, there are a total of 526 rooms spread over a 6-storey main building. Guests are welcomed in the foyer with 24-hour reception desk, 12 safes and 8 lifts, which is situated within the Chancellors Court building. Further facilities include 3 cafés, a kiosk, a bar and 2 restaurants with highchairs for infants and culinary delights. In addition, there are 18 conference rooms and a public Internet terminal available for use (additional fees apply). A laundry service, for an added fee, completes the offerings. Bicycle storage facilities are also on hand and those arriving by car may make use of the car park, which is free of charge. The pleasant rooms feature a bathroom with a shower, a direct dial telephone, a TV, a tea/ coffee maker and individual heating. Guests may select their breakfast, midday and evening meals from a buffet. In addition, lunch may also be chosen from the set menu.

25917.description: Located in the leafy Southside of Edinburgh, in the beautiful grounds of the Pollock Estate, The Scholar is a newly refurbished hotel within walking distance of all of the city's world famous landmarks. We take a serious approach to quality and comfort. All of the bedrooms in The Scholar are luxurious and feature large beds, Elite mattresses, and quality linen to ensure the best possible night's sleep. All rooms also include a TV with a whole host of channels, award winning Novus tea and cafetiere coffee, and a desk with ample work space. Our large bathrooms include rainfall showers, Laura Thomas toiletries and fluffy towels. The hotel's contemporary restaurant, bar and garden dining area proudly serve the highest quality breakfast, lunch and dinner. We focus on using locally sourced Scottish ingredients, from Stornoway black pudding at breakfast to serving Holyrood Gin from our neighbouring distillery, allowing you to sample Edinburgh's excellent food and drink scene without needing to leave the hotel. If you are seeking inspiration for what to do, the local Southside neighbourhood buzzes with small restaurants, bars and an eclectic mix of independent shops. Our friendly staff are always on hand to help and share their top tips on the best places to explore. We offer free parking on site but have limited availability. We also offer 18 free electric vehicle charging points (electric charging requires a 'Charge Places Scotland' card which can be borrowed from reception).

name.content: The Trafalgar St. James London, Curio Collection
