26120.description: Boasting a prime location in the prestigious Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, 100 Queen's Gate Hotel London, Curio Collection by Hilton, is on the doorstep of iconic cultural attractions including the Royal Albert Hall, Natural History Museum, Science Museum, and Victoria and Albert Museum. Enjoy a leisurely stroll from our historic, Victorian-style hotel to Harrods, Notting Hill, Kensington Palace, Hyde Park, and the designer boutiques of Knightsbridge. Following a multimillion-pound refurbishment, guest rooms and suites at our Kensington hotel exude elegance and feature complimentary WiFi, electronic newspapers, flat-screen HDTVs with Chromecast, and bathroom amenities. Unwind in a stylish Deluxe or Luxury bedroom with upgraded amenities and additional space. For a unique experience, select a two-level Duplex suite, boasting a top-floor location. Enjoy a workout in our state-of-the-art gymnasium or host a small meeting in one of two elegant boardrooms. Our signature restaurant Cento proudly showcases the very best of traditional Italian cuisine. Breakfast and all-day dining can be enjoyed here, or unwind with a late-night drink in our concept cocktail bar ESQ. For a traditional Botanical Afternoon Tea or pre-theatre drinks in a sophisticated atrium setting, visit Botanica. 100 Queen's Gate Hotel London offers 24-hour room service so you can dine in the comfort of your room or suite, day, or night.

name.content: Ponient Vila Centric by PortAventura World

26418.description: The four-star Hotel Vila Centric is located in Vilaseca, on the Costa Dorada, just two minutes from PortAventura World and a few kilometers from the beaches of La Pineda and Salou. Reus Airport is a short 10-minute drive away, while Barcelona Airport is an hour away. The hotel's unique architecture houses 94 spacious rooms, including Standard, Superior, and Apartments. All rooms feature a bedroom and a full bathroom, thoughtfully equipped with various amenities. Apartments also include a kitchen with a microwave, kettle, and utensils (available upon request). Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast and a Mediterranean-inspired dinner menu in the hotel restaurant, which also caters to celebrations and banquets. Additional services include five meeting rooms with audiovisual equipment, free Wi-Fi, a library, games area, cafe, business corner, parking, bicycle rentals, and seasonal transfer services to PortAventura World, beaches, and local points of interest.

26978.description: The Holiday Inn Express Inverness, an IHG Hotel, is conveniently located within a 10-minute drive of Inverness Castle and the Eastgate Shopping Centre. This hotel offers 94 air-conditioned rooms with amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, LED TVs with digital programming, and private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy a complimentary buffet breakfast, grab a bite at the snack bar/deli, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Additional amenities include free self-parking, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk with a safe deposit box. The hotel is also a short drive from the Victorian Market and Inverness Museum and Art Gallery.

26982.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Haymarket Hotel, centrally located in Edinburgh within a 15-minute walk of Princes Street and Dean Village. Start your day with a full breakfast (fee applies) at our snack bar/deli and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Our 39 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, and desks. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, luggage storage, laundry facilities, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Nearby attractions include Murrayfield Stadium and the Scottish National Gallery of Modern Art One, both within 0. 8 miles. Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is 6. 6 miles from the hotel.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Edinburgh - Queensferry Cross

27176.description: The hotel is located just outside the historic village of North Queensferry, set on the picturesque north shore of the River Forth and within walking distance from the Iconic Forth Bridges. The Hotel is a fantastic base not only for corporate guests but it is also very popular with leisure guests looking to explore Scotland's historical UNESCO World Heritage Site the Forth Bridge. With free car parking facilities, accessible road/rail links, and spectacular views from The Shore Grill, our onsite restaurant, the hotel offers a little something for everyone. With Edinburgh less than 15 miles away and St Andrews/Dundee only 35 miles east from the hotel, it is an excellent base for Golf lovers looking to explore and experience Scotland's finest golf courses as well as take in the sights of the capital city. Staying with us you can also benefit from joining our Hilton Honors program and get instant benefits on your next stay such as the lowest price anywhere and points towards free nights.

27179.description: Discover the stylish elegance of the Novotel London Greenwich hotel, which features bright, spacious bedrooms and colourful artwork throughout. Neighbouring Greenwich tube station, the 4-star hotel is a great choice for travellers interested in live music, riverside walks and nightlife. This modern hotel offers private on-site parking and boasts a fitness centre, a stylish restaurant, and spacious bedrooms. Please note that the Sauna & Gym will be refurbished from 25th November to 16th December 2019.

27296.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of this Victorian hotel, and take advantage of complimentary Wi-Fi. A range of amenities are available, including concierge services, ski storage, and a banquet hall. Dine at the hotel's restaurant for lunch, dinner, or brunch, or grab a quick bite at the coffee shop/cafe. Room service is also available during limited hours. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are offered daily for a fee. Additional amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. The hotel also features conference space and a meeting room. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours), and free self-parking is provided onsite. Relax in one of the 33 guestrooms, each equipped with a DVD player and a plasma television. Sleep comfortably on a pillowtop bed with Egyptian cotton sheets. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, and enjoy cable programming. Bathrooms offer shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include Bellfield Park, the University of the Highlands & Islands, Inverness Castle, and the Inverness Visit Scotland Information Centre. The preferred airport is Inverness (INV).

27416.description: Located in the heart of Glasgow, the Artto Hotel offers convenient amenities and comfortable accommodations. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, on-site dining at Bombay Blues restaurant and cafe, and room service during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Start your day with a continental breakfast (fee applies). The hotel also provides dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk. Each of the 50 guestrooms features private bathrooms, digital programming, and coffee/tea makers. A short walk from Buchanan Street, George Square, and other key attractions, this hotel is also easily accessible from Glasgow International Airport (GLA).

27458.description: Nestled within landscaped gardens on the outskirts of Falkirk and Grangemouth, The Grange Manor offers a convenient location between Junctions 5 and 6 of the M9 motorway. Ideal for both business and leisure travelers, the hotel provides a comfortable base for exploring the area. Our passionate chefs offer a delightful culinary experience, serving breakfast in Le Chardon Restaurant and lunch and dinner in the relaxed atmosphere of Cook's Bar and Kitchen. Afternoon tea is also available daily. Reservations are recommended, especially for lunch and dinner on weekends.

28116.description: This hotel is located at the heart of Amposta, one of the most beautiful towns in Catalonia. The hotel enjoys a natural setting, surrounded by intrinsic beauty and cultural splendour. The hotel is just 1 km away from the beaches of Sant Carles de la Rapita. This wonderful hotel is just 100 metres away from links to the public transport network. An array of shopping and entertainment venues can be found nearby. The hotel enjoys convenient access to Reus Airport, which is just a 35 minutes' drive away. This modern hotel tempts visitors with the promise of a comfortable stay. The guest rooms are spread over 4 floors, and are tastefully designed, for added comfort. The hotel features a restaurant, a bar and a cafe, where guests can enjoy delightful dining.

name.content: The Howard, an Ascend Hotel Collection Member

28718.description: This intimate and elegant hotel is known for its distinct attention to detail together with the personal touch that makes all travellers feel special. This is a Georgian retreat in the city centre of Scotland's capital city, ideally positioned for both business and leisure travellers alike. Every guest has a dedicated butler who will tend to their every need – from unpacking their bags and serving afternoon tea in the drawing room to co-ordinating their social itinerary and serving a three-course dinner in their suite. In total, there are eighteen individually characterised rooms where every kind of guest will enjoy a memorable stay. Dining at this hotel is an experience full of decadent pleasures, where dishes are meticulously prepared by a dedicated team of chefs, and there is attention to detail in this warm and exclusive Georgian setting.

28721.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of The Mansion House Hotel in Elgin. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, wedding services, a communal lounge, and a banquet hall. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge, and savor a full breakfast each morning (fee applies). The 23 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs, memory foam beds with premium bedding, and en suite bathrooms with shower/tub combinations. Free self-parking is available onsite, and the front desk is staffed during limited hours. Located on the river, the hotel is a short walk from Relax and Elgin Museum, and within a 15-minute walk of Elgin Cathedral. Spynie Palace and Glen Moray Distillery are also a short drive away. The preferred airport is Inverness (INV).

28723.description: Trinity City Hotel is a 262 room, stylish hotel in the heart of Dublin City Centre with the world-famous Trinity College on it's doorstep and Grafton Street, Temple Bar, St Stephens Green, the Dublin Convention Centre, and Dublin Castle all just a short stroll away. The hotel's ideal location, on Pearse Street, Dublin 2, allows for a peaceful stay while still being close to the action. Guestrooms offer complimentary Wi-Fi, luxurious cotton bed linens with fluffy duvets flat-screen TVs, an electronic laptop safe, tea and coffee making facilities, en-suite bathrooms with luxurious toiletries, a hairdryer, ironing facilities and a work desk, as standard. The most central four-star hotel in Dublin, Trinity City Hotel offers contemporary comfort, and delicious dining in the Courtyard Restaurant, Brunswick Bar and Courtyard Garden. The Concierge is available daily from 7:00am to 11:00pm and room service is available 24 hours.

28728.description: The hotel is located in London's financial district just opposite Liverpool Street station, which is a short hop on the tube from the thriving West End and a stones' throw from the numerous bars and restaurants of London's fashionable Hoxton and Shoreditch districts. Guests can benefit from the flexibility of a hotel while at the same time enjoy the space and freedom of an apartment offering a range of serviced apartments from studios up to two bedrooms, and all with no minimum stay. Each of the serviced residences is decorated to the same high standard and has been furnished with a contemporary flair. All offer fully equipped kitchens, marble clad en-suites, and dining areas. Whichever type of apartment is required, they all guarantee the space to relax, work or entertainment.

28735.description: Whether you're on the road for business or pleasure, the Premier Inn Hotel Newcastle (Team Valley) is the perfect place to pull in for a pit stop - just off the A1 and handy for all the city's must-see sights. If you're here for the high life you'll have all the shops, sports and show action right on hand. Or if you're focused on work, we're in a great spot on the Team Valley complex, not far from the Sage and Metro Centre. And you'll get a great night's rest with our on-site restaurant, spacious rooms and cosy beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

29136.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Take advantage of the sauna and fitness center. This hotel also provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services. Enjoy a meal at one of the two restaurants, including Simon Radley Fine Dining, or order 24-hour room service. Snacks are available at the coffee shop/café. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, express check-in/check-out, and self-parking (subject to charges). The 80 individually decorated guest rooms feature minibars, LED TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, hair dryers, phones, safes, and desks. Located near The Rows of Chester, Eastgate Clock, and Chester Cathedral, the hotel is a short distance from Chester (CEG-Hawarden) Airport and conveniently accessible from Manchester Airport (MAN).

29247.description: The 4-star Mercure London Paddington hotel blends contemporary design with the convenience of being in Central London. Located next to Paddington station, this stylish hotel offers state-of-the-art facilities to help make your stay a welcome one. Its serene setting offers a contrast to the hustle and bustle of the city. Each ensuite bedroom provides guests with the comforts of home and more. The hotel comes equipped with free high-speed WiFi and a 24-hour gym, while the on-site restaurant serves food and drinks all day. Travellers can get between London Heathrow Airport and the hotel in just 15 minutes via the Heathrow Express train service. London Zoo, Hyde Park, Little Venice and Oxford Street are all nearby attractions.

name.content: Holiday Inn  Express Birmingham Castle Bromwich

29258.description: A smart hotel close to Birmingham with free parking and breakfast includedHoliday Inn Express® Birmingham - Castle Bromwich hotel is a stone's throw from the M6 motorway. An easy 20-minute drive takes you to Birmingham Airport (BHX) or an exhibition at the NEC. Direct trains from the local Stechford station reach Birmingham city centre in less than 10 minutes, and we’re ideally situated for catching a football match at Villa Park. If you have kids with you, they can learn how chocolate is made at Cadbury World chocolate factory or brave the roller coasters at Drayton Manor Theme Park, only 11 miles away. If it’s raining, the nearby StarCity leisure complex has a 25-screen cinema, a bowling alley and laser tag to keep them busy. Business guests are close to the Jaguar factory at Castle Bromwich and the headquarters of the National Express Group, and your clients can visit you in our onsite meeting room. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- An inclusive Express Start™ Breakfast- Rooms with sofa beds for familiesComfortable bedrooms have a desk for work and blackout curtains to help you sleep. Start the day with our inclusive Express Start™ Breakfast buffet, and in the evening order a pizza in the Great Room or relax with friends and watch a match on the big-screen TV in the bar.

29264.description: Located in Salou, this attractive property offers guests a home away from home. This establishment enjoys an idyllic location in the heart of the city. Conveniently situated just 12 km away from the airport and 400 metres from the beach, guests will be enticed by its easy access to the surrounding attractions. Guests will find quaint, white-painted rooms awaiting them. All the rooms are fully furnished with an en suite bathroom, a living room and other modern amenities such as a fridge and microwave. Those who enjoy the sun can take a cooling dip in the outdoor swimming pool. This hotel is sure to provide guests with a memorable stay.

29314.description:
This house is located in peaceful surrounds just a short taxi ride from the town of Bishop's Stortford, where guests will discover various shops, bars and restaurants. In addition, guests may quickly and easily gain access to Stansted Airport by making use of the express train link. The nearest bus stop is about 50 m from the hotel.

This hotel is housed in an English country house that has been lovingly restored and modernised (2005). It comprises 2 floors with 2-storey wings and a total of 23 rooms of which 20 are double rooms, 2 are suites and 1 is a studio. This typically English hotel features a foyer with a currency exchange facility and a cloakroom as well as a small supermarket, a conference room, a bar and an à la carte restaurant with highchairs for infants. There is a nightclub on offer within the hotel as well as special cabaret and casino nights. It is possible to make use of the room and laundry services as well as a public Internet terminal and there is a car park on offer to those arriving by car.

The Victorian rooms come with an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, a radio, Internet access, tea and coffee making facilities and individually controllable central heating.

The hotel's spa area has an indoor swimming pool with a sauna and steam baths as well as various massage and spa treatments. There is a gym with aerobics sessions on offer and archery can be tried out in the hotel's outdoor area. Furthermore, this is the ideal starting point for excursions to the city of London.

Breakfast is on offer in the mornings; lunch and the evening meal can be taken à la carte or chose from a menu. Special dietary requirement and individual-specific dishes can be provided.

29507.description:
This attractive apartment complex is situated 800 m from a sandy beach and about 600 m from the lively tourist centre and its countless shops and leisure venues. Reus is less than 13 km away, easily reached by making use of public transport, links to which lie just 900 m from the hotel. Built in 2004 and situated on a busy street, this air-conditioned property comprises a total of 30 apartments spread across 6 floors. The cosy café provides an ideal space for guests to enjoy tasteful treats and share pleasant moments of relaxation. The modishly decorated, elegant apartments come with Internet connection and a TV with satellite/cable channels. Air conditioning and a charming balcony are also standard features in all accommodations 
*** CHECK-IN TIME: 10:00 - 14:00 ***

29650.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at Rossett Hall Hotel, located in Wrexham, a short drive from River Dee and Wrexham Industrial Estate. This upscale hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a restaurant specializing in British cuisine, a bar/lounge, and room service during limited hours. A full breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel also features a banquet hall, bike parking, and free self-parking. Each of the 51 guestrooms includes a flat-screen television with digital programming, a private bathroom with shower and complimentary toiletries, a desk, phone and electric kettle. Nearby attractions include Grosvenor Museum (9. 8 km) and Chester Golf Club (9. 8 km). John Lennon Airport (LPL) is the nearest major airport (50. 4 km).

34504.description: This property is 1 minute walk from the beach. Estival El Dorado Resort is a beachfront resort, 1. 5 km south of Cambrils Old Town and marina. It offers 3 outdoor pools, spa-gym and many sports facilities, supervised by qualified monitors. Sports facilities include tennis courts and mini golf. You can go sailing and windsurfing. In the bike centre, courses and routes are available. You can choose from different types of rooms: standard, with sea views, suite and junior suite. Each of them has a private bathroom with amenities and hairdryer. The Spa-Gym includes a sauna, hot tub, hamman, indoor pool, spinning room and cardiomachinery room. Massage and beauty treatments are available. Estival El Dorado Resort has 4 restaurants serving Mediterranean and international cuisine. There are 5 bars, each offering a unique atmosphere. Free parking is offered nearby and you can hire a car or bicycle. There is a tour desk and you can exchange currency

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London - Luton Airport

35317.description: Located near Luton Airport, the Holiday Inn Express London Luton Airport offers convenient access to ZSL Whipsnade Zoo and the University of Bedfordshire. This hotel provides 154 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with showers and complimentary toiletries. Guests can enjoy the convenience of an on-site restaurant, bar/lounge, and snack bar/deli. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. Additional amenities include 3 meeting rooms, dry cleaning/laundry services, and self-parking (subject to charges).

35319.description: The Holiday Inn Express Hemel Hempstead offers convenient accommodation with free parking. Located across from Apsley train station, it's a short 20-minute drive to Luton Airport. A short drive away, experience the magic of Warner Bros. Studio Tour London – go behind the scenes of the Harry Potter films and enjoy a butterbeer. Families can visit over 10, 000 animals at Whipsnade Zoo or tackle the obstacles at Ninja Warrior Watford, five miles away. Explore local history at King Henry VIII's former home, Ashridge Estate (a National Trust property), or enjoy the fresh air at Batford Springs Nature Reserve and Gadebridge Park. For thrill-seekers, Drift Limits Racetrack offers the chance to drive a real Formula 1 car or supercar, while The Snow Centre provides skiing and snowboarding opportunities. Take a day trip to St. Albans, known for its Roman and medieval heritage and impressive cathedral, or visit Knebworth House, a historic stately home and garden. Sports fans can catch a game at the Hemel Hempstead Town Football Club. After a day of exploring, enjoy pizzas and drinks from the hotel bar, followed by an inclusive buffet breakfast in the Great Room lounge.

35677.address: Frankland Road M4 Jct 16, Blagrove, N/A
35677.description: Holiday Inn Express Swindon - West is just off the M4 motorway, with easy access to the Cotswolds and free on-site parking. Bristol Airport is an hour’s drive and only ten minutes from Swindon train station, making it an ideal base for travellers. Shop for bargains at the nearby Swindon Designer Outlet, featuring over 90 high-end brands and experience live music and performances at the Wyvern Theatre & Arts Centre, both a 10-minute drive away. Explore the picturesque villages and natural beauty of the Cotswolds or head to Lydiard Park, a 5-minute drive away, for parkland walks and events. Spot over 120 species of animals at Longleat Safari Park, a great day out for all ages. Tour the hedge maze, adventure castle and have fun on the rides. Get up close to iconic locomotives at STEAM – Museum of the Great Western Railway, four miles away. History enthusiasts can visit Barbury Castle or explore Bowood House and Garden to learn about Georgian aristocracy. In the evenings, recharge with pizzas and drinks from the bar, and start your day with a free breakfast buffet in the Great Room. Unwind in our comfortable rooms, each featuring a flat-screen TV, an en-suite bathroom with a shower and a desk for working on the go.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Birmingham Airport NEC

35679.description: The Holiday Inn Express Birmingham Airport NEC, an IHG Hotel, is conveniently located in Marston Green, Birmingham, a short five-minute drive from the National Exhibition Centre and the National Motorcycle Museum. This hotel offers 179 guest rooms, each equipped with a flat-screen television, complimentary Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with shower, a hairdryer and a desk. Guests can enjoy a satisfying meal at the Great Room restaurant and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A free buffet breakfast is served daily. Hotel amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, a vending machine, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage and meeting facilities. Self-parking is available (subject to charges).

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Newcastle City Centre

35933.description: Holiday Inn Express® Newcastle - City Centre is just a 5-minute walk from Newcastle Station, where you can catch direct trains to London or Edinburgh. For those flying in, Newcastle Airport (NCL) is a quick 15-minute drive away. Sports fans can easily reach St. James' Park, home to Newcastle United, just 10 minutes away. Take a stroll along the river to admire the stunning Tyne Bridges, including the Gateshead Millennium Bridge. Explore The Quayside, with its markets, pubs, and scenic river walks. History enthusiasts will enjoy the nearby Great North Museum: Hancock and Discovery Museum, which offers a glimpse into Newcastle’s history. When you're back at the hotel, unwind in rooms equipped with free Wi-Fi, ironing facilities, and en-suites with showers. Enjoy a drink from the bar or a snack from the 24-hour menu. Don’t miss our free breakfast buffet each morning, with a selection of hot and cold options to start your day right.

36016.description: This stunning hotel offers visitors the ideal setting from which to explore Glasgow. The property is just a short distance away from the city centre and the West end of the Glasgow. Glasgow Airport is a 20 minutes' drive away. This wonderful property offers visitors close proximity to a number of attractions in the area such as Kelvingrove Art Gallery, SECC Glasgow, The Hydro Arena, Buchannan Galleries, West End Theatres and Glasgow Science Centre. This family-run hotel offers comfortable accommodation, traditional hospitality and culture. The guest rooms offer individual charm and style. The property offers visitors a number of excellent facilities and services, ensuring that the needs of business and leisure travellers are fully met.

36398.address: Southwold Road, Black Prince Interchange, N/A
36398.description: This smart southeast London hotel offers convenient access to central London and Kent, with Bexley station nearby providing direct trains to London Charing Cross and London Bridge. The new Elizabeth Line in Abbey Wood is just 15 minutes away. By road, the A2 provides access to Canary Wharf, Docklands, and London's O2 arena in 20 minutes, and the M25 is a short 10-minute drive away. Holiday Inn® London - Bexley is ideal for business and leisure travelers. Host a meeting or wedding for up to 120 guests in one of our eight well-equipped banqueting suites. Enjoy free WiFi, 24-hour room service, and comfortable rooms with desks, satellite TV, and a choice of pillows. Families can opt for rooms with sofa beds, and kids stay and eat free. Premium Rooms include a stocked minibar. The hotel restaurant offers an extensive breakfast buffet and hearty dinners, with drinks and snacks available all day in the lounge.

36403.description: A stylish Birmingham hotel close to the NEC that offers a variety of bedrooms, large meeting spaces and a restaurant that serves to everyone's needs. Crowne Plaza® Birmingham NEC hotel is located in a fantastic spot, only a five-minute drive from Birmingham Airport and a short walk from Resorts World and the NEC, so whether it is exhibitions at the NEC, concerts at Resort World Arena, or a trip away - we have you covered. We also offer Park, Stay and Go packages so you can catch your flight without a worry. The Hotel is situated just off the M42 motorway, which provides easy access to the M40, the M6 and the M1, and Birmingham city centre is only 15 minutes away by train from nearby Birmingham International station. Host a meeting for up to 200 guests in our eleven meeting rooms, with wall-mounted screens for presentations and a breakout space for networking. Our Crowne Plaza Meetings Director is on hand to take care of all the details. At this hotel, you can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, Energy Essentials, Sleep Advantage® Programme and 24-hour room service. Our restaurant offers buffet breakfasts and delicious meals in the evening, or for a more relaxed feel you can lounge in our Lobby Bar where you can grab a Starbucks coffee, and keep your energy up with Fast and Fresh meals at any time of day. Our thoughtfully designed bedrooms all have executive work desks, and USB ports to keep you completely connected.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Birmingham - South A45

36422.description: A family-friendly Birmingham hotel near the airport with breakfast includedHoliday Inn Express® Birmingham - South A45 hotel offers 83 spacious rooms just off the A45, a major road through the scenic Midlands. It's a short drive to Birmingham Airport, and just 10 minutes into Birmingham city centre. Business guests are a 15-minute drive from Birmingham's historic financial buildings along Colmore Row, and the NEC is even closer for major conferences and exhibitions. Back at the hotel, Curlers Room provides an elegant meeting space for up to 16 delegates, with friendly staff on hand to assist. For shopping and dining the famous Bullring Centre is a short drive away, and from there it's an easy walk to a concert at Symphony Hall. Less than 30 minutes' drive into the surrounding countryside are Drayton Manor Theme Park and Warwick Castle, both popular spots for family outings. Don't miss a trip to Cadbury World, a fun visitor centre at the world-famous chocolate factory. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- An included Express Start Breakfast buffet- Secure on-site parking- A Business CentreAll guest rooms come with spacious work areas and a choice of pillows, while family rooms include a sofa bed for the kids. After a busy day, you can enjoy local beers and tasty pub food at the friendly lobby bar and restaurant.

36439.address: Coal Pit Lane, Clifton Village, West Yorkshire, N/A
36439.description: Welcome to Holiday Inn Leeds – Brighouse, situated in the picturesque Clifton Village. Our hotel offers complimentary on-site parking and easy access from Junction 25 of the M62, making it a convenient destination for both business and leisure travellers. We are perfectly located near Halifax, Huddersfield, Bradford, Leeds, and Manchester, with numerous nearby attractions such as the Royal Armouries, The John Smith Stadium, and Eureka! Children's Museum. For those who love nature, the stunning Kirklees and Calderdale countryside is right on our doorstep. Whether you're planning a meeting, conference, or your dream wedding, our hotel boasts spacious event facilities with countryside views. Business guests can enjoy well-equipped meeting spaces, free Wi-Fi, and a lovely courtyard for outdoor entertaining. Our Open Lobby concept offers a modern, relaxed environment where you can unwind, catch up on work, or enjoy a meal from our all-day dining menu. Stay active in our on-site health club, which features a swimming pool with beautiful valley views, along with a relaxing sauna and steam room. Leeds city centre is just a 20-minute drive away, offering vibrant nightlife and shopping.

36579.description: A smart Chester hotel on racecourse grounds, with inclusive breakfast and a bar. Holiday Inn Express® Chester - Racecourse hotel is next to racecourse eateries and a five-minute walk from the city centre. Trains from Chester Station, a mile away, reach Manchester Airport (MAN) in just over an hour. Up to 15 business guests can gather in the hotel's naturally lit meeting room, and there are catering options for a productive working lunch. Chester is among the UK's most famous historic towns, and close to the hotel you can walk the ancient city, following in the footsteps of long-gone Roman soldiers. The Grosvenor Museum, Chester Cathedral and medieval Chester Castle are all within a 15-minute walk of the hotel, as is Grosvenor Shopping Centre if you're in need of some retail therapy. At this hotel you can enjoy:-Free Wi-Fi An electric car charging point Express Start™ Free breakfast In good weather, savour a delicious English or continental breakfast on the deck area, where you can also admire views of the racecourse with a drink in hand in the evenings. Discounts at 1 racecourse restaurant in the city centre means you can tuck into tasty dishes with a bit of change left over for a bet. After strolling back from dinner, retire to an inviting Next Generation room with Smart TV, USB ports and blackout curtains.

36584.description: Welcome to town and gown. Coventry South is just a mortar's board throw away from Warwick University. But there's plenty of business being done here too, with the Jaguar and LandRover HQs nearby. Whatever drives your stay, you're in the perfect location. Catch a show or an exhibition at Warwick Arts Centre, or throw a teambuilding day at Stoneleigh Park. Stroll through Coventry city centre and marvel at the world-famous cathedral. Our friendly team will help you enjoy your stay to the full and our spacious rooms and extra-comfy beds will have you relaxing into the land of nod in no time. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London Gatwick Crawley

36598.address: The Squareabout Haslett Ave East, Crawley
36598.description: Convenient Hotel in Crawley Town Centre with Breakfast IncludedHoliday Inn Express® London Gatwick - Crawley hotel is less than a 15-minute drive from Gatwick Airport (LGW). The hotel is just off the M23 near Crawley town centre. It’s a short stroll to Three Bridges station for trains to London, Brighton and the Sussex coast. Catch a show at The Hawth theatre, a quick walk away, or wander into Crawley to browse the shops or grab a bite to eat at the County Mall. You can tee off at the nearby Tilgate Forest Golf Centre, or take the kids to spy otters and owls at Tilgate Nature Centre. Hever Castle, Anne Boleyn's childhood home, is a 30-minute drive, and Wakehurst Place country estate is even closer. Business guests are within easy reach of Manor Royal Business District, for meetings with Virgin Atlantic, CGG, Thales or Boeing. You can also host up to 25 people in our Crawley hotels conference room. At our hotel near Gatwick Airport you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- All Day Dining menus- Express Start™ Breakfast included in the room rate- On-site parkingRooms include blackout curtains for a good night’s sleep. If you’re travelling with kids, you can choose a room with a sofa bed. Start the day with a hearty breakfast of scrambled eggs, baked beans and sausages. For lunch or dinner, our all-day dining menu is available.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London Croydon by IHG

36697.description: A central Croydon hotel with bright, thoughtfully designed rooms and breakfast includedHoliday Inn Express® London - Croydon is in the centre of Croydon, next to the Centrale Shopping Centre. It’s a short walk to East Croydon station, where direct trains speed you to London Victoria or London Bridge in 20 minutes. Gatwick Airport (LGW) is also 20 minutes on the train, or 30 minutes by car. You’ll find a tram stop a few steps from the hotel. If you’re in town for a Crystal Palace game, it’s a short drive or bus ride to Selhurst Park Stadium. For your event needs, 8 versatile, fully equipped meeting rooms provide space for up to 65 guests. With plenty of natural light, these high-floor rooms offer sweeping views over London, and refreshments are available to suit your needs. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- A pillow menuFuel up for the day with the included Express Start™ Breakfast with a range of hot English and continental choices.

36698.description:
Holiday Inn Express® London – Dartford is conveniently located just off the M25, only a 35-minute drive from both London City Airport (LCY) and Gatwick Airport (LGW). Ebbsfleet International Station, less than 15 minutes away by car, offers Eurostar services to Europe. 

Guests can enjoy easy access to top shopping destinations, including Lakeside and Bluewater Shopping Centres. For a memorable family day out, the historic Leeds Castle is just a 30-minute drive away. Motorsport fans will appreciate being only 10 miles from Brands Hatch Circuit, while central London is easily reached in around 30 minutes from nearby Dartford train station. 

After a busy day, unwind in the hotel lounge with a refreshing drink and pizza, or relax in your room with fast, free Wi-Fi, a wall-mounted TV, bedside USB ports and an en-suite bathroom with a power shower. Start your day right with the free breakfast buffet, or grab a quick bite with our convenient Grab & Go option if you’re on the move.

36710.description: A modern hotel 12 minutes by train from Leeds city centre, with breakfast included, free parking and free Wi-Fi. Holiday Inn Express® Leeds - East hotel offers easy access to the North via the M1 and M62 motorways, ten minutes' drive away. Leeds city centre is seven miles from the hotel, with fast, direct trains from nearby Woodlesford station. It takes about half an hour to drive to Leeds Bradford Airport (LBA) to catch a flight. You can host a business meeting or a training day for up to 30 delegates in the Oulton Suite, which has natural daylight, overhead projectors, air conditioning and complimentary refreshments. If you're set for a long day, catered buffet lunches can be provided. After a meeting, you can treat your clients to a round of golf at Oulton Hall Golf Club, a 10-minute walk away. The shops and restaurants of Leeds Trinity shopping centre and the nightlife of the Northern Quarter are a short train ride away, in the city centre. Or you can explore the country mansion and parkland at 500-year-old Temple Newsam House,  five miles away. Fill up on sausages, baked beans and scrambled eggs as part of the hotel's inclusive Express Start breakfast. Hotel staffs are happy to order takeaways or offer restaurant recommendations, or you can just unwind with a beer and enjoy live sport on TV in the bar and lounge.

36712.description: Smart hotel in Hemel Hempstead with a gym, sauna, indoor swimming pool and conference facilities. Holiday Inn Hemel Hempstead M1, Jct. 8 hotel has everything you need for a seamless stay, including free WiFi, an Open Lobby with a bar, restaurant and lounge, Spirit Health Club with a gym, pool and sauna facilities, and kids stay and eat free!Stylish hotel rooms have Smart TVs and pillow menus for customised comfort. All Day Dining means you can grab a bite to eat at any hour from the To Go Cafe, or enjoy a quiet night in with 24-hour room service. Here for work? Our 7 light-filled function rooms and breakout lounge offer space for up to 130 guests. A dedicated host can help personalise your business meeting. We also host amazing social events!Our Hemel Hempstead hotel is within 2 minutes of the M1 and 5 minutes from M25 motorways. Buses to London Victoria leave from right outside our accommodation, and Luton Airport is 8 miles away. We're also just minutes from direct trains to London via Hemel Hempstead Station. Take the kids on an adventure at the Warner Bros Studios, Harry Potter Studio Tour is only 12-minute drive. Or head over, a quick drive to the historic St Albans town centre, Cathedral and Abbey, as well as the majestic 11th-century Berkhamsted Castle.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Leeds City Centre

36717.address: Cavendish Street (Off Kirkstall Road), W Yorkshire, N/A
36717.description: Centrally located in Leeds, the Holiday Inn Express Leeds City Centre is a convenient base for exploring the city. Within a 5-minute drive, you'll find the University of Leeds and the First Direct Arena. This hotel offers 122 air-conditioned rooms with amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, LED TVs with digital programming, and private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy a complimentary buffet breakfast each morning, and other dining options include The Great Room restaurant and a snack bar/deli. Additional facilities include a business center, meeting rooms, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and on-site parking (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include the Royal Armouries and Leeds Town Hall.

36720.description: The 4-star Holiday Inn Liverpool City Centre is located in the heart of this walkable city, with adjacent car parking and across from Lime Street Station. Catch direct trains to London, Manchester, and Scotland, plus Merseyrail for visits around the Wirral and the broader city region. The award-winning hotel has 139 modern, air-conditioned bedrooms, ensuring a clean and comfortable stay, and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi. The View Restaurant offers an all-day dining menu with marvelous views of the historic St. George's Quarter. Grab a Starbucks at the To Go Café or relax in the open lobby with refreshments while working at the E Bar. A 24-hour mini-gym is also available. The hotel's meeting and events wing has seven function rooms that can host over 300 people for meetings, conferences, weddings, and private events. Numerous brand-name and independent restaurants, bars, shops, and nightlife options are all close by. Sports fans can hop on the football bus for match days at Anfield or Hill Dickinson Stadium. Avid golfers have a choice of over five dream golf courses in the area, including Royal Liverpool Hoylake, home of the 2023 Open Championship. Nearby, the Liverpool Exhibition Centre and ACC Liverpool host great shows, conferences, and concerts, with St. George's Hall, the Royal Court Theatre, the Liverpool Philharmonic Hall, and the Empire Theatre just a stone's throw from this award-winning hotel. The Knowledge Quarter, home to The Spine, Royal Liverpool Hospital, and university campuses, is a short walk away.

36758.description: Explore London from our Modern Stratford HotelThe family-friendly Holiday Inn Express® London - Stratford hotel is a 10-minute walk from Stratford Tube and DLR station, where you can catch direct trains to London City Airport and the O2 arena. From Stratford International station, a 15-minute walk away, you can take high-speed trains to St Pancras station. You can also catch the fantastic new Elizabeth Line which can take you from Stratford straight to Heathrow without having to change. The landmark venues of Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park sports complex, and the towering ArcelorMittal Orbit sculpture are nearby the hotel. The restaurants, cinema and bowling alley of the expansive Westfield Stratford City shopping centre is located by the main station. Business guests are a 15-minute DLR ride away from the ExCel London exhibition centre. Host meetings at our Stratford London hotel for up to 80 people in the five flexible, air-conditioned spaces, with natural light and free Wi-Fi.  Limited on-site parking is available on a first come first serve basis for a daily fee of £20. Set yourself up for the day with Express Start Breakfast included, served in the modern dining area, which is also open for evening meals. The open-plan lounge bar area is a great spot to chat with colleagues and friends over a glass of wine, or relax at the table with a pint of draught beer.

36759.description: Contemporary hotel with breakfast included and free Wi-Fi, close to top London attractionsHoliday Inn Express® London - Limehouse hotel sits near the Thames River in a historic part of London close to major attractions. It's less than 5 minutes' walk from Limehouse DLR station, where trains travel to central London in about 20 minutes and to the O2 arena and London City Airport (LCY) in less than 30 minutes. Whether you want to explore the Tower of London, shop at Westfield Stratford City or see a popular band at the O2 arena, you can get around easily via public transport. You're right next to London's East End, a vibrant area with shops, restaurants and art galleries, and Bethnal Green's V&A Museum of Childhood. Business guests have a direct 30-minute link to the ExCeL centre, and the art deco Troxy theatre and concert venue is just seven minutes' walk away. Back at the hotel, two naturally lit meeting rooms can host up to 30 people, and you can have a working lunch catered. The Business Centre is open until midnight, and your delegates will appreciate the free Wi-Fi, available throughout the hotel. Start the day with an inclusive Express Start Breakfast buffet of scrambled eggs, sausages, baked beans and continental items. An airy lobby bar serves drinks and a selection of sandwiches.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London Swiss Cottage

36760.description: The modern Holiday Inn Express London - Swiss Cottage offers free WiFi and an inclusive breakfast, just minutes from London's main attractions and within easy reach of Heathrow Airport. Located a short walk from Finchley Road Tube station, with Metropolitan and Jubilee line connections, guests can quickly reach Oxford Street and other central locations. Heathrow Airport is easily accessible via the Tube and Heathrow Express train. On-site parking is available for guests arriving by car. Nearby, explore the charming canals of Little Venice or discover bargains and diverse food options at Camden Market, a short Overground train ride away. The O2 Centre, offering shopping and dining, is also just steps from the hotel. For business travelers, the hotel features a naturally lit, air-conditioned meeting room for up to 25 people, as well as a Business Centre with fax, PC, and copier facilities. Free WiFi is available throughout the hotel. Start your day with the included Express Start breakfast buffet, featuring fruit, yogurt, cereals, hot eggs, baked beans, and sausages.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Chingford North Circular

36761.description: Holiday Inn Express London Chingford offers a comfortable and convenient base to explore the city’s attractions with modern amenities, nearby attractions, and excellent transport links. Walthamstow Central Station has direct links to London Euston. Catch flights from London City Airport, 11 miles away, or Stansted Airport is a 30-minute drive along the M11. On-site parking is managed by YourParkingSpace and is available for £10 per day. Tick off top London attractions with ease. The Tower of London, Buckingham Palace, the British Museum and Big Ben are all easily accessible via public transport. Cheer on Tottenham Hotspur FC at the Spurs’ Stadium, less than four miles away. Escape the hustle and bustle of the city. Visit the picturesque Epping Forest, a 15-minute drive away, for walking trails and picnic spots, or head to the nearby William Morris Gallery. Roam around the beautiful gardens in Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, watch events in the aquatics centre and enjoy panoramic views across the city atop the ArcelorMittal Orbit sculpture. After a day’s exploring, refuel with pizzas and drinks from the bar and when you wake up, enjoy an inclusive buffet breakfast in the Great Room lounge.

name.content: voco London Camden Lock by IHG

36763.description: Located in the heart of London, the voco London Camden Lock by IHG offers convenient access to top attractions like The British Museum and Hyde Park, both within a 10-minute drive. This upscale hotel provides 130 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with deep soaking bathtubs. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at the Mezzanine Restaurant and coffee shop/cafe, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A fitness center, concierge services, and a business center are also available. For those planning events, the hotel boasts over 6, 000 square feet of meeting space.

36764.description: Situated opposite Colliers Wood Underground station on the Northern Line, this modern hotel offers convenient access to central London, with Waterloo just 20 minutes and Leicester Square 30 minutes away. Popular attractions such as Legoland and Chessington World of Adventures are a 30-minute drive away, while Wimbledon's renowned tennis and greyhound racing venues are merely 5 minutes from the hotel. Heathrow and Gatwick Airports are easily accessible via the A3 and M25 motorways. The hotel's 83 air-conditioned rooms provide a comfortable stay, featuring private bathrooms with power showers, Sky TV, workspaces, internet access, and tea/coffee making facilities. Guests can also enjoy complimentary continental breakfast and make use of the hotel's lounge, bar, and conference facilities, complete with high-speed Wi-Fi. Secure underground parking is available for a fee. Five accessible rooms cater to guests with disabilities.

36765.description: A central London hotel with 52 modern rooms and easy access to Victoria Station and the West EndHoliday Inn Express® London Victoria hotel, housed in a historic building, is a 10-minute walk from Victoria Station, which has express trains to Gatwick Airport (LGW). Pimlico Tube station, with fast links to the city’s main shopping districts and the West End, is only three minutes away. Free on-street parking is available 6:30pm–8:30am on weekdays and all weekend. A car park is within walking distance of the hotel. The Apollo Victoria and Victoria Palace theatres are a 10-minute walk from the hotel. You are only a couple of Tube stops from the shopping hubs of Bond Street and Oxford Street. Some of London’s major sights, including Buckingham Palace and the Houses of Parliament, are less than half an hour away on foot. The nearby Queen Mother Sports Centre has a gym and an indoor pool. The QEII Centre, one of London’s largest exhibition spaces, is a 30-minute walk from the hotel. The financial districts of The City and Canary Wharf are about 20 minutes away by Tube, and it’s a 40-minute trip to ExCeL London. Business visitors can take advantage of inclusive Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Guests enjoy a complimentary breakfast each morning, and the Beverley Bar in the lobby serves drinks and snacks until late. There are many dining options in the surrounding area.

36766.description: The Holiday Inn Express London - Southwark offers a central London location near Southwark and Blackfriars Tube stations, providing easy access to attractions like the Tate Modern, Shakespeare's Globe, and Borough Market. Business travelers are within a short walk of The Shard and the London Stock Exchange. Amenities include free WiFi, on-site parking, a Business Centre, and the Express Start™ Breakfast buffet with hot and cold items. Relax after a day of sightseeing or meetings in the lobby bar.

36772.description: Welcome to the Holiday Inn Express in Gateshead, just off the A1 Motorway and a 10-minute drive from Newcastle Airport. Enjoy free parking and easy access to Newcastle city centre, with a convenient bus service running every 10 minutes from outside the hotel. Our hotel is near some of Newcastle's top attractions. Discover over 250 brands at the Metrocentre just across the road to get your shopping fix or get hands-on with interactive exhibits at the Discovery Museum, a 10-minute drive away. Explore the fascinating Beamish Museum, the Living Museum of the North or cheer on Newcastle United at St James' Park, both reachable within 20 minutes. Music lovers will enjoy performances at The Glasshouse International Centre for Music, previously known as Sage Gateshead. For live concerts and sports, guests can catch top performances at Utilitia Arena, a 10-minute drive from our hotel. Discover the iconic Angel of the North or relax at Blyth Beach, both of which can be reached within a 25-minute drive. Enjoy comfortable rooms with free Wi-Fi, en-suite bathrooms with showers, and essential amenities like a work desk and iron. Start your day right with our free breakfast buffet, offering a variety of hot and cold options, fresh fruit juice, and hot drinks.

name.content: Holiday Inn Stoke on Trent M6, Jct.15

36773.description: A family-friendly Stoke on Trent hotel with meeting rooms and a Health ClubHoliday Inn® Stoke on Trent M6, Jct. 15 hotel is only 3 miles from Stoke-on-Trent city centre. We’re a handy base for Stoke City FC games at the bet365 Stadium, a family visit to Alton Towers theme park, or a trip to the Peak District National Park. China buffs will get all fired up in the museums and pottery shops of the Potteries district in Stoke-on-Trent. Nearby Stoke-on-Trent station has direct trains to London, Manchester Birmingham and Derby, and you can drive to Manchester Airport (MAN) or East Midlands Airport (EMA) in around 45 minutes. Our well-equipped onsite meeting rooms have space for up to 150 guests, and our meeting coordinators will help keep everything running smoothly. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- Free parking- To Go Café- Kids stay freeWake up to an invigorating workout, a relaxing sauna or a brisk swim at You Fit Health Club. Relax with a Starbucks coffee in our inviting Open Lobby, where the whole family can kick back in vintage armchairs in the Media Lounge. Our comfortable bedrooms all have satellite TV, as well as blackout blinds and a choice of pillows to ensure a good night’s rest.

36774.description: Smart, contemporary hotel with free Wi-Fi and included Grab and Go breakfast 20 minutes from central London. Holiday Inn Express® London - Park Royal hotel is a three-minute drive from the A40 motorway and around the corner from North Acton Tube station. Catch the Central line to inner-city London in 20 minutes or to Westfield London shops and restaurants in eight minutes. If you're landing at Heathrow Airport, you'll find the hotel just 40 minutes away by rail. London attractions like Buckingham Palace and the British Museum are a quick trip from the hotel. Vast Kew Gardens awaits you just four miles away, and Ealing Studios,  home to ''Downton Abbey'' and several hit films, is three miles away. See rock concerts and football games at Wembley Stadium, 20 minutes' drive away. The hotel is in the heart of the Park Royal Business Centre, with over 1, 200 companies, and less than four miles from the Wembley Conference Centre. An on-site conference room comes equipped with all you need for a successful boardroom meeting for up to 14 people. Modern and inviting public spaces make your stay at the hotel fun and convenient, and there's free Wi-Fi throughout. Wake up to an inclusive Grab and Go Breakfast. Relax at any time of day in the casual Express Café and Bar.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Birmingham Oldbury M5/Jct.2

36777.description: Holiday Inn Express Birmingham Oldbury is close to the M5 and a 15-minute drive from Birmingham city centre. Board direct trains to London and Glasgow from Sandwell &Dudley station less than 2 miles away or catch flights off from Birmingham Airport, a 30-minute drive away. Visit local companies in Birmingham Business Park in half an hour. Immerse yourself in the rich industrial history of the region with a visit to the nearby Black Country Living Museum. Experience the sights and sounds of the past as you explore reconstructed buildings and interact with costumed characters. If you fancy some retail therapy, visit Merry Hill Shopping Centre, a 20-minute drive away, or head into central Birmingham for the Bullring. For a day of adventure and wildlife with the family, Dudley Zoo and Castle is four miles away. Roam the castle grounds and spot animals from around the world. Book a trip to West Midlands Safari Park for a thrilling safari experience or indulge your sweet tooth at Cadbury World. Walk through a transparent tunnel surrounded by sharks and learn about the importance of ocean conservation at The National Sea Life Centre. When you return, order pizzas and drinks from the bar and when you wake up, enjoy a free buffet breakfast in the Great Room.

36979.address: Avenue Vista Hermosa N 13, Fracc Peninsula de Sant
36979.description:
With a stay at Barceló Karmina All Inclusive in Manzanillo, you'll be next to a golf course, within a 10-minute drive of Playa La Audiencia and Las Hadas Golf Course. This upscale property is 1. 3 mi (2 km) from Playa Azul Salagua and 1. 3 mi (2. 1 km) from Orus Casino. Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. After dipping into one of the 6 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. This property also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, . Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 324 air-conditioned rooms featuring free minibar items. Rooms have private furnished balconies or patios. Wireless internet access (surcharge) keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature separate bathtubs and showers with rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. This property is all inclusive. Rates include meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

Grab a bite at Bugambilias, one of the property's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. When you are in need of a refreshing drink, visit the beach bar or one of 5 bars/lounges, or 2 poolside bars.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Swindon City Centre

36998.description: A modern hotel refurbished in 2024 located near the train station in central Swindon, with a free hot breakfast and free Wi-Fi. Holiday Inn Express® Swindon City Centre hotel is in the centre of town and a quick walk from restaurants and bars, as well as shopping at the McArthur Glen Designer Outlets. We have a small car park on site and alternative car parking at preferential rates within a 1-minute walk from the hotel. Business guests are a short stroll from the local corporate headquarters of Zurich, Nationwide, GWR and Network Rail. Back at the hotel, three fully equipped state-of-the-art meeting rooms with free Wi-Fi are a convenient place to hold a workshop or seminar for up to 25 delegates. Fishing and watersports are just a 30-minute drive away at the Cotswold Water Park and the ancient Ridgeway route offers plenty of opportunities for hiking, cycling and horseback riding. Further afield, history lovers will delight in Barbury Castle, the remains of an Iron Age fort, and world-famous Stonehenge. The city of Bath, with its Roman ruins, is just half an hour away by rail. Or why not visit Longleat? Perfect for kids’ days out. Start the day with the hotel's Express Start Breakfast, featuring pastries, a pancake machine, continental items including natural yogurt and fresh fruit, bacon, sausages, scrambled eggs, hash browns, tomatoes and beans, and end it with a nourishing evening meal or kick back with a refreshing drink in the hotel bar.

37083.description: Waterfront hotel near London with top-notch meeting and banquet facilities. Overlooking the Grand Union Canal, Holiday Inn® London - Brentford Lock hotel is within easy reach of central London. Boston Manor Tube Station, with direct service to the city and Heathrow Airport (LHR), is less than 2 miles away. Nearby Brentford Station has direct trains to London Waterloo. Cheer on your favourite team at Twickenham Stadium, or explore the London Museum of Water & Steam. We're 10 minutes by car from Kew Gardens and a 20-minute drive to the semi-wilderness of Richmond Park. GlaxoSmithKline headquarters are within walking distance. A dedicated Conference Suite can host up to 700 guests in a total of six meeting rooms. Facing the canal, the Waterfront Suite is the perfect spot for a big celebration. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free Wi-Fi- A Fitness Centre- On-site parking- A deck overlooking the canal- Kids stay and eat freeComfortable rooms include pillow menus and refreshing power showers. The warmly inviting Open Lobby features a Chef's Station at breakfast, a To Go Café, Starbucks coffee, a Media Lounge and an E-bar with computer access. All Day Dining means you can order what you like, when you like, from the restaurant and bar, or you can take advantage of 24-hour room service.

37126.description: Quiet hotel with an Open Lobby and indoor pool near Liverpool and ManchesterJust beside the M56 motorway, Holiday Inn® Runcorn hotel welcomes you for an event, business trip or holiday. It's a short drive to Runcorn station, with direct trains to Liverpool and London, and Runcorn East station, serving Chester and Manchester. You're also just 20 minutes by car from Liverpool John Lennon Airport (LPL) and 30 minutes from Manchester Airport (MAN). You can go bargain-hunting at the nearby Cheshire Oaks Designer Outlet and Manchester's Trafford Centre, or take your kids for a day of fun at Chester Zoo or Knowsley Safari Park. Here on business? You're close to several industrial estates, and you can arrange a conference for up to 500 people in the hotel's Cheshire Suite, which can be partitioned into smaller rooms. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free Wi-Fi- A fitness centre with an indoor pool- Free on-site parking- Kids stay and eat freeUnwind in a cosy guest room with TV and a pillow menu to suit your needs. You can indulge in a juicy steak at the Cow on the Hill grill, take advantage of 24-hour room service or grab a bite from the All Day Dining menu. The Open Lobby bar is just the place for a drink, while the Media Lounge, with comfortable seating, a TV and games, is an inviting spot to relax and socialise.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London Royal Docks

37130.description: A smart, convenient London Docklands hotel with free Wi-Fi and included breakfast near The O2 arena and Canary WharfIn the heart of London's Docklands, Holiday Inn Express® London - Royal Docks, Docklands hotel is convenient for a business or leisure trip. You can walk to Canning Town Tube and DLR station in four minutes, and from there, there are fast connections to London City Airport and central London. The nearest bus stop is a two-minute walk away. The hotel is a 10-minute walk from the Emirates Air Line cable car. For a big concert or event, The O2 arena is one stop away by Tube. Westfield Stratford City shopping centre and Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, with its Aquatics Centre and kids' playgrounds, are both three miles north of the hotel. Guests heading to an exhibition are a 10-minute walk from the Royal Victoria Dock, home to both The Crystal and ExCel London. Hosting a conference? You can invite 40 delegates to the largest of the hotel's three meeting rooms. If you're visiting a local business, the hotel is just two miles from Canary Wharf. Help yourself to scrambled eggs, baked beans and sausages each morning as part of the inclusive Express Start Breakfast, and check emails using the free Wi-Fi. At dinner time, you can find several restaurants in the area around the hotel. Or simply relax with a drink in the lobby bar.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London - Stansted Airport

37137.description: Located near Stansted Airport in Bishop's Stortford, the Holiday Inn Express London Stansted Airport offers convenient access to Bishop's Stortford Golf Club (a 5-minute drive). This hotel is 14. 3 miles from Audley End House and 3. 4 miles from Flitch Way Country Park. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, a vending machine, and an on-site restaurant, The Great Room, along with a bar/lounge for a relaxing drink. A complimentary continental breakfast is served weekdays from 4:00 AM to 9:30 AM and weekends from 4:00 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel's 254 guestrooms feature complimentary Wi-Fi, digital programming, and private bathrooms with showers and hair dryers. Coffee/tea makers and irons/ironing boards are also provided for your convenience. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and five meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours), and self-parking is available on-site (subject to charges).

37139.description: Our hotel in Stoke on Trent offers comfortable and spacious rooms for a memorable stay. Kickstart your day with our Express™ breakfast buffet, which is always included, before exploring the city's top attractions. You’ll find our Holiday Inn Express hotel next to the M6 and a 45-minute from East Midlands Airport (EMA) and Manchester Airport (MAN). Guest parking is charged at £7 per 24 hours. Collect a code from reception at check-in to benefit from this discount. Stoke City FC fans will appreciate our hotel's convenient location to Bet365 football stadium – we’re across the road. The Stoke Ski Centre at Festival Park is a 10-minute drive from the hotel and offers winter sports fun for all ages. Drive to Alton Towers in 30-minutes for a perfect day out and an unforgettable theme park experience. Trentham Gardens is a peaceful oasis, great for a leisurely stroll, and Trentham Monkey Forest offers a unique encounter for the kids to spot monkeys. Waterworld is the place to be for swimming and slides, and The Potteries Museum &Art Gallery provides a glimpse into the area's rich history and culture. Unwind at the end of the day in our modern and family-friendly rooms. Complete with handy amenities like fast and free Wi-Fi, power shower, a desk with chair and coffee making facilities. Whether you’re with the family or on a business trip, we’ve got you covered. Enjoy food around the clock on our snack menu or sit back with a glass of wine or hot drink before a great night’s rest.

37164.description: Stunningly situated on the edge of the Cotswolds between Oxford and Swindon, this superb hotel boasts a peaceful, tranquil setting amidst captivating surroundings. Set among 9 acres of beautiful gardens, the hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality and the promise of unrivalled service. The guest rooms are sumptuously decorated, featuring soothing tones and traditional touches. Guests are invited to wine and dine in style amidst the relaxing surroundings of the restaurant, where mouth-watering culinary delights are the order of the day. Guests will appreciate the hotel's selection of exemplary facilities, which ensure that the needs of even the most discerning business and leisure travellers are fully catered for.

37338.description: Welcome to our central Luton hotel, featuring our new generation bedrooms with an impressive 40" flat screen and brand new, slumber-inducing, king-size Hypnos bed. The hotel is ideally situated for both business and leisure guests. Luton Town Railway Station is just 0. 5 miles away, with connections to the North, and to London and the South. The hotel is just 2 miles from London Luton Airport and within easy reach of the M1 Junction 10. The Arndale Centre provides excellent shopping opportunities, with the Galaxy Leisure Centre offering a multi-screen complex and bowling facilities - all within a 5 minute walk of the hotel. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

37676.description: This stylish boutique hotel is just 10 km away from Gatwick, in London. The property is within easy access of everything that the culturally-rich, captivating city centre of London has to offer. This luxurious hotel boasts a stunning architectural design. Set in a country house, amidst 120 acres of parkland, the property offers a peaceful, inviting retreat, in which to experience well-deserved luxury and relaxation. The spacious guest rooms feature large beds and marble bathrooms, many of which come complete with Victorian baths. The ultimate rejuvenation can be enjoyed in the spa, which comprises plunge pools, a yoga studio and a wide range of beauty treatments. A gym, fitness suite and tennis courts meet guests' leisure needs, while a delectable restaurant satiates visitors' dining expectations.

38699.description: Explore the best of London from Holiday Inn Express London Wandsworth. Heathrow Airport is 10 miles away, Catch flights from Gatwick Airport (LGW) via Clapham Junction Station, or Heathrow Airport (LHR) is just over an hour away. We also have parking available at £30 a day. Wandsworth town station is a 5-minute walk away, and Clapham Junction is a bit further. Stroll along the river in Wandsworth Park or take a boat trip along the Thames for scenic views of the Houses of Parliament and Tower Bridge. On sunny days, head to Clapham Common for a picnic. Browse the shops at Southside Shopping Centre or enjoy a show at Battersea Arts Centre. Hop on the London Underground to visit infamous sights like Big Ben, The London Eye, Buckingham Palace and St Paul’s Cathedral. Catch musicals and plays in the West End or head to Stamford Bridge to cheer on Chelsea FC. Watch rugby at nearby Twickenham Stadium or if you’re in town for tennis at Wimbledon, it’s a short tube ride away. Order a pizza and pint from the bar and relax in the hotel lounge after a day’s sightseeing. In the morning, tuck into a buffet breakfast, included for every guest.

38759.description: On school or national holidays, this hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has kids amenities available on requestThe DoubleTree by Hilton London ExCel hotel is situated on a dramatic waterfront on the banks of the historic Royal Victoria Dock London. A warm welcome to the bustling East London awaits. Enjoy the convenience and our proximity to London City Airport, with an enviable closeness to the ExCel London and ICC London. Be in your guest room within minutes of landing into the heart of the docks, and relaxing in our lounge bar within minutes of closing your meeting. If you're looking to enjoy the tourist sites of London, the hotel's superb transport links are just 20-25 minutes from the Docklands Light Railway, Stratford, The City, London Bridge, Tower of London and Central London. For music lovers, stroll along the dock and fly the Emirates Airline to The O2, taking in the sights of a stunning Canary Wharf backdrop along the way. For sports fans the Queen Elizabeth Park is easily accessible. Even Wimbledon and Wembley are easy commutes away. Relax in a spacious guest room with modern decor, complimentary WiFi, HDTV and climate control. Upgrade your room for that little touch of luxury, including deluxe rooms with floor-to-ceiling views and many with balconies and water views. Our stunning suites on the highest floors of the hotel offer uncompromised views of the Royal Docks, London City Airport and Canary Wharf, all with separate lounge, luxury decor and walk-in rain shower rooms. We've got space for all the family with interconnecting rooms. Stay committed to your workout in the 24-hour Fitness Centre. Our sustainable restaurant, The Salt Port Restaurant & Delicatessen, embraces the history of the royal docks, offering a delicious all-day dining menu.

38760.description: London O2 hotel close to Canary Wharf and Emirates Cable Car with breakfast included. Holiday Inn Express® London – Greenwich hotel is five miles from London City Airport (LCY), and London Euston station is a 35-minute tube ride away. Parking is available for 35 GBP per night. Ready to explore London? Hop on a bus to the Royal Observatory Greenwich, National Maritime Museum and Cutty Sark Ship Museum. Take a cruise on a Thames Clipper river bus from North Greenwich Pier or enjoy aerial views of London with Emirates Air Line cable cars. Sing your heart out at gigs at the nearby O2 Arena or check out the latest exhibits at the National History Museum. Host a conference for 70 in the hotel’s two flexible meeting rooms or attend events at the nearby ExCeL London exhibition centre. Canary Wharf is a 15-minute drive for visiting the offices of American Express, Barclays PLC, IBM and KPMG. Recharge your batteries in the comfy rooms with bedside USB ports and a large flat-screen TV or sip a refreshing gin and tonic in the bar. Choose from classic dishes like fish and chips, burgers and pizzas to enjoy in the hotel’s lounge while uploading your snaps of London on the fast and free Wi-Fi. In the morning, wake up to breakfast included.

38781.description: Stay connected with Premier Inn Hotel South Mimms/Potters Bar. Just off the M25 motorway, we're in a great spot to help break up a long journey. And if you've time to stop and explore, you'll also be well placed to zip off to business and leisure destinations in London. Hop on the train for all the sights and sounds of central London. Catch the big match at Wembley Stadium. Or take a magical trip to Hogwarts on the Harry Potter Studio Tour. After a busy day, return for a tasty meal in our restaurant and a great night's sleep in your lovely, comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

38799.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. This Victorian hotel also features wedding services, a fireplace in the lobby, and tour/ticket assistance. Enjoy a satisfying meal at Station Road serving guests of The Lovat, Loch Ness. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 28 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

39218.description: This attractive hotel boasts a prime setting on the stunning Costa Dorada. It is situated amidst a residential area, just 800 metres away from the city centre. Numerous shopping opportunities, restaurants and bars can be found just a short distance away. Port Aventura theme park is situated close by, offering fun for guests of all ages. Guests will find themselves within easy access of many vineyards, as well as the monasteries of the Cistercian Route. Reus Airport is conveniently situated just 20 km from the hotel, while Barcelona Airport is 85 km away. This charming hotel is sure to impress, offering a relaxing ambiance. The guest rooms are superbly styled, featuring modern elements and functional space. Guests are invited to avail of the many facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

39716.description: This hotel is situated on a main road, directly overlooking a sandy beach, in Altafulla. It is located just 2 km away from Torredembarra. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to a number of attractions in the area, including the castle. Links to the public transport network can be found just 20 metres away. This hotel features tastefully-designed, well-equipped guest rooms. Guests are invited to savour the delights that the restaurant menu has to offer. The hotel offers visitors a wide range of excellent facilities and services. Themed dinners can be enjoyed in the gardens in the evenings, while during the day, open air activities are organised.

39763.description: Strategically situated in Bromley, Kent, this sophisticated hotel is located a mere 16 km away from the south-east side of the centre of London. Set amidst 2 acres of landscaped gardens, this hotel offers a convenient setting from which to explore the area. Occupying the original building, which was once the family home of Lord Farnborough, this heritage hotel offers guests historical surroundings. Embracing the charm of a bygone era, the hotel enjoys refined elegance blended with contemporary amenities. The guest rooms are beautifully decorated, featuring modern amenities and soothing tones for the convenience of business and leisure travellers. The hotel offers a myriad of excellent facilities, catering to the needs of every type of guest.

39920.description: The upscale Mercure London Heathrow Hotel, located in Hayes (Pinkwell), is within a 15-minute drive of both Windsor Castle and LEGOLAND® Windsor. It's also conveniently close to Wembley Stadium (9. 7 miles) and Hampton Court Palace (9. 8 miles). The hotel offers 184 guestrooms equipped with refrigerators, flat-screen televisions with satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences are phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Guests can enjoy a workout in the fitness center or take advantage of the concierge services. The hotel also provides wedding services and has a television in the common area. Dine at Borders Restaurant and bar/lounge, or order room service (limited hours). Full breakfasts are available daily (fee applies). Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, express check-out, a conference center, and six meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

40388.description: This hotel is located directly in the centre of London and offers views out over Kensington Palace. It is housed in a 19th century historic building and comprises a total of 57 rooms spread over 6 floors. Facilities available to guests include a stylish air-conditioned foyer, a charming bar, and an à la carte restaurant with highchairs for infants. The tastefully designed and spacious rooms come with an en-suite bathroom and a comfortable king-size bed. Further fittings include satellite/cable TV and individually regulated central heating. The hotel offers the use of an indoor heated swimming pool and a massage service. Sport enthusiasts may enjoy their routine workout in the gym and take advantage of the sauna.

name.content: Hilton Grand Vacations Club Craigendarroch Suites

40887.description: Enjoy a Scottish getaway to the Cairngorms National Park at the Hilton Grand Vacations Club at Craigendarroch Suites. Set in Royal Deeside, just an hour from Aberdeen Airport, this Victorian country hotel offers the perfect location close to Balmoral Castle and outdoor activities in the Scottish Highlands. Settle in to a warm and inviting guest room or suite at this Royal Deeside hotel. Keep in touch with complimentary WiFi or curl up to watch the 32-inch TV. Select a spacious suite for upgraded amenities including a balcony. Take some time out and enjoy the array of recreational amenities for children and adults alike. Swim laps or take an aqua aerobics class in the lagoon-style pool as the children enjoy the kid's pool with slide. Children adore meeting new friends at the Acorn Club, held during the school holidays.
