Maintain your exercise regime with a workout at the fully-equipped fitness center, play squash or tennis, rent a bicycle to explore the area, or book a treatment at the spa. Indulge in delicious Scottish cuisine in the elegant restaurant.

41285.description: Centrally located in London, Roseate House London is a luxury hotel within a short walk of St. Mary's Hospital and Paddington Central. Enjoy views from the terrace and garden, and take advantage of complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and discounted access to a nearby fitness center. The 47 air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, ensuite bathrooms with bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include in-room safes, desks, and phones. The hotel offers a restaurant, bar/lounge, and room service (limited hours). Buffet breakfast is available on weekdays for a fee. Other amenities include wired internet access, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park.

42028.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with **reduced service**: Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Pool, Room Service, Spa. Have a delightful stay amid acres of lush countryside at DoubleTree by Hilton Oxford Belfry. Perfect for work visits and long weekends alike, our hotel is conveniently off the M40 motorway and 10 miles from Oxford's eclectic museums and famed university. Shop designer fashions at Bicester Village or see the stunning Blenheim Palace, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. We look forward to welcoming you with a warm DoubleTree Chocolate Chip Cookie at check-in. Settle into a guest room with fresh modern décor, complimentary WiFi, an HDTV, work desk, and en suite bath/shower. Deluxe rooms offer extra space and amenities, and suites include a separate lounge area with sofa bed. Enjoy a relaxed atmosphere and tasty British cuisine from morning 'til night in our restaurant, and enjoy cocktails and light bites in the terrace bar. Room service is available 24 hours, perfect for busy schedules. Our spa entices with a relaxation lounge and 9 private treatment rooms, and the health club offers guests a heated indoor pool, steam room, sauna and fully equipped fitness center. Play tennis on our outdoor courts or unwind with a stroll in the sunny courtyard. The hotel grounds span 17 acres, with plenty of beautiful outdoor areas for weddings and photos. All 18 meeting rooms boast natural light and can stylishly accommodate any event, from board meetings to celebration dinners to corporate conferences. Let our dedicated coordinators assist with the details.

42090.description: This stately home hotel in Cheshire offers a blend of old-world charm and modern amenities. Located approximately 52 km from Manchester Airport, it's surrounded by quaint villages steeped in history, many predating the Norman Conquest. The hotel is also conveniently situated for exploring Chester, Chester Zoo, and Alton Towers. The 117-room hotel, including historic suites, features a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, and dining options like the brasserie with its unique revolving bar. Recently, a £13. 5 million investment enhanced the 17th-century hall with a dedicated Events Centre and a Health, Fitness, and Spa, complete with a Technogym, spa treatment rooms, steam room, sauna, hot tub, and an 18m indoor heated pool. A 3. 5-acre outdoor Events Field within a walled garden provides space for team-building activities. Guest rooms and suites include en suite bathrooms, hairdryers, direct-dial telephones, satellite/cable TV, internet access, radios, and central heating.

42220.description: The DoubleTree by Hilton Glasgow Strathclyde welcomes you with a freshly baked cookie and comfortable accommodations. Located in the central belt, just 12 miles from Glasgow city center and a short train ride from Bellshill station, our hotel offers convenient access to Hampden Park, the Emirates Arena, and the Eurocentral and Newhouse business districts. Glasgow's vibrant city center, with its shops, museums, and nightlife, is only 20 minutes away. Enjoy complimentary parking in our 120-space car park. Each guest room and suite features modern amenities, including high-speed Wi-Fi and a large HDTV. Upgrade to a Deluxe Room for additional space and perks such as plush bathrobes, slippers, and a one-hour extended checkout. Relax and rejuvenate at Europe's largest LivingWell Health Club, complete with state-of-the-art fitness equipment, exercise classes, and an indoor pool. Indulge in beauty and relaxation treatments at our spa, or unwind in one of the two saunas, steam rooms, or whirlpools. The Space offers Starbucks coffee, all-day dining, and a perfect setting for casual or business meetings with complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, mobile charging stations, Bluetooth connectivity, and TVs. Room service is also available 24 hours a day. For meetings and events, our flexible indoor and outdoor spaces can accommodate up to 360 delegates.

42581.description: The hotel and conference center is situated on the banks of the River Clyde in Clydebank, approximately 13 km from Glasgow Airport and 61 km from Prestwick Airport. It offers 168 stylish bedrooms, a 24-hour reception with currency exchange, an Arcoona conference room, and 14 versatile meeting rooms. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout. Guests can dine at the Acroona restaurant and enjoy the hotel's bar and cozy lounge. Free parking is provided for 300 cars. All rooms feature queen-size or twin beds and free Wi-Fi. Leisure facilities include a 15-meter swimming pool, steam room, and a fully-equipped gym.

42648.description: Do business or pleasure in style at the Best Western Garfield House Hotel. The hotel is near to Glasgow meaning you’re close to the hustle and bustle of the major city. However, in this delightful village location of Stepps you’ll be a world away from the stresses of everyday life. As part of Scotland's central belt, Stepps itself makes for a quiet, peaceful retreat, but you’re still only five miles away from the excitement and sights that Glasgow has to offer. The beautiful Edinburgh is also within easy driving reach. The hotels 3-Star bedrooms are excellent value for money, whilst nearby points of interest make the hotel an attractive spot for leisure guests. The Garfield House Hotel's meeting and conference facilities are excellent, and particularly suited to those on a working weekend or a team-building tour, in need of an escape from the busy office. As the hotel is known as such an elegant and modern place to stay near Glasgow, it proves a very popular wedding venue. Wedding reception parties fill the hotel’s lobby with joyful laughter and bubbles most weekends. The Best Western Garfield House Hotel is proud to be dog friendly, as we welcome four legged friends for only a small extra fee.

42675.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace at the Burnett Arms Hotel in Banchory, near the golf course. Make use of complimentary Wi-Fi and the games room, or store your skis after a day on the slopes. Dine at the Coach House Restaurant and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available for a fee. The hotel offers dry cleaning, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Free self-parking is available on-site. Each of the 18 guestrooms features a flat-screen television, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a private bathroom with a bathtub or shower and a hairdryer. Coffee/tea makers and daily housekeeping are also provided, and cribs are available upon request. The hotel is a short walk from Banchory Museum and Platform 22, and a short drive from Falls of Feugh and Crathes Castle. Aberdeen Airport (ABZ) is approximately 30. 6 km away.

42701.description: Mansfield Castle Hotel, a splendid example of a Scottish country house, is just five minutes from the center of the historic Pictish town of Tain, dating back to 1066. Built in the 1880s by a tea plantation family, the hotel sits amidst three acres of gardens yet remains close to local amenities. The castle offers superior rooms in the main building and standard rooms in the connected garden wing. Guests can also choose the popular Tower Suite, known for its rumored ghost, Mrs. Fowler, and breathtaking views. The standard rooms provide ample space and amenities such as power showers and trouser presses. The hotel features a full bar, restaurant, and an excellent wine list.

42759.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional amenities at this hotel include a picnic area and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to noon. Featured amenities include luggage storage and a safe deposit box at the front desk. This hotel has 2 meeting rooms available for events. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 16 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Glencorse Golf Club - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Penicuik Tower - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Pentland Hills Regional Park - 6. 3 km / 3. 9 mi- Rosslyn Chapel - 6. 6 km / 4. 1 mi- Hillend Country Park - 7. 3 km / 4. 6 mi- Napier University - 12. 8 km / 8 mi- Craigmillar Castle - 13. 7 km / 8. 5 mi- King's Theatre - 14. 4 km / 9 mi- Edinburgh Corn Exchange - 14. 5 km / 9 mi- FountainPark - 14. 6 km / 9. 1 mi- Dalhousie Castle - 14. 6 km / 9. 1 mi- John McIntyre Conference Centre - 15 km / 9. 3 mi- Holyrood Park - 15. 1 km / 9. 4 mi- Edinburgh International Conference Centre - 15. 3 km / 9. 5 mi- Festival Theatre - 15. 3 km / 9. 5 mi. The nearest major airport is Edinburgh Airport (EDI) - 23. 1 km / 14. 4 mi Located in Penicuik, The Craigie is within a 5-minute drive of Glencorse Golf Club and Penicuik Tower. This hotel is 3. 9 mi (6. 3 km) from Pentland Hills Regional Park and 9. 6 mi (15. 4 km) from Grassmarket.

43700.description: One of the most prestigious luxury hotels in the Glasgow area, Gleddoch Golf & Spa Resort, features a top-quality golf course and spa resort in addition to top quality rooms and a prime location. History and heritage also play a part in the unique charm of the hotel - which was once the awe-inspiring home of notable shipping baron, Sir William Lithgow. The outdoor terrace and outdoor hot tub are currently closed in order to commence with ground works for the arrival of the brand-new state-of-the-art outdoor spa pool, due to open early Spring! Hotel apologies for any inconvenience caused.

43995.description: The 198 welcoming guest rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Travelodge Park Royal does not offer 24-hour reception. Travelodge Park Royal may charge a fee for some services.

44806.description: A welcoming Essex hotel with an open lobby, conference centre and lakeside garden Holiday Inn® Basildon hotel is a 10-minute drive from the M25 and close to Basildon station. If you’re visiting the City of London or the Docklands on business, direct trains to Fenchurch Street station take only 35 minutes. You can host meetings, conferences or a wedding at the hotel's Conference Centre, which has space for up to 300 guests in its largest function space and optional catering. Local companies at Southfields Business Park are within a short drive of the hotel. The surrounding Festival Leisure Park offers dining and entertainment options, including a cinema, nightclubs and a bowling alley. The whole family can enjoy a trip to the Aqua Park located on the lake directly next door. At this hotel, you can enjoy a: full English breakfast, lunch and dinner served daily, room service available around the clock, comfortable rooms with a pillow menu to help you get a good night's sleep. The satellite TV and free WiFi will keep everyone entertained. In summer, you can stretch your legs, enjoy a drink from the bar or host a party in the pretty lakeside garden.

name.content: Best Western Welwyn Garden City Homestead Court

45263.description: The Best Western Welwyn Garden City Homestead Court Hotel offers rooms with a view, just one mile outside the city center. Enjoy peace and tranquility as you wander through the hotel's landscaped gardens or relax on the patio. Excellent road and rail links provide easy access to London's attractions. Whether you prefer exploring local sights like Roman baths and historic houses or engaging in activities such as fishing and birdwatching, there's something for everyone. The hotel can accommodate weddings, meetings, and events, and guests can enjoy garden views from the suites. Spacious, stylish furnishings and well-designed bedrooms with modern amenities create a comfortable atmosphere. Bedrooms with kitchen facilities are also available. Guests enjoy complimentary access to the local Gosling Sports Park (pre-booking is recommended).

45372.description: An opulent Dublin Airport hotel with bistro dining and superb conference facilities. Overlooking a serene park, Crowne Plaza® Dublin Airport hotel is only a seven-minute drive from Dublin Airport (DUB) on our eco-friendly electric shuttle bus. We are easily accessible via the M50 and M1 motorways, and Dublin City Centre can be reached in 15 minutes by car. Explore the Guinness Storehouse and enroll in a whiskey cocktail-making class at the Jameson Distillery in the city center. Visit Trinity College Library to admire the Book of Kells. Experience the energy of Gaelic football at Croke Park or an Aviva Stadium concert. Our dedicated Conference and Events Centre offers everything from private boardrooms to a versatile event suite suitable for a conference, gala dinner, awards ceremony, or other events for up to 650 guests. Our experienced Crowne Plaza Meetings Director will ensure everything runs smoothly. At this hotel, you can enjoy free superfast 400mbps Wi-Fi, a complimentary 24-hour airport shuttle bus, and secure onsite parking. Our Touzai Restaurant serves an extensive breakfast from delicious local produce. After dinner, relax with a chilled glass of wine, a refreshing cocktail, or a cold pint in the refined Cinnabar Social bar. A great night's sleep is assured with our Sleep Advantage® Programme, featuring premium bedding, quiet zones, and guaranteed wake-up calls.

45988.description: The Royal Clifton Hotel has outstanding views across the northwest coastline, King's Gardens and marine lake. Suites, mini-suites and spacious family rooms. Award-winning restaurant, designer bistro bar and friendly staff. Easy access to Liverpool, Manchester and several championship golf courses. An impressive business venue with stunning sea views of the northwest coast. 11 ground-floor conference rooms accommodating up to 300 delegates combine with 120 bedrooms, some suites are available. This prestigious hotel is easily accessible, 20 minutes from the M58 and M6, with parking for 80 cars. Enjoy your stay.

46622.description: This enchanting hotel boasts a prime situation in the heart of London, just a few metres from Hyde Park and the famous Oxford Street. Theaterland, countless galleries and museums and many local points of interest are all situated in the near vicinity, as are a range of shops, restaurants, and bars. The nearest public transport stop is around 300 m from the hotel. The rooms are tastefully decorated in soothing colours and include charming wooden furniture that creates a homely atmosphere in which to completely unwind. A café and a bar are among the hotel's culinary options, and there is a public Internet terminal available for guests' use. Breakfast is served every day in the dining room. The onsite services include Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, ideal for those staying for business purposes or guests wishing to stay in touch with the family or friends.

name.content: Best Western Glasgow Livingston Hilcroft Hotel

46858.description: The family-run Best Western Glasgow Livingston Hilcroft Hotel is ideally situated between Glasgow and Edinburgh, just one mile from junction 4 on the M8. This convenient location provides easy access to various attractions, including shopping centers, museums, art galleries, and picturesque countryside. The hotel features a contemporary bar and restaurant, offering a welcoming atmosphere after a day exploring. Guests can also look forward to well-appointed, modern bedrooms for a comfortable night's sleep. The hotel is a memorable venue for weddings and other events.

46873.description: Enjoy suburban Inverness at Lochardil House Hotel, a short drive from Inverness Castle and Bellfield Park. This hotel offers 28 guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms, and in-room safes. Cooked-to-order breakfast is available daily (fee applies), and guests can relax in the bar/lounge. Amenities include free self-parking, dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Urquhart Castle is 18 miles away, and Inverness Museum and Art Gallery is just 1. 5 miles from the hotel.

47855.address: Hemel Hempstead Rd, Redbourn, St Albans, Herts
47855.description: Stunningly set amidst the beauty of the rolling English countryside with a woodland backdrop, this hotel is steeped in serenity and tranquillity. The property is located in Hemel Hempstead, within easy driving distance of the bustling city centre of London. Guests can explore the town centres of Hemel Hempstead and St. Albans with ease. The hotel boasts a long history, dating back to 1287. Beautifully respecting its rich heritage, the guest rooms are decorated in a classical style, with subtle contemporary influences. Guests are invited to sample the delights that the restaurant has to offer. A sumptuous afternoon tea can be enjoyed with friends, or guests can simply relax and unwind on the terrace. This magnificent hotel offers a retreat in which to escape the rest of the world.

47856.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Grab a bite to eat at Chiltern Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 97 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have showers and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Genting Casino Luton - 2. 9 km / 1. 8 mi- Luton Mall - 3. 5 km / 2. 2 mi- University of Bedfordshire - 3. 9 km / 2. 4 mi- Grosvenor Casinos - 4 km / 2. 5 mi- Stockwood Discovery Centre - 4. 5 km / 2. 8 mi- Chiltern Hills - 5. 5 km / 3. 4 mi- Woodside Animal Farm - 6. 8 km / 4. 3 mi- Dunstable Downs - 7. 2 km / 4. 4 mi- Sundon Hills Country Park - 7. 3 km / 4. 5 mi- ZSL Whipsnade Zoo - 11. 1 km / 6. 9 mi- Hertfordshire County Showground - 11. 5 km / 7. 1 mi- Wrest Park & Gardens - 12. 7 km / 7. 9 mi- Mead Open Farm - 14. 8 km / 9. 2 mi- Top Field - 16. 2 km / 10. 1 mi- Ashridge Artisans Golf Club - 16. 6 km / 10. 3 mi. The nearest airports are: Luton Airport (LTN) - 11. 3 km / 7 mi Heathrow Airport (LHR) - 59. 6 km / 37 mi Stansted Airport (STN) - 89. 7 km / 55. 7 mi The preferred airport for OYO The Chiltern Hotel is Luton Airport (LTN). With a stay at OYO The Chiltern Hotel in Luton, you'll be within a 15-minute drive of ZSL Whipsnade Zoo and Genting Casino Luton. This hotel is 12. 4 mi (19. 9 km) from Woburn Safari Park and 2. 2 mi (3. 5 km) from Luton Mall.

48410.address: Cardiff Lane, Sir John Rogerson'S Quay
48410.description: Clayton Hotel Cardiff Lane is located in the heart of Dublin, near the Bord Gáis Energy Theatre and Dublin's Docklands. It boasts a Club Vitae leisure centre, with one of the largest swimming pools in Dublin City along with a separate kids pool. The hotel is within walking distance of iconic Dublin attractions. Whether it's a fun-filled family staycation, a romantic night away or a golf break, our hotel in Dublin has everything you need to explore the city at our doorstep. Please note that car parking is not available at the hotel but there are discounted rates available nearby. The Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification. The Hotel has been accredited by Green Tourism, a certification program that provides a framework to achieve a sustainable business in the tourism industry. Our Meetings and Events Centre offers 6 versatile and stylish meeting spaces providing an ideal event venue for board meetings, braining storming, training, or hosting a corporate event in Dublin's Grand Canal Dock.

48411.description: The Britannia Waterside Hotel is situated on Scotland's northeast coast in Peterhead, a major fishing port. Set in extensive gardens on the banks of the River Ugie estuary, the hotel offers 121 en-suite bedrooms, complimentary parking, and a health and leisure club with a 15-meter swimming pool. Enjoy fantastic views of the hotel grounds and river from Ogilvie's Restaurant, where the team prepares delicious meals using the finest local produce. For a more informal dining experience, Muse Bar offers a relaxing atmosphere and a range of bar snacks. 24-hour room service is also available. Located just a few miles from Peterhead and the coast, this hotel is an ideal base for exploring the surrounding areas.

48693.description: The Highlander Hotel is situated in the heart of the Scottish Highlands, within the picturesque village of Newtonmore. The hotel is an ideal base for touring the North of Scotland with Loch Ness, Ben Nevis, Inverewe Gardens and Culloden Battlefield all accessible for day trips. The city of Inverness is 1 hour away by car. Each bedroom is en-suite with satellite television, hospitality tray and hairdryer. The hotel is renowned for its friendly atmosphere and great food, and our well stocked bar gives you the perfect opportunity to sample many of the malt whiskies for which the area is famous.

48711.address: Moore Street Plaza, Parnell St, Dublin, 1
48711.description: The hotel is situated right next to O'Connell Street. Within a 10-minute walk guests will find Trinity College, pubs, clubs and Eireann bus station. Within a 20 -minute drive, guests will find Dublin Zoo, as well as Heuston station and Phoenix Park. Dublin airport is located roughly 10 kms from the hotel. Established in 2004, this hotel comprises a total of 253 rooms. There is a foyer with 24-hour reception desk, safe and currency exchange facility. In addition, there are 3 lifts, a café pub, a bar, a restaurant and 3 conference rooms as well as public Internet access. The rooms all come with an en suite bathroom. A direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, a radio, coffee/tea maker, an Internet connection and centrally regulated air-conditioning are also standard. Ten rooms are wheelchair accessible. Special dietary requirements may be catered for.

48771.description: The Hotel is opposite the Christchurch Cathedral and less than 500 metres from Temple Bar and Dublin Castle. Grafton Street, Trinity College, O'Connell Street and the Guinness Storehouse are less than 800 metres away. The Heuston Train Station is 1. 6 km. The rooms are spacious and modern. Breakfast is served every morning in the contemporary restaurant which also offers an international dinner menu. The hotel's bar also serves lunch, snacks and coffee.

48772.description: Located near Dublin Airport and Dublin city centre, the Croke Park Hotel boasts a unique location just steps from the historic Croke Park Stadium, the home of Ireland's Gaelic games and a leading conference venue. Its convenient location, minutes from the city centre and its attractions, makes the Croke Park Hotel an excellent choice for business or leisure travellers.

49192.description: Situated in South Queensferry, the Orocco Pier is a beachfront hotel offering stunning terrace views. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, on-site dining at the Samphire Seafood Grill and a cafe, plus a bar/lounge. The 17 guestrooms feature iPod docks, DVD players, and digital programming. The hotel is conveniently located near Forth Rail Bridge (0. 5 mi) and provides easy access to Edinburgh Airport (7. 6 mi). Other amenities include luggage storage and complimentary newspapers.

49375.description: 'Where history meets hospitality' is more than the motto of this truly remarkable centrally located hotel, it is a statement of intent. The hotel stands on a site that has a heritage dating back to Roman Britain, and many unearthed artefacts are proudly displayed in the Museum of London. There are a multitude of attractions and experiences to be enjoyed nearby; take a trip back in time with a visit to Shakespeare's Globe or join the ultra hip with a visit to the Tate Modern art gallery. The Thames Path is near to the hotel and a relaxing walk along the River Thames is particularly recommended in the summer months, whilst a spin on the London Eye will provide spectacular views of a truly great city at any time of year. The hotel prides itself on high quality service and all rooms are spacious and equipped with everything that guests will need during the stay. The hotel is just steps from The Shard. The View From The Shard is a fantastic tourist attraction and offers panoramic 360-degree views across the capital and beyond. The gym is currently under renovation, guests can use a local gym near the hotel until the renovation has been completed at the end of 2025.

49880.description: Nestled in Tain, The Glenmorangie House offers a relaxing beachside escape. Just a short drive from Moray Firth and Tarbat Discovery Centre, this hotel boasts a restaurant, bar/lounge, terrace, garden, and picnic area. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, room service (limited hours), and a full breakfast. Additional amenities include concierge services, multilingual staff, luggage storage, laundry facilities, and airport shuttle (surcharge). The 9 guestrooms feature iPod docking stations, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, desks, coffee/tea makers, and phones with free local calls. Free self-parking is also available. Nearby attractions include Browns Gallery and Tarbat Ness Lighthouse. The preferred airport is Inverness (INV).

51177.description: This appealing hotel enjoys a great location in London, surrounded by historic theatres and museums and the famous Harrods department store. This hotel was constructed in a cosy country house style and is renowned for its outstanding interior appointment with comfortable service and warm hospitality. Guests may look forward to an inviting foyer with 24-hour reception, hotel safes and a lift. A bar and a W-LAN access point also feature within the hotel amenities, and laundry and room services are also available. The modern, tasteful rooms are all carpeted and come with an en suite bathroom with shower and hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, TV, and an Internet connection. Breakfast is served to guests every morning.

name.content: Garner Hotel Birmingham South East by IHG

51178.description: Located less than 6 miles from both the NEC and Birmingham Airport and with Birmingham city centre just 10 minutes away by train, this hotel offers an enviable location. But while guests may choose it for the convenience, it's the warm and friendly welcome that keeps them coming back. Whether you're exploring all Britain's second city has to offer or visiting on business, this is a great spot to enjoy a relaxing dinner and drinks before getting a restful night's shut-eye.

51237.description: Situated on the beach of El Vendrell (Comarruga), the hotel has a full-service spa, indoor pool and whirlpool and offers access to wireless Internet in public areas. This excellent hotel includes business services such as a meeting rooms for small groups, and audio-visual equipment. It includes 3 restaurants as well as cafeteria, bar next to the swimming pool and bar/lounge. Additional amenities include a seasonal outdoor pool, children's pool and kids club. It has parking for guests' added convenience.

51285.description: Located in Calexico, California, our hotel is a short drive from the Mexican border and less than two hours from San Diego. We're also conveniently close to San Diego State University Imperial Valley Campus and Rockwood Plaza, both under three miles away. Enjoy amenities such as our heated outdoor pool, fitness center, and complimentary hot breakfast.

51816.description: Situated in the heart of Tarragona, this charming hotel offers the perfect escape for a sunny beach holiday or a romantic getaway. Just a short walk from the city center, guests can easily explore the impressive Roman and Medieval ruins of Tarraco. The beautiful golden-sand beach is mere steps away, and public transport is readily available. The thoughtfully designed rooms provide a tranquil retreat after a day of exploring, offering stunning sea views and modern amenities for a comfortable stay. Enjoy a daily buffet breakfast and sample local delicacies at the on-site delicatessen. Parking is also available for guests arriving by car.

51817.description:
This hotel is around a 3 minute-walk from the centre. Countless bars and stop for public transport are to be found within 100 m of the hotel, and nightclubs are situated a 20-minute drive away. Reus airport is 7 km from the hotel and it is some 100 km to Barcelona airport.

Opened in 2005, the hotel comprises a total of 12 rooms spread over 3 floors. The air-conditioned lobby offers a reception desk and lifts. Dining options include a café and a restaurant with highchairs for children. Additional facilities include public Internet access. Room and laundry services complete the offerings and those arriving by car may use the hotel car park.

The rooms have an en suite bathroom with shower, bath and hairdryer. Further fittings include a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV, an Internet connection, a king-size bed and a minibar. There is also a hire safe, air conditioning, heating, a seating area and a balcony or terrace in each room.

There is a swimming pool within the hotel grounds. An attractive golf course is located about 12 km from the hotel.

Breakfast is served every morning. Lunch and dinner can be taken à la carte.

51853.description: This family-friendly hotel is located just 50 metres away from the city centre in Coma Ruga. The hotel is just 100 metres away from the area's stunning beach. Guests will find countless shops and public transport links in the area. The station is just 800 metres away. Guests can explore the beauty of Barcelona, just 60 km away. The hotel is conveniently situated 40 km away from Reus Airport. This wonderful hotel invites visitors into the welcoming surroundings of the lobby. Tastefully designed, the guest rooms offer a comfortable setting in which to unwind. The hotel offers facilities and services which are sure to please every type of traveller.

51997.description: The hotel is located within the historic city walls, which date back to the 17th century. It occupies an enviable central location with shops, bars, theatres and nightlife to be found close by. This stylish and contemporary city hotel opened in May 2002. It comprises a total of 93 rooms on 4 floors and includes an entrance hall with 24-hour reception, lift access, a bar, a pub, a restaurant, conference facilities and car parking (limited and on a first come basis). A laundry and dry cleaning service, luggage storage are all readily available. The bedrooms are well-appointed and warmly decorated, each with an en suite bathroom. They all have a telephone, TV and wireless Internet access. Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification.

52178.description: Located in Stillorgan, Dublin, the 4-star Talbot Hotel Stillorgan is within a 10-minute drive of Aviva Stadium and Dublin Port. It's also conveniently close to St. Stephen's Green and Grafton Street. Enjoy on-site amenities such as a fitness center, bicycle rentals, complimentary Wi-Fi, babysitting services (surcharge), and wedding services. The hotel offers 150 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions with cable programming and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Desks and complimentary newspapers are also provided, and housekeeping is daily. Dine at the hotel's Purple Sage Restaurant for lunch or dinner or enjoy 24-hour room service. A bar/lounge is also available. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. For business travelers, the hotel offers a business center, express check-in and check-out, conference space, and meeting rooms. Free self-parking is available on-site.

52315.address: Carretera De Sant Carlos a Alcanar Platja Km 4
52315.description: Nestled in a tranquil setting along the Costa Dorada, Hotel Carlos III sits beachfront, offering breathtaking views of the Alfacs and Delta del Ebre Nature Reserves. Guests can enjoy two inviting swimming pools and a terrace with stunning sea vistas. Each room features a private terrace, a well-appointed bathroom, air conditioning, and complimentary WiFi. Savor delicious meals at the hotel's restaurant, with both menu and à la carte options available, or dine al fresco on the terrace. Families will appreciate the children's play area, while business travelers can utilize the meeting room. Free parking and electric car charging stations are also available.

52437.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This Edwardian hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at The Dining Room, a restaurant which specializes in local cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. A shuttle from the airport to the hotel is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours).

52655.description: Holiday Inn Express® Dunfermline is located just off the M90 motorway and 18 miles from Edinburgh, the hotel is a short drive from Dunfermline's historic centre and nearby coastal villages. Edinburgh Airport is 15 miles away, and for a night out, direct trains from Dunfermline Queen Margaret Station take you to Edinburgh Waverley. The golf courses and beaches of St. Andrews are less than an hour away by car. Families can discover 700 years of history at Dunfermline Palace and Abbey, and explore underwater adventures at Deep Sea World, a 13-minute walk from the hotel. Business guests can easily walk to events at the Carnegie Conference Centre next door. The local offices of Sky, Nationwide, Amazon and FMC Technologies are all within a short drive. At this hotel, you can start your day with a free buffet breakfast, park your car for free, and use the meeting room that fits up to 25 people. The rooms have USB ports to charge your phone, movable desks for work, ensuite bathrooms with showers, and comfy beds. In the evening, kick back with a pint at the bar or grab a snack in the Great Room.

53517.description: Nestled in Dublin's exclusive Ballsbridge quarter, this renovated 1890 hotel offers 25 rooms across three floors, just a short drive from the city center. Enjoy nearby bars, restaurants, shops, and the sea within walking distance. The hotel features a 24-hour reception, internet access, a dining room with award-winning breakfast, and laundry and room service. Luxurious rooms include ensuite bathrooms, satellite TV, internet access, and trouser presses. Golf and cricket grounds are also nearby. Free parking and WiFi are available.

53556.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with **reduced service**: Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Pool, Room Service, Spa. Discover our tranquil lakeside location, just 7 miles from the bustling historic centre of Cambridge. Our Leisure & Spa facilities are an essential ‘must do' during your visit, with our stunning 12-metre pool, spa pool, relaxation room, sauna and steam room as well as 7 spacious ELEMIS treatment rooms to relax and enjoy. Settle into a guest room featuring complimentary WiFi, 32-inch flat-screen TV, and tea/coffee making facilities as well as a spacious bathroom with separate bath tub and shower. Upgrade to a suite for separate living area, mini-refrigerator, whirlpool bath and larger TV with Sky channels. Savor delectable cuisine at The Bridge Restaurant featuring a tasty mix of contemporary dishes and tempting home comforts for breakfast, lunch and dinner as well as 24-hour room service. Relax anytime of the day at The Lounge Bar and enjoy a coffee with colleagues, a light lunch with friends or pre-dinner cocktails.

53565.description: Enjoy garden views at The Tontine Hotel in Greenock, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi and a cozy lobby fireplace. Dine at the Georgian Restaurant or enjoy room service (limited hours). Unwind at one of the two bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are available daily (fee applies). Amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. The hotel offers conference space and five meeting rooms. The 52 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and digital programming. Bathrooms include shower/tub combinations and hair dryers. Coffee/tea makers and complimentary tea/coffee are provided, with daily housekeeping. A short walk from McLean Museum and Art Gallery and Greenock Cemetery, the hotel is also convenient to local attractions like Cathcart Square and the Waterfront Leisure Complex.

54174.description: This hotel is situated at the heart of the London district of Chelsea, one of the most modern and culturally interesting parts of London. There are scores of shops and restaurants on the King's Road, in South Kensington and in Knightsbridge. There are excellent links to the city centre, the West End and Waterloo as well as Heathrow (24 km) and Gatwick Airports (48 km). Built in 1935, this hotel welcomes international visitors every year including business travellers from Fortune 2000 and FTSE companies. A wide selection of accommodation is on offer including large suites for bigger groups. The apartment hotel comprises a total of 200 fully equipped apartments spread over 9 floors. The lobby features a 24-hour reception, a safe, a security service, a cloakroom and a lift. There is also a bar and 2 air-conditioned à la carte restaurants serving Japanese and Argentinean cuisine. A supermarket is located right next door. Room and laundry services are also available (for an additional fee), as are car-parking facilities.

54356.description: Located in the heart of Kensington, a short three-minute walk from Earls Court tube station, this Dreamtel Group hotel seamlessly blends modern and classic vintage styles. Catering to both business and leisure travelers, it offers a range of amenities including a 24-hour reception, lift, bar, dining room, Wi-Fi, and an à la carte restaurant. Recently renovated, the stylish rooms provide en suite bathrooms, hairdryers, tea and coffee making facilities, irons, direct dial telephones, TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi for maximum comfort. Guests can enjoy breakfast, lunch, and dinner in the restaurant, recently acquired by London's renowned Med Salleh Viet, offering delicious Vietnamese street food in a relaxed atmosphere.

54358.address: Av Los Riscos Y Vista Hermosa Peninsula De Santiag
54358.description: This comfortable hotel is located in the wonderful Mexican Riviera, at the harbour of Manzanillo. The property comprises a total of 232 rooms, and includes an inviting lobby with a currency exchange counter. Corporate travellers are invited to take advantage of the conference facilities and, in addition, a public Internet connection is available. The rooms are designed in a Moorish style and all come with en-suite bathrooms and air conditioning. In the property guests will find two swimming pools, numerous fountains, tropical plants, and a minaret. Moreover, it is possible to hire a yacht at the hotel's own marina and explore the wonderful surroundings.

54474.description:
This hotel is situated at London's most exclusive address, Sloane Street in Chelsea and Knightsbridge, opposite private gardens and a short walk from both Sloane Square (50 m) and Knightsbridge underground stations. The all-suite hotel is also just a few steps away from Harrods, Hyde Park and the Kings Road. It is easily accessible from London's main train stations and also from London's City, Gatwick (65 km) and Heathrow (25 km) airports, whether by taxi, train or limousine. There are numerous bars, restaurants and shopping facilities in the immediate vicinity.

The hotel is a discreet sanctuary in the heart of the vibrant London district of Chelsea. It is an all-suite hotel offering 11 elegantly furnished period suites, born of a traditional English classicism tempered with modern touches and dedicated personal service. The hotel offers a lobby with 24-hour reception desk and check-out service, as well as 24-hour room service. Furthermore, the hotel provides a hotel safe, lift access and a laundry service.

The spacious suites are 45 m² and upwards with kitchens, sitting rooms, period fireplaces, sofas, dining tables and chairs and space to sleep up to 4 people. Facilities include direct dial telephone, TV, Internet access, minibar, tea and coffee making facilities, iron and ironing board and double or king-size beds. The kitchens feature a fridge, oven and microwave, while the bathrooms contain a bath or shower and hairdryer. The rooms also come with central heating, individually regulated air conditioning and a safe.

Cadogan Place Gardens and Tennis Court
Directly opposite Durley House is Cadogan Place, private gardens for the use of local residents and guests. If you would like to stroll, have a picnic, play a few sets of tennis or just sit in the garden, please ask Reception for the key to open the gate. If you wish to play tennis, we are able to book online and to provide rackets and balls

name.content: The Cadogan, A Belmond Hotel, London

54475.description:
Since 1887, The Cadogan, A Belmond Hotel, has been a refined London residence at the crossroads of Chelsea, Knightsbridge, and Belgravia. This reimagined townhouse, with 54 exquisite rooms and suites, offers the intimate charm of a cherished home, elevated by Belmond's impeccable service. The rooms and suites effortlessly blend tradition and modernity. Historical touches like original flooring and fireplaces subtly grace certain rooms, while the top floor can be transformed into a seven-bedroom penthouse retreat. Once a haven for legendary figures such as Lillie Langtry and Oscar Wilde, it now welcomes contemporary icons. Two event spaces, aptly named Oscar and Lillie, evoke the property's storied past, accommodating up-to 60 seated guests for celebrations and gatherings. 
 
The Cadogan provides an ideal base for exploring London's thriving cultural scene. For moments of tranquillity amidst the city's energy, guests enjoy exclusive access to the serene Cadogan Place Gardens, complete with private tennis courts. 
 
Willett’s, the hotel's British bistro, offers familiar comforts with a meticulously crafted seasonal menu by Executive Chef Michael Turner. The Drawing Room perfect for a cozy morning read or an elegant evening cocktail, a true home away from home from dawn till dusk. 
 
The hotel’s dedicated concierge team, all members of Les Clefs d’Or, possess the secret key to unlocking London's latest theatre shows and bespoke experiences. 
 
Furthermore, The Cadogan’s proximity to Victoria Station facilitates seamless onward journeys aboard Belmond's legendary trains: The British Pullman or Britannic Explorer, inviting guests to explore England and Wales in unparalleled style and luxury.

54514.description: Steeped in culture and elegance, this hotel enjoys a superb location in London. The hotel is situated just a short distance away from the Victoria and Albert Museum, the Serpentine Gallery, the Science Museum and Hyde Park. The Natural History Museum, Diana Memorial and Harrods can also be found nearby. Guests can explore the mesmerising Kensington Palace and Gardens, as well as the many shopping opportunities on Kensington High Street. This charming property adds contemporary style to its historical setting. The guest rooms ooze elegance and character. Guests can enjoy a delightful meal in the restaurant, refreshing drinks in the bar, or simply sit back and enjoy the view over the city rooftops.

54754.description: Located in Glasgow's bustling business district, near the main shopping area, this hotel offers an ideal base for both leisure and business travelers. Nearby, you'll find a vibrant array of shops, bars, nightclubs, and restaurants. The hotel is also within easy reach of cultural attractions such as the Glasgow Museum & Art Gallery, the Kings Theatre, the Botanic Gardens, the Museum of Transport, and the Glasgow Science Centre. Conveniently located near Buchanan Galleries and Princes Square shopping centers, the hotel also offers easy access to public transportation with an underground station directly in front and a bus stop just 200 meters away. Renovated in 2008, this 14-story hotel features 278 spacious, clean, and stylish rooms. Each room is equipped with an en-suite bathroom with shower gel, tea and coffee making facilities, a work desk with internet access, comfortable duvets and pillows, a TV with remote control, and individual heating. All rooms are non-smoking. Guests can enjoy a full Scottish cooked or continental breakfast each morning. In the evening, the hotel restaurant offers a diverse menu, ranging from light snacks to three-course meals. The hotel also caters to business travelers with three conference rooms, internet access, and Wi-Fi. For guests arriving by car, parking is available.

54817.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional features at this Georgian hotel include concierge services and a television in a common area. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 9 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and multilingual staff. Planning an event in Edinburgh? This hotel has 22 square feet (2 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 16 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment.

name.content: Arden Guest House, Edinburgh - SELF CHECK IN

55019.description: 'Located on the outskirts of Edinburgh's city center, the OYO Arden Guest House offers comfortable accommodations near Craigmillar Castle and the scenic Portobello Beach. Each clean, tidy room features soft decor, plush beds, en suite bathrooms, free WiFi, TVs, and tea & coffee making facilities. Guests can also enjoy the hotel's garden with outdoor furniture, as well as books and board games. Free secure onsite parking is available, along with accessible and street parking options. While the hotel is conveniently located near major attractions such as the National Museum of Scotland, Mary King's Close, and the Royal Mile, please note that it does not have wheelchair access. Breakfast service is currently unavailable but will resume on February 1, 2023. '

55093.description: Located in London's Hammersmith and Fulham borough, the Holiday Inn Express London - Earl's Court offers convenient access to Kensington High Street and the Natural History Museum, both within a 5-minute drive. This hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and a vending machine. The 150 guestrooms feature LCD televisions with satellite programming, and bathrooms include showers and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy a complimentary continental breakfast daily and grab a bite at the snack bar/deli or a drink at the bar/lounge. A business center and 24-hour front desk are also available. Onsite parking is limited.

55193.description: The following services and amenities are available, Complimentary Evening Social, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently **not available**: Fitness Center. DoubleTree by Hilton Swindon is set in the beautiful Wiltshire countryside, near Junction 16 of the M4 motorway and just 3 miles from Swindon town centre. Enjoy proximity to Windmill Hill and key businesses, the Swindon Designer Outlet, STEAM Museum and the Cotswolds parks – all minutes from our Swindon hotel. Feel welcome with a warm DoubleTree chocolate chip cookie upon arrival, and settle into a stylish guest room with WiFi access, air-conditioning, an LCD TV and generous work area. Our suites offer plenty of space to relax, work or entertain, with a separate lounge, coffee machine, music docking station and other upgraded amenities. Visit our 14Twelve Brasserie to savor breakfast and dinner in a casual and relaxed setting, or meet friends and colleagues for a cocktail in the Bar. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service with an extensive menu. Re-energize after a long day with cardio and strength-training equipment in our fitness center, open 24 hours. Boasting a dedicated meeting floor with 15 event spaces, our DoubleTree hotel near Swindon is perfect for any occasion. Host a private dinner, intimate wedding reception, or even a large conference for up to 300 guests. We have expert event staff to help with the details, plus an array of catering options and wedding packages.

55554.description: The hotel is situated on Parkgate Street, across the River Liffey and Heuston train station. The centre of Dublin, as well as the famous Temple Bar district, is a 20-minute walk from the hotel. It is also a short distance to many of Dublin's premier tourist attractions. Dublin Airport is about 11 km from the hotel and is connected from Heuston Station. The hotel offers the Chesterfields and the Iveagh Bar. Conference facilities are available. All units are elegantly-decorated and equipped with modern essentials. They come with an en suite bathroom, double or twin beds, complimentary Internet access and TV. Central heating comes as standard. Breakfast may be selected from a hot and cold buffet each morning. Lunch and dinner are served daily for an additional charge.

56847.description: The Grand Canal Hotel in Dublin City boasts 142 comfortable and tastefully decorated bedrooms. Situated near the Bord Gáis Energy Theatre, Grafton Street, Trinity College, International Financial Services Centre, Convention Centre Dublin, Aviva Stadium, and Ballsbridge, all within walking distance. The Grand Canal Dock DART Station is located just across the street, making travel around Dublin and neighboring coastal towns easy. Whether you are looking for a relaxing break or an opportunity to explore Dublin, we offer a fully equipped gym, free high-speed Wi-Fi, and private parking in our secure car park. Our hotel is also a popular venue for conferences and events, with five meeting rooms providing capacity for up to 140 delegates.

56848.description: When it comes to unique hotels in Dublin city, The Spencer Hotel is not to be missed. Our designer rooms have all the extras you would expect and plenty of added luxuries. Our rooms have air conditioning, rainforest power showers, complimentary high speed Wi-Fi, ultra-comfort beds, working desks, blackout curtains, tea/coffee making facilities, European adapters, digital TV with over 50 channels and bottled water. Our newly refurbished Energize Fitness & Leisure features a pool and fully-equipped gym. Guests have access to these luxurious facilities free of charge. Take a dip in our 18 metre heated pool or relax and unwind in our sauna, steam room or hot tub.

56900.description: Magnificently located in the fashionable Dublin suburbs of Killiney and Dalkey, this landmark hotel epitomizes elegance and charm. Overlooking Dublin Bay, it's just 30 minutes from Dublin city center. Set on its own grounds, this 18th-century castle offers breathtaking views from Killiney Hill and is easily accessible from Dublin Airport and Dun Laoghaire ferry port. Each luxuriously appointed bedroom, decorated in a classic and charming style, includes superior features such as a private balcony with panoramic views and four-poster beds. Guests have full access to a modern fitness center, complete with a swimming pool, sauna, hot tub, and steam room. The castle also boasts two award-winning restaurants for an exquisite dining experience.

56918.description: This hotel is the perfect choice for a classic Dublin experience, situated opposite the famous Gate theatre on O'Connell Street and close to everything a visitor to Dublin could want. Dublin's shopping districts and museums are all within a short stroll away. This hotel is within easy walking distance of Dublin Castle and Trinity College. The hotel is also close to Croke Park, and the main shopping areas of Henry Street and Grafton Street where guests will also find restaurants, bars, clubs and public transportation links.

56950.description: The Morgan Hotel is one of the most popular hotels in Dublin! The 168-bedroom boutique-style Hotel is located on the cobbled stones of the City's Cultural Quarter - Temple Bar. The Morgan Hotel is the perfect base to rest and relax whilst being in the heart of Dublin. All Bedrooms feature Air Conditioning, Nespresso Coffee Machines, Suite Pads, Complimentary Wi-Fi, Robes, Slippers and Bottled Mineral Water as standard. Guests can also enjoy complimentary access to The Westwood Club Gym & Pool during their stay. A Concierge and Room Service are available 24 hours. The Hotel's in-house restaurant and bar, 10 Fleet Street, offers unique and memorable dishes, and the capital's best cocktails. Dublin's major attractions are within walking distance, including Trinity College, Dublin Castle, The GPO and many more! The City Centre Hotel is 4-star AA rated.

57313.description: The NH Brugge hotel is set in a former monastery that dates back to the 17th century. The hotel is within walking distance to most of Bruges' top attractions. From here, you can easily reach the town center and its beautiful canals, cobbled streets, and famous pedestrian market square in just 10 minutes on foot. If you are in the city for business, the Oud St Jan Congress Center is less than a five-minute walk away. NH Brugge has 149 spacious rooms with large comfortable beds. Our guests can feel at home with free Wi-Fi access in each room, as well as tea and coffee making facilities. We serve a daily fresh breakfast buffet that offers a wide variety of options for any taste. Have a casual lunch at the Jan Breydel Bar and sample authentic Belgian beer by the cozy fireplace. During the summer months, enjoy a drink on our garden terrace. There is a gym for guests to use. The hotel also has 8 meeting rooms for up 250 people.

57374.description: Enjoy ski-in/ski-out access at this hotel in Hol, Norway, featuring an indoor pool and sauna. Amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, an arcade/game room, ski storage, and a complimentary ski shuttle. Dine at the on-site restaurant and unwind at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available on weekends for a fee. The hotel offers 89 guestrooms with flat-screen TVs and pillowtop beds, and also features a computer station, 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and five meeting rooms. Free self-parking is available. Nearby attractions include Arnetrekket, B Fugleleiken, D Geiloheisen Express, and Kikuttoppen. The preferred airport is Gardermoen Airport (OSL).

57482.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a health club, an indoor pool, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy Modern European cuisine at Indigo, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 102 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring refrigerators and minibars.

58082.description: The Lancaster Gate Hotel enjoys a central London location, just minutes from several Underground stations. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property. With major transport links on its doorstep, the hotel offers easy access to all top landmarks. Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens are just across the road, and Queensway and Lancaster Gate Underground stations are a 5-minute walk away. The modern, spacious bedrooms are well-equipped with a private bathroom, air conditioning, tea and coffee facilities, and an LCD flat-screen TV. A generous continental breakfast buffet is available daily. The stylish Serpentine Bar offers a range of beverages, snacks, and modern cocktails. Conference facilities are also available.

58317.description: The apartments are located on the east coast of Spain, south of Barcelona and right in the picturesque centre of Salou. They are on Plaza de Europa on the route to Port Aventura and around 350 m away from the beach and the beach promenade. Scores of shops, bars, restaurants and nightclubs are within easy reach. The modern complex offers guests a currency exchange and lifts. The hotel further features a coffee shop, a disco, a pub and a hairdresser. 2 to 4 bed apartments include a double room, a bathroom, a kitchen, a dining room with a sofa bed (with space for 2 persons) and a terrace. Everything is connected with modern and comfortable furniture. The 4 to 6 bed apartments are furnished similarly to the other apartments, but include an additional bedroom. In addition, all lodgings include satellite/cable TV and a fridge. Included in the apartments are laundry (with the exception of bath towels), cleaning on departure and weekly linen change. On the hotel grounds guests will find swimming pools for children and adults, which are open in the peak season. There are sun loungers and parasols for hire on the local sandy beach.

59342.description: Given its lively feel and setting in the Centre of the resort, this seaside hotel is perfect for a holiday or a vacation getaway. In the seaside neighbourhood of Coma-ruga, this unfussy hotel is a minute walk from the beach and 15 km from Aqualon Water Park. The Hotel has a restaurant/bar with a pool table, free Wi-Fi zone, 24-hour reception desk and a play area for children. Port Aventura Theme Park is just a 30-minute drive away and Barcelona is around a 40-minute drive away, via the nearby C-32 Motorway. The casual air-conditioned rooms have colourful decor, parquet floors, modern bathroom with free toiletries, satellite TV and balconies with views of the swimming pool or the resort and kids age 12 and under stay free in some of room types. Buffet breakfast is included and served in the simple restaurant/bar, which offers international and gluten-free choices. Amenities include an outdoor pool with a kids' area, plus table tennis, a pool table and complimentary use of bikes.

59559.description: The Hilton Belfast, a stunning city center hotel, is located on the banks of the River Lagan, next to the ICC Belfast Waterfront. Its 202 rooms and suites offer amenities such as LED TVs, air conditioning, work desks with USB charging points, and tea/coffee making facilities. Guests can enjoy dining at the Riverside Restaurant and Bar with its river views or cocktails at No. 4 Bar. The hotel also boasts a fitness center, extensive meeting and event facilities, and an Executive Lounge. Nearby attractions include Lanyon Station and Victoria Square.

59560.description: This modern hotel is located in the heart of the city, within walking distance of major business districts, tourist attractions, and shopping areas. Belfast Airport is approximately 25 kilometers away. The hotel offers a wide range of facilities, including a safe, restaurant, bar, and conference and banqueting facilities for up to 600 people. Its 170 guest rooms are fully air-conditioned and well-equipped. The restaurant features a varied and appealing menu showcasing modern British cuisine. Enhanced sanitation procedures and new practices, rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a leading global authority in testing, inspection, and certification, are in place.

name.content: Best Western London Queens Crystal Palace

59579.description:
Built in 1854 to coincide with the reopening of the Crystal Palace exhibition venue, Best Western London Queens Crystal Palace Hotel is a striking Victorian building in one of the most picturesque parts of south London. 
A stay here puts you in good company – French writer Emile Zola resided here for many months in the 1890s during his time in exile, while German emperor Kaiser Wilhelm II used the hotel as a base for his visits to Queen Victoria. 
Our updated rooms all come with contemporary décor, air conditioning, flat-screen TV and hairdryer. We also have an onsite car park, conferencing facilities, Italian restaurant and spacious ground floor lounge bar with satellite TV. 
Selhurst Park football ground is only a five-minute drive away, while Crystal Palace Park is just two minutes by car. If you’re looking to do a spot of sightseeing while you’re here, you’ll find the major attractions of central London around 8 miles from the hotel.

59641.description: This charming hotel is located in a quiet residential area just outside Cardiff's historic city centre, with easy access to the Motorway M4 and close to many popular attractions including Wales Millennium Centre, Cardiff Castle and Millennium Stadium. With its convenient location and excellent facilities designed with both the business and leisure travellers in mind, the establishment is an ideal choice to enjoy a pleasant stay in Cardiff. The accommodation units offer a smoke-free environment and offer all the necessary amenities to relax peacefully and work productively. Facilities include a soothing rainfall shower, complimentary high-speed Internet access, coffee and tea provisions and a flat-screen TV for guests' entertainment. The on-site restaurant, with its contemporary design, offers a casual and relaxing ambiance where guests can sample delicious International dishes as well as authentic UK specialities. The bar is the perfect place to meet up with friends and enjoy a draught beer or a refreshing cocktail.

60399.description: Located on the outskirts of Leeds, just off J42 of the A1 (M), Best Western Plus Milford Hotel has excellent links to both the M1 and the M62 motorways. The shops and attractions of York, Wakefield, Selby, Doncaster, Pontefract, Harrogate and Wetherby can all be enjoyed within a 30 minutes drive of the hotel, and our fully air conditioned bedrooms will be ready and waiting when you get back! Plus, there's free Wi-Fi for telling the folks back home all about your bargain hunting and sightseeing! Then, once you've indulged in a newly installed luxury bathroom, it's time to relax and reflect as you enjoy a good night's sleep ready to do it all over again the following day! If you want a bite to eat before bed, you can enjoy a choice of freshly prepared dishes in the hotel's recently refurbished Watermill Restaurant, which also features a working waterwheel! Enjoy your stay.

61760.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an outdoor pool and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, Villa Retiro, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the poolside bar. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 9 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and espresso makers. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature complimentary toiletries and bidets. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.
