The preferred airport for Hotel Villa Retiro is Reus (REU) - 93. 2 km / 57.

62062.description: Boasting a classic façade which contrasts with the modern interior design, this refurbished hotel enjoys a central location in Edinburgh, right in the vibrant Grassmarket area, one of the most visited places of the city with splendid views of the nearby castle. The property is only a few minutes' walk from the popular Royal Mile and the National Museum of Scotland, while Waverley Train Station is some 800 m away. The establishment is proud to describe itself as a little magic place with charming guest rooms, which present a very modern and pleasant decoration as well as great facilities such as iPod docks, air-conditioning, tea making facilities and rain showers in every bathroom. Also business travellers can take advantage of the on-site facilities which include free Wi-Fi throughout the building and comfortable work desks within every bedroom. The property offers a tasty room service menu with a great variety of delicious dishes and a packed lunch can also be arranged.

62722.description: This recently refurbished 4-star deluxe hotel boasts a strikingly beautiful décor and a superb city-centre location. Within walking distance of Dublin's key business district, shopping areas, and cultural attractions such as Merrion Square, Trinity College, and the National Museum, it's ideal for both leisure and business travellers. The hotel offers spacious guest rooms (30 sq ft), a fashionable cocktail bar, a restaurant, excellent meeting facilities, and a new Executive Lounge. All rooms are individually air-conditioned and offer free Wi-Fi.

63306.description: This charming and elegant hotel is ideally situated in the suburbs of Dublin, with good public transport and road links to the city centre or other nearby destinations. Dublin international airport is also easily reachable, being a perfect accommodation option for both leisure and business travellers alike. Guest rooms are tastefully appointed and take care of the utmost details. They are individually decorated and exude an elegant and enchanting atmosphere that guarantees travellers will enjoy a pleasant stay. Moreover, guests can rest and relax at the heated, indoor swimming pool and invigorate at the state-of-the-art fitness room, apart from trying delicious specialities at the on-site dining facilities. Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification. Hotel has been accredited by Green Tourism, a certification program that provides a framework to achieve a sustainable business in the tourism industry.

63799.description: An elegant Victorian retreat overlooking The Stray. Explore the unique charms of the beautiful spa town of Harrogate with a stay at The Yorkshire Hotel. It's perfect for a romantic short break, family holiday or business trip. This elegant Victorian accommodation overlooks the town's open grassland known as The Stray, and is just a two minutes' walk from the world-famous Betty's Cafe Tea Rooms and within half a mile of Harrogate Convention Centre. Our friendly staff are on hand to make your stay as comfortable as possible and offer advice on the best places to go in Yorkshire, whether you are looking for the best boutique shops in Harrogate, award-winning gardens, or things to do in the wider area. Why not take the train to York or Ripon or drive out to the wilds of the Yorkshire Dales for invigorating walks in the countryside?After a tiring day, snuggle up in one of our 94 super-comfy bedrooms, which range in size from singles to king rooms. All come with plush linen, a flat-screen television and free Wi-Fi, while many boast a town or park view. Our relaxing Pickled Sprout Restaurant offers an a la carte menu of contemporary British and international cuisine, while the welcoming bar serves a range of ales, wines and soft drinks. Enjoy good old Yorkshire hospitality at this picturesque spot in the heart of Harrogate.

65169.description: Don't miss out on the many recreational opportunities, including a health club, an indoor pool, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy British cuisine at Lanes of London, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 1292 square feet (120 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 5 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 152 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding.

65569.description: Enjoy a central Edinburgh stay at The Frederick House Hotel, steps from George Street and a short walk from Edinburgh Castle. This guesthouse offers 44 comfortable guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and coffee/tea makers. Start your day with a cooked-to-order breakfast (available for a fee), and take advantage of amenities such as dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk. The hotel is conveniently located near Princes Street, the Royal Mile, and various city attractions.

65659.description: Set amidst the charm and beauty of the leafy residential area of Kensington and Chelsea, this elegant hotel is perfect for discerning travellers eager to explore. The Natural History Museum, the Victoria and Albert Museum and the iconic Royal Albert Hall can be found nearby. Hyde Park is also located just a short distance away. This elegant hotel oozes style and sophistication. The guest rooms and suites are luxurious and spacious. Individually-styled event spaces offer the perfect setting for special events, weddings and conferences. Guests can treat themselves to the ultimate relaxation in the spa. A fitness centre is also available onsite. Delectable dishes and afternoon tea can be enjoyed in the elegant surroundings of the restaurant.

65939.description: Situated in an exclusive Salou residential district just 300 meters from the town center, this apartment complex offers convenient access to a variety of restaurants, bars, and shops. The nearest beach is a mere 5-minute stroll away, while Barcelona is only 100 km and Reus Airport approximately 15 km from the property. The complex features 60 fully-equipped apartments, each with satellite/cable TV, a kitchen (including a fridge and oven), a washing machine, and individually controlled air conditioning and heating. Guests can enjoy a range of amenities, including a swimming pool, jacuzzi, sauna, gym and a children's playground. The spa (swimming pool and jacuzzi are currently closed, while the sauna and Gym remain open from Monday to Sunday, 14:00-21:00. Reception hours are Monday to Thursday from 09:00 to 23:00 and Friday to Sunday from 09:00 to 00:00.

66746.description: As Dublin's tallest hotel 10 minutes from Dublin Airport and 20 minutes from the centre of Dublin. Facilities include a charming café/bar and an on-site restaurant. Wireless Internet access is free of charge and is available throughout the hotel. The rooms have been decorated in a fresh and contemporary style with comfort and convenience in mind. All come with an en-suite bathroom and feature modern amenities, such as satellite/ cable TV and high-speed Internet access, as standard. Metro Hotel's airport shuttle bus operates from 4am until 11. 45pm every day to and from Dublin Airport. To request a pick-up from the airport please contact the hotel on +353 1 866 9500.

67124.description: The Crown Court Town House Hotel, located in Inverness, the capital of the Highlands, dates back to the 1700s when it served as a residence for crown court judges. Following a recent restoration, the hotel now offers stylish accommodations, first-class service, and excellent dining, all with a warm Highland welcome.

67500.description: A warm welcome awaits you at this family-run hotel in Lossiemouth. Relax in the friendly atmosphere, popular with returning guests and locals. Enjoy free Wi-Fi in public areas, free limited parking, and comfortable surroundings. The breathtaking view from the hotel overlooks the Moray Firth, extending to the Cromarty Firth and the hills of Caithness. Situated directly opposite the historic Moray Golf Club, the hotel is ideal for exploring the coastal, castle, or whisky trails. It's also a convenient base for visiting Inverness, Aberdeen, and the surrounding areas. The Stotfield Hotel has recently refurbished many bedrooms and ground floor guest areas while retaining its original 1895 character, including the grand staircase and revolving front door.

67759.description: This hotel is set in an elegant Georgian townhouse in Paddington, only a 10-minute walk from Hyde Park. Within a few minutes' walk, guests will find restaurants and bars. This is an ideal starting point for a visit to the sights of London, such as the British Museum, Madame Tussauds, The Victoria and Albert and Natural History Museums to name but a few. Located in one of the most exciting and renowned capital cities in Europe, this hotel is ideal for both business and leisure travellers. With 52 comfortable & relaxing rooms ranging from singles to large family rooms, all with en suite facilities, we are confident we can meet the expectations of our guests.

68319.description: This comfortable and affordable hotel boasts a strategic position less than a kilometre away from Belfast's city centre. Thus, this hotel is a good accommodation option when visiting this interesting city either for leisure or business, as the property is conveniently located within walking distance from the City Hall or St Anne's Cathedral. The Grand Opera House is also not far away, allowing its guests to enjoy great musicals or other kinds of shows. All the accommodation units come well equipped with all the necessary amenities for a pleasant stay. They are tastefully appointed and have a lot of ample space for visitors to relax after a busy day of sightseeing or working. The hotel is also provided with accessible rooms for everyone who might need them. Guests can keep updated thanks to the WIFI connection and enjoy the delicious continental breakfast served on-site.

68321.description: This modern hotel enjoys a convenient location at less than 3 km distance from Grafton Street and Dublin's self-designated Cultural Quarter. Attractions such as Dublin's Castle, Christchurch Cathedral and Temple Bar leisure district can be reached easily in a short driving distance. The establishment is also in close proximity to many of Dublin's restaurants, theatres, art galleries and museums. Designed to meet the needs of today's budget-conscious family, corporate guest or short break customer, the hotel offers spacious guest rooms, elegantly equipped with all the necessary amenities required by today's traveller. Facilities on offer at this affordable complex include a 24-hour check-in service, limited, underground parking for €12 per day (please reserve in advance) and free Internet access.

68323.description: Ideal for corporate travellers, this comfortable property features a prime location just 1 kilometre from Dublin Airport and a short driving distance from Dublin and all its vibrant attractions. Guests staying at this stylish property cannot miss Swords Castle, home to a cluster of buildings dating back to the 1200s, situated some 5 kilometres away. And for a fun-filled family day, visitors can explore Malahide Castle and learn about Talbot family. The bright guest rooms feature a welcoming atmosphere and are decorated in soothing tones to guarantee a restful night's sleep. The onsite services include free Wi-Fi Internet connection. Car parking is available at the hotel at EUR 5. 00 daily charge.

name.content: Ten Hill Place Hotel, WorldHotels Distinctive

69219.description: Opened in 2006, Ten Hill Place, WorldHotels Distinctive property, is a premier city center hotel in Edinburgh. From its airy public spaces to its 129 smart bedrooms, the hotel offers quiet sophistication, setting it apart from other Edinburgh accommodations. Seven fully equipped accessible rooms are available, with elevator access from the street level to all floors. Historic and contemporary rooms within Surgeons' Hall can accommodate conferences, meetings, and social events. This innovative hotel is within easy walking distance of Princes Street, the historic Old Town, and the city center's main tourist, shopping, and business districts, yet peacefully situated away from the main thoroughfares. The Festival Theatre is across the road, the National Museums are around the corner, and the Royal Mile, Edinburgh Castle, and Holyrood Palace are just a short distance away. Whether for business or a city break, make Ten Hill Place, WorldHotels Distinctive your first choice. The hotel is owned by the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh, and profits help fund surgical care and development worldwide.

69479.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy international cuisine at Tigerlily, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Make yourself at home in one of the 33 guestrooms featuring minibars and Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. With a stay at Tigerlily, you'll be centrally located in Edinburgh, steps from George Street and 4 minutes by foot from Princes Street. This upscale hotel is 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Grassmarket and 0. 7 mi (1. 1 km) from Edinburgh International Conference Centre.

69685.description: Whether you're in Aberdeen for business or pleasure, a stay at Premier Inn Hotel Aberdeen City Centre puts both on your doorstep. Conference venues like the University and the Exhibition and Conference Centre are within easy reach, as are all the sights and sounds of North East Scotland's most vibrant city. Spend the morning strolling the streets of Aberdeen and visiting the famous granite landmarks like the Town House. Don't miss the chance to get some serious shopping done too. Then why not have fish and chips strolling along the Esplanade. After lunch there's still plenty to do, with the Maritime Museum or the Arts Centre to explore. Then it's time to head home for mouth-watering food in our restaurant and a refreshing sleep in our comfy beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions.

70242.description: This award-winning hotel is superbly located a 5-minute walk from Wembley Park Underground Station, Wembley Stadium, SSE Arena, Troubadour Wembley Park Theatre, London Designer Outlet, and Wembley Park Market. Central London is just a 15-minute tube ride away. The hotel offers 165 en-suite rooms, a sports bar, restaurant, and meeting rooms, as well as conference, training, and event halls for hire. Guest rooms feature triple-glazed windows (that open slightly), safes, irons and ironing boards, flat-screen TVs, work desks, and air conditioning. Three accessible rooms with walk-in showers are available on the ground floor upon request. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, and free parking is provided for one car per room on a first-come, first-served basis. Additional parking may be available with prior arrangement and may incur charges. Heathrow Airport is a 25-minute taxi ride, and St. Pancras International is a 25-minute tube journey from the hotel.

70388.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a rooftop terrace. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a reception hall. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. This hotel has 6 meeting rooms available for events. Make yourself at home in one of the 210 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers.

70399.description: Nestled amidst the scenic splendor of the Cairngorm Mountains, this traditional 3-star hotel, accredited by AA and Visit Scotland, offers a prime location near Inverness, the Highland capital. Enjoy easy access to both the Cairngorm and Lecht ski slopes, making it an ideal base for exploring the Scottish Highlands. Discover nearby attractions such as Balmoral, Loch Ness, and Culloden Battlefield, or venture further afield to John o'Groats and the Isle of Skye. A wide array of activities awaits, from golfing and fishing to hillwalking and skiing.

70534.description: Get rested and ready for anything at our smoke-free Comfort Inn Birmingham in Birmingham, EN near Broad Street. Our hotel is near the Birmingham Hippodrome theater, Birmingham Botanical Gardens and more. Prepare for a successful day ahead with such amenities as a continental breakfast, a meeting room, a lounge and bar, free weekday newspapers and more. Your spacious room includes a private bathroom and shower facilities, hospitality trays and more. Behind every great day is a great night at Birmingham hotels like our Comfort Inn Birmingham. Book now. Required extra bedding is free in rooms shared by one or two children 14 or under and two parents or grandparents. Email enquiriesthecomfortinnbirmingham. co. uk.

70707.description: Get yourself to Glasgow, and experience one of Europe's most exciting destinations. The Best Western Glasgow City Hotel puts you at the heart of this sophisticated metropolitan city. From the Exhibition Centre, theaters and nightlife to the amazing shopping that's famous around the world. An exceptional central location isn't the only big attraction of this stylish and comfortable hotel. We offer some of the best bedrooms in the city too, at some of the best rates! Whether you're planning a surprise romantic weekend away, a family break close to everything Scotland has to offer or a great value for money business trip, we'll welcome you with open arms! Our hearty Scottish breakfast will set you up for the day ahead and be every bit as memorable as the evenings here in Glasgow! As for things to do, it's endless. Why not take a tour of the Gallery of Modern Art under two miles away, or Glasgow Science Museum 1.5 miles or feast your eyes on the Burrell Collection 3.5 mile from the hotel? Whatever you do, don't miss out on our warm brand of Best Western Glasgow City Hotel hospitality! Enjoy your stay.

70920.address: Park West Business Park, Nangor Road, 12
70920.description: The Aspect Hotel Park West, conveniently located just 7 km from Dublin city centre, offers easy access to the city via a 10-minute train ride and to major road networks with its proximity to the M50 motorway. This 141-room hotel, including 6 suites, provides a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, conference facilities, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each contemporary room features a TV, high-speed internet access, and a safe. Leisure facilities include a swimming pool, gym, and sauna located a short 7-minute walk away, with a golf course reachable within a 40-minute drive. Please note that a valid credit card and photo ID (passport or driver's license) are required upon check-in. The hotel remains open for essential workers. Leisure travelers with bookings before January 31st are kindly asked to rebook their stay via the website or their travel agent. For bookings made directly on the hotel website, online rebooking or contacting the hotel directly is recommended. The Aspect Hotel Park West prioritizes guest and staff safety and looks forward to welcoming leisure guests back as soon as restrictions allow.

70989.address: South Quay Marsh Wall London E14 9sh
70989.description: This hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has a range of kids amenities available upon request. Situated in the heart of the thriving Canary Wharf business district, Hilton London Canary Wharf offers elegant guest rooms and suites as well as fully refurbished, flexible Hilton Meeting Rooms. With excellent transport links to the rest of the city and beyond, only 15 min from London City Airport, about 50 min to Gatwick Airport and 70 min to Heathrow Airport, this hotel will allow you to make the most of your event in London. Stay connected with WiFi access (fees apply) in London’s largest Hilton Guest rooms, complete with LCD TV (ESPN, CNN, BT Sports 1 & 2), US and USB plugs, safe, tea & coffee making facilities, iron & board, luxury bathroom amenities and much more. Upgrade to an executive room or suite on the higher floors and enjoy a range of complimentary services, including access to the executive lounge on the 14th floor, offering breathtaking views of the city. Unwind after a busy day with a workout in the fitness centre or relax in the steam room and sauna. With 8 elegant and flexible Meeting Rooms and a spacious function room, for up to 400 delegates, with state-of-the-art amenities, dedicated coordinator and 24/7 Business Centre, you are always guaranteed successful meetings & events at Hilton London Canary Wharf. Sit at the bar of the stylish Cinnamon restaurant decorated in green-glass and mahogany proposing contemporary and innovative dishes and sip signature cocktails.

71131.description: The hotel is situated in the village of Newtonmore and is surrounded by the dazzling landscape of Scotland. Many locations in Newtonmore were featured in the TV Series ''Monarch of the Glen'', such as Glen Bogle House, which is officially known locally as Ardverikie Castle and is roughly 20 minutes' drive from Newtonmore. The largest national park in Great Britain, Cairngorm, is also in the immediate vicinity and is one of the most breathtaking areas in Scotland. The hotel comprises a total of 50 rooms. Among the facilities offered to guests are a reception lobby and games room with snooker table. The hotel is family-owned and the staff all live in the village, meaning that guests will be greeted with typical Highland hospitality. The fantastic restaurant offers a diverse and varied menu. The banqueting facilities have space for around 150 people. Guests are invited to relax in the bar after a busy day's exploring. There is parking available for those arriving by car. The comfortable rooms each come with an en suite bathroom, as well as all the amenities today's traveller expects. Guests have access to a swimming pool and sauna. Through its natural surroundings the hotel is perfect for nature-lovers and those who enjoy outdoor activities. It is possible to book a bed & breakfast stay.

name.content: Premier Inn Edinburgh Cc Lauriston Place

71550.description: Premier Inn Hotel Edinburgh Central (Lauriston Place) is the perfect place to stay if you're coming to visit Edinburgh or Edinburgh Castle. You'll be within easy reach of all the tourist attractions, plus great transport links to the whole region. Spend the morning doing some window-shopping along the Royal Mile. For lunch, why not venture out to Leith, Edinburgh's 'port', and discover some glorious restaurants. If you're visiting during the Edinburgh Festival or the International Film Festival, there's plenty to distract during the afternoon. Then it's time to come back to the hotel for a meal in our tasty restaurant, and a well-earned rest in our new, modern rooms with extra-comfy kingsize Hypnos beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

71721.description: Including a restaurant and 2 bars serving many local whiskeys, the Richmond Arms Hotel is located in the attractive village of Tomintoul in the Cairngorms National Park. Around 57 miles from Aberdeen Airport, this hotel provides free parking and WiFi. Each guest room has an en suite shower or bath with toiletries provided. The Richmond Arms restaurant offers a full menu including pastas, burgers, pies and vegetarian dishes. There are also desserts and a children’s selection. The 2 hotel bars stock around 150 single malt whiskeys, including many from the Speyside region. Tomintoul is around 27 miles from Aviemore, north of beautiful Loch an Eilein, and 14 miles from Grantown-on-Spey. The town is home to the Speyside Center, including a whiskey shop, restaurant, art gallery and garden center.

71905.description: This inn is located in the small village of Inchmore, on the A862 just 7 miles from Inverness. It is ideally situated close to Inverness Airport and only a short distance from Aberdeen Airport, whilst Glasgow and Edinburgh Airports are within 3 hours' drive. Both intimate and charming, the inn holds a prime place in the colourful history of the area and still today remains at the heart of the local community. There has been an inn at Inchmore for over 270 years and it has provided food and shelter to diners and travellers through the years and has seen Inverness change from a sleepy highland capital to the vibrant, exciting young city it is today. This establishment comprises a total of 10 rooms and guests are offered a bar and a breakfast room. This inn has comfortable bedrooms which all offer en suite facilities as well as tea and coffee making facilities, a telephone and TV.

name.content: Best Western Plus White Horse Hotel

72400.description: If you are looking for a Warm Welcome, Style, Fine Food, Great Service and Comfortable Accommodation, look no further than the 4 Star Best Western Plus White Horse Hotel. Ideally located along the main Causeway Coastal Route and only minutes from Derry-Londonderry’s 17th Century Walled City Centre, this Four Star establishment offers all the luxurious amenities that guests would expect whether their visit is for leisure, business, conference, banqueting or just a memorable meal. Situated minutes from the City Centre (6 miles), City of Derry Airport (3 miles), Faughan Valley Golf Course (3 miles), River Faughan for fishing (2 miles) the Main Dual Carriageway to the Causeway Coast, Wild Atlantic Way, The White Horse Hotel can offer a wide range of things to see and do both in the surrounding area and within the hotel itself.

72439.description: This hotel is in a prime location 5 minutes from Gatwick airport, 15 minutes from the centre of Crawley, and an hour from central London, and 65 km from London Heathrow. Facilities on offer include an entrance hall with 24-hour reception, lift access, a café, a restaurant and parking for those arriving by car (charges apply).

73444.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, babysitting (surcharge), and wedding services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Urban Kitchen, a restaurant which specializes in Regional cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 155 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

73445.description: Located on Baker Street, our cosy hotel provides the perfect base for exploring the rich history, culture, and attractions that London has to offer. Our hotel features 29 guest rooms and offers great value accommodation with a continental breakfast included in the price. All guestrooms are with an en-suite bath/shower and equipped with modern amenities such as air-conditioning, flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and hairdryer for your comfort. There is a comfortable tv lounge by reception, where complimentary fresh ground coffee, hot chocolate and tea are available 24/7. Explore the world-famous Baker Street Underground station, just a short walk away providing excellent connectivity to attractions such as Madame Tussauds, museums, and the West-End theatres. Sherlock Holmes fans will take delight in visiting the Sherlock Holmes Museum, located just around the corner. Oxford street and Regents Park home to the zoo is also within walking distance. Our friendly staff are available 24/7 to assist you with any inquires or reservations whether you assistance planning your day in London or need help with transportation. No pets allowed.

73681.description: Overlooking the historic Bute East Dock, Novotel Cardiff Centre is the ideal hotel for guests looking for style and comfort. Just 10-minutes from Cardiff Central station, the shops and nightlife, it's the perfect spot for exploring the Welsh capital. The historic Cardiff Castle is just a short walk away too! After a long day of sightseeing, let off some steam in the fitness centre. You could enjoy a dip in the indoor heated pool, or maybe you would prefer to relax in the sauna or steam room?

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Liverpool John Lennon Airport

73959.description:
The hotel is ideally located for both Liverpool Airport and as a base for exploring the fabulous city of Liverpool. There is a bus station at the airport (about 1.6 km away) and Hunts Cross train station is about 2.4 km away. Manchester Airport is also in the region (approximately 47 km away).

This airport hotel offers comfort and value-for-money accommodation. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service. Facilities at the hotel include a hotel safe and lift access. There is a bar and restaurant on the premises. It is ideal for the leisure or business traveller, with 100 en suite rooms, three purpose-built meeting rooms with natural light and air conditioning plus accompanying conference facilities. Complimentary parking is offered to hotel guests.

There are 100 en suite bedrooms with a power shower, hairdryer, hospitality tray, and a TV with satellite channels and in-room movies (fees may apply). Rooms are furnished with double beds and further amenities include a direct dial telephone, a radio, Internet access, tea and coffee making facilities, and central heating.

There is a golf course about 6.4 km away.

By car: From the M62 motorway turn off at Junction 6 onto the A5300 to the A561 and follow the signs to Liverpool John Lennon Airport. The hotel is situated off Speke Hall Avenue.

74481.description: This luxurious and landmark hotel boasts an excellent and peaceful location both for business and leisure travellers who come to Dublin city. The property sits overlooking the beautiful Dublin Bay and visitors can reach Dublin's city centre through the DART train line in just 20 minutes. Moreover, the hotel is a 2-minute walk from Dun Laoghaire's ferry port and very close from Wicklow, the Garden of Ireland. Those staying at this hotel may choose between several room types, all of them tastefully appointed in bright or creamy tones. They are also ideally equipped for a comfortable stay with superior amenities that will delight even the most discerning guests. All travellers will appreciate the award-winning spa and health centre and the varied and mouth-watering in-house dining offer. Business travellers may make good use of the available meeting rooms and conference centre.

name.content: Vilar Rural Arnes by Serhs Hotels

74539.description: This charming, village-style hotel combines the essence of a country house with the comfort of a rural retreat. Nestled in a unique setting ideal for nature lovers, it offers easy access to excursions in the surrounding Terra Alta region. Located in southern Catalonia, near Valencia, the hotel is close to the Ebro Delta and the culturally significant town of Horta de Sant Joan, a landscape characterized by olive groves and vineyards. Nearby attractions include the Ports de Tortosa-Beseit National Park and the Greenway, a scenic route following a former railway line. The natural areas of Matarraña and the Ebro Delta are also easily accessible.

74759.description: The apartments, located directly by the sea, are within 500 m of the city centre, where guests will discover a considerable number of shopping amenities, banks, chemists, restaurants, bars and nightclubs. Reus Airport is approximately 30 km away and Barcelona Airport is 120 km from the hotel. The complex comprises 2 buildings, both on the seafront, with direct access, via a flight of steps, to the beach. There is a total of 100 apartments available, and facilities on offer include a currency exchange facility, lift access and a small supermarket. Cleaning of the accommodation units before guests' arrival and water and electricity costs are included in the price. Guests can also hire a parking space behind the hotel complex. The apartments for 4 to 6 people each come with 2 double bedrooms, a fully-fitted en suite bathroom with shower, an individual kitchen, a living/ dining room with a sofa bed to sleep up to 2 people, and a furnished balcony. The apartments for 6 to 8 people have 3 double bedrooms, a living/ dining room with sofa bed to sleep 2 people, a fully fitted en suite bathroom with shower, an individual kitchen and a furnished balcony. Guests can use the shared swimming pool on the grounds of the complex. There is a golf course just around 3 km away.

75132.description: The hostel is located on Edinburgh's historic Royal Mile, just a few minutes' walk from Waverley railway station and the airport link bus stop. This specially designed complex offers secure furnishings for women, as well as quiet peaceful rooms upon request. The hostel has a high level of security with electronic key cards and a 24-hour concierge service. Further facilities include a luggage storage, hotel safes and a bike cellar. Guests can relax, meet friends and have a drink in the stylish Bar 50. All rooms come fully-equipped as standard featuring a private bathroom and all the amenities world travellers and backpackers need. Guests can select their breakfast, lunch and dinner from a buffet. Lunch and dinner can be chosen either from a set menu or selected à la carte.

75224.description:
The hotel is situated on the city outskirts, yet lies no more than 2 km from the centre of town, which can be easily reached thanks to a convenient bus stop located nearby.

This is a family hotel offering 56 accommodation units. It is the perfect choice for people who want to stay in a comfortable budget hotel.

The bedrooms are all equipped with bathroom, direct dial telephone, TV with 5 English language channels, radio alarm, tea and coffee making facilities and biscuits.

75382.description: Perfectly located on Kensington Gardens Square, this hotel is set amidst elegant surroundings in London. The hotel is located just off Queensway, where guests will find a multitude of boutiques and restaurants. Whiteleys shopping complex is just a few minutes' walking distance away. Guests will find themselves within easy access of Oxford Street, Kensington Stores and the famous Portobello Market. This charming property has been beautifully restored to showcase its original, Victorian splendour. Stylish, comfortable guest rooms invite visitors into a world of calm and serenity. This property is a great choice for business and leisure travellers alike.

75459.description: The Fleet Street Hotel, nestled in Dublin's vibrant Temple Bar, offers a tranquil escape in the heart of the city center. Refurbished in 2019, this 4-star hotel provides comfortable accommodations just steps from premier shopping, galleries, theaters, and iconic landmarks like Grafton Street, Trinity College, the Guinness Storehouse, and Dublin Castle. Its 93 en suite rooms, including doubles, twins, triples, and family options, feature amenities such as LED TVs with satellite channels, tea and coffee facilities, hairdryers, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Discover the hidden treasures of Temple Bar's cultural quarter and enjoy the perfect base for exploring Dublin from the Fleet Street Hotel.

75460.description: Ocean Serviced Apartments are in Edinburgh, offering spacious apartments for a comfortable stay including free parking and fast Wi-Fi. The Royal Yacht Britannia, cinema and restaurants of the Ocean Terminal complex is in the area along with a 24Hour supermarket. The bustling city centre with the famous Edinburgh Castle can be reached by bus and the tram which is located close by to us. Each apartment has two bedrooms which has two bathrooms consisting of one family bathroom with a bath and one ensuite shower room. The large living rooms have digital TVs and comfortable sofas. The fully equipped kitchens have ovens, fridges, dishwashers and a washing machine in the apartment. SELF CHECK-IN: Reception is open daily from 09:00 to 17:00, an emergency contact number is available for urgent matters after hours. Property operating on a self-check in basis. To arrange self-check in, guest needs to send a copy of valid driving license/passport or ID to stay@oceanservicedapts. com and to complete the pre-authorisation security deposit of £100 which will be sent via email. All requirements must be completed in advance. Check – in starts from 16:00, and check-in instructions will be only sent once both requirements are completed. Check out time is by 10:00 GROUP BOOKINGS POLICY: Ocean Apartments has a NO GROUP policy. We do not accept certain groups to stay such as single sex parties as well as hen/stag groups, and we reserve the right not to accept bookings with an EH postcode. All guests who made a reservation for 5 or more adults, need contact reception to confirm the nature of their group booking. If the nature of your stay is not confirmed, the deposit may increase up to £200/£300 per apartment. HOUSE RULES: no smoking allowed, no parties/events allowed, no pets allowed. OCEAN SERVICED APARTMENTS CONTACT: Tel: 0131 553 7394; Email: stay@oceanservicedapts. com; Emergency Tel: 07751764649

75739.description: This luxury hotel enjoys a prime location in Dublin, nestled amidst beautiful surroundings, directly facing a sandy beach with stunning views of the Irish Sea. Guests can easily explore the heart of Portmarnock, with its vibrant nightlife, convenient train station, and picturesque beach. Malahide, offering a variety of shops, bars, and restaurants, is also just a short drive away. The hotel seamlessly integrates an old house with a modern new building, boasting 137 guest rooms. Each room offers breathtaking views, overlooking either the sea or the tranquil gardens and golf course. In-room amenities include broadband internet access and tea and coffee making facilities. The hotel's championship golf course artfully incorporates the natural dunes and terrain, creating a truly memorable experience for golf enthusiasts of all levels.

75957.description: At the foot of a hill, the resort is situated in a natural and preserved among the famous vineyards of the Priory and the Mediterranean and just 6 km from Miami Platja and the large sandy beach of Playa Cristal, located in the magnificent bay bounded on the north by Cape Salou and south by the Delta del Ebro. The structure offers accommodation with a typically Mediterranean architecture and has many spaces for your leisure. It has a restaurant where you can enjoy Mediterranean cuisine in a shaded terrace. The spacious apartments are decorated with care for maximum comfort and a fully equipped kitchen. This hotel is classed as a “bikefriendly” hotel and welcomes cyclists from all over the world. The hotel boasts facilities to support both the leisure and professional cyclist. A Fine Print: -Tourist tax: € 0. 99 Per person / night. This tax does not apply to children under 16 years. To pay on site. - Restaurant is closed from Mon, Sept 30, 2019 until Thu, Apr 02, 2020- Swimming pool is closed from Mon, Sept 30, 2019 until Thu, Apr 02, 2020-Limited reception hours from Mon, Sept 30, 2019 until Thu, Apr 02, 2020: from monday to sunday from 9 a. m. to 5 p. m. and 24-hour contact telephone number (608249119)

77640.description: This hotel is ideally located within a 10-minute walk of Dublin Castle and the Guinness Storehouse. The vibrant Temple Bar district is easily accessible by tram (10 minutes), and the Jameson Distillery Bow Street and Smithfield LUAS station are just a 2-minute walk away. A wide selection of restaurants, shops, and bars surround the hotel, and O'Connell Street is only three tram stops away. Dublin Airport is approximately a 25-minute drive. The hotel offers well-appointed, modern rooms, some boasting panoramic city and Dublin Mountains views. These bright and spacious rooms feature comfortable double beds with crisp white duvets, and the calming color palettes create a relaxing ambiance. The en suite bathrooms are roomy and include power showers. Furthermore, the hotel has implemented enhanced sanitation procedures, rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, and holds a Green Tourism accreditation for its commitment to sustainability.

77641.description: Situated in Dublin's historic Georgian quarter, this hotel is just moments from O'Connell Street, the vibrant Temple Bar district, and Croke Park. Its 92 en suite rooms feature power showers, satellite TV, tea/coffee facilities, and complimentary Wi-Fi in the lounge areas. The hotel also offers a 24-hour reception, safe, lift, dining facilities, and conference rooms. Recently renovated, the rooms boast contemporary decor and modern amenities, including hairdryers, ironing sets, and in-room safes. Sports enthusiasts will appreciate the proximity to Croke Park, while theatre lovers can easily reach the Gate and Abbey theatres. The hotel's commitment to sustainability is reflected in its Green Tourism accreditation.

77690.description: Set against the backdrop of one of London’s best known historical landmarks, at the centre of the buzzing More London district, Hilton London Tower Bridge is a contemporary 4-star hotel ideally situated for business or sightseeing whilst experiencing a real slice of vibrant London life. A short walk from London Bridge mainline and underground station, the hotel boasts elegantly furnished guest rooms, with WiFi access (fees apply), 37-inch TV , US & USB plugs, safe, tea & coffee making facilities, luxury bathroom amenities and much more. Work out in the fully equipped fitness suite and upgrade to the executive floors to enjoy a range of complimentary services, including the stunning views of The Shard from our Executive Lounge City Terrace. With 8 elegant and flexible Meeting Rooms and 2 spacious Suites, for up to 450 delegates, with state-of-the-art amenities, dedicated coordinator and 24/7 Business Centre, you are always guaranteed successful meetings & events at Hilton London Tower Bridge. Sip cocktails with friends and colleagues in the lively atmosphere of the stylish TwoRuba cocktail bar. The energy of this dynamic area and the buzz from our stylish bar concepts flows right through the hotel for a chilled, informal atmosphere.

77692.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with **reduced service**: Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently **not available**: Airport Shuttle. Hilton Dublin Airport is a contemporary 4-star hotel just 20 minutes from Dublin city center with convenient access to Dublin Airport via the hotel's airport shuttle service, which is complimentary to Hilton Honors members and available for 3 for all others. With secure underground parking, this Dublin hotel offers nine flexible meeting rooms for up to 350 guests, with WiFi and breakout rooms. The spacious meeting facilities are all bright with natural daylight and offer adjustable heating and air conditioning. The hotel offers a relaxing atmosphere for guests to unwind whilst delivering all of the required business facilities for a top class experience. Choose from a variety of guest rooms, including upgraded deluxe rooms, family rooms and suites. Large soundproof windows offer plenty of light without any noise and a choice of thoughtful amenities are available, including WiFi access, a work desk, laptop safe and large flat-screen TV. Keep fit at the fully equipped LivingWell Express Gym with cardiovascular and strength training equipment. Feast on succulent steaks and seafood at the hotel restaurant, Burnells, or unwind with an evening drink and a light meal in the bar where you can choose from plenty of local beers and spirits.

77750.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Hydrotherapy Pool. Located in the heart of historic Dublin, the Hilton Dublin Kilmainham hotel is just 10 minutes by car from the city center. This Dublin hotel is minutes' walk from Heuston Intercity Railway Station and the Luas tram line, as well as being easily accessible from the city's motorway network. Hilton Dublin Kilmainham overlooks Kilmainham Gaol Museum and the surrounding area is home to some of Dublin's premier attractions including the Guinness Brewery, Phoenix Park, Dublin Zoo, the National Museum and Old Jameson Distillery. Close by for sporting events is the famous Croke Park, The 3 Arena and the Aviva Stadium at Lansdowne Road. All rooms at this modern Dublin hotel offer WiFi internet access and plasma TVs. Step up to a deluxe room to enjoy views of Dublin City and the Dublin Mountains. Ideally located for corporate meetings, seminars or conferences, the modern meeting rooms can accommodate up to 150 people and are filled with natural daylight from floor-to-ceiling windows. Secure underground parking and 24-hour room service is available to all guests. This central Dublin hotel boasts a LivingWell leisure center including a hydrotherapy pool and fully-equipped gym. Savor delicious Irish cuisine at Cinnamon Restaurant or unwind with a whisky or traditional pint of Guinness in Broyage Bar & Bistro and Terrace.

78495.description: This family-run hotel is 800 metres from Inverness Rail Station and the shops of the city centre. It has free parking, free Wi-Fi, a bar and a restaurant serving modern Scottish cuisine. The Beaufort Hotel offers a range of rooms, some with views over the city. Each room has a TV for guests to use, as well as facilities for making tea and coffee. The restaurant offers an à la carte menu and is known for its prime Scotch beef. The restaurant and the bar also offer a range of wines and beers for guests to enjoy. St Andrews Cathedral, overlooking the river, is a 15-minute walk from The Beaufort. There are also a variety of restaurants along the riverbank, which guests can reach in 10 minutes on foot.

78690.description: This welcoming hotel is located in the heart of Dublin city, just off Upper O'Connell Street. Visitors may experience the best of the city as the hotel is situated beside some of Dublin's most renowned attractions such as Croke Park, the Aviva Stadium and the Guinness Storehouse as well as being a short stroll away from the best international shops. The establishment offers a blend of modern luxury and comfort with traditional Irish high standards of customer care and service. It is one of the leading conference hotels in Dublin and is close to the 3 Arena, the Dublin City Convention Centre Dublin (CCD), the IFSC and Temple Bar. Moreover, it boasts comfortable bedrooms with useful facilities including flat screen televisions, air conditioning, laptop sized safe, integrated work desk, complimentary wireless Internet and super comfort beds.

79273.description: Experience a unique stay at the Best Western White House Hotel, a charming townhouse hotel in Watford, just a short walk from the vibrant high street and convenient for exploring London. Enjoy easy access to the capital's countless attractions and shopping destinations. Our dedicated staff provides warm British hospitality, and the hotel offers delicious English and international cuisine. The hotel features comfortable rooms full of character, making it the perfect base for your London adventures. Please note: Bar times may vary for non-residents. Verify family room suitability for children's ages before booking. Limited free on-site parking is available on a first-come, first-served basis. Chargeable parking options are nearby; contact the hotel for details. Cash payments require a £100 deposit plus photo ID, or a £50 pre-authorization for incidentals. In-room dining is available with a £4 delivery and admin fee. Guests can enjoy meals in the lobby or breakfast room with a drink purchase from the bar.

79350.description: Surrounded by beautiful parks and gardens in the tranquil, leafy suburbs of Belfast, this luxurious hotel boasts the perfect combination of traditional Irish hospitality and modern comforts. The Ulster Museum and Belfast Botanical Gardens are just a stone's throw away, and the city centre is within walking distance of the hotel. The hotel offers guest rooms, suites and apartments suitable for families, executives and leisure travellers. Each room or suite is decorated in soothing neutral tones with a chic, contemporary edge. The adjacent restaurant, the Gallery, specializes in hearty dishes made with local and artisan ingredients, and guests can start the day with a delicious continental or full Irish breakfast. Whether travelling to Belfast on business or for a weekend city break, this hotel is sure to please with its sophisticated rooms and warm, inviting atmosphere.

79593.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an attached winery, an indoor pool, and a hot tub. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Enjoy local cuisine at Belle Epoque, a restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge and dine alfresco. Or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). A complimentary buffet breakfast is served on weekdays from 7 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7 AM to 11 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and multilingual staff. This hotel has 4 meeting rooms available for events. A train station pick-up service is provided at no charge, and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 45 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring minibars and espresso makers. Your bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets. Rooms have private balconies. Flat-screen televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Heimat und Rebbaumuseum - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Spiez Castle - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- St. James Way - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Lake Thun - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Diemtigtal Nature Park - 8. 4 km / 5. 2 mi- Culture and Convention Center Thun - 8. 7 km / 5. 4 mi- Schloss Schadau - 9. 5 km / 5. 9 mi- Thun-Panorama - 9. 6 km / 6 mi- Arena Thun - 11. 2 km / 7 mi- Swiss Army Museum - 13. 4 km / 8. 3 mi- Stockhorn Cableway - 14 km / 8. 7 mi- Tropic House - 14. 1 km / 8. 7 mi- Thun Ferry Terminal - 14. 1 km / 8. 8 mi- Blumlisalp Steamship - 14. 3 km / 8. 9 mi- Thun Art Museum - 14. 6 km / 9. 1 mi.

79594.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Thun. It is close to the n/a. The Hotel has a restaurant.

79621.description: A secret passageway connects the front of this property to Green Park, and within 5 minutes guests can walk to the Green Park underground station, Old Bond Street and Jermyn Street. Opened in 1912, parts of the establishment are almost 400 years old. After major renovation works, the hotel now offers 105 rooms, spread over 6 floors. Facilities include a traditional lounge and a fine-dining restaurant, as well as a distinctive American Bar, popular with royalty and a great spot for a light meal. The hotel is proud of its unique historical courtyard, provided with tables for outdoor dining. The elegant, traditional and quiet rooms each offer an en- suite marble bathroom and are fitted with complimentary wireless Internet access and individually regulated air conditioning and heating.

79871.description: La Selva Hotel in La Selva del Camp, in the province of Tarragona, welcomes you. The combination of comfort, personalised service and fully equipped facilities make this hotel the perfect choice for both family and business stays, as well as for holding all kinds of events. Its 62 rooms have been designed to offer spaces devoted to relaxation and peaceful rest. Spacious, warm and functional, the different types of rooms La Selva Hotel offers meet the needs of families, business clients, couples or groups of friends. Whatever the reason for your trip, we have a room for you. In addition, its full range of services, including bathroom with bathtub and shower, desk with chair, air conditioning, heating, TV, amenities and free Wi-Fi, mean you won't have to worry about anything.

80431.description: Ideally located close to the stunning Ayrshire coasts, this hotel is immersed in peace and serenity. Located in the historical, picturesque village of Fenwick, this hotel offers visitors close proximity to the many natural and cultural attractions that the area has to offer. The property enjoys close proximity to Glasgow International and Prestwick airports. This wonderful hotel offers comfortable, stylish guest rooms, in which to escape the bustle of daily life. Offering facilities and services to meet the needs of business and leisure travellers, combined with impeccable attention to detail, this hotel is sure to impress.

80673.description: Housed in the 19th-century aristocratic residence of the Baron de Peellaer, this luxurious hotel enjoys an enviable setting in the centre of Bruges. Guests will be impressed by opulent décor featuring crystal chandeliers, brown wooden furniture and cutting-edge amenities to meet needs of even the most discerning visitors. The spacious and sun-lit rooms are fitted with cosy furnishings and plush bed linens, featuring a quintessence of luxury and refined taste. Visitors may treat themselves to ultimate relaxation at the hotel spa or have an invigorating workout at the fitness centre. The signature restaurant offers a rich and flavourful buffet-style breakfast and is sure to enchant patrons with sophisticated décor, exquisite gastronomy and excellent attention to detail. Meeting facilities are also available for those travelling on business purpose.

80786.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as bicycles for rent, a terrace, and a garden at this Bruges hotel. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, and enjoy amenities including babysitting services (surcharge) and a cozy lobby fireplace. A coffee shop/cafe and bar/lounge offer dining and drinks. Start your day with a local cuisine breakfast (fee applies). Other conveniences include dry cleaning/laundry services, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and free self-parking. Each of the 31 guestrooms features a flat-screen TV with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with shower and complimentary toiletries, a safe, and a desk. Hotel Olympia is located in Bruges' historical district, a short drive from the Bruges Christmas Market and Market Square.

80787.description: This modern, stylish city hotel is located in Tallaght on Whitestown Way, just 9 km from Dublin's city center. Ideal for business and leisure travelers, it's only 3. 5 km from the Arena and 20 km from Dublin Airport. The hotel is a short walk from the Tallaght Luas light rail station and The Square Shopping Centre. The on-site leisure center features a fully equipped gym, a swimming pool with hydro jets, a steam room, a hot tub, an aerobics studio, and a sauna. Rooms are available with comfortable double, queen, or two single beds; some rooms also have balconies and tea/coffee making facilities. Overlooked by the Dublin Mountains, the hotel boasts a two-floor conference center with 10 private rooms, the largest accommodating up to 275 people. The hotel has implemented enhanced sanitation procedures reviewed by Bureau Veritas and is accredited by Green Tourism.

80789.description: The hotel is just a 5-minute walk from the centre of Liverpool. It offers good access to public transport, with Liverpool Lime Street train station just 2 minutes away, and Queen Square bus station 5 minutes away. The Met Quarter and its shopping opportunities and the Walker Art Gallery are also in the immediate vicinity. Penny Lane and the Liverpool Tate Modern can be reached easily on public transport. The hotel is just 16 km from Liverpool Airport, while Manchester Airport is 57 km away. This city hotel, which dates back to 1900, was renovated in 2005. It has 50 rooms in total spread over 3 floors. The hotel offers a lobby with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, lift access, a TV room as well as bar and limited dining facilities. There are limited parking spaces available (subject to fees). All of the standard rooms are finished in a basic style. They are clean and tidy and come with an en suite bathroom with bath (no shower). Tea and coffee making facilities are provided in the rooms. Individually adjustable heating features as standard. There are no televisions in the rooms. The Resident's Bar serves a wide range of premium brand alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks. The DugOut Bar, a beer bar/sports bar with a difference, serves a wide range of bottled beers from around the world along with premium alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks. Entertainment includes wall-to-wall plasma screens, a pool table and a dart board.

81150.description: A warm welcome and traditional hospitality await guests at the Plough and Harrow Hotel in Edgbaston, Birmingham. The red brick Victorian architecture of the original building, along with its large garden, lawns, and ample parking, distinguishes the Plough & Harrow from other Birmingham hotels. Built in 1704 as a wayside inn, the hotel boasts a rich history. It was renowned as one of Birmingham's most popular hotels in the 1980s and early 1990s, even earning the Egon Ronay Hotel of the Year award in 1984. Its restaurant was *the* place to dine, attracting celebrities, politicians, and prominent figures. Following a period of underinvestment and changing ownership, the hotel returned to private hands in 2010 under TTM Partnership LLP. They've embarked on a 10-year phased investment and refurbishment plan, aiming to restore the hotel to its former glory as a high-quality, independent boutique hotel. The owners envision the Plough and Harrow as the preferred choice for corporate and leisure travelers, weddings, local functions, and casual dining. Future plans include expanding the hotel and potentially adding a spa and beauty facility around 2020 or later, after the existing public areas and bedrooms are refurbished.

81231.description: The hotel is located in the heart of the city and linked directly to Birmingham International Convention Centre and Symphony Hall. It is within walking distance of Broad Street and Brindley Place, the city's vibrant nightlife area. The family-friendly residence features deluxe accommodation combining a central location, beneficial for both business and leisure travellers. It comprises a total of 319 guest rooms and guests are invited to make use of a number of in-house facilities and services. They can wine and dine in the two restaurants, one of which is located at the main lobby level under a unique glass-roofed atrium, and the other offers a relaxed atmosphere nestled around Roman pillars and naturalistic surroundings.

name.content: Holiday Inn Luton South M1, JCT.9

82669.description: A modern Luton Airport hotel near the M1 with free parking, a smart restaurant and a poolHoliday Inn® Luton - South hotel offers family-friendly accommodation a 10-minute drive from Luton London Airport (LTN). The hotel's Park, Stay & Go package allows guests to catch flights refreshed, leaving their car in a secure parking lot. For staying guests parking is free, and the nearby M1 makes it easy to get around. Travelling with kids? The lions and elephants of Whipsnade Zoo are just five miles from the hotel, and it’s a 20-minute drive to the Harry Potter tour at Warner Bros. Studios. Milton Keyes, 30 minutes away, draws shoppers with thecentre:mk, a covered mall with over 200 shops plus restaurants and a special events hall. Grand St. Alban's Cathedral, with the longest nave in England, is just eight miles away. Business travelers appreciate the location a short drive from central Luton businesses. You can host anything from a client meeting to a banquet in one of the hotel's five purpose-built rooms. Free Wi-Fi, in-room work desks and a Business Centre will help you stay productive. The skylit pool and spa area is a lovely place to unwind or cool off after a workout in the fully equipped fitness centre. Treat yourself at Borders restaurant with a delicious buffet breakfast and à la carte dinner. Arriving late? There's 24-hour room service. Kids stay and eat free.

82670.description:
Crowne Plaza® Harrogate is a contemporary hotel perfectly positioned in the heart of Harrogate, ideal for business, leisure, and everything in between. The hotel features seven versatile meeting rooms accommodating up to 400 guests, supported by a dedicated Meetings Director and tailored catering options to suit every occasion. 

Guests can enjoy restful nights with the exclusive Sleep Advantage® programme, offering premium bedding, quiet zones, and guaranteed wake-up calls. For fitness enthusiasts, the on-site mini gym is available exclusively to hotel residents. 

Dine at Springs Restaurant, serving a variety of delicious dishes, or unwind with drinks and light bites at Springs Bar, the perfect spot to relax and socialise. 

Harrogate itself is a charming Victorian spa town in the heart of Yorkshire, known for its boutique shopping, exceptional dining scene, and famous Bettys Tea Rooms. The town is surrounded by picturesque countryside and historical landmarks, including Spofforth Castle and The Valley Gardens. 

The hotel is less than a 10-minute walk from Harrogate Station, with regular services to York and Leeds, and onward connections to Edinburgh and London. Convenient on-site parking in our underground car park is available for a daily fee, with accessible parking at the hotel entrance.

82971.description: This historic Georgian townhouse welcomes guests to central Edinburgh, conveniently located near excellent bus services to the city center. Enjoy complimentary off-street parking and a continental breakfast served in your room. The hotel adheres to WTTC guidelines, with disinfected rooms and contactless check-in/check-out. Please contact the hotel for late arrival information and your lockbox code. All bathrooms are either ensuite or private. From this elegant and peaceful setting, explore the vibrant city of Edinburgh, with its unique blend of historical and modern attractions. Edinburgh Castle, the Scottish Museum, Holyrood Palace, Dynamic Earth, the Royal Mile, the University of Edinburgh, the Royal Commonwealth Pool, and golf courses are easily accessible. The hotel offers stunning views of Edinburgh's renowned architecture and beautiful hillsides from every room. Our staff is happy to assist with directions, tour bookings, and local information. Edinburgh has mainline rail connections to London and other parts of Scotland. We are a 20-minute drive from the airport and 5 minutes from Waverley Train Station.

83150.description: Located a short driving distance from London City Airport and only 3 km from Woolwich Ferry, this charming hotel is ideal for those seeking accommodation for a holiday stopover or wanting to explore the vibrant English capital. Travellers can explore the ExCel Exhibition Centre, an international exhibition and conference centre which hosts a variety of interesting events, or visit Upton Park to see the grounds of West Ham Football Club. For shopping fanatics, Galleons Reach Shopping is a dream centre where they can discover over 35 major stores all in one convenient location. Alternatively, if guests are looking for hotels near the world-famous O2 Arena then this is a great option, as the thriving entertainment venue is only 9 km away, making it the perfect place to stay if visitors have tickets for an up-and-coming show. The hotel has a fresh new look and features a new room design complete with Dreamer Bed so travellers can be sure of a great night's sleep. Guests staying at this modern property can take advantage of the café bar and parking facilities, all for a comfortable stay in London.

84040.description: Discover Chester's favorite venue, The Mill Hotel & Spa, a waterside destination in the heart of the Roman city. Enjoy complimentary parking and access to our 60-foot swimming pool, hot tub, steam room, and state-of-the-art Techno-gym. Our public bar, featured in the Good Beer Guide for the past decade, offers 16 rotating hand-pulled beers weekly. Originally built in c1830 as Griffith's Corn Mill, the hotel expanded in 2001 with the addition of the south wing, connected by an internal bridge over the Shropshire Union Canal. We offer five room grades, from Standard Rooms in the original Mill Building to spacious Club Class Rooms and the luxurious Champagne Suite in the South Wing. All rooms are en suite and include Sky TV and Wi-Fi. The Mill boasts extensive dining options. The award-winning, waterside Canaletto Restaurant serves lunch and dinner daily, offering both à la carte and table d'hôte menus, with Dine & Dance evenings on Fridays and Saturdays. The L'eau Cuisine, our broad-beam restaurant cruiser moored alongside the hotel, offers lunch and dinner cruises seven days a week, accommodating up to 50 people with a licensed bar and dance floor. Special events include Queen Mary Crown Cruises and Roman High Tea Cruises. The Brasserie Flambé Steak Restaurant (open Sunday-Thursday) serves various starters, main courses, desserts, and specialty flamed coffees. The Peppermill Trattoria, located on the ground floor of the south wing, is ideal for a light lunch after the gym, with a selection of sandwiches, baked potatoes, and salads. Finally, the Deli Bar in our Real Ale Bar offers traditional homemade bar meals.

84057.description: This wonderful hotel is nestled in the heart of the historically rich city of Calafell. Located within 37.3 kilometres from Tarragona and less than 64 kilometres from Barcelona, this charming property is a perfect choice for both business and leisure travellers alike. The property is conveniently close to public transport networks including Calafell railway station only 1.4 kilometres away, allowing visitors to explore this beautiful area. Guests will find themselves within walking distance from the pristine sandy beach. This lovely hotel enjoys impressive architectural design and elegant décor. The light-filled hotel rooms are ample and tastefully appointed, offering a complete escape for senses. The stylish on-site restaurant will enchant patrons with varied and flavourful dishes. Guests may also have a soothing dip in the outdoor swimming pool.

84242.description: This hotel enjoys a superb location on the South Bank, rubbing shoulders with many of London's most famous attractions such as the Houses of Parliament, Westminster Abbey, London Dungeons and the London Eye. Named ‘Best Family Friendly Hotel' at the HRS Hotel Excellence Awards 2011, the hotel specialises in treating children like VIPs through its Family Fun in the City package. Spacious family rooms include substantial closets and plenty of space to relax and unwind, while Studio Rooms and Penthouse Apartments afford an enhanced feeling of indulgence with defined sleeping and living areas. Additional facilities include a restaurant and a bar where the guests can enjoy a nice meal and a beverage and a modern fitness centre were guests can keep up with their routine.

84356.description: The hotel is centrally located in Bloomsbury, with Euston, Russell Square and King's Cross/St Pancras stations close by. Ideal location to explore attractions around the hotel, the London Zoo, the British Museum, Madame Tussauds and Camden Market are at a short driving distance. This stylish property was recently restored and is housed in a building which dates back to 1906. Italian architect Guiseppe Boscherini has created a fresh, contemporary design to meet the needs of a highly discerning corporate and conference market. The hotel offers 100 rooms spread over 6 floors. Facilities and amenities include conference and banqueting for up to 250 delegates, air-conditioned common areas, a restaurant and Internet. All bedrooms have en-suite facilities with everything that guests will need during the stay.

84456.description: Birmingham offers a wealth of cultural attractions and a fascinating history, as well as fantastic nightlife, and this luxurious apartment hotel puts guests in the heart of it all. Visitors can see the historic Bull Ring market, Victoria Square, and the jewellery quarter, and those with a sweet tooth will not want to miss Cadbury World. The serviced apartments are bright and spacious, each with a fully-equipped kitchen, open-plan lounge and dining area, private bathroom, and one or two bedrooms. Guests can take advantage of the kitchen and complimentary DVD rentals in reception to prepare a wonderful home-cooked meal and have a night in, though the hotel is surrounded by the city's best restaurants, pubs and entertainment venues. The hotel also offers a range of helpful services such as reception, parking and grocery shopping delivery service, all for a productive business trip or delightful city break. Check In: Reception opening hours are 08:30 to 19:00 Monday to Friday, 10:30 to 19:00 on Saturday, closed on Sunday. If you are arriving outside these hours, please contact The Spires reception. Please be aware we require a £250 security deposit before arrival which requires to be paid through our secure on-line payment portal. IMPORTANT** Please contact The Spires reception 48/72hours before your arrival date**

84545.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. This hotel also features wedding services and a fireplace in the lobby. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, The Restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and 2 meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 36 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and coffee/tea makers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.
