Enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant and cafe, or unwind in one of the two bars/lounges. The hotel features 68 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms. Amenities include bicycle rentals, a terrace, a garden, wedding services, and tour/ticket assistance. A buffet breakfast is available (fee applies). Nearby attractions include Kingussie Golf Club and Ruthven Barracks, both within a 5-minute drive. The hotel is also a short drive from Highland Folk Museum and Cairngorms National Park.

96134.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features wedding services, a television in a common area, and a picnic area. Enjoy local cuisine at Convive, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 9:30 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a computer station, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and 21 meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 114 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment.

96135.description: Featuring a convenient location just a few minutes from Leeds city centre, this elegant hotel is a great base while visiting the area's popular attractions. Leeds Bradford International Airport is just a 20-minute drive away and links to the public transport and national rail links can all be found just a short walk away. Ranging from Standard to the luxurious Executive rooms, all the accommodation units have been superbly appointed to ensure a comfortable stay. They all come complete with ‘dive into bed duvets' and hypoallergenic pillows to ensure a great night's sleep. A wide choice of well-crafted dishes are served at the onsite restaurant, while the cosy bar offers a unique fusion of classic and contemporary culinary creations that will delight even the most discerning palates. The onsite meeting rooms are ideal for corporate travellers and have been tastefully designed to suit any occasion. Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification.

96534.description: This hotel is located 3. 5 km from Dublin city centre and within walking distance of the Dublin City University and the Helix complex. It is just off the M50 and the M1 for easy access to destinations north or south of the city. The leisure traveller will find the most beautiful coastline and beaches in the country, at Malahide and Howth, just a short drive away. This hotel is just 5 minutes' drive from Dublin Airport. This contemporary city residence opened in 2006 and offers 125 spacious rooms designed to meet the needs of today's budget-conscious families and corporate guests. The reception desk is manned around the clock providing travellers with convenient flexibility and useful information. The breakfast room features modern décor and can seat up to 60 people in an open-plan setting.

97114.description: On an exclusive Victorian street in Ballsbridge, this hotel is nestled in the heart of Dublin city centre's most sophisticated quarter. This outstanding boutique property is located 10 minutes' walk from Grafton Street, St. Stephen's Green, the Aviva Stadium, the O2 and the RDS, and is in the epicentre of Dublin's happening cultural scene. This hotel features a sharp eye for detail and a dashing knack for stylish indulgence. Its prime situation just off Baggot Street in Dublin's south city centre makes it the ideal choice to discover all the stunning region has to offer. This upmarket establishment provides a choice of individually designed guest rooms that will delight even the most discerning visitors, equipped with the latest technology and offering a stylish décor. The award-winning restaurant and cocktail bar serves upmarket bistro cuisine with the finest Irish produce, all for a unique stay in Ireland.

97283.description:
Situated in the heart of Inverness, this award-winning, luxurious boutique hotel and bar boasts a convenient setting within a few minutes’ walk of the High Street and Inverness Castle. 
An exclusive hideaway in the centre of the city, Rocpool is within 20 minutes of Inverness Airport and approximately 5 minutes from Inverness bus and train stations, making all local attractions easily accessible. 
We are pleased to offer our Resident Lounge Menu between12:30 PM – 8:00 PM for those who wish to enjoy a casual meal. 

For a more formal dining experience, allow Rocpool Reserve to help you discover Inverness' hidden culinary gems. Our dedicated team will be delighted to provide recommendations for dining in the area.

97414.description: Located 25 miles from London and 20 minutes from Heathrow, Foxhills is a 4-star resort acclaimed by The Times as 'one of the best luxury family hotels. ' Set on a 400-acre estate, this 19th-century mansion is ideal for weddings, parties, and conferences. Guests enjoy two championship golf courses, 11 tennis courts, a health club with treatment rooms, three restaurants, and three bars. The 70 beautifully-appointed bedrooms offer 24-hour room service, same-day laundry, work desks with data ports and voicemail, and in-room entertainment including magazines, movies, and a lending library of films, music, and books. Guests can also enjoy on-site amenities like tennis and golf clinics, gym classes, and three swimming pools. With nine conference rooms, Foxhills also caters to business and meeting needs.

97482.address: Ctra Nacional 340 Km. 1059 (Sol De Riu), Km 1059
97482.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages or enjoy recreation amenities such as an outdoor pool. This country house also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the country house's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. This country house has 2 meeting rooms available for events. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 17 guestrooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

97576.description: An elegant hotel, ideally located for both Business and LeisureWelcome to Crowne Plaza London Gatwick Airport Hotel. We are located just 5 minutes drive from LGW Airport and less than 1 mile from Crawley Manor Royal Business District, home to many multinational companies such as Thales, Elekta, and the Boeing Flight Simulator. The Gatwick Express offers a direct rail link to London in just 30 minutes and regular trains from Three Bridges and Crawley, just under 2 miles from the hotel, also offer links to London and Brighton. Our comfortable bedrooms have free Wi-Fi, USB chargers and satellite TV and the Sleep Advantage® programme offers premium bedding and quiet zones so you will not be disturbed. The Cube Restaurant serves delicious locally sourced food for breakfast and dinner and drinks and light meals are available all day in the trendy Bar 92. When you are off duty, relax and enjoy cocktails with your colleagues on the heated outdoor terrace, enjoy our 24 hour Fitness suite. Our chic meeting spaces include private boardrooms and a gorgeous event suite with a foyer and a bar, so you can host receptions or dinners for up to 200 guests or 280 guests for meetings. Your Crowne Plaza Meetings Director can help take care of all the details.

name.content: Great Hallingbury Manor, BW Signature Collec

97661.description: This eco-friendly hotel is beautifully situated amidst the splendour and appeal of the English countryside. The property is located within easy access of Hatfield Forest and Flitch Way. Links to the public transport network can be found just 1 km away, in the town of Takeley. Restaurants, bars and nightlife opportunities are just 5 km from the property, in Bishops Stortford. Stansted Airport is conveniently located 3 km from the hotel. This classical, Tudor-style mansion is set amidst its own private parkland, which features a natural lake. Guests can dine in style in the restaurant, or enjoy a more relaxed meal in the lounge.  Standard double and single rooms are located in our Annexe across the road, Hallingbury House. All patrons of these rooms are welcome to enjoy all the benefits of the main building and its facilities.

98112.description: It's hard to imagine a more convenient spot than the Premier Inn Hotel Glasgow City Centre South. You're just up the road from two of Scotland's biggest football teams. And, if you don't get your kicks on the pitch, you'll find all the nightlife, city centre attractions and businesses just a saunter away. See 'The Beautiful Game' at Celtic Park or Ibrox. Or people watch and window-shop your way along Argyle Street. Make great music your goal at the Hydro, then come back and kick off your shoes and relax with some fabulous food at our restaurant. Then take a dive into a lovely comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

98207.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Recreational amenities include a hot tub, sauna, and fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, wedding services, and a lobby fireplace. Enjoy modern European cuisine at The Ivy restaurant, overlooking the garden, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (7:00 AM to 10:00 AM) for a fee. Business amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Free self-parking is available. The hotel offers 145 guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms (separate bathtubs and showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers), safes, and desks. Housekeeping is provided daily. Nearby attractions include Blanchardstown Shopping Centre (5. 7 mi), Carton House Golf Club (5. 9 mi), Maynooth University (5. 9 mi), and Dublin Airport (16. 4 mi).

98281.description: This city hotel is located in the centre of Cardiff, close to a number of bars, restaurants, shops and the Principality Stadium. It lies just 500 metres from the central railway station and 4. 8 km from the M4 motorway. Cardiff International Airport is 26 km from the accommodation, whilst Bristol International Airport is some 84 km away. This hotel offers a cool, boutique style and quite spectacular views over Cardiff city. The 60-room hotel enjoys a city centre location and features facilities including 24-hour reception and check-out service, hotel safe, cloakroom and lift access. Guests will find a lounge bar serving refreshments, as well as 2 conference rooms and wireless Internet access in all bedrooms and public areas. Guests arriving by car can leave their vehicles in nearby car park at reduced rates (fees apply). The hotel comprises cool and contemporary bedrooms with individually regulated air conditioning and heating, quadruple glazing, high-speed Internet access and a direct dial telephone. The rooms feature spacious en suite bathrooms with power showers and also come with flat-screen TV, a laptop safe, hairdryer, tea and coffee making facilities. Please contact the hotel prior to arrival with regards to room requests and additional information on 02920 550750 or email reception@theroyalhotel. uk. com.

98419.description: Located less than a mile from Derry City Centre, the four-star Ramada Da Vinci's Hotel offers convenient access to major routes. This modern hotel features 65 bedrooms, a choice of bars, a Grillroom restaurant, meeting and event facilities, and complimentary on-site parking. Free Wi-Fi is also available. Ideal for weekend getaways in Northwest Ireland or business trips, with Derry City Airport only 7 miles away. The world-host trained staff looks forward to welcoming you.

98421.description: Enjoy your stay at Kings Park Hotel in Glasgow, conveniently located a 5-minute drive from Hampden Park and 10 minutes from the OVO Hydro. This hotel offers 26 comfortable guestrooms, complimentary Wi-Fi, and wedding services. Savor a meal at the on-site restaurant and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A business center, 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage are also available. Event facilities include conference space and a meeting room. Free self-parking is provided. Nearby attractions include Glasgow Green, Emirates Arena, and Queen's Park. Glasgow International Airport (GLA) is approximately 17. 6 km away.

98733.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace at Astors Belgravia, a centrally located London hotel. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast, served from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy the convenience of concierge services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Relax in one of the 47 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a flat-screen TV, safe, and desk. The hotel is within a 15-minute walk of Buckingham Palace and Victoria Station, and a short distance from Sloane Square and Harrods.

99040.description: Novotel Brugge Centrum is a newly renovated hotel and offers a contemporary, relaxed atmosphere in Bruges city centre, ideal for families and business travellers. Easily accessible by train and with a car park nearby, our 4-star hotel is the perfect base for exploring the Venice of the North on foot. Enjoy tasty dishes in our modern restaurant or a cheerful moment at the bar. In fine weather, our heated outdoor swimming pool awaits.

99277.description: This modern 4-star hotel, featuring classic decor, offers 115 rooms in the heart of Leysin. The property comprises two buildings connected by an internal passageway and boasts 13 fully equipped meeting rooms, accommodating 10 to 200 people, plus an auditorium/cinema with seating for 187. Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant, lobby bar with a TV lounge, an additional bar, a small garden, and a pétanque area. The elegantly furnished rooms offer amenities such as an ensuite bathroom with a shower, satellite TV, a workspace, a minibar, a direct telephone line, and a double bed. Some rooms also feature panoramic mountain views and balconies (first to third floors). Room and laundry services are available. The hotel's elegant restaurant serves French cuisine prepared with locally sourced ingredients.

99279.description: This 4-star spa hotel in the heart of the Alpine holiday resort of Leukerbad combines leisure activities in beautiful countryside with blissful relaxation. The hotel's recently opened spa with thermal indoor & outdoor pools, biotop, hammam, sauna and fitness area guarantees wellbeing and offers an extensive range of professional cosmetic and massage treatments. The mountain railway to the TORRENT hiking and skiing area is only a few minutes' walk away. Free WIFI access is available throughout the hotel.

99283.description: Holiday Inn® Hasselt places you close to the city's central bars and restaurants. A 10-minute walk away, Hasselt station is served by local and regional trains. Brussels Airport is a 50-minute drive away, and Liège Airport is just 35 minutes away. Around the corner from the hotel, Modemuseum Hasselt traces the history of fashion with collections from the 18th century to the present. Five minutes away, the Jenevermuseum examines jenever, Belgium's juniper-flavoured national liquor. Stroll past cherry trees and koi ponds in the Japanese Garden, a 20-minute walk from the hotel. Opposite the park, the Trixxo Arena hosts international concert and event programmes. Here for work? Host up to 250 delegates in the hotel's five naturally-lit meeting rooms. Catering is available upon request, and there's free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Enjoy city or canal views from the stylish guestrooms of this welcoming hotel, where Kids Stay and Eat Free. Start your day with a buffet breakfast in the hotel's modern Brasserie De Boulevard, and enjoy our traditional Belgian cuisine. Unwind with a mini gym workout or a sauna session before meeting friends for drinks at the bar.

99285.description: Hasselt city centre hotel, with free Wi-Fi and breakfast buffet included. Just off the Hasselt ring road, Holiday Inn Express® Hasselt is located 10 minutes' walk from Hasselt station, for local and regional trains. Brussels Airport is a 50-minute drive away, Liège Airport is just 35 minutes away and Maastricht Aachen Airport (MST) is 40 minutes' drive. Head to the Modemuseum Hasselt, five minutes' walk from the hotel, to admire an extensive fashion collection. A seven-minute walk takes you to the Jenevermuseum to learn about the history of Belgium's national liquor – jenever. You can catch concerts and sport events at the Trixxo Arena, 10 minutes' drive from the hotel. Host up to 25 people in the hotel's naturally lit meeting room, and stay connected with free Wi-Fi throughout the building. Guests are a three-minute walk from a public car park. In the smart, welcoming guestrooms, make yourself a tea or coffee and relax with a movie on the flatscreen TV. Wake up to the continental Express Start Breakfast buffet included in the room rate. Later, enjoy a drink in the Lobby Bar, or out on the leafy terrace. To savour traditional Belgian cuisine for lunch or dinner, visit the Brasserie De Boulevard, three minutes' walk away in our sister hotel Holiday Inn Hasselt.

99819.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as an outdoor pool and bicycle rentals. This aparthotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and barbecue grills. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and luggage storage. Free self-parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 32 air-conditioned rooms featuring kitchens with full-sized refrigerators/freezers and ovens. Rooms have private balconies or patios. Flat-screen televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while complimentary Wi-Fi keeps you connected. Conveniences include phones, microwaves, and coffee/tea makers. Located in Paihia, Edgewater Palms Apartments is steps from Bay of Islands and Paihia Beach. This beach aparthotel is 0. 1 mi (0. 2 km) from St. Paul’s Church and 0. 3 mi (0. 6 km) from Paihia Wharf. The nearest airports are Kerikeri Airport (KKE) and Auckland International Airport (AKL).

100016.description:
A city centre hotel located in the heart of Chester. Crowne Plaza® Chester is the perfect setting for business, pleasure and leisure. Workout or book a beauty treatment in our leisure club, or wind down in the heated pool and sauna. Eat at Stables Bar and Grill restaurant with views of the Welsh hills, then retire to the lounge for drinks in a relaxed atmosphere. There’s also an outdoor terrace for those who prefer to enjoy the fresh air. The hotel has an entire floor of meeting rooms to accommodate up to 600 guests, with a dedicated Crowne Plaza Meetings Director on site, a Conference Café and food and drink options to match your requirements. 
Chester is steeped in history and culture, it boasts the most complete city walls, the oldest racecourse and the largest Roman Amphitheatre in Britain. This unique city offers fantastic shopping and a vibrant café and bar scene. You are also just a short journey away from the world-renowned Chester Zoo, and even more great shopping at the Cheshire Oaks designer outlet. Chester station has direct trains to London, Manchester and Liverpool. Manchester and Liverpool John Lennon airports are both within a 40-minute drive. Secure parking is available for a daily fee.

100032.address: Westbound A55, Northop Hall, Mold Flintshire
100032.description: A modern North Wales hotel close to Chester, with a restaurant and facilities for meetings and weddingsHoliday Inn® A55 Chester West hotel is in the beautiful Welsh countryside, close to the border and a 15-minute drive from Chester. A park-and-ride scheme provides hassle-free access to the city. The hotel is on the A55, which provides links to the region. The area is best explored by car, and there's ample free parking at the hotel. The Welsh coastline is dotted with castles. CADW castles and historic sites are all within 30 minutes' drive from the hotel. Hunt for designer bargains at Cheshire Oaks Outlet, 20 minutes away by car, or head to Chester, where you can discover history at Chester Cathedral, see the ancient city walls or spend a family day out at Chester Zoo. Business travelers visit the area for Deeside Industrial Park and St. Asaph Business Park, 10 and 25 minutes away respectively. You can hold a conference at one of the hotel's four meeting rooms. The largest, the Vivaldi Suite, opens on to a landscaped garden, making it an ideal venue for weddings, too. Kids stay and eat free, so book a family room with two double beds and make the most of dining at the hotel's Conservatory Restaurant. Work out at the mini-gym, and stay connected with free Wi-Fi. End the day unwinding with a drink in the Open Lobby Bar Area.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Hull City Centre

100036.description: The Holiday Inn Express Hull City Centre offers comfort and convenience in Hull's revitalized city center. Located next to Hull Paragon Interchange, the city's bus and rail terminal, the hotel is a 45-minute taxi ride from Humberside Airport (HUY) and a short drive from ferries to Belgium and the Netherlands. Guests can easily explore the historic Old Town, visit the Streetlife Museum of Transport and the Hull Maritime Museum, or discover The Deep aquarium. The hotel features a business center, meeting rooms, a bar with an outdoor balcony, and free WiFi. Enjoy an inclusive Express Start breakfast and convenient parking at St. Stephen's Shopping Centre (HU2 8QP).

100038.description: A welcoming Redditch hotel with free parking and breakfast includedHoliday Inn® Express Birmingham - Redditch hotel places you in the town centre within easy reach of the M42 motorway. Steps from the hotel, Redditch Station offers direct trains to Birmingham New Street Station. Catching your flight is a breeze, with Birmingham Airport (BHX) just 30 minutes away by car. Business guests can host meetings for up to 50 delegates in our 2 naturally lit conference rooms. Within a 30-minute drive, you can sink your teeth into chocolate production at Cadbury World, or explore England's grisly history in the medieval dungeon of Warwick Castle. In Stratford-upon-Avon, also an easy drive away, visitors can view the half-timbered house where William Shakespeare was born, and see productions of his plays at the Royal Shakespeare Theatre. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free Wi-Fi- Complimentary on-site parking- Business CentreThe Express Start™ Breakfast buffet included in the room rate features sausages and scrambled eggs, as well as continental items. After a busy day, settle down to a satisfying evening meal in the smart restaurant, or enjoy a glass of wine or a pint in the bar. Comfy guest rooms come with handy bedside USB ports to keep your devices charged, and a choice of pillows for a restful stay.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Strathclyde Park M74 JCT 5

100043.description: Clean, COVID-secure and recently refurbished Holiday Inn Express® Strathclyde Park M74, Jct. 5. The hotel is dog-friendly and features ample free car-parking and breakfast included. Holiday Inn Express® Strathclyde Park M74, Jct. 5 hotel sits at the edge of the beautiful and dynamic Strathclyde Country Park. Up the road, Motherwell offers regular rail services to London. The hotel is just off the M74, close to the M73 &M8 motorways for access to Glasgow, Edinburgh, Stirling and beyond. Glasgow Airport (GLA) is 25 minutes away, and Edinburgh Airport (EDI), a 45-minute drive. It's a short walk to M&D's, Scotland’s theme park, and there are walking and cycling trails around nearby Strathclyde Loch, which also hosts a wide range of water sports. Hamilton is a short drive away, a historical town home to Hamilton Park Racecourse and Strathclyde Business Park. Eurocentral Industrial Estate is 10 minutes up the road. At this hotel you can enjoy: - Free Wi-Fi &free parking- Express Start™ Breakfast included in the room rate- Rooms with sofa beds for families- Two meeting rooms Bright, newly refurbished guest rooms are cleaned using science-led protocols as part of the IHG Way of Clean, for your safety and are designed for your comfort, with flat-screen TVs, pillow menu and blackout curtains. Wake up to our delicious breakfast of scrambled eggs, bacon, sausages, baked beans and continental items. In the evening, unwind over drinks at our Express® bar.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London - Golders Green (A406)

100047.description: A modern London hotel near Hampstead Heath with free WiFi and parking, and an inclusive hot breakfastJust off the North Circular road, Holiday Inn Express® London - Golders Green hotel is within 15 minutes' drive of both the M1 and M25 motorways, and the hotel offers free, on-site parking. A 10-minute bus ride away, Tube trains run from Golders Green underground station to central London. Heathrow Airport (LHR) is 45 minutes' drive from the hotel. Head to historic Hampstead Heath, a 10-minute drive away, for woodland, swimming ponds and sweeping London views. Or drive 15 minutes to the 19th-century Alexandra Palace, set in leafy parkland with an ice-skating rink and an international entertainment programme. Also a 15-minute drive from the hotel, iconic Wembley Stadium hosts major football matches. You can host events in the hotel’s two flexible meetings spaces for up to 250 people. There's free WiFi throughout the hotel and free parking.

name.content: Citrus Hotel Coventry South by Compass Hospitality

100048.description: The total number of accomodation units is 51. The hotel offers Wi-Fi internet connection on-site. The front desk offers 24-hour reception. All guest rooms at this disability-friendly property are wheelchair-accessible. Additionally, a car park is available on the premises for guests' extra convenience. Due to its functional meeting facilities, this accomodation is a perfect place for guests travelling for business purposes. Some services of Citrus Hotel Coventry South by Compass Hospitality may be payable.

100049.description: A modern Belfast hotel near Queen's University Belfast with easy access to the Titanic Quarter and the city centre. Holiday Inn Express® Belfast City - hotel offers free on-site parking and is 15 minutes' drive from George Best Belfast City Airport (BHD). The hotel is a couple of minutes walk to bars and restaurants of central Belfast and is 15-minute walk from Belfast Great Victoria Street Train Station. Business guests are a 15-minute drive from the Titanic Exhibition Centre, which hosts major conferences and events, while Belfast Waterfront conference centre is 20 minutes' walk away. Back at the hotel, three smart meeting rooms can host events for up to 105 people. There's free Wi-Fi throughout. You can catch live concerts and sports at the SSE Arena Belfast, a 10-minute drive from the hotel. The Grand Opera House hosts theatre productions and musicals, or you can check out the Ulster Museum's varied exhibits. Buses from stops near the hotel take you to the city centre, where the glass-domed Victoria Square shopping complex houses upmarket designer brand stores. Set yourself up for the day with a free hearty Express Start Breakfast, served the bright dining area. The modern, open-plan lounge bar is a great spot to chat with colleagues and friends over a glass of wine.

100050.description: The Holiday Inn Express Cardiff Bay offers a convenient location overlooking Bute East Dock, situated between Cardiff Bay and the city center. A short walk from both Cardiff Central and Cardiff Bay stations, and a five-minute walk to the Cardiff Baycar bus stop. Cardiff International Airport is a 30-minute drive. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and on-site parking. Start your day with the included Express Start Breakfast, featuring hot and continental options. After a busy day, relax with a drink in the hotel bar. Explore the vibrant Cardiff Bay area with its restaurants and bars, or walk to the city center to visit the Principality Stadium and Cardiff Castle.

100052.description:
Crowne Plaza Solihull is a stylish 4-star hotel set in landscaped grounds and perfectly positioned in the Heart of England. Just minutes from the M42, Birmingham Airport (BHX), the NEC, and bp pulse LIVE, it’s the ideal base for both business and leisure travellers. 

Our 120 spacious, contemporary bedrooms feature premium bedding, smart TVs, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, and dedicated work areas — designed for comfort, productivity, and a great night’s sleep. 

Solihull’s vibrant town centre is just a short stroll away, offering excellent shopping at Touchwood Centre, John Lewis and a fantastic choice of dining from cosy pubs to fine dining restaurants. Family-friendly attractions are within easy reach, including Drayton Manor Theme Park (home of Thomas Land), West Midlands Safari Park, Warwick Castle, and Cadbury World. 

Unwind at our Leisure Club with a heated indoor pool and fully equipped, air-conditioned gym. Savour lakeside dining at the Terrace Restaurant or enjoy a relaxed drink in the Terrace Bar & Lounge. 

With 12 versatile, fully equipped meeting rooms for up to 200 guests, a dedicated Crowne Plaza Meetings Director, conference café, and tailored catering options, we make business events effortless. 

Solihull train station is less than a mile away, with direct trains to Birmingham (Moor Street) and London Marylebone, and Birmingham Airport is just a 15-minute drive. The hotel offers 184 on-site parking spaces (£12. 50 per night for residents).

name.content: The Hillcrest Hotel Sure Hotel Collection by BW

100196.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace at The Hillcrest Hotel in Widnes. Benefit from complimentary Wi-Fi and wedding services. Dine at Cu Restaurant, or enjoy room service during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily (7:00 AM - 9:00 AM) for a fee. The hotel also offers complimentary wired internet access, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. With 49 guestrooms and 3 meeting rooms, this hotel caters to both leisure and business travelers. Each room features a flat-screen TV, digital programming, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combination. Coffee/tea makers and work desks are also provided. Free self-parking is available onsite. Located near the airport, The Hillcrest Hotel is a short drive from Sefton Park, Sherdley Park, and Knowsley Safari Park.

100216.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of The Imperial Crown Hotel. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy the convenience of wedding services and tour/ticket assistance. Dine at Adham Restaurant, unwind at the bar/lounge, and savor a delicious English breakfast (fee applies) served weekdays from 7:00 AM to 9:30 AM and weekends from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM. The hotel offers a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Event facilities include conference space and meeting rooms, and self-parking is available (surcharge). Relax in one of the 41 comfortable guestrooms featuring private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, desks, and coffee/tea makers. Rollaway/extra beds are available upon request (surcharge). Located near Halifax Minster, Halifax Borough Market, and Eureka! The National Children's Museum, the hotel's preferred airport is Leeds Bradford (LBA).

name.content: The Regency Hotel Sure Hotel Collection by BW

100218.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at The Regency Hotel Solihull. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, wedding services, and a banquet hall. Dine at the onsite restaurant and bar/lounge or grab a coffee at the cafe. Full breakfasts are available daily (fees apply). Amenities include a business center, express check-in/check-out, and self-parking (charges apply). The 111 guestrooms feature private bathrooms, digital programming, and coffee/tea makers. Located in Solihull, the hotel is near Blythe Valley Park and Touchwood Shopping Center, and is 8. 3 mi (13. 4 km) from the National Exhibition Centre and 8. 5 mi (13. 7 km) from the University of Birmingham.

100616.description: Securing a room in this distinctive Victorian building puts you within easy reach of London's iconic attractions, including the Science, Victoria & Albert, and Natural History museums, as well as Earl's Court. From our Kensington location you can reach Gloucester Road tube stop in just two minutes. Admire the elegant façade of the Royal Albert Hall, stroll through Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park, then return to style, comfort, and attentive service courtesy of our hospitality team. It's what we do.

100693.description: Situated on the banks of the Water of Leith in the West End of Edinburgh City Centre, the Britannia Hotel Edinburgh is conveniently located within easy reach of many of the city's major attractions and the main shopping area. The Britannia Edinburgh Hotel features 178 well-appointed guest bedrooms with room facilities including televisions and tea & coffee making equipment. In addition, the hotel also offers complimentary WIFI and chargeable car parking. There is an on-site restaurant and bar where guests can enjoy breakfast, lunch and evening meals. The hotel is only 1 mile from Edinburgh Haymarket Train Station and 12 Miles from Edinburgh Airport.

100761.description: The Manor Elstree offers 49 comfortable guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center, a terrace, and a garden. The Cavendish Restaurant provides on-site dining, with room service also available during limited hours. A bar/lounge, complimentary breakfast for a fee, and free self-parking are also offered. For events, the hotel features conference space and meeting rooms. Nearby attractions include Elstree Film Studios (2 mi) and the Royal Air Force Museum London (5. 9 mi). The closest airport is Luton Airport (LTN), 23. 6 miles away.

100996.description: The Travelodge Aberdeen Central offers 97 comfortable guest rooms in the heart of Aberdeen. Located within a 5-minute walk of Edward VII and Union Square Shopping Centre, this hotel provides easy access to many city attractions. Nearby points of interest include The Trinity Centre (0. 2 km), Union Terrace Gardens (0. 2 km), and Aberdeen Music Hall (0. 3 km). Aberdeen Airport (ABZ) is approximately 11. 1 km from the hotel.

101313.description:
The St. James's Hotel & Club prioritizes the health and safety of its guests, as evidenced by its Global Health Assured certification. This luxurious hotel offers a prestigious location in London's city center, near Piccadilly Circus and Green Park Station. Guests enjoy convenient access to exclusive shopping, dining, and entertainment. Elegantly appointed rooms provide luxurious accommodations, while exemplary facilities and services cater to every need. Business travelers will appreciate the hotel's conference facilities. For a truly exceptional culinary experience, the award-winning Michelin-starred restaurant, Seven Park Place by William Drabble, awaits. Breakfast can also be enjoyed in the Francatelli Restaurant upon request. 

Please note the hotel does not have rooms with twin beds only doubles. If twin rooms are required please contact the reservation team on reservations@stjameshotelandclub. com

102045.description: Located on vibrant Commercial Road, this apartment complex offers easy access to Limehouse Station, the City, and Canary Wharf. Nearby, explore picturesque docks, basins, and waterways, including Limehouse Marina just 400 meters away. Renowned dining options such as Gordon Ramsay's The Narrow and Nobu Restaurant are within 800 meters. London City Airport is 8 km away, and Heathrow is 54 km. Established in 2008, this complex caters to both business and leisure travelers. Its 81 stylish apartments offer comfort and striking London views. Guests enjoy a 24-hour reception, lift access, and Wi-Fi. Each modern apartment features a furnished living and dining room, satellite/digital TV, DVD player, iron, ironing board, and a fully equipped kitchen with a fridge, cooker, microwave, and tea/coffee facilities. The emphasis on light and space is evident in the large, picturesque windows, many floor-to-ceiling in the living areas. Enjoy ten times the space of a typical hotel room, complimentary broadband internet, Sky Freeview, and weekly linen changes. Bedrooms include a double bed with a walnut headboard, telephone, and alarm clock. Private bathrooms offer a power shower, bathtub, Molton Brown toiletries, a heated towel rail, hairdryer, and shaving socket. A direct-dial telephone, radio, washing machine, and central heating are also standard. All apartments include a balcony or terrace.

name.content: Melia London Kensington Member of Melia Collection

102239.description: This luxury newly refurbished townhouse hotel enjoys a stunning setting in London. It is located at the heart of Kensington and Chelsea, on one of London's renowned tree-lined avenues with the Natural History Museum, Science Museum, V&A, Royal Albert Hall and Hyde Park minutes away. Well connected with Gloucester Road tube station just a short walk, the hotel enjoys close proximity to London's financial and business centre. SW7 restaurant and bar is located in the hotel, an exclusive place to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and discover a fascinating fusion of British and Mediterranean cuisine and an eclectic selection of signature cocktails inspired by William Morris artworks The hotel lies just a short stroll away from the city's Royal Parks. This hotel combines an excellent location with exemplary facilities and genuine hospitality. The guest rooms enjoy a classical design, oozing elegance and sophistication. The hotel offers a range of exemplary facilities and services, ensuring a first-class experience that is sure to impress.

102420.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a health club, an indoor pool, and a spa tub. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Enjoy British cuisine at Twentynine Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). English breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 67 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

102553.description:
•	Newly refurbished Victorian building style Boutique hotel in the heart of London, only a few minutes walking from Marble Arch, Hyde Park and Oxford Street. 
•	Amazingly connected with Paddington station, located just metres from our hotel, with easy access to Heathrow Airport (Heathrow express available) and 4 different underground lines: Bakerloo, Circle, District line and Hammersmith & City.
•	All our newly refurbished rooms and suite have modern amenities, including air conditioner, a flat-screen smart TV, minibar and safe for our guest's best comfort. Hair dryer, iron and tea-coffee maker are available in all rooms as well.
•	All rooms have their own new modern design bathroom equipped with smart toilets, spacious showers and complimentary toiletries.  
•	Free Wi-Fi is available in the rooms and throughout the property.
•	24 hours reception/concierge.

102554.description: Located in central London, the Waterloo Hub Hotel is a budget-friendly option for solo and family travelers. Our cozy rooms feature comfortable beds, fresh linens and towels, a TV, and an en-suite bathroom with a shower, complimentary toiletries, and ample storage. Guests can also enjoy complimentary tea and coffee around the clock in our lounge area. We're within walking distance of iconic landmarks like the London Eye, Houses of Parliament, Big Ben, Buckingham Palace, and Trafalgar Square, and just a short stroll from Waterloo International Train Station, as well as Lambeth North and Elephant & Castle tube stations.

102836.description:
This country house hotel is conveniently located close to Caterham, Redhill and Crawley & Reigate. It is also within easy reach of the centre of London, as well as attractions like Hever Castle, Chartwell National Trust, Chessington World of Adventures, Thorpe Park, Legoland, the RHS Gardens at Wisley and Lingfield and Epsom Race course. Gatwick Airport and Heathrow Airport are roughly 14 km and 54 km from the hotel, respectively.

The hotel, which dates back to 1872, is an idyllic country mansion set high on Nutfield ridge. It enjoys breathtaking views of the Sussex and Surrey countryside. Enjoy afternoon tea in one of the elegant Victorian lounges; curl up in front of a roaring log fire in the grand Library; or, on a fine day, simply enjoy the fresh air and panoramic views across the countryside from the terrace. The hotel has 60 guestrooms and a lobby providing a 24-hour reception and check-out service, cloakroom and lift access. Guests can wine and dine in the hotel restaurant, café and bar, and the hotel also offers room service. There are conference facilities and a car park on site.

Each of the guestrooms, including family rooms and sleek executive rooms, has been lovingly furnished. There are soft, warm fabrics, high-quality furniture and, in the gleaming bathrooms, unique luxury toiletries. Alongside these timeless comforts is the latest 21st-century gadgetry, including widescreen TVs with satellite channels, DVD and CD players, direct dial telephone, radio and high speed Internet access. All rooms come fitted with an en suite bathroom with shower, bathtub and hairdryer, as well as tea and coffee making facilities, a fridge and an ironing set.

Adjacent to the hotel, the Spa is an oasis of relaxation with its sauna, steam room and range of health treatments. For those looking to get more active, there is the Leisure Club complete with indoor pool, snack bar, gym, squash courts and body studio for yoga and Pilates (fees may apply).

102837.description: Set in a Victorian mansion in 55 acres of grounds, Norton House features a luxury spa, award-winning restaurant and boutique rooms with free internet. Edinburgh is a 20-minute drive, and Edinburgh Airport is 3 miles away. Bedrooms at Norton House Hotel & Spa each have a modern bathroom with free toiletries and fluffy bathrobes. All rooms have a satellite TV/DVD player and a minibar. Guests can relax in the sauna, steam room or hydrotherapy pool in the luxurious spa. The health club also has a swimming pool with feature fountains, a fully equipped gym and treatment rooms. Ushers Restaurant offers fine dining and specialist wines in elegant surroundings. The Brasserie offers traditional British cuisine, and The Glass Lounge serves classic cocktails and afternoon teas. Set in leafy grounds, Norton House Hotel is just off the junction of M8 and M9 motorways. Free on-site parking is available.

103060.description: The family-run Gstaaderhof - Active & Relax Hotel is located in the heart of Gstaad, not far from the famous promenade. All rooms are designed in a modern chalet style and have been renovated in recent years. Enjoy the peace and quiet and a view of the mountains of the Bernese Oberland as well as the surrounding chalets. The hotel has two restaurants and a hotel bar. Relaxation is provided by a small and fine wellness area and massage service. You are able to park your car in the hotel's underground parking for a small extra charge and can easily reach hiking trails, excursion destinations and ski slopes on foot or by public transport during your stay.

103179.description:
This is a chalet-style hotel in a central yet peaceful location in the heart of Adelboden. The hotel has beautiful panoramic views of the mountains and the famous Wildstrudel and is only 150 m from the Sillerenbühl cable car station. It is easy to reach via Spiez and Frutigen. 
This 56-room ski hotel features meeting rooms for organising various business discussions and seminars. Facilities available to guests at this establishment include a hotel safe, lift access to the upper floors and a bar and restaurant. Guests arriving by car may leave their vehicles in the hotel car park with extra cost. 
The hotel features finely furnished accommodation units that are gracefully decorated with all essential amenities to ensure a comfortable stay. In addition to a private bathroom with a hairdryer, in-room amenities include TV, radio and a safety deposit box. 
After an exhausting day, guests can work out at the gym to maintain their fitness regime, indulge in various games in the games room or rejuvenate body and mind at the wellness area that features a hot tub, sauna, solarium and massage services. Guests may also hire bikes for exploring the local area. 
Guests must pay city tax upon arrival at the hotel: children aged 0-5 are free, children aged 6-15 pay CHF 2. 10, and adults aged 16 and over pay CHF 5. 20.

103181.description:
Welcome to the Hotel Grichting-Badnerhof in Leukerbad! This family owned and managed hotel is the place to relax in a natural environment where enjoyment and well-being are combined to form a comfortable and pleasant oasis. Our aim has always been to offer our guests an elegant and rustic atmosphere, yet with attentive service. Upon your arrival, our team will be there for you to make your experience with us wonderful and unforgettable. 
Guests can now book a parking space at the time of booking for CHF 15 per day per vehicle. A member of staff will take care of dropping off and collecting the vehicle from the hotel. 
Services at our hotel: 
Entry to the thermal baths (subject to a charge and booking)
E-bike hire (free of charge and subject to booking)
Children’s play area (free of charge and open to all)
Car park (subject to a charge and booking) with valet parking. 
Treatments and massages (subject to a charge and booking). 
Notes: We like to inform you that the Grichting Hotel & Serviced Apartments will close his restaurant the 15. 09. 2026 without any dates of reopening. We keep the bar and the breakfast as services.

103184.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Saas Fee and was established in 1992. It is a short drive away from the Allalin mountain and the nearest station is n/a. The Hotel has 2 restaurants, a bar, a conference room, an indoor swimming pool and a fitness centre/gym. All 45 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe and ironing set.

103185.description:
Enjoy the hospitality in the Hotel Kemmeriboden-Bad in Schangnau in the uniquely beautiful Emmental landscape! Come visit us for a relaxing time.

Here you find tradition and modern comfort united under a single roof. Whether you want single or double rooms, 4- 6- and 8-bed rooms or a three-room apartment (ideal for families) - you will always find what you need for an untroubled and relaxing stay.
Fully covered WLAN access in the hotel and the garden.
4-star upgraded standards at a 3-star price!

On Monday our restaurant is closed all day and on Sunday from 6.00pm
Overnight stays without dinner are possible.

Please inform the reception if you will arrive after 5pm on Sundays or Mondays.

Bookings for the same day are possible until 10 pm.

103437.description: The chic and stylish apartments at W6 Hotel come with free Wi-Fi and modern kitchen facilities. Hammersmith Tube Station is a 5-minute walk away, for links to London attractions. Each W6 Hotel apartment is different. However, all feature an LCD TV, some have a DVD. A laundry service, shopping service and concierge can also be used. Via the Piccadilly Line, Hammersmith Station offers direct access to Heathrow Airport, museums at Knightsbridge, and entertainment at Leicester Square and Covent Garden. Private parking is opposite the property, and is available at an additional cost per day.

103495.description: Nestled in the historical district of Inverurie, Meldrum House Country Hotel & Golf Course offers a delightful escape. Enjoy on-site recreation including a golf course, terrace, and garden, or explore nearby attractions such as the Glen Garioch Distillery (a 1-minute drive) and Pitmedden Garden (7 minutes away). The hotel features 57 individually decorated guestrooms, each equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with designer toiletries, and convenient amenities such as in-room safes and desks. Indulge in a meal at the restaurant, unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Additional amenities include a fireplace in the lobby, concierge services, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Full breakfasts are available for a fee. Free self-parking is provided on-site.

103674.description: Located in Inverness City Centre, The Glen Mhor Apartments is a short walk from Inverness Castle and the Victorian Market. This eco-certified hotel offers 10 guestrooms with kitchens equipped with full-sized refrigerators/freezers and ovens. Enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant, relax with a drink at the bar/lounge, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and a 24-hour front desk. A full breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Limited parking is available on-site. Nearby attractions include Inverness Cathedral and Eden Court Theatre. The preferred airport is Inverness (INV).

103835.description: This centrally located London guesthouse is within walking distance of the city's famed landmarks and a short stroll from Victoria's rail, tube, and coach stations, including the Gatwick Express. Guests will find a lively pub and bar scene just 150 meters away. Built in 1850, this family-friendly guesthouse offers en-suite rooms with modern amenities ideal for both leisure and business travelers. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and a healthy continental breakfast each morning.

name.content: Andaz London Liverpool Street, By Hyatt

103836.description: Hyatt’s five star luxury boutique hotel, Andaz London Liverpool Street is a 21st century masterpiece, a stunning blend of traditional and contemporary features throughout.

103993.description: Touch down in to London at Sofitel London Heathrow, the only hotel with direct access to Heathrow Terminal 5 via a 5 minutes covered walk way. Conveniently situated, discover London many attractions only 21 minutes away by train. Our award-winning hotel features 605 luxurious bedrooms and suites with modern amenities and the largest ballroom in Heathrow, catering up to 1300 people. Indulge into diverse dining options including our 2 AA Rosette Restaurants where guests can experience rich global flavours.

104013.address: Heath Lane, Childer Thornton, South Wirral
104013.description: This hotel welcomes its guests to a typical country house atmosphere where they will be made to feel at home right from the start. The best way to demonstrate the authentic hospitality is through the traditional English breakfast, which is made from locally sourced produce and best enjoyed at the elegant surroundings of the hotel's restaurant, overlooking the manicured garden. Business travellers can than get on with their work at the modern onsite conference facilities. At the end of the day the comfortable, individually-styled rooms afford surroundings to relax and have a good-night sleep. The location of the venue is perfect for visiting Liverpool, Chester and the surrounding area and also the coastline of North Wales and Snowdonia.

104273.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Grab a bite to eat at The Riverside Terrace, a restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge, take in the garden view, and even dine alfresco. You can also stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Full breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 15 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Mildenhall and District Museum - 0. 4 km / 0.

104275.description: Located in Hyde Park, Days Inn Hyde Park is a perfect starting point from which to explore London. Both business travelers and tourists can enjoy the hotel's facilities and services. All the necessary facilities, including free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, express check-in/check-out, luggage storage, Wi-Fi in public areas, are at hand. Guestrooms are designed to provide an optimal level of comfort with welcoming decor and some offering convenient amenities like whirlpool bathtub, air conditioning, heating, desk, iPod docking station. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. Days Inn Hyde Park combines warm hospitality with a lovely ambiance to make your stay in London unforgettable.

104320.description: This Tudor-style hotel is conveniently situated in the west of London, at less than 10 km from Heathrow International Airport. It features a restaurant, a bar and free parking. Osterley underground station is within a 10-minute walk, providing easy access to Central London. Osterley Park can be reached within a short stroll; Twickenham Rugby Stadium is less than 5 km away.

104321.description: Tower House guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 8 units. Guests may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception. Tower House may charge a fee for some services.

104337.description: This family-friendly hotel is located near many pubs, bars and restaurants where guests can sample English specialties and international food. The area, known as the Borough of Newnham, is well served by public transportation. The centre of London and its attractions are only 12 km away. This is an ideal location from where to discover the English Capital and all it has to offer.

name.content: Stoke on Trent Alsager Manor House

104603.description: On the outskirts of Alsager, the Best Western Plus Stoke on Trent Alsager Manor House Hotel stays impressively true to its quaint farmhouse heritage. But as an imaginative conversion, it now features 58 en suite bedrooms, a spacious oak beamed Stables Bar and Grill, indoor swimming pool, sauna and meeting/function rooms. As a base for touring the potteries and Cheshire, few hotels come close... and our reputation as a superb 'stop-over' is just as impressive. Business and leisure travelers will love our location, but everyone who stays here will benefit from charming public areas, fresh approach to customer service and welcoming atmosphere throughout. If you plan on dining with us during your stay we recommend booking a table prior to arrival as our restaurant is usually very busy. We recommend booking a table prior to arrival as is usually very busy.

105633.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of this Victorian hotel, and take advantage of complimentary Wi-Fi. A fireplace in the lobby, tour/ticket assistance, and a picnic area add to the charm. Dine at the on-site restaurant or enjoy a snack in the coffee shop/cafe. Mingle with fellow guests at the daily complimentary reception, or relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast is served weekdays from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Business amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and a 24-hour front desk. Free self-parking is available. The 28 guest rooms feature LCD televisions and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms offer shower/tub combinations and hair dryers. Desks, coffee/tea makers, and daily housekeeping are also provided. Located near the Giant's Causeway Visitors Centre, Hezlett House, and Runkerry Beach, the hotel offers easy access to area attractions. The preferred airport is Belfast International Airport (BFS).

105673.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 184 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and LED televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding.

name.content: Premier Inn LON Heathrow Airport T2 & T3 (Bath Rd)

105693.description: Jetting off or flying in? Wherever you're heading, you'll find Premier Inn Hotel Heathrow Bath Road a handy launch pad. And with great transport links and the Heathrow Express Rail just minutes away, you'll be well placed for business and leisure destinations throughout London too. If you've time to stop and explore, plan a big adventure at Legoland. Cheer on your team at Twickenham Stadium. Or head for high-adrenalin thrills and spills at Thorpe Park. Then come back to earth at our tasty restaurant, and unwind in your spacious room and extra-comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

105696.description: This charming hotel has the best option to stay when visiting Glasgow, UK. It is conveniently right next to the Glasgow Central Station and about 15-minute car ride away from the Glasgow Airport. The complex has an amazing location being in the very centre of this wonderful city, thanks to that, it offers easy access to many restaurants that offer delicious local and international cuisine, lovely cafes, bars, shops and malls of all type. For the ones who like history and culture, there are museums, art galleries and beautiful streets to take a walk and enjoy the surroundings. Before going out to explore the city, visitors can have a delicious early breakfast in the property. Guests won’t have enough time to explore everything Glasgow has to offer. Decorated with warm colours, the rooms are equipped with all the essential facilities and cosy beds to make travellers feel comfortable and have a pleasant stay.

105801.description: This charming boutique hotel is nestled in the heart of historic Bruges, on a quiet street just steps from the picturesque Rosary Quay. Housed in an 18th-century former carriage house, The Pand is a small, family-owned hotel adorned with art, exquisite fabrics, and precious antiques. The welcoming atmosphere creates a warm, homey feel with a distinct focus on service. Common areas include salons with an open fireplace, a cozy bar, and an inviting outdoor courtyard. Enjoy a delicious waiter-served champagne breakfast in the romantic breakfast room (between 7:00 AM and 10:30 AM), featuring eggs cooked to order on the AGA stove and a small buffet. Guests traveling by car can reserve private parking spaces in advance (for a fee). Each of the 26 rooms and junior suites is individually decorated. Cosy Charming (15 sq m) and Charming Plus (17 sq m) rooms offer compact bathrooms. The Duplex Junior Suite (27 sq m) features a ground-floor bathroom with a bubble bath and a first-floor bedroom with a sitting area (separated by 17 steps). Stylish Junior Suites (approximately 25 sq m) boast sitting areas and bathrooms with bubble baths (some also with showers). The Master Suite (36 sq m) offers opulent fabrics, a comfortable sitting area, and a beautiful bathroom with a bubble bath and walk-in shower. Experience the magic of Bruges at this unique hotel.

106034.description: Overlooking the Royal Mews at Buckingham Palace, this hotel is situated adjacent to the Queens Gallery. Buckingham Palace, the Royal Parks, Pall Mall and theatres are located close by. This property is hailed as London's smallest, most intimate boutique hotel, yet is uncompromising on comfort, luxury and relaxation. The guest rooms are stunningly designed, immersing visitors in elegance and style. Guests can enjoy a traditional afternoon tea, or dine in style in the award-winning restaurant. The club lounge offers the ideal place in which to completely relax and unwind. This property combines 21st-century technology with attentive service.

106035.description: Located in literary Bloomsbury, just steps from the British Museum, we are famous for al fresco dining and wonderfully fun pop-ups. Our chic Leopard Bar offers live jazz, whilst the conservatory is the perfect place to enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea overlooking peaceful gardens. Each and every one of our guest rooms and suites is elegantly and individually designed, from garden facing rooms and suites, to family studios and multi-bedroom apartments which feature a private entrance and patio. All of our guest rooms are designed with our guests' comfort in mind and include luxury Floris amenities, marble bathrooms and Savoir beds. We are proud to be a part of the family-owned and run Red Carnation Hotel Collection and of our hotel's exceptional heritage. We strive to create the most enriching and rewarding experiences for our guests – which is why they choose to stay with us again and again. The Montague on the Gardens combines the best of two worlds. In front is the British Museum, whilst to the rear there's a serene private garden, cut off from the city by a rectangle of fine Georgian townhouses. Between the two lies The Montague on the Gardens – an intriguing blend of up-to-the-minute city vibrancy and old-world Bloomsbury charm, where guests can expect British hospitality at its finest.

106036.description: Our beautifully restored historic hotel is cared for by a team who take genuine pride in delivering impeccable service and exceeding expectations at every turn. Overlooking The Royal Mews of Buckingham Palace - the entrance used by the Royal family - The Rubens showcases exceptional dining journeys, and enriching and rewarding experiences, from the very first moment guests are greeted by our red-uniformed doormen.

106037.description: Step into our polished marble lobby and you will immediately notice the warm and personalised service that defines The Chesterfield. Our staff members are empowered to make a real difference to each and every guest's stay, whether that's remembering a favourite welcome drink or organising a romantic surprise for a special birthday. We go above and beyond to ensure every stay is exceptional. Red Carnation's first hotel, located in the heart of Mayfair, is quintessentially British and exudes classic charm and unique personality. Renowned for the best Dover sole in London, themed Afternoon Teas, molecular cocktails and gin tasting experiences, we are ideally located, moments from Bond Street, Piccadilly and the Royal Parks. We are honoured that our guests choose to stay with us again and again. Every one of our team offers remarkably considerate service and discrete attention to detail. From freshly-cut flowers in the suites to personalised gifts for special occasions, it is no surprise that guests often remember the names of our staff and ask after them when they return. Exhale and relax after a busy day of exploring London in the warm, intimate surrounds of Butlers Restaurant. Renowned for serving London's best Dover sole, filleted right at your table, our Executive Chef Nathan Hindmarsh offers an enticing range of delicious dishes that make the most of organic, seasonal British ingredients – from salmon smoked by H. Forman & Son, London's oldest smokery, and classics such as roasted Orkney scallops and venison Wellington, to our famous signature dishes. With the smart shops of Bond Street nearby and some of London's most vibrant sights – The Royal Academy, Buckingham Palace, the Royal Parks – just a short stroll away, this truly is the beating heart of Mayfair. Yet our elegant Charles Street address offers a tranquil haven from the bustle outside, a place to retreat, relax and regroup.

106040.description: Complete with modern conference facilities and a comfortable and cosy lounge, you're guaranteed a stylish welcome at our pet-friendly hotel. Plus we're proud to offer a gorgeous outdoor terrace, where guests can sip a glass of something cool and fizzy while watching planes take off and land at Luton's runway. What better way to kick off or wrap up your trip?

106153.description: Indulge in a pampering experience at the full-service spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. The Vincent Hotel also provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and assistance with wedding arrangements. Savor a meal at The V Cafe & Restaurant, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are available on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM (for a fee). The hotel offers complimentary wired internet access, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Event facilities include conference space and meeting rooms. For a surcharge, guests can utilize the 24-hour airport shuttle and a train station pick-up service. Each of the 59 guestrooms features a minibar, an LCD television, and a pillowtop bed with a down comforter. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is provided, along with digital programming. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Located near Southport Air Show, Silcock's Funland, and Southport Pier, The Vincent Hotel is conveniently situated for exploring local attractions. John Lennon Airport (LPL) is the preferred airport.

106203.description: Our hotel is located in central Hounslow, five miles from Heathrow and ten miles from central London, with easy access to the motorway network. We are also just a two-minute walk from Hounslow Central Tube Station. All guest rooms and the lobby area offer free high-speed internet access. Our in-house restaurant is open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner seven days a week, and the hotel bar is open late. Limited parking is available for a nominal fee.

106395.description: Our guests enjoy a warm, friendly atmosphere thanks to our lively café/restaurant and 24-hour snack service. Complimentary fiber Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, and each of our 356 bedrooms features fresh, modern decor and plush Sweet Beds, earning us consistent five-star reviews. Enjoy a convenient location less than a mile from the runway at unbeatable room rates!

106396.description: This hotel enjoys a great location, with Paddington, Queensway, Baywater and Lancaster Gate stations all nearby, providing easy access to all areas of London. The hotel is within convenient reach of London's West End and easy access to tourist attractions, fine restaurants, exclusive designer boutiques and department stores. It is also a short walk away from Marble Arch and Oxford Circus, and Piccadilly Circus is a 10-minute underground ride away.

106397.description: Indulge in the hotel's sauna and 24-hour fitness center. Stay connected with complimentary wired internet access and benefit from concierge and wedding services. Enjoy delicious meals at the Manhattan Grill steakhouse with a bar/lounge, or order room service during limited hours. Buffet breakfasts are available for a fee on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:30 AM. The hotel also offers a 24-hour business center and express check-out. For events, there's 14, 445 square feet of space, including a conference center and 19 meeting rooms. Relax in one of the 301 guest rooms featuring minibars, 48-inch Smart TVs with satellite programming, and pillowtop beds with premium bedding. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, deep soaking bathtubs, and complimentary toiletries. Located near the Thames River, the hotel is also a short distance from attractions like the Cutty Sark, ExCeL Exhibition Centre, and O2 Arena.

106398.description: Indulge in a rejuvenating experience at our spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Enjoy recreational amenities such as a health club and indoor pool. The hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a hair salon. Dine at our restaurant, featuring a bar/lounge and golf course views, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Our 62 guestrooms offer refrigerators, plasma televisions, and private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers. Located near Southport and Ainsdale Golf Club, Formby Hall Golf Resort & Spa is a short drive from John Lennon Airport (LPL).

106399.description: The hotel is located in a quiet square in the heart of Bayswater, close to Queensway, Hyde Park and Notting Hill, and providing easy access to all areas of London. Hyde Park can be reached in about a 5-minute walk, Oxford Circus is around 20 minutes' walk away, and Piccadilly Circus is some 25 minutes' walk from the hotel. The hotel's convenient location provides quick and easy access to and from London Heathrow, Gatwick and Stansted airports. The hotel has an accentuated style with regal overtones. It offers the best value for money with brand-new contemporary styling, graced with the comfort of mood lighting and Internet access. Other facilities at this air-conditioned city hotel include a lobby, 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe and a cloakroom. There is also a bar and breakfast room, and room service and a laundry service are offered. All rooms have been renovated recently, providing the greatest standards in comfort and relaxation. They have en suite bathroom facilities with a shower, bath and hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV with pay movies, free Internet access and a radio. Furthermore, the rooms include a fridge, a microwave, tea and coffee making facilities, ironing facilities, a double bed, carpeting and a hire safe. All the rooms are air-conditioned and come fitted with central heating as standard. A breakfast buffet is served daily.

106573.description: Set in the vibrant heart of the city, Hilton Leeds City is steps from Leeds Central railway station, minutes from the M62, and less than 25 minutes from Leeds Bradford International Airport - LBA. Walk to restaurants, bars, and shops including the premium shopping center, Victoria Quarter, and Trinity Leeds, a brand new one million sq. ft. shopping center. Other amenities close by include Leeds Grand Theatre and First Direct Leeds Arena. This really is the perfect base for both business and leisure guests. Relax in front of the 42-inch HDTV in a stylish guest room and stay connected with WiFi at the table. Enjoy city views from a deluxe room or unwind on the sofa of a suite. For those traveling without laptops, there is a complimentary Connectivity Centre offering PCs, WiFi, and printing facilities. Dine from our Taste Republic menu, inspired by the best local comforts and tastes from around the world in City 3 Restaurant, sip a coffee over the morning papers at Piacetto Coffee Lounge, and enjoy cocktails at City 3 Bar. Free WiFi is offered throughout the hotel.

106695.description: Sleep like a princess (or prince) at the Premier Inn Hotel Gatwick Airport South, situated in the grounds of the thirteenth-century Gatwick Manor. Relax before lift off or recover from a long-haul flight with a stroll around the tranquil medieval grounds, keeping your eyes peeled for wildlife. And, if you're here for work, we're close to key destinations like Manor Royal business centre, too. Catch a film or bowl a strike at Crawley Leisure Park. Take a dip or hit the gym at K2 Leisure Centre. Fly back in time at Gatwick Airport Aviation Museum. Then land safely with a tasty meal in our restaurant and a great night in your huge comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

106713.description: This apartment hotel is situated on Inverness Terrace, on the north side of Hyde Park in London. The establishment is located just a 5 minutes' walking distance from the Queensway and Bayswater underground stations, enjoying ease of access to Oxford Street and Covent Garden. Guests will find a number of bars, pubs, restaurants and shops in the vicinity, while Notting Hill can be found just a 15 minutes' walking distance away. London Heathrow and Gatwick airports are within driving distance of this hotel. The hotel comprises stylishly-decorated apartments, which offer contemporary accommodation in a prestigious location. The apartments are well equipped with up-to-date conveniences. Guests are sure to enjoy a memorable stay at this wonderful establishment.

106896.description: Located in Aylesbury, Hartwell House & Spa is in a rural location, within a 15-minute drive of Buckinghamshire County Museum and Thame Museum. This 4-star hotel is 7. 9 mi (12. 8 km) from Waddesdon Manor and 7. 3 mi (11. 8 km) from Chiltern Hills. Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as outdoor tennis courts, a health club, and an indoor pool. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. This hotel has 2 meeting rooms available for events. Free self parking is available onsite. Stop by the hotel's restaurant for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/café, and 24-hour room service is provided. Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 4 bars/lounges. Make yourself at home in one of the 48 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

106969.description: Located in the heart of Watford, this hotel is just a 5-minute walk from Watford Junction Railway Station, the town centre and its busy shopping streets. From there it takes just a 20-minute train ride to get to Euston Station in central London, which means that both business and leisure travellers can use the property as their hub. Business travellers can also find 8 dedicated meeting rooms, all with natural daylight and featuring the most up-to-date technologies. For a less formal environment, the venue offers a cosy coffee shop and more casual restaurant. The hotel restaurant serves excellent international dishes with great beers and wines to complement the mouth-watering food. There is also a bar where one can relax at the end of the day with a chilled pint and some good company.

107321.description: This hotel is centrally located in the heart of Esbjerg, close to the beautiful west coast of Denmark. Visitors to Esbjerg will find it a fascinating fishing centre and seaport; but it is much more than that. Esbjerg is equally a fulfilling cultural experience with a combination of town, harbour and a hinterland of great natural beauty. Scandic Olympic is situated on Denmark's longest pedestrianised street with good opportunities for shopping. Guests will find nightspots, links to the public transport network, the tourist centre and the park just 1 km away and the beach is 8 km. This city hotel has been recently expanded and renovated and comprises a total of 147 rooms, 60 of which are ultra-modern, air-conditioned and decorated in Nordic design. Facilities on offer to guests include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a shop, a hotel safe, a currency exchange facility, a cloakroom and lift access. Furthermore, the establishment offers a café, bar and a new restaurant, and guests will appreciate the conference facilities and WLAN Internet access available. There is a car park and covered garage parking for those arriving by car. Guests will also find a bicycle hire station on the premises. All rooms come with a private bathroom with a WC, a bathtub and a hairdryer. They are equipped with a radio, minibar and a TV with pay-TV channels, as well as a trouser press, telephone and wireless Internet access. Golf enthusiasts will find 2 golf courses available within a radius of 9 km of the hotel. Guests will enjoy the varied menu of both Danish and foreign dishes served at the restaurant. They can select their breakfast from a buffet and dinner is available à la carte.

107554.description: Gear up to experience the buzzing vibe of Northern Ireland’s vibrant capital at Moxy Belfast City. Located in the heart of Belfast City, our hotel brings a fresh spin to Belfast’s historic charm with a playful vibe, bold design, and a lively social scene. Explore the iconic sites such as Titanic Belfast and the artsy Cathedral Quarter, just steps from our doorstep. Our lively lobby, complete with entertaining board games and a chic bar, invites you to kick back and relax, while spacious rooms ensure a good night's rest with our comfortable floating bedding. Enjoy seamless streaming of your favourite shows on the smart TV with high-speed Wi-Fi for your convenience. Switch effortlessly from work to relaxation, in our coworking and leisure space.
