With a complimentary welcome cocktail at check-in, a 24/7 grab and go station, and bold décor, we’re redefining what it means to stay and play.

107555.description: Located in the heart of Belfast, next to the Grand Opera House, this hotel sits discreetly on Great Victoria Street. Shopping, entertainment, and dining are all within easy walking distance. The Europa Bus and Rail Station is a mere 320 meters away, and the historic Crown Bar is just across the road. Local transport is readily accessible, connecting you to attractions like the W5 Interactive Discovery Centre, Titanic Museum, and Odyssey Arena within 10 minutes. The hotel boasts a thoughtful, contemporary design within a classic setting, featuring spacious rooms and one of Belfast's finest restaurants. A lively bar and comprehensive business and conference facilities complete the guest experience.

107593.description: Located in Dublin city centre, beside Merrion Square, The Davenport is a newly redesigned 4-star hotel just steps from the National Gallery and Trinity College. This hotel offers 115 stylish rooms with en suite marble bathrooms, a 24-hour gym, a chic restaurant, and a welcoming bar. Each room features a seating area with a work desk, uniquely designed furniture, air-conditioning, Smart TVs with Chromecast, free WiFi, and international electrical outlets. The restaurant serves a selection of Irish and international dishes, specializing in afternoon tea and homemade desserts. Guests can also enjoy a gastropub menu and an extensive whiskey selection at the hotel bar. The Davenport is a short walk from Grafton Street's luxury shops and approximately 10km from Dublin Airport.

107594.description: The Green Hotel, a newly redesigned 4-star establishment, sits directly across from St. Stephen's Green in Dublin's city center, just a short stroll from Grafton Street's luxury shops. Its 99 en-suite bedrooms are fully air-conditioned and boast uniquely designed furniture, smart TVs with Chromecast, work desks, and free WiFi. Guests can enjoy buffet breakfasts and internationally inspired cuisine made with locally sourced ingredients in the stylish, retro-bistro restaurant. Further amenities include a 24-hour gym with state-of-the-art equipment, 24-hour room service, and a ground floor work hub with free WiFi and charging points. The Saint Stephen's Green Luas stop is conveniently located right outside the hotel, providing easy access to Trinity College, St. Patrick's Cathedral, and Iveagh Gardens.

107677.description: Discover the very best that the capital has to offer at our Novotel London Paddington hotel. With contemporary stylings, a fitness centre and a heated swimming pool, this is the perfect base for guests travelling alone or as a family. With four major tube lines and National Rail services situated nearby, guests can move around the city with ease or stay local with a family day out at London Zoo. We are delighted to announce that Novotel London Paddington will undergo a full renovation of its rooms from November 2025 and due to end January 2027 During this time, structural works will take place from Monday - Friday, 09:00 am to 17:00 pm.

107779.description: Situated in Cambrils, this budget-friendly property offers an ideal place of rest and relaxation. This hotel offers easy access to the city which is only 3 km away. Guests who enjoy the sun and sand will be delighted to know that the beautiful beach is also only 50 metres away from the hotel. Guests will also be able find numerous bus and metro stops within walking distance. The spacious rooms are well-appointed with modern amenities to give it a homely feel. For fans of the fairway, they can find the nearest golf course just 20 km away from this superb establishment. Guests are sure to have a comfortable stay here.

107825.description: Built in 2002, the Ramada Hotel London North M1 stands as one of the largest Ramada Hotels in Europe. Enjoy free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel and in-room TVs with on-demand movies. This modern hotel boasts 200 en-suite bedrooms, each larger than average for London accommodations. The hotel offers easy access to Central London, Wembley, Heathrow Airport, and Luton Airport. All double rooms feature a queen-size bed. Guests can enjoy the convenience of an on-site bar and restaurant, along with buffet and continental breakfast options (fees apply). A complimentary newspaper and a cash machine are also available. Please note, pets are not allowed, and access to the hotel is via the M1 motorway.

107908.description: Miiro Templeton Garden offers a central stay in well-heeled Kensington, close to museums, landmarks, luxury shopping and some of the city's most beautiful green spaces. Tucked away on a magnificent Victorian row near Earls Court, a charming hidden gem that combines traditional townhouse elegance with all the stylish, modern flair of a hotel. Guests may start their days with generous breakfast overlooking the tranquil award-winning landscaped private garden, a rare luxury and tranquil oasis in the heart of London. Its restaurant offers a variety of contemporary dishes. The stylishly designed rooms radiate warm elegance and comfort expected from a Central London accommodation. Between dawn and dusk, the visitors can enjoy a high-end gym in the fitness centre or just indulge themselves with the electronic devices using the high speed Wi-Fi and LAN internet.

107909.description:
This hotel enjoys a central location in Richmond. It is situated close to the rail, underground, bus and road (M3, M4, and M25) links and has a number of restaurants, bars, pubs, nightlife spots, tourist attractions and shops within 500 metres. Nearby airports include London Heathrow (17 km), London City (40 km), Luton (60 km), London Gatwick (75 km) and London Stansted (77 km). 

This guesthouse is set in a recently refurbished Victorian townhouse dating back to 1874. The establishment comprises a total of 23 guest rooms and offers a warm but modern decor, with affordable accommodation in a non-smoking environment. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, and on-site facilities include a restaurant and a laundry service (fees apply). Guests arriving by car can leave their vehicles in the nearby car park. 

Each bedroom has been designed with modern, warm, welcoming colours and fabrics. Single standard rooms have large 1, 20 m single beds. No rooms are suitable for extra beds but double standard rooms can accommodate baby cots. Singles without a bathroom have a washbasin within the room and a shared shower room and toilet. All rooms have complimentary tea and coffee making facilities, and other facilities available include a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, a radio and central heating. Hairdryers and irons are available on loan from reception. 

A continental buffet breakfast is served each morning. 

From Heathrow Airport: Take the M4 towards London, exit at Junction 1. Follow the signs for Richmond. When entering the town centre, Church Road is the first turning on the left after the Richmond Circus roundabout.

107995.description:
This charming design hotel is located on Lower Leeson, just beside St Stephens Green and within walking distance of Grafton Street (Dublin's premier shopping street), Trinity College, a tram line, the business district, IFSC (Irish Financial Services Centre) and Pearse Street train station. Heuston and Connolly stations are 20-minute drive away. Guests will find shops, restaurants, bars and clubs on the doorstep, and the city business hotel is approximately 12 km from Dublin Airport.

This deluxe property consists of 27 luxury suites and 3 large penthouses with the space and privacy only an apartment can bring. The family-friendly aparthotel offers a central location with spacious, luxurious, stylish, comfortable and elegant suites. Facilities on offer to guests include a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, currency exchange facilities, lift access, Internet access and a car park.

Every guest's needs are catered for, each suite has a spacious living room with a wall-mounted 32-inch plasma TV, a mini hi-fi stereo and a large work desk with complimentary wired and wireless broadband Internet access. The kitchen offers integrated appliances, such as a dishwasher, washer/dryer, fridge, microwave and hobs, and is finished to a very high standard with cream granite worktops and marble tiling. Each bathroom contains a bath, power shower, shaver socket and a heated towel rail, and is complimented by rich cream marble tiles which give the bathroom a luxurious finish. Other in-room amenities include a hairdryer, king-size bed, direct dial telephone, safe, ironing set and central heating.

108368.description: Above a traditional London pub, this family-run budget hotel offers reasonably-priced accommodations and free Wi-Fi. Elephant & Castle and Kennington tube stations can be reached with a 15 minute walk. Each comfortable room at Hour Glass has a TV, free tea/coffee-making facilities, sink and a fridge. There are ample shared bathroom and kitchen facilities, including a washer and dryer. This Victorian pub and hotel still retains some original wood framing. The pub can also serve meals throughout the day. Burgess Park with its playground and barbecue facilities is a 2 minute walk away. Hour Glass is across from a bus stop, allowing easy access to the center of the city. There are a number of restaurants and clubs including the Ministry of Sound in Elephant and Castle, which are just a 5 minute drive away.

108369.description: Sitting proudly on Green Lanes, this hotel basks in the splendour of this vibrant area of North London. Finsbury Park is just a few minutes' walking distance away. Manor House tube station and Harringay Rail Station are a 5 minutes' walk away. The lively centre of London, with its array of intriguing, world-renowned attractions, is within easy reach. This hotel is housed in an attractive Victorian building. Classically-styled guest rooms offer serenity and comfort. The hotel features a traditional pub, where guests can relax and unwind with a drink. A delightful breakfast is available in the mornings, for a superb start to the day.

108731.description: This hotel enjoys a great setting in Newcastle-Upon-Tyne. The hotel is situated close to a wealth of attractions in the area. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to a host of shopping, dining and entertainment venues. This popular hotel greets guests with the promise of a comfortable, enjoyable stay. The guest rooms are tastefully designed, offering a peaceful setting in which to completely relax and unwind. Guests are invited to avail of the many facilities and services that this wonderful hotel has to offer. Guests are assured of a comfortable, convenient stay at this charming hotel.

109171.description: The hotel is a small-budget hotel providing guests with a base for exploring London. The hotel is located near the Golden Green and Brent Cross underground (tube) stations, providing guests with easy access to central London and all its famous tourist attractions. Local attractions include the nearby suburbs of Hampstead Heath and Regent's Park as well as Wembley Stadium. The classic rooms are clean, bright and very cosy. Each room feature tea and coffee making facilities and a private bathroom with a hairdryer. The reception is manned 24 hours and the staff is friendly and always ready to help with any enquiries. For the guests arriving by car, there is a car park available.

109372.description: Located in East Grinstead and with Hever Castle reachable within 16 km, Elite Venue Selection Felbridge - Gatwick provides concierge services, allergy-free rooms, a garden, free WiFi throughout the property and a bar. Providing a restaurant, the property also has a fitness centre, as well as an indoor pool and a sauna. The accommodation features room service, a 24-hour front desk and currency exchange for guests. At the hotel, each room has a wardrobe and a flat-screen TV. The private bathroom is equipped with a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer. Guest rooms at Elite Venue Selection Felbridge - Gatwick include air conditioning and a desk.

109456.description: This beach hotel is situated in the tourist village of La Pineda, a few metres from the beach. Guests will find a number of restaurants and bars in the hotel's vicinity, as well as shops and a range of entertainment facilities. Nearby attractions include the Aquatic Park Aquopolis, which is approximately 500 metres away, and Port Aventura Theme Park, which is less than 3 km from the establishment. Fully air-conditioned, the establishment offers a range of facilities. Business travellers are sure to appreciate the conference facilities and guests arriving by car can leave their vehicles in the nearby parking garage. The hotel offers different types of restaurants, a buffet restaurant, an à la carte restaurant that has a daily menu and a select menu with Mediterranean cuisine and a Teppanyaki restaurant, which allows guests to enjoy the pleasure of eating whilst watching a cooking show.

109654.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional amenities at this hotel include an arcade/game room, a picnic area, and barbecue grills. At Forest Gate Hotel, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary English breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 9:00 AM. Featured amenities include luggage storage and laundry facilities. Make yourself at home in one of the 20 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and microwaves. Flat-screen televisions with pay movies are provided, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Westfield Stratford City - 3. 4 km / 2. 1 mi- Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park - 3.

name.content: Hotel Indigo London Paddington Hyde Park

109693.description: Hotel Indigo® London Paddington is nestled in a leafy part of the Paddington neighbourhood – the perfect location to experience London. Situated just a short stroll from the Heathrow Express, Paddington train and tube stations, Hotel Indigo Paddington is ideally located for you to enjoy world-famous Hyde Park, canal rides and buzzing bars at Little Venice and the shops of Oxford Street. Explore the grandeur of elegant Georgian townhouses, cobbled streets, and the surrounding quaint street cafes, and then step inside to modern interiors, boutique bedrooms and inspirational artwork. Enjoy sensational Italian cuisine in our Bella Italia restaurant or choose to escape the hustle by relaxing with a drink on our private garden terrace - we’re ready to welcome you.

109700.description: Situated in an oasis of tranquillity at the heart of Paisley's heritage and entertainment district, this property is sure to impress. Located in the Oakshaw conservation area, it is perched on a hill between Orr Square church and Trinity Church. The property enjoys close proximity to a wealth of attractions in the area including the UWS university, Coats Venue, Museums and 800+year old Paisley Abbey. A wide range of traditional restaurants and pubs, as well as stylish shopping options, can be found nearby. This hotel occupies 2 listed Georgian town houses within their own walled gardens complete with Whisky Bar & Brasserie. The interior features stunning period details and the guest rooms have been designed in a classical style, offering a relaxing ambiance. Guests can enjoy the many excellent facilities and services that the property has to offer.

109733.description: A fantastic location in the heart of London. Best Western Buckingham Palace Road Hotel occupies a prime spot close to the capital’s top attractions. Buckingham Palace, the Houses of Parliament, London Eye, Hyde Park and West End theatres are all within walking distance, so there’s plenty to tick off your must-do list!Whether you’re in London for a business meeting, stopover or sightseeing trip, our handy base will make your stay a comfortable one, with rooms at prices to fit your budget. Look forward to a restful night’s sleep in our cosy beds, and enjoy home comforts including a hairdryer, TV, central heating, direct dial telephone, hospitality tray and modern bathroom. All our stylish rooms are decorated in subtle tones with contemporary furniture and tasteful artwork. Wi-Fi is also available.

109734.description: An attractive hotel in West London, The Best Western Chiswick Palace & Suites is conveniently located on Chiswick High Road, just half an hour away from Central London and Heathrow Airport. If you want to enjoy all the capital has to offer - or even jet off and see the world - this hotel is just the place to stay. Set in a beautiful and trendy suburb of West London, the Best Western Chiswick Palace & Suites is also close to Kew Gardens. You'll have the best of both worlds - close to the bright lights of London's shopping and nightlife, yet well away from the hustle and bustle when you return to the hotel and its tree-lined setting. London Underground stations are also just a short walk away to give you full access to the whole city, day and night. For the sports fans amongst our guests, we're just a drop kick away from Twickenham, while Wembley is also nearby for sporting and all kind of other events. If you're not interested in sport, try the regular music and comedy gigs at the nearby Hammersmith Eventim Apollo. If you're looking for an exceptional hotel in Hammersmith from which you can explore the capital, look no further than the Best Western Chiswick Palace & Suites.

110555.description: Nestled between two Cathedrals and located at the heart of Liverpool City Centre, the hotel offers travellers high quality guest accommodation and a warm friendly welcome in a unique Georgian setting. The hotel is located on historic Rodney Street at the heart of Liverpool City Centre, 9 km from the airport of Liverpoll. It is located just three minutes walk from both the Roman Catholic and Anglican Cathedrals as well as the main campuses for Liverpool John Moores University, University of Liverpool, and LIPA (Liverpool Institute of Performing Arts).

110557.description: Housed in an exquisite Victorian building dating back to 1859, this traditionally decorated hotel offers a prime location in Victoria, London. Just a ten-minute walk from public transport, it provides easy access to iconic attractions like Buckingham Palace and the Houses of Parliament. Fully renovated to the highest standards of comfort, the hotel caters to both leisure and business travelers with its impeccable service and convenient access to historic sites and shopping.

110593.description:
PREMIER SUITES Edinburgh Fountain Court boasts a prime location in Edinburgh’s West End, near Haymarket and the Financial District. Everything you need is right on your doorstep, and only a twenty-minute walk to Princes Street, where you will find all the best retail, hospitality, and cultural experiences. 

We have created a home away from home experience. We provide you with everything you need to make you feel at home and enjoy an easy, stress-free and comfortable stay. 

All apartments include one or two-bedroom units and all come with a fully fitted kitchen, living room, bedroom and ensuite bathroom. Each of the fully equipped kitchens includes a combi-oven, microwave, hob, fridge with icebox, laundry facilities and coffee machine. Our serviced apartments also include a contemporary living area with a flat-screen TV. 

Whether you are traveling for business or pleasure our serviced apartments cater for everyone’s needs.

110619.description: Enjoy garden views at Blue Bells Hotel in London City Centre, and take advantage of amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM. Luggage storage and a safe deposit box are available at the front desk. The hotel offers 25 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions with digital programming and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences such as desks, coffee/tea makers, and irons/ironing boards (upon request) are also provided. A short walk from Portobello Road Market and Kensington Gardens, the hotel is also conveniently located near Kensington Palace and Kensington High Street.

110620.description: Conveniently close to central London, Chelsea House Hotel offers good-value accommodations, 5 minutes’ walk from Earl's Court Underground Station and 2 miles from Victoria Train Station. A Victorian listed building, Chelsea House Hotel provides comfortable rooms, all with en suite private bathrooms and a TV. Guests can also make use of tea and coffee-making facilities. A continental breakfast buffet is served in the morning, and there is free Wi-Fi internet access in public areas of the building. Earl's Court Exhibition Center and Stamford Bridge, home of Chelsea Football Club, can both be reached in 15 minutes’ walk or less. Numerous pubs and restaurants are also nearby.

110621.description:
With a stay at Acacia Hostel in London (London City Centre), you'll be steps from Natural History Museum and 6 minutes by foot from Victoria and Albert Museum.  This hostel is 0.4 mi (0.7 km) from Imperial College London and 0.5 mi (0.8 km) from Kensington High Street.
Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access, tour/ticket assistance, and a reception hall.
Featured amenities include luggage storage and microwave in a common area. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge.
A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM.
Make yourself at home in one of the 20 guestrooms featuring refrigerators. Prepare your meals in the shared/communal kitchen. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers. Housekeeping is provided daily, and irons/ironing boards can be requested.

110773.description: Smartly designed Watford Junction hotel with inclusive breakfast and easy access to London. Holiday Inn Express® London - Watford Junction hotel is just steps from Watford Junction train station. Trains reach London's Euston Station in about 20 minutes, and only 15 minutes by train to reach Wembley Stadium. Heathrow Airport (LHR) is a 45-minute drive. Central Watford shopping and dining are a short walk away. A shuttle from Watford Junction bus station carries Harry Potter fans young and old to the Warner Bros. Studio Tour. Walk 10 minutes to the Atria Watford shopping centre, or take a breezy stroll along the Grand Union Canal. Two well-equipped, naturally lit meeting rooms make it easy to organise small seminars. Catering options range from fresh coffee and biscuits to a hot lunch. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free Wi-Fi- Express Start™ Breakfast included in the room rate- All Day Dining- Competitive car parking ratesSpacious, streamlined Next Generation rooms offer comfortable bedding, plus thoughtful touches like blackout curtains, bedside USBs and Smart TVs. Double rooms with sofa beds are perfect for families. Start the day with a hearty breakfast, including scrambled eggs, bacon, sausage and beans, and end it with a drink in the bar. A tasty dinner awaits you in the open-plan Great Room lobby.

111000.description: This cozy hotel, nestled in a quiet neighborhood just off Leith Walk and opposite a large park, retains many original period features across its three floors. Waverley Station and the city center are within a 15-minute walk, while Edinburgh Castle, Calton Hill, and the Zoo are easily accessible by public transport. The airport is approximately 25 km away. It's an ideal base for exploring Edinburgh's attractions and activities.

111218.description: Enjoy a central Edinburgh stay at Fraser Suites, a Victorian aparthotel just steps from St. Giles' Cathedral and a short walk from Princes Street Gardens. This eco-certified aparthotel offers 75 individually furnished guestrooms with kitchenettes (refrigerator and microwave included), LCD TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a continental breakfast (fee applies), and take advantage of the 24-hour fitness center, concierge services, and fireplace in the lobby. Additional amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk.

name.content: The Watermill Hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Best

111574.description: Built on the site of an old flour mill on the banks of the River Bulbourne just outside Hemel Hempstead, The Watermill Hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western offers serene surroundings away from the hustle and bustle of city life. Our 71 tastefully decorated bedrooms offer modern home comforts, with several boasting beautiful views of the surrounding lush green meadows and river. Whether you're here for leisure or business, you can take advantage of ample free parking and WiFi throughout the hotel and relax in our Riverside Bar and Lounge when your day is done. We're within easy reach of London and a host of top attractions, like Whipsnade Zoo and Woburn Abbey. Harry Potter fans can follow in the footsteps of the adventurous boy wizard on a magical day out at the Warner Bros Studio Tour, while ski and snowboard enthusiasts can take to the indoor slopes of The Snow Centre.

111639.description: Nestled on the banks of the River Cam, Graduate by Hilton Cambridge is an idyllic retreat inspired by centuries of rich traditions and academic life. With unmatched views, seasonal culinary experiences, and a cozy bar, it offers a unique stay. Guest rooms honor the heritage of the University of Cambridge, featuring bespoke designs and subtle nods to Cambridge blue throughout.

111645.description: Just 30 minutes from London, the Holiday Inn London Luton North is ideal for business and leisure travelers. This 100% smoke-free hotel offers easy access to the M1 and A1M motorways, local business parks, and London Luton Airport. The hotel boasts 10 modern, well-equipped meeting rooms suitable for small meetings, conferences, and product launches, plus complimentary Wi-Fi. Maintain your fitness routine in the complimentary fitness center. Choose from 157 recently refurbished, modern bedrooms, each with complimentary internet access and stylish bathrooms. Enjoy freshly prepared lunch from our lounge menu or dinner in the brasserie-style restaurant. Evening room service is available 24hrs.

111687.description: This hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has a range of kids amenities available upon request. Home to the largest ballroom in Hertfordshire, Hilton London Watford hotel is a 3-minute drive from the M1 and 16 minutes from London Euston. Local attractions include a variety of museums in St Albans, the Warner Brothers Studio Tour - The Making of Harry Potter, and the stately homes of Knebworth and Hatfield that evoke times gone by. The LivingWell Fitness Centre offers guests a great way to work out. Start your day with a delicious breakfast at Jamie's Restaurant, guaranteed to get your day off to a great start, while Rayner's Bar is the perfect spot to relax over drinks, lunch, dinner, and bar snacks, or enjoy an evening nightcap. During summer, enjoy al-fresco dining in our Secret Garden. WiFi is available in all Hilton London Watford hotel rooms, fees apply. For more space, upgrade to a Deluxe Room, Suite, or Family Room.

111690.address: Kingfisher Country Estate, Paradise Walk, Templepa
111690.description: DoubleTree by Hilton Belfast Templepatrick combines a convenient location with superb facilities. The 130 guest rooms are each equipped with WiFi access, an LED TV, work desk, and in-room safe. All guests enjoy access to our Health Club swimming pool and gym, as well as preferential rates for the Halcyon Spa - hydrotherapy pool, and upon the championship Par 72 golf course. Car parking is complimentary for hotel residents. The hotel is located four miles from Belfast International Airport and 15 miles from Belfast City Centre. There is ease of access to the various Antrim and Belfast business parks.

111691.description:
With generous rooms, a welcoming atmosphere, and a mix of classic style and modern convenience, this hotel in Bromsgrove is ideal for business breaks, leisure breaks or for a short stayover in the West Midlands. Conveniently located near the M5 and M42, our Bromsgrove hotel offers a welcoming base for exploring Worcestershire and the surrounding West Midlands, with easy access to Birmingham, Stratford-Upon-Avon and the Cotswolds. . 
 
As a guest, you can choose from a range of comfortable bedrooms all of which are en-suite & offer classic décor, giving you a calm and welcoming place to unwind, with flat screen tv’s, free Wi-Fi access and a work desk, tea & coffee making facilities, ironing facilities & complimentary toiletries. 
 
During your stay, you can take advantage of the hotel’s dining options, where you can enjoy breakfast, afternoon teas and evening meals in a traditional setting. The hotel also features stylish bars and lounges—perfect for meeting friends, enjoying a quiet drink, or simply taking a moment to relax in the Coffee Lounge. 
 
The hotel is also well known for its impressive 9 function suites and event spaces, regularly hosting weddings, conferences, and social events. 
 
We also have a leisure club which includes a 60ft heated swimming pool, fully equipped fitness room & sauna which guest are welcome to use at a special discounted rate. Guests can explore nearby countryside at Lickey Hills Country Park or Waseley Hills Country Park, discover local history at Avoncroft Museum of Historic Buildings, or enjoy family attractions such as Cadbury World and West Midland Safari Park. With a mix of relaxation, nature and attractions nearby, Bromsgrove Hotel & Spa is an ideal location for all our guests needs. 

On‑site parking is now free with approximately 230 spaces available on a first-come, first-served basis. Guests must register their vehicle details at reception to avoid penalties.

111693.description: Hilton Dublin Charlemont is ideally located in the heart of Dublin city centre, overlooking the Grand Canal of Dublin. We offer a perfect location if you're travelling for business or leisure. The hotel is only a five-minute walk to the main shopping and cultural areas of Dublin. We're within walking distance to key business areas and are close to Stephens Green and The Grand Canal area. The LUAS tram connects guests to Stephens Green and Grafton Street - the main shopping street in Dublin, or travel 15 minutes south to Ireland's largest shopping centre, Dundrum Town Centre. For leisure, we're ideally situated for shopping and visiting the many attractions of the city, including The Guinness Store House, Trinity College, and the main sports and concert venues in Dublin. Visit Croke Park and 3Arena, just a ten-minute drive away. Aviva Stadium and the RDS are only a ten-minute walk from our Hilton Dublin Charlemont. For business travellers, the hotel is in a perfect location for the Dublin Convention Centre, the RDS and variety of Dublin's business parks. The LUAS tram offers access to Sandyford, Dundrum, Leopardstown and Cherrywood. We offer easy access to The Financial Services area of Dublin (IFSC) and Eastpoint Business Park. We're also just 30 minutes from Dublin Airport. The hotel offers excellent conference and event facilities, including six suites for 2 – 340 delegates. Guests enjoy free WiFi throughout the hotel, an onsite gym, secure parking ( fee payable) and the Sixth Lock Bar & Bistro.

111855.description: The well-being of guests is top of mind at Choice-branded hotels. Guests may experience a variety of new, improved cleanliness protocols and products. Get rested and ready for anything at the smoke-free Comfort Inn Edgware Road, W2 hotel in London, EN near the city of Westminster. Our hotel is also near the Marble Arch monument, Hyde Park and Bayswater District. Prepare for a successful day ahead with amenities like free breakfast, free wireless high-speed Internet, a business center and a restaurant, to name a few. Guest rooms come with TVs, coffee makers, desks, hair dryers, safes and more. Behind every great day is a great night at our Comfort Inn Edgware Road, W2. Book now. Local phone calls are available for a small fee, contact the hotel for more information.

name.content: PortAventura Hotel Gold River+ Ticket Included

111904.address: Avinguda De L Alcalde Pere Molas, S/N
111904.description: More than just a hotel, Gold River recreates a whole town that rose up with the settlement of the first gold prospectors. This town contains various shops, a grocery store, a train station, bars, a school, wooden bungalows. . . and all these buildings house the rooms that make up the hotel. This hotel, located inside PortAventura Park, has unlimited access to PortAventura Park throughout the stay and 1-day access to Ferrari Land included per stay and person (according to parks opening dates and times), discount on Caribe Aquatic Park tickets, preferential booking for table service restaurants in the parks via the hotel's Guest Service Desk and Pick-Up service at PortAventura Park and Ferrari Land shops. The hotel features 3 swimming pools, a 24 hour reception service, bars, restaurant, shops and a snack bar in the pool area. In addition, in relation to the new benefit for guests staying at Far West hotels, between 10 July and 11 September, you will have early access to the new ride Uncharted: The Enigma of Penitence, 2 hours before PortAventura Park opens! From 08:30 until 10:30.

name.content: Cala Cristal by Pierre & Vacances Premium

111993.description: This aparthotel offers eight comfortable, air-conditioned apartments, each with direct access to a public garden, a restaurant, and a pool bar. Guests can also enjoy the lobby café and room service. All apartments boast a terrace overlooking Platja Cristal (Miami Beach) with stunning panoramic sea views and a convenient snack bar. Note: For 2024, key pickup and check-out will be at the Bonavista de Bonmont resort (Golf de Bonmont, Urb. Terres Noves 43300 Mont Roig Del Camp, Spain).

112217.address: The Waterfront Level Street Bierley Hill
112217.description: Set in the heart of Dudley's historic canal marina, the Copthorne Hotel Merry Hill-Dudley is a luxury corporate hotel boasting a stunning waterfront location. With 138 en-suite rooms, modern amenities and conference space for 570 guests, commercial and social events can be hosted with ease. Perfect for leisure and family breaks, the Copthorne is just minutes from the fantastic Merry Hill Shopping Centre and within easy reach of such as Cadbury World, Dudley Zoo and the Black Country Living Museum. With convenient road, rail and air transport links, onsite parking, and only 12 miles from Birmingham, the Copthorne offers a picturesque and peaceful location, close to a vibrant city. ** As of the 1st August 2024, we wish to advise you that Copthorne Hotel Merry Hill-Dudley will be operating as a cashless business. **

112294.description: Situated in the heart of Dublin city centre, beside Merrion Square and Trinity College, The Mont offers a vibrant base for exploring one of Europe's most captivating cities. Just a five-minute walk from Grafton Street and the financial district, this hotel boasts Dublin's fastest Wi-Fi, a state-of-the-art gym, and a wood-fired pizza restaurant. Guests can also enjoy a bar stocked with artisan gins and craft beers, along with contemporary, designer-led bedrooms.

112295.description: Located in Belfast's vibrant Cathedral Quarter, this hotel offers free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout. Guests can choose from executive and accessible rooms, and enjoy dining at the in-house SQ Bar and Grill restaurant. The hotel also features invigorating power showers in each room and three meeting rooms. Car parking is available nearby (charges apply). Laundry and dry cleaning services are available off-site.

112296.description: Enjoy a stylish stay at Numa London Bloomsbury, a boutique hotel in the heart of London's City Centre, just steps from Tottenham Court Road and a short walk from the British Museum. The 86 air-conditioned rooms offer smart TVs with digital programming and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each room includes a private bathroom with a bathtub or shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hair dryer. Coffee/tea makers and safes are also provided for your convenience, and housekeeping is offered weekly. Leicester Square and Covent Garden Market are within a mile of the hotel.

112353.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a rooftop terrace and a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Grab a bite at Mayfly Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is complimentary (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 100 guestrooms featuring minibars and Smart televisions.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Liverpool - Albert Dock

112882.description: Comfortable rooms in a converted warehouse overlooking Albert Dock, with easy access to Liverpool City Centre. Located on the vibrant, rejuvenated Albert Dock,  Holiday Inn Express® Liverpool - Albert Dock hotel is a 25-minute drive from Liverpool John Lennon Airport (LPL). James Street Subway Station is only 10 minutes’ walk away and offers access to nearby Chester as well as local service around Liverpool. Business guests are minutes away from the ACC Convention Centre. You can host a meeting and request a working lunch at the hotel’s two meeting rooms, which seat up to 40 people and can be configured to suit your needs. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. The hotel is only minutes away from the Tate Liverpool Museum, the M&S Concert Arena and the interactive Beatles Story exhibit, all located on Albert Dock. You can meander Liverpool’s UNESCO World Heritage waterfront and take your pick from the many cafés, bistros, restaurants and bars that dot the dock. All guests enjoy an inclusive Express Start Breakfast ranging from hot items like scrambled eggs, baked beans, bacon and sausages to continental options, including fresh pastries and cereal. Relax with a drink at the Great Room bar, which has excellent views over the river. Guests receive a discount at a nearby car park.

113083.description: Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection at hand in communal areas. Visitors will appreciate the 24-hour reception. There is a car park. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

113401.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as a seasonal outdoor pool and bicycle rentals. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, an arcade/game room, and gift shops/newsstands. Dine at the on-site restaurant, or take advantage of room service (during limited hours). Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. For your convenience, dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff are available. Planning an event? The hotel offers 1, 970 square feet of conference space and four meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). The hotel offers 101 guest rooms equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, hair dryers, and toiletries. A phone, desk, and coffee/tea maker are also provided for your comfort. Nearby attractions include Tillegembos, Kinepolis Bruges, Loppem Castle, and the Jan Breydel Stadium. The nearest airports are Ostend-Bruges International Airport (OST) and Brussels Airport (BRU).

name.content: voco St David's Cardiff, an IHG Hotel

113573.description: Experience a warm Welsh welcome at voco St. David's Cardiff, our landmark five-star hotel nestled on the picturesque Cardiff Bay waterfront. Our iconic architecture boasts unparalleled views and sets the stage for an unforgettable stay. Whether you're unwinding in our award-winning Spa at St. David's, indulging in exquisite dining at Tir a Môr, or simply relaxing on your private balcony, every moment is infused with luxury and relaxation. Venture beyond our doors and explore the vibrant city of Cardiff or the serene countryside, both a short distance away. Stroll along the waterfront promenade, take a leisurely boat ride, or simply immerse yourself in the beauty of our surroundings. For those seeking relaxation, our spa beckons with rejuvenating treatments and luxurious amenities, including hydro and swimming pools. But voco St. David's Cardiff is more than just a retreat; it's also a premier destination for events and celebrations. With eight contemporary event spaces boasting breathtaking views of Cardiff Bay, our hotel provides the perfect backdrop for weddings, conferences, and more. Located near major transport links and just a stone's throw from the city centre and the renowned Principality Stadium. Whether you're here for business or pleasure, our hotel promises an unforgettable experience from the moment you arrive. So come on in, make yourself at home, and let voco St. David's Cardiff be your gateway to the best of Wales.

113617.description: Based in a typical Anglo-Norman style building, which merges perfectly with the charming style of the city, this enchanting hotel is centrally located, just a few minutes' walk from Bruges' ancient market square and a 2-minute walk from 't Zand Square. Guests will fall in love with this beautiful city where they can go for a boat trip on the picturesque canals, taste some local specialities in the restaurants and visit the famous Belfry tower. The hotel presents a modern colonial interior design, offering a charming atmosphere where guests will feel right at home. Room facilities include parquet flooring, a flat-screen TV for guests' entertainment and Wi-Fi access is available throughout the building. Family rooms as well as a special kid's corner with a range of activities and games are available for those travelling with children. Guests who want to keep their gym routine may take advantage of the hotel's fitness room and relax by taking a dip into the sparkling indoor pool.

113866.description: The hotel is located on Flemings Way, in a prime central spot, within easy reach of the Parade retail area and the town's leisure district. Within walking distance of the hotel, guests will find restaurants, bars and nightclubs, as well as shopping opportunities. London Heathrow Airport is approximately 71 km away from the hotel, while Bristol Airport is around 73 km away. This hotel was built in 2009. It is an air-conditioned, family-friendly establishment comprising a total of 229 standard bedrooms, all of which are accessible through lifts. Business guests can make use of the fully-equipped conference facilities, including 7 meeting rooms, while leisure guests can relax with a drink at the café where various snacks and refreshments are served. Rooms are contemporarily designed and fitted with amenities ensuring the ease and comfort of both business travellers and tourist.

113868.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and wedding services. Additional features at this hotel include a fireplace in the lobby, a picnic area, and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, DuVall's Restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 87 individually decorated guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have shower/tub combinations and hair dryers.

114513.description: Located near Gatwick Airport, this hotel offers 218 guestrooms with LCD TVs, digital programming, and private bathrooms. Enjoy amenities like a fitness center, garden, restaurant, bar/lounge, and room service. Business travelers appreciate the 24-hour business center and meeting rooms. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available in common areas, while in-room Wi-Fi is available for a surcharge. Buffet breakfast is offered daily (fee applies). The hotel provides a convenient airport shuttle (surcharge) and on-site parking (fee applies). Nearby attractions include Manor Royal Business Park and Gatwick Aviation Museum.

114673.description: Dorma Cunit Suites & Spa invites you to enjoy a peaceful and relaxing stay. Located on the sunny Golden Coast, the hotel has been designed and equipped to offer our clients a refreshing wellness experience in a peaceful and serene setting. This peaceful atmosphere also surrounds the 32 suites that make up the hotel. Ample spaces with plenty of natural light, the suites present a modern décor that complements perfectly with amenities that are integrated in a varied range of the most modern services. Every suite is equipped with a living room with TV, telephone, a full kitchen and Wi-Fi connection. Everything you need to enjoy a carefree stay. Dorma Cunit Suites & Spa rounds its relaxation proposal off with an exclusive lounge with panoramic views, jacuzzi, sauna, spa bath and a wide range of beauty and wellness treatments. You'll find a magnificent outdoor Roman-style pool and a children's play area that will delight the little ones. Next to the pool area, you'll find our restaurant, which is specialised in all kinds of rice, paella and seafood. The ideal place to enjoy quality Mediterranean cuisine.

114913.description: The Ramada London Stansted Airport, built in 2009, is conveniently located near motorway junction 8 off the M11, just four miles from Stansted Airport. This hotel offers free Wi-Fi, complimentary newspapers, and digital Freeview flat-screen TVs with over 60 channels in each of its executive and interconnecting family rooms. Guests can enjoy a full English breakfast (for a fee) and 24-hour reception service. On-site amenities include a cash machine and adjacent petrol forecourt and food court. Parking is available for £5 per night. All rooms feature triple-glazed windows, walk-in wet rooms with power showers, coffeemakers, and Hypnos deluxe beds. Taxis are available upon request. Cambridge City is 14 miles away, London Docklands a 25-minute drive, and Olympic Park a 20-minute drive. Please note that pets are not allowed.

114914.description: This hotel, conveniently located a short taxi ride from London Stansted Airport, offers a variety of rooms, including executive rooms and rooms with laptop safes. All rooms feature flat-screen TVs with 60+ digital Freeview channels and free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property. Guests can also take advantage of on-site parking, 24-hour reception, and pet-friendly accommodations (fee applies). Additional amenities include hot drinks and snacks available for purchase at reception, a free newspaper, and a cash machine.

114917.address: M6 Motorway Junction 3-4 Highfield Lane Corley
114917.description: Days Inn Corley NEC M6 is perfectly located for both business and leisure guests in Coventry. The property offers guests a range of services and amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. Service-minded staff will welcome and guide you at Days Inn Corley NEC M6. Each guestroom is elegantly furnished and equipped with handy amenities. The property offers various recreational opportunities. Discover all Coventry has to offer by making Days Inn Corley NEC M6 your base.

name.content: Southcrest Manor Hotel BW Signature Collection

114993.description: Built in 1921, this former manor house offers 63 stylish bedrooms, each featuring modern decor and contemporary conveniences. Guests enjoy complimentary access to a fully equipped fitness suite, outdoor hydrotherapy hot tub, and Swedish & infrared saunas. The elegant Laura Ashley-designed restaurant and bar, inspired by the hotel's stunning surroundings, provides a uniquely British setting for special occasions. The menu offers a range of delicious dishes, including the popular Sunday roast, along with an exciting cocktail menu and an extensive wine list. In the charming Laura Ashley Tea Room, guests can enjoy a delightful afternoon tea experience, featuring homemade sandwiches, fresh scones, beautiful cakes, and a selection of teas, catering to all dietary requirements. The Elemis-approved Manor Health & Beauty Club offers a unisex range of luxury products and treatments. The hotel also caters to a variety of events, from interviews and conferences to private dinners and weddings, with a range of meeting rooms and outdoor spaces.

114996.description: Our Edinburgh Haymarket hotel is located in Edinburgh's elegant West End, perfect for those wanting a quiet base within touching distance of everything the Scottish capital has to offer. And we're just around the corner from the train station. Set in a listed Georgian building, it's great whether you're in town for the Festival, Edinburgh Castle, world-class shopping and restaurants or just want to soak up the vast history and culture of this majestic city. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals.

115210.description: Staybridge Suites Liverpool offers comfortable fully-equipped studio and one-bedroom suites in the Royal Albert Docks area of Liverpool. Liverpool Lime Street Station is a twenty-minute walk, with Moorfields and Central Stations both just ten minutes away. The M62 motorway is a twenty-minute drive and Liverpool John Lennon Airport (LPL) is 25 minutes by taxi. Work delegates can make use of our 14-capacity Den Meeting Room and have 24-hour access to the business centre's copying and scanning services, as well as complimentary Wi-Fi. During your stay, workout in our 24/7 Fitness Centre, stock up on provisions from The Pantry, and why not join us for our Staybridge Social events, where you can enjoy a drink and bite to eat on us three times a week. Explore Liverpool from our centrally located hotel. You can find us right opposite the M&S Bank Arena and our hotel is part of the iconic Royal Albert Docks. Enjoy all that our city has to offer during your stay with us including the famous Wheel of Liverpool, The Beatles Story museum, the Tate Liverpool and a great selection of bars and shopping right on our doorstep.

115211.description: Staybridge Suites® Newcastle offers relaxing, home-like apartment-style accommodation with all the comforts of home, whether you’re staying for a night, a weekend or for an extended business trip. Features include spacious suites with living spaces & fully fitted kitchens, 85 on-site parking spaces, complimentary Wi-Fi, fitness studio, laundry facilities and a 24/7 reception and Pantry. All guests can enjoy our complimentary breakfast buffet with English breakfast and continental choices and mid-week evening socials with drinks and nibbles included, excludes Bank Holidays. Located just a short walk from Millennium Bridge, Staybridge Suites Newcastle is perfectly positioned for those who want to explore the sights and nightlife of the city. Newcastle Central Station is a twenty-minute walk and the nearest Metro Station, Manors, can be found 5 minutes up the road. The A167 motorway is easily accessible as well as the A1. The nearest airport, Newcastle International Airport is 20 minutes by taxi. Delegates can book our 14-capacity, boardroom style, Den Meeting Room and have 24-hour access to the Business Centre's services, including click-share, as well as complimentary Wi-Fi. Newcastle has a fantastic choice of bars and restaurants that can be found along the Quayside. Music fans are a six-minute drive from the Utilitia Arena, a 15-minute walk from the waterfront concert venue, Sage Gateshead, and the Baltic Centre for Contemporary Art.

name.content: The Royale Chulan Hyde Park Hotel London

115212.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at The Royale Chulan Hyde Park, including complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a reception hall. Room service is available during limited hours. The hotel also offers a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and an elevator. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). The 52 guestrooms feature kitchenettes equipped with refrigerators and stovetops, flat-screen televisions with digital programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Desks and electric kettles are also provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Located in London's City Centre, the hotel is within a 10-minute walk of Kensington Gardens and Portobello Road Market, and a short distance from Kensington Palace and Hyde Park.

name.content: Four Points Flex by Sheraton Cardiff

115214.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, a fireplace in the lobby, and tour/ticket assistance. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Make yourself at home in one of the 95 air-conditioned guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, as well as phones with free local calls. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Cardiff Tourist Information Centre - 0. 2 km / 0 .

115413.description: Ideally located next to the Excel Centre, only 40 minutes to Central London by public transport, 20 minutes from the O2 Arena by public transport and 20 minutes by car. London City Airport is just 1 mile away. Conveniently located for Prince Regent DLR station. Our London Docklands (Excel) Premier Inn has everything you'd expect, incredibly comfy beds in every room and an integrated restaurant serving a mix of traditional and contemporary dishes. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

115613.description: The Bermondsey Square Hotel is located in the heart of Bermondsey, London. This 90-room hotel is designed to meet the needs of discerning guests, from business travellers to party people, to those simply looking to relax and enjoy the local attractions. Bermondsey is one of London's most happening areas, with great galleries, boutiques, bars and restaurants, all within a stone's throw of the City Centre, the London Eye, Shakespeare's Globe and TATE Modern amongst other attractions. With a thriving restaurant, bar and clubs, art galleries, design studios and boutique shops are located just a short distance from the hotel as well as main attractions like the Design Museum, Borough Market, Tate Modern and Tower Bridge, the Bermondsey Square Hotel is the ideal place to stay.

115655.description: Enjoy modern comfort and convenience at Future Inns Cardiff Bay. Located near the Wales Millennium Centre, this hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, an on-site restaurant and bar, and room service during limited hours. Start your day with an English breakfast (fee applies), or grab a bite at Thomas Restaurant. Host your next event in our spacious conference facilities, and unwind in one of our 197 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen TVs and private bathrooms. Free self-parking is available. We're a short drive from Cardiff International Airport (CWL).

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London Heathrow T5

115835.description: The comfortable, 300-bedroom Holiday Inn Express London - Heathrow Terminal 5 is conveniently located a short 10-minute drive from the terminal. With an included Express Start Breakfast and ample on-site parking (fee applies), we offer everything you need for a great stay, whether for business or leisure. The hotel provides easy access to numerous local companies and business parks, including Balfour Beatty, Travelport, DHL, and Royal Mail. Slough Trading Estate, home to many global headquarters, is only 5 miles away. Just minutes from the M25, M40, and M4, and situated outside the newly extended ULEZ zone, the hotel offers convenient links throughout Greater London. Direct trains from nearby Slough station can whisk you to London Paddington in just 20 minutes. The hotel's seven well-equipped meeting rooms can host up to 120 guests, with packages available for all events, from day delegate and all-inclusive rates to room hire, residential conferences, private dinners, and social celebrations. For leisure travelers, Windsor Castle and Windsor Racecourse are a short drive away. Families with children will find the Holiday Inn Express T5 a perfect base for visiting Legoland® Windsor Resort. Relax and enjoy a meal and a drink in our Great Room Restaurant and Bar after a busy day.

115927.description: This welcoming hotel is situated in a peaceful area of Knowsley, on the outskirts of Liverpool. The hotel is just a short driving distance away from Liverpool John Lennon Airport. Many attractions can be found in the area. This attractive hotel welcomes visitors with the promise of a comfortable stay. The guest rooms are relaxing and peaceful, offering a welcome escape from the bustle of daily life. The property offers conference facilities for the convenience of business travellers. Attentive service, warm hospitality and the utmost in comfort and convenience combine to make this property the perfect choice for every type of traveller.

115943.description: This family-friendly hotel is located just steps from the historic town centre and the Concertgebouw (concert hall). Guests will find a range of restaurants and shopping venues within 500 m of the accommodation. Public transport links via rail can be found just 100 m away and Brussels Airport lies some 100 km from the hotel. A large and varied cold buffet breakfast is served. There is a safe underground carpark. Further fittings include internet corner in the lounge and WiFi in the rooms. The comfortable and tastefully furnished units come equipped with a private bathroom with a bathtub, shower and hairdryer. Further in-room amenities include cable TV, radio and a safe. Furthermore, all rooms are centrally heated. A buffet-style breakfast is served at this hotel.

116233.description: Indulge in a visit to the hotel spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Maintain your fitness routine at the health club or unwind in the sauna. Bicycle rentals are also available. This hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a hair salon. Enjoy a meal at Le Mystique restaurant and bar/lounge or order 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee (8:00 AM to 11:00 AM). Business amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours), and limited onsite parking is provided. Each of the 27 individually decorated guest rooms features an iPad, a flat-screen television with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, a safe, a desk, and a phone with free local calls. Bathrooms include designer toiletries and hair dryers. The hotel is conveniently located near Bruges City Theater, the Friet Museum, and the Historium. The preferred airport is Brussels Airport (BRU).

116234.description: Hotel Dukes’ Palace is a 5-star superior hotel located in a unique 15th-century former ducal palace in Bruges, just 280 meters from the Markt. Dukes' Palace Brugge combines classically elegant décor with luxurious 5-star amenities. The hotel features 135 rooms across three wings. The main building’s castle wing offers Deluxe rooms and suites with high ceilings. Our Heritage Junior suites, Heritage suites and the Mary of Burgundy suite, blend sumptuous comfort with preserved historical details. The abbey wing accommodate our standard 'superior' rooms, while the Pavilion building, situated within the hotel's 3000 m² private garden, presents 21 modern rooms and 3 unique suites providing a contemporary contrast to the historic surroundings. Guests can unwind at Bar Julien, which offers a casual and comfortable setting for drinks and tapas, or enjoy refined Belgian cuisine at Restaurant Julien, where the menu highlights seasonal ingredients. Relax in ‘The Spa’ (additional fee) with sauna, bio sauna, UV and infrared cabins, salt wall and fitness room. The hotel offers private, secured on-site parking, accessible to guests for an additional fee.

116235.description: This cosy, family-friendly hotel is situated in the heart of Bruges, in the shade of magnificent mature trees. The market square is just a 2-minute walk from the hotel and guests will find a range of restaurants, bars and shopping venues close by. Brussels Airport lies some 80 km from the accommodation. Comprising comfortable rooms, this charming hotel welcomes guests into a lobby. All of the rooms radiate a warm and cosy atmosphere, with French oak panelling and romantic shades of colour.

116236.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, tour/ticket assistance, and a vending machine. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 46 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring refrigerators and minibars. Flat-screen televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with bathtubs feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily.

116311.description: By the quiet water's edge of the harbour, you'll find the welcoming Copthorne Hotel and Resort Hokianga, and its 33 rooms and suites. Located in Hokianga, just 3 hours north of Auckland, this 4-star Qualmark-rated hotel is an escape from the hustle and bustle of city life. Its beachfront rooms are a minute's stroll from the shore, and rooms with balconies offer magnificent views of the harbour and sand dunes. It's also the ideal base from which to explore Omapere. Discover breathtaking landscapes and rare flora and fauna in Waipoua Forest. Marvel at Tane Mahuta, an ancient Kauri tree as old as 2, 000 years. The beauty here is unlike anywhere else in the country, so stay with us and experience a slice of Kiwi paradise.

name.content: Copthorne Hotel and Resort Bay of Islands

116312.description:
Copthorne Hotel and Resort Bay of Islands commands a superb waterfront location in the heart of the Bay of Islands, with uninterrupted bay views surrounded by subtropical gardens. Adjacent to the historic Waitangi Treaty Grounds, the hotel is the perfect base for golf, some of the best big game fishing in the world, the wonder of the local native bush or to simply relax in a picturesque location. All 180 rooms have individual patios or balconies to enjoy the water or garden views, and taking inspiration from nature, have been designed to blend into the natural environment. Onsite facilities include a tennis court, free form lagoon style swimming pool, hot tub, massage studio, and Jimmy Cook's Kitchen Restaurant and Bar. 

NZD$50 per night credit card pre-auth, or cash deposit is required at check in.   This deposit will be refunded upon check-out minus any applicable charges.

116694.description: Roomzzz offers award-winning, spacious serviced apartments combining the comfort of home with the convenience of a hotel. Located minutes from Leeds city centre and major transport links, our stylish apartments are approximately 50% larger than the average hotel room and feature a full kitchen, LCD TV, and complimentary Wi-Fi and local/national calls. Enjoy luxurious touches like craftsman-built beds with 1250 pocket spring mattresses and a complimentary 'Grab & Go' breakfast. Onsite parking is available for a fee (subject to availability), and offsite parking options are also nearby. Whether you're staying for a night or a year, experience the luxury of home at Roomzzz.

117155.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Enjoy a satisfying meal at Dinner serving guests of Celtic International Hotel Cardiff Airport. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are served on weekends from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 50 individually decorated guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and coffee/tea makers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Porthkerry Country Park - 2. 2 km / 1. 3 mi- Penmark Castle - 3 km / 1.

117239.description:
This hotel is located in a commercial district of Salou's city centre. Llevant's beach is 4 minutes away and Port Aventura is only 2 km from the hotel. The nearest train station is 600 metres away and Reus airport is 12 km from the hotel.

This air-conditioned beach hotel has 40 rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-out service as well as a hotel safe and lift access to upper floors. Guests can enjoy a drink at the café and bar, which is close to the exterior terrace, before dining in the restaurant. Further amenities include wireless Internet access and bicycle hire.

The spacious rooms come en suite with a shower, a bath and a hairdryer. Guests can look forward to a good night's rest on their double bed. The rooms also have satellite/cable TV, a telephone and a safe. Guests can moreover expect to find air conditioning, central heating and either a balcony or terrace as standard.

The nearby beach is sandy.

The hotel serves a breakfast buffet.

117594.description: This family-friendly beach hotel is located just 800 m from Llevant Beach, 150 m from Salou city centre and about 2 km from PortAventura. In the surrounding area, guests will be able to enjoy the Cala Llenguadets and Cala Capellans beaches, as well as the city's splendid promenade. This Hotel offers guests the best accommodation option, with a total of 180 rooms available. Guests are welcomed into a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, lift access and a newspaper stand. The air-conditioned establishment also offers a games room, TV lounge, children's playground, kids' club, café, bar and restaurant. For an additional fee, guests may also make use of the the laundry service and the garage. All the rooms are equipped with a furnished balcony, air conditioning and central heating. They also feature a double bed, satellite TV, a direct dial telephone, an in-room safe and a complete bathroom with bath, shower and hairdryer. High chairs for children are also available. The hotel offers guests 3 swimming pools, both indoor and outdoor, one of which is heated. There is also a children's swimming area, a poolside snack bar and a sun terrace with sun loungers and parasols. Guests may enjoy a game of minigolf or relax in the hot tub. An entertainment programme for adults is organised by the hotel, and sun loungers and parasols are also available (for a fee) on the nearby sandy beach. A breakfast buffet is served each morning, and dinner is also served in buffet form. À la carte options are available for lunch.

117653.description: Enjoy modern conveniences like complimentary Wi-Fi, gift shops, and even wedding services at this Dublin hotel. Additional amenities include a TV lounge, tour/ticket assistance, and a ballroom. A convenient area shuttle (surcharge) simplifies travel. The hotel offers dining options ranging from a restaurant to a coffee shop/café, plus room service during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available for a fee on weekdays (6:30 AM - 9:00 AM) and weekends (7:30 AM - 11:00 AM). Business travelers appreciate the 24-hour business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers. With 10, 000 square feet of event space, including a conference center and 12 meeting rooms, it's ideal for conferences and events. Free self-parking is available. The 273 guest rooms feature flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, and bathrooms with bathtubs/showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Coffee/tea makers and desks provide added convenience. Nearby attractions include Park West Business Park (4. 7 km), Citywest Convention Centre (4. 7 km), and The Square Tallaght (4. 9 km). Dublin Airport (DUB) is 23. 7 km away.

118123.description: This hotel enjoys a peaceful setting in Bruges. The hotel is situated close to the city's main shopping street, lying just a 3 minutes' walking distance from Market Square. Guests will find a range of bars, restaurants and nightlife venues just metres away. Links to the public transport network are easily accessible from the hotel. This wonderful hotel occupies a stunning, former Flemish mansion. The hotel enjoys a charming design, beautifully incorporating traditional and classical elements. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, exuding refined elegance. IMPORTANT INFORMATION:- Check-in at Hotel Dukes' Palace (Prinsenhof 8 in Bruges), afterwards you will be accompanied to your room at Hotel Prinsenhof. - Breakfast is served at Hotel Dukes' Palace. - As a guest of Hotel Prinsenhof, all facilities of Hotel Dukes' Palace can be used (bar, restaurant, spa, fitness, . . . ) during your stay. - Check-out at Hotel Dukes' Palace (Prinsenhof 8 in Bruges), possibility to leave luggage in the luggage room.

118557.description:
The Cove Bay Hotels charm emanates from the Early 1800 hundreds when it was a Coaching Inn. Situated on a peninsula overlooking the North Sea, in the south of Aberdeen, it is a mix of traditional charm and modern amenities. 

Nearby Castles, distilleries, beach walks, Golf courses or dolphin watching all add to our welcoming nature. With sea facing rooms and restaurant, it’s a wonderful base to explore Aberdeen and the beautiful surrounding countryside.

118559.description: Nestled above the market town of Otley in West Yorkshire, this hotel offers secluded accommodations amidst unspoiled woodland and a stunning spa. Choose from 48 hotel rooms and log cabins, providing a tranquil escape while remaining just minutes from bustling markets, restaurants, bars, galleries, and shops. Indulge in locally sourced cuisine at the AA Rosette-awarded Lakeside Restaurant. Whether traveling for business or leisure, guests enjoy access to a range of amenities, including an indoor pool, hot tub, steam room, outdoor hot tub, and a luxurious spa (available at a supplement and require pre-booking). Located 11 miles from Leeds, the hotel also features a private fishing lake and scenic walking routes. For those arriving by air, the hotel is a short two-mile drive from Leeds/Bradford Airport via the A658 towards Harrogate.

118560.description: Get away from it all at the Premier Inn Hotel Glasgow (Paisley). If you're looking to escape the great British weather, we're ideally located for Glasgow Airport. Or if you just want to escape the hustle and bustle, the tranquility of Loch Lomond is only a short drive away. Listen in at the Glasgow World Pipe Band championships or head out on the slopes at Snow Factor. Snap up the bargains at intu Braehead Shopping Centre or get down to Linwood Leisure Centre. Then come back for some tasty food at our Brewers Fayre restaurant and a great sleep in a comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

name.content: The Queen at Chester Hotel, Handwritten Collection

119164.description:
Since 1860 we have been creating wonderful experiences for discerning travelers, situated at the gateway to Chester we provide a welcome and stylish escape, a place to rest from your journey, and a luxurious and well-connected base to make the most of Chester and beyond. The hotel is famous for its rich heritage, stunning public areas serving great food, afternoon teas and signature cocktails, with its hidden gem - the terrace, a tranquil oasis in the heart of the city. 

The Queen at Chester Hotel-Handwritten Collection is a historic boutique hotel in the heart of Chester, ideally located opposite Chester Railway Station and moments from the city centre. Blending Victorian grandeur with contemporary style, the hotel offers elegant rooms, distinctive dining, afternoon tea, meeting and event spaces, and beautiful wedding facilities. The perfect base for city breaks, business stays and exploring Chester's rich heritage.

119165.description: Once a wealthy cotton merchant's home, Liverpool Aigburth Hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western exudes period charm and sophistication. The hotel overlooks the magnificent green oasis of Sefton Park – with its tranquil boating lake, classical statues and restored Palm House – yet is only 2 miles from the buzzing restaurants, culture and nightlife of Liverpool city center. You'll be spoilt for choice for things to do in this vibrant, cosmopolitan city, whether you're sipping cocktails in a swanky bar on Albert Dock, shopping for designer clothes at Liverpool One or following in the legendary footsteps of The Beatles. You don't even have to step far from the hotel to find activities. Go for a morning stroll or jog around Sefton Park, or enjoy a drink in one of the bohemian pubs and restaurants of the Lark Lane district. For business travellers to the city, we offer free parking, superfast Wi-Fi and a restful night's sleep in one of our 41 cosy bedrooms. All our rooms have comfortable mattresses, crisp white linen sheets and plump pillows, as well as high-end toiletries and 24-hour room service. Some of our more luxurious rooms boast large Edwardian windows and four-poster beds draped in delicate fabrics. Away from your room, there are several guest lounges and a conservatory restaurant where you can relax and catch up with the day's events.

119168.description:
Wrexham Llyndir Hall Hotel is part of the prestigious Signature Collection by Best Western. The hotel is surrounded by the stunning countryside of Cheshire and the mountains and beaches of North Wales but located only seven miles from Chester. This country house offers gardens, a swimming pool, gym and beauty salon along with intriguing artwork, sculptures, an Italian-style terrace and a 200-year-old oak tree. The lounge bar and restaurant serves tasty, comforting food and there is free car parking and free high speed internet & Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. 

The Roman City of Chester has a huge array of shopping and site seeing. Visit the city walls which are the oldest, longest and most complete in Britain, parts of which are almost 2000 years old. Chester also boasts the fabulous ‘Rows’ – a picturesque, half-timbered gallery of shops, reached by steps, above those at street level and are completely unique in the world to Chester – nobody is quite sure why they were built in this way. Cheshire Oaks Designer Outlet is within easy reach of the hotel and guests receive a 10% discount. 

Visit Chester Zoo for the perfect family day out – Europe’s biggest zoo and the most visited wildlife attraction in the UK - a visit is sure to release the animal in everyone!

For those adventurers among us, Snowdonia national park and Mount Snowdon– the highest mountain in England and Wales, is within easy reach, conquerable with an early start to be back in time for traditional afternoon tea and a celebratory beer.

119434.description: Located in Grächen's quiet center, near public transport, this cozy hotel offers 28 comfortable single and double rooms, including unique tower and 'Alp' rooms featuring hay or Swiss pine mattresses. Built in 1920 and recently renovated, the hotel features a lobby with a safe, currency exchange, and lift access. Amenities include a café, restaurant, bar terrace, sauna, bio sauna, steam room, Kneipp bath, sun terrace, solarium, massage service, and hot tub (some with fees). Free Wi-Fi is available. Enjoy a delicious 5-course dinner (vegetarian options available) in the charming chimney hall, prepared with fresh ingredients.

name.content: Best Western Premier Suites Hotel Spa Liverpool-Kn

119816.description: This 4 star hotel is located within the city of Liverpool and was established in 2000. It is a short drive away from the Safari Park. The Hotel has a restaurant, a bar, an indoor swimming pool and a fitness centre/gym. All 96 suites are equipped with hairdryer, safe, iron, ironing board and trouser press.

119974.description: Hope Street Hotel is an independent 4 star boutique hotel. 149 rooms are divided between Standards, Deluxes, Studios and Suites all with a city chic style. The hotel has two restaurants – The London Carriage Works (TLCW) and 1931. TLCW is an award-winning restaurant with a focus on fresh, seasonal and local produce and 1931 serves delicious hand-stretched pizzas, pasta and sharing boards. Our gorgeous new spa opened in 2021.
