Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7 AM to 10 AM and on weekends from 8 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Aberdeen? This hotel has 366 square feet (34 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Limited parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 80 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions.

130197.description:
Property Malacuna Liverpool, like the Michelin man, has a room for everyone: all types and sizes. 
Malacuna Liverpool property has a room to accommodate all your demands and needs. 
At Malacuna, we’re not big on marathons after a long night out, so we’ve kept our location more central (Mount Pleasant, Liverpool) than the mayor’s house; close to everything, and far enough for a good night’s sleep. With access to public transport just a short walk from our front door (Liverpool Central Station), hitchhiking is better left for another adventure. Restaurants and bars are a stone throw away, literally, so watch out for any glass windows. With a fully equipped communal kitchen, bar, and restaurant for all your meals, 24-hour reception, and outdoor/indoor areas for activities of your choice, finding something that tickles your fancy won’t be a hard thing to reach.

131445.description: Situated just 600 meters from the stunning sandy beach and crystal-clear waters of the Balearic Sea, this aparthotel offers the ideal setting for an unforgettable vacation. Located in the heart of Salou, guests will appreciate the proximity to a wide array of shops, restaurants, bars, and entertainment venues. A bus stop directly in front of the hotel provides convenient transportation, while those arriving by car can utilize the on-site parking garage. The spacious apartments feature two double bedrooms, a separate dining room with a double sofa bed, and a large terrace. Fully equipped kitchens cater to those who prefer self-catering. Two swimming pools—one for adults and one for children—and a tennis court offer recreational opportunities.

131922.description: The Hampton Inn Iowa City/Coralville hotel is located off I-80 in a beautiful residential area. The hotel sits on a hill looking over the city and offers easy access to the highway. We are within minutes of the University of Iowa, Hancher Auditorium, Coral Ridge Mall, Kinnick Stadium and the University of Iowa hospitals and clinics. As with every Hampton Inn, this Iowa City hotel features complimentary amenities such as a breakfast buffet, local calls, high-speed internet access, indoor pool and whirlpool, a copy of USA Today and coffee service in the lobby 24 hours a day. At the Hampton Inn Iowa City, each room is equipped with a full size iron and ironing board, TV with movie channel and high-speed internet access. Laundry/valet services, meeting/banquet facilities and refrigerators are available for a nominal fee. We love having you here in Iowa at the Hampton Inn Iowa City/Coralville hotel!

132502.description: This hotel is conveniently located in the largest business district on the island. Guests will find themselves just a 10 minutes' walking distance away from the International Ferry Terminal. The Nagoya Hills Shopping Centre is situated just a 25 minutes' walking distance from the hotel. The airport is conveniently located just a 25 minutes' driving distance away. This upscale business hotel enjoys an attractive architectural design. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, and are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests are sure to be impressed by the host of business, dining and leisure facilities that this wonderful hotel has to offer.

132504.address: Jalan Duyung Sei Jodoh, Jodoh River, Batu Ampar
132504.description: Relax in 4-star comfort at AP Premier Batam close to the Harbour Bay ferry terminal, only 45 minutes from Singapore. Your modern, airy room gives you and the family the space you need to stretch out. A spa treatment or drinks among the columns of the spacious lobby or in the oriental courtyard gardens are great ways to unwind at AP Premier Batam.

132506.description: Enjoy on-site massages or take advantage of amenities like complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Swiss Cafe, the hotel's restaurant, specializes in international cuisine. Guests can also dine at the coffee shop/cafe or order 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel offers 128 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a refrigerator, LCD TV, and cable programming. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and bidets. Safes, desks, and daily housekeeping are also provided. Conveniently located near the airport, Swiss-Belinn Baloi Batam is a 5-minute walk from Grand Batam Mall and a short drive from Nagoya Hill Mall. The hotel is also close to Harbour Bay Ferry Terminal (3. 8 km) and Batam Centre Ferry Terminal (7. 2 km).

132550.address: Off Lower Gilmore Pl, Lochrin Basin
132550.description:
The boat hotel is tucked away in Edinburgh city centre's Lochrin Basin and accessed via Lower Gilmore Place at Tollcross, making it a superb base for exploring the delights Edinburgh has to offer. The tourist centre is within about 500 m. Edinburgh Airport is situated at a distance of approximately 13 km.

The luxurious boat hotel is berthed in the heart of Edinburgh, just minutes from Princes Street, Edinburgh Castle and the Royal Mile. It is a permanently moored wide-beamed barge measuring 17 m by 3 m, sleeping up to 4 adults and two children comfortably. It offers excellent self-catering holiday accommodation. It was built in 2010 and offers 3 rooms. Guests may hire bicycles on site.

The boat hotel offers two double cabins with a plasma TV with free satellite/cable channels and DVDs as well as a recess with bunk beds and a lounge with a bed-settee and plasma TV. The en suite bathrooms are fitted with a shower and hairdryer, while further standard in-room amenities include a double bed, a radio with a hi-fi, Internet access, an ironing set, individually regulated heating and a terrace. The kitchen is equipped with a fridge, cooker, microwave and tea and coffee making facilities.

Sun loungers have been laid out for use.

From Edinburgh Airport, take the A8 through Corstophine to Haymarket Terrace and follow signs for the city centre. Continue onto Shandwick Place and make a right turn onto Lothian Road. Continue on Lothian road, following signs for the A702. At the top of Lothian Road/Earl Grey Street there is a junction with 3 forks, take the right-hand lane onto Home Street (A702). Once on Home Street, take the right-hand lane and turn right onto Gilmore Place (the King's Theatre will be on the left). Drive on for about 100 metres and Gilmore Place Church will be seen on the left. Take the right-hand turn onto Lower Gilmore Place immediately opposite.

132599.description: Facing the majestic summits of the Dents du Midi, the Hotel Le Cèdre - named after the ancient Lebanon cedar in front of it - is located in the picturesque town of Bex, 11 mi east of Lake Geneva and Montreux. WiFi access and parking are available for free. With the mountains of the Swiss Alps and the shores of Lake Geneva in close proximity, the visitor may choose whatever he likes best: hiking in the mountains, strolling along the lake, or skiing during the winter months. All rooms are equipped with a TV, a safe, and a private bathroom. Some have a private balcony. Bex is known for its fine wines, its historical salt mines, and its fabulous setting. It is located 11 mi east of Lake Geneva and Montreux, in the Chablais Vaudois, next to the A9 motorway, and close to the St Bernard and Simplon railway tunnels. Thus, the Hotel Le Cedre is easy to reach from Italy, France and northern Europe.

132728.description: From the vibrant mural that greets you in the lobby to our 116 beautifully designed en suite bedrooms, we offer a chic London bolthole unlike any other. Whether you're here for sightseeing, business, shopping or just taking a load off, our friendly team will take care of you around the clock. So if you're craving a refreshing nightcap at 11pm or a hot coffee at 6am, our 24-hour people will make sure your every need is met. Our 118 newly-refurbished, fully air-conditioned rooms are bright, minimalist and modern, providing a calm and relaxing environment to unwind after a full day exploring the delights of the city.

132767.description: This charming and welcoming hotel is located in the wonderful city of London, in United Kingdom. The London City Airport is about 50-minute car ride away from the complex. The Paddington Station is conveniently just a couple of steps away. In the surroundings, there are several local and international restaurants offering delicious dishes and great atmospheres. There are also many lovely cafes and bars ideal to spend a nice evening with family or friends. Trendy shops can be also found within walking distance. If travellers prefer, they can have breakfast in the property and then go out and explore the city. The rooms have been decorated with warm colours and are equipped with all the essential amenities to please every visitor and make them have a pleasant stay.

132796.description: Ideally located for exploring Hitchin and Royston to the west, Cambridge to the north, Duxford and Newmarket to the east, and the charming market town of Bishops Stortford and Stansted to the south, this family-friendly country house hotel is approximately 20 minutes from each of these destinations. Nearby attractions include Cambridge (19. 3 km), the Imperial War Museum Duxford (8 km), Newmarket Racecourse (32 km), Saffron Walden (12. 8 km), and Audley End House (19. 3 km). The hotel is also convenient to several airports: London Stansted (28 km), London Luton (30 km), London Heathrow (88 km), and London Gatwick (90 km). Originally built in 1900 with local flint and formerly known as the Coach and Horses Inn, this air-conditioned hotel retains its old-world charm and offers a warm, friendly welcome. Following extensive refurbishment, it now features modern amenities, including a traditional English restaurant, a bar, and ample private parking for 100 cars. The hotel offers 22 guest rooms, a lobby, conference facilities, and internet access. All guest rooms are centrally heated and equipped with an en suite bathroom, a TV, a clock/radio, a trouser press, a hairdryer, and tea and coffee making facilities. Other amenities include a double bed, an ironing set, and direct modem internet access (fees may apply). Guests can enjoy a full English breakfast or a continental breakfast. Set menu and à la carte options are available for lunch and dinner. By car: From the M11, take junction 10 and turn onto the A505 towards Royston. The hotel is approximately 6 km along the A505 on the right-hand side, opposite a Total filling station.

132861.description: Lying just a short distance away from central London, this hotel offers visitors the best of both worlds. Set amidst the tree-lined, tranquil surroundings of Chiswick High Road, the property is within easy walking distance e of Gunnersbury tube station. Kew Bridge Station and Heathrow Airport are also within easy reach. The hotel offers luxurious accommodation options, a high-class leisure centre, well-equipped conference spaces and wonderful banqueting facilities. Offering the ideal choice for every type of traveller, this property ensures an unrivalled level of comfort and convenience, in a superb setting. Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification.

133030.description: Chic and casual, cosy and design, the Chalet RoyAlp Hotel & Spa, member of the Leading Hotels of the World, invites you to enjoy a moment of well-being in an exceptional setting. All year round Chalet RoyAlp is a haven of peace in the heart of the Swiss Alps in the town of Villars-sur-Ollon. Offering a breathtaking panoramic view of the surrounding mountains, the Chalet RoyAlp is the ideal retreat for anyone wishing to relax.

133031.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Bruges and was established in 2009. It is close to the City hall and the market square. The Grand Hotel Casselbergh has a breakfast restaurant, a bar, a conference room, a wellness center and a fitness centre/gym. All 118 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe and air conditioning.

133046.description:
Located in the heart of Coventry city centre, the 4-star Ramada Hotel & Suites by Wyndham Coventry is just a 10-minute walk from Coventry Rail Station. The hotel offers a 24-hour front desk, while the iconic St Michael’s Cathedral is less than a mile away. Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the property. 

Each spacious, air-conditioned en-suite room is designed with a contemporary style and features a 40-inch LED TV, tea and coffee-making facilities, a hairdryer, and ironing amenities. Guests can also enjoy private tiled bathrooms or shower rooms, while rooms on the upper floors offer impressive views across historic Coventry and the Warwickshire countryside. 

The hotel’s Queens Road Restaurant serves freshly prepared dishes, combining distinctive flavours and quality ingredients in a stylish dining setting. 

Ideally positioned for both business and leisure travellers, the hotel is less than 500 metres from Coventry’s ring road, with the M6 motorway reachable within a 10-minute drive. Popular attractions including Coventry Cathedral, Herbert Art Gallery & Museum, and the Belgrade Theatre are all within a short 10-minute walk. The CBS Arena is approximately a 15-minute drive from the hotel, making it a convenient choice for guests attending concerts, exhibitions, and sporting events. 

Public parking is available in the adjoining car park for an additional overnight charge.

133218.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch, dinner, or brunch at The Brasserie, a restaurant which specializes in local cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Stay in one of 64 guestrooms featuring plasma televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and coffee/tea makers.

133224.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch, dinner, or brunch at The Brasserie, a restaurant which specializes in British cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7 AM to 10 AM and on weekends from 8 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Leeds? This hotel has 2217 square feet (206 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 100 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and coffee/tea makers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Canal Wharf - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Briggate - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Corn Exchange - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Trinity Leeds Mall - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Leeds Kirkgate Market - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Leeds City Square - 0. 4 km / 0. 3 mi- Victoria Quarter - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- City Varieties Music Hall - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Leeds Grand Theatre - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Yorkshire Contemporary - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- The Light - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Leeds Park Square - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Leeds Town Hall - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- Leeds Central Library - 1 km / 0. 6 mi- West Yorkshire Playhouse - 1 km / 0. 6 mi. The nearest airports are: Leeds (LBA-Leeds Bradford) - 23. 2 km / 14. 4 mi Doncaster (DSA-Sheffield) - 73. 8 km / 45. 9 mi The preferred airport for Malmaison Leeds is Leeds (LBA-Leeds Bradford).

name.content: Hampton by Hilton Liverpool city centre

133385.description: Hampton by Hilton Liverpool City Centre is a hotel which successfully combines contemporary style with warm, welcoming service. From the way we welcome you at our contemporary Reception to how you enjoy your stay in the air conditioned guestroom we want to take care of you! Why not talk to a member of our friendly team to get the insider's scoop on all the best places to visit in this fabulous city? We have on-site parking available for £22 per day. Located at the new Kings Dock Mill development in the Baltic Triangle, Hampton by Hilton Liverpool City Centre is in a prime location for business and leisure visitors alike. When you stay at Hampton by Hilton Liverpool City Centre you'll be within a few minutes walk of world-famous tourist attractions including the Tate Modern and evocative Beatles Story at Albert Dock. With the BT Convention Centre just minutes from our door, Lime Street Station only 1. 4 miles away and prime business locations nearby our corporate guests are also superbly catered for. A World Heritage Site with a fascinating history, Liverpool is also famed for its rich musical heritage which is one of the main draws for visitors. The city's ongoing love for its favourite sons The Beatles is plain to see and fans from across the globe are spoiled for choice with sights and attractions celebrating the achievements of John, Paul, George and Ringo. Music fans will also be delighted to hear that we're just minutes from Liverpool Echo Arena. Liverpool is of course, also famed for its sport. Football is a passion for city's residents with the two teams, Liverpool Football Club and Everton, having a long-running, good-natured rivalry. The city also plays host to the world's most watched sporting event, the Grand National horse race, held at Haydock Park, located just 19. 1 miles from our hotel.

133399.description: This luxurious country house hotel is situated on the border of Hertfordshire and Essex. The property is ideally located for access to Bishop's Stortford, Harlow and London Stansted Airport. This stunning property is set amidst 110 aces of land, oozing charm and sophistication. Superbly-styled guest rooms have been designed to exude classical elegance and splendour, beautifully echoing the charm of the surroundings. Guests can indulge in an alfresco dining experience, amidst the sophisticated surroundings of the estate. The establishment features a well-equipped fitness centre, as well as tennis courts, an opulent lounge, a cocktail bar and a restaurant. A fully-functional conference centre is available for the convenience of discerning business travellers. Pets are allowed. Charges may be applicable.

name.content: Inhabit Queen's Gardens, a Member of Design Hotels

133482.description: This hotel is in the idyllic corner of Queens Garden at Paddington, offering the perfect calm and serenity while still being in the heart of all the buzz of the capital. This prime location is less than 5 minutes from Paddington whilst being surrounded by all the excitement of London's West End. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, a restaurant, Wi-Fi in public areas and room service.

133483.description: Located in the heart of London, The Villa Kensington is within a 15-minute walk of the Natural History Museum and Kensington High Street. This hotel offers 38 air-conditioned guest rooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, digital programming, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads. Enjoy convenient amenities such as express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and a continental breakfast available daily (for a fee). Nearby attractions include Imperial College London and Kensington Gardens. The closest airport is London City Airport (LCY).

133485.description: Located on the north bank of the Thames, residential Hammersmith retains a bustling, city-centre feel with high-street shops and offices. The area is best known for Stamford Bridge, the home stadium of football team Chelsea FC. There is an underground station within a 10-minute walk. The airports of Heathrow (about 21 km), Luton (43 km), Gatwick (58 km) and Stansted (78 km) are all nearby. This is an ideal choice for both business and tourist travellers. The hotel features 13 guest rooms located on three floors. There is also a conference room and complimentary wireless Internet access in the public areas. The reception in the lobby is open 24 hours a day. All rooms have standard décor, television, complimentary wireless Internet access, and complimentary toiletries. These rooms have shared bathroom facilities. The hotel serves a continental breakfast.

133487.description: This London hotel places you in the heart of the city, within a 10-minute walk of Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. The Astoria Hotel offers 12 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions and complimentary wireless internet access. Each room includes a private bathroom with a shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hair dryer. Additional conveniences such as electric kettles and daily housekeeping are also provided, and cribs/infant beds are available upon request. On-site amenities include multilingual staff, luggage storage, and coffee/tea in a common area. Self-parking is available for a fee. Nearby attractions include Marble Arch (0. 7 mi) and Oxford Street (1. 2 mi). Heathrow Airport (LHR) is the preferred airport for the hotel.

133500.description: This friendly, family-run hotel, housed in a restored, historically listed Victorian building, is just a two-minute walk from bustling Marble Arch. With its convenient access to the Underground, train stations, Hyde Park, and world-class shopping on Oxford Street, the hotel is ideally situated for exploring London. All major city attractions are within easy reach. Nearby airports include Heathrow (approximately 30 km), Luton and Stansted (both around 50 km), and Gatwick (roughly 60 km). Recently refurbished rooms feature direct-dial telephones, satellite TV, refrigerators, central heating, hairdryers, fans, and tea and coffee making facilities. The hotel offers late check-in for a fee, upon request. Please note: cribs/cots are not available, and children under 12 are not permitted.

133501.description: Enjoy a central London stay at the Corbigoe Hotel, conveniently located within a 5-minute drive of Buckingham Palace and Hyde Park. This hotel offers 22 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs and digital programming. Stay connected with Wi-Fi (surcharge). Each room includes a coffee/tea maker and a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Hotel amenities include a 24-hour front desk, express check-in, luggage storage, and tour/ticket assistance. Victoria Station is a short walk away (0. 6 mi).

133502.description: Conveniently located in Victoria, this hotel enjoys close proximity to the nearby station. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the wealth of intriguing attractions that this mesmerising city has to offer. Major links to the public transport network can be found nearby. Perfect for business and leisure trips alike, this property offers a high level of comfort and convenience. The guest rooms are comfortable, tastefully designed and well equipped with modern amenities. Offering friendly staff, excellent service and an ideal location, this hotel is a great choice for any type of visit to London.

133505.description: The hotel is placed in one of the most convenient locations in the Victoria and Westminster neighbourhood. This area features a large amount of attractions and tourist sites, such as the Westminster Abbey, Houses of Parliament, London Eye, Buckingham Palace, and the Tate Britain. London Heathrow Airport is around 22 km from the hotel, London Gatwick some 36 km, whilst London Luton and London Stansted airports are situated at a distance of approximately 46 km and 51 km, respectively. This traditional, clean and comfortable bed and breakfast hotel in Victoria, Central London is an ideal choice for travellers looking for competitive and moderately priced accommodation within easy reach of all London has to offer. Comprising a total of 21 rooms, the hotel offers a 24-hour reception and a breakfast room. The hotel features clean, comfortable and traditional guestrooms with or without en suite facilities depending on guests' needs and budgets. A direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV and tea and coffee making facilities come in the rooms as standard. Breakfast is served each morning. By train, from Heathrow Airport: take the Piccadilly Line to Earl's Court and once there interchange to the District Line towards Westminster/Upminster and get off at Victoria Station. The hotel is within walking distance of the station. It is also accessible from Gatwick Airport by trains which run directly to Victoria Station.

133506.description: The Seymour Hotel & Annex is situated in one of London's most popular tourist locations. It is a small and friendly place to stay on your visit to London. Only a few minutes walking distance from Hyde Park, and with Paddington, Lancaster Gate and Edgware Road Stations all being close by, visitors are never far from any of the great tourist sites of Central London. All 19 bedrooms have full en-suite facilities, direct-dial, telephone, satellite television and hair dryers.

133518.description: Strategically located only 5 minutes from the Victoria coach and train stations, all major sights, shops, restaurants, and theatres are within either walking distance or reachable within a few minutes using public transport. London Heathrow Airport is situated approximately 22 km away and London Gatwick is some 36 km away, whilst London Luton Airport and London Stansted Airport are roughly 46 km and 51 km away, respectively. This family-run hotel offers comfortable, good value bed and breakfast accommodation in London's fashionable district of Pimlico. Comprising a total of 18 rooms, the hotel features a 24-hour reception and a breakfast room. All well-furnished en suite rooms have an LCD flat-screen Freeview TV, complimentary high-speed Internet access, a direct dial telephone and tea and coffee making facilities. The en suite bathrooms are fitted with a shower and hairdryer. A continental breakfast is served each morning.

133519.description: Located in London's City Centre, the Gresham Hotel is a short walk from Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. This hotel offers 56 guestrooms and amenities such as a 24-hour front desk and an elevator. A complimentary breakfast is included. Nearby attractions include Marble Arch (1. 2 km) and Paddington Central (0. 8 km). The closest airport is Heathrow (LHR).

133520.description:
The hotel is situated at Marble Arch in the heart of London's West End, only a few minutes' walk from Oxford Street and Hyde Park. Bus and underground transport links are located virtually at the door, making it easy to access all major airports and intercity rail terminals. London Heathrow Airport is some 21 km away, Gatwick Airport is around 39 km away, Luton Airport is about 43 km away and it is roughly 50 km to Stansted Airport.

The hotel's cosy atmosphere and a warm welcome provide an ideal starting point for a holiday. Whether guests are looking for a comfortable guest room or a well-equipped self-contained apartment, this hotel has the perfect accommodation on offer. Being a small establishment, with just 11 rooms in total, the friendly staff have time to offer advice and assistance to make every guest's stay as enjoyable as possible. The hotel reception is open around the clock.

All of the clean and comfortable rooms have an en suite bathroom and are fully equipped with a radio, TV, telephone, tea and coffee making facilities, a safe, minibar, hairdryer and ironing set, ensuring a pleasant and enjoyable stay.

133525.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at Hyde Park Court Hotel, including complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a reception hall. Continental breakfast is available daily for a fee. The hotel also offers express check-out, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Relax in one of the 21 comfortable guestrooms, each featuring a pillowtop bed, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers. Located in the heart of London, Hyde Park Court Hotel is a short walk from Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens, and conveniently close to Marble Arch and Oxford Street. Nearby attractions include Paddington Central, Baker Street, Madame Tussauds Wax Museum, and the Sherlock Holmes Museum.

133527.description: This modern hotel on London's Upper Berkeley Street places you near various attractions, shopping, dining, and entertainment. Conveniently located near public transport, it offers easy access to the bustling city center. The charming property features stylish guest rooms equipped with modern amenities. With warm hospitality and high-quality service, it's an excellent choice for both business and leisure travelers.

133528.description: Ideally located at the heart of London, this hotel is just a few minutes' walking distance from the Heathrow Express terminal at Paddington Station. World-famous attractions can be found nearby, including Oxford Street, Regent Street, Knightsbridge, Hyde Park and the West End theatres. Buckingham Palace, Trafalgar Square and many museums are also within easy reach. This property offers tastefully-decorated guest rooms, which are fully fitted with modern amenities. Guests can enjoy a hearty breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to explore the city. This property offers a high level of service, complemented by warm hospitality and an inviting ambiance.

133597.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and convenient tour/ticket assistance at The Park Hotel, located in London's city center. The hotel's 18 guestrooms offer comfortable accommodations with rainfall showers and work desks. Housekeeping is provided daily. You'll be within a 5-minute drive of Westminster Abbey and Buckingham Palace, and a short walk from Victoria Station. Nearby attractions include Big Ben, St. James Park, and Hyde Park.

133686.description: Situated near Olympia, Westfield, BBC studios, and Shepherd's Bush Empire, this cozy hotel offers convenient access to transport links, placing Hyde Park, Notting Hill, and central London within easy reach. Heathrow Airport is 20 km away. This 11-room city hotel in Hammersmith provides a bustling atmosphere amidst shops and offices. Guests enjoy a 24-hour reception, breakfast room, and Wi-Fi. Rooms feature amenities like TVs, Wi-Fi, and telephones, with shared bathrooms. A continental breakfast is served daily.

133689.description: Located in fashionable South Kensington, St Simeon offers cooked breakfast in the mornings, a self-catering communal kitchen, and free WiFi in public areas. Less than 10 minutes' walk from central London's famous museums, it is also just a 5-minute walk from both Earl's Court and Gloucester Road Tube Stations. With period-style decor, each budget room includes a flat-screen TV, tea/coffee making facilities in central kitchen, and an en-suite bath or shower room. Hairdryers are available upon request. St Simeon offers a communal kitchen for guests along with a dining area and a TV room. Reception closes at 1. 00am. There are numerous bars and restaurants within 10 minutes’ walk of the building. In London's affluent Kensington and Chelsea district, St Simeon is just 20 minutes' walk from the world-famous Harrods Department Store. Home to the historic Houses of Parliament and Big Ben, iconic Westminster can be reached after a 20-minute journey on the District or Circle Tube Lines. Public car parks and on-street metered parking is available just 5 minutes' walk away.

133843.description: With a total of 5 accomodation units, this is a nice place to stay. Those staying at this hotel may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception. Additional fees may apply for some services.

133844.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Grab a bite to eat at the hotel's restaurant, which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 5 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 50 guestrooms featuring DVD players. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have shower/tub combinations and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Mountfitchet Castle - 4. 9 km / 3 mi- House on the Hill Toy Museum - 4. 9 km / 3 mi- Whoosh Explore - 6. 4 km / 4 mi- Flitch Way Country Park - 6. 4 km / 4 mi- Hatfield Forest Country Park - 6. 8 km / 4.

133845.description: This hotel is located only 5 minutes from Victoria coach and train stations. All major sights, shops, restaurants, and theatres are either within walking distance or reachable in a few minutes using public transport. The hotel is situated on a quiet residential street, with no traffic noise. It is around 1. 8 km to Buckingham Palace, some 2 km to Westminster and the tourist centre, about 2. 5 km to Hyde Park, roughly 2. 9 km to Piccadilly Circus and around 6 km to Notting Hill. Heathrow Airport is approximately 26 km away. A warm welcome awaits guests at this city hotel. It comprises a total of 10 rooms spread over 6 floors and has discrete and attentive staff who take the utmost care to retain the traditions of hospitality and superior service at this establishment. Facilities on offer to guests include a 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, a breakfast room and wireless Internet access. All rooms come with a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer. They are equipped with satellite/cable TV, Internet access and tea and coffee making facilities. Furthermore, an ironing set and central heating are provided in all accommodation as standard.

133848.description: Enjoy a complimentary breakfast at the Staunton Hotel, located in London's City Centre, a short walk from Russell Square and Tottenham Court Road. This hotel offers 17 guestrooms, a 24-hour front desk, computer station, and multilingual staff. You'll be within a 5-minute walk of University College London and just a short distance from attractions like the British Museum and Covent Garden Market. The nearest airport is London City Airport (LCY), and Heathrow Airport (LHR) is also easily accessible.

133852.description: Enjoy a central London stay at the Opulence Boutique Hotel, located within a 10-minute walk of Marble Arch and Hyde Park. This boutique guesthouse offers 19 comfortable guestrooms equipped with refrigerators, LCD TVs, and satellite programming. Wireless internet access is available for a surcharge. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and bidets. Additional conveniences include desks, coffee/tea makers, and daily housekeeping. The hotel also provides dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk with multilingual staff. You'll be just a short stroll from Oxford Street and Madame Tussauds Wax Museum, putting the best of London at your doorstep.

133853.description: Situated in the heart of Golders Green, this city hotel is set in a very quiet location, only a short walk away from the local shops and restaurants and Golders Green metro station. Golders Hill Park is a 5-minute drive away and nearby airports include London Heathrow (21 km away), London Luton (36 km away), London Gatwick (45 km away) and London Stansted (46 km away). This well-established bed and breakfast hotel offers 23 rooms to suit almost everyone. Breakfast is served in the breakfast room. The hotel offers comfortable rooms to suit almost everyone, with a mixture of singles, twins, doubles and triples. All rooms are fully equipped with a TV, tea/coffee making facilities and a direct dial telephone.

133854.description: Enjoying a great location on London, this bed and breakfast is situated in the district of Tufnell Park. The property is located within easy walking distance of the area's underground station. Local attractions include Hampstead Heath and Camden Market. Central London, with its treasure trove of intriguing attractions, is just a 10 minutes' underground ride away. This charming property occupies an elegant Edwardian house, which was built towards the end of the 19th century. The guest rooms echo the character and charm of the building, featuring soothing tones and fine furnishings. Guests are invited to enjoy a superb breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to explore this vibrant city.

133856.description: This unique new central London hostel is housed in a Victorian listed building that has received a substantial refurbishment to restore it to its original condition. It offers travellers all the facilities expected from the very best hostels in London at an ideal location. Sitting near Swiss Cottage and Finchley Road tube stations it allows them to get to the heart of the city within minutes. Regent's Park is around 1. 5 km away, while Camden Town is roughly 2. 9 km and the downtown area is just a 10-minute ride away. At the venue they can relax in the TV lounge with the free Wii console or a game of pool. Those who want to try a proper British pint can visit the onsite bar. Couples can share a double bed, which comes equipped with privacy curtains, their own lights and power sockets

133861.description:
Apolo Suites is a complex of modern and elegant suites located between Salou and La Pineda, designed to offer its guests a comfortable and pleasant stay on the Costa Dorada. Enjoying a privileged location, just steps from the beach, surrounded by a historical site from the Greek era that can be visited, opposite the coastal path, and close to the area's main attractions such as the Aquopolis water park and Port Aventura amusement park, Apolo Suites combines contemporary design, comfort, and high-quality services to ensure the best experience for all visitors. 

Spacious and bright suites with fully equipped kitchens and private terraces, ideal for families and couples. They feature an adult pool, a children's pool, a sun terrace with a chill-out area, and a bar. Located on the seafront, a 4-minute walk from La Pineda Beach, in a quiet area close to viewpoints with spectacular views.

133867.description: The Somerset Hotel is located in London City Centre, a neighbourhood in London. Buckingham Palace and The British Museum are notable landmarks, and some of the area's popular attractions include London Eye and Natural History Museum. Looking to enjoy an event or a game? See what's going on at Wembley Stadium or O2 Arena. Take the opportunity to explore the area for outdoor excitement like cycling. 3-star hotel near Oxford StreetNear Madame Tussauds Wax Museum, The Somerset Hotel provides everything you need. Stay connected with free WiFi in public areas. You'll also enjoy the following perks during your stay:Self-parking (surcharge), smoke-free property and luggage storageA 24-hour front desk. Note-Late check-in will carry an extra fee of £10 per hour between 00:00-02:00, then £20 per hour for 02:00 onwards. Guests will have to pay £100 refundable security deposit at check-in.

133868.description: Enjoy convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and wedding services at the Ravna Gora Hotel in London's Kensington district. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge after exploring nearby attractions like Portobello Road Market (a 15-minute walk) and Kensington Gardens. A computer station, 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff are available for your assistance. Self-parking is available for a fee, and breakfast can be added to your stay. The hotel offers 23 comfortable guestrooms. Westfield London Shopping Centre and Kensington High Street are within a short distance, and Heathrow Airport is easily accessible.

133869.description: Situated just 6 km away from London Heathrow Airport, this property boasts a convenient setting in London. Twickenham Rugby Stadium is just a short driving distance away. This property sits just a short walk away from Hounslow West London Underground Station, offering ease of access to the bustling centre of the city, where a wealth of attractions can be found. A number of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities are located in the area. This charming property ensures a warm welcome and a peaceful setting in which to unwind. The tastefully-designed guest rooms offer a comfortable space in which to work or rest. The lodge offers a superb breakfast in the mornings, for a hearty start to the day.

133871.description: Located in London's Kensal Green neighborhood, Kensal Green Backpackers 1 is a convenient base for exploring the city. Westfield London Shopping Centre and Wembley Stadium are within a 10-minute drive. This hostel offers 103 guestrooms, a shared kitchen for preparing meals, and both complimentary Wi-Fi and paid Wi-Fi options. Guests can enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant for lunch and dinner, a coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service. Additional amenities include a bar/lounge, an arcade/game room, a communal TV area, and a 24-hour front desk. Nearby attractions include Hyde Park, Royal Albert Hall, and Portobello Road Market. Buffet breakfast is available daily (for a fee. )

133873.description:
This hotel enjoys an ideal location, just a short walk from Paddington Station and some 4 minutes' walk from Edgware Road station. It offers easy access to London's major tourist attractions such as Madame Tussaud's, Buckingham Palace and Kensington Palace. Hyde Park and Oxford Street are around 10 minutes' and 15 minutes' walk away respectively.

This city hotel comprises a total of 35 rooms over 5 floors. Facilities on offer to guests include a 24-hour reception and reservations service, a breakfast room and wireless Internet access on all floors. Parking is available on the premises (for an additional fee).

All rooms are comfortable and come with a private bathroom with a shower. They are equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, Internet access and a fridge as well as tea and coffee making facilities.

Guests are served a continental breakfast each morning.

Edgware Road is the nearest tube station and is served by the Circle, District and Hammersmith and City lines.

134360.description: This hotel is situated on the beachfront of the Costa Dorada. It consists of a total of 39 rooms. Guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service. Facilities in this air-conditioned establishment include a chill-out zone, a games room and a TV lounge. There is a children's playground, a car park and bicycle hire. Guests can also wine and dine in the restaurant, café and bar.   All rooms come with two beds, a phone and a TV.    Minibar and safe are also provided. Each unit is en suite with a shower, bath and a hairdryer. Further in-room amenities include a radio, Internet access, air conditioning and heating. There are sun loungers with parasols laid out at the hotel and on the beach. The hotel serves a breakfast buffet, whilst both lunch and dinner is served à la carte and from a set menu.

134403.description: This spring, experience the epitome of hospitality at our esteemed Crowne Plaza Hotel positioned near Dublin's vibrant city centre. With 188 inviting rooms boasting spacious bathrooms, walk-in showers, large bathtubs, and amenities, we guarantee an unmatched stay for every guest. Savour culinary delights at Forchetta Restaurant, offering European contemporary cuisine to tantalize your taste buds. Retreat to Sanctuary Bar for a moment of relaxation and enjoy handcrafted beverages in a sophisticated ambiance. Host your conference, business meeting, or event in our Heather Suite or any of our thirteen meeting rooms, all equipped with the latest technology and complimentary Wi-Fi, including private boardrooms and a conference centre for 600 guests. Conveniently located just 15 minutes from Dublin Airport, our award-winning Crowne Plaza® Dublin - Blanchardstown hotel offers easy access to Dublin City Centre and major companies like Liberty Insurance, IBM, and eBay, making it ideal for business travellers. For wellness enthusiasts, our gym and sauna provide rejuvenating experiences to nurture both body and mind. Enjoy inclusive Wi-Fi and indoor parking for a daily fee during your stay with us. Embark on adventures to top attractions such as Blanchardstown Shopping Centre, Phoenix Park, Tayto Park, and Dublin City Centre.

name.content: Holiday Inn Leeds Wakefield M1 J40

134472.description: Welcome to Holiday Inn Leeds Wakefield! We’re delighted to have you with us. Whether you're here for business or leisure, our dedicated team is here to ensure your stay is comfortable and enjoyable. Explore the vibrant city of Leeds or unwind in the serene surroundings of Wakefield, knowing that a warm, relaxing atmosphere awaits you at the end of the day. If there’s anything we can do to make your stay even better, please don’t hesitate to ask.

134577.description: Indulge in onsite massages and body treatments at Hotel & Restaurant Cal Llop, located in Gratallops by the sea. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services, and dine at the onsite restaurant or coffee shop. Room service is also available. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Local cuisine breakfasts are offered daily (for a fee). The hotel features express check-in/check-out, multilingual staff, and a 24-hour airport shuttle (surcharge). Free self-parking is available. Each of the 10 guestrooms features a flat-screen TV, complimentary Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a bidet, a safe, a desk, and daily housekeeping. Hotel & Restaurant Cal Llop is within a 15-minute drive of Celler Sabate and the Church of Saint Mary, and conveniently located near Buil and Gine Winery (1. 2 mi), Bodega Família Torres (2. 6 mi) and Gratavinum Winery (3. 3 mi). The nearest airports are Reus (REU) and Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN).

134631.description: This city hotel, just 10 meters from Ponent Beach and adjacent to the marina, offers a prime location. Situated 200 meters from Salou's center, guests enjoy easy access to numerous bars, restaurants, shops, and the bus station. Reus and Tarragona are approximately 11. 3 km and 12. 4 km away, respectively, while Barcelona-El Prat De Llobregat Airport and Reus Airport are 85 km and 11 km away. The air-conditioned hotel features 65 rooms, a 24-hour reception, a safe, and lift access. Amenities include a garage, à la carte restaurant, cafe, TV lounge, bar, children's playground, gardens, conference facilities, Wi-Fi, and laundry service. Each room includes an en suite bathroom with a bathtub and hairdryer, a double or king-size bed, and a terrace with sea views. Additional amenities include satellite TV, air conditioning, central heating, a telephone, music system, safe, minibar, and internet access. Guests can enjoy the outdoor swimming pool with a children's area and a poolside snack bar (fees apply), complete with sun loungers. Massage services and beach volleyball are also available. Nearby, Ponent Beach offers a variety of water sports (fees apply), including waterskiing, diving, surfing, windsurfing, motor boating, banana boating, sailing, catamaran boating, canoeing, and pedal boating. Port Aventura Golf Club is approximately 3. 9 km from the hotel (fees apply). The hotel offers breakfast, lunch, and dinner buffets, with lunch and dinner also available à la carte.

134667.description:
This modern hotel is a convenient accommodation option when visiting this multi-cultural and interesting city either for business or leisure. The property is situated on the Aston University Campus within easy reach from the city centre. In a 5-minute stroll, visitors may reach a wide entertainment and shopping offer, including the famous Bullring shopping centre. The stylish guest rooms are tastefully decorated with all of the expected comforts. Business travellers may also appreciate the meeting facilities available as well as the complimentary WIFI access. Guests may enjoy the delicious on-site restaurant and bar, with a choice of menus available; guests may enjoy a la carte restaurant from Sunday to Thursday, with lighter bar menus available Friday and Saturday. Room Service and Takeaway Delivery services are also available. Guests may relax at the nearby sports centre a short two-minute walk from the hotel with a Victorian indoor heated swimming pool and large gym. Pool requires pre-booking and is subject to availability. Pool and Gym are closed all bank holidays, Christmas week, New Year, Easter Tuesday and August Bank Holiday Monday and Tuesday. 
Undercover parking parking is a two minute walk from the hotel and must be pre-booked online via the hotel website. Guest code of conduct: http://www. conferenceaston. co. uk/cacodeofconduct

name.content: Premier Inn Belfast City Cathedral Quarter

135129.description: The Cathedral Quarter was traditionally the home of Belfast's trade associations and warehouses, and still has some of the city's oldest buildings. But a stay at Premier Inn Hotel Belfast Cathedral Quarter puts some distinctly twenty-first century attractions on your doorstep. Come in August and hear some of the latest sounds and bands at the Belsonic Festival. Or December, for a Christmas market that pulls out all the stops. Or in September, for all the fun of over 250 events during Culture Night. Or visit any time of year for world class shopping and fascinating visitor attractions. Then come back to the hotel for mouth-watering food and a lovely comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

name.content: Premier Inn Belfast City Centre Alfred St

135130.description: Welcome to the city that inspired Gulliver's Travels. A stay at Premier Inn Hotel Belfast Alfred Street puts you just a small step away from some big attractions, not to mention all the delights of a twenty-first century shopping centre. And if you're here on business, we'll make sure your stay is a pleasant one. Track down the Titanic story to its source. Or make tracks to some of the biggest names on the high street - don't miss the continental market if you're here over Christmas. There's nightlife that'll make your day, and everything from an interactive science museum to a candy factory. Don't fill up on too many sweets though, there's good food waiting for you at our restaurant, and comfy beds in every room. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

135153.description:
The hotel is located in a quiet cul-de-sac in the heart of Knightsbridge, an exclusive and fashionable address. London's finest museums, Hyde Park and its most exclusive shops are all within a 5-minute walk, and the hotel is next door to Harrods and Harvey Nichols. Links to the public transport are within around 200 m and the bus and railway stations are roughly 3 km from the hotel. The Knightsbridge tube station can be reached in some 5 minutes on foot. The hotel is situated at a mere 15 km from London City Airport, whilst London Heathrow Airport and Gatwick Airport are approximately 40 km and 70 km away respectively. London Luton and Stansted Airports are both about 100 km from the residence.

The elegant award-winning Victorian boutique townhouse features stylish decor, with fine fabrics, original art and handpicked antique furniture. The hotel was built in 1880 and comprises a total of 28 guest rooms. With warm and personable service that cannot be matched, guests feel more like friends when they stay at this hotel. The air-conditioned property welcomes guests in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service. Facilities on offer to guests include a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, a cloakroom, lift access and a newspaper stand. Meals may be taken in the breakfast/dining room. In addition, WLAN Internet access, 24-hour room service, a laundry service and a car park (for a fee) are at guests' disposal.

135260.description:
Modern, understated and right beside the 3 Arena, the gibson hotel captures the essence of Dublin city. The hotel takes inspiration from its central location in the docklands area and provides the ultimate urban retreat for music lovers, art junkies and food fanatics. The rooms are designed with soothing colours and textures and include a host of amenities, such as free wifi, flat-screen TV, luxurious beds, workstation, laptop safe, and tea and coffee making facilities. 

Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification.

Hotel has been accredited by Green Tourism, a certification program that provides a framework to achieve a sustainable business in the tourism industry.

135575.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at Motel Six in Whangarei's Regent neighborhood, a short walk from the Claphams Clock Museum and Tuatara Gallery. This motel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, free self-parking, and convenient amenities like laundry services and luggage storage. Each of the 14 guestrooms features a refrigerator, microwave, private bathroom with rainfall showerhead, and complimentary toiletries. Guests can also enjoy the convenience of a desk and electric kettle. The Old Library Arts Centre and Pou are less than a kilometer away.

135621.description: Centrally located in Liverpool, 62 Castle Street Hotel offers 20 comfortable guestrooms featuring Select Comfort beds, minibars, complimentary Wi-Fi, and digital programming. Enjoy cooked-to-order breakfast available for a fee (7:00 AM - 10:00 AM). The hotel is just steps from Liverpool ONE shopping center and an 8-minute walk from the Royal Albert Dock. Nearby attractions include the Cavern Club (0. 2 km) and Liverpool Pier Head Ferry Terminal (0. 6 km). Bathrobes and hair dryers are provided in each bathroom. The front desk operates on limited hours.

135764.description: Enjoy a stay at the luxurious Lodge Bordeaux guesthouse, located in Whangarei's Avenues, just a short walk from the Quarry Arts Centre and Botanica & Cafler Park. The guesthouse offers a seasonal outdoor pool, bicycle rentals, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Room service is available during limited hours, and cooked-to-order breakfasts are served for a fee. Each of the 15 individually decorated guestrooms features a kitchen with a stovetop and microwave, a 49-inch LED TV, and a minibar. Additional amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services and free self-parking.

135790.description: Located just a short stroll from the Paihia waterfront for local shopping, cafes bars and restaurants and just 10 minutes from the Paihia Wharf for boat and fishing excursions. Executive studio and two bedroom units have in room SKY Digital TV, DVD, phone, high speed internet and a kitchenette with microwave, hot plate and tea/coffee making facilities.

135830.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 9:30 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 85 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have showers and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Grosvenor Museum - 0. 3 km / 0.

135844.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a terrace. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, an arcade/game room, and tour/ticket assistance. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, express check-in, and express check-out. Make yourself at home in one of the 28 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Statue of Hans Memling - 0. 2 km / 0.

135865.description: This charming resort is located just a 5 minutes' walk from Paihia town centre and a short stroll from golden sands and the shimmering, azure sea in the Bay of Islands. This idyllic setting affords guests the opportunity to explore the nearby attractions which include The Kauri Museum, Wenderholm, Regional Park, Waipu Caves and the McClelland Galleries.Guests are greeted by a relaxing, calming resort which sits unassumingly in its beachfront location amidst lush greenery. The guest rooms feature a simplistic style in earthy tones reflective of the natural surroundings. The resort provides superb facilities to meet the individual conference, leisure and dining needs of guests. Guests are invited to wine and dine in the calming surrounds of the restaurant, where they can savour the culinary delights the menu has to offer.

135879.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Wengen and was established in 1898. It is 20.0 Km from the Männlichen and the nearest station is Wengen. The Hotel has a restaurant, an indoor swimming pool, an outdoor swimming pool and a fitness centre/gym. All 40 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe and ironing set.

name.content: Grand Hotel Belvedere – a Beaumier Hotel and Spa

135880.description:
The 5-star Grand Hotel Belvedere in car-free Wengen welcomes individual travelers, couples, and families alike, offering a unique experience in the heart of the Swiss Alps. Every architectural detail is crafted in the classic Alpine style, emphasizing the artisanal heritage of the Bernese Oberland. The 90 rooms and suites (starting at 22m²) are a successful blend of urban flair and cozy atmosphere, featuring amenities such as a in room bar, hairdryer, safe, and TV. 

The hotel's wellness and spa area offers a variety of treatments for the relaxation of body and mind. Enjoy the warmth in one of the saunas or take a dip in the indoor and outdoor pools to experience a restful retreat. Our two restaurants, Brasserie Belvedere and Restaurant Waldrand, combine the best of Swiss cuisine with modern accents, creating new culinary classics. Let yourself be enchanted by the culinary creations of the Grand Hotel Belvedere. 

The Grand Hotel Belvedere enjoys a prime location in Wengen, just a 5-minute walk from the village center and the lifts to the ski and hiking area. Thanks to its hillside location, the hotel offers a breathtaking, unobstructed view of the Lauterbrunnen Valley and the Jungfrau.

135923.description: Set in a prime location of Bay of Islands, Blue Pacific Quality Apartments puts everything the city has to offer just outside your doorstep. The property features a wide range of facilities to make your stay a pleasant experience. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, facilities for disabled guests, express check-in/check-out, luggage storage, Wi-Fi in public areas are there for guest's enjoyment. Comfortable guestrooms ensure a good night's sleep with some rooms featuring facilities such as television LCD/plasma screen, internet access – wireless, internet access – wireless (complimentary), whirlpool bathtub, non smoking rooms. To enhance guests' stay, the hotel offers recreational facilities such as golf course (within 3 km), spa, garden. Blue Pacific Quality Apartments is an excellent choice from which to explore Bay of Islands or to simply relax and rejuvenate.

135968.description:
The Crans Ambassador, Luxury Sport Resort, immerses you in the heart of the Swiss Alps. As soon as guests step into the hotel, a 180° view of Europe's highest, most stunning peaks takes their breath away.

The Crans Ambassador is a privileged haven of serenity in a cosy, timeless setting.
Combining luxury, friendliness, vibrancy and performance, the hotel welcomes guests in search of wellness year round.

Guests at the Crans Ambassador can take advantage of its 17-meter pool heated to 29°C all year round. Afterwards, why not unwind in the hotel's hot tub, followed by relaxing moments in the dry heat of the sauna or humid heat of the hammam.

Our spa is dedicated to the devotees of sport and wellbeing. Occupying 1300 m2 and centered on a 17 m indoor pool, the spa benefits from latest-generation keep-fit and gym equipment, as well as spaces devoted to relaxation.

135990.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an indoor pool or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and a picnic area. Satisfy your appetite for dinner at the hotel's restaurant, Courtyard Restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and 8 meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 62 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and coffee/tea makers.

135992.description:
Surrounded by 8 hectares of tranquil parkland, the conference hotel offers a delightful blend of modern comforts and traditional charm. Didcot Parkway train station is approximately 5 km from the hotel and Oxford is around a 20-minute drive away. London Heathrow airport and London Luton airport are approximately 96 km and 129 km from the hotel, respectively.

This enchanting Georgian manor house has been sympathetically extended over the years. Guests may enjoy a drink in the hotel bar and dine in the on-site restaurant. There are 115 guest rooms in total. A laundry service is also provided.

The en suite rooms feature free high-speed Internet access, an LCD TV with Sky channels, a direct dial telephone, and tea and coffee making facilities.

There is an indoor swimming pool, mini gym, spa with sauna and steam room, a football pitch, croquet lawn, volleyball court and table football on the premises (fees may apply).

A breakfast buffet is served each morning and guests may select their dinner from a set menu.

By car: exit the M4 at Junction 13, take the A34 to Oxford. After 14 km take the A4185 to Wantage. Go straight over the first and second roundabout. Just after the Packhorse Public House take the left turn (shared entrance with Milton Business and Technology Centre). Take the first left turn into the main drive for Milton Hill House Training Centre. Follow this drive all the way to the main house.

136000.description:
This hotel is located 5.1 km from Crewe, a short distance from Junction 16 of the M6 motorway, and has fast rail links to Manchester, Birmingham and London. It is 76 km to Liverpool Airport and Birmingham International Airport is 106 km away.

This conference hotel offers light and airy accommodation with a vibrant atmosphere, all packaged in contemporary style. It comprises a total of 108 rooms and is surrounded by a beautiful PGA European-tour standard golf course with wonderful undulating views of the Cheshire countryside; enough to keep even the most traditional golfer beaming with pleasure. Facilities on offer to guests include a bar, a restaurant and wireless Internet access.

All rooms come with an en suite bathroom and are equipped with a direct dial telephone, a TV with Sky channels, free high-speed Internet access and a hospitality tray with tea and coffee making facilities.

This hotel features a mini gym and golf fans have plenty to keep them busy, including an 18-hole championship course, a driving range, a pro shop and a putting green. Guests can also enjoy the health and beauty salon (fees may apply).

Guests may select their breakfast from a buffet and the evening meal may be enjoyed as a set menu.

Guests arriving by car from the M6 Junction 16, should take the A500 toward Nantwich. At the roundabout, take the A531 towards Keele and Nantwich. At the next roundabout turn left on to the A531 towards Keele. The hotel is on the right-hand side and the entrance to the property is at the right-hand exit off the next roundabout.

136225.description:
The complex is located in the centre of Salou on the Costa Dorada, only 900 m from the sandy beaches. Located in a quiet area near to many restaurants, a 10-minute walk leads guests to the shops, bars and nightlife. Guests with their own car can pay a visit to the famous Universal Studios Port Aventura theme park, which is the second largest in Europe and less than 10 km from the holiday village. Nearby guests will find Roman ruins and ancient monasteries as well as national parks and vineyards. Salou is a prestigious resort, which offers superb dining, shopping, nightlife, attractions for children, and many other excellent facilities. The train station is a 10-minute walk and the city of Tarragona is roughly 20 minutes by car. Reus airport is approximately 17 km from the complex and Barcelona-El Prat de Llobregat is around 100 km away.

Renovated in 2009, this resort features two buildings housing the 60 fully furnished apartments. An elegant reception area welcomes guests into the hotel and further facilities include a hotel safe, lift access, a children's playground, laundry service and a car park. The resort is ideal for a family holiday.

Each apartment features a dining room with a lounge and sofa area, a kitchen with a fridge, cooker, microwave, crockery, utensils and tea and coffee making facilities, a bedroom with a double bed and bed sheets, an en suite bathroom with a shower, bathtub, bath towels and hairdryer, and a balcony or terrace. Other in-room amenities include a satellite TV, radio, washing machine, ironing set, air conditioning, individually regulated heating and everything else needed for guests to feel at home.

136627.description: The hotel, located 800 meters from Westport town center with its array of supermarkets and restaurants, offers 18 fully serviced, self-contained motel units. Guests enjoy complimentary morning newspapers and access to amenities including air conditioning, a lobby, and a car park. Each unit features Sky television, internet access (wireless and cable), and individually controlled air conditioning. All units are non-smoking and equipped with a shower and a double bed.

136945.description: Enjoy a luxurious stay at the London Marriott Hotel County Hall, situated near Westminster Bridge, with stunning views of the Thames River. This hotel offers 206 guestrooms with pillowtop beds, premium bedding, LCD televisions, and private bathrooms. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy satellite programming. Take advantage of the hotel's amenities, including an indoor pool, fitness center, two restaurants (including the British cuisine Gillray's Steakhouse), and a bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfast is available for a fee. The hotel also provides concierge, wedding, and business services, along with ample conference space and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include the London Dungeon, London Eye, Big Ben, Houses of Parliament, and Westminster Abbey.

137090.description: This magnificent hotel is located in the charming seaside town of Paihia just a short walk away from a selection of dining options and attractions. The hotel is the perfect choice for travellers who are looking to explore the delights of the surrounding area with bush and beach walks. The hotel features island-influenced architecture, allowing it to blend effortlessly with its environment. The guest rooms are beautifully-designed in neutral tones, creating a tranquil ambience where guests can relax and unwind in an intimate environment. The hotel provides guests with leisure and dining amenities to ensure that each visitor enjoys a relaxing experience.

137311.description: On the shore of the Firth of Forth, Queensferry is situated ten miles to the north of Edinburgh. So the Premier Inn Hotel Edinburgh (South Queensferry) is the ideal base for venturing into Scotland's first city, or for exploring the majestic landscape of the Lothians. Queensferry has some puzzling traditions, like the procession of the Burry Man and the annual dip in the Firth of Forth. But there are plenty of other things to do, such as a visit to the Georgian splendour of Hopetoun House or Dundas Castle. There are lots of business venues and good transport links. Once you're done for the day, come back to great food at our Brewers Fayre restaurant and a lovely comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

137329.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Glasgow and was established in 2001. It is close to the Kelvin Grove Museum and the nearest station is Buchanan Street. The Hotel has a restaurant and a bar. All 102 rooms are equipped with hairdryer and ironing set.

138448.description: This hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has a range of kids amenities available upon request. The Hilton Liverpool City Centre hotel offers award-winning service located within the fashionable Liverpool ONE development, less than 20 minutes from Liverpool John Lennon Airport. Enjoy access to Liverpool’s wonderful attractions and spectacular views over the city. Guest rooms, suites, deluxe and executive rooms at this Liverpool all offer wonderful views from the floor to ceiling windows, wireless internet access, LCD TV and spacious desk with comfortable work chair. Deluxe and Executive rooms include access to the Executive Lounge offering complimentary continental breakfast. With separate lounge, work and dining areas, Executive Lounge access, and breathtaking views over the city of Liverpool, Suites offer the ultimate in comfort and relaxation. A prime city center location, eight flexible meeting rooms and a board room supported by an experienced events team, makes this Merseyside hotel perfect for corporate functions, prestigious award ceremonies and elegant Liverpool weddings. Stay in touch with a business center and WiFi access in the rooms and public areas and stay fit in the fully equipped fitness center. The contemporary Exchange restaurant boasts beautiful views of Chavasse Park, sumptuous seasonal cuisine for breakfast, lunch or dinner and elegant, stylish surroundings. Popular Liverpool bar, Pima, offers live entertainment, a relaxed sociable ambience and an outdoor terrace.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Birmingham Star City

138461.description: A Birmingham hotel near Star City, with free parking and breakfast included. Holiday Inn Express® Birmingham - Star City hotel is just off the M6 motorway at Junction 6 and is a 10-minute drive from the city centre. Alternatively, leave your car in the hotel’s complimentary car park and hop on a bus into town from the stop near the hotel. A short drive away, Aston Station offers local train services. Birmingham Airport (BHX) is a 25-minute drive from the hotel. Business guests can host events for up to 40 people in our five flexible and fully equipped conference rooms. A short walk from the hotel, StarCity entertainment centre houses a multi-screen cinema, bowling alley and indoor mini golf. A quick drive away, you can browse high-street shops at the Bullring retail complex. Twenty minutes by car takes you to the varied exhibition and event programme at the National Exhibition Centre or the rides and attractions at Drayton Manor amusement park. At this hotel you can enjoy Free Wi-Fi throughout and complimentary on-site parking. Set yourself up for the day with our inclusive Express Start™ Breakfast buffet, featuring scrambled eggs, sausages and continental items. In the evening, relax in the lounge bar over a chilled glass of wine with friends, or if you're feeling peckish, order a bite to eat from the snack menu.

name.content: Hampton by Hilton Liverpool/John Lennon Airport

138466.description: Please note, we do not accept cash payments at the hotel. All guests are required to provide a pre-authorisation at check in of £50 on a debit or credit card for security and extras. The Hampton by Hilton - Liverpool/John Lennon Airport is the first hotel at Liverpool John Lennon Airport, and is situated directly opposite the terminal building. The hotel is the perfect stop-over location for guests arriving or leaving via the airport's busy regional airport. Delivering a level of service and comfort that is unparalleled in the economy hotels sector, the Hampton by Hilton –Liverpool/John Lennon Airport offers 160 air conditioned en suite bedrooms including free WiFi, in both the bedrooms and public areas. All room rates include a complimentary hot buffet breakfast and guests have free use of the hotel's gym. Guests can unwind in the Hub Bar, where they can also enjoy an evening meal, or purchase light meals and snacks at any time. Car parking is available at the hotel for overnight guests (charges apply), along with park and fly packages. The Hampton by Hilton – Liverpool/John Lennon Airport offers three naturally lit air-conditioned meeting rooms for up to 30 delegates, including free WiFi. So whether you’re planning a presentation, a board meeting or even an interview, our comfortable, well-equipped meeting rooms mean you can conduct your business in affordable style. Liverpool John Lennon Airport is located 8 miles from Liverpool City Centre with easy access to the M62 motorway. The hotel is easily accessible from the M62 at Junction 6 following signs for Liverpool John Lennon Airport. Approaching the airport, follow signs for the Short Stay (Multi-Storey) Car Park which is located directly opposite the Terminal Building, and proceed to the fifth floor of the car park.

139527.description:
Town Hall Hotel, East London
Discover Town Hall Hotel, a luxury boutique hotel in Bethnal Green, London, set within a beautifully restored Grade II-listed Edwardian building. Our 97 individually designed rooms, suites and apartments range from approximately 23–94 sqm, offering stylish accommodation for everything from city breaks to extended stays. Many suites feature kitchens, separate living areas and spacious layouts, ideal for couples, families and business travellers. 
Guests can enjoy our 14-metre heated indoor swimming pool, refurbished gym with Peloton bikes, in-room spa treatments and exceptional dining, including two-Michelin-starred Da Terra, Elis restaurant and the Assembly Lounge. The hotel also offers seven versatile event spaces for meetings, weddings and private celebrations. 
Located on Patriot Square, Bethnal Green, Town Hall Hotel is just a short walk from Bethnal Green Underground Station, with easy access to Shoreditch, Brick Lane, the City of London and central London. 
Experience the perfect blend of historic character, contemporary design and exceptional hospitality at Town Hall Hotel.

140388.description: Whether you're exploring the capital, taking care of business at Canary Wharf, heading for adventure from London City Airport or indulging in serious retail therapy at Westfield Stratford, ibis London Barking offers easy access to all of it. Home to 86 inviting guest bedrooms (complete with en suite power showers, 43' flat screen TV's and tea & coffee facilities), our affordable London hotel puts on a very good value hot & cold breakfast spread each morning, setting you up for even the busiest of days.

140401.description: Located in Solihull, Ramada Birmingham Solihull Hotel is a perfect starting point from which to explore Birmingham. Both business travelers and tourists can enjoy the hotel's facilities and services. To be found at the hotel are 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, daily housekeeping, taxi service, 24-hour security. Designed for comfort, selected guestrooms offer television LCD/plasma screen, carpeting, linens, mirror, towels to ensure a restful night. The hotel's peaceful atmosphere extends to its recreational facilities which include yoga room, fitness center, golf course (within 3 km), massage, garden. For reliable service and professional staff, Ramada Birmingham Solihull Hotel caters to your needs.

140407.description: This boutique hotel, housed within seven Victorian townhouses in London's Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, offers a blend of grand architecture and contemporary design. Located near Earl's Court Underground station (500m), it provides easy access to Olympia, the Royal Albert Hall, world-renowned museums like the Victoria and Albert and Natural History Museum (1km), and the upscale shopping districts of Knightsbridge and Kensington, including Harrods (1. 2km).
