Paddington Station is approximately 2km away, and Victoria Coach Station and Piccadilly Circus are both roughly 3km from the hotel. The hotel's 76 rooms and 2 apartments are spread over four floors, featuring amenities such as a 24-hour reception, currency exchange, and lift access. Guests can enjoy a private garden, on-site bar and restaurant serving pan-Asian cuisine for lunch and dinner, and a comprehensive breakfast. Each room includes a private bathroom, king-size or double bed, satellite TV, internet access, a minibar, and tea and coffee making facilities. For those looking to stay active, a gym is also available.

141487.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at Hotel Bellevue - Traditional Swiss Hideaway in Lauterbrunnen. Located near Kleine Scheidegg (7. 7 km) and Eiger (10. 1 km), this family-friendly hotel offers numerous amenities, including a spa tub, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Enjoy meals at the restaurant or snacks at the coffee shop/café. Unwind with a drink at one of the three bars/lounges. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily (8 AM - 10 AM). The hotel also provides complimentary newspapers, dry cleaning/laundry services, multilingual staff, and free train station pick-up. The 33 guestrooms feature complimentary Wi-Fi, phones, safes, and desks. Nearby attractions include Wengen LWM, Grindelwald - Wengen Ski Area, Mannlichen Mountain, Mini Golf Wengen, and the Wengen-Mannlichen Cable Car.

141687.description:
During the current pandemic, this hotel is open only for housing key workers and workers with no alternative abode. Breakfast is a self-service 'grab & go' on departure.

The Best Western Gatwick Skylane Hotel, the shortest of short-hauls away from London Gatwick Airport, is ideal for overnight stays en route to foreign destinations and just the ticket for short breaks close to London too.

The hotel is as affordable as it is affable, combining great value with friendly service and warm Best Western personality. And as you would expect from a conveniently located London Gatwick Airport hotel, we offer parking and transfers to make your journeys a joy. 

Situated in the south east of England, the Best Western Gatwick Skylane Hotel also puts you within touching distance of Central London, with a 45 minute train ride making departures to London Gatwick Airport equally hassle free.

From our bar to our breakout areas and our restaurant to our rooms, the hotel has everything you might need for functions, conferences, meetings, weddings, private parties and great nights sleeps! Airport shuttle from 6am to 11:40 pm. 3 GBP one way or 5 GBP round trip. Out of these hours suggest Roadrunners taxi phone: 01293 780 780 (24hrs). Airport Shuttle: North/South Terminals coach pick-up points listed as ‘Days Hotel Gatwick'.

141690.description:
White House Hotel is 1990 built property, specialised to cover all facilities and requirements for passengers travelling to & from Gatwick airport. 
We have Concierge services within 5-10miles, for leisure, shopping, beaches, historical places, wedding venues, nature reserves, countryside walks and cyclings etc. 
The Hotel is suitable for adults, business delegates, day rooms, airline crews, students, families and aged guests who need ground-floor rooms. 
We have one of the best locations, which is just 10 minutes’ drive from Gatwick Airport and 10-minutes walk from Horley town centre and train station offers services to central London, Brighton, and many other places to be visited. M23 motorway is 2 miles away, and M25 is 5miles. 

Hosted by experienced family in the hospitality industry, making your stay comfortable, valuable, memorable in a relaxed & friendly atmosphere. 

The bedrooms at Gatwick White House feature colourful linens, towels and a private bathroom with free toiletries and other small travelling essentials. consists of a water bottle, tea/coffee facilities with biscuits, TVs. 
Welcome drink dispensers are located at the reception. 
Our additional facilities are: Breakfast, "All day cafe" Bar and Restaurant, evening meals, transfers to Gatwick, car park, luggage storage, laundry and customised services as required. 
Charges are applicable and preferable to book in advance. 

Charges are applicable and preferable to book in advance. towels and a private bathroom with free toiletries and other small travelling essentials. consists of a water bottle, tea/coffee facilities with biscuits, TVs.

142535.description:
Located in Agarn, Hotel Central is in a rural location, a 4-minute drive from Turtmann - Ems Ski Lift and 9 minutes from Gampel-Jeizinen Gondola.  This hotel is 10.2 mi (16.5 km) from Leukerbad-Therme and 6.8 mi (10.9 km) from Raron-Unterbaech Gondola.
Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access. Additional features at this hotel include ski storage and tour/ticket assistance.
Featured amenities include express check-in, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and multilingual staff. Free self parking is available onsite.
You can enjoy a meal at the restaurant serving the guests of Hotel Central, or stop in at the snack bar/deli. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10 AM.
Make yourself at home in one of the 15 guestrooms featuring minibars. Rooms have private balconies. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers with rainfall showerheads and hair dryers.

143390.description: The luxurious Grange Beauchamp Hotel enjoys a privileged situation in the centre of London, just steps away from the famous British Museum and the shopping venues of the Brunswick shopping centre. The exclusive shops and boutiques of Oxford Street and Regent's Street as well as Covent Garden are within a short stroll, while attractions such as Buckingham Palace, Big Ben and the Houses of Parliament are within easy reach. The elegant hotel exudes an air of unobtrusive luxury. The excellently appointed rooms are tastefully decorated in a contemporary style, and features include high-speed wireless internet access and flat-screen LCD TV. The hotel offers meeting facilities, and guests can dine in the on-site restaurant serving delicious international cuisine. Guests can relax having a drink in the cosy bar. This hotel is a perfect base to discover this vibrant city surrounded by style.

name.content: Leonardo Royal Hotel London St Pauls

143393.description: Situated beside St Paul's Cathedral in London's business district, Leonardo Royal Hotel London St Paul's boasts an excellent base for exploring the rest of the capital . Each elegant room at the Leonardo Royal Hotel London St Paul's features a luxury bathroom with power shower, designer toiletries, and hairdryers. Rooms offer a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, bathrobes and slippers, and free WiFi. Leo's onsite Bar and Restaurant is the perfect place to enjoy lunch, dinner or a cocktail. The health and fitness club features a fully equipped gym with TVs, personal trainers, and fitness classes. The spa offers a number of luxurious treatments, while guests can relax in the hot tub and sauna. The hotel also has 2 floors of meeting and events space. St Paul's Underground Station and the London Stock Exchange are both a 5-minute walk away. One New Change shopping centre is a 4-minute walk away and Shakespeares Globe is an 11-minute walk away. Leonardo Royal Hotel London St Paul's is also just a short walk away from key transport links like Mansion House and Blackfriars stations.

143394.description: Situated directly on Vincent Square, the elegant hotel Grange The Wellington enjoys a prime location in Westminster in central London. World-famous attractions such as Buckingham Palace, Westminster Cathedral, Westminster Abbey, Houses of Parliament, Big Ben or St. James's Park are within walking distance, while Hyde Park or the London Eye are within easy reach. London Victoria Station is just a few steps away. The hotel is housed in a beautiful Edwardian building. The spacious rooms and apartments are wonderfully appointed and decorated in a classic style of timeless elegance and with neutral colours. They are equipped with high-speed wireless internet access and LCD satellite-TV. This attractive hotel is an oasis of peace and tranquillity in the centre of London, ideal to start discovering this fascinating city.

143449.description: 'Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden at Whites Hotel, a Victorian hotel in Newcastle-upon-Tyne's Jesmond neighborhood. The hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a cozy fireplace in the lobby, and tour/ticket assistance. Dine at Bar Blanc, specializing in local cuisine, or enjoy room service during limited hours. A complimentary reception provides a chance to mingle with other guests. Unwind at one of the two bars/lounges. Guest rooms feature flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and bathrobes, and conveniences such as coffee/tea makers and desks. Free self-parking is available onsite. Whites Hotel is conveniently located within a 5-minute drive of the Tyne Bridge and Quayside, and a short distance from local attractions. '

143508.description: Situated within a short stroll from East Croydon train station and the Warehouse Theatre, the home of the annual International Playwriting Festival, this contemporary hotel is ideal for visitors seeking accommodation in London with easy access to local entertainment. Visitors may easily reach Wimbledon town centre, 10 km away, a bustling hub which offers shopaholics a fantastic retail experience, or football lovers may explore Crystal Palace Selhurst Park and tennis fanatics will enjoy a trip to the world-renowned Wimbledon Lawn Tennis Club. Whether looking for somewhere for a holiday stopover or wishing to explore the nearby attractions, travellers will not find a better place to stay in Croydon Central than this. This hotel has recently been updated with a fresh new look and features  new room design complete with commodious bed so guests can be sure of a great night's sleep. They may also enjoy a daily breakfast and throughout the day sip a drink from the bar.

143586.description: On a tranquil square, the budget European Hotel offers rooms 3 minutes’ walk from St Pancras Station and the Eurostar Terminal. Kings Cross Station, a 2-minute walk away, offers access to the London Underground. The British Museum is 10 minutes by bus and the British Library is 5 minutes' walk away. Each room at European Hotel has free WiFi and tea/coffee making facilities are also available. Hairdryers and irons are available on request.

143638.description:
Champex-Lac is a village located in the Valais, part of the municipality of Orsières, at 1,470 metres on the shore of Lac de Champex, in between the foot of the Mont Blanc Massif and the St Bernard Pass. The hotel is next to the center, the bus station and facing the lake. Hiking and cycling paradise its also a ski resort. Martigny is reachable in 20, Verbier in 30 minutes. 

Cozy and familiar Hotel runned by the same family since more than 115 years which features 2 restaurants (brasserie-pizzeria and traditional home-made food and exquisite gourmet) with terrace and garden. Tennis courts, lift, free car parking, children playroom, TV-Lounge with chimney and WiFi-internet connection in the whole building. Spa area with sauna and whirlpool.

The spacious, bright and comfortable rooms features ensuite bathroom with shower or bath and wc, cable- tv, direct phone and radio. WiFi-internet connection aviable in the whole building. Some rooms with balcony and lakeview and family rooms on request. 


Relaxing spa area with sauna and whirlpool as well as gameroom with billards and TV-lounge with chimney.

The restaurants offers brasserie-pizzeria and traditional home-made food and exquisite gourmet.

From motorway A9 take exit 22-Gd St-Bernard and continue on road 21 until Les Valettes. In summertime: turn slightly right direction Champex-Lac par les Valettes. Arriving in Champex-Lac, the hotel is situated on the left side just at the beginning of the lake. In wintertime: continue direction Gd-St-Bernard and Champex-Lac at Orsières. Arriving in the village follow the lakeside almost until the end. The hotel is on the right. In public transports: take a train from Martigny to Sembrancher, change direction Orsières and from there a bus until Champex, Lac. The hotel is at 200 m on the right.

143639.description: Enjoy a day on the slopes, then unwind with amenities like outdoor tennis courts and a refreshing pool. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). A complimentary ski shuttle provides easy access to the slopes. Le Chaudron, the poolside restaurant, offers a bar/lounge with a garden view and room service is available during limited hours. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast served from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. For business travelers, there's a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. The hotel features 120 square feet (11 square meters) of conference and meeting space, perfect for events. Train station pick-up and free self-parking are also available. Relax in one of the 33 guestrooms featuring minibars, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and private bathrooms with deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Additional conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. Located near Casino de Crans-Montana, the Miniature Train Museum, and Patinoire Ycoor ice rink, the hotel provides easy access to various attractions. The nearest airports are Sion (SIR) and Geneva International Airport (GVA).

143645.description: The Indasol Apartments are centrally located in Salou, just 700 meters from the beach, surrounded by supermarkets, restaurants, and shops, with easy access to public transport. Barcelona El Prat Airport is approximately 99 km and Reus Airport is 15 km from the property. This complex offers 25 apartments, all accessible by lift. Apartments feature two bedrooms, a living room with a sofa bed, a fully equipped kitchen with a ceramic hob, microwave, and washing machine, and a bathroom with a hairdryer and bathtub. Larger apartments accommodating 6-7 guests include an additional single bedroom and bathroom with a shower. All apartments have a TV, air conditioning, heating, and a large terrace with garden furniture. Guests can enjoy both adult and children's swimming pools, and the nearby beach is sandy. To reach the Fincas Indasol office from Plaza Europa, turn right onto Paseo Jaime I, continue to the end at Calle Barcelona, and the office will be on the left, 150 meters past the roundabout at the fountain.

name.content: Stewart by Heeton Concept Aparthotel Edinburgh

143721.description: Tucked just off George Street, Stewart by Heeton Concept is your launchpad for exploring Edinburgh’s historic heart. Spacious apartments, local charm, and all the comforts of home —right where the city buzzes. Situated in Edinburgh’s UNESCO-listed New Town, just minutes from Edinburgh Castle, Old Town, and St. James Quarter. ​ Spacious studios and multi-room apartments with kitchenettes—perfect for families of all sizes. ​Quiet rooms, flexible layouts, and thoughtful touches tailored for traveling families. ​

143763.description: Nestled in the tranquil countryside of La Canonja, Mas La Boella, a luxurious Tuscan-style hotel, offers a serene escape just a 15-minute drive from Tarragona Port and PortAventura World. Enjoy a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool, stay active in the fitness center, or savor delicious meals at Restaurant Espai Fortuny or the on-site coffee shop. Each of the 13 air-conditioned rooms features modern amenities, including Smart TVs, MP3 docking stations, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads. Complimentary Wi-Fi and convenient services such as concierge assistance, wedding services, and dry cleaning/laundry facilities ensure a comfortable and memorable stay. A buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee.

143893.description: Malacuna Birmingham is located in the Jewellry Quarter, a hip and interesting area in town where one can find great speakeasies, restaurants and creative spaces. Next to the check-in desk, enjoy a cool coffee shop kiosk with the highest quality coffee and light bites. We offer private and shared rooms.

name.content: Premier Inn London Gatwick Manor Royal

143900.description: Jetting away or heading home? Wherever your destination, you'll find a warm welcome at Premier Inn Hotel London Gatwick Airport (Manor Royal). Just a short distance from the airport, you'll also be well placed for business and leisure destinations around London. Unwind after a long flight, or stretch your legs at K2 Leisure Centre. Head for the bright lights and city sights of central London. Or seek out the seaside charm of Brighton and the South coast. After a busy day, unwind with a tasty meal in our restaurant and a great night's sleep in your extra-comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

name.content: Premier Inn London Gatwick Airport A23

143901.address: Longbridge Way Gatwick Airport, North Terminal
143901.description: Whether it's a short hop or a long haul flight, the Premier Inn London Gatwick Airport (A23 Airport Way) is the perfect place to rest your head. And with the frequent shuttle bus service you'll be at the North or South Terminal in no time. But it's not all about the air miles. Keep your feet on the ground with quick connections into London, a spot of sightseeing in Sussex or a jaunt into nearby Crawley town centre. We'll be here with our tasty restaurant and comfy rooms whenever you need us. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

143970.description: Book your stay at one of our 36 luxurious apartments in Leeds City Centre. Choose from a Smart Studio, Grande Studio, Elegance Studio, a Liberty One-Bedroom Apartment, or a Maxima Two-Bedroom Apartment. Each has been individually designed with stylish interiors to ensure your comfort. Our award-winning aparthotel is within walking distance of Trinity Shopping Centre, Harvey Nichols, Victoria Arcade, First Direct Arena, the O2 Academy, Victoria Gate & John Lewis, and numerous bars and restaurants. Leeds train station is just under five minutes away, placing you in the heart of the city. For workouts, Pure Gym is nearby. Discounted parking is available at Q-Park, Sovereign Square (LS1 4AG). Pre-book at www. q-park. co. uk/en-gb/cities/leeds using code 'ROOMZZZ30' for a 30% discount.

name.content: Dover Marina Hotel & Spa, Tapestry Collection

144026.description: The Dover Marina Hotel & Spa Tapestry Collection By Hilton is a recently refurbished seaside gem on the Dover waterfront, with the White Cliffs as a stunning backdrop. Located across from the beach, with excellent access to the ferry and cruise terminals, and just ten minutes from the Eurotunnel, it's ideal for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel blends 21st-century comfort with 19th-century Victorian decor, creating a charming and character-filled atmosphere. Modern rooms, sea views, and a welcoming ambiance make this hotel a wonderful place to stay. Enjoy dining at Mr. White's English Chophouse restaurant overlooking the sea, grab a Starbucks coffee, indulge in a traditional English tea, or have breakfast at the Waterfront Café. For a light bite, visit Wheeler's Fish & Chips or the Waterfront Lounge Bar with views of the Dover coastline. With easy access to the A20 and A2, the hotel is a great base for exploring Kent or even taking a day trip to France or Belgium.

144076.description: The hotel enjoys a quiet location in central Engelberg, a short walk from the Valley Museum and the Benedictine Monastery. Guests can relax in the sauna or admire mountain views from their balconies. Rooms feature amenities such as mini-bars, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, safes, and hairdryers. Parking is available, including a garage and separate parking spots. The hotel is easily accessible by car from Zurich Airport (100km) and Basel (via A2, exit Stans-Sud/Engelberg).

name.content: St Christopher's Inn London Bridge - The Village

144097.description: This multi-award winning London Bridge backpacker hostel is located right in the heart of London. All of the rooms are modern, safe and secure, and can only be accessed by digital key cards. Not only is St Christopher's The Village the UK's first hostel to offer Japanese-style capsule beds designed to give you the best night's sleep possible, but this hostel also has brand new private rooms now available too, including ‘The Shard' Room, offering killer views from your own private balcony of the Shard!Please note: We have a 7 day maximum stay policy. We cannot accommodate guests under the age of 18. Bookings of 9+ guests are subject to additional conditions and supplements apply, contact the reception team for any queries. Guests are required to show in date photo ID on check in, the accepted forms are passport or UK drivers license. Photocopies or images of ID will not be accepted.

144898.description: Enjoying an exciting setting at the heart of Ketchum, this charming hotel offers guests the perfect place from which to explore the delights that the area has to offer. Guests will find themselves within easy access of a number of attractions and key points of interest, making it the perfect setting for business and leisure travellers alike. The hotel is situated in close proximity to the Sun Valley Centre for the Arts, Big Wood Golf Course, Sun Valley Ski Resort and the Ernest Hemingway Memorial. This charming hotel exudes elegance and style, welcoming guests into the relaxing surroundings of the lobby. The guest rooms are tastefully appointed, and come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. The hotel affords guests a number of excellent facilities, meeting the needs of every type of traveller.

145247.description: Strategically located in the tourist resort of Salou, on the Costa Daurada, this comfortable aparthotel is just 500 metres from Capellans white, sandy beach and a short walk from the town centre, with an impressive offer of restaurants, bars and stores, allowing its guests to have a relaxing time during their holidays either if they come with the whole family, with friends or as a couple. The famous Port Aventura theme park is in the nearby area and Reus airport is only 10 kilometres away from the premises. The en-suite, fully equipped studios include a kitchenette for guests to prepare their own food, as well as all the necessary amenities for a comfortable stay. Guests can enjoy the interesting leisure and dining offer at the premises, as it includes a magnificent swimming pool and several bars and a buffet service restaurant for added comfort.

145403.description: Enjoy your stay at the Park Hotel in Ilford's Cranbrook district, conveniently located within a 15-minute drive of the ExCeL Exhibition Centre and the Thames River. This hotel offers 60 guestrooms equipped with LCD televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, coffee/tea makers, and work desks. Guests can also enjoy free Wi-Fi and a television in the common area. Free self-parking is available onsite. The hotel is a short drive from the O2 Arena (9. 5 mi) and the Tower of London (10. 3 mi). London City Airport is the closest airport.

145540.description: Enjoy garden views at the Britannia Inn Hotel in Ilford, and take advantage of complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a microwave in the common area. Free self-parking is available on-site. The hotel's 36 guestrooms feature LCD televisions and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Coffee/tea makers and desks are provided for your convenience, and housekeeping is offered daily. The hotel is conveniently located near ExCeL Exhibition Centre and the Thames River, and within a 15-minute drive of London City Airport. It's also within easy reach of attractions like London Bridge and St. Paul's Cathedral.

145542.description: The Best Western London Ilford Hotel offers a perfect blend of business and leisure accommodations in the heart of Ilford Town Centre, just 20 minutes from Central London. Enjoy easy access to shopping, markets, and financial institutions, all within easy reach. Back at the hotel, unwind in well-appointed rooms featuring flat-screen HDTVs, radios, private telephones, tea/coffee makers, and complimentary wired and wireless internet access. Our new state-of-the-art media hubs allow you to connect your iPod, MP3 player, DVD player, PlayStation, Xbox, laptop, or digital video camera to your TV and also offer Bluetooth connectivity for mobile phones. For effortless travel to the capital, the hotel is conveniently located just two minutes from Ilford Train Station and a short walk from two Central Line Underground stations.

145543.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Cranbrook Hotel, located in Ilford. . We offer 80 guest rooms equipped with LCD televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, coffee/tea makers, with daily housekeeping. Ilford station is a 5 minute walk from the hotel where you can take the Elizabeth line direct to the centre of London in 20 minutes. Stratford home to the London stadium is 10 minutes away. You'll be within a 15-minute drive of ExCeL Exhibition Centre and the Thames River, and a short distance from London City Airport. Explore nearby attractions including London Bridge and St. Paul's Cathedral.

145568.description: Based a few minutes' walk from the West End of Princes Street in the New Town of Edinburgh, these apartments are a perfect base to explore the riches of Scotland's capital, either as a weekend stopover or for a short-term business visit. St. Andrew Square bus station and Waverley train station are both roughly 1. 5 km from the hotel. Built in 1840, these 5 self-contained apartments fuse traditional Georgian architecture with modern design flair and technology. The city hotel's full-height windows overlook gardens. The establishment is equipped with modern stylish furnishings coupled with state-of-the-art fittings. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-out service. The hotel also provides wireless Internet access and a laundry service. The living areas are designed to the highest standard with modern furniture and appliances, offering a perfect base from which to explore Edinburgh. All rooms are en suite and feature a shower, bath and hairdryer, as well as a king-size bed, a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, a radio and Internet access. The apartments also feature a kitchenette with a fridge, a cooker, a microwave and tea and coffee making facilities. Further amenities include a washing machine, an ironing set and heating.

145627.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and barbecue grills. Enjoy a meal at RBG, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 9:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in Aberdeen? This hotel has 3315 square feet (308 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. Stay in one of 185 guestrooms featuring plasma televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

145836.description: Located in London's Kensington district, the Holland Inn Hotel is a short walk from Kensington High Street and the Olympia Conference and Exhibition Centre. Westfield London Shopping Centre and the Natural History Museum are also easily accessible. The hotel offers 26 guestrooms equipped with refrigerators, coffee/tea makers, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Guests can enjoy free Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and convenient amenities such as a 24-hour front desk and luggage storage.

145837.description: Located in the heart of London's Bayswater and Queensway, this charming hotel offers warm hospitality and convenient access to Notting Hill, Hyde Park, and Kensington Gardens. A short distance from the West End's shops, restaurants, and theatres, it provides a relaxing garden for guests to unwind. The cozy guest rooms feature private bathrooms with showers, ensuring a peaceful stay. This non-smoking establishment offers breakfast and Wi-Fi in public areas, making it an excellent choice for both business and leisure travelers.

name.content: Ponient Piramide Salou by PortAventura World

145838.description: The Hotel Piramide Salou offers a convenient location in Salou, just 600 meters from Salou Beach and 1. 5 km from PortAventura World. Some rooms include tickets to PortAventura and Ferrari Land (see room details). Stays of one or two nights include one-day, two-park tickets, while stays of three or more nights include two-day, two-park tickets (subject to park operating dates). Discounts are available for Caribe Aquatic Park tickets (subject to park operating dates). The hotel features a buffet restaurant serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner, two bars, a swimming pool, and a garden. From July 1st to September 30th, guests can enjoy a 20-minute royal family experience (bookable upon arrival, subject to availability). The hotel is a 15-minute drive from Reus Airport and an hour from Barcelona Airport. Private parking is available for a fee. During peak season, a shuttle service operates to PortAventura World in the mornings and returns in the afternoons (times vary, with one rest day per week). Indoor parking is available at the hotel for a surcharge, and PortAventura World parking requires a separate fee.

146196.description: This beautiful holiday property is nestled along the stunning promenade and just metres away from the beach in Cambrils. Its guests can be working on their tans just a minute after enjoying their delicious breakfast. They can either opt for the onsite pool that is located on the well-tended hotel grounds or the excellent beach itself. The former will attract them with poolside snack bar that serves a number of refreshing colourful cocktails, while the latter with a constant stream of soothing foamy waves. For a little extra fun they can head to the onsite bar for a chilled drink or take the short drive to the centre of Cambrils, where bars and shops abide. Those who want to explore the area with the public transport can find a convenient stop just in front of the hotel.

147201.description: This charming hotel enjoys a convenient location just 3 kilometres from Dublin city centre and a 15-minute walk from Croke Park Stadium. Dublin Airport is a short driving distance from the hotel and travellers will find themselves close to Dublin City University and to Albert College Park. The main building dates back 200 years and combines the traditional Irish elegance and contemporary convenience of Dublin. The guest rooms have been tastefully decorated and provide a host of modern services such as complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection and free access to the state-of-the-art spa. Business travellers will appreciate the fully-equipped meeting facilities with a capacity for up to 900 guests.

147344.address: Marchburn Dr Glasgow Aprt Bus Pk Paisley
147344.description: This accessible hotel in Paisley offers complimentary breakfast and convenient amenities such as express check-out, a safe deposit box at the front desk, and an elevator. The 98 guestrooms provide a comfortable home base. Located within a 15-minute drive of the OVO Hydro and the Scottish Exhibition and Conference Centre, and conveniently close to Glasgow International Airport (GLA). Other nearby attractions include St. Mirren Park (1 mi), Paisley Abbey (1. 7 mi), and Braehead Arena (3. 8 mi). This hotel is also within easy reach of Ibrox Stadium and Loch Lomond.

147414.description: This is the coolest hostel in London. Modern, cosy and intimate, it has an impressive fully equipped kitchen, TV rooms and internet. It is around a 10-minute walk to the British Library and some 2. 3 km to Covent Garden, the British Museum and Dickens' House. Only steps from the impressive King's Cross station and Hoxton, it is the perfect base to explore the city and relax. Facilities include a lobby with a 24-hour reception, hotel safe, lift access and a TV lounge.

147461.description:
The hotel is within walking distance of Inverness city centre, and just 1.3 km away from Inverness bus and train stations and only a short drive from the world-famous Loch Ness. Eastgate shopping centre and the city's nightlife spots are around 15 minutes' walk from the hotel, and there are bars and restaurants 10 minutes away on foot. Other nearby places of interest include Culloden Battlefield (10 minutes' drive), Cawdor Castle and Loch Ness Exhibition Centre (both 20 minutes), Urquhart Castle (30 minutes) and Fort George (25 minutes). The hotel is around 13 km away from Inverness Airport.

The hotel is an environment for relaxation and stimulation, the perfect place for re-energising during a business trip, or a golfing break. At the hotel there is a mezzanine lounge, business centre, green spaces, golf course views, an exclusive bar and a restaurant. Built in 2010, the hotel is fully air-conditioned and further facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, lift access to the upper floors and a hairdressing salon. Guests may also take advantage of the wireless Internet access, room service and a car park.

Each room features an en suite bathroom with shower, bathtub and hairdryer, a king-size bed and individually regulated air conditioning and heating. Other in-room amenities include a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, Internet access, a safe and tea and coffee making facilities.

There is a health and beauty spa with heated indoor swimming pool, massage suites, a relaxation area, nail salon, hot tub, sauna, steam room, aqua fit sessions and a number of spa treatments on offer. The hotel also has a gym and an outdoor swimming pool with poolside snack bar. Inverness Golf Club is just a 5-minute drive from the hotel.

A continental breakfast buffet is served each morning and à la carte options are available for lunch and dinner.

name.content: Heeton Concept Hotel - City Centre Liverpool

147905.description: Step into Heeton Concept Hotel – Liverpool, your stylish base in the heart of this vibrant city. Just moments from the iconic waterfront, legendary music spots, and lively dining scenes, our rooms are designed for curious families, couples, and solo explorers. Whether you’re tracing Beatles history at the Cavern Club or strolling along Albert Dock, Liverpool is where your story begins — with comfort, character, and a touch of the unexpected. ​

147911.description: Enjoying a prime city centre location, the apartments are just two minutes from St Andrews Square and the exclusive shopping district of Multrees Walk and the world renowned Harvey Nichols. The trendy bars and restaurants of George Street and Rose Street are also within a short distance making this the perfect location for a city break in Edinburgh. Alternatively for a splash of culture famous historical attractions including the Walter Scott Monument, National Gallery and Edinburgh Castle are within easy reach. The apartments are easily accessible from Waverley station and the new tram system has a stop just round the corner at St Andrew Square ensuring those travelling from the airport are able to transfer practically door to door. The apartments are comfortable, spacious and well equipped both in the kitchen and the bathroom. The apartments shall be serviced every 4 days and additional cleaning can be arranged at an extra charge. Please arrange this directly with Fountain Court.

148501.description: The Hotel Indigo® Liverpool is a colorful character in our lively district,  perfectly complementing the history and thriving business of the neighborhood. Inside, eye-popping dyed accents are splashed onto lobby murals and stitched into fabrics,  reflecting the area’s cotton trading heritage.  Chapel + Barrel serves up delicious cocktails, with laid-back vibes and comfort food done right. Enjoy spacious bedrooms, warm service and modern facilities, including rainfall showers.

148614.description:
Welcome to NX London Hostel, proudly nestled in a classic Victorian building dating back to 1897. Rich with history, character, and timeless charm, our hostel is anything but ordinary. Like any heritage treasure, it comes with a few delightful quirks, reminders of a bygone era that lend a truly unique flavor to your stay. 
We adore our historic building and the charm it brings, but we know it’s not for everyone. 
Please keep your expectations consistent with the budget, community minded accommodation we provide. 
The hostel is just a two-minute stroll from both New Cross Gate and New Cross Overground and train stations. 
Reception is open 4. 00 PM to 1:00 AM daily
Upon arrival all guests must provide a copy of a valid Photo ID*, along with a £50 deposit for incidentals. 
We reserve the right to refuse accommodation to anybody without giving a reason.

name.content: Hotel Victoria Lauberhorn, Wengen, a Faern Collect

148871.description: Victoria-Lauberhorn is a charming alpine retreat nestled in the picture-postcard car-free village of Wengen. The hotel offers rooms with stunning views on the Jungfrau, delightful restaurants, and more than a 1000 sqm wellness area (biggest spa in town), creating a perfect blend of outdoor activities and relaxation. The direct access to skiing and hiking trails is ideal for adventure seekers and those looking to unwind in this enchanting setting. Our adventurous guests can enjoy the Top of Europe - Our hotel is located just a few steps away from the iconic train station that takes you to the legendary Jungfraujoch. Perched at 3, 454 meters above sea level, this glacier offers breathtaking, indescribable views that will leave you in speechless.

148902.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Saas Fee and was established in 1881. It is close to the Saas Fee. The Hotel has a restaurant, 2 bars and a coffee shop. All 40 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer and safe.

150340.description: Clayton Hotel Cardiff offers 12-story accommodation with 216 well-appointed air conditioned guest rooms. We're big on charm here, which is perhaps not surprising as we're located in one of Cardiff's tallest buildings! Panoramic views, excellent service and fantastic local attractions all await, as do complimentary Wi-Fi, a laptop safe and tea & coffee making facilities. Conferences are welcome here too, with seven rooms to choose from in a convenient venue. All guests can have access to our fitness room located on Level 2, but if you simply want to relax, few hotels in Wales will welcome you as warmly. Enjoy your stay. Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification.

150524.description: Enjoy a relaxing drink at our on-site bar/lounge. We offer complimentary Wi-Fi, a computer station, and a 24-hour front desk for your convenience. Free self-parking is also available. Our 16 guestrooms feature flat-screen televisions. Located in the heart of Croydon, the Kirkdale Hotel, a charming bed and breakfast, is within a 15-minute drive of Surrey Hills and conveniently close to central London attractions such as the London Eye and Westminster Abbey (both 10. 7 miles). The nearest airport is Gatwick (LGW), approximately 20. 5 miles away.

150525.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at the Mowbray Court Hotel in London City Centre. Dine in the on-site restaurant and enjoy a continental breakfast (fee applies). The hotel offers 138 air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen TVs, satellite programming, private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, safes, and electric kettles. Daily housekeeping is provided. Nearby attractions include Kensington High Street, the Natural History Museum, Westfield London Shopping Centre, and Hyde Park. The closest airports are London City (LCY), Heathrow (LHR), and Gatwick (LGW).

150646.description: Situated opposite South Bank University, this modern city hotel offers 33 stylishly appointed rooms, blending traditional elegance with contemporary amenities. A short walk from Lambeth North and Elephant & Castle tube stations, it's surrounded by numerous bars and restaurants. Ideal for business conferences, weddings, and receptions, this family-friendly hotel features a lobby and restaurant. Comfortable rooms include a TV, fridge, hairdryer, tea/coffee making facilities, complimentary fruit and bottled water, and Wi-Fi access. Triple rooms are furnished with one double and one single bed. A continental breakfast is served daily. Guests can request twin or double rooms directly with the hotel, subject to availability.

150845.description: Just 5 minutes’ walk from the famous Bullring Shopping Center, B&B Hotel Birmingham has a great location, less than 0. 5 miles from Birmingham city center. With free Wi-Fi in its trendy bar and public areas, it also features 2 meeting rooms, an on-site restaurant and a fitness center. Each spacious room at B&B Hotel Birmingham has an en suite shower and free toiletries, a flat-screen TV and a desk. In the morning you can enjoy a hearty breakfast – or grab a pastry to go if you’re in a rush. Lunch and dinner are also available in the on-site restaurant. The NEC is only 9 miles away, and Birmingham’s National Sea Life Center is 5 minutes’ drive from the building. Cadbury World, where you can see tours and exciting events, is a 10-minute drive away, and Birmingham International Airport is a 20-minute journey by car. Birmingham New Street Station is within 10 minute's walk from the hotel.

150976.description: Centrally located on a residential street in Earls Court, this property enjoys close proximity to Kensington and Chelsea. The property is located close to links to the public transport network, enjoying ease of access to the many attractions that the city has to offer. Many shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can also be found nearby. The hotel comprises 3 former townhouses, which were build in the 1800s. The guest rooms are stunningly designed, beautifully retaining an element of rustic elegance and history. This property prides itself on its excellent customer service, welcoming ambiance and comfortable setting, ensuring a relaxing stay for every type of traveller.

151183.description: Enjoy this Art Deco hostel's vibrant social scene and convenient amenities, including free Wi-Fi, an arcade/game room, and a lively bar/lounge. Generator Dublin also offers a restaurant, cafe, and weekday buffet breakfast (fee applies). The hostel provides helpful tour/ticket assistance and a 24-hour front desk with multilingual staff. Each of the 109 guestrooms features complimentary Wi-Fi and a private bathroom with a shower. Daily housekeeping and irons/ironing boards are available upon request. Located a short walk from the Jameson Distillery Bow St. and just minutes from Guinness Storehouse, Generator Dublin is centrally situated for exploring Dublin's top attractions.

151329.description:
This hotel enjoys a convenient location, 1 km away from the Hammersmith HMV Apollo, Shepherd's Bush theatres, the Westfield shopping centre and Kensington Olympia. The famous Kensington High Street is within walking distance (2 km).

This city hotel features contemporary-style interiors and offers its guests a range of convenient facilities and services. It comprises a total of 16 rooms, including 3 singles. There is a 24-hour reception, Internet access and an elegant breakfast room.

All rooms come with a shower and are equipped with a TV, Internet access, tea and coffee making facilities, an ironing set and central heating.

In the morning, guests can enjoy a hearty continental breakfast in the elegant breakfast room.

151330.description: This hotel is situated on Shepherd's Bush Road and has 5 main London underground stations within 5-15 minutes' walk. It lies just a 5-minute walk from Westfield, Europe's biggest shopping centre. Big London attractions and venues are all only minutes away and easily accessible, including the West End, Piccadilly Circus, Buckingham Palace, Hyde Park, Hammersmith Apollo Theatre, Olympia Grand Hall, BBC Television Centre and many more. It is a 10-minute walk to the Olympia Exhibition Centre and 20 minutes' walk from the Earl's Court Exhibition Centre. This city hotel is a pleasant and relaxed property and offers its guests a great experience, making them feel at home from the moment they arrive. The friendly team is on hand 24 hours a day, and is available to assist guests with any queries. The hotel comprises a total of 33 rooms, including 3 singles. Facilities on offer to guests include a 24-hour reception, a hotel safe and a laundry service. All rooms come with a shower and a hairdryer and are equipped with Internet access, a safe, a fridge and tea and coffee making facilities. Furthermore, an ironing set and central heating units are provided in all accommodation units as standard.

151634.description: The hotel is located near Tower Bridge and the Tower of London and offers modern and spacious bedrooms. The hotel, in London's historic core, is close to a number of popular local attractions including the Tower of London, Borough Market, St. Katherine's Dock and the HMS Belfast. The hotel also offers a number of transport options, with Tower Hill Tube Station close by and both Fenchurch Street rail and Tower Gateway DLR stations a short distance away. Each spacious luxurious room offers cosy bathrobes, a private bathroom that includes luxury toiletries. The restaurant serves a range of grill and authentic tapas dishes. A range of cocktails and wines is offered in the sophisticated lounge bar. The swimming pool and a gym feature in the hotel's leisure facilities. There is a business centre on site, and there are well-equipped event suites for guests to use.

name.content: Comfort Zone Parkside Apartment Hotel Birmingham

152119.description: These centrally located apartments are just 350 meters along the canals from the International Convention Centre (ICC), the National Indoor Arena (NIA), and Broad Street. Birmingham New Street train station and the Bullring shopping and leisure complex are a short 10-minute walk away. Enjoy the extra space and comfort of these modern city-center apartments. Whether for business or leisure, these apartments offer an excellent alternative to a traditional hotel and are an ideal choice for short or long stays.

152291.description: The Hotel Beau-Site is an exclusive boutique hotel nestled in the breathtaking Swiss Alps, just 50 minutes from Interlaken in the Bernese Oberland. Ideal for both summer and winter holidays, this charming hotel resides in a traditional building with a warm and friendly atmosphere. Its 38 meticulously decorated rooms feature warm alpine wood, creating a cozy and inviting ambiance. Enjoy stunning views of a typical Alpine valley from the hotel's privileged location at 1, 350 meters above sea level. The Beau-Site offers two delightful restaurants, relaxing gardens, a comfortable lounge, and a spa featuring a sauna, Turkish baths, and a fitness room. Located just 1 km from the Adelboden ski slopes, this hotel is a perfect choice for experiencing the beauty and excitement of the Swiss Alps.

152339.description: This hotel is set at the foot of the Sierra del Tallat. It boasts spectacular views over the Prades mountain range. The hotel lies just 6 km away from Vallbona de les Monges, an important village in the region, for its culture and monasteries. The hotel enjoys its stunning surroundings, revelling in the perfect blend of culture and natural beauty. The hotel blends effortlessly with its surroundings. The hotel is built on the site of a historical building, dating back to 1908. The hotel enjoys the ideal combination of traditional style and modern comfort. The guest rooms and suites are sumptuously designed. Guests are invited to take advantage of the many excellent facilities and services that the hotel has to offer.

name.content: Heywood House Hotel, BW Signature Collection

152348.description:
Built on the site of Liverpools first bank, the lovingly-restored Heywood House Hotel, BW Signature Collection combines original style with modern luxury. 
Just a stones throw from James Street station in the thriving business quarter, our 4-star boutique accommodation offers a comfortable base for exploring the sights and sounds of one of the most vibrant cities in the UK. 
Here, 35 individually-designed rooms are all equipped with air conditioning and Hypnos beds, while our luxurious balcony rooms have outdoor areas with seating and decking. 
Fan of The Beatles? The Cavern Club is only a five-minute walk away, while The Beatles Story museum is also nearby, amid the bustling bars and restaurants of Albert Dock. 
If you're a shopaholic, you'll love the trendsetting style of Liverpool One, while sports fans can soak up the atmosphere at some of the most iconic venues in the country, whether you're having a flutter at Aintree or cheering on your team at Anfield. 
Due to vicinity of a night club some external noise may be experienced over the weekends.

152350.description: The team at ibis Birmingham Centre New Street Station prides itself on always going above and beyond from the speediest check-in systems in the city, free WiFi and healthy hot buffet breakfast to a guaranteed warm welcome around the clock. As an added bonus, our trendy, laidback bar and restaurant offers relaxing spots for enjoying drinks and dinner. Throw in on-site private parking plus excellent modern business facilities and it is easy to see why we remain a top pick for regular visitors to Birmingham.

152605.description: Traveling with friends, as a couple, or with colleagues? Kabannas Newcastle is perfect for group travellers, friends, couples, and business professionals alike. Enjoy our comfortable rooms, on-site restaurant and bar, welcoming staff, and unbeatable central location. Looking for an affordable hotel in Newcastle? Kabannas is your go-to choice! Whether you're planning a cheap city break in Newcastle, a mid-week getaway, or a business trip - we provide budget-friendly, cozy accommodation in Newcastle's city centre that doesn't compromise on comfort. Situated in the lively heart of Newcastle, Kabannas is just a short stroll from Newcastle Central Station, Grainger Town and Grey's Quarter. Step outside and immerse yourself in Newcastle's nightlife, explore the city's historic landmarks, or unwind in our on-site cinema room, bar and cafe.

152661.description: This 5 star hotel is located in the city centre of Grindelwald and was established in 1892. It is 18. 0 Km from the Interlaken and the nearest station is Grindelwald. The Hotel has 2 restaurants, a bar, a conference room and an indoor swimming pool. All 83 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe and ironing set.

152703.address: Jl. Kolonel Sugiono Tanjung Pinggir Sekupang
152703.description: Nestled along the pristine shores of Batam Island, KTM Resort was born from a vision of blending habitation with untouched natural beauty. Founded in 2000, our resort began as a secluded retreat for travelers seeking serenity, and over the years, it has evolved into a haven of world-class hospitality.

152745.description: Discover the Holiday Inn in Jesmond, a leafy neighbourhood just a mile from Newcastle's city centre. With 119 stylish ensuite bedrooms, this contemporary hotel provides a comfortable base for your Newcastle adventure. Immerse yourself in the vibrant local scene near Jesmond's Osborne Road, known for its bars, shops, and restaurants. Explore iconic Newcastle attractions, universities, and parks on foot, and take advantage of multi-story parking with electric vehicle charging points for adventures beyond the city. The Holiday Inn Jesmond offers a Fitness Centre, free Wi-Fi, in-room safes, and complimentary toiletries for your comfort. Enjoy traditional Italian cuisine at Fratello’s and unwind with an extensive wine and cocktail menu at Zio’s Bar & Grill, offering light bites and meals. With versatile function rooms, it's ideal for conferences, meetings, events, and weddings. Experience a memorable stay blending comfort, convenience, and local charm in Newcastle.

152748.description: Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. Skiers will be in heaven, but there are recreational options available for non-skiers as well, which include a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, an arcade/game room, and ski storage. You'll be on the slopes in no time with the complimentary ski shuttle. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and luggage storage. A train station pick-up service is provided at no charge. Stay in one of 30 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature bathtubs or showers, hair dryers, and bathrobes. Conveniences include safes, housekeeping is provided daily, and cribs/infant beds (surcharge) can be requested.

152751.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Meiringen and was established in 1880. It is a short drive away from the Meiringen and the nearest station is n/a. The Hotel has 2 restaurants, a bar, a conference room, an indoor swimming pool, an outdoor swimming pool and a fitness centre/gym. All 71 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer, safe and trouser press.

152752.description: Ideally located in the main street of Wengen, just a stone's throw from the Männlichen cable car, Braunbär Hotel & Spa is the 4-star gem of the resort. The existing building has undergone a complete renovation and refurbishment to infuse a new spirit, blending refinement and authenticity. Thanks to carefully selected wood and materials, the atmosphere exudes elegance and warmth. All the 4-star services provided ensure that guests enjoy a memorable stay.

152788.description: In the Swiss glacier village of Grindelwald, guests can expect an ice-crowned mountain backdrop with the star cast of the Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau. If you want to marvel at this sight from the front row, the Sunstar Hotel Grindelwald is the right place for you. The range of activities on offer in the Jungfrau Region is as varied as its natural spectacle. After relaxing in the wellness area, it's time to recharge your batteries and focus on indulgence. This is easy at the Adler Restaurant and Ambience. This is where families meet business people, adrenaline junkies meet romantics and influencers meet people who simply want to be offline.

152884.description: Perfectly positioned on the waterfront with stunning views of the brilliant blue-green sea, Kingsgate Hotel Autolodge Paihia is the ideal base from which you can explore the 144 islands in Bay of Islands. Also known as the 'Jewel of the magnificent Bay of Islands', Paihia is an aquatic playground. Featuring 100 rooms and 13 waterfront suites, the hotel also offers amenities including a swimming pool, an indoor spa, and games room. McKenzie's Restaurant & Bar on the first floor (stair access only) provides a waterfront panorama to accompany your meal. Delight in views over the bay at Paihia View Point, hike to the breath-taking Haruru Falls, or swim with playful dolphins on one of the many tours. Enjoy a slower pace of life right here. Stay and discover our distinctive hospitality.

152892.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 6 outdoor swimming pools, an outdoor tennis court, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a picnic area. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include multilingual staff, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 21 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring microwaves and DVD players. Rooms have private balconies or patios. 55-inch flat-screen televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected.

152921.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include shopping on site and complimentary use of a nearby fitness facility. Stop by the hotel's bar/lounge, Henderson Bar and Kitchen, for dinner or brunch, or grab snacks at the coffee shop/cafe. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Make yourself at home in one of the 51 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

153000.address: Blvd. Miguel de la Madrid Km 8.5
153000.description: The property is located in the hotel district, just 10 minutes from the centre of Manzanillo. The hotel is situated on the wide, sandy beach and close to the commercial area, which features excellent Mexican and international restaurants, lively bars, popular nightclubs and wide selection of shops, all within easy reach. The bus station is located approximately 25 minutes away and Lake Cuyutlán roughly 30 minutes away, each by public transport. The Turtle Sanctuary and Peña Blanca are each about a 30-minute drive away. This is a family-friendly hotel is set on the beach, with a 124 m² area for sunbathing. The rooms are decorated in tropical, Mexican style and have beautiful ocean views. Playa de Oro Manzanillo International Airport is 25 minutes away.

153296.description: The hotel is situated on a quiet street close to Victoria Station, in the historic Belgravia district. London's museums, the theatres of the West End and the shops of Knightsbridge are about 100 m from the hotel. Restaurants, bars and nightclubs are a short walk away, as are bus, train and underground services. Buckingham Palace and Westminster Cathedral are a short walk away, as is Hyde Park. The hotel offers contemporary services, traditional hospitality and a tranquil atmosphere.

153438.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional features at this hotel include concierge services, an arcade/game room, and wedding services. Grab a bite at Parklands Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 3 bars/lounges. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 148 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and LCD televisions. Your room comes with a Select Comfort bed. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.
