The nearest airports are: Birmingham Airport (BHX) - 22. 1 km / 13. 8 mi East Midlands Airport (EMA) - 43. 4 km / 26. 9 mi The preferred airport for Drayton Manor Hotel is Birmingham Airport (BHX).

153441.address: St Marys Street, Imperial Gate, Cardiff
153441.description: Located on St Mary's Street in the heart of Cardiff city centre, this hotel is just a 15-minute walk from Cardiff Central train station, Cardiff bus station and Cardiff Bay. The Millennium Stadium is just 500 metres from the hotel and there is a Walkabout late-night bar directly below the hotel. The family-friendly business hotel is air-conditioned and offers comfortable rooms, an excellent location and affordable accommodation. For the convenience of guests there is a bar and a café. There is also a breakfast room and wireless Internet access point. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-out service, as well as lift access to the upper floors. All rooms come with a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer, and offer a double bed. The rooms also come equipped with a satellite TV, Internet access, individually regulated heating and tea and coffee making facilities as standard.

153449.description: This city centre hotel is located opposite the Grand Theatre, less than 5 minutes' walk from the main shopping and nightlife areas. The non-smoking establishment is air-conditioned and offers contemporary quality accommodation with spacious modern rooms. There is a bar/cafe serving breakfast and dinner and the family-friendly residence also offers wireless Internet access. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, where they will find a 24-hour reception and check-out service, as well as lift access to the upper floors. Those arriving by car may leave their vehicles in the hotel car park. All rooms come with an en-suite bathroom and feature individually regulated heating, satellite TV and tea and coffee making facilities as standard.

153589.description: Situated on the River Tyne with Quayside views, this contemporary hotel is within 300 meters of the Gateshead Millennium Bridge and Sage Gateshead. It offers stylish, comfortable rooms, some with river vistas. Guests can unwind in the restaurant and bar, or take advantage of amenities including Wi-Fi, air conditioning, car parking, and lift access. Business travellers will appreciate the conference facilities. Each en suite room features a shower, bath, hairdryer, double bed, telephone, and TV, along with individually controlled air conditioning and heating. Nearby, guests can enjoy a sandy, pebble, and rocky beach. A continental buffet breakfast is served daily.

name.content: ibis Birmingham Airport - NEC (new ibis rooms)

153696.description: Ibis Birmingham International Airport hotel is a modern hotel located 100m from Birmingham International Airport, within walking distance to the NEC, Resorts World, Genting Arena and BHX train station. We offer 162 recently renovated bedrooms, free WIFI, restaurant and bar open 24/7. You can pick up a snack or relax with a nightcap in the friendly bar. Please note that the hotel does not have its own car park. We suggest booking parking online with NCP directly.

153828.description: This charming hotel is conveniently located in Leeds's business district and a short walk from the city's pedestrianized area. Nearby, guests will find a selection of interesting museums, vibrant nightclubs, and cozy restaurants. The hotel is well-connected to public transport, adjacent to Leeds City railway station and a stone's throw from a bus and coach station. The comfortable, bright guest rooms are ideal for a restful night's sleep, whether traveling for business or leisure. Rooms are equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi for those who need to stay connected and coffee and tea making facilities for added comfort. Guests can enjoy a continental buffet breakfast each morning.

name.content: Citrus Hotel Cardiff by Compass Hospitality

153864.description: Ideally located in Cardiff City Centre opposite the Motorpoint Arena and the new St. David's shopping arcade, Citrus Hotel Cardiff (Formerly The Big Sleep Hotel Cardiff) is within walking distance of the Cafe Quarter, local tourist attractions and businesses. Recently refurbished, Citrus Hotel Cardiff offers 83 bedrooms and is designed to meet all your needs and offer you complete comfort during your visit to Cardiff. The hotel is a pet-friendly hotel. All rooms are well equipped with the necessary facilities for your comfort during your stay. This fabulous Cardiff City Centre Hotel is perfect for those looking for budget accommodation with a difference – great value with a designer feel. All bedrooms have Wi-Fi, complimentary tea and coffee making facilities, Super King Beds, Smart TV, views of the city. Car parking is available on a first come first parked basis and is chargeable.

153998.description: Situated in Swindon, the Delta Hotels by Marriott Swindon is a short drive from the Wyvern Theatre and STEAM Museum. This upscale hotel offers 156 guestrooms with 49-inch flat-screen TVs, private bathrooms, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy an indoor pool, outdoor tennis court, sauna, and spa with massages and facials. The on-site Cast Iron Bar & Grill serves British cuisine, and 24-hour room service is available. Additional amenities include a business center and ample meeting space. For those looking to explore, the Swindon Designer Outlet and Lydiard Park are within a short driving distance.

154001.description: A thoughtfully designed hotel close to Cambridge, with onsite parking (chargeable) and excellent transport links. B&B Hotel Cambridge South is 5 minutes from the M11 motorway. We’re next door to Whittlesford Parkway station, which has direct trains to Cambridge, a 10-minute ride, and London Liverpool Street. If you're flying from Stansted Airport (STN), it's only 20 miles away, straight up the M11. For a day out, explore Cambridge University or go punting on the River Cam. Kids love the vintage aircraft at the nearby Imperial War Museum Duxford. If you’re here on business, hold a private gathering in our air-conditioned meeting room that holds up to 15 people boardroom style. The scientific labs at Granta Park and Chesterford Research Park are a short drive away and the conference facilities of the Wellcome Genome Campus are close by. The Duxford Hotel Cambridge South - M11 Jct. 10 provides free WiFi throughout the hotel. In the lounge and restaurant you can enjoy a buffet breakfast or lunch and dinner ordered from our available menu with drinks from our bar.

154026.description: Originally built in the 1800s as one of the city’s very first power stations, a building that lit the path for Glasgow’s development, the Hotel Indigo® Glasgow hotel today puts you close to a new kind of buzz—local cuisine, world-class shopping, museums, historic theatres and sporting events.  Our hotel’s design mixes Victorian architecture, high ceilings, and original brown brick with modern comfort. Murals by local artists line the walls, while our restaurant serves local dishes prepared with fresh, locally sourced ingredients. It’s a great place to chat over a brew and look for the famous local Glaswegians depicted in the mural above diners’ heads.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Edinburgh Royal Mile

154029.description: Located in the heart of the historic city of Edinburgh, Holiday Inn Express® Edinburgh – Royal Mile is where comfort and Scottish charm come together. Catch trains to Glasgow and London from the nearby Edinburgh Waverley station or take off from Edinburgh Airport (EDI), 30 minutes away. Situated steps away from iconic landmarks and cultural treasures, such as the magnificent Edinburgh Castle and the Royal Mile, our hotel allows you to get lost in the city's buzzing atmosphere. For those looking to explore the natural wonders of Edinburgh, we’re an eight-minute walk from Holyrood Park, offering breathtaking views of Arthur's Seat. Culture enthusiasts will be delighted to find the National Museum of Scotland and the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh within easy reach, providing a glimpse into Scotland's fascinating past and its diverse botanical wonders. No visit to Edinburgh is complete without a trip to Calton Hill, just 12 minutes away and soak in panoramic views of the city and the striking Scottish National Monument. Additionally, history buffs can explore the impressive Royal Yacht Britannia and discover the grandeur of the Palace of Holyroodhouse, the official residence of the British monarch in Scotland. Unwind in our modern hotel. Rooms feature handy amenities like free Wi-Fi and ironing facilities. Start your day off right with our free buffet breakfast, offering tasty hot and cold items.

154030.description: Located just off the A14/M11 at Junction 28, this Ramada Cambridge hotel offers convenient access to Cambridge, Huntingdon, Newmarket, and Stansted Airport. Nearby attractions include the Fitzwilliam Museum, Cambridge University, the Cambridge American Cemetery and Memorial, as well as business parks such as Buckingway and Cambridge Science Park. Hotel amenities include paid parking, complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs with Freeview, and ergonomic workspaces. A variety of dining options, including McDonald's, Burger King, KFC, and M&S Simply Food, are available on-site. Pets are not permitted.

name.content: Ramada By Wyndham South Mimms M25

154045.description: Located just off the M25 at Junction 23, the Ramada London South Mimms offers convenient access to London attractions such as Wembley Stadium (a 30-minute drive) and Emirates Stadium. The hotel provides complimentary parking and each room features free Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV, a comfortable Hypnos bed, and tea/coffee making facilities. Guests can enjoy onsite dining at the hotel restaurant. Please note, pets are not allowed.

154137.description: This hotel is located in Crans Montana, in the Swiss alps. The nearest bus stop is 100 m from the hotel and it is about 200 m to the Violettesbahn Crans Montana ski area. Guests will find the town centre and the shopping facilities 2 km away. This hotel offers a peaceful and rustic setting with breathtaking views. Guests can expect a warm welcome and quality service, ensuring they enjoy an unforgettable stay. Facilities on offer to guests include a lobby, a cloakroom, lift access, a bar and a restaurant. Guests will appreciate the wireless Internet access and there is parking available for those arriving by car. All rooms come with a private bathroom with a bathtub and a hairdryer. They are equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, a radio and Internet access. Furthermore, a safe and a minibar are provided in all accommodation units as standard and all rooms feature either a balcony or a terrace. This hotel offers a restaurant with a difference where guests can select their breakfast from a buffet on the splendid veranda.

154140.description: This 3 star hotel is located within the city of Leysin and was established in 1975. It is a short drive away from the Montreux and the nearest station is Leysin Fedey. The Hotel has a restaurant, a bar, an indoor swimming pool and a fitness centre/gym. All 129 rooms are equipped with hairdryer, safe and ironing set.

154143.description: This hotel enjoys a quiet location on the outskirts of the city, 300 m from Lake Brienz and about 560 m from the high altitude resort. The city centre, shops and park are 1 km away, and the train station 2 km. Guests will find the nearest ski area 8 km from the property (Brienz-Axalp) and it is about 12 km to Meiringen-Hasliber and 18 km to Bödeli Interlaken. This family-friendly ski hotel places particular value on genuine hospitality, flexibility and warm professional service. The hotel focuses on offering guests an unforgettable stay. Facilities on offer to guests include lift access, a children's playground and a fine restaurant with a terrace. Guests will appreciate the Internet access and there is free parking for those arriving by car. All rooms come with a private bathroom with a shower/bathtub and a hairdryer. They are equipped with satellite/cable TV, a radio and Internet access. All units feature either a balcony or a terrace. Guests can enjoy a game of table tennis at the hotel, should they wish. Guests may select their breakfast from a buffet.

154147.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional amenities at this hotel include concierge services, wedding services, and a picnic area. Enjoy international cuisine at Mary Beale, a restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge, take in the garden view, and even dine alfresco. You can also stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. English breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-in. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 59 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

154187.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, an arcade/game room, and ski storage. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is included. Featured amenities include luggage storage, laundry facilities, and a library. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 42 guestrooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have bathtubs or showers and bathrobes. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and complimentary bottled water. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Swiss Alps Jungfrau-Aletsch - 0.

154231.description: 'Our Birmingham Central Broadway Plaza hotel is conveniently located for the Edgbaston cricket ground and the University of Birmingham, and a short walk from the atmospheric Symphony Hall and the Birmingham Museum and Art Gallery. Step back in time at the National Trust's Back to Backs or visit the nearby National Sea Life Centre. Embrace your inner chocoholic at Cadbury World or commune with nature at Winterbourne House Botanic Gardens. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals.

154236.description:
"Our Cambridge Fourwentways hotel sits beside the pretty village of Little Abington, in a handy location east of Cambridge city centre. Granta Park and Abington Hall Conference Centre are just down the road - perfect for business travellers.

Spend a day soaking up the stories of the past at the Imperial War Museum, Duxford, then head into Cambridge city centre for a show at the Corn Exchange and a pint or two in one of the traditional pubs.

All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a variety of food and drink choices within easy walking distance from this hotel."

154237.description:
This city hotel is conveniently located at Atlantic Wharf in Cardiff Bay, just a two-minute walk from Cardiff Bay station and a short walk from Cardiff Central station.  Millennium Stadium and Cardiff Castle are within walking distance, and the National Museum of Cardiff, Cardiff University, and Bute Park are within easy reach.  Guests can find entertainment options such as bowling, cinema and shopping right next door at the Red Dragon Centre.
The hotel's cosy and functional rooms feature Travelodge's signature king-sized ‘Dreamer Beds' in addition to standard amenities such as private en suite bathrooms and tea and coffee facilities.  Guests can start a busy day with a delicious breakfast buffet in the café bar with options such as bacon, scrambled eggs and tomato, and unwind at the end of the day with a drink to accompany classic pub fare such as fish and chips or pie and mash, all for an exciting weekend city break.

154238.description: 'Our Inverness Fairways hotel is next to the golf course a few miles outside Inverness city centre, so after 18 holes you can be back in time for a show at the Eden Court Theatre. With Inverness' privileged position at the head of the Great Glen on the Moray Firth, you can go dolphin watching and highland walking on the very same day, and of course, don't miss a chance to spot Nessie!All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a wide variety of food and drink choices within a short car journey from the hotel. '

154241.description: This property is situated close to a number of points of interest and attractions in Liverpool. The hotel is located within easy access of the National Museum of Liverpool, the Royal Philharmonic Hall and Chester Zoo. The UK's largest designer outlet, Cheshire Oaks, is also situated nearby. Links to the public transport network can be found in the area. This wonderful hotel appeals to business and leisure travellers alike. Tastefully-designed guest rooms come complete with modern amenities. Guests are invited to take advantage of the many excellent facilities and services that this charming hotel has to offer.

154245.description: Located in the heart of Newcastle-upon-Tyne, the Travelodge Newcastle Central offers convenient access to the Quayside, just a 5-minute walk away. Enjoy a complimentary breakfast and unwind at the bar/lounge or take advantage of room service during limited hours. The hotel features 129 guestrooms equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi and private bathrooms with bathtubs and hair dryers. Additional amenities include express check-out, an elevator, and self-parking (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include the Gateshead Millennium Bridge, St. James' Park, and the High Level Bridge. Newcastle International Airport (NCL) is approximately 7. 6 miles from the hotel.

154252.description: 'Our Stansted Great Dunmow hotel is perfectly placed if you want to just pack up and fly off - it's an easy 12-minute drive to the airport. And it's easy to find, thanks to its convenient location just off the M11. The historic Roman village of Great Dunmow is a stone's throw away. Wander the cobbled streets enjoying the friendly atmosphere and then stop for a pint in one of the cosy local pubs. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals.

154253.description:
Just a short drive from Junction 15 of the M6, this hotel is situated next to the Trentham Village Toby Carvery, 6 km south of Newcastle-under-Lyme on the A5035. The nearest railway station is 9.6 km from the hotel.

This budget hotel has a variety of facilities including a lobby, 24-hour reception and check-out service, lift access and a car park. The hotel has a total of 23 guest rooms. WLAN Internet access is available for a fee throughout the hotel.

The en suite rooms are spacious and comfy. They are well equipped with a shower, tea and coffee making facilities as well as an ironing set. Additional facilities include a satellite/cable TV, Internet access and individually regulated heating.

Leave the M6 at J15 and follow the A500 until the slip road for the A34. At the roundabout turn right onto the A34 towards Stone and at the next roundabout turn left onto the A5035. The hotel is located 800 m on the right.

155255.description: A relaxing Antrim hotel near Belfast city centre, with a restaurant, free Wi-Fi and meeting facilitiesHoliday Inn Express® Antrim - M2, Jct. 1 hotel is situated in The Junction Retail Park, convenient for snapping up bargains from high-street favourites and designer brands. You can be in Belfast city centre within a half-hour drive. Belfast International Airport (BFS) is five miles down the road, and Belfast City Airport (BHD) is half an hour away. The hotel offers Park, Stay & Go packages for holidaymakers. Antrim train station is a 10-minute drive from the hotel, and you can reach Coleraine or Londonderry in about an hour. Just off the M2 motorway, the hotel has its own business centre in the lobby, and there are four meeting rooms, the largest seating up to 40 people. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, and there is extensive free parking on site. The Giant's Causeway, an impressive natural formation of basalt columns, is a 55-minute drive away, along the Causeway Coastal Route, while a 10-minute walk brings you to the pretty Antrim Gardens. In the evenings, browse the à la carte menu in the hotel's Great Room, or relax in the lounge. The included Express Start Breakfast is a full Irish breakfast and features eggs, sausages, bacon, tomato and baked beans, plus continental items.

155257.description: A stylish London hotel offering upscale dining, an indoor pool and a spa. Crowne Plaza® London Docklands hotel offers stylish accommodation a six-minute walk from the ExCeL London exhibition centre. London City Airport is a 10-minute cab ride from the hotel. The O2 arena is 15 minutes away by the IFS Cloud Cable Car car over the Thames; Custom House Elizabeth Line station and Royal Victoria DLR station is only five minutes' walk away. From there, trains can whisk you to Canary Wharf in 15 minutes or to Bank station in the City in 25 minutes. You can host conferences for up to 275 people in our eight flexible meeting rooms, with natural light, AV equipment and free Wi-Fi. There's a breakout area for networking, and our Crowne Plaza Meetings Director can manage all the little details. After a busy day, you can swim a few lengths of the indoor pool, work up a sweat in the fully equipped gym or book a beauty treatment in the spa. If you have time, ride the IFS Cloud Cable Car over the river to check out The O2's buzzing bars and restaurants. The airy Docklands Bar &Grill serves breakfast, as well as juicy steaks, burgers and international dishes for lunch and dinner. Enjoy views over the docks from the covered terrace. Relax with a glass of wine or a cocktail in our modern bar, or take it really easy and order from our 24-hour room-service menu.

155259.description: Located just a few minutes' driving distance from Heathrow Airport, this property will appeal to every type of traveller. It offers the ideal accommodation for business guests or for a stopover, as the airport terminals are just 5 minutes from the hotel. Several golf clubs are in the surrounding area, making this property a great choice for those who enjoy a leisurely game on green. Complimentary public buses will transfer guests from Heathrow Central bus station to Blunts Avenue and Sipson Way, and guests can also buy tickets in the ticket machine situated in the lobby to travel between Heathrow Airport and the hotel. The guest rooms offer comfort and convenience, including triple-glazed windows to guarantee a restful night sleep. This establishment features a stylish restaurant as well as a mini gym, ideal to enjoy an invigorating workout after a busy day of work. There is also a parking monitored for guests’ convenience. The excellent facilities guarantee that the needs of every type of traveller are fully catered for.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Leeds City Centre Armouries

155262.description: Discover the comfort and convenience of Holiday Inn Express Leeds City Centre - Armouries, ideally located next to the iconic Royal Armouries Museum in the vibrant Leeds Dock area. Whether you're here for business or leisure, our welcoming and reliable hotel offers everything you need for a great stay. We're just a short 10-minute walk from both Leeds city centre and the train station, with easy access to the M621. Plus, enjoy discounted parking at the nearby multi-storey car park. Relax in our cozy, air-conditioned rooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, perfect for any traveler. We're also pet-friendly, so you can bring your furry companions along (charge applies). Start your day right with a free buffet breakfast with all your favourites. If you're looking for more, our modern bar and restaurant serve delicious meals around the clock, with a full dinner menu available. Our location puts you within walking distance of local attractions, including Leeds Dock’s bars, restaurants, and the Royal Armouries Museum. The nearby Leeds city centre offers a variety of shops, dining, entertainment, stunning architecture, and a lively nightlife scene. Be sure to explore The Calls, the Victoria Quarter, and the historic Leeds Corn Exchange, all just a short walk away. For business needs, our modern meeting rooms accommodate up to 80 attendees, making us a top choice for events and gatherings in Leeds.

155270.description: The Sporthotel Wildstrubel in Lenk im Simmental offers a wellness area with an indoor pool, a steam bath and a sauna, as well as free WiFi and free parking on site. All rooms at the Wildstrubel Sporthotel are equipped with satellite TV, a seating corner, a mini-bar and a safe. Some rooms have a balcony. The restaurant features a panoramic terrace and serves Swiss and Mediterranean cuisine. The bar with an open fireplace is a cozy place to relax after a day out in the mountains. Lenk Train Station and various bus lines can be found right next to the Sporthotel Wildstrubel. During the summer season the SIMMENTAL CARD is included in the rate and offers free access to all bus routes in Lenk (except the Laubbärgli route) and discounts on certain summer activities. During the winter season, all bus routes in Lenk can be used free of charge and guests can benefit from further discounts for certain winter activities.

155310.description: Excellently positioned to explore London, this hotel is located in the heart of Kensington. This Mid-Victorian building is typical of the area’s white Italianate façades with stately doric columns. Numerous restaurants, bars and small coffee shops are close-by, famous attractions such as Royal Albert Hall, Buckingham Palace, Natural History Museum, the West End Theatres or Stamford Bridge, home of Chelsea FC are within easy reach. Kensington High Street, Hyde Park, Knightsbridge and Harrods are within walking distance. The breakfasts are freshly prepared and served daily in the elegant dining room. Guests can relax at the elegant lounge, with the cosy fireplace. The cosy rooms have fresh, modern décor, a tv, tea and coffee making facilities and a private bathroom with toiletries.

155583.description: With easy access to the M62/M1 motorways, this hotel and spa complex is situated just 10 km from Leeds' city centre. This stylish, air-conditioned hotel and spa has 117 rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe as well as lift access to the upper floors. Guests can enjoy a drink at the cafe and bar, and dine in the creative, boutique-style restaurant. All rooms are en suite with a shower, bath and a hairdryer. Rooms also come equipped with a satellite/cable TV, a minibar and tea and coffee making facilities. Individually regulated air conditioning is a standard feature of all accommodation. The hotel features a modern spa with indoor swimming pool as well as a fitness and leisure centre. Guests can unwind on the sun terrace, work out in the gym, or relax in the sauna and steam room.

155986.description: 'Enjoy a stylish stay at this Art Deco hotel, conveniently located in Birmingham's vibrant shopping district near Hurst Street. Indulge in British cuisine at Collage, the hotel's restaurant and bar, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Amenities include a fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a 24-hour business center. Each of the 211 air-conditioned rooms features a flat-screen TV with satellite programming, a private bathroom, and a laptop-compatible safe. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel is conveniently located near several local attractions including the Alexandra Theatre and the Birmingham Hippodrome. Birmingham Airport (BHX) is the closest airport. '

156078.description: Mercure St Helens is conveniently situated in the heart of the town. The hotel is close to major transport links and boasts free onsite parking, so getting to Manchester and Liverpool is easy. As well as a 24-hour front desk, onsite restaurant, and sports bar with Sky and BT Sports channels, Mercure St Helens features a range of leisure facilities. Sink into the swimming pool, sauna, or jacuzzi, or unwind in the fully equipped gym. For business or leisure, Mercure St Helens is a perfect hotel choice.

156119.description: Mercure Birmingham West Hotel is conveniently situated just five miles from Birmingham city centre, and is close to the M5 and other major transport links, making it easy to access wherever you're coming from. With 168 bright, spacious, and comfortable rooms available and Wi-Fi included throughout, the hotel is perfect for those visiting Birmingham on business or leisure. Guests are welcome to make use of our onsite leisure facilities, which include a heated pool, spa, steam room and multi gyms.

156205.description: Featuring a seamless blend of comfort and modern technology, this family-friendly business hotel welcomes guests for an unforgettable stay in Cardiff. All the guest rooms at this golf hotel are very comfortable and come with modern amenities. Guests are welcomed in a lobby and there is a fabulous restaurant. Business guests will appreciate the conference facilities available. The hotel is situated 19 km from the airport of Cardiff.

156206.description: Set in beautiful parkland and less than 5 minutes’ drive from the M62 motorway, the Gomersal Park Hotel offers free on-site parking and free WiFi. The luxurious Dream Spa offers facilities and treatments, with discounted entry to the spa for staying guests. A flat-screen TV and DVD player are provided in each room at the Gomersal Hotel. All bathrooms include a selection of toiletries and a hairdryer. Fresh, seasonal produce is served in the stylish restaurant, 'Latitude 53'. Guests can dine in the light, high ceiled dining room or on the terrace seating area which features views across the garden. Oakwell Hall, a manor house set in 110 acres of land, is less than 1 mile away. Red House Museum, a historic house and museum, is a 5-minute drive from the Gomersal Hotel. Leeds city center is a 15-minute drive away and Bradford is less than 10 minutes’ drive.

156207.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Grab a bite to eat at Fire Lake, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Leeds? This hotel has 0 square feet (0 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Stay in one of 147 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.

156212.description: This monumental townhouse, dating back to 1926, offers classic and comfortable accommodations. Each room is decorated in warm colors and features modern amenities. Business travelers have access to conference facilities and Wi-Fi. Tourists can enjoy a scenic 15-minute walk along Bruges' canal to the Basilica of the Holy Blood and the Belfry, or a short 10-minute stroll to the Grote Markt Square and city center. After a day of exploring, relax at the on-site bar and sample excellent Belgian beers. Breakfast is available for €15 per person. A city tax of €3. 00 per person, per night applies to all bookings and is payable directly to the hotel. Pets are not permitted. Check-in begins at 4:00 PM. Luggage storage is available for early arrivals. Two private parking spaces are available for €25 per day (not suitable for vans). Please vacate parking spaces by 12:00 PM on your departure day. Contact us to reserve parking.

156248.description: The Bloc Hotel, nestled in Birmingham's vibrant Jewellery Quarter, offers a unique village atmosphere surrounded by cafes, bars, restaurants, and convenient access to business, shopping, arts, and sports facilities. Inspired by Japanese pod hotels, our rooms are more akin to luxury yacht cabins, boasting king-size beds with luxurious linens, climate control, en-suite wet rooms with monsoon showers, 32-inch Samsung LED flat-screen TVs, and high-speed Wi-Fi. Birmingham's central location and excellent transport links provide quick and easy access to the motorway network, national rail, and international flights.

156249.address: Royal Victoria Dock, One Eastern Gateway
156249.description: Take advantage of recreational opportunities offered, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, a banquet hall, and bike parking. Enjoy a satisfying meal at Docksider Restaurant serving guests of Aloft London Excel. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-in. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 252 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is available. Bathrooms feature showers with rainfall showerheads. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.

156252.description: Turi Beach Resort, a family-friendly eco-hotel, is a 35-minute ferry ride from Singapore, offering convenient access to shopping, cultural, and entertainment hubs within a 20- to 35-minute drive. Located a short drive from Nongsapura Ferry Terminal (5 minutes), Batam Center (15 minutes), Nagoya (20 minutes), Harbour Bay (25 minutes), and the airport (10 minutes), this air-conditioned resort offers 140 rooms. Guests can enjoy a variety of amenities including a game room, TV lounge, café, bar, pub, disco, restaurant, and Wi-Fi. Each room features an en suite bathroom, individually controlled air conditioning and heating, and a private balcony or terrace. The resort also boasts two outdoor swimming pools with a children's area, a poolside snack bar, and a sun terrace. Active guests can enjoy biking, golf, tennis, pool/snooker, volleyball, beach volleyball, and an array of water sports such as water-skiing, jet skiing, diving, surfing, windsurfing, motor boating, banana boating, sailing, catamaran boating, and canoeing.

156266.address: Haunch Lane, Lea Marston, Sutton Coldfield
156266.description: Lea Marston Hotel is a delightful modern 4-star hotel set in 52 acres of countryside near Sutton Coldfield. Lea Marston Hotel offers 88 stylish, well appointed bedrooms with a contemporary style. All rooms feature en-suite bathrooms with luxury toiletries, free Wi-Fi access and plasma screen televisions. Excellent leisure facilities include a health club featuring indoor pool, whirlpool, sauna, steam room and gymnasium, plus a luxury spa with a rasul, hydrotherapy bath, relaxation area and spa treatment rooms offering indulgent spa treatments using leading beauty product Elemis. Complete with two 9-hole golf course onsite and a floodlit driving range this is the perfect place to relax and unwind. Lea Marston a great base to explore the local area and the many local places of interest including Drayton Manor Theme Park, the Bullring Shopping Centre in Birmingham city centre, Tamworth Castle, SnowDome, Warwick and Stratford. Lea Marston Hotel is a member of Classic British Hotels.

156382.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional features at this hotel include tour/ticket assistance and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Restaurant 66A, a restaurant which specializes in local and international cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are available daily from 8 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 49 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.

156384.description:
Located in Edinburgh's vibrant Cowgate, STAY Central offers more than just a good night's sleep. A short walk from major attractions, this hotel features 37 refurbished rooms, accommodating from two to six guests. Each room includes complimentary Wi-Fi, large flat-screen TVs, and rainfall showers, along with unexpected extras. Perfect for adult travelers (guests must be 12 or older), STAY Central offers a range of room types, from cozy doubles to spacious dorm-style accommodations equipped with modern amenities for a memorable stay in the heart of Edinburgh's bustling city center. 

Please be aware: downstairs bar atmosphere can be lively at night

156619.description: The hotel is situated only 800 metres west of the city centre on Sauchiehall Street. It is within minutes' walk of the Scottish Exhibition and Conference Centre, as well as Glasgow's art galleries and museums. An array of restaurants, bars and shops are also within walking distance of the property and the train station is some 1. 6 km away. This terraced guesthouse offers warm Scottish hospitality combined with several services and facilities, including wireless Internet access. There are 38 rooms in total and dining options include a café and a restaurant. All rooms feature a double bed, Internet access and air conditioning and central heating.

156620.description: Pool access: Hotel guests get access to the pool, Jacuzzi, sauna, steam room and relaxation room for £25. 00 per person for 2 hours. Please note these are adult-only facilities. Hilton London Syon Park is a hotel designed with comfort and convenience in mind, marrying the best of contemporary London with the finest traditions of an English country house estate. Conveniently located to the West of London, centrally positioned between London City Centre and London Heathrow Airport, Hilton London Syon Park offers a peaceful retreat from London’s cosmopolitan center, with 200 acres of idyllic parkland, convenient for both business and pleasure. 137 guest rooms and suites offer guests total comfort. All bathrooms have rain showers and HDTV. All rooms feature modern technology, wired and wireless internet access, 55 inch HDTVs and Media Hubs. The rooms have varying views, many benefiting from their own private balcony or terrace. The adults only hotel spa features a complimentary gymnasium, as well as 11 treatment suites, an indoor swimming pool, sauna, steam room, and whirlpool spa, which guests can access for an additional fee. Enjoy our restaurants - Mood in the Park and Syon Lounge. Syon Lounge offers wide variety of Sushi and other Japanese specialties whilst Mood in the Park offers contemporary & elegant cuisine. Ideal for everything from small meetings to large exhibitions and conferences, social events to weddings, the hotel features twelve flexible function suites with the latest technology, accommodating from 10 to 400 guests.

156643.description: The Cairn, situated only minutes walk from the town centre and Harrogate International Conference Centre, offers excellent value for money. We are renowned for our extremely friendly and efficient service, and are proud to offer a warm 'home from home' atmosphere where many guests return again and again. Please note, accommodation booked must be settled in full on arrival at the hotel.

156834.description: This charming and stylish hotel, ideal for family holidays, is nestled in the countryside just off the A6, only 5 km from Derry city centre. Recently restored, this historic hotel offers 19 tastefully decorated rooms, each featuring beautiful fabrics and wall coverings, a work desk, and a flat-screen TV. En suite bathrooms include a shower, bath, hairdryer, and complimentary toiletries. Enjoy amenities such as Wi-Fi, tea and coffee making facilities, and individually regulated heating and air conditioning. The hotel boasts a 24-hour reception, a hairdressing salon, a bar, a restaurant, and conference facilities. Local attractions include Altnagelvin Hospital (4 km), Learmount Forest (10 km), the 17th-century city walls, and St. Columb's Cathedral, all easily accessible via public transport located just outside the hotel. Derry Airport is 18 km away. From September to February, the hotel hosts Las Vegas Gala Cabaret nights, with evening entertainment in the Bistro every Friday and Saturday.

156955.description: A 20-minute walk from London's leading attractions, including the Victoria and Albert Museum, Hyde Park and some of the city's most exclusive shopping areas, this hotel enjoys a prime location in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. It offers contemporary style within an elegant setting in one of London’s most bustling and popular districts. The property features 171 well-appointed and modern rooms along with refurbished public areas. The stunningly crafted rooms meet the highest expectations of the guests. Each of these spacious rooms are carefully crafted to provide convenience and comfort. Guests can unwind and enjoy a cocktail at the onsite restaurant and bar which also offers live music and a delicious Thai and British Food menu. This state-of-the-art hotel is ideal for families or groups and is sure to provide a relaxing and memorable experience while visiting London. PROPERTY ENHANCEMENTS FROM JUNE 2025 – IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT YOUR STAYWe are currently making enhancements to the property to improve your experience. As the property is historic, dating back to the 19th century, we are making necessary upgrades to preserve and enhance its legacy. Work is taking place daily, and while there may be minor disruptions during your stay, we will make every effort to minimize any inconvenience.

157118.description: This hotel is superbly placed in London's premier commercial and cultural centre. Park Lane, Piccadilly, The Royal Academy of the Arts, Buckingham Palace, Bond Street, Green Park and Hyde Park are a few minutes' walk away, as are Oxford Street, Piccadilly Circus, Regent Street and Knightsbridge. There is a plethora range of restaurants, bars and clubs in the vicinity. Facilities include a lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, lift access and currency exchange, a café, bar and restaurant. The hotel also offers conference facilities, Wi-Fi, and room and laundry services.

name.content: London Chigwell Prince Regent BW Signature

157292.description: The hotel is located just 10 minutes' drive from the M11 motorway and less than 3 km from Woodford Underground Station. There are numerous restaurants, bars and shops within walking distance. This 61-room city hotel is a listed Georgian building and a unique conversion of an old chapel. It offers a range of services and facilities, including a lobby with 24-hour reception and a hotel safe. Additionally a bar, a restaurant and a beautiful terrace are on site. The en suite rooms are equipped with a shower and a bath as well as a double bed. Additional amenities include a direct dial telephone and satellite/cable TV, and tea and coffee making facilities. A terrace also comes in all rooms as standard. There is a golf course located directly beside the hotel. In addition to a continental breakfast, guests can enjoy A la carte and set menu options for both lunch and dinner.

157343.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and a television in a common area. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Make yourself at home in one of the 90 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and Smart televisions. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Shopping District - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- The Mailbox - 0. 1 km / 0.

160749.description: The guesthouse is located in a listed Victorian building in the area of Stockbridge in Edinburgh, within a short walk from the Royal Botanical Gardens, Princes Street or Edinburgh Castle. The Edinburgh International Conference Centre, the Stand Comedy Club and the Scottish Gallery are also close-by. A bus stop is 50 m away. Features of the non-smoking guesthouse include WIFI, express check-out and luggage storage.

160906.description: Located in Dublin's City Centre, Albany House is a charming bed and breakfast within a short walk of St. Stephen's Green and Grafton Street. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and cable programming in each of the 50 guestrooms, along with conveniences such as coffee/tea makers and hair dryers. A continental breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel also offers a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box. Trinity College and St. Patrick's Cathedral are within a kilometer. Dublin Airport (DUB) is approximately 17. 5 km away.

161062.description: Right at the hub of London's rail network, Premier Inn London King's Cross puts the capital and Europe on your doorstep. With easy connections across the UK, France and Belgium, the world's your oyster. . . or moules-frites! Hop aboard the Eurostar for that early connection to Paris or DisneyLand. Wander to Camden for cool bars and bargain hunting. Or tick off the capital's must-see sights, from the London Eye to the O2 arena. Whether it's 'bon voyage', or 'welcome home', our friendly team and new, modern rooms will make sure you start the day with a spring in your step. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

161166.description: Enjoy a luxurious stay at the 47 Park Street - Grand Residences by Marriott in the heart of London. Located a short walk from Hyde Park and Grosvenor Square, this upscale vacation home offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). The 49 guestrooms feature kitchenettes, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, iPod docking stations, and satellite TV. Guests can also enjoy 24-hour room service and continental breakfast (available for a fee). Additional amenities include wired internet access, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, airport shuttle (surcharge), and on-site self-parking (surcharge).

161190.description: The 4-star Roganstown Hotel & Country Club offers the convenience of an airport hotel while nestled in the countryside, just eight minutes from Dublin Airport's main terminal. A shuttle bus operates to and from the airport daily between 7 am and 11 pm. The hotel features 52 modern bedrooms, most with king-size beds, along with restaurants, bars, and a full leisure club including a pool, steam room, sauna, hot tub, and gym. Guests can also enjoy two 18-hole golf courses on-site, 'Roganstown Championship Golf Course' and 'Swords Open, ' at special rates. Meeting rooms are available for 10 to 250 people, and complimentary Wi-Fi is accessible throughout the hotel. This hotel is ideal for both business and leisure travelers.

161365.description: This modern, intimate, chic hotel following a full refurbishment is the perfect choice for either a pleasurable few days holiday or short business trip. Located on King Street, Hammersmith, just a few minutes' walk from the Hammersmith Tube and Bus Stations with connections to all across London. In the surrounding area of the Seraphine Hammersmith Hotel one can find stylish shops, bars and restaurants. Hammersmith Apollo and Lyric Hammersmith Theatre are only a few minutes' walk from the hotel. The Seraphine Hammersmith Hotel is also within easy access to both the Hammersmith town hall, Olympia and Earl's Court Exhibition Centres and also has excellent transport links with Heathrow Airport and Central London. Enjoy your stay.

161367.description: Overlooking Kensington Gardens and just 800 m from the Royal Albert Hall, this hotel enjoys a privileged location near art galleries and the Natural History Museum. This stylish city establishment offers 21 comfortable, well-equipped and chic rooms and is the perfect choice for either a pleasurable holiday or a short business trip. All rooms have complimentary high-speed Internet access and guests can relax in the lounge or hotel bar. In addition, the residence offers a cosy café and a restaurant. Corporate travellers will appreciate the conference facilities and room and laundry services are also available. All rooms come with a double bed and further features include satellite TV and Internet access.

161368.description: This modern, intimate, chic hotel is the perfect choice for holidays, or a business trip. The hotel is conveniently located near the stylish High Street Kensington shops, Holland Park, major tourist attractions, tour buses and metro station. Guests are welcomed in the lobby with 24-hour reception, hotel safe, cloakroom, and lift, café, a bar and a restaurant, conference facilities and wireless Internet access. Guests can also take advantage of the room and laundry services.

name.content: Park Inn by Radisson Birmingham Walsall

161512.description: Situated just off the M6 and only 29 Km from Birmingham Airport, this contemporary hotel is ideally situated for business and tourist travellers alike. Walsall town centre with its lively nightlife is close by and Birmingham and its famous Bull Ring shopping centre is within easy reach. Among the other places of interest in the area visitors can enjoy are Cadbury World, Sea Life Centre, Drayton Manor Theme Park, West Midland Safari Park and Dudley Zoological Gardens and Castle. Amenities include free parking, fitness centre, coffee bar, bar lounge and restaurant. There are meeting rooms and copy services for corporate guests. The spacious, modern accommodation offers climate control, high speed wireless internet access, television with free view channels, coffee and tea makers and hairdryer. This is a non-smoking establishment and also has accessible facilities.

161831.description:
The hotel is located 2 km outside Pratdip on the T-311 road which joins Pratdip with The Santa Marina Hermitage. The nearest beaches are 12 km away (Hospitalet de l'Infant), where guests will also find restaurants and bars. It is roughly 25 km to nightspots in Cambrils and around 30 km to Reus, with its shops, park and tourist centre. The region of Priorat is 40 km away, as is Delta Ebro. It is approximately 35 km to Reus Airport, 130 km to Barcelona Airport and 220 km to Girona Airport.

This small, charming, air-conditioned gourmet hotel is ideal for those looking to relax in intimate surroundings and relish in good food. Hidden amongst the olive groves, in rural Catalonian countryside, relaxation and getting away from it all are guaranteed thanks to this little secret paradise that breathes only silence and tranquillity. Guests will enjoy emotional well-being, where time passes but is never wasted. It was renovated in 2010 and comprises a total of 7 rooms, including 1 suite and 1 junior suite. Facilities on offer to guests include a 24-hour reception and check-out service. Guests can dine at the restaurant and will appreciate the wireless Internet access. They can also take advantage of the room service. A car park is available for those arriving by car and it is also possible to hire bicycles on the premises.

The rooms have been created as a shrine to absolute rest. High quality materials have been used such as oak or metal, pale colours cover the walls and there is the serenity of white towels, soft white sheets and the comfort of the mattresses. Everything has been carefully considered to guarantee guests' rest. All come with an en suite bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer and offer a double bed. They are equipped with a direct dial telephone, a TV, a radio and complimentary wireless Internet access. Furthermore, a balcony or terrace and individually regulated air conditioning and heating are provided in all accommodation as standard.

161840.description:
This hotel is located in the municipality of Calafell, 25 m from the beach and 50 m from the centre of Calafell. Guests will find the nearest restaurants, bars and shops and the tourist centre within 150 m of the hotel and it is around 200 m from the bus station and 250 m from the closest nightspots. It is around 1.2 km to the local train station and attractions in the surrounding area include the Ciutadella Ibérica (roughly 1.5 km), the Castell de Calafell (some 2 km) and it is about 6.2 km to Barcelona. It is approximately 35 km to Reus Airport and 50 km to Barcelona's El Prat Airport.

This small, cosy beach hotel opened in the year 2000 and comprises a total of 18 fully equipped double rooms spread over 5 floors. In addition to a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, facilities on offer to guests include a hotel safe, a cloakroom and lift access to the upper floors. There is a TV lounge, a special hall, a large sunny terrace and a garden and guests can enjoy a drink at the cafe or bar and dine in the breakfast room. They will appreciate the wireless Internet access and there is private garage parking available. This is, without a doubt, the perfect place to relax and enjoy the beaches of the Costa Daurada.

All rooms come with an en suite bathroom with a shower/bathtub and a hairdryer and offer a king-size or double bed. They are equipped with a TV, wireless Internet access and a safe. Furthermore, secure electronic card locks, a fridge, a balcony, air conditioning and central heating are provided in all accommodation as standard. All rooms are external.

Fans of the fairway can head to the nearest golf course, about 2 km from the hotel.

The hotel serves a continental breakfast each morning.

162374.description:
Inspired by the Japanese tradition of Omotenashi (perfect, selfless hospitality), The Prince Akatoki offers five-star luxury from the moment you arrive. Each of their 82 bedrooms offers air-conditioning, high-speed wireless internet, Sky HD television, and 24-hour room service as standard. TOKii restaurant, open from breakfast to dinner, serves only the finest and freshest cuisine, hand-prepared by expert chefs. Located right in the heart of London, The Prince Akatoki focuses on mindfulness and tranquillity, offering a truly unique five-star experience. Keeping fit on the move is easy with their 24-hour fitness centre, while the closeness to Hyde Park means enjoying greenery and park land is never more than a few minutes away. Each bedroom offers a private bathroom, minibar, dry cleaning and laundry services, and access to the business centre. 
Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Marble Arch - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Park Lane - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Frameless Immersive Art Experience - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Hyde Park - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Baker Street - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Selfridges - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Marylebone High Street - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Bond Street - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Madame Tussauds Wax Museum - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Sherlock Holmes Museum - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Oxford Street - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Regent's Park - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Regent Street - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Kensington Gardens - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Oxford Circus - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi. 162418.description: This city hotel, near Plaza Europa in central Salou, is just 700 meters from the beach. Numerous shops and leisure activities are within a 300-meter radius. Opened in 2012, this complex comprises nine buildings, each housing ten apartments. Each apartment features two spacious bedrooms, a private bathroom, a living room with a double sofa bed, and a fully equipped kitchen. Air-conditioned guestrooms open onto terraces overlooking the well-tended garden. Guests can enjoy two refreshing swimming pools within the hotel grounds. Parking is available for €1. 00 per person per day (free for guests under 17, payable on-site). Reception hours are 9 a. m. to 5 p. m. , Sunday to Thursday, and 9 a. m. to 8 p. m. on Fridays and Saturdays.

162667.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as bicycle rentals, a terrace, and a garden. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a picnic area. Dine at Molenvijver, a restaurant with a bar/lounge and garden views, or take advantage of room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are served weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM (for a fee). Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Make yourself at home in one of the 81 guest rooms featuring minibars, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable TV. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Desks and coffee/tea makers are also provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Nearby attractions include St. Martin's Church (0. 4 mi), Genk Sundial Park (0. 5 mi), and C-mine Cultural Centre (1. 6 mi). The nearest airport is Maastricht (MST-Maastricht - Aachen) (16. 9 mi). The preferred airport is Brussels Airport (BRU) (57. 6 mi).

162677.description: Only a 10-minute walk from the ski slopes in Medels im Rheinwald and next to the Reno River, this hotel offers a traditional restaurant and simple rooms with an private bathroom. Each room at Hotel Restaurant Walserhof is fitted with a TV set and a wardrobe. A hairdryer is also provided in the bathroom. The cross-country skiing trail is next to the hotel. Guests can also go hiking in the vicinity. Italian and Swiss specialties play the lead role at the restaurant. There are grilled meats, vegetable stews and pizzas. The restaurant also includes a separate dining room where raclettes and fondues are served. The Splügen Pass is a 5-minute drive from Walserhof Restaurant. Guests can also drive to San Bernardino in less than 20 minutes. A free shuttle bus to the ski elevators is available.

162872.description:
The hotel is centrally located in a quiet and relaxing area and offers breathtaking views of the lake, castle and the Berne Alps. It is easily reachable by car (the nearest motorway exit is 1.2 km away) and by public transport (Spiez train station is 300 m away and there is a local bus station in front of the hotel). The main attractions including Spiez Castle and the lakeshores (boat excursions) are within walking distance of the hotel. Niesen Summit Railway and the historic town of Thun (Old Town with a castle and museums) are reachable in less than 15 minutes. Interlaken is 17 km away and Berne is 37 km away. Bern International Airport is approximately 28 km from the hotel.

The cosy historical hotel, built in 1900 and renovated in 2005, offers a magnificent view over Spiez Castle, Lake Thun and the snow-topped mountain peaks (Eiger Mönch and Jungfrau) of the Bernese Oberland Alps. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which features lift access to the upper floors. Guests can dine in the excellent gastronomic restaurant (14 Gault Millau points) with its sunny terrace. In addition to the 18 guest rooms, the hotel offers a wide range of further amenities including meeting and banquet facilities, free wireless Internet access, as well as free parking spaces and a secure bike storage room.

The cosy non-smoking rooms are appointed with a lot of wood and feature an en suite bathroom with a shower, WC and hairdryer. Rooms come further equipped with cable TV, a radio and a direct dial telephone. They face south and offer a beautiful view of Lake Thun and the famous mountain tops of the Bernese Oberland. They either have a small balcony or direct access to the terrace, as well as featuring central heating and individually regulated air conditioning as standard.

Fans of the fairway can head to the nearest golf course, Golf Club Thunersee, which is approximately 10 km from the hotel.

A hearty buffet breakfast is served each morning.

163031.description: Perched right on the shore of one of the most legendary bodies of water in the world, this cosy and welcoming hotel offers enchanting views of Loch Ness and the surrounding Highlands. Boat tours of Loch Ness leave from just outside the hotel, and Urquhart Castle is just a ten-minute drive away. Guests may also wish to visit Culloden Battlefield, golf on one of the area's many traditional golf courses, tour a local whiskey distillery, or take a fishing, horseback, or mountain bike excursion. Each room is en suite with modern comforts such as coffee and tea facilities, plasma television and Wi-Fi. Guests can start the day with a coffee and signature cake in the coffee shop, and enjoy delicious meals made from local produce at the in-house restaurant. The restaurant overlooks the loch and features a mirrored wall so that all diners can observe any unusual activity on the lake. The perfect base for a delightful family holiday.

163136.description: This aparthotel is situated on the coast between Salou and Cambrils. Facilities include a 24-hour reception with a safe and lifts, a restaurant, a bar, a supermarket, and a shop. Laundry services, a kids' club (July and August), bicycle hire, and car parking are available for an extra charge. Each air-conditioned room features a living room with a sofa bed, a separate twin bedroom, a bathroom, and a kitchen with a fridge and a TV. Guests can enjoy a swimming pool, a sun terrace with loungers, and a poolside snack bar. In the evenings, the restaurant offers à la carte and set menus.

163245.description: This golf hotel is located in a beautiful part of the Irish countryside, less than 4 km from Giant's Causeway. The city of Derry is about 38 km away and Coleraine is some 13. 5 km away, with bars, restaurants and pubs. The City of Derry Airport is around 35 km away and Belfast International Airport is about 45 km away. This family-run golf hotel has 15 rooms and is a good base for exploring the north coast of Ireland. Guests are welcomed in the lobby and the property also offers a traditional bar and a breakfast room. The bedrooms are in a courtyard adjacent to the main building and are laid out in American-motel style with two double beds, with an extra guest bed available if required. All but two bedrooms have baths and separate walk-in showers. The rooms are very accessible and are graded category 1 disability access by the tourist board. The gym is fully equipped and usually rarely busy. The hotel's nine-hole golf course crosses water seven times but fans of the fairway are never far from help and encouragement from our bar manager of over 40 years, Gerry McIlwaine. The Royal Portrush Golf Club is 24 km from the hotel. The area is also good for horse riding (for a fee) and fishing.

163382.description: The DoubleTree by Hilton London - West End is ideally located in London's historic Bloomsbury district, between Holborn and Russell Square Underground stations. This full-service hotel offers business and leisure travelers the perfect location just a stone's throw from the British Museum and within walking distance of top attractions such as Covent Garden, the West End, and Oxford Street shops. Heathrow (LHR) and Gatwick (LGW) airports are easily accessible by tube, rail, and bus. Behind its beautiful Edwardian façade, our newly renovated West End hotel retains its historic charm with modern conveniences. Inviting guest rooms, suites, and executive accommodations include pampering bath amenities, generous work surfaces, flat-screen TVs, our luxurious Sweet Dreams bedding, and wireless high-speed internet access. Guests will also appreciate: a well-equipped fitness center by Precor, concierge services, and 24-hour in-room dining. After a day of business or sightseeing, enjoy a light bite, afternoon tea, or evening cocktails at Bar 92, where you can watch the news or sporting events. Join us at The Level Restaurant for sleek and modern dining, serving a selection of international cuisines. Don't forget to start your day with our extensive DoubleTree breakfast buffet. The DoubleTree by Hilton London - West End enjoys a prime location between the Financial District and popular West End attractions and neighborhoods like Soho and the Theatre District. Our Bloomsbury location is also close to many wonderful cafés and restaurants, from casual eateries to fine dining. The hotel is also situated near three colleges, including University College London. For business meetings, conferences, weddings, and receptions, the DoubleTree by Hilton London - West End offers attractive and flexible meeting room spaces, a professional banquet staff, and creative menus.

name.content: The Hari London by IHG, Vignette Collection

163411.description: Designed for those with a penchant for modern elegance, The Hari London by IHG, Vignette Collection is glamorous yet intimate, leaving guests feeling like they have found a hidden home away from home in the heart of London. Located moments from Harrods and the luxury shops of Knightsbridge, The Hari London by IHG, Vignette Collection is also within walking distance of Buckingham Palace, Hyde Park, The Royal Albert Hall and London's most famous museums. The Hari London, Vignette Collection is one of the most luxurious hotels in London, with 85 designer bedrooms, including 14 luxury suites. Each guest room boasts a mix of plush velvet upholstery, marble bathrooms, contemporary art and cosy furnishings, designed to make your stay as relaxing as possibleAll rooms offer complimentary Wi-Fi and portable handy phones with free local and international calls and 3G internet, as well as Noble Isle amenities. The Garden Terrace, The Hari's unique outdoor oasis with living ivy walls, a retractable roof and heaters, is also accessible to all guests. This hotel's chic, dignified atmosphere makes it perfect for a sumptuous London retreat.

163498.description: The Comfort Inn Westminster hotel in London, England is located in the heart of the prestigious Royal Borough of Westminster near famous attractions like the Royal Albert Hall, South Bank, Westminster Abbey, Madame Tussauds and House of Fraser. The Comfort Inn Westminster is also close to The Queens Gallery, Victoria Shopping Centre, London Eye and Tate Britain. Guests of the hotel are invited to enjoy free breakfast and free WiFi. All guest rooms offer a desk, flat-screen TV and in-room tea and coffee. This is a non-smoking hotel. Create your perfect stay at the Comfort Inn Westminster in London. Book now to enjoy easy access to attractions and wonderful amenities while we help you relax and feel at home.

163782.description: Experience small-town charm near big-city amenities at the Hampton Inn Yorkville. Located on the Fox River in Kendall County, one of the fastest-growing counties in Illinois, Yorkville offers both relaxation and excitement. Within minutes of the hotel, you'll find parks, racetracks, a casino, water parks, museums, hiking, cycling, and kayaking. Enjoy diverse shopping opportunities in nearby Chicago and surrounding areas, plus easy access to the Chicagoland Speedway in Joliet. Discover the quaint charm of Yorkville's historic downtown and the excitement of Chicago.

164100.description: This elegant hotel is located on the seafront in Cambrils, in front of the beach Regueral Prat d'en Fores, 100 meters from the Yacht Club and the Port of Cambrils, and 10 km from Port Aventura . Recently renovated, it comprises a total of 58 rooms, well-equipped with amenities. The famous on-site restaurant opened in 1955 and was one of the first in town. Guests of this deluxe property can enjoy the benefits of complimentary Internet access and younger visitors can spend some exciting moments in the children's play area. Recreation options include a swimming pool, and a solarium is available as well.

164138.description: The hotel is located in the centre of Meiringen, directly next to the bus stop and 200 metres from the main train station. It is very close to the Meiringen-Hasliberg cable cars, leading into the on-site hiking and skiing region. This family-friendly hotel consists of the traditional hotel (now a listed building) and a new modern building that are connected with one another. The hotel has air conditioning and comprises a total of 28 rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers 24-hour reception and 24-hour check-out services, as well as a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities and lift access to upper floors. Guests can enjoy a drink at the café and bar and dine in the restaurant. Additional amenities include Internet access, room and laundry services as well as a car park for those arriving by car. All rooms are en suite with a shower, a bath and a hairdryer. Rooms come further equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, Internet access and a safe. Air conditioning and central heating are standard features of all accommodation. Guests can enjoy a refreshing dip in the hotel's indoor public swimming pool. There are many leisure opportunities available at the hotel, including paddle tennis, tennis and, for an additional fee, golf. There is also an entertainment programme for both children and adults. The hotel serves a breakfast buffet while the lunchtime and evening meals can be enjoyed à la carte or as a set menu.

164139.description: The hotel is situated very close to the Meiringen/Hasliberg cable cars and is only 500 metres from Meiringen train station. It is just 100 metres from a range of shopping venues and around 95 km from Bern airport. This is a ski hotel with a personal feel and a quiet location, making it perfect for holidays. It has air conditioning and comprises a total of 56 rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, which offers 24-hour check-out service and a hotel safe. Guests can unwind in the TV lounge while younger guests will appreciate the kids' club. Guests can enjoy a drink at the café and bar and dine in the restaurant. Internet access is available for an additional fee. The hotel also provides both room and laundry services and, at an extra charge, car parking facilities and bicycle hire. This hotel offers guests a quiet place to stay near the woods. All rooms are en suite with a shower, a bath and a hairdryer. Guests can enjoy a good night's rest on their double or king-size bed. Rooms come further equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, Internet access and a safe, as well as tea and coffee making facilities. Air conditioning and heating are standard features of all accommodation. Additional room features include a balcony or terrace. Guests can enjoy a refreshing dip in the hotel's indoor heated swimming pool. They can relax in the hot tub and sauna or pamper themselves with a massage treatment at the hotel. There is a range of leisure opportunities available on-site including tennis, table tennis, horse riding and biking. There is also an entertainment programme for both children and adults. The hotel serves breakfast while the lunchtime and evening meals can be enjoyed à la carte or as a set menu.

164179.description: Built in typical Swiss chalet style, the Hotel Bänklialp offers its guests cosy rooms and its peaceful location makes it a relaxing retreat after an active day in the mountains. Guests enjoy the idyllic atmosphere and the view of the beautiful mountain landscape, the village of Engelberg and the neighbouring forest. Most of the room categories also offer balconies, where the panoramic views are even better. An eventful day in the Swiss Alps at the Hotel Bänklialp always begins with an appealing breakfast buffet featuring regional products. The Bänklialp restaurant invites you to savour culinary delights in an elegant Alpine chic ambience. Here, traditional Swiss dishes as well as international cuisine are served for lunch and dinner. In fine weather, the panoramic terrace invites guests to enjoy their meal. For lovers of fondue and raclette, the Engelberger Stube is a special place to go, offering a varied selection of meat and cheese fondues as well as raclette specialities.

164363.address: Richmond Court North End Road Fulham
164363.description: The apartment hotel is just a 10-minute walk from West Brompton Underground Station and only 500 metres from the famous Cromwell Road. Chelsea Football Club is a 20-minute walk away making this city hotel the perfect accommodation for out-of-town supporters of the team. The fully furnished apartment hotel comprises of 12 units in total. The apartments come complete with everything guests would expect to find at home and weekly servicing is provided as standard. They are perfect for families or groups travelling together in style. All accommodation units are en-suite with a shower and a bath. They come further equipped with a TV and Internet access, as well as a kitchen, which features a fridge, a cooker, a microwave and a washing machine. Central heating is provided for additional comfort.

164412.description: The establishment is ideally located within walking distance of Earls Court tube station and attractions such as the Earls Court Exhibition Centre, Natural History Museum, Victoria and Albert Museum, Stamford Bridge Stadium and many more. A variety of shops, entertainment venues and restaurants can be found within the vicinity of this city hotel. The residence features stylish guest rooms, all of which have private en-suite bathrooms and in-room entertainment facilities. WiFi high-speed Internet access is available throughout the hotel. Every morning guests can enjoy a continental breakfast buffet.

164543.description: A small, family-run hotel set in a Victorian terrace in Glasgow's fashionable West End, the Argyll Western Hotel has a strong Scottish identity and provides guests with a traditional Scottish welcome. The hotel is close to Glasgow University and the popular Byres Road, with its vibrant bars and restaurants, and benefits from easy transport links to the city centre. Each of the 17 comfortable modern guestrooms is decorated using a different tartan and features an en-suite bathroom plus TV with Freeview, free Wi-FI and tea/coffee making facilities. Breakfast is served daily in the bright, high-ceilinged breakfast room and reception is 24-hours

164545.description:
A waterside hotel in Liverpool city centre offering comfortable en-suite rooms, friendly service and free guest parking. Perfectly located for the Albert Dock, Liverpool ONE and the M&S Bank Arena. 

Please note: We do not accept Hen or Stag Parties. 

For a smooth check-in, please email your contact details to: liverpool@dolbyhotels. co. uk 

When booking 3 rooms or more, different cancellations terms and policies apply.

164782.description: A Victorian style venue that has been tastefully refurbished in order preserve its original elegance and atmosphere. Located right in the heart of Southport on the main shopping artery - Lord Street Boulevard, it is near to all of its attractions and fine restaurants. The Southport Pier is 3km away and the Rail Station can be reached within a 5-minute walk, while the New Pleasureland theme-park is just 10 minutes away. This family-friendly beach hotel combines elegant and stylish decor with modern luxury and conveniences The establishment is perfect for business meetings or for those looking for a quiet stay by the sea. With traditional restaurants, a cocktail lounge and real ale bar, guests will have plenty of options for dinning or for that celebratory end-off-the-day pint of beer.

164789.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. This hotel also features concierge services, a fireplace in the lobby, and a picnic area. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 39 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and minibars. Your Select Comfort bed comes with Egyptian cotton sheets. 49-inch Smart televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries.

164966.description: Treat yourself to a comfy stay in the capital at The Best Western London Highbury, as this incredibly convenient hotel places in the heart of London. You'll be offered the warmest of welcomes and ultimate access to the city, thanks to the great transport links nearby. Finsbury Park and Manor House Underground tube stations are just 500 meters from the hotel, giving you a fast connection to Central London, Kings Cross Station and St. Pancras International. Central London is bursting with famous tourist attractions, entertainment hotspots, music venues, and diverse cultural districts. You'll also find some of the capital's most prominent business areas and sporting venues, such as Tottenham Football Stadium nearby, so there will never be a dull moment. Stop off at Kings Cross for a visit to the Harry Potter Shop, and a quick photo on platform 9 ¾ - before you head to Hogwarts of course. The two tube stations also offer direct routes to Trafalgar Square and Camden, and the famous canalside Camden Market.
