A taxi from Edinburgh Airport will take each guest straight from door to door, whilst the Airlink Bus runs frequently between the airport and Edinburgh's Princes Street. If arriving by train, Edinburgh Waverley Station is around a 10-minute walk from the hotel.

179223.description: This hotel enjoys a strategic location, surrounded by the delights of Hammersmith. Within a short distance of the hotel, lie a host of local attractions. Guests can enjoy ease of access to an array of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues, where the essence and intrigue of the area can be uncovered. Guests will be impressed by the style and poise which the hotel displays. The hotel rooms are tastefully decorated, featuring soft, soothing tones and modern furnishings. The rooms come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. The hotel offers a warm, friendly atmosphere, alongside professional service, to ensure a memorable stay for each individual guest.

179295.description: Located at the mouth of the Tyne in South Shields, The Sea Hotel, Sure Hotel Collectionis ideally placed for taking trips to Sunderland and Newcastle; we're within easy reach of the A1 and A19. Above all, we're proud of our personality. . . and make every effort to make every stay superb. The friendly service, comfortable interiors and modern facilities certainly help us! For the business traveler, our meeting rooms are a must, while a secure car park means you can enjoy peace of mind in more ways than one. While you're here we recommend a stroll along the beautiful coast, though Beamish Open Air Museum, Durham Cathedral, Hadrian's Wall and the Angel of the North are well worth a look-see too! Enjoy your stay.

name.content: Cedar Court Hotel Harrogate Ascend Hot. Collection

179300.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and wedding services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at The Restaurant, a restaurant which specializes in British cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Harrogate? This hotel has 8310 square feet (772 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 100 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries.

179314.description: We look forward to welcoming you at The Best Western Victoria Palace hotel in Central London, for a modern and cozy break in the capital. Whilst staying with us you will enjoy a prime location in the very heart of London, within walking distance of many of the city's most celebrated attractions. Buckingham Palace is less than a 20-minute walk away, so why not head there for 10:30 a. m. and get a good spot for the changing of the guard. You'll also be a 20 minute walk from the London Eye, for some breath-taking birds eye views of the city. Big Ben, Westminster Abbey, Trafalgar Square and Downing Street (to name a few) are also close by, meaning you'll be able to tick off all the biggest points of interest. For something a little more obscure – we'll have plenty of recommendations. Visit the night time food market Street Feast, Kayak down the Thames, or visit Jumeirah Carlton Tower for a spectacular 1960's afternoon tea. If you're visiting London for a weekend of spending, Carnaby Street and Oxford Street are both just 20 minutes away by tube. If you feel like a more extravagant splurge, London's highly exclusive Mayfair is also 20 minutes away. You're sure to work up an appetite during your day of sightseeing or shopping, so check out Time Out's listing of the best restaurants in London for some incredible - yet still very affordable – food spots. If you wish to venture away from London, we're proud to be a hugely convenient London hotel just five minutes' walk of Victoria Station and Victoria Coach Station.

name.content: Swindon Blunsdon House Hotel, BW Premier Collectio

179328.description: The Best Western Premier Blunsdon House Hotel, BW Premier Collection in Swindon is set in 30 acres of beautiful Wiltshire countryside, overlooking the Vale of Cricklade with views of the Cotswolds. An ideal place to stay in Swindon, you’ll be surrounded by picture postcard villages and ancient landmarks, not to mention the excellent shopping facilities of the town itself. With its great location, the Best Western Premier Blunsdon House Hotel, BW Premier Collection is famously welcoming and has been owned and run by the Clifford family for over 50 years, who celebrated their Golden Jubilee in 2010. With the M4 Corridor just one mile away, the Swindon hotel is convenient for London (80 miles), Bristol (40 miles) and Birmingham (85 miles), so you'll never be far from things to see and do. Take a walk along the Ridgeway, near Swindon and enjoy breathtaking views across the Marlborough Downs. In the fantastic surrounding countryside, you’ll find huge images carved into hills (like the famous White Horse of Uffington) and monuments that pre-date recorded history at Avebury and Silbury Hill. More practically, you can enjoy a bargain in the Swindon Designer Outlet Village and Brunel Shopping Centre. Close to the hotel itself at the Blunsdon Abbey stadium, you can find motorcycle speedway racing, featuring the Swindon Robins. The Best Western Premier Blunsdon House Hotel, BW Premier Collection in Swindon has fabulous rooms available for conference hire and is one of the most sought-after wedding venues in Swindon. This hotel, plus all that surrounds it, is a real hidden gem.

179336.description: The Roker Hotel, BW Premier Collection® has been a landmark on the stunning North East coastline for decades and offers visits an unparalleled view of the sea. This classic hotel retains its traditional feel but with all the modern comforts, including rooms with state-of-the-art facilities. Guests can enjoy the many amenities including two very different - but equally as stunning – restaurants the Tavistock Italia and Tavistock Thai China which serve the best of Italian and Oriental cuisine.

179338.description: The Best Western Grand Hotel in Hartlepool offers the best of both worlds. Combining old and new, the traditional French Chateaux building plays host to a modern décor inside, while its wonderful coastal location is convenient for a number of inland attractions. Thanks to good transport links, our guests can not only get away from it all but get back to it easily too! Newcastle is within easy reach, while other northern cities and towns are also easily accessible. Wherever you decide to go during your stay, we'll be ready and waiting with a warm welcome on your return.

name.content: Weston Hall Hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Best W

179363.description: Nestled on seven acres in a charming village, the 16th-century Weston Hall Hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western, offers a relaxing and intimate escape in the heart of the Midlands. Enjoy ensuite rooms with modern amenities, six conference rooms for 2-200 delegates, and ample free parking. Explore nearby attractions such as Warwick Castle (17. 5 miles) and Shakespeare's Stratford-upon-Avon. Coventry Cathedral, Twycross Zoo, the NEC, and Birmingham International Airport are also easily accessible, making this an ideal base for touring the Heart of England.

name.content: Derwent Manor Hotel, BW Premier Collection

179367.description: The Derwent Manor Hotel, BW Premier Collection is a delightful hotel near Durham that enjoys a rural location on the outskirts of Consett, nestled amongst 20 acres of Northumberland countryside. It’s right on the edge of an area of outstanding natural beauty in the North Pennines, overlooking Derwent Valley and yet is easily accessible from the A68. This hotel near Beamish is perfectly placed for those who want to see everything Northumberland and the North East has to offer. It’s just 30 minutes from the vibrant cities of Newcastle and Durham - so you'll have your pick of things to do. Famous attractions include the magnificent Durham Cathedral, the 360 indoor shops in the Gateshead Metro Centre and the historic coast-to-coast Roman construction, Hadrian’s Wall. The delightful market towns of Hexham and Corbridge, along with popular visitor attractions like Beamish Open Air Museum are also close-by - so you'll have ample opportunity to get out and about. Go walking, cycling, fishing or horse riding and see even more of the great outdoors. However if you’d prefer to stay close, the Derwent Manor Hotel, BW Premier Collection has its own on-site leisure facilities – including swimming pool, gym and sauna. If you’re looking for the ideal spot to hold a business meeting, the Derwent Manor Hotel, BW Premier Collection has several spacious suites – making this a fantastic conference hotel near Newcastle. The same facilities mean that this is a wonderful place to hold a wedding celebration too, with epic views of the Derwent Valley as your backdrop. With the Derwent Manor Hotel, BW Premier Collection as your base, the North East is yours to explore.

179369.description: Near the intersection of A53 and A500, our location puts you close to attractions as well as businesses. Festival Retail Park, Stoke Ski Centre, and Waterworld are all within a quarter mile pf our hotel. The city center and bet365 Stadium are within 10 minutes. We offer ample meeting and event space, a full-service spa, and Josiah’s restaurant.

name.content: Best Western Mornington Hotel London Hyde Park

179390.description: The Best Western Mornington Hotel London Hyde Park enjoys a great location in the heart of Greater London. Close to Lancaster Gate tube and buses, our accommodation has been elegantly re-designed and is fully equipped! Our bedrooms are, of course, comfortable. . . and complemented by our intimate Library Bar which serves drinks and light snacks. Please note that whilst we only have a breakfast restaurant, there are a variety of good restaurants nearby. The great news is our free high-speed wireless Internet access will help you find them all! Shopping opportunities are countless in the capital, but if you simply want to wander around and see the sights, Hyde Park is the perfect starting point! The West End is less than two miles away if you fancy a show, and The Victoria & Albert and Natural History Museums will enthrall you as you explore. Enjoy your stay.

179392.description: This charming hotel is set amidst 3 acres of Strathaven countryside, just a short driving distance from East Kilbride. This delightful hotel is located in close proximity to a number of attractions in the area, including the Scottish Museum of Rural Life, Strathclyde Park Watersports and Country Park, Calderglen Country Park and Low Waters Museum. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to a number of shopping, dining and entertainment venues. This 18th century hotel was built in the style of Robert Adam Junior, and has embraced period elements. The guest rooms are sumptuously appointed, and provide a cocoon of peace and serenity in which to work and rest in comfort. Business and leisure travellers alike will appreciate the exemplary facilities the hotel has to offer.

name.content: Best Western Glasgow South Eglinton Arms Hotel

179395.description: Nestled in the semi-rural village of Eaglesham, the Best Western Glasgow South Eglinton Arms Hotel, a former coaching inn, has been a landmark since the mid-18th century. As Scotland's first conservation village, Eaglesham offers a quiet, relaxing escape from the hustle and bustle of city life. We are only eight miles from Glasgow, renowned for its architecture and shopping. Explore the Merchant City area, known as Little Italy, with its boutique shops and restaurants. For golf enthusiasts, the world-famous Turnberry Golf Course is just 20 miles away. Scotland's national stadium, Hampden Park, home to major sporting events and concerts, is only six miles away. Enjoy your stay.

179402.description: If you’re looking for a place to stay in London, the Best Western Swiss Cottage Hotel offers the best of both worlds. In a pleasant residential area near Regents Park, you’ll enjoy peace and quiet during your stay. Yet with London’s countless attractions just a few minutes away, the sights and sounds of the capital are never far away. This elegant Victorian townhouse is full of character and fascinating objets d’art, which add a unique charm to the hotel – including a grand piano, oil paintings and antique furniture. You can be sure your stay here will be memorable for all the right reasons. Our hotel is right next to Swiss Cottage tube station and just a few minutes from the West End by tube or bus. The Jubilee line links us directly to Lord's cricket ground, Madam Tussauds, Oxford Street, Big Ben, Wembley arena and many other attractions - so you'll spend more time deciding where to go than you will getting there. There are lots of convenient bars, bistros and brasseries around the hotel and for these reasons we have no restaurant for lunch or dinner. Instead, we provide a pleasant breakfast room that serves a range of cooked and continental items to give you the energy boost you need for a day of sightseeing.

179409.description: Completely rebuilt in 2015, this modern hotel in Central London offers innovatively designed, air-conditioned rooms. Relaxing rain showers, media streaming, large smart TVs, and touch-controlled mood lighting create a chic base for exploring the city. The Best Western Plus Delmere Hotel is a 5-minute stroll from Paddington Station and the Heathrow Express, with an airport journey time of only 15 minutes. Excellent tube and bus connections provide easy access to all major London sights. You'll be a stone's throw from Hyde Park and within walking distance of world-class shopping on Oxford Street and Soho's vibrant nightlife. For rainy days, there's a direct tube connection to both Westfield shopping centers. The local restaurant scene offers a vast selection for every budget, and numerous traditional pubs provide further choices. In the hotel, you'll find The Hub, offering complimentary tea and coffee—an ideal place to relax before exploring London. Our cozy and stylish rooms perfectly reflect the city's focus on style.

179413.description:
A total of 51 rooms are available for guests' convenience. Once a historic watermill, Quy Mill Hotel & Spa is a secluded haven which offers delightful hotel accommodation in Cambridge, superb food and unfailing courtesy. It is the only hotel in Cambridgeshire to be awarded the Silver Star award by the AA, recognising our superior level of quality, and high standards of service and cleanliness. All our rooms feature en suite bathrooms, and some offer the height of exclusivity with four poster beds, free Wi-Fi. 
All our 51 rooms feature en-suite bath or shower and range from Standard Double Rooms, Executive Double Rooms, Executive Twin Rooms, Superior Double Rooms and Deluxe Four Poster Bedrooms. Quy Mill is also a dog friendly hotel. 
Private Parking available (plenty of spaces) . The costs £10. 00 per car per night.

179415.description: Beverley is a remarkable architectural gem. . . where else could you hope to find such fabulous medieval treasures nearby such as St. Mary's, Beverley Minster or even one of the finest Georgian entrance halls in Yorkshire. Set in the center of this gorgeous market town, right at the heart of the homeliness, Best Western The Lairgate Hotel prides itself on the considerable character created by both staff and building, and guests are treated to the highest standards at every turn. Recently enhanced by major refurbishment and extension work, the hotel offers a secluded patio area at the rear of the property, providing an ideal suntrap (weather permitting). So after a day's shopping, umpteen must-see sights and rolling countryside just moments away, it is a great place to spend some quality time with. . . well, anyone! Enjoy your stay.

name.content: Mayfield House , Sure  Coll. by Best W.

179428.description: *Hotel completely nonsmoking*New English cuisine sourcing great local produce prepared by great local chefs offering a true taste of the Cotswolds. The Mayfield House Hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western is situated in a small Cotswold village between Cirencester and Chippenham on the A429. Close to Malmesbury, with easy access to the M4 and M5. Spacious walled garden and an award-winning restaurant. Ideal for touring the Cotswolds and Bath. Golf, fishing and walking nearby. Relax and enjoy a warm and friendly welcome.

name.content: ibis budget London Whitechapel - Brick Lane

179527.description: Looking for a stylish and affordable stay close to central London, Ibis Budget London Whitechapel is an excellent choice. Located just a 7-minute walk from both Whitechapel and Aldgate stations, the hotel offers easy access to the best of East London. Enjoy a fresh continental breakfast to start your day, grab snacks whenever you need them, and explore nearby highlights like Brick Lane and Spitalfields Market—well known for their vibrant street food, art scene, and vintage shopping.

name.content: The Royal Hotel and Merrill Leisure Club

179610.description: This upscale hotel boasts a prime setting in the vibrant surroundings of Sandyford and is a short distance away from the main shopping venues in the area, as well as a host of dining options and entertainment venues. The hotel exudes elegance and sophistication, instantly impressing each individual guest. Enjoying the tranquil surroundings of Wicklow, guests can enjoy breath-taking natural beauty, as well as a host of recreational activities. Guests will be impressed by the eloquent style and poise that the hotel displays. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, and come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Guests are invited to enjoy the tranquil surroundings of the hotel, or relax with a refreshing drink after a busy day of sightseeing. Easily accessable by public transport, the hotel is located 22 km from Dublin city centre and 33 km from Dublin Airport.

179611.description: Choose from 102 pet-friendly guest bedrooms with fun design, comfortable furnishings and spacious en-suite shower rooms. Our continental breakfast spread (included in your room rate) will take care of thirst and hunger first thing, but if you fancy a tipple and a treat later on, head to our open-plan Hub area. With free fibre Wi-Fi available and a games room for a bit of friendly competition, you'll find everything you need for a relaxing afternoon and evening, right here under one roof.

name.content: AC Hotel Birmingham NEC and Airport

179612.description: AC Hotel by Marriott Birmingham NEC & Airport pairs purposeful design with a calm, contemporary aesthetic. Located moments from Birmingham Airport and the NEC, the hotel offers 169 sleek, air-conditioned rooms, a modern gym, generous parking, and the AC Lounge®, a stylish space to dine, unwind or connect over cocktails. Flexible meeting rooms provide a polished setting for collaboration or events. In a short stroll, explore the shops and entertainment of Resorts World, catch a concert at bp pulse live, or visit the NEC convention halls. Birmingham International station is just minutes away on foot, with direct trains to central Birmingham, London and beyond, and a free Air-Rail Link to the airport operating daily from 03:30 to 00:30. Not your typical airport hotel, AC Birmingham Airport offers pet-friendly spaces, service focused on effortless stays, and interiors designed for comfort and clarity. The reimagined AC Hotel at Birmingham Airport is a place to relax, recharge and enjoy the journey.

179729.description: The charming hotel is located in the heart of Saanen, just 2 km from Gstaad, and offers beautiful country-style rooms and tasty Swiss specialties. Spend peaceful nights in your cozy yet elegant room, start every day with a hearty breakfast buffet and enjoy a delicious cheese fondue in the rustic restaurant.

179790.address: Emperor way, Crewe Business Park, CW1 6BD Crewe
179790.description: From the moment you check in at the reception desk (styled on a vintage walnut dashboard) to the minute you leave us, your every need will be seen to. We're proud to offer free fibre Wi-Fi throughout, unlimited continental breakfast spreads (included in your room rate for simplicity), a pleasant terrace for al fresco dining through the day, and expertly shaken cocktails to be enjoyed on vintage Chesterfield sofas.

179868.description: Apartment stays allow for more space and privacy - you can live and shop like a local. Best for stays of 2 days or longer, enjoy perks like full kitchens and space to entertain and relax with your family and friends. With a washer/dryer in each apartment, flat-screen TVs, and free high-speed wifi no need to compromise on facilities. With first-class customer service from the Concierge team and a seven-day-per-week housekeeping service Scottish hospitality is assured. IMPORTANT CHECK-IN INFORMATION:At the Knight Residence by Mansley, guests are required to complete the check-in process online, prior to arrival. Guests must contact the property 72h before arrival to receive arrival instructions. For Emergency assistance outside the opening hours: Please contact our customer service team at +44 1316 228 120.

180050.description:
Rest Up at Driscoll House: Sleep Where Stories were Made

Experience London like never before at Rest Up Hostel, nestled inside the historic Driscoll House built 1913, a beautifully preserved landmark brimming with timeless character. Perfectly located in Zone 1, we're your gateway to the very best of the city. 

We keep it simple, clean, cozy, minimalist rooms so you can focus on the experience not the extras. Want more? We’ve got it! Need a towel, luggage storage or even toiletries? Just ask, they are available just for a small fee. You pay only for what you need. 

WHY STAY WITH US?
• Prime central location, unbeatable value
• Stunning historic building with unique charm
• Close to London’s best attractions
• Welcoming atmosphere—ideal for solo travellers and groups

“Sleep where the past inspires your future adventure. ”

BOOK YOUR BED TODAY – YOUR LONDON STORY STARTS HERE

SLEEP IN THE PAST WALT INTO THE CITY

REST UP HOSTEL ALSO HAS CAFÉ, DAILY CONTINENTAL BREAKFAST AN ENGLISH BREAKFAST ON WEEKENDS

180527.description: These elegant, modern suites and studios are situated just meters from Battersea Park in central London. Clapham Junction Rail and Underground Station is a 5-minute drive away. London's main attractions, including Oxford Circus, Piccadilly Circus, Hyde Park, and Oxford Street, are easily accessible by Tube. Buckingham Palace is only 7 minutes from the building. Each air-conditioned studio features a TV and a bathroom with a walk-in shower and complimentary toiletries. Secure underground parking is available for guests arriving by car.

180568.description: Located in Glasgow city centre, this budget-friendly hotel is a 15-minute walk from Glasgow Central and Queen Street rail stations. Nearby attractions include Glasgow Cathedral & Necropolis and the City Chambers. The hotel offers 125 twin, double, and accessible rooms across five floors, each equipped with air conditioning and a private shower room. Flat-screen TVs and Wi-Fi are available for an additional fee, as is housekeeping service, including linen and towel changes. The hotel is also conveniently located just 20 minutes from Glasgow International Airport by taxi.

181507.description: Located just off the Belgrave road gives the Mornington Hotel London Victoria the best of being part of the hustle and bustle of London whilst enjoying the peace of the Victorian residential street. Located moments from London Victoria Station the Mornington Hotel London Victoria is ideally located for sightseeing, shopping trips luxurary trips and business with a twist.

181535.description: This independent, warm, and friendly hotel offers burning log fires, complimentary Wi-Fi throughout, and ample parking. Located just 10 minutes from both Peterhead and Ellon, in the heart of Cruden Bay, it's a short stroll from the beach, harbor, and the ruins of Slains Castle. Foodies will appreciate that meals are cooked to order using locally sourced ingredients by our team of experienced chefs. The recently restored hotel features 16 unique en-suite bedrooms, thoughtfully designed to complement the historic building. A range of standard, attic, garden view, and patio rooms cater to various budgets. Enjoy meals in our bright, airy dining room, or relax in the warm, cozy lounge—all menus are available in all areas, including room service. A public bar shows major sporting events. Whether you're here for business, leisure, or golf (Cruden Bay Golf Course is just 800m away), we offer a home-from-home experience. See what past guests say on TripAdvisor. We hope to welcome you soon.

name.content: The Mornington Victor Hotel London Belgravia

182130.description: Reopening after a two-million-pound complete refurbishment the Victor Hotel London Belgravia is the essence of Victorian elegance in the heart of London. Offering elegant 4-star boutique accommodation that combines modern luxuries with Victorian charm. Located moments from London Victoria Station and Buckingham Palace the Victor Hotel London Belgravia is ideally located for sightseeing, shopping trips and business with a twist. To create a sense of luxury and tranquillity the room features luxurious Rituals Toiletries, high quality cotton linen and memory foam toppers on Hypnos Mattresses. Our fully refurbished rooms offer a wide variety bedding configurations to suit all types of traveller. All rooms are equipped with Air Conditioning, Complimentary High-Speed Wi-Fi, Laptop Safe, Tea & Coffee making facilities, 43-inch Flat Screen TV, iron centres, and hairdryers.

182647.description: Hotel Le Chamois, situated in the centre of Les Diablerets, offers convivial and warm accommodation. It is directly at the entry to the village near the hiking pathways and close to the shops (supermarket, pharmacy, Pressing) and the pick-up points for the sports services. Fully renovated in 2006, ideal for families!Enjoy the delicious breakfast from 8. 00am to 10. 00am in the morning and have a refreshing drink in the evening at the bar. Dogs are allowed at CHF 30. 00 per day when booked in advance. Please contact the hotel by email for this. Bookings for the same day are possible until 10 pm. An arrival after 10 pm is not possible.

182792.description: Art galleries, cobbled streets, arts venues, fashion boutiques, Georgian houses, cocktail bars, Cathedrals*, craft fairs, and book shops. Our beautiful aparthotel is located in Edinburgh’s eclectic West End. This is where theatres and arts venues brush up next to fashion boutiques and cocktail bars. Haymarket train station is just down the road and the city centre is a 10 minute walk away. You’ll find a great selection of restaurants, bars and cafes within a few minutes' walk of the property, ask our friendly team at reception for their recommendations - they’re always on hand to help. *Head to St Mary’s Episcopal Cathedral to see a rainbow of dazzling lights when the sun hits the magnificent Paolozzi Window. PLEASE NOTE: Stag / Hen parties are not permitted under any circumstance Check in may be refused and refunds not permitted

183052.description:
The Harcourt Hotel, Dublin is set in 8 Georgian buildings that were originally home to playwright George Bernard Shaw. The hotel is located in one of Dublin's most fashionable areas, within 500 meters of St Stephen's Green and Grafton Street in the city's shopping district.  Guests of the Harcourt Hotel can spend the evening in the D-Two Bar, which also has a hot serviced buffet and serves bar meals. Alternatively, guests can choose from an Italian and international menu in the hotel's restaurant, or enjoy late night barbecues and alfresco dining in the beer garden with its water feature. The hotel also offers babysitting and dry cleaning services and a limited room service. The 105 guestrooms are furnished in a classical style. All include direct dial telephones, coffee makers and satellite television. Also rooms come with hair dryers, trouser presses and complimentary newspapers. 
CAR PARKING INFORMATION

IMPORTANT: The hotel cannot be held responsible for accidents or lost or missing items.

183194.description: Conveniently located opposite Victoria Station, the DoubleTree by Hilton London - Victoria provides its guests with immediate access to public transportation and points of interest. Major attractions, such as Westminster Abbey, the Houses of Parliament, Soho, and Trafalgar Square, are within walking distance. Victoria station is the departure point for the Orient Express. With beautiful guest rooms and suites, the DoubleTree by Hilton London - Victoria embodies 4-star comfort with a full concierge service and wireless internet access throughout the hotel. After returning from a day of shopping and sightseeing, guests will find unlimited opportunities to unwind and recharge. We’re only 30 minutes from London’s Heathrow airport, and Gatwick airport is easily accessible by the Gatwick Express. Our guests have use of many amenities including our restaurant, bar, and business center. Enjoy cocktails in our chic bar, or dine on international cuisine at the restaurant, Terminus Kitchen and Bar. Whether business or leisure brings you to London Victoria our staff look forward to welcoming you with our signature, warm DoubleTree Chocolate Chip Cookie at check in.

183627.description: The Hotel is situated on a famous tree-lined avenue in Drumcondra, Dublin City. Dublin Airport and city centre are approximately 15 minutes away by car. The Hotel is located in a beautiful residential part of Dublin City. This excellent B&B has tastefully designed Ensuite bedrooms with only warmth and comfort in mind. Each bedroom offers privacy, warmth, and comfort. All the rooms are en-suite, and serviced each day with fresh towels.

name.content: Mount Royal Edinburgh by The Unlimited Collection

183705.description:
Discover the true beauty of Scotland's capital at Mount Royal Edinburgh by The Unlimited Collection. This stylish 4-star destination provides guests with panoramic views of Edinburgh Castle, Old Town and Princes Street Gardens from its central location. After a day of sightseeing, experience a relaxed meal at the in-house Scott's on Princes Street restaurant before retreating to one of our stylish and comfortable rooms for the perfect night's sleep. 

Restaurant Eidyn, located at Mount Royal Hotel Edinburgh on Princes Street, serves modern Scottish cuisine in an elegant setting overlooking Princes Street Gardens. It offers seasonal, locally sourced dishes and signature cocktails with attentive service. 

Edinburgh is a city that knows how to feed the soul and your appetite. From hearty Scottish breakfasts to Michelin-worthy bites, our guests will find a feast of flavours just a short wander from our doorstep. Whether it’s Rose Street’s cosy pubs, George Street’s elegant eateries, or the vibrant mix in the St. James Quarter, there’s something to suit every craving from a full Scottish to a vegan delight! If they are not sure where to start, our cheery reception team are always on hand with maps, directions, and local gems to share from traditional Scottish fare to international flavours.

183879.description:
Situated on private mature gardens. Only 5 minutes from Dublin Airport and 20 minutes to Dublin city, the picturesque town of Malahide.odern family run B&B ideal for guests looking for the Irish experience with private parking.

Comfy ensuite rooms.

183891.description: Situated just a 10-minute drive from Heathrow International Airport, this elegant and modern hotel is a perfect choice for business and leisure travellers alike, whether they arrive or depart. Features of the hotel include a 24-hour concierge service, a restaurant, a bar and a gym. The Hounslow and Osterley underground stations are within a short stroll, providing easy access to the centre of London with all its famous attractions.

183898.description: On school or national holidays, this hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has kids amenities available on requestSet just steps from St James's Park, Buckingham Palace, and the Houses of Parliament, Conrad London St. James boasts a prestigious, historic facade and a classic, contemporary interior, which showcases stunning art and locally inspired design. The ideal location connects guests to iconic London landmarks and provides easy access to the City and major conference centres. The hotel's intuitive and personal service appeals to both today's smart luxury travelers and local clientele who came to dine or hold meetings in the inspiring setting. Inside you will find luxurious rooms featuring modern in-room technology and amenities, complete with spacious bathtubs and walk-in showers. Enjoy an elevated style of British cuisine by renowned Chef Sally Abe at The Pem restaurant, before sampling a pint of house draught from Meantime Brewery, or perhaps one of the selections of craft beers, wines and iconic gins in the Blue Boar pub. Savour a quintessentially English afternoon tea in the Orchard room, and enjoy innovative cocktails created by top mixologists in our glamorous cocktail bar The Hedgerow. 194684.description: The St. Helen's Hotel, located near University College Dublin, offers a variety of amenities including a fitness center, rooftop terrace, garden, and on-site restaurant and bar/lounge. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services, and 24-hour room service. A buffet breakfast is available for a fee. The hotel also features a business center, express check-in/out, and ample meeting space, including a conference center. The 151 air-conditioned rooms are equipped with LCD TVs, cable programming, and private bathrooms with showers.

194779.description: Anantara The Marker Dublin Hotel is conveniently located just 25 minutes' drive from Dublin Airport. This five star hotel is also close to tourist attractions, key business districts, the 3 Arena and Aviva Stadium making it a perfect base for business and leisure travelers. With views across Grand Canal Square and Dublin's Docklands, the hotel offers 187 contemporary rooms and suites equipped with Irish-designed furnishings. Nespresso machines, king-size beds and complimentary Wi-Fi come as standard. A buffet breakfast is served in the hotel restaurant, The Brasserie, daily from 06. 30 am, giving business guests plenty of time to get to the office. Gluten-free, vegetarian and children's options are always available. The hotel's dining options include local and international dishes prepared with locally sourced produce, with snacks, meals and drinks available in the hotel restaurant, The Marker Bar or at the stunning wraparound Rooftop Bar and Terrace. Meetings, special events and civil weddings can be held in the hotel's well-equipped events spaces, with capacity for up to 350 guests. Those staying at the hotel enjoy complimentary access to the well-equipped gym and 23 meter indoor infinity pool, as well as being able to book relaxing treatments at the hotel spa.

195061.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Geilo and was established in 1930. It is a short drive away from the Geilo and the nearest station is Geilo Station. The Hotel has 2 restaurants, a bar, a conference room, a coffee shop, an indoor swimming pool and a fitness centre/gym. All 125 rooms are equipped with minibar, hairdryer and ironing set.

195062.description: Nestled in the heart of Hol, the Highland Lodge offers a family-friendly retreat just steps from the Arnetrekket and B Fugleleiken ski lifts. After a day on the slopes, unwind in the indoor pool and sauna, or enjoy the arcade/game room and on-site dining options, including two restaurants and a café. The hotel's 60 guestrooms feature flat-screen televisions, pillowtop beds, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Free self-parking and a ski shuttle (surcharge) are also available. Nearby attractions include Geilolia Summer Park and Kikuttoppen.

195275.description: Benefit from this hotel's top location only 100 metres from the main Market Square and enjoy its classic bar with terrace. Hotel Acacia offers spacious rooms with 4 star comfortable amenities. All rooms dispose of air conditioning. Decide to have the delightful buffet breakfast and plan the rest of your day at leisure – all Bruges' main sites are within walking distance. Make use of the free Wi-Fi connection in the comfortable lobby and bar or use the PC in the special internet room. Hotel Acacia is situated between 2 main shopping streets and provides you with a free city map and a reduction card for most tourist attractions.

195282.description: Enjoy a stay at Hotel Pax, located in the heart of Diksmuide. A short walk from Boterlandfietsroute and Diksmuide Town Hall, and offering convenient access to St. Nicholas Church, this hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi and wired internet access in all 36 guestrooms, along with flat-screen TVs and cable programming. Guests can enjoy a complimentary buffet breakfast daily and choose between a meal at our on-site restaurant (open 4 PM - 10 PM, closed Sundays) or a snack in the coffee shop/cafe. Room service is also available. Amenities include express check-out, multilingual staff, luggage storage, free self-parking, and cribs/rollaway beds (surcharge). Plopsaland De Panne is a 30-minute drive away.

195734.description: Escape to the tranquil Holiday Inn Resort Batam, nestled in the northeast of Batam Island. Just a 15-minute drive from Sekupang International Ferry Terminal and 45 minutes from Hang Nadim International Airport, this resort offers family-friendly hospitality with a casual, welcoming atmosphere. Enjoy fun-filled activities and child-friendly facilities, all within a safe and relaxing environment. Unwind by the sparkling pool surrounded by swaying palm trees, or indulge in a soothing massage at the award-winning Tea Tree Spa, housed in beautiful Balinese-style architecture. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the resort, perhaps finding a quiet moment in a private gazebo. The resort features 275 suites, each boasting a living room and private balcony overlooking the lush gardens and inviting pool.

name.content: Carton House, a Fairmont Managed Hotel

195757.description: Carton House, Fairmont is luxury resort escapism at its best. Set on 1, 100 private acres of sweeping Kildare parkland, just 25 minutes from Dublin International Airport, it is one of Irelands most exquisite national treasures dating back to 1739. The resort is home to 2 championship golf courses, award winning spa and wellness facilities, 4 distinctive dining options and most impressive conference and banqueting facilities catering for up to 500 delegates.

195864.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a garden. This Victorian hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and tour/ticket assistance. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Ledgowan Dining Room, for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service (during limited hours) is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include luggage storage, laundry facilities, and coffee/tea in a common area. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 12 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring kitchens. Prepare your meals in the shared/communal kitchen. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected.

196094.address: Snow Hill Plaza St Chads Queensway, 1
196094.description: Holiday Inn Express® Birmingham – Snow Hill is a 5-minute stroll from Snow Hill station and New Street station is a 15-minute walk away. Birmingham Airport (BHX) is a 25-minute drive. Guests enjoy a 55% discount off parking on the standard tariff at the B4 car park. The hotel's central location is an ideal base for exploring the city's attractions, including the famous Birmingham Bullring shopping centre and Birmingham Mailbox, a trendy shopping and dining destination. Get hands-on at Thinktank Science Museum with a wide range of interactive exhibits that explore science and technology. Discover over 2, 000 creatures at the National SEA LIFE Centre, a 15-minute walk from the hotel or get up close with over 1, 500 animals at Dudley Zoo and Castle, a 30-minute drive away. Art lovers can visit the Birmingham Museum and Art Gallery and families can have a day of fun at the Birmingham LEGOLAND Discovery Centre. For entertainment, the Utilita Arena is just a 4-minute drive away, hosting the biggest names in music and comedy. Birmingham Children’s Hospital is 3 minutes door-to-door. Unwind in your room, stream your favourite shows on fast Wi-Fi or catch up on emails at the desk. Relax with a drink and snack in the bar and wake up to a free breakfast of hot baps, cereals, and coffee.

196109.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional features at this hotel include concierge services and wedding services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at The Dining Room, a restaurant which specializes in local and international cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 21 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries.

196704.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a sauna and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch, dinner, or brunch at The Brasserie, a restaurant which specializes in local cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7 AM to 10 AM and on weekends from 8 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Planning an event in Birmingham? This hotel has facilities measuring 3035 square feet (282 square meters), including conference space. Make yourself at home in one of the 193 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions.

197394.description: This hotel is superbly located in the Natural Park of the Ebro Delta. The hotel is situated just a 2 hour's driving distance away from the bustle and excitement of Barcelona. Guests will find themselves less than a 2 hours' driving distance away from Tarragona Els Ports Natural Park, and the wine routes of Terra Alta, Montsant and Priorat. The hotel enjoys an elegant design, tempting visitors into the peaceful surroundings of the lobby. The guest rooms are sublimely designed, offering a relaxed setting in which to unwind. The hotel features a number of first-class facilities and services, guaranteeing the utmost in comfort and convenience for every type of traveller.

name.content: Els Prats Village Beach & Camping Park

197505.description: Nestled on the beautiful Costa Dorada, this beachfront bungalow complex in Mont Roig Del Camp offers stunning sea views. Located 2. 5km from the town center and a short drive from Cambrils and Port Aventura, it provides easy access to area attractions. Reus Airport is just 20km away. Enjoy a rejuvenating and memorable experience.

197860.description: Enjoy a central London stay at Garner Hotel London Victoria by IHG, a guesthouse conveniently located within a 5-minute drive of Westminster Abbey and Buckingham Palace. We offer 43 air-conditioned rooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and digital programming. Each room also includes a desk, coffee/tea maker, and a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box. We're just 0. 5 miles from Victoria Station Travel Information Centre and 1. 2 miles from Big Ben.

198921.description: In Harrogate's elegant Montpellier Quarter in the heart of the town, just a few minutes from Harrogate International Centre, this fine accommodation is ready and waiting to give you the warmest of North Yorkshire welcomes. A hotel and conference centre, our Grade II listed building includes Luxury Apartments for the full city living experience during your break or business trip - overlooking the famous Stray.

198945.description: Located in the heart of Birmingham, our hotel is just a short walk from the Bullring & Grand Central shopping centres, offering a wide variety of shops. With easy access to three major rail stations, attractions like the Sea Life Centre, O2 Academy, and Barclaycard Arena are also nearby. Each room features a comfortable king-size bed with four pillows and a cozy duvet. The on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and delicious evening meals.

199022.description: Located in the heart of Edinburgh, No. 32 Hotel offers 11 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with showers, toiletries, and hair dryers. Enjoy on-site amenities such as bicycle rentals, a garden, a bar/lounge, and cooked-to-order breakfasts (fee applies). Concierge services, dry cleaning/laundry, and luggage storage are also available. Murrayfield Stadium and Princes Street Gardens are within a 5-minute drive, while Princes Street and Johnnie Walker Princes Street are approximately 1 mile away.

199055.description: Situated just a 15-minute walk from Edinburgh Castle and the shops of popular Princes Street, this accessible hotel is directly across the road from Haymarket Rail Station.  Families might enjoy a trip to the Edinburgh Zoo, only an eight-minute drive away, or take a short stroll to the Scottish National Gallery.  The hotel's guest rooms have cool modern décor with wooden flooring and private en suite bathrooms. Features include air conditioning, a safety deposit box, a TV and a hairdryer. There is free Wi-Fi throughout the building.

200694.description: Easy access from the M5 motorway yet close to the action of Birmingham and the attractions of the West Midlands, Oldbury Birmingham offers a comfortable home from home for the business traveller and tourist alike. Conveniently situated just off the M5, Redwings Birmingham is easy to find and ideal for business or pleasure.

200896.description:
The 4-star hotel is just a 5-minute walk from the Bullring Shopping Centre. Birmingham New Street Rail Station is 10 minutes' walk from the hotel and the Hippodrome Theatre is less than 15 minutes' walk away. Birmingham Museum and Art Gallery are within 20 minutes' walk. It serves modern food in its stylish restaurant. Bespoke cocktails are made by expert mixologists in the bar and there is also an on-site fitness centre. There is also free Wi-Fi available throughout the hotel. Rooms also have a flat-screen TV, and an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer.
Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification.

201189.description: Discover the brand new Hotel Weinebrugge, BW Premier Collection by Best Western, where life is beautiful, so close to everything and yet in a quiet, relaxing and green environment. Located at the outskirts of the city centre of Brugges, we offer the best of both worlds. Experience the highlights of the 'Venice of the North', while enjoying the many facilities our hotel has to offer. We are located only 500 meters of Highway E40, Exit 7. We have 47 exclusive rooms with air conditioning, flat screen television, free internet and all modern comforts. Restaurant Weinebrugge is well known for its excellent Belgian/French gastronomy. The bar is the place to be to have a drink with friends in a relaxing atmosphere. The hotel also offers possibilities for conferences and parties. Free parking and a shuttle service to downtown (five minutes) are also available. Special packages are available. Check our website for actual offers like wellness, gastronomy, history, romance, VIP. Our attentive, multilingual staff takes pride in providing a personalized service. You ask and we make it possible. A stay at the Hotel Weinebrugge, BW Premier Collection by Best Western will make you want to come back! A city tax is in force of 2.12 EUR per person per night. The additional fee is not included in the reservation amount and will be paid directly at the hotel.

201510.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include a fireplace in the lobby, discounted use of a nearby fitness facility, and a reception hall. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 126 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers.

201957.description: This modern hotel enjoys a wonderful setting in Luton town centre, lying just a 5 minutes' walking distance from Luton Train Station. The hotel is conveniently located just 3 km away from Luton International Airport. This wonderful hotel affords guests close proximity to the intriguing sights and sounds that the centre of London has to offer. This charming hotel greets visitors with warm hospitality and the promise of a comfortable stay. The guest rooms are elegantly designed, offering a peaceful setting in which to work and rest in comfort. Guests are treated to a wonderful breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to work or explore the city.

209299.description: The 5 star luxury Lenkerhof gourmet spa resort is situated in Lenk. All 83 rooms feature a stocked minibar (non-alcoholic beverages), Nespresso coffee machine, hair dryer, bathrobe and slippers. Dining is recommended at one of the hotel gourmet restaurants. Guests can also relax in the 7sources beauty & spa with 2000m2 including an indoor and outdoor pool and 7 different saunas. Spa treatments including beauty and massage are available. Wifi access is available throughout the hotel. On site car parking is available at the hotel. Meeting facilities are available. Dogs are welcome at the hotel (at an extra charge and in rooms on the first floor). The hotel has disabled facilities with wheelchair access to the hotel, reception, restaurant, bar and conference facilities and has disabled car parking spaces. Smoking is not permitted at the hotel (except at the Cigar Lounge).

210087.description: Relax and unwind with massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the convenience of ski-in/ski-out access at this hotel, which also features a spa tub and a sauna. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and ski storage. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, Le Carnotzet, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Leysin? This hotel has 323 square feet (30 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Stay in one of 30 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding.

210088.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at Hotel Krone in Thun, offering complimentary Wi-Fi and tour assistance. Dine at one of the two onsite restaurants, including Grill Restaurant, or enjoy room service (limited hours). Continental breakfast is available for a fee on weekdays (6:30-10:00 AM) and weekends (7:30-11:00 AM). Amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers, and multilingual staff. Limited onsite parking is available. The hotel's 27 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs, cable programming, safes, and desks. Housekeeping is provided daily. Located near Thun Castle and the Thun Art Museum, Hotel Krone is a short drive from Lake Thun and conveniently located between Bern (BRN-Belp) and Zurich Airport (ZRH).

210210.description: The 4-star Hotel Le Grand Chalet offers 21 cozy double rooms and two suites. Perched on a hilltop overlooking Gstaad's pedestrian-friendly center, the hotel boasts breathtaking views of the valley and surrounding mountains. Home to the acclaimed La Bagatelle, a gourmet restaurant consistently awarded 16/20 points in the Gault&Millau Swiss guide, reservations are highly recommended. The hotel is approximately 1 km from Gstaad train station, 155 km from Geneva Airport, and 220 km from Zürich Airport.

210232.description: The stylish Berghaus Bort is situated next to the middle station of the Grindelwald-First gondola lift and offers you rooms with free Wi-Fi and glacier views. A half-board menu is served in the evenings and fine regional cuisine is served à la carte throughout the day in the cosy restaurant and on the panoramic terrace. All rooms in the Berghaus Bort have been renovated in 2009, are flooded with natural light and most offer panoramic views of the Eiger's north face or the Grindelwald glacier. In winter, the Berghaus Bort is only reachable by cable car.

210237.description: When you stay at Pension Heino in Saas Grund, you'll be near ski lifts, within a 5-minute drive of Saas-Grund - Kreuzboden Cable Car and Saas-Grund Ski Resort. This family-friendly hotel is 2. 2 mi (3. 6 km) from Saas-Fee Ski Resort and 2. 4 mi (3. 9 km) from Weissmies. Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access. This hotel also features an arcade/game room, ski storage, and a television in a common area. Featured amenities include multilingual staff, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Free self parking is available onsite. Enjoy a meal at Halbpension Restaurant or snacks in the hotel's coffee shop/café. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Make yourself at home in one of the 30 individually decorated guestrooms. Your room comes with a Select Comfort bed. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers.

210250.description:
Surrounded by impressive mountain scenery, the Hotel Waldrand offers a relaxing atmosphere and a variety of facilities; arrive, switch off and feel fine.

The hotel's gentle comfort and personal touch create a warm atmosphere throughout the hotel and its rooms. Most rooms have a balcony and all boast a breathtaking view of the mountains. There are a number of activities to enjoy in the near by area and the hotel's restaurant provides regional specialities.

210427.description: alpha thun hotel offers rooms with wooden furniture and is located next to Lake Thun and the marina. It includes an innovative restaurant, serving freshly-made dishes with seasonal ingredients. Free beverages and snacks are available in the lobby. Wi-Fi is free throughout the hotel. Some rooms come with private bathrooms and some have shared bathroom facilities. The alpha thun restaurant offers a selection of various fresh dishes and was awarded for the use of regional products. The congress Center of Thun and the Schadau Palace are within 0. 6 mi from the hotel. The Thun Train Station is only a 20-minute walk away. The station can be reached by local bus (Line 1), which stops directly in front of the Hotel alpha thun. Guests benefit from the complimentary PanoramaCard Thunersee, which includes the free use of public transports and many reductions for attractions in the region.

210464.description: This hotel is located in Newcastle, lying within easy access of the city's main attractions. The hotel is situated just a short distance away from Newcastle Central Station. The hotel lies close to the famous River Tyne, where guests can enjoy a leisurely stroll to the Quayside. This hotel enjoys a stylish design. The guest rooms are tastefully designed, offering a comfortable setting in which to completely relax and unwind. This hotel offers all the amenities that modern business and leisure travellers require. Guests are sure to enjoy a comfortable, relaxing stay at this charming establishment.

210706.description: Guests staying at the centrally yet tranquilly located Flanders Hotel enjoy free Wi-Fi, a heated indoor pool and an extensive breakfast buffet. The property is in the center of Bruges, just under half a mile from Market Square. All rooms at Flanders Hotel include satellite TV with international programming and in-room hot drinks facilities. The private bathroom features free toiletries. Each morning, breakfast is served in the dining room overlooking a terrace with a pond. The buffet includes freshly baked bread, scrambled eggs, bacon and fresh fruit. Guests can also enjoy locally brewed beers or cocktails in the on-site bar. Many restaurants are in the vicinity of the accommodations. The Concert Hall is just over a 15-minute walk from Hotel Flanders and the Groeninge Museum is a 10-minute walk away. Bruges Train Station is just over 1 mile from the hotel.

210747.description: First-class Holidays at the foot of the North face of the Eiger:The Chalet-style Hotel Kirchbühl, which includes some holiday apartments, has been run by the Brawand family for four generations. Personal care and attention is therefore part of the special charm of this comfortable first-class hotel, which is also famous for its food: while you can find sophisticated delicacies in the gourmet restaurant 'La Marmite', more local specialities are served in the 'Hilty-Stübli' and the 'Eiger-Stube'. Meeting Point for active nature-Lovers:its idyllic, peaceful location above the village church, with wonderful views of the surrounding mountains and glaciers of the Bernese Alps, make the Hotel Kirchbühl the ideal starting point for visitors who want to actively enjoy nature in the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site. Hotel Shuttlebus or (ski)Bus from train station. Ski-In & Ski-Out, Skiischool, Firstbahn and Pfingsteggbahn are nearby.

name.content: Beach Palace Hotel by CW Hotel Collection

210807.description: The Beach Palace Hotel in Blankenberge offers a beachfront location with convenient access to nearby attractions such as Zeebrugge Harbour and Blankenberge Marina. Guests can enjoy various amenities including an indoor pool, sauna, fitness center, restaurant, and bar/lounge. The 95 guestrooms feature minibars, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with toiletries and hair dryers. A self-serve breakfast is available daily for a fee. Other conveniences include safes, desks, daily housekeeping, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

210875.description: Enjoy a central Bruges stay at Bryghia Hotel, steps from the Market Square and Historic Centre. Guest rooms offer refrigerators, minibars, and LED TVs with digital programming. Complimentary Wi-Fi and private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations are also provided. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Convenient amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and self-parking (charges apply). Nearby attractions include the Statue of Hans Memling and Choco-Story Museum. The nearest airports are Ostend-Bruges International Airport (OST) and Brussels Airport (BRU).

210962.description: Spend the day on the slopes, or enjoy recreational amenities including an indoor pool and a spa tub. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Grab a bite at The Carnotzet, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, and multilingual staff. Make yourself at home in one of the 52 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Rooms have private balconies. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

212055.description: The Hampton Inn Iowa City/University Area is the best choice for travelers coming to the Iowa City/Coralville area. Our spacious contemporary guest rooms are all smoke free and designed to meet the needs of all travelers. Located along the Iowa River, our hotel is ideally located just a few minutes from the University of Iowa campus and UI Hospitals & Clinics. While in Iowa City take in the beauty of the historic downtown area which includes Iowa's first capital building as well as many shopping and dining options. Stop by our front desk and one of our friendly guest service agents can inform you of any festivals that may be occurring downtown as well. If you are in town for an Iowa Hawkeyes home football game you will enjoy our close proximity to Kinnick Stadium which is less than 2 miles from our hotel. Start your day off right with our On The House hot breakfast buffet which includes many healthy and satisfying options including fresh baked waffles and hot oatmeal. Whether you are in Iowa City for business or leisure you can always stay connected with our free high speed wired and wireless internet located in the guest rooms and throughout the hotel. Unwind in our indoor pool & whirlpool or get energized in our state of the art fitness center. The Hampton Inn Iowa City/University Area is the perfect location for any traveler – especially those looking to enjoy the Hawkeye way of life!

212057.description: The Homewood Suites by Hilton Coralville offers spacious suites with the comforts of home, conveniently located at the intersection of Interstate 80 and 1st Avenue/Hayden Fry Way in Coralville, Iowa. Situated in the Iowa River Landing, guests are minutes from the University of Iowa, medical facilities, restaurants, and shops. Enjoy nearby dining options like 30hop and Tribute, or sample award-winning craft beers at Backpocket Brewery. Sports fans can catch the Iowa Heartlanders at the Xtreme Arena just a block away, or Hawkeye games at Kinnick Stadium and Carver Hawkeye Arena within three miles.

212518.address: Harbourbay Complex Jln Duyung Sei Jodoh
212518.description: This hotel enjoys an ideal location in the central business and commercial district of Batam. The hotel is conveniently situated just a 30 minutes' driving distance away from Hang Nadim International Airport. Guests can enjoy a 35 minutes' high-speed ferry ride to Singapore, from the nearby Harbour Bay Ferry Terminal. This wonderful hotel tempts guests with the promise of an enjoyable stay. The guest rooms are luxuriously appointed, offering a cocoon of comfort in which to escape the rest of the world. The hotel affords guests a host of facilities and services, which are sure to meet the expectations of even the most discerning traveller.

212658.description:
This establishment is set at the heart of the stunning Costa Daurada. The property lies close to a number of points of interest in the area. Salou is just 15 km away. Guests will find themselves just 7 km away from Cambrils. This hotel offers visitors a break with a difference, drenched in natural splendour and charm. Set amidst 4 hectares of Mediterranean vegetation, this property is set overlooking the sea. Guests can enjoy a wide range of activities nearby. Guests will be pleased by the comfortable accommodation options that the property has to offer, with a choice of camper and tent plots, apartments or bungalows. The accommodation options provide a relaxed setting in which to enjoy a memorable stay. 
Check-in must be completed before 7:00 p. m. If guests are unable to arrive during this time slot, they must contact us directly by email at reservas@campingplayayfiesta. com or by phone at +34 977179513 so that we can explain how to check in. If we are not informed of this situation in advance, guests will not be able to access the campsite.

214104.description: Enjoy this Hasselt hotel's 24-hour fitness center and bicycle rentals. Stay connected with complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and enjoy in-room entertainment on your LCD television. Bistro Green House offers Belgian cuisine, with additional dining at the coffee shop/cafe and 24-hour room service. Unwind at one of the two bars/lounges. Buffet breakfast is available for a fee. The hotel features a 24-hour business center, express check-in/out, a conference center, and 14 meeting rooms, perfect for events. Airport shuttle service is available (surcharge). The 128 air-conditioned rooms offer minibars, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, safes, and desks. Nearby attractions include Hasselt Market Square (0. 4 km), Virga Jesse Basilica (0. 5 km), and the Japanese Garden (1. 7 km).

214115.description: This hotel offers designated smoking areas and a complimentary buffet breakfast served daily from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM. The front desk has limited hours. Free self-parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 21 guestrooms, each featuring complimentary wireless internet access and satellite programming. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Conveniences such as separate sitting areas and complimentary tea and instant coffee are provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Located in Aarau, Hotel Sternen is within a 5-minute drive of Chocolat Frey and Aargau Jura Park. This hotel is 2 miles from Naturama Aargau Museum and 2. 2 miles from Kasino Park. Other nearby points of interest include Aargau Art Museum (2. 2 mi), Aarau Church (2. 3 mi), and Jura Crest Trail (4. 1 mi). The nearest airports are Zurich Airport (ZRH, 30. 6 mi), EuroAirport (BSL, 38. 7 mi), and Mulhouse (MLH-EuroAirport, 38. 7 mi).

214128.description: A total of 18 rooms are available for guests' convenience. Those staying at this property may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. This hotel does not offer 24-hour reception.

214151.description: Experience the historic ambiance of Binningen Castle, nestled in an idyllic park near Basel. Enjoy a delicious meal in the castle restaurant, stroll among ancient trees along the babbling brook, and relax in comfortable rooms within the heritage-listed building. Whether you're planning a family celebration, intimate banquet, or seminar with overnight accommodations, Binningen Castle offers a tranquil escape. Indulge in our renowned hospitality and culinary offerings at the Binningen Castle hotel and restaurant.

214153.description: The establishment comprises 25 cosy accomodation units. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas.

214158.description: At a less than ten minutes walking distance from the main square “Markt” and the historical heart of Bruges, you will discover this Bed and Breakfast , in a charming restored mansion dating from around 1800. The impressive façade and the rich interior offering amongst other elements, decorative chimneys in Louis XVI style, are welcoming you for a romantic stay.

214167.description: Located in the heart of Bruges, Malleberg Hotel offers guests a convenient and comfortable stay. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, air-conditioned rooms with digital programming, and en-suite bathrooms complete with separate bathtubs and showers. The hotel provides a range of amenities including bicycle rentals, a terrace, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and a library. A continental breakfast is available daily for a fee. Just a short walk from Bruges Market Square and the Historic Centre of Brugge, this hotel is the perfect base for exploring the city's many attractions.

214170.description: Guests are guaranteed a warm welcome at this chalet hotel just 400 m from the Champery cable car in the heart of one of Switzerland's best skiing regions. The boutique establishment also welcomes children, for whom there is a separate playroom on the premises and family rooms are available. The 18 units are all furnished in elegant Alpine style and the balconies afford panoramic views of the Dents du Midi. In winter, complimentary afternoon snacks with home-made cakes are served around the crackling fireplace, while a CCTV networks monitors the ski equipment in the secure storage facilities. In the summer, once the snow has melted, outdoor-loving guests can make the most of the beautiful scenery by hiking or cycling around the valleys. This non-smoking property has an on-site restaurant which also serves homemade food and snacks. Visitors have a choice of double or twin rooms.

214173.description: Hotel Patritius, a beautifully converted mansion dating back to 1830, is ideally located just 1476 feet from Bruges' central Market Square and its iconic Belfry. This charming hotel offers air-conditioned accommodations and a tranquil garden terrace. Each room features a private bathroom and views of either the interior garden or the historic city. Amenities include a TV, telephone, and safe. Guests can enjoy a daily continental breakfast buffet with fresh orange juice and eggs in the elegant breakfast room. The peaceful garden provides a perfect spot for afternoon tea. The Wollestraat Shopping District is within easy walking distance, and Bruges Railway Station, with regular connections to Ghent, is just 1. 2 miles away. Blankenberge, on the North Sea coast, is 8. 7 miles from the hotel. Private parking and garage boxes are available on-site for a fee.

214178.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance at this Bruges hotel. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge after a day exploring the city. Start your mornings with the included buffet breakfast. Luggage storage, complimentary newspapers, and a safe deposit box at the front desk are also available. Self-parking is offered (for a fee). Each of the nine guestrooms provides cable TV, free Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries, and a hairdryer. Conveniences such as phones, in-room safes, and desks are also provided. Located in the Historical Center of Bruges, the hotel is within a 10-minute walk of Bruges Market Square and the Historic Centre of Brugge. It's also conveniently close to popular attractions like the Bruges Christmas Market and just a short drive from Knokke-Heist Beach.

214206.description:
When you stay at Hôtel le Funi in Cossonay, you'll be within a 10-minute drive of Jura Vaudois Nature Park and Chateau de Vuillerens.  This hotel is 12.1 mi (19.4 km) from Lausanne Cathedral and 17.8 mi (28.7 km) from Haut-Jura Regional Nature Park.
Featured amenities include luggage storage and an elevator. Free self parking is available onsite.
A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM.
Stay in one of 16 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers. Conveniences include coffee/tea makers, housekeeping is provided daily, and cribs/infant beds (complimentary) can be requested.

214209.description: Hotel Koffieboontje can be found in the cultural heart of Bruges, 50m from the Market Square. The hotel is situated in a calm, traffic-free street and has a terrace and a bistro. The hotel offers apartments and guest rooms. The rooms are equipped with modern facilities and a private bathroom. In the morning, you can enjoy a breakfast buffet. From the public hotel terrace, you have a view on the Belfry. For a wide choice of more than 50 Belgian beers, you can visit the tearoom-brasserie Het Strijdershuis. They also serve a large selection of French and South African wines and various snacks, salads, wafels and hot meals. If you are in for something active, rent a bike from the hotel and explore the surrounding area.

214212.description: This historic townhouse boasts an eye-catching exterior and a large terrace overlooking Bruges' Grote Markt, directly across from the 13th-century Belfry. Hotel Central offers simply decorated rooms with private bathrooms and basic amenities. A daily breakfast includes bread, croissants, cheese, and yogurt. Savor seasonal dishes and fish specialties in the hotel restaurant, or enjoy local Belgian beers, cake, or light meals on the terrace. Explore nearby attractions such as the Basilica of the Holy Blood (just 215 yards away), the Groeningemuseum (a 5-minute walk), and the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Beguinage (less than a 15-minute walk).

214261.description: Indulge in the full-service spa offering massages, body treatments, and facials. This Grindelwald hotel provides convenient ski-in/ski-out access, a spa tub, and a sauna. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Dine at the restaurant, grab snacks at the coffee shop, or order room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. The hotel offers express check-in/check-out, complimentary newspapers, and meeting/conference space. Train station pick-up is free, and self-parking is available (charges apply). The 35 guestrooms feature minibars, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, complimentary Wi-Fi, and digital programming. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. The hotel is near Grindelwald-Wengen Ski Area. Zurich Airport (ZRH) is the preferred airport.

214285.description: Welcome to the 3 star Innbrugas B&b in Bruges. Off site car parking is available. Hotel guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant on site. Rooms at the Innbrugas B&b. Smoking is permitted in certain bedrooms (please specify when booking) and the public areas of the hotel. Wifi internet access is available in all rooms. All rooms feature a stocked minibar. Leisure Info. The Innbrugas B&b offers guests a selection of leisure activities and facilities. A relaxing sauna is available for use by guests.

214413.description: Situated in the town center, the Bernerhof hotel is an ideal choice for both summer and winter holidays. All cable cars, railways, ski lifts, and footpaths are easily accessible. Along with our friendly staff, the Bernerhof offers a cozy, traditional Alpine atmosphere, ensuring a pleasant and comfortable stay. Enjoy the magnificent view of the Eiger Mountain from our terrace!

214432.description: Formerly Hotel De Markies, this charming 3-star hotel is nestled in Bruges' historic center, a short stroll from the vibrant 't Zand square, Market Square, and Belfry. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi in your private room, relax on the terrace, or unwind in the cozy bar. The restaurant offers a delicious lunch and dinner menu featuring a wide variety of dishes. Multilingual staff are available to assist with tours and tickets.

214474.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. A hot tub and a sauna offer a relaxing way to wind down after a day on the slopes. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. The complimentary ski shuttle makes getting to the slopes a breeze. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Featured amenities include multilingual staff, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 24 guestrooms featuring refrigerators. Rooms have private balconies. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Rue du Prado - 0. 5 km / 0.

214486.description: Located in Bruges, within 2133 ft of Basilica of the Holy Blood and 2625 ft of Bruges Concert Hall, Monsieur Maurice features accommodations with a bar and free WiFi throughout the property. The property is set 0. 9 mi from Beguinage, 1640 ft from Market Square and 1640 ft from Belfry of Bruges. The hotel has family rooms. At the hotel the rooms have a desk, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom. Guests at Monsieur Maurice can enjoy a buffet breakfast. Minnewater is 2. 2 mi from the accommodations, while Boudewijn Seapark is 2. 2 mi from the property. The nearest airport is Ostend - Bruges International Airport, 20 mi from Monsieur Maurice.

214493.description: The three-star De Stoute Hotel offers a comfortable stay in Bruges. Guests can enjoy on-site dining and convenient amenities such as tea and coffee making facilities in each room, and a hairdryer. The hotel also provides an airport shuttle and concierge service, and welcomes pets. Off-site parking is available. A no-smoking policy is in effect throughout the property.

214548.description: The Ridderspoor Holiday Flats is a small hotel in Bruges. The hotel offers restaurant facilities. Room Facilities Ridderspoor Holiday Flats. Smoking in certain bedrooms is allowed, as well as in public areas of the hotel. Please specify when booking if you require smoking. Rooms have wireless internet access available.
