214558.description: Enjoy views from the terrace and garden, and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional amenities at this hotel include wedding services, a fireplace in the lobby, and a ballroom. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Featured amenities include multilingual staff, luggage storage, and an elevator. Free self-parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 16 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have bathtubs or showers and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and complimentary bottled water. Located in Bruges (Sint-Kruis), Hotel Lodewijk Van Male is within a 10-minute drive of Minnewater Park and Burg. This hotel is 3. 1 mi (5. 1 km) from Groeningemuseum and 3. 6 mi (5. 7 km) from Begijnhof. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. St. George's Archers Guild - 3. 6 km / 2. 3 mi; St. John's House Mill - 3. 7 km / 2. 3 mi; Gate of Ghent - 3. 8 km / 2. 4 mi; The English Convent - 4 km / 2. 5 mi; St. Anne's Church - 4. 1 km / 2. 5 mi, Engels Klooster - 4. 1 km / 2. 6 mi. The nearest airports are: Ostende (OST-Ostend-Bruges Intl. ) - 35. 8 km / 22. 3 mi; Brussels Airport (BRU) - 106. 1 km / 65. 9 mi. The preferred airport for Hotel Lodewijk Van Male is Brussels Airport (BRU).

214571.description: The Hotel Reestaurant Passage is situated right in the center of Grenchen’s pedestrian zone, 7 minutes from the southern and northern train stations. The hotel offers rooms with private bathrooms with a minibar and free Wi-Fi. Traditional Swiss food is served in the restaurant of the Hotel Passage. Solothurn is just a few miles away.

214624.description: Enjoy stunning terrace views at Hotel Bourgoensch Hof, centrally located in Bruges, just steps from Market Square and the Historic Centre. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a coffee shop/café, and room service during limited hours. Relax with a drink at the bar/lounge after a day exploring nearby attractions. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The 25 guestrooms feature complimentary Wi-Fi, phones, safes, and electric kettles. Additional amenities include luggage storage, a safe deposit box at the front desk, an elevator, and a 24-hour airport shuttle (surcharge applies). The hotel is a short walk from the Basilica of the Holy Blood, the Bruges Belfry, and the Christmas Market.

214628.description: With a small number of only 7, this establishment is very convenient for a quiet stay.

214632.description:
Situated in the heart of the historic centre of Brugge, Hotel T Voermanshuys is housed in a 16th century building offering rooms with a touch of old Flemish atmosphere, at attractive rates.

The rooms at Hotel T Voermanshuys have private bathrooms with bathtub, and are equipped with cable flat screen television, safe, hair dryer, and a kettle with coffee and tea facilities, while free Wi-Fi access is provided all over. Continental buffet breakfast is served each day and included in the room price.

Surrounded by canals, the unique and very central location of this property, makes it ideal for discovering the beautiful and  romantic city of Bruges. Main sites of interest such as the Groeninge museum, the Oud Sint Jan site, the cathedral of Our Lady etc. are only 200-500 metres away, while the famous market with the imposing belfry - landmark of the city- is only a block away.

214658.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as bicycles to rent or take in the view from a terrace. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 16 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. St. Anne's Church - 0. 2 km / 0.

214661.description: The De Pauw Hotel (rated 2 star) is a small hotel in Bruges. On site car parking is available at the hotel. Hotel guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant on site. Room Features De Pauw Hotel. A hairdryer is provided in every room. Rooms have wireless internet access available.

214686.description: The 3-star Matterhorn Valley Hotel Hannigalp enjoys a quiet location in the car-free southern part of Grächen, about 1200 ft from the center of the village, and features an indoor pool. All rooms feature a flat-screen TV, free Wi-Fi and a private bathroom including a hairdryer. Apart from the pool, there are various other spa facilities like a sauna, a jacuzzi and a solarium. In summer and fall you can make free use of the tennis court, the ping-pong table and the mountain bikes. E-bikes are available as well as of summer 2011. The restaurant of the Hannigalp Hotel serves delicious Swiss and international cuisine and features a kids' corner.

214705.description: Hotel Ter Duinen is a small family-run hotel along Langerei Canal in Bruges, a 10-minute walk from Market Square and the Belfry. It features free Wi-Fi, a private courtyard and a terrace. Rooms at the Ter Duinen come with a view of the canal or courtyard. Each room includes air conditioning, a TV and a private bathroom with a shower or a bathtub. Breakfast is served daily in the breakfast room. It includes fresh fruits, freshly squeezed orange juice, meat and cheese dishes, boiled eggs and more. In the afternoon, guests can relax at the lounge bar with a coffee or a tea. Damme is 3 miles away. Historic Ghent is a 35-minute drive from the property. The Belgian Seaside is just 12 miles away. Bruges Train Station is 3. 4 miles from Hotel Ter Duinen.

214733.description: Enjoy garden views at Hotel Asiris, located in the heart of Bruges. The hotel offers 13 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, cable, and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Make use of convenient amenities like room service (limited hours), luggage storage, and on-site self-parking (for a fee). You'll be within a 15-minute walk of Bruges Market Square and the Historic Centre of Brugge, and a short distance from attractions like the Choco-Story Museum and the Friet Museum. Brussels Airport (BRU) is the preferred airport for accessing the hotel.

214757.description: Hotel Leopold is in the heart of Bruges, within a 10-minute walk of 't Zand Square and Bruges Market Square (Grote Markt). This hotel is 11. 4 mi (18. 3 km) from Sea Life Blankenberge and 11. 6 mi (18. 7 km) from Zeebrugge Harbour. Featured amenities include multilingual staff, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Stay in one of 13 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include electric kettles, and housekeeping is provided daily.

214774.description: Located in the heart of Bruges' Historical Center, Hotel Boterhuis offers a delightful stay just steps from the Market Square and Bruges Christmas Market. Enjoy modern conveniences such as complimentary Wi-Fi, daily buffet breakfast, and room service. Bicycle rentals and a terrace provide opportunities for leisure. The 17 air-conditioned guestrooms feature cable TV, coffee/tea makers, and private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Onsite amenities include laundry facilities, luggage storage, and self-parking (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include St. James's Church and the Historium. The nearest airports are Ostend-Bruges International Airport (OST) and Brussels Airport (BRU).

214799.description: Located in the center of Crans-Montana, this family hotel combines modern alpine-style rooms with rustic Swiss design and offers free in-room WiFi. It is just 656 feet from the ski slopes and 164 feet from the casino. The air-conditioned rooms at Hotel Olympic feature cable TV and a bathroom with hairdryer. Several sports shops and restaurants can be found near the property and the ice skating ring is located next door. Private parking spaces are available on request. Characteristic Swiss dishes such as fondue and raclette, as well as fine regional wines, are served in the hotel restaurant. Guests can enjoy music and a wide range of drinks at the in-house bar.

214801.description: Nestled within a magnificent park near the center of Yverdon-les-Bains and its thermal springs, Hotel La Prairie, a Swiss Bike Hotel, offers a serene retreat on the shores of Lake Neuchâtel. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and mini-golf. The en-suite rooms feature a minibar and cable TV, while some boast air conditioning, balconies, and garden views. Savor fresh, regional cuisine in the modern Restaurant La Terrasse or relax on the terrace and in the well-maintained garden. A playground is available for children. Free private parking and covered bicycle storage are provided. Explore Yverdon's rich 6, 000-year history, from prehistoric sites and Roman ruins to a 13th-century Savoy castle and elegant 18th-century buildings. Enjoy cultural events at the Benno Besson or Echandole Theaters.

214808.description: The Hotel Kernen is located close to the Schönried train station, about 3. 1 mi from Gstaad, and offers rooms with balconies, gourmet food and free Wi-Fi. All rooms are rustically but elegantly furnished, and most have a balcony with a beautiful view of the surrounding mountains. You can use the swimming pools and the spa area of the neighboring hotel at a reduced rate. The 18-hole golf course of Gstaad is only a 10-minute drive from the hotel. As a hotel guest you will receive a green fee discount of 10%. The Horneggli and Rellerli cable cars are only a few minutes' walk away from the Kernen hotel. The Hotel Kernen is an ideal starting point to the hiking paths and mountain bike trails, as well as the ski slopes and cross-country ski runs of the Gstaad-Saanenland region.

214828.description: Enjoy ski-in/ski-out access at this hotel, which also features a health club and an outdoor pool. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, an arcade/game room, and ski storage. Dine at the on-site coffee shop/cafe or enjoy room service. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (8:00 AM to 9:30 AM) for a fee. The hotel also offers express check-in/check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and a roundtrip airport shuttle (available on request for a surcharge). Free self-parking is available on-site. The 30 air-conditioned guest rooms provide complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and safes. Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers. Housekeeping is provided daily. Located near the Zweisimmen Gondola and Ski Lift Zweisimmen-Eggweid. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Zweisimmen Gondola - 0. 4 mi / 0. 6 km, etc. The nearest airports are Sion (SIR), Bern (BRN-Belp), and John Paul II - Balice Airport (KRK). The preferred airport is John Paul II - Balice Airport (KRK).

214857.description:
Our hotel offers 16 cozy, modern, and functional rooms designed to make every stay comfortable and relaxing. Each room features underfloor heating for a warm and pleasant atmosphere, a flat‑screen TV, Wi‑Fi, and an in‑room coffee and tea maker. 
Our reception operates 24/7, always ready to assist you with anything you may need. 
Every morning, guests can enjoy a delicious buffet breakfast, prepared with fresh, high‑quality ingredients — the perfect start to the day. 
We take pride in our warm hospitality, creating a welcoming atmosphere where every guest feels truly cared for. 
For added convenience, free parking is available directly at the property.

214905.description: This 3-star hotel is located directly on Lake Murten, surrounded by an unspoiled natural landscape and only a 10-minute walk from the small historical town of Murten. Free WiFi is available. All rooms are located directly by the lake. The Hotel Bad Murtensee offers a large lake terrace, a romantic interior courtyard, a barbecue room, an à la carte restaurant and a banquet room with lake views. In summer, Hotel Bad Murtensee features a lakefront restaurant, a large sunbathing lawn, and a private pier on the lake. A large parking space is available. Various restaurants and shops are in walking distance.

214961.description: This characteristic Swiss chalet hotel with mountain views is centrally located in Lauterbrunnen in the heart of the Jungfrau Ski Region, a 3-minute walk from the Train Station. Hotel Schützen Lauterbrunnen was renovated in 2013 and features a cozy restaurant with an open fireplace and a garden terrace. During winter, the family-run restaurant with its fireplace offers a relaxing and homely Swiss atmosphere. In summer, superb views from the garden terrace towards the mountains can be enjoyed. A breakfast and half board option is available for a surcharge. For breakfast guests can select from an extensive buffet with many local specialties. In the evening guests may choose from a 3-course half board menu or Swiss à la carte dishes. In winter guests can enjoy ski-to-door access from Schilthorn or Mürren. Cable cars are leaving from Grütschalp and Stechelberg and take guests right back to the hotel. The world-famous 311-yard Staubbach waterfall can be seen from Hotel Schützen Lauterbrunnen. Hotel Schützen has its own bus stop, which is in front of the restaurant.

215016.description: Welcome to the luxurious, 4-star See Und Farbhotel Wilerbad in Wilen Bei Sarnen. On-site parking is available, and guests can dine at our hotel restaurant. Business travelers can utilize our Wi-Fi and meeting facilities. Each room at the See Und Farbhotel Wilerbad is equipped with a hairdryer. Please note that smoking is not permitted in any area of the hotel. For leisure, relax and rejuvenate in our luxurious sauna.

215025.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. This hotel also features an arcade/game room, tour/ticket assistance, and a picnic area. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 24 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature hair dryers and bathrobes. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

215036.description: Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a spa tub, a sauna, and bicycles to rent. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a fireplace in the lobby. Satisfy your appetite at the hotel's coffee shop/cafe, or stay in and take advantage of the room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, express check-in, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 8 guestrooms featuring refrigerators. Your memory foam bed comes with Frette Italian sheets. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

215040.description: Located in the quiet village of Leissigen, 8 km from Interlaken, Hotel Kreuz offers panoramic views over Lake Thun and the surrounding mountains. Free WiFi is available, and there is a sunbathing lawn with deck chairs at the lakeside. All rooms come with a TV, electric kettle and a private bathroom with shower or a bath tub. Some rooms feature a balcony. Swiss and international cuisine including fresh fish from the lake is served in the restaurant which features a lake-view terrace. Half-board includes a 4-course dinner (choice of 3 main dishes).

215093.description: With a stay at Hotel Baeren in Reichenbach im Kandertal, you'll be 10. 6 mi (17. 1 km) from Lake Thun and 12. 2 mi (19. 6 km) from Elsigenalp - Metschalp Frutigen Ski Resort. This hotel is 12. 6 mi (20. 3 km) from Adelboden Ski Resort and 14. 8 mi (23. 8 km) from Oeschinen Lake. Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Make yourself at home in one of the 19 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Conveniences include phones and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily.

215098.description: Spend the day on the slopes, or enjoy other recreational amenities, which include bicycles to rent. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, babysitting (surcharge), and an arcade/game room. Enjoy Chinese cuisine at Golden Dragon, one of the hotel's 7 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 93 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment.

215168.description: Die Swaene is located right at one of Bruges’ canals, featuring a swimming pool and elegant accommodations with free WiFi. The Belfry and the Market Square are just 3 minutes away on foot. The 18th-century salon 'Guild of the Taylors' includes a fireplace and offers a cozy ambiance to relax. Die Swaene is a 15-minute walk from the Beguinage and De Halve Maan Brewery. Bruges Train Station is a 20-minute walk away. Various museums are within a 5-minute walk from the accommodations.

215169.description: Enjoy on-site massages and amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and a vending machine. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The hotel also offers a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. For events, there's 517 square feet (48 square meters) of conference and meeting space. The 46 guest rooms feature flat-screen TVs, cable programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Each room also has a phone, desk, and ceiling fan. Hotel des Arts is located in the heart of Neuchatel, a short walk from Casino Neuchatel and the Musée d’Art et d’Histoire.

215177.description: With a small number of only 13, this property is very convenient for a quiet stay.

215182.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at Hotel Adornes, centrally located in Bruges, a short walk from the Market Square and Historium. The hotel offers 20 guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, cable programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Amenities include concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), an arcade/game room, limited room service, and a daily buffet breakfast (fee applies). Complimentary Wi-Fi, a computer station, express check-in, and multilingual staff are also available. Self-parking is available for a fee.

215192.description: Enjoy ski-in/ski-out access at this Saas-Fee hotel, complete with outdoor tennis courts and a lazy river. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and cable TV in your guestroom, and enjoy the convenience of concierge services and babysitting (surcharge). A complimentary ski shuttle whisks you to the slopes. Dine at the hotel's restaurant, Bristol, or grab a quick bite at the coffee shop/cafe. Room service is also available during limited hours. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast, served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel offers complimentary wired internet access, express check-in, and express check-out. A ferry terminal shuttle is provided free of charge, and self-parking is available for a fee. Each of the 21 guestrooms features a flat-screen TV, safe, and desk. Bathrooms include shower/tub combinations and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include the Saas-Fee Ski Resort, Saas-Fee Guides, and the Alpin Express Gondola. The nearest airports are Sion (SIR) and Geneva International Airport (GVA).

215193.description: Enjoy a warm welcome from Bart, Isabelle, and their family at the charming Boutique Hotel Butler, nestled in the tranquil countryside of Zuienkerke. Just a short drive from the expansive North Sea beaches and the historic city center of Bruges, this family-friendly hotel offers a peaceful retreat. A bus stop is conveniently located 50 meters away, and the scenic Polderwind lake and domain are within 100 meters. Ample parking is available on-site. Explore the surrounding area by bicycle, available for rent at the hotel, and discover nearby towns like Blankenberge, De Haan, and the picturesque villages of Lissewege and Damme. Please note, this is a non-smoking hotel, and pets are not allowed. Reception hours are 8:30 am to 9:00 pm, closing at 3:00 pm on Wednesdays and Sundays.

215212.description: Con Ampere Bed And Breakfast The Con Ampere Bed And Breakfast is situated in Bruges. The hotel offers off site car parking. Hotel guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant on site. Room Features Con Ampere Bed And Breakfast. Smoking in certain bedrooms is allowed, as well as in public areas of the hotel. Please specify when booking if you require smoking. Wifi internet access is available in all rooms. Leisure Info. The Con Ampere Bed And Breakfast offers a range of leisure facilities.

215288.description:
The Westbridge Hotel exudes all the luxury and comfort you would expect from a modern 4 star hotel situated in a Grade II listed building dating back to 18th century. 
There are 80 rooms with free WIFI internet access, individually controlled air conditioning and private bathrooms with walk in showers, luxury amenities and a hairdryer, LED Smart TVs, phone, refrigerator, safe, iron, and tea & coffee making facilities.

215396.address: Jl. Raja Ali Haji Sei Jodoh
215396.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at this full-service hotel near Nagoya Hill Mall. Indulge in massages at the spa, take a dip in the outdoor pool, or unwind in the sauna. With four restaurants, including the international cuisine of KK Sky View, a coffee shop, and 24-hour room service, dining is a breeze. Additional amenities include a nightclub, ballroom, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and an area shuttle. The 282 air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen TVs, private balconies or patios, and private bathrooms with deep soaking bathtubs. Airport transfers are available for a surcharge, and free self-parking is provided.

215409.description: This resort is set facing the strait of Singapore, in Batam. The resort is located just a short distance away from a host of attractions in the area, affording guests a great location from which to explore the rich culture and heritage of the region. This wonderful resort enjoys a delightful design, incorporating elements of traditional and contemporary styles. The resort comprises beautifully-appointed guest rooms, which are immersed in luxury and style. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities, ensuring the utmost in comfort and convenience. Guests are invited to take advantage of the host of facilities and services that this wonderful resort has to offer. Business and leisure travellers are sure to appreciate the comfort and convenience that this hotel delivers.

215416.description: Conveniently situated in Batam, this property is the perfect base for both business and holiday travel. Its guests will be at only a 5-minute walk from the shopping paradise that is the Mega Mall Batam Centre and the International Ferry Terminal Batam Centre, they can also reach the Nagoya district in a 20-minute drive and the Hang Nadim Airport for half that time. Those visiting the area on business can take advantage of the modern and multi-functional meeting and banquet facilities of the establishment. They will also have access to a top-of-the-line business centre and complimentary WiFi internet. Since it is not all work the venue also offers plenty of opportunities to relax. From a dip in the splendid outdoor pool, through a workout in the fitness centre and a soothing massage, guests will be well looked after.

215474.description: Hotel Indigo Newcastle is a stylish 4-star hotel in the Newcastle city centre. In our design and decor, you will see influences from Newcastle's industrial and shipping history, and of course, nods to the local football club. Hand drawn murals on the internal walls of the hotel depict our neighbourhood story and local history. Relax in our stylish bar before a meal in 'Social Bird', a brand new dining concept where guests and locals alike enjoy food and drinks to rave about. We are situated near the railway station, Grainger Market, and the Tyne Theatre and Opera House. Our team is passionate about sharing the best of our neighborhood, so you'll never be short of recommendations.

215776.description: ou know the award-winning Roomzzz Newcastle City is a bit special the moment you arrive. There’s the beautiful Grade 2 listed original Friar House building with 14 individually styled, spacious serviced apartments – with something to suit every pocket from our Smart Studio to the fabulous duplex Penthouse Suite – and a character that other hotels can only dream of. Plus new for 2020, we’ve developed a beautiful modern extension with 74 more stunning, spacious apartments. Complimentary Grab & Go coffee and a croissant is available every day between 6:30am and 10:30am to shake up your wake up. Our Essentialzzz includes everything you need from toiletries and organic ready meals to treats and drinks. We offer concession with the Times Square Car Park on Railway Street (NE1 4AD). Please speak to our reception team on departure for a discount voucher. This will reduce your parking charge (for 24 hours) to £10. Alternative parking can be found at the Central Station car park (NE1 5DG) at a cost.

215887.description: Offering a restaurant and a seasonal outdoor pool, Hotel Lacotel is located outside of Avenches, 300 metres from the Lake of Morat and a 7-minute drive from the Amphitheatre. Free WiFi is available in all areas of the property and free private parking is possible on site. Each room at Hotel Lacotel features cable TV, a balcony or terrace with garden and pool views, and a bathroom with shower or bath tub and hairdryer. Guests can relax in the sauna and in the garden of the property.

215901.description: The Hotel Stalden offers you rooms with a balcony, free internet access and a satellite TV (200 channels) in a quiet residential area of Berikon. The restaurant and the reception are closed on Sunday. For arrivals on Sunday you will get a code for self check in. The hotel restaurant serves market-fresh and seasonal cuisine, as well as classic dishes, and guests are welcome to relax in the hotel bar. Free parking is available on site.

216132.description: Enjoy your stay at Hotel Canadá in Tarragona, conveniently located within a 15-minute drive of PortAventura World and Tarragona Port. Make use of complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and our banquet hall. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies), available from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Unwind at our bar/lounge, or grab a snack at the coffee shop/cafe. Our 50 air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen TVs, private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads, and complimentary toiletries. Additional conveniences include phones, desks, and daily housekeeping. We also offer a 24-hour front desk, a safe deposit box, and an elevator for your comfort. Nearby attractions include the Central Park Shopping Center (1. 1 mi), Carrefour Commercial Center (1. 2 mi), and the historic Roman Forum (1. 8 mi). The nearest airports are Reus (REU) and Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN).

216223.description: This cozy hotel is situated on a hill, 22 yards above the village of Hergiswil, overlooking Lake Lucerne and offering a fantastic view of the surrounding mountains. The Roggerli is located 6 miles from the center of Lucerne, and is an ideal starting point for excursions to the mountains, on the lake and to many other places of interest in Central Switzerland and throughout the country. If you are just passing through, the hotel is close to highway A2, which goes from Germany to Italy, yet enjoys a quiet and relaxing setting. The hotel offers plenty of parking space. The restaurant and terrace invite you to try local Swiss cuisine as well as fish and vegetarian dishes.

216226.description: Eco-Hotel Fevery is a small, family-run hotel set in Bruges, a 10-minute walk from the centrally located Market Square and the Belfry. Rewarded with a European Eco label for environmentally friendly hotels, it offers free WiFi and bicycle rental services. Each room at the Fevery features cable TV and a telephone. The private bathroom is fitted with a bath or a shower, a toilet and a hairdryer. The daily continental breakfast with buffet includes bread rolls, toast, bread, cornflakes, nuts, ham, cheese, salami, yogurt, fruit salad, chocolate spread, marmalade, jam, fruit spread, honey and boiled eggs. Croissants are served on Sundays as well. The closest bus stop is 492 feet from Hotel Fevery. You can make use of a secured bicycle and motorbike garage. The historical center of Ghent is a 35-minute drive. Zeebrugge on the seaside is a 15-minute drive away.

216440.description: This 2 star hotel is located in the city centre of Liverpool. It is a short drive away from the Albert Dock and the nearest station is Liverpool Lime Street. All rooms are fully accessible and contain super-sized bunk beds, free WiFi and en-suite shower rooms, and there is a 24-hour reception desk and no curfew for guests. Each dormitory contains individual guest lockers, power points and reading lights, as well as adjustable heating. For guests that require more privacy, female-only dormitories and boutique twin and double rooms with street views are also available. The hostel has a breakfast menu that offers guests continental or cooked breakfasts for a surcharge. For lunch and dinner, guests can enjoy a meal at the property's on-site Kitchen and Bar. In the evening, guests are welcome to have a drink at the on-site Hatch Bar: Sky Sports and BT Sports games showing and a pool table.

216480.description: This cosy, family-run hotel is set in a traditional brick building in the centre of Edinburgh. The popular Haymarket train station is mere metres away, and visitors will be able to arrive to many of the city's most famous attractions on foot, including the National Museum of Scotland and Edinburgh Castle. Shoppers will delight in the shops, restaurants and pubs of Princes Street and George Street, just ten minutes away, while art lovers can enjoy easy access to a wealth of art museums and galleries, such as the National Gallery of Scotland and the Scottish National Gallery of Modern Art. The comfortable rooms come with tea and coffee makers and complimentary wireless internet access, and some are en suite. The helpful and friendly staff can assist guests in making travel arrangements and booking tickets for festivals and events as well as restaurant reservations.

name.content: Hull Humber View Hotel, BW Signature Collection

216595.description: Set in 17 acres of landscaped grounds on the outskirts of Hull, the Hull Humber View Hotel, BW Signature Collection is a wonderful setting for a short break, business meeting or wedding. You can admire views of the Humber Bridge from almost all parts of the hotel, whether you are sipping coffee in the lounge, dining on the terrace or resting in one of our executive bedrooms. As a 2017 City of Culture, Hull put itself firmly on the map and showed why it is a destination full of surprises. Experience its warm welcome and quirky humor while exploring what the city has to offer. You will find a wealth of free museums, including the Streetlife Museum and Ferens Art Gallery, which hosted the Turner Prize in 2017. Down on the waterfront, The Deep aquarium is a must-see attraction, home to Gentoo penguins and an underwater viewing tunnel. If you want to explore further afield, why not take a scenic hike along the Yorkshire Wolds Way or head to the seaside resort of Bridlington?Our 95 stylish bedrooms are dressed in warm, inviting colors, and come with free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and writing desks, and if you want to keep fit while you are here, we have a gym and outdoor jogging track. There is also plenty of free parking and a helipad if you are planning to arrive by chopper.

name.content: London Croydon Aerodrome Hotel by Sunday

216603.description: The Hotel is located on the A23, close to Croydon town centre and 12 miles from the centre of London. Croydon has an excellent shopping complex and a lively nightlife, with a wide choice of restaurants, pubs and clubs for all ages. The centre of London is only 15 minutes away by train from East Croydon station for those wishing to take in the West End shows or all the other visitor attractions of our capital city. The former Aerodrome hotel has completed its extensive refurbishment and has emerged with the contemporary style now synonymous with Hallmark Hotels. The hotel has a well-loved heritage in Surrey, being originally built in 1928 to serve the airport. It has a stunning new lobby, stylish lounge bar and Brasserie as well as fully equipped meeting and conference facilities. All rooms come en suite and fully – equipped as standard.

217179.description: Situated along the beaks of the Hatea River and surrounded by a beautiful natural environment, this colonial-style hotel is an excellent choice for travellers visiting the city as it is close to the Marina and the city centre. The property is approximately a 10-minute drive away from the Whangarei Airport and the beautiful Whangarei Falls. The accommodation units are elegantly appointed and completely equipped with en-suite bathrooms and wireless internet access. Guests can relax and unwind by the hotel's outdoor swimming pool or the Garden Bar. All guests 12 years and over are required to be fully vaccinated and validated by the COVID-19 vaccination pass in order to enter the premises, its venues and outlets. This policy will continue to be reviewed in line with the changing government restrictions.

217481.description: This multi-award-winning New Zealand luxury hotel and retreat is set within a 75-acre estate atop its own private ridgeline, offering spectacular views of the Bay of Islands. Designed and furnished in an eclectic international contemporary style, the gardens and lodgings blend seamlessly into the natural topography and foliage. Unlike many other New Zealand luxury hotels, Eagles Nest at Russell in the Bay of Islands offers the services of its own resident personal trainer and spa therapists, ensuring the most indulgent of stays. Four of the five world-class villas offer their own private heated horizon-edged lap pools, and all villas feature private hot tubs, air conditioning, original artworks, home theatre systems, Ecostore amenities, and fully equipped gourmet kitchens.

217985.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and convenient amenities like a vending machine at Citi Hotel Luton. This hotel offers 68 air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen TVs and digital programming. Each room includes a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Daily housekeeping is provided, and irons/ironing boards are available upon request. The hotel also provides express check-out and luggage storage at the 24-hour front desk. Located near Luton Mall and the University of Bedfordshire, you'll be within a 15-minute drive of ZSL Whipsnade Zoo and a short distance from Grosvenor Casinos. Luton Airport (LTN) is just 3. 5 km away.

218066.description: This smoke-free, four-story guesthouse offers convenient bellhop services and a 24-hour front desk. Guests can store luggage securely and utilize the safe deposit box at reception. Each of the 19 air-conditioned rooms features a flat-screen television, a private bathroom with a shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hairdryer. For added convenience, rooms also include phones, safes, and electric kettles. W12 Rooms is centrally located in London, a short drive from Westfield London Shopping Centre and Kensington High Street. It's also within easy reach of popular attractions like the Natural History Museum and Marble Arch.

218188.description: Set amongst the hills of rural Cheshire, this picturesque hotel has beautiful panoramic views. The premises are a fifteen-minute drive from the centre of Chester. Local attractions include Chester race course and Oulton Park motor racing circuit which are both a short drive away, and the surrounding area offers various country pursuits including walking, golf, fishing and shooting. The comfortable accommodation is housed in historic sandstone buildings and comprises twelve en-suite rooms boasting modern facilities which include free Wi-Fi. The accommodation consists of standard, executive and superior rooms. The inn specialises in serving good food made with fresh locally-sourced ingredients. The bar serves a selection of real ales and has an excellent wine list. Guests can enjoy al fresco dining in good weather or can eat by a roaring fire in the winter.

218189.description: Located in the picturesque village of Warmingham, The Bear’s Paw is a characterful luxury country hotel and restaurant in Cheshire dating from the 19th century. This charming and stylish luxury hotel is located near the major market towns of Sandbach, Middlewich and Crewe in Cheshire, and easily accessible from the M6, making The Bear’s Paw hotel and restaurant the ideal base from which to explore the many delights that Cheshire has to offer. Our luxury hotel accommodation offers 5-star quality rooms, ideal for stopovers and short breaks in the heart of the beautiful Cheshire countryside, whilst our restaurant offers gastro pub style food using local and seasonal produce, awarded for its quality dining experience with an AA Rosette.

218192.description: The 4-star City North Hotel is located 15 minutes from Dublin Airport, and 25 minutes from Dublin Port, just off Junction 7 on the M1, Dublin-Belfast route and 30 minutes from Dublin city. Guests can avail of a Taxi at €25. 00 per car each way to & from Dublin Airport. This must be prebooked for pick up at Dublin Airport. There is also a coach stop at the hotel and a regular service to Dublin city centre which takes 30 minutes. The historic town of Drogheda is 10 minutes away and is the gateway to the Boyne Valley Region and Ireland's Ancient East. Rooms feature large beds, power showers, free Wi-Fi and satellite plasma-screen TVs. There is a 24-hour room service menu and interconnecting rooms are available for families, upon request. Whether your stay is for business or leisure, relax and enjoy stylish surroundings in this contemporary 4 star hotel with excellent facilities including Luxury Accommodation, Elegant Ballroom for Conference, Events and Weddings, Afternoon Tea, Fitness Room, Treatment Room, and a wide choice of dining options in our Tara Lounge and Mornington Restaurant.

218358.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an indoor pool, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy British cuisine at Booking Office 1869, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 4850 square feet (451 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 12 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.

218615.description: Situated moments from Newcastle's picturesque Quayside, with its renowned bridges and The Sage Conference venue, Ramada Encore Newcastle Gateshead offers an ideal base for both business and leisure travelers. Nestled in the vibrant Gateshead Quayside area on the banks of the River Tyne, the hotel is within walking distance of popular restaurants, bars, theaters, art galleries, and attractions, including the Baltic Centre for Contemporary Art and the Utilita Arena. This modern, 200-bedroom hotel boasts free WiFi throughout, meeting rooms, and The Hub bar and restaurant, perfect for relaxing and enjoying a delicious coffee. On-site parking is available for £10. Small dogs are permitted in bedrooms upon request for a £10 fee per pet, per stay. Please note that dogs are not allowed in public areas.

218616.description: Enjoy a satisfying meal at the Travelodge London Ealing's restaurant and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary breakfast is included. This hotel offers 99 air-conditioned guest rooms, each equipped with complimentary dial-up internet access, a safe, and tea/coffee making facilities. Bathrooms include a bathtub and hairdryer. Additional amenities include a safe deposit box at reception and an elevator. Located in London's Ealing district, the hotel is a short drive from Wembley Stadium and the River Thames, and within easy reach of Westfield London Shopping Centre and Kensington High Street.

219147.description: The accomodation comprises 71 cosy guest rooms. Travellers can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the accomodation. Ferienart Resort & Spa offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. Visitors may relax and recharge their batteries at the residence's health and wellness facilities.

219390.description: This exclusive and sophisticated hotel is set in an elegant Georgian building in the heart of Chester, just a few minutes' walk from the leafy banks of the River Dee as well as the Grosvenor Museum and Cheshire Military Museum. The hotel offers luxurious rooms with unique, contemporary décor and an undeniable charm, each inspired by the work of John Douglas, Peter Newbrook and Randolph Caldecott. Many rooms feature wood floors and skylight windows, and all come with modern amenities. The hotel's restaurant and dining rooms offer delectable Mediterranean cuisine as well as classic brunch and afternoon tea, while the bars offer chic and eclectic interiors as well as a garden and outdoor terrace- the perfect place to enjoy a glass of champagne and watch the sun set over Chester.

219393.description: Stay at the Travelodge London Central Southwark, located in the heart of London, a short walk from iconic landmarks such as The Shard and Tate Modern. This hotel is also conveniently close to Borough Market and London Bridge, offering 99 comfortable guestrooms for a pleasant stay. Nearby airports include London City (LCY), Heathrow (LHR), Gatwick (LGW), and Luton (LTN), with London City Airport recommended for ease of access.

219441.description: Centrally located in London, the Travelodge London Central City Road Hotel is within a 5-minute drive of Liverpool Street and St. Paul's Cathedral. This hotel offers 99 guestrooms with bathrooms featuring bathtubs or showers. Guests can enjoy a satisfying meal at the on-site restaurant and drinks at the bar/lounge. A breakfast service is also available (fee applies). The hotel provides wheelchair access, express check-out, and an elevator. Nearby attractions include the Barbican Arts Centre, The Gherkin, Brick Lane, and Sky Garden.

220071.description: With a stay at Hotel Mardaga - Different Hotels in As, you'll be next to a golf course, within a 10-minute drive of Maasmechelen Village Outlet and Spiegelven Golf Club. This 4-star hotel is 14. 7 mi (23. 6 km) from Center Parcs Erperheide and 15. 4 mi (24. 8 km) from Market. Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including a health club and bicycles to rent. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in As? This hotel features 1076 square feet (100 square meters) of event facilities. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and free self parking is available onsite. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/café. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held on select days. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Stay in one of 18 guestrooms featuring LED televisions. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed, and all rooms are furnished with sofa beds. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature deep soaking bathtubs and hair dryers.

220962.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of this elegant Edwardian hotel, complete with complimentary Wi-Fi. The hotel offers wedding services and a banquet hall, perfect for special occasions. Dine at the Crystal restaurant for lunch or dinner, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge after a day exploring the nearby Delamere Forest, just a short drive away. Each of the 36 guestrooms features an LCD television, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combination, bidet, and hairdryer. Additional amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and free self-parking. A full English breakfast is available for a fee. Nunsmere Hall Hotel is conveniently located near several attractions, including Cheshire Falconry and Little Budworth Country Park.

221387.description: Located 4. 9 feet above sea level in Bürchen, on the south-facing slope of the Rhone valley, the Hotel Restaurant Bürchnerhof offers views of the alpine landscape. Most of the nicely furnished rooms feature a balcony. Guests can enjoy an indoor pool and a children’s pool. A hot tub and a sauna are also provided and massages are available on request. The Bürchnerhof also features table tennis and a children's playroom. After a day out in the fresh mountain air, guests can enjoy tasty seasonal specialties in the Hotel Bürchnerhof’s restaurant. Special gourmet events, such as the traditional wine-and-dine evenings with winegrowers from the region are organized as well. The Bürchnerhof can be found on the access road from Visp, Turtmann, Unterbäch, Törbel and Moosalp next to the bus stop, yet in a quiet location. Bürchen is perfectly suited for hiking in summer and skiing in winter. Bürchen has a great ski area with 6 ski elevators. Surrounding cities like Zermatt, Saas-Fee and Montana can be reached within one hour by car.

222062.description: The Camden Hotel, situated in the heart of Dublin, offers convenient access to the city's vibrant attractions. A short walk from Grafton Street and St. Stephen's Green, and within a mile of Trinity College and St. Patrick's Cathedral, this hotel provides an ideal base for exploration. The 35 guestrooms feature complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional amenities include desks, electric kettles, a 24-hour front desk, a safe deposit box, an elevator, and tour/ticket assistance. Housekeeping is provided once per stay.

222217.description: This hotel enjoys a great setting in Leeds, lying just a 10 minutes' walking distance from Leeds City station. The hotel is set in the financial district of the city, close to shops and entertainment areas. A variety of restaurants and cafes can be found just a 5 minutes' walking distance away. Guests will find themselves within easy access of a host of attractions. This charming hotel welcomes guests with style and sophistication. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, offering a superb setting in which to work and rest in comfort. Guests can enjoy a delightful dining experience in the relaxing surroundings of the restaurant, followed by a refreshing drink from the bar.

222227.description: The George Hotel, a charming 16th-century coaching inn, is nestled in the heart of Wallingford's historic market town, a short 20-minute drive from Oxford. Each room features a private bathroom, TV with Sky, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can also enjoy amenities such as hairdryers, tea/coffee-making facilities, and laundry/dry cleaning services. Savor seasonal, traditional English cuisine at Wealh’s Restaurant or enjoy a lighter meal in the relaxed atmosphere of the Bistro. The Tavern Bar offers a selection of drinks, real ales, and classic pub fare, perfect for savoring in the hotel's courtyard. Free parking is available on-site, and regular bus service to Oxford and Reading is easily accessible from the nearby market square. The hotel boasts a prime location near the River Thames, with views of the 11th-century Wallingford Castle ruins from behind the property.

222260.description: The Hotel Café Royal, a luxurious 5-star hotel, graces Regent Street in the heart of London, nestled between elegant Mayfair and vibrant Soho. A short walk reveals iconic attractions like Big Ben, Buckingham Palace, and the National Portrait Gallery, alongside world-class shopping and theaters. Sensitively restored historic areas dating back to 1865 blend seamlessly with contemporary spaces. Guests can indulge in diverse dining experiences, from the Grill and Sushi Bar - Laurent at Café Royal to the relaxing Green Bar and the opulent Oscar Wilde Lounge, perfect for afternoon tea. Ziggy's cocktail bar offers a unique tribute to David Bowie. The Akasha Holistic Wellbeing Centre provides a 1200+ sqm urban retreat.

222354.description: Just a 5-minute walk from Ilford Railway Station, Arinza Hotel London offers free onsite parking, free Wi-Fi, and continental breakfast throughout the whole day. Ilford Railway Station and Gantshill Underground Station offer direct access to Central London, with Oxford Street and Piccadilly Circus just 35 minutes away. Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park is only 15 mins away. Following London airports are also at a close distance:City Airport: 15 mins driveStanstead Airport: 20 mins driveHeathrow Airport: 45 mins driveGatwick Airport: 50 mins driveAll rooms have modern furnishings, tea and coffee making facilities, LCD interactive TV, climate-controlled Air Conditioning, and free WiFi. Each room also features an ensuite bathroom with a power shower and complimentary toiletries.

222758.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Genk. It is a short drive away from the Studio Piet Stockmans.

222777.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages, body treatments, and facials. Skiers will be in heaven, but there are recreational options available for non-skiers as well, including an indoor pool and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, ski storage, and a television in a common area. At Hotel Regina Terme, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, dry cleaning/laundry services, and multilingual staff. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 62 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have bathtubs or showers and complimentary toiletries.

222779.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the city centre of Meiringen and was established in 1895. It is close to the City center and the nearest station is n/a.

222916.description: Located close to the river Cam, this welcoming family-run guest house is an ideal place to stay for visitors to Cambridge. Guests can easily access the city centre and the historic colleges and the premises feature easy access to Cambridge's main business parks and so are ideal for business travellers. The premises are well served by public transport and there is some off-street parking available. The tastefully decorated guest rooms comprise single, twin, double and family rooms, some of which are located in the annex, Hawthorn house. The family rooms feature a double bed as well as a single or bunk bed, and an extra mattress can be provided. All rooms feature en-suite bathrooms, as well as TVs and tea and coffee making facilities. Guests can start the day with a traditional cooked breakfast or a lighter continental breakfast, served in the premises' pretty dining room.

223176.description: Comfortable accommodation. It has good-value en suite rooms and a new bar.The rooms come with TVs, toiletries and tea/coffee. Reopened after refurbishment, the hotel is in Dublin city centre, across the river from Temple Bar and close to the shops, bars and attractions. It is only a few steps from the Academy music venue and 300 metres from the shops of Henry Street. Grafton Street and the Olympia Theatre are both 700 metres away.

224781.description: This property boasts a countryside setting in Bedfordshire. Luton Airport is just a 10 minutes' driving distance away. Heathrow International Airport is a 40 minutes' car journey from the property. Stunningly situated amidst 1,000 acres of parkland and gardens, which were designed by Capability Brown, this spectacular hotel oozes regal elegance and splendour. Mature trees are dotted throughout the surroundings, while the River Lea flows by the property. This luxurious mansion tempts visitors into a world where classical charm, contemporary style and traditional elements are combined. The sumptuously-designed guest rooms exude character and charm. Guests can enjoy boating and fishing in the lake. Guests can dine in the original state dining room, which is drenched in regal glamour. This hotel is sure to surpass the expectations of even the most discerning traveller.

224793.description:
Make yourself at home in the heart of Georgian Dublin
A happy marriage of 19th Century Georgian style and 21st century comfort.
Contemporary cool meets warm, Irish hospitality.
 
Find us on Pembroke Road, a 15-minute stroll from St Stephen's Green past elegant streets and famous squares that echo with centuries of history.
 
Think gracious spaces. Comfortable sofas. Crackling fires. Warm smiles. Friendly faces.
 
Awarded second place in Ireland for Georgina Campbell's Guesthouse of the year 2020.
 
Included in the Michelin Guide and chosen as 'One of the Top 100 Places to stay in Ireland.'

224794.description:
Herbert Park Hotel & Park Residence is an independent property, featuring a 4-star hotel and self-catering studio apartments, established in 1996. Situated in Ballsbridge, Dublin 4, the property is conveniently close to the RDS, Aviva Stadium, and the nearest DART(train) station is Lansdowne Road. 

The hotel offers two dining options: the Pavilion Restaurant and the Terrace Lounge, as well as a fitness suite/gym. All 185 bedrooms and 43 apartments are equipped with a minibar, hairdryer, safe, trouser press, ironing set, and air conditioning. 

Information for Park Residence Studio Apartments:
Please note that the property operates a weekly housekeeping service. Guests staying fewer than 8 nights can request a full cleaning service at a cost of €45 per day. This can be arranged through reception or by contacting parkresidenceservice@herbertparkhotel. ie with 24 hours' notice.

224884.address: Komplek Reffles City Blok E No 6-9
224884.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a nightclub, an outdoor pool, and a sauna. Additional amenities at this Edwardian hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Grab a bite at Bellini Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge and a pool view. You can also stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. A ferry terminal shuttle is provided at no charge, and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 60 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed. Cable television is provided for your entertainment.

225857.description: Nestled in the heart of the Midlands, just five minutes from Junction 2 of the M5 and opposite Dudley Zoo and Castle, this charming hotel offers a warm, friendly welcome, free Wi-Fi, and parking. The property is perfectly positioned for those wishing to explore the historic Black Country and is just a short distance from the Black Country Museum, Merry Hill Centre, and Birmingham City Centre. The hotel has a long and storied past; its grand staircase, high ceilings, and tall windows evoke the traditional ambiance of a bygone era. Each of the comfortable and well-appointed en suite bedrooms is complete with modern comforts to create a home-away-from-home atmosphere. The restaurant offers an extensive selection of fine food and wine, all served in stylish and sophisticated surroundings. There is also a lounge bar leading onto an impressive conservatory where guests can relax and enjoy drinks with friends.

name.content: DoubleTree By Hilton International Newcastle Airpo

226009.description: The DoubleTree by Hilton Newcastle International Airport offers contemporary, upscale accommodations directly adjacent to Newcastle Airport in Northumberland. Just steps from the terminals and long-term parking, it's ideal for overnight stays or layovers in Newcastle, UK. The city center is a quick 20-minute metro ride south. Modern guest rooms feature refreshed bathrooms, flat-panel TVs, generous workspaces with data ports, our luxurious Sweet Dreams® beds, and complimentary wired or wireless high-speed internet access. Guests also enjoy upscale amenities, including a well-equipped fitness center, an inviting coffee lounge, and in-room dining. Dine at Fratello's Restaurant, serving international cuisine and local favorites for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Start your day with our extensive DoubleTree breakfast buffet. Unwind with friends or colleagues over a glass of wine at the bar. In addition to modern amenities and a convenient location, the DoubleTree by Hilton Newcastle Airport boasts flexible meeting rooms and attractive ballroom space perfect for conferences or social events. Our support services include first-class catering and banquet facilities, state-of-the-art AV and connectivity solutions, complimentary wireless high-speed internet in all public areas, and a business center. Let our professional staff help you plan a memorable corporate event, gala, or wedding reception. During your stay, enjoy a round of golf at one of the many nearby golf clubs, or indulge in retail therapy at Eldon Square Shopping Centre or trendy Northumberland Street. The hotel offers easy access to numerous Newcastle and Gateshead attractions, as well as universities and businesses. Upon arrival in Newcastle upon Tyne, our friendly staff will welcome you with our signature warm DoubleTree chocolate chip cookie.

226123.description: A total of 25 accomodation units are available for guests' convenience.

226694.description: This cosy hotel is the ideal accommodation destination for everyone visiting Edinburgh. In front of Leith Links park and close to Ocean Terminal shopping centre, the property is also not far from the famous Royal Yacht Britannia for those interested in paying a visit. Using the public transport connections or their own car, travellers can easily get to the city centre and go to Princess Street. Built in a Georgian house and set in a quiet area, this hotel will provide a pleasant and relaxing stay without a doubt. It is fitted with nice guest rooms, which are fully equipped and include modern amenities to guarantee an unforgettable stay. Guests will appreciate the warm welcome at their arrival by the hotel’s staff, who will make sure guests have a pleasant time at the property.

226971.description: Hotel ibis budget Brugge Centrum Station is a budget yet modern choice for your stay in the historical centre of Bruges, a UNESCO world heritage site that is also famous for its chocolate and beers - delicious. All of the rooms offer modern facilities such as air conditioning, flat-screen TVs, free WiFi, a private toilet and comfortable Sweet Beds. Enjoy our daily breakfast, get ready, and with one step out of the hotel you are immediately in the hustle and bustle of Bruges amazing culture.

226972.description: The ibis Styles Zeebrugge welcomes both business and leisure travelers to its beachfront location in the heart of Zeebrugge's port, offering harbor views. This economy hotel features a swimming pool, wellness center, meeting rooms, a bar serving drinks and snacks, and a delicious breakfast buffet.

226988.description:
ibis Styles Hasselt City Centre

In the heart of Hasselt, our hotel brings the adventurous spirit of Adrien de Gerlache to life. Small, cozy cabin style rooms exude a trendy charm. Enjoy street art, the famous banana carpet and vibrant tourism. Perfect for both business guests and leisur e travelers. Discover a world full of penguin inspiration, fruity details and playful references. Here, coziness meets adventure. 

ibis Styles Hasselt City Centre is a unique hotel in the heart of Hasselt, close to the shopping streets. Discover the largest Japanese garden in Europe, the Jenever Festival, Pukkelpop, the Trixxo Arena and the famous Hasselt Speculaas. 

Welcome to ibis Styles Hasselt City Centre. Enjoy style, comfort and Hasselt coziness. We ensure that you immediately feel at home with us. Our promise, our word. In name of the entire team, a warm welcome.

228532.description: While our room rates won't break the bank, attention to detail is always high. With the comfort of Sweet Beds in every room, lightning-quick free fibre Wi-Fi throughout, and one of the most varied breakfast spreads you'll find in any hotel, customers are regularly surprised at just how much they get for what they pay. Oh, and you don't have to check out until noon, so you can enjoy a lazy start and an unhurried breakfast.

name.content: Ibis Edinburgh Royal Mile - Hunter Square

228553.description: ibis Edinburgh Centre Royal Mile's prime location sets you right in the city's nerve centre for the duration of your stay. And whether you're in town to shop, party, take care of business or all of the above, our modern décor, friendly staff, hearty breakfast spread and spotless modern rooms come together to provide you with the ultimate mini break - for a lot less than you might think.

name.content: ibis Glasgow City Centre - Sauchiehall Street

228555.description: For business trips or leisurely pleasure, ibis Glasgow City Centre puts everything within easy reach, including the SSE Hydro Complex, SEC Armadillo, Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Sauchiehall Street. . . and one of the best night's out you've ever had. Our hotel is kitted out with modern décor and staffed by some of Glasgow's finest people, so you can explore this buzzing cultural hub with all the creature comforts you need, at prices that suit your budget.

228570.description: Right on the doorstep of some of the world's most famous sights and attractions, ibis London Blackfriars promises comfort and convenience in abundance. Whether you're in the capital for some culture on the Southbank and a ride on the Eye, or for a business meeting over in the City, we're perfectly located. Nearby you'll enjoy some of London's best markets, independent stores and live music venues, while crowd-pleasers like St Paul's Cathedral and Tate Modern are within easy reach.

228571.description: Just a 15-minute stroll from the banks of the Thames, a stay at Ibis London City - Shoreditch promises convenience as well as comfort. With quirky decor and interior stylings that pay homage to nearby Brick Lane, our modern hotel is the ideal place to call home if you're looking for a fun and cultural stay in the British capital. You'll fall in love with the amazing local food markets, offering cuisine from around the world, independent stores and live music venues that Shoreditch has to offer.

228572.description: Start your day right by tucking into an unlimited spread of cooked and continental breakfast options, enjoy easy transport access to London's hottest attractions for a fun-filled day, and blast away the day's adventures in our en suite power showers, available in every room. And if you need a hand with anything? The friendly team at our affordable London hotel is always happy to help, 24 hours a day.

228573.description: When you're trying to get from A to B, sometimes you just need the essentials - but that doesn't mean they can't be done really well. That's exactly what we're about here: with super-comfortable Sweet Beds in every room, a hearty breakfast served up each morning, a stylish on-site bar and restaurant, free fibre Wi-Fi, late checkouts (just in case your schedule loosens up) and the friendliest staff in the region, ibis London Elstree Borehamwood ticks all the boxes.

228575.description: The all-new ibis Styles hotel at Gatwick has modern, stylish decor with a 'wanderlust' theme. With 182 guestrooms, all with triple glazing and air conditioning, you'll enjoy a comfortable break on your travels. Facilities at the hotel include a restaurant with some options available 24/7, airport shuttle bus (charges apply), meeting space and a gym, you'll find all you need for a great stay. Located just a few minutes from the airport by taxi or shuttle bus, and within easy reach of Gatwick Airport train station.

228576.description: Relax with a drink in our stylish 24hr lobby bar, stay connected with free fibre Wi-Fi throughout the building, and tuck into a filling breakfast (cooked breakfast with several options or a fresh continental spread - the choice is yours) each morning at the linked Banana Tree. ibis London Greenwich merges a great location with all the necessary comforts, so that you enjoy a relaxing break at budget-friendly prices.

228577.description: Secure yourself spotless accommodation and an unbeatable city location: ibis London Shepherd's Bush positions you within a stone's throw of local attractions and handy transport links. And with a hearty breakfast spread each morning, free fibre Wi-Fi throughout, a modern, airy bar and restaurant, efficient tour-booking service, and plush Sweet Beds in every room, we've got you more than covered for the most relaxing, restorative London stay.

228579.description: ibis London Wembley is home to 210 inviting en suite bedrooms with modern furnishings and our famous Sweet Beds. Our friendly bar is open to you from dawn until midnight so, whether you fancy a mid-morning coffee or a chilled-out nightcap, there's always a friendly face waiting. And with two of London's most beloved events spaces within easy reach, our guests enjoy the best location at the most affordable prices.

228582.description: We offer 148 well-appointed rooms with all the space you need, and none of the frills you don't. Enjoy a great night's sleep before indulging in an unlimited continental breakfast spread, designed to fuel you up for whatever the day holds. Pop down to the lobby at any time of the day or night for snacks and drinks: our friendly staff work around the clock to make sure everything you need is seen to.

228583.description: Stay at the ibis Styles London Southwark, centrally located near Borough Market, within a 10-minute walk of Tate Modern. This eco-certified Art Deco hotel offers a terrace, garden, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant or snack bar/deli, and drinks at the bar/lounge. The 154 air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Additional amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Meeting and conference space is available. Self-parking is available (subject to charges).

228587.description: Welcome to the DoubleTree by Hilton London - Greenwich, a modern, historic hotel located in Royal Borough of Greenwich. Once a police ‘section house, ’ this RIBA winning 1940’s landmark building has been restored with a contemporary flare while preserving its historic charm. Our tranquil location is near train stations putting you within easy reach of popular attractions. The major business district of Canary Warf is just 20 minutes away via DLR services. Enjoy a unique perspective from our viewing deck on the 8th floor which overlooks the city of London. Our exemplary service starts with a warm DoubleTree chocolate chip cookie at check-in. Each of our modern guest rooms feature complimentary WiFi, 37-inch HDTV, coffeemaker and laptop-sized safe. Upgrade to a suite for a view of London and Greenwich Park as well as a mini bar, high ceilings and seating area. Enjoy a unique dining experience at Restaurant Oasis 01, a beautifully restored firearms shooting gallery offering locally sourced ingredients prepared and presented to perfection. Unwind after a busy day at Oasis Bar & Lounge where you can savor the best wines, cocktails and champagne in Greenwich as well as a light lunch, dinner or afternoon tea. Our hotel in Greenwich also offers 24-hour daily room service. Keep your exercise regimen on track in our fitness center featuring Precor® equipment for a full-body workout. Along with a 24-hour business center, we offer 1, 269 sq. ft. of Greenwich event space for small meetings and intimate celebrations for up to 90 guests. Our professional staff is eager to help you with all your planning, decorating and catering needs.

228589.description: If you're looking for a contemporary and elegantly-designed hotel in a vibrant and easy-to-reach corner of the capital, Novotel London Blackfriars has you covered. Just a few steps to the attractions that line the Southbank, a short stroll from London's top markets, and a couple of Tube stops to the likes of St Paul's Cathedral and Tower Bridge - the best of London will be right on your doorstep. Just minutes from the City, we're as well-placed for business as we are for pleasure.

228591.description: Nestled in the trendy Baltic Triangle and close to the Georgian Quarter, ibis Liverpool Centre Albert Dock positions you perfectly for exploring this sprawling maritime city. Start right with a hearty, unlimited breakfast spread, spend your day exploring the extensive local sights and attractions then head back for a light bite and a nightcap in our friendly on-site restaurant and bar. With free fibre Wi-Fi throughout and quirky urban-inspired décor, we know how to do 'budget' extremely well.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel London Heathrow Airport

228735.description: DoubleTree by Hilton London Heathrow Airport offers perfect rooms for all travelers flying to or from Heathrow as well as staying on business. Located off the A4 Bath Road, we're three miles from Heathrow Airport Terminals 2 and 3. Heathrow Hoppa bus is available on a schedule. Situated on the Piccadilly line, Hatton Cross and Hounslow west tube Stations are 1. 2 miles from the hotel and offer direct service to central London in around 30 minutes. Feel at home in a comfortable, air-conditioned guest room including complimentary WiFi, a well-lit work area and flat-screen TV with Freeview channels. Stay productive in the 24-hour business center and plan an event for up to 70 people in one of the 6 meeting rooms with natural daylight. Energize with the latest exercise equipment in the complimentary 24-hour fitness center. Unwind with a drink in the relaxed sports bar, before enjoying a meal in the Touchdown restaurant.

228989.description: This hotel boasts a privileged location in the city of Reus. The hotel is located just 10 km away from the stunning beaches of the Costa Dorada. Port Aventura and Tarragona City are just a short distance away. Guests can explore the many attractions that the area has to offer. Reus Airport is just 1.5 km away. This wonderful hotel enjoys a charming design. Guests are welcomed with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms offer a peaceful, comfortable setting in which to completely unwind at the end of the day. Guests can enjoy a delectable dining experience in the elegant surroundings of the restaurant, where sumptuous dishes are sure to tempt even the most discerning palate.

230058.description: The newly refurbished Commodore Hotel, a beautiful Victorian townhouse in London, offers a unique 4-star hotel experience. A range of accommodations, from comfortable rooms to spacious suites, are available, including executive rooms, double rooms with sofa beds (suitable for triples), and townhouse suites. The hotel is committed to ongoing improvements and updates throughout its rooms and public areas.

230415.description: With its convenient location near London Victoria station and Pimlico tube station, this luxurious family-run hotel is an ideal base for tourists to explore London's attractions and for business travellers to the city. Set across four Georgian town houses it features 73 individually-designed and stylishly-decorated en-suite guest rooms, all of which feature rainfall showers, designer fabrics, HD TVs, Wi-Fi and Nespresso coffee makers. The Signature rooms boast excellent views over the city. Guests can kick the day off with a tasty breakfast, and later on the reception and bar area makes an excellent place to relax with a cocktail after a hard-day's sight-seeing and before heading out to explore London's range of gastronomic delights. The premises also feature a meeting space and have on-site catering services which make it the ideal venue for meeting with clients.

231021.description: Situated at the crossroads of vibrant Soho and Leicester Square, the Leicester House Hotel welcomes discerning guests to its renovated, historic building, steeped in three decades of history. The hotel offers 11 double rooms, 3 twin rooms, and 3 heritage suites, including the Karl Marx Suite, the Johann Strauss Suite, and the Emile Suite, each designed for comfort and convenience. Located in the heart of London, the hotel is just minutes away from renowned cultural and entertainment venues such as The National Gallery, the Royal Academy of Arts, Covent Garden, Trafalgar Square, the Apollo Theatre, and the Palace Theatre. Piccadilly Circus and Leicester Square Underground stations are both a short 3-minute walk away, providing easy access from Heathrow and Gatwick Airports in under an hour.

231023.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a sauna or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access. Enjoy British cuisine at Palominos Restaurant, a restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge, take in the garden view, and even dine alfresco. You can also stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Meet other guests and eat at the complimentary reception. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 30 guestrooms featuring espresso makers and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms with showers are provided. Conveniences include phones, as well as coffee/tea makers and fans. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Auchentoshan Distillery - 8. 7 km / 5. 4 mi- St. Mirren Park - 10. 1 km / 6. 3 mi- Golden Jubilee National Hospital - 10. 9 km / 6. 8 mi- Paisley Campus, University of the West of Scotland - 11. 3 km / 7 mi- Paisley Abbey - 11. 9 km / 7. 4 mi- Royal Alexandra Hospital - 12. 3 km / 7. 6 mi- Titan Clydebank - 12. 7 km / 7. 9 mi- Xscape Braehead - 13. 8 km / 8. 6 mi- Dumbarton Castle - 14. 7 km / 9. 1 mi- Braehead Shopping Centre - 15 km / 9. 3 mi- Gleniffer Braes Country Park - 15. 7 km / 9. 8 mi- Queen Elizabeth University Hospital - 15. 8 km / 9. 8 mi- Custom House - 15. 9 km / 9. 9 mi- Waterfront Leisure Complex - 16 km / 10 mi- Thomas Coats Memorial Baptist Church - 16. 9 km / 10. 5 mi. The nearest airports are: Glasgow International Airport (GLA) - 9. 6 km / 6 mi Glasgow (PIK-Prestwick) - 61. 7 km / 38. 3 mi The preferred airport for Ingliston Country Club Hotel is Glasgow International Airport (GLA).

231084.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this Edwardian hotel include a fireplace in the lobby and a ballroom.
