Satisfy your appetite for lunch, dinner, or brunch at Berners Tavern, a restaurant which specializes in British cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. English breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, limo/town car service, and a computer station. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 1020 square feet (95 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 2 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 173 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. Your bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets.

231087.description: Welcome to London. The Best Western Greater London Hotel, built in 2013, is conveniently located near Ilford train station, offering easy access to central London (15 minutes) and ExCeL London (10 minutes by car). This hotel offers guests comfort and convenience with proximity to the Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park and Ilford's shopping center. TripAdvisor® has recognized Ilford as a rapidly growing tourist destination in Europe. The hotel features crystal chandeliers, Roman pillars, a Chesterfield sofa lounge, and an air-conditioned reception area for a sophisticated and elegant ambiance.

231557.description: A central Birmingham aparthotel with free Wi-Fi and breakfast included, plus a Fitness Centre and laundry room. The apartment-style Staybridge Suites® Birmingham hotel sits in the heart of Birmingham, within a short walk of Moor Street, New Street and Snow Hill stations. A 10-minute train ride from Birmingham International Airport, the hotel is just steps from Aston University, the Birmingham Science Museum and Corporation Street. Guests can visit the Bullring Market and House of Fraser to stock up on daily comforts. There are restaurants and bars around New Street, and many galleries and theatres nearby. Business guests are close to the International Convention Centre and the central business district, with local headquarters of international companies like Barclays and HSBC. The fully-equipped kitchen in your suite makes it easy to cook your own dinner, with all the groceries you need at our 24-hour Pantry. With a laundry room on-site, you'll want for nothing. Start your day with an inclusive breakfast buffet or a visit to the Fitness Centre. Unwind with drinks and snacks and meet other guests at social receptions three evenings a week. Relax in your spacious suite and catch up with your family using the free Wi-Fi. Please note guests are required to leave a £50 deposit by credit card, or £200 cash along with a driving license or passport matching the name on the booking.

231701.description: This modern aparthotel is situated in the central area of Edinburgh, just a 5-minute walk from Haymarket Railway Station. Housed in an elegant Georgian townhouse that dates back to 1881, its boasts style and comfort that will surely win-over all of its guests. The self-catering accommodations are equipped with large flat-screen TVs, kitchen facilities that are perfect for preparing home-like meals and cosy seating areas. Guests who prefer to explore the fine restaurants of the city will be within a 10-minute walk from Princes Street and can pick any of the excellent establishments located in the immediate vicinity. The iconic Edinburgh Castle, the International Conference Centre and the historic Royal Mile are all less than 30 minutes' walk away.

name.content: Hampton by Hilton London Luton Airport

232159.description: We’re conveniently located less than 5 minutes from Luton Airport terminal via the DART passenger transit system, which is just outside the hotel. We’re also right next to Luton Parkway Train Station, which offers direct access to St. Pancras International Station in less than 25 minutes. Enjoy comfortable rooms, each with a bathroom with walk-in power shower, free high-speed internet access and air-conditioning. Hampton by Hilton Luton Airport features an on-site fitness center which is open 24 hours a day. Freshly cooked bacon and sausage are served with breakfast, along with Hampton's signature waffles. Evening meals are provided in the hotel bar and dining area. A range of Italian, Indian and Chinese restaurants can be found in Luton town center, which is a 20-minute walk from the hotel.

232187.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as a fitness center, a terrace, and a garden at this Victorian hotel. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Savor international cuisine at Whittys Restaurant, where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge, admire the garden view, and dine alfresco. You can also take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Mingle with other guests at the complimentary daily reception. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Free self-parking is available onsite. The hotel offers 187 guestrooms featuring Smart TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Safes and complimentary newspapers are provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Nearby attractions include Aviva Stadium (0. 2 mi), Grand Canal (0. 4 mi), and Herbert Park (0. 8 mi). The preferred airport is Dublin Airport (DUB), 8. 8 mi away.

232371.description: It is a design located in the historic centre of Bruges, a 5-minute walk from the the market square and the belfry. The rooms are equipped with wooden floors. It serves a healthy breakfast in the breakfast room. Less than 5 minutes walk there are various cafés and restaurants. The basilica of the Holy Blood is a 8 minute walk, while the Bruges train station is less than 1.2 km. Wollestraat Mall is located 600 metres from the hotel. The historic city of Ghent is 35 minutes by train or car.

232920.description: This comfortable hotel enjoys a convenient location for anyone needing to attend the London Excel exhibition and conference Centre, but also for those wanting to access several other popular London sightseeing attractions such as London Greenwich, Canary Wharf or the world-famous West End. The property is incredibly well connected with London City Airport and the DLR Royal Albert Underground within less than a kilometre away. Guests can be sure of a great night's sleep at the fully equipped and tastefully appointed guest rooms, which come with everything necessary for a pleasant stay. Those visitors travelling with their own vehicles may wish to use the on-site parking spaces available for them free of charge and the café bar to relax with a drink at the end of the day.

233163.description: Pamper yourself at the full-service spa. Recreational amenities include an outdoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a picnic area. A complimentary area shuttle provides transportation to nearby destinations. Enjoy international cuisine at Cuppa, grab a bite at the coffee shop/cafe, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours), and free self-parking is provided. The 215 air-conditioned rooms feature refrigerators and LCD televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable programming. Private bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and bathrobes. Safes and desks are also provided, and housekeeping is offered daily.

233347.description: The BCC Hotel & Residence is perfectly located for both business and leisure guests in Batam Island. The property features a wide range of facilities to make your stay a pleasant experience. Take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, Wi-Fi in public areas. Guestrooms are fitted with all the amenities you need for a good night's sleep. In some of the rooms, guests can find television LCD/plasma screen, complimentary tea, dressing room, free welcome drink, mirror. To enhance guests' stay, the hotel offers recreational facilities such as fitness center, sauna, outdoor pool, spa, massage. Friendly staff, great facilities and close proximity to all that Batam Island has to offer are three great reasons you should stay at The BCC Hotel & Residence.

234466.address: Jl. Duyung, Sungai Jodoh, Kec. Batu Ampar
234466.description: Ideally located in the prime touristic area of Batu Ampar, AGlow Hotel Harbor Bay Batam promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. The hotel offers a high standard of service and amenities to suit the individual needs of all travelers. Facilities like free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, convenience store, daily housekeeping, photocopying are readily available for you to enjoy. Closet, towels, slippers, television LCD/plasma screen, mirror can be found in selected guestrooms. The hotel's peaceful atmosphere extends to its recreational facilities which include fitness center, spa, massage, pool (kids), karaoke. For reliable service and professional staff, AGlow Hotel Harbor Bay Batam caters to your needs.

234528.description: The Panorama Regency Hotel, a striking 17-story landmark on Batam Island, Indonesia, offers breathtaking views of the cityscape and Singapore's skyline. From check-in, guests experience attentive four-star service and impeccable hospitality, synonymous with the hotel. Exceeding international standards, the Panorama Regency provides a rich array of sophisticated facilities and refined services for both leisure and corporate travelers, ensuring a memorable stay.

234569.address: Jl. Raden Patah, Kampung Utama No.01 Batam
234569.description:
Modern comfort awaits guests in GiiA Hotel Nagoya Batam, a 10-minute stroll from Nagoya Hill Shopping Mall. The luxurious property features an outdoor pool, spa and a restaurant. Free WiFi is available throughout the building. There is a convenience store on site. Fully air-conditioned, rooms are fitted with fine bedding and warm lighting. In-room facilities include a flat-screen satellite TV, a mini-bar and a fridge. Shower facilities and toiletries are provided in the private bathrooms. Luggage storage facilities and daily newspapers are available at the 24-hour front desk. Staff can arrange car rental and airport transfers upon request. Guests can work out at the gym, visit the hotel's shops or unwind with a relaxing in-room massage after a day of activities. 
Indonesian and International specialties are served at the La Bamba Restaurant. Meals may also be delivered to guests’ rooms. GiiA Hotel Nagoya Batam is a 10-minute drive from Harbor Bay Ferry Terminal and a 30-minute drive from Batam Center Port. Hang Nadim International Airport is a 45-minute drive away.

234581.address: Jl. Raja Ali Haji Komp. Boulevard Nagoya 11 - 18
234581.description: Stop at Triniti Hotel Batam to discover the wonders of Batam Island. The hotel offers guests a range of services and amenities designed to provide comfort and convenience. 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, taxi service are just some of the facilities on offer. All rooms are designed and decorated to make guests feel right at home, and some rooms come with television LCD/plasma screen, internet access – wireless, internet access – wireless (complimentary), air conditioning, desk. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. Triniti Hotel Batam combines warm hospitality with a lovely ambiance to make your stay in Batam Island unforgettable.

234585.address: Jl. Pembangunan Baloi Blok VI Penuin
234585.description: Set in a prime location of Batam Island, 89 Hotel puts everything the city has to offer just outside your doorstep. The hotel has everything you need for a comfortable stay. 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, private check in/check out are on the list of things guests can enjoy. Some of the well-appointed guestrooms feature television LCD/plasma screen, internet access – wireless (complimentary), air conditioning, wake-up service, desk. Recuperate from a full day of sightseeing in the comfort of your room or take advantage of the hotel's recreational facilities, including hot tub, fitness center, sauna, spa, massage. No matter what your reasons are for visiting Batam Island, 89 Hotel will make you feel instantly at home.

235879.description: Located in the picturesque south suburb of Glasgow - Giffnock, this hotel is just a 20-minute drive from the city centre. The relaxed neighbourhood is the perfect place for anyone who is looking for tranquillity while visiting the city, but due to its convenient access to the main transport arteries guests can be watching a game at Hampden Park, Scotland's national stadium, just 20-minutes after starting their car at the onsite parking. Those who prefer a little less noisy activities can test their swing at the nearby Golf Course and then celebrate with a scotch whiskey or a real ale at the onsite in-house bar. The restaurant takes pride in its traditional Scottish fare that is prepared with only the freshest local produce and which must surely be tried by all guests.

237024.description: Enjoy a wealth of amenities at the Crown Vista Batam Hotel. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and take advantage of free on-site parking. Relax in the inviting lobby by the fireplace. The hotel maintains a smoke-free environment, with designated smoking areas provided. Start your day with a complimentary breakfast and savor fresh coffee at the in-house cafe. For dining convenience, the hotel offers enticing culinary options. Maintain your fitness routine at the hotel's well-equipped fitness center.

237212.description: Housed in a Grade II historic-listed building dating back to 1830, the SO Arch is less than 2 miles from Emirates Stadium and Camden District, home of Arsenal Football Club. With free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, on-site parking (paid £10 per night) and a 24-hour front desk, the boutique hotel is just a 5-minute walk from Archway Underground (subway) Station on the Northern Line. Bathed in natural light, the modern apartments, studios and suites at SO Arch feature a sitting area, a flat-screen TV, air conditioning and a kitchenette. Close to many of London's major attractions, Madame Tussauds London and London Zoo are both less than a 4-mile away.

237213.description: Tucked away in the heart of England amidst 3 acres of wooded gardens, this elegant family-run Hotel offers peaceful surroundings, fine food, luxurious accommodation and free Wi-Fi and parking. A quintessentially English Country House Hotel, the Old Rectory is one of the best kept secrets in Worcestershire. With a wonderfully relaxed atmosphere, plenty of character and superb service, it radiates peace and charm. Individually decorated in a traditional style, each of the en-suite guestrooms combines the grace and comfort of a bygone age with modern contemporary facilities. Serving an ever-changing selection of traditional and contemporary favourites the restaurant uses the finest locally sourced produce to create its wonderful cuisine. Situated in Redditch it is 10 minutes from the M42 and 30 from Birmingham. It is perfectly positioned for visitors wishing to explore such attractions as Stratford-upon-Avon, the Cotswolds, Warwick Castle and the Birmingham NEC. From the M42, take Junction3, then follow the A435 signposted for Redditch. Stay on this road, the A435 until you reach the first roundabout at Mappleborough Green. Turn right, go straight over the next island and turn left at the next into Icknield Street Drive. Take the first left into Ipsley Lane and they are on the left amongst the trees.

Tarragona City is 20 minutes’ drive.

237364.description: Located in Crans-Montana (Randogne), Hôtel Résidence de la Forêt is within a 5-minute drive of Violettes Express Gondola and Aminona Gondola Lift. This hotel also features complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and babysitting/childcare (surcharge). Featured amenities include limo/town car service, a computer station, and express check-in. Planning an event in Crans-Montana? This hotel has facilities measuring 538 square feet (50 square meters), including a meeting room. Free self parking is available onsite. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10 AM. Stay in one of 59 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have shower/tub combinations and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

253035.description: Centrally located in Paihia, the Ala Moana Motel is steps from Paihia Beach and the Bay of Islands. This beachside hotel offers 9 guestrooms equipped with refrigerators, microwaves, 28-inch flat-screen TVs, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy amenities such as a terrace, garden, bicycle rentals, concierge services, and a bar/lounge. Free self-parking, luggage storage, laundry facilities, and a library are also available. St. Paul’s Church and Paihia Wharf are just a short walk away.

253873.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. After dipping into one of the 2 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. This resort also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Guests can get around on the shuttle (surcharge), which operates within 2 kilometers. Grab a bite to eat at one of the resort's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink at the beach bar, the poolside bar, or one of 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:00 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Event facilities at this resort consist of conference space and meeting rooms.

254169.description: Ideally located on Olympic Way, the Novotel London Wembley hotel makes for the perfect match-day experience. Whether visiting for business or family trips, the hotel is well-equipped to meet all your needs, with spacious rooms designed for modern, easy living. Wembley Park Tube Station is just a 3-minute walk away, while central London can be reached within 30-minutes. Guests can also benefit from the on-site fitness centre, with modern equipment and panoramic views throughout.

256053.description: Enjoy recreational amenities at the Edelweiss Motel including an outdoor pool and spa tub. This Paihia motel, located near the bay, offers complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and a picnic area. Laundry facilities and a water dispenser are also available, along with free self-parking. The 18 guestrooms feature microwaves, complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, phones, electric kettles, and complimentary tea and instant coffee. A short walk from Paihia Beach and St. Paul's Church, the motel is also conveniently close to Paihia Wharf and the Waitangi Treaty Grounds.

256717.description: The historic Best Western Crewe Arms Hotel, established in 1830 as the world's first railway hotel, offers a comfortable stay in Crewe, Cheshire. Located adjacent to Crewe Railway Station, this charming red brick building welcomes both business and leisure travelers. Once a favorite of Queen Victoria, the hotel retains its unique character. Enjoy a relaxing getaway with convenient amenities. Note: The hotel restaurant is closed on Sunday evenings, and for lunch and dinner on bank holidays. Limited cold food options are available at the bar.

260322.description: Nestled in the tranquil residential area of West Coates, this sophisticated boutique hotel offers convenient access to Edinburgh's city center. Guests are just 20 minutes from Edinburgh Castle and other main attractions. Rugby enthusiasts will appreciate the hotel's proximity to Murrayfield Stadium (5 minutes) and Haymarket train station. Edinburgh Airport is a quick 15-20 minute drive. The elegantly furnished rooms and suites offer contemporary amenities and traditional Scottish charm, creating a comfortable home-away-from-home experience. Business travelers will also find suitable meeting facilities and the whisky bar offers tastings.

name.content: Aptos varios segunda linea en Miami

262068.description: This apartment complex is located in the city centre, just a short drive from Tarragona y Salou, and just 30 minutes from Reus airport. The area boasts beautiful sandy beaches, breathtaking cliffs and hidden bays with crystal clear waters. An abundance of outdoor activities are available such as surfing, sailing, water skiing, fishing, tennis and mountain biking. There is a golf course nearby and Port Aventura is within easy reach. Miami Playa also has a great variety of restaurants offering international cuisine. Among the amenities are parking, an outdoor pool and a money exchange service. The well-appointed, pleasantly furnished apartments are well equipped and come with television, coffee and tea maker and a kitchen with oven, microwave and refrigerator. Disabled visitors are catered for and non-smoking apartments are available. Pets are welcome.

262070.description: This bungalow complex is situated in Miami Playa, near to some of the best beaches in Spain and just 40 minutes from Reus Airport. Outdoor enthusiasts will find plenty of activities to enjoy such as surfing, sailing, mountain biking and horse riding. Within easy reach visitors will find places of interest such as Port Aventura, Aquopolis, Costa Caribe Aquatic Park and the Costa Dorada Natural Parks. Facilities at the complex include parking, an outdoor sweet water pool, garden, terrace and solarium. There is a money exchange service and a safe for the use of the guests. The accommodation is pleasantly furnished and well equipped, and offers two bedrooms, full bathroom, television and a small kitchen with oven, refrigerator, microwave, coffee and tea maker and washing machine. The complex caters for the disabled. Non-smoking bungalows are available and pets are allowed.

262479.description: Enjoy garden views at this boutique hotel in Edinburgh's Newington area, offering complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. Relax with room service (limited hours) or a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available for a fee on weekdays and weekends from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and luggage storage. The hotel features 538 square feet of event space, including conference space and two meeting rooms. The 15 guestrooms offer iPod docking stations, complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, safes, and desks. Housekeeping is provided daily. Kildonan Lodge Hotel is a 3-minute drive from the University of Edinburgh and 5 minutes from the Royal Mile, 2. 1 miles from Edinburgh Castle, and 2. 5 miles from Princes Street.

270789.description: With a small number of only 8, this property is very convenient for a quiet stay. The hotel offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. The reception desk is not open throughout the day. Some services may be payable.

270842.description: The Hundred House Hotel, near the world-famous Ironbridge, is centrally located to Telford, Wolverhampton, and Shrewsbury, making it an ideal getaway destination. This quirky hotel features lavishly decorated bars with beamed ceilings and ten uniquely designed bedrooms, some with patchwork quilts, lavender-scented linens, and even velvet-covered swings. The hotel's 2AA rosette restaurant offers award-winning, innovative cuisine using fresh, local ingredients, many sourced from the on-site Sylvia's Garden. From its origins as a 14th-century courthouse in the half-timbered thatch barn to its modern conference and party facilities, the Hundred House Hotel caters to a variety of needs. All en-suite rooms offer modern amenities, including color TV, direct-dial telephone, clock radio, tea and coffee making facilities, iron and ironing board, and central heating. Superior rooms boast more spacious accommodations with period furnishings, some featuring half-tester beds and the hotel's signature swings.

270932.description: Located on the fun-packed bowling complex at Great Park, Birmingham South Rubery Premier Inn is the perfect place to let your hair down. You're just seconds from an array of family entertainment - including a Brewers Fayre fun factory, a cinema, bowling alley and bingo. Further afield, there are even more family favourites including Cadbury World, the Sea Life Centre and Birmingham's many events and attractions. Then, after a day of indulgence or industry, return to our spacious rooms, Brewers Fayre restaurant, and extra-comfy beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

271379.description: 'Enjoy a meal at the on-site restaurant or relax with room service. Each of the 30 guestrooms features a flat-screen television with satellite programming, complimentary wireless internet access, a phone, a desk, and coffee/tea making facilities. This eco-certified hotel is also close to Theatre At The Mill (2. 1 km) and provides easy access to Belfast International Airport (BFS). '

271393.description: Located in Bushmills, Portcaman House B&B is in a rural location, a 4-minute drive from Dunluce Castle and 6 minutes from Giant's Causeway. This bed & breakfast is 4. 3 mi (6. 9 km) from Royal Portrush Golf Club and 5. 6 mi (9 km) from Whitepark Bay. The front desk is staffed during limited hours. Free self parking is available onsite. A complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 9:30 AM. Stay in one of 8 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers.

271406.description: Located in Birmingham's vibrant city center, Hotel Indigo occupies the 23rd and 24th floors of the iconic Cube building. This unique four-star hotel boasts 52 beautifully designed boutique rooms and a Marco Pierre White Steakhouse Bar & Grill with 360° panoramic city views. Hotel Indigo promises an exceptional stay with breathtaking views from the restaurant and floor-to-ceiling windows in every room.

271668.description: Treat yourself to a spa visit offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Recreational amenities include an indoor pool, sauna, and fitness center. Enjoy a drink at the bar/lounge, and a buffet breakfast (fee applies) each morning between 8:00 AM and 10:30 AM. The hotel also features a business center, 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. For events, there's 398 square feet (37 square meters) of conference and meeting space. Self-parking is available (charges apply). Each of the 58 individually furnished guest rooms features a minibar, espresso maker, complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathroom with bathtub or shower, complimentary toiletries, hair dryer, phone, safe, and desk. Located in Blankenberge, Hotel Aazaert by WP Hotels is within a 10-minute drive of Zeebrugge Harbour and the Belle Epoque Centre. This upscale hotel is also convenient to Casino Blankenberge, the Serpentarium, and Blankenberge Esplanade.

271856.description: Wake up just minutes from Birmingham's must-see sights and iconic shopping centre. Whether it's underwater antics or soaring strings, big brands or trendy bars, our Birmingham hotel puts it all at your feet. Get nose-to-nose with sharks in the amazing Sea Life Aquarium. Catch one of the big events at the NIA, ICC or Symphony Hall. Or indulge in some world-class retail therapy at the Bullring. In the evening, unwind in the canal-side bars before returning to your new generation room, with an impressive 40" flat screen TV and freshly-updated bathroom with large shower head. What could be better than that? All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

272268.description: Set on the High Street of Stourbridge this hotel dating back to the 1630's is full of charm and character. Inside the hotel is full of old oak beams, stuccoed ceilings, half timbered black and white rear facade and features like the old bells to call the servants. A big surprise is the Ballroom located at the rear of the hotel, the old civic hall of Stourbrige still used today by the Masons. No two bedrooms are the same in this historic setting though all offer modern conveniences. With ample car parking the hotel is perfect for business or leisure travellers. The hotel offers very reasonable room rates, a popular restaurant as well as a friendly bar. When visiting the Black Country Market Town don't forget to make time to visit the nearby Glass Quarter (Walking Distance), Merry Hill Shopping Centre (2 miles), Birmingham City Centre (25mins by train), The West Midlands Safari Park, Historic Ironbridge, Dudley Zoo and the Severn Valley Steam Railway.

272285.description: Located in the heart of Bruges, Montovani Hotel offers convenient access to top attractions like the Bruges Market Square and Bruges Christmas Market, both within a 15-minute walk. This hotel provides 12 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and digital programming. Guests can enjoy a daily buffet breakfast (fee applies), a restaurant, a coffee shop/cafe, and a complimentary daily reception. Additional amenities include bicycle rentals, a terrace, a garden, gift shops, tour/ticket assistance, express check-out, free self-parking, and multilingual staff.

272567.description: This lovely hotel is in Birmingham.

272661.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this establishment. Dobbins Inn offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. As this hotel features 24-hour reception, guests are always welcome.

name.content: Premier Inn Ashby De La Zouch

272804.description: There's plenty of space for everyone at Premier Inn Hotel Ashby De La Zouch, with a selection of interconnecting and 5-sleeper rooms. In beautiful countryside with great nearby transport links, you'll be well placed for business and leisure destinations around the Midlands. Take a wild ride at Drayton Manor Theme Park, or take a trip through time at Ashby Castle or Calke Abbey. Go full throttle at Donnington Park racing circuit, or slip into neutral at Champneys Spa. After a busy day, relax with a tasty meal in our restaurant, and a great night's sleep in your extra-comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions.

272805.description: This hotel does not offer 24-hour reception.

272813.description: Ideally located at the Port of Larne, this hotel sits proudly on the Gateway to the Glens. Just a 25 minutes' driving distance away from Belfast's rich culture and history, this property is perfect for travellers seeking relaxation, yet who are eager to be close to the heart of the entertainment. This long-established, family-run hotel comprises luxurious, well-equipped guest rooms. The restaurant is second to none, offering a sumptuous journey for the senses. Offering a friendly, professional services, and exemplary facilities and services, this property is sure to impress business and leisure travellers alike.

273008.description: The establishment features a total of 100 accomodation units.

273095.description: ibis Styles Birmingham Oldbury is situated just off junction 2 of the M5, one mile from Sandwell & Dudley station. Guests enjoy free car parking, gym facilities and WiFi throughout. Each comfy, en-suite guest room features tea/coffee-making facilities and a flatscreen TV. Monday to Sunday evenings, guests can dine in the on-site restaurant and a generous buffet breakfast is on offer Tuesday to Sunday. A well-stocked bar provides a great place to enjoy hot drinks, beers, wines or spirits.

273133.description: Enjoy modern comforts like complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a game room at this charming B&B. Relax in the picnic area with barbecue grills, or grab a snack from the vending machine. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge, and enjoy breakfast for a small fee. A 24-hour front desk, laundry facilities, and ATM/banking services are also available. Free self-parking is provided onsite. Each of the six guestrooms features a flat-screen television. Located in Bushmills, the Causeway Tavern B&B is a short drive from the Giant's Causeway and Causeway Coast, placing you within easy reach of top attractions.

273357.description: There's so much on your doorstep at Sutton Coldfield. The bright lights, sights and shops of Birmingham are just a quick train ride away. While closer to home there are a number of renowned golf courses, as well as the beautiful Sutton Park National Nature Reserve. Conquer your fears on Stormforce 10 at Drayton Manor. Or indulge in retail therapy at big name stores in Birmingham. Watch some famous names tee off at the Belfry, then come back for tea and pampering yourself in our spacious rooms and extra comfy beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

273562.description: Situated on four acres of Warwickshire countryside and landscaped gardens, this family-run hotel features Art Deco-style rooms. Guests can enjoy fresh, seasonal food at the hotel's restaurant. Each bright and stylish room at Grimscote Manor Hotel offers a flat-screen TV, free Wi-Fi access, a fridge, and a private bathroom. Evening meals are prepared using local ingredients. Guests can also unwind after dinner in the relaxing bar and lounge area. The beautiful gardens feature a striking Victorian-style oriental bandstand and a wooden bridge over a stream. Free parking is available at Grimscote Manor, and both Birmingham and Birmingham Airport are less than 20 minutes away by car. Birmingham NEC is a 15-minute drive away.

273743.description: There are a total of 22 rooms on the premises. The Townhouse Sutton offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. The reception desk is open all day long.

273961.description: Enjoy a stay at the Canalview Hotel Ter Reien, located in the heart of Bruges. A short walk from Bruges Market Square and the Historic Centre of Brugge, this hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a vending machine, and a terrace with scenic views. Guestrooms feature phones and desks, with daily housekeeping provided. Buffet breakfast is available for a fee on weekdays from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 8:30 AM to 10:30 AM. The hotel also offers express check-in/check-out and multilingual staff. Nearby attractions include the Bruges Christmas Market and Knokke-Heist Beach.

277606.description: Our great-value Premier Inn Birmingham (Great Barr/M6 J7) hotel on Birmingham Road is a great base for exploring local Black Country attractions. Victoria Square in Birmingham City Centre is about a 20-minute drive away, and if you follow the Birmingham City Centre Walk, you’ll reach the iconic Town Hall – architecture fans will love the Corinthian columns of this Grade I listed building! It's also a popular event venue and the city's main Symphony Hall, if you're in the mood for some live classical music. Culture lovers won’t want to miss visiting the Birmingham Museum and Art Gallery – just a 15-minute drive from our Premier Inn Birmingham (Great Barr/M6 J7) hotel – while families will love exploring the Black Country Living Museum. Football fans can watch live games at nearby Villa Park, home of Aston Villa, or why not stretch your legs around scenic Walsall Arboretum? If you’re planning on using public transport throughout your stay, then you’ll love having main stations like Tame Bridge Parkway and Birmingham New Street nearby. Set behind an elegant Georgian facade, the hotel is full to the brim with heritage and character. 112 stylish well-appointed bedrooms means there's plenty of charm and choice for those here to make use of our extensive facilities for hosting corporate events, banquets and weddings. Due to its location, it's convenient not just for Birmingham and the many events at the NEC, but an excellent hotel near Coventry and the South Midlands too. Here you'll find some more great attractions, like the Ricoh Arena for sporting and music events or Warwick Castle with its mediaeval-themed amusements. If you feel like a day out for some retail therapy, it's equally close to both Solihull Touchwood Shopping Centre and Coventry city center. When you return, you can enjoy an acclaimed dining experience in our two AA Rosette award-winning restaurant at this lovely hotel near Birmingham. With the M6, M5 and M40 mere minutes away, you'll be at the center of everything when you stay at the Best Western Plus Birmingham NEC Meriden Manor Hotel.

283241.description: With a small number of only 8, this accomodation is very convenient for a quiet stay. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Unfortunately, the front desk is not open 24 hours. The hotel may charge a fee for some services.

name.content: Premier Inn Chester Central - South East

283247.description: The majestic hills of North Wales or the buzz and bustle of Chester - at Premier Inn Hotel Chester Central (South East) you can have both. We're the gateway to Snowdonia but we're also perfectly situated for some great retail therapy, and there's plenty to entertain the whole family. Climb up to a cairn at the top of Snowdon. Place your bets at Chester races. Stroll around Chester's Roman walls, or see the lions roar at the city zoo. Then it's back to our place for great food in our Brewers Fayre restaurant, and a lovely comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

283261.description: Escape to the country with Premier Inn Hotel Cardiff West, just outside the beautiful rural village of Wenvoe. And with great nearby transport links, you'll also be well placed to zip off and explore business and leisure destinations around Cardiff and South Wales. Catch the big game at the Millennium Stadium. Dig into Wales' past at St Fagans National History Museum. Settle down for a show at the Millennium Centre, or dive into the crowd at the Motorpoint Arena. Then relax with a tasty meal in our restaurant and a great night's sleep in your extra-comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

283290.description: Nestled within a charming 16th-century coaching inn, The Old Bull seamlessly blends historical character with modern comforts. Located in the bustling market town of Royston, just 12 miles from Cambridge, the inn offers complimentary Wi-Fi. As Royston's oldest hostelry, The Old Bull boasts individually designed rooms, some featuring large windows or exposed beams. Each room includes a private bathroom, hairdryer, and tea and coffee-making facilities. The inn's restaurant serves delicious traditional, homemade British cuisine and a popular Sunday lunch, while the bar offers a relaxed setting for beverages and snacks. Just 8 miles from the renowned Imperial War Museum Duxford, Royston also benefits from a railway station providing direct access to Cambridge and central London. For golf enthusiasts, Royston Golf Club is a mere 0. 5 miles from the inn.

283782.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at Blanco's Hotel Port Talbot, including complimentary Wi-Fi and wedding services. Dine at the on-site restaurant, or take advantage of room service (during limited hours). Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 9:00 AM. Event facilities include conference space and three meeting rooms. Free self-parking is available. The hotel's 65 guestrooms feature flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and digital programming. Bathrooms include showers and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences such as desks and coffee/tea makers are also provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Located in Port Talbot, Blanco's Hotel is within a 5-minute drive of Go Ape at Margam Port Talbot and Surf School Wales. It's also a short drive from Aberavon Beach and Margam Sands.

Each of our seven guestrooms features a flat-screen television with cable programming, a desk, and tea and coffee-making facilities. Bathrooms are equipped with a shower and hairdryer. Housekeeping is provided once per stay. We are conveniently located near St Martin's Church (0. 6 mi), The Gate Arts and Community Centre (0. 6 mi), and Capitol Shopping Centre (0. 7 mi).

284803.description: Summer holiday or business trip? Cut down the stress with a convenient stop-over at our Cardiff Airport hotel. Located in a countryside spot close to the town of Barry, it's just 3 minutes' drive from the terminals. Explore Barry town centre and you'll discover delights like Barry Island Pleasure Park and waterfront walks at the docks. Or for some natural coastal beauty, head to Porthkerry Country Park with its pebble beach and green meadows. This hotel has upgraded rooms that feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. It is located next to the Toby Carvery. Useful informationAll bedrooms in this hotel have ensuite shower rooms.

284815.description: Thank you for choosing our Super 8 by Wyndham Chester East hotel. Super 8 is the worlds largest economy lodging brand with over 2300 properties in the U. S. Canada and China making it easy to explore super destinations from coast to coast. Under its 8 point promise service culture guests at every Super 8 across North America can depend on every Super 8 to deliver complimentary SuperStart breakfast free high speed internet access upgraded bath amenities free in-room coffee and kids under 17 stay free.

284874.description: A total of 120 guest rooms are available for guests' convenience at Travelodge Cambridge Central. Everyone staying at this accommodation can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the establishment. The reception does not work around the clock. Travelodge Cambridge Central may charge a fee for some services.

285193.description:
• Beautifully restored Victorian mansion in the heart of North Wales. 
• Nestled in nine acres of private woodland and secluded gardens. 
• Built in 1872 by the Watkinson family. 
• Only a kilometre away from the centre of Northop Hall. 
• Situated about 18 km from the famous city of Chester. 
• A total of 38 guest rooms are available for guests' convenience. 
• A total of 43 free on-site parking spaces are available for guests' convenience.

285310.description: Tanes features a total of 18 accomodation units. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. There is no 24-hour reception. Additional fees may apply for some services.

285401.description: Stauntons On the Green Hotel is delightfully set in an unrivalled position overlooking picturesque St Stephens Green - one of the best known and most beautiful parts of Dublin. To the rear of the building is a private garden, offering peace and serenity in Dublin's city centre. Located behind Staunton's is the beautiful Victorian Iveagh Gardens, an expanse of leisurely walks and greens. The building embodies Georgian elegance and style, and proffers a most inviting atmosphere. We invite our guests to enjoy absolute comfort and privacy, coupled with immediate access to the heart of Dublin. We are within walking distance of Grafton Street and Henry Street, Dublin's pedestrianised shopping areas and Temple Bar. Stauntons is only 5 minutes on foot, from the Houses of Parliament, and is located in the heart of Dublin's business and banking district. All of Dublin's entertainment, historical and cultural centres are easily within walking distance of this unique accommodation.

285424.description: Located in the heart of Dublin, the Beresford Hotel is within a 10-minute walk of Trinity College and O'Connell Street. This hotel offers 107 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a fireplace in the lobby, a bar/lounge, and a full breakfast served on weekdays. Additional conveniences include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Nearby attractions include Grafton Street and The Convention Centre Dublin.

285514.description: Enjoy garden views at this charming guesthouse, and take advantage of amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Additional features include a lobby fireplace and a picnic area. A complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast is served on weekdays from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Free self-parking is available on-site. Stay in one of 37 guestrooms featuring LED televisions with digital programming and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, with housekeeping provided daily. Located in Dublin's Ballsbridge neighborhood, Ariel House is a 2-minute walk from Aviva Stadium and a 12-minute walk from RDS Main Arena. This guesthouse is 1. 3 miles from both Dublin Port and the Bord Gáis Energy Theatre.

285649.description: With a stay at The Gate Hotel, you'll be centrally located in Dublin, steps from O'Connell Street and 11 minutes by foot from Trinity College. This hotel is 0. 7 mi (1. 2 km) from Grafton Street and 0. 9 mi (1. 4 km) from Dublin Castle. Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless Internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Full breakfasts are available daily from 8:00 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Stay in one of 38 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers. Conveniences include irons/ironing boards, and housekeeping is provided daily.

285754.description: This exclusive and luxurious hotel boasts a great position a mere 4 kilometres from the towns of Dun Laoghaire Killiney and Dalkey, all of them on the coast, and enjoys easy access to Dublin’s town centre with its myriad of popular and historical attractions. Business travellers will find several business centres nearby such as Cherrywood Business Park, and those on a leisure trip may discover Dun Laoghaire Harbour and the Wicklow Mountains. There are several types of guest rooms, perfectly designed to suit all its guests’ needs, whether they travel alone, as a couple or with the whole family. The comfortable and enchanting rooms feature a private bathroom with a power shower and special toiletries. Guests travelling with their own car may use the complimentary parking facilities available. For added comfort, visitors can enjoy the fantastic indoor pool and spa.

285795.description: Handel's Hotel is an oasis of calm on historic Fishamble Street, once the fish market of medieval Dublin. Handel's is a modern hotel with 45 well-appointed double, twin, triple and family (double + single) rooms, with all the facilities, conveniences and comforts a guest could want, including complimentary Wi-Fi. Most of Dublin's major attractions are within a short walk of Handel's Hotel, including Temple Bar, Guinness Storehouse, Dublin Castle, Christ Church Cathedral and St. Patrick's Cathedral. Handel's Hotel is named after renowned 18th century composer George Frederick Handel whose most famous oratorio - “Messiah” - was first performed in the New Musick Hall Dublin, on the site the hotel now occupies.

285840.description: This hotel is located at the top of O'Connell Street, in the heart of Dublin city center. The shopping district of Henry Street is around 200 meters away. The hotel is within a 15-minute walk of all the major tourist attractions in Dublin including Trinity College, Temple Bar. All rooms have been simply and tastefully redecorated with modern furniture and finished to the highest standard. Each of the en-suite guestrooms features crisp white duvets and tea/coffee making facilities. The standard rooms are reasonably sized and offer good comfort.

285974.description: Situated in a 19th-century building on Dame Street, in the heart of Dublin's vibrant Temple Bar, this hotel offers a cozy retreat just steps from Trinity College and Grafton Street's luxury shops. Enjoy easy access to museums, the Olympia Theatre, galleries, and historical sites, all within walking distance. Experience the lively music scene of Temple Bar and convenient access to Dublin Airport, just a 30-minute drive away. The hotel features comfortable rooms with fresh, inviting decor, complete with premium linens, en-suite bathrooms, and tea/coffee making facilities. Savor award-winning cuisine and live entertainment, all under one roof.

286006.description: Enjoy a stay at the Baggot Court Townhouse, centrally located in Dublin, within a 10-minute walk of the Irish Architectural Archive and Art Market. This hotel offers 17 guestrooms with amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, LCD TVs with digital programming, and private bathrooms with showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include phones, desks, and coffee/tea makers. Start your day with an English breakfast (available for a fee), and take advantage of amenities like a terrace, tour/ticket assistance, express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Limited on-site parking is available. Nearby attractions include the National Museum of Natural History and the RHA Gallery, both within a short walk from the hotel. Dublin Airport (DUB) is a convenient 15. 5 km away.

286060.description: With a total of 9 rooms, this is a nice place to stay. Those staying at this accomodation may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception. Some services of Abbey Bed And Breakfast may be payable.

286161.description: The grand 19th-century Wynn's Hotel is located a 5-minute walk from Trinity College, Temple Bar, and Henry Street. It offers an elegant restaurant and rooms with free Wi-Fi. Rooms combine a traditional, warm décor with modern amenities, including flat-screen TVs and safes. They feature tea/coffee-making facilities, a 24-hour room service menu, and DVD/CD players on request. The stunning Playwright Restaurant is decorated with period furniture, huge mirrors, and large windows overlooking Dublin’s vibrant city streets. It serves a traditional breakfast, carvery lunches, and an à la carte dinner menu. Guests can relax with a drink in the lounge, which has a beautiful mahogany bar, or in Saint's & Scholar's Bar, with its bar menu and comfortable seating. The hotel is a 5-minute walk from the historical Ha'penny Bridge on the River Liffey. The Abbey Theatre, O'Connell Street, and Grafton Street are also close by.

286267.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. Additional amenities at this hotel include concierge services, a television in a common area, and a ballroom. Satisfy your appetite for dinner at the hotel's restaurant, The Chancery Grill, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Dublin? This hotel has 3380 square feet (314 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 13 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 234 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and Smart televisions. Digital television is provided for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

286379.description: Whether traveling for leisure or business, this stylish hotel offers easy access to Dublin city center and its surroundings. Overlooking the Wicklow Mountains, the property is conveniently located on Belgard Road, within walking distance of bus stops and the Luas Line. Guests can choose from various well-appointed accommodations, each featuring charming decor and luxury bedding for a comfortable stay. All rooms are non-smoking and offer free Wi-Fi. Dining options include a traditional Irish pub and an Italian restaurant. The bar boasts scenic mountain views—a perfect backdrop for enjoying wine or cocktails. Additional amenities include excellent business facilities, free secure parking, and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout.

286421.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at the Marine Hotel in Dublin, featuring an indoor pool and sauna. The on-site Cucinos Restaurant offers lunch and dinner, with room service also available during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge, and start your day with a full breakfast (fee applies). The hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Each of the 48 guestrooms includes a flat-screen TV with satellite programming, a private bathroom with shower/tub combination, and a laptop-compatible safe. Conveniently located near Howth Castle, Howth Harbour, and just a short drive from Croke Park and Dublin Port, the Marine Hotel offers easy access to numerous attractions. Self-parking is available on-site (subject to charges).

286510.description: It's a strikingly contemporary restaurant and hotel. The product of a major renovation in 2008, what was once the village's pub, The Marquis of Granby, has been utterly transformed. Space, light, fine furnishings and beautiful fabrics – the opportunity to fine tune every detail hasn't been missed. The restaurant is a revelation. Head Chef Charles Lakin's seasonally inspired and locally sourced menus are as fresh as they are imaginative, and the elegant 21st century styling is exceptional. Queen sized pocket sprung beds are swathed in the finest cotton. Sumptuous fabrics dress windows and chairs. And an eclectic collection of art completes the mood, the mix and the personality that makes this place unique. Boutique chic in the heart of the English countryside? You've found it. You've arrived.

286681.description: The establishment features a total of 49 rooms. The property offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Uppercross House offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience. The hotel may charge a fee for some services.

286759.description:
The Fitzsimons Hotel in Temple Bar offers an exceptional stay in the heart of Dublin’s vibrant cultural district, featuring 22 newly refurbished rooms designed for maximum comfort and style. Perfect for party bookers, including hens, stags, and birthday celebrations, the hotel is an ideal base for immersing in Dublin’s nightlife and historic charm. 

Tourists can explore Dublin’s rich heritage and attractions, with the bustling Temple Bar area just steps away, renowned for its lively pubs, eclectic shops, and cultural events. Our dedicated team is ready to assist in planning unforgettable experiences and providing bespoke decorations and personalized touches for your events. 

Enjoy a variety of drinks and food packages tailored to your needs. With modern amenities and an unbeatable location, Fitzsimons Hotel is perfect for celebrating, exploring, or relaxing.

286782.address: Newland's Cross, Exit 1A Naas Road, Dublin 22
286782.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center, complimentary wireless internet access, and concierge services. This hotel also offers babysitting services (surcharge), wedding services, and a cozy fireplace in the lobby. Dine at one of the two on-site restaurants, including LJ Bar and Restaurant, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind at the bar/lounge after a busy day. English breakfasts are served daily (7:30 AM to 10 AM, for a fee). Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers. Event facilities consist of conference space and 20 meeting rooms. Free self-parking is available. The hotel offers 190 guestrooms, each featuring a flat-screen television with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with shower, designer toiletries, a hairdryer, a phone, a safe, and a desk. Nearby attractions include Park West Business Park (2. 6 mi), The Square Tallaght (2. 7 mi), and Tallaght Stadium (2. 9 mi). The preferred airport is Dublin Airport (DUB), 12. 7 miles from the hotel.

286941.description: Located in the Donnybrook / Ballsbridge area of Dublin 4, this immaculate Georgian guesthouse is an ideal choice whether visiting Dublin for business or pleasure. With easy access from Dublin Airport by the Air coach, which passes every 10 minutes and on Route N11 from Dun Laoghaire Port, a bus service from Morehampton Road to Dublin city centre runs frequently with a journey time of approximately 10-minutes. Awarded a Certificate of Excellence by Trip Advisor in 2013, the spacious bedrooms are maintained and serviced to the highest standard, each being en-suite and with well-appointed, large Georgian windows allowing natural light to flow through each room.

286963.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance at this conveniently located Dublin hotel. Start your day with a continental breakfast (available for a fee), grab a coffee at the café, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. The 27 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs with cable programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, coffee/tea makers, and daily housekeeping. A 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and an elevator are also available. Located in Dublin's City Centre, the hotel is a short walk from Phoenix Park, Dublin Zoo, and the Guinness Storehouse. Kilmainham Gaol, Saint James's Hospital, and other attractions are also within easy reach. Dublin Airport (DUB) is approximately 12. 8 miles away.

287176.description: Ashfield Hostel is the most centrally located hostel in Dublin - between Trinity College and O'Connell Bridge and one minutes' walk from Temple Bar, Grafton Street and attractions. The O2 venue and new Grand Canal Theatre and Convention Centre are all within walking distance of our hostel. Ashfield Hostel is ideal for travellers or backpackers needing a low-cost base in Dublin. The hostel has all ensuite rooms (private bathroom), free Wi-Fi and bed linen, and no curfew. There are vending machines with drinks and light snacks. Other services included in your rate include: hot showers, luggage storage and use of self-catering kitchen and common areas.

287335.description: This luxury boutique-style hotel is located in Ballsbridge, 1. 5 miles from Dublin city center. It offers stylish rooms with free Wi-Fi, comfortable beds and Nespresso coffee machines. Rooms at the Roxford Lodge Hotel are decorated in light shades and mix the original Victorian character of the building with modern facilities. Rooms feature work desks and most come with a Smart TV. The elegant dining room serves traditional Irish and continental breakfasts each morning at a cost of €8. 50 per person for a Continental and €16. 00 per person for a Cooked Breakfast. There is a lounge in the hotel available, which also has a computer for guests to use. There is a bus stop outside of the hotel, which has regular services to Dublin Airport. Lansdowne Road and the RDS are both within a 10-minute walk, while there is a DART station just 2625 feet away. The hotel also has a car park, which has limited parking space available and is on a first come first serve basis. Parking cost €10. 00 per car/per night. There are also three electric vehicle charging points available in the car park.

287356.description: There are a total of 105 guest rooms on the premises. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. Guests may contact the reception desk any time during the day. The Mercantile Hotel has wheelchair-accessible common areas. There is a car park. null Offering several dining options, this hotel will cater the needs of all types of guests. Additional fees may apply for some services.

287524.description: Comfortable Accommodation: The Dawson Hostel in Dublin offers a 4-star hostel experience with free WiFi, air-conditioning, and carpeted floors. Each room includes a private bathroom with a shower, ensuring a pleasant stay. Convenient Facilities: Guests benefit from a 24-hour front desk, daily housekeeping service, express check-in and check-out, a tour desk, and luggage storage. The property staff speak English, Spanish, and Portuguese, providing excellent service support. Prime Location: Located in the city centre, the hostel is a short walk from the National Museum of Ireland - Archaeology (3-minute), Book of Kells (300 metres), and Trinity College (600 metres). Dublin Airport is 10 km away. Guests appreciate the bathroom cleanliness, convenient location, and attentive staff.

287784.description: Immerse in the splendour of InterContinental Dublin. Our five-star urban resort boasting 215 luxurious rooms and suites, set on two garden acres in the affluent Ballsbridge neighbourhood, is renowned for its elegant guestrooms, breathtaking views, and award-winning spa. Indulge in curated culinary experiences or host your own conference or gala in our elegant meeting & event space. The hotel is within walking distance to the city centre, and minutes from Aviva Stadium, Trinity College and more.

287903.description:
The Harding Hotel is ideally located in a central and convenient part of historic Old Dublin.

We are within a 2-3 minute walk from Dublin Castle, Christchurch Cathedral and the vibrant Temple Bar but on a quieter side street – one of Dublin‘s oldest streets. Travel networks are easily joined and the hotel is brilliantly served by the Airlink bus to/from the airport and the Hop-On-Hop-Off buses. Choose to explore some of Dublin's older streets personally or join some of the nearby walking tours and join in the legacy of the Vikings through to the times of George Frederic Handel performing his wonderful Messiah for the very first time on Fishamble Street and the other major events in Dublin to modern days.

At Harding Hotel we pride ourselves in offering a genuine Irish welcome. Our clean, comfortable and spacious rooms all at great value for money rates.

287980.description:
This comfortable Hotel is in St Stephen's Green. The establishment consists of 39 accommodation units. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection at hand in communal areas. This accommodation offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience. 
Please note the Russell Court Hotel is a party hotel with 3 nightclubs open 7 nights a week until late.
All of our rooms are affected by the noise.

288000.description: In a unique location over-looking Donabate beach, this superbly situated hotel offers spectacular sea views and direct access to the long, sandy beach. The quaint village of Donabate is a little over a twenty-minute walk away and the nearest golf course is just five minutes. Close to the M1, the hotel is also well located for access to Dublin Airport and the city. The tastefully decorated rooms are designed to offer the best in comfort and convenience and some feature great views over Lambay Island. Offering a choice of dining and beverage options, guests can benefit from the award winning Samphire Restaurant or for something less formal there is the Tower Bar & Bistro – both boasting stunning views.
