Whether you've dreamed of relaxing in an Eames chair or admire the modernism of Le Corbusier or Mies Van der Rohe, we have the perfect room for you. Ideally located near Liverpool Street, the Boundary Shoreditch offers a range of high-quality rooms and suites perfect for both creative professionals and City workers seeking a comfortable escape. Leisure travelers will also find themselves in the heart of Shoreditch, moments away from the city's most exciting restaurants, independent shops, and boutiques, as well as our own on-site bars and restaurants. All rooms feature large, comfortable beds and luxurious appointments, creating a unique and comfortable hotel experience in bustling Shoreditch.

311879.description: Ideally located in the prime touristic area of Tower Hamlets, Citystay Hotel promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. The hotel offers a wide range of amenities and perks to ensure you have a great time. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, Wi-Fi in public areas, family room are on the list of things guests can enjoy. Guestrooms are fitted with all the amenities you need for a good night's sleep. In some of the rooms, guests can find television LCD/plasma screen, internet access – wireless, heating, wake-up service, desk. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. A welcoming atmosphere and excellent service are what you can expect during your stay at Citystay Hotel.

311890.description: Inverness Terrace - Concept Serviced Apartments guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 8 units.

311903.description: Ideally located in central London, the Four Stars Hotel is an 8-minute walk from Paddington Station and 0. 8 miles from Madame Tussauds. This 2-star hotel offers a shared lounge, a 24-hour front desk, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private parking is available on-site. All rooms feature TVs with satellite channels, bed linen, and towels. The Serpentine is one mile from the hotel, while Lord's Cricket Ground is 1. 1 miles away. London City Airport, the nearest airport, is 11 miles from the property.

311918.description: There are a total of 17 rooms at The Brent. Everyone staying at this accommodation may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at The Brent. The Brent does not operate a 24-hour reception. Everyone staying at this accommodation arriving by car may leave their vehicle at its parking spaces.

311931.description: Enjoy a stay at the King William Inn, conveniently located near the University of Bedfordshire and Luton Mall. Make yourself at home in one of the 13 comfortable guestrooms, each featuring complimentary Wi-Fi and cable TV. The inn offers a variety of amenities including an on-site pub, a terrace, a garden with barbecue grills, and a relaxing bar/lounge. Other conveniences include express check-out and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Cribs/infant beds are available for a surcharge. The closest airport is Luton Airport (LTN).

311933.description: With more connections than the London Underground tube map, Premier Inn London Euston puts the best of the capital - and Europe - on your doorstep. From here, you're just minutes from Euston and King's Cross stations and Eurostar at St Pancras, as well as London's must-see sights. Meet the stars at Madame Tussauds. Delve into the world's treasure-trove at the British Museum. Or hit the big brands of Oxford Street and the off-the-beaten-track stores in cool Camden. After a busy day, put your feet up and recharge in our recently refurbished rooms, tasty restaurant, and extra-comfy beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

311935.description: Visitors may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Old Street Apartments. The reception desk is open all day long. The hotel may charge a fee for some services.

311942.description: Seductive and striking, this hotel brings a new energy to London, blending the style and sophistication of a boutique hotel. Uniquely reflecting the urban feel of the Southbank neighbourhood, this classy establishment is within walking distance of landmarks such as Tate Modern, Royal Festival Hall, the National and Globe theatres, as well as Borough Market and the London Eye. Moreover, London City Airport is only 13 km from the hotel. Situated on the banks of the River Thames in the famed Sea Containers building, it uniquely offers river-view balcony suites directly on the Thames. However, the most glamorous of spaces will be the rooftop bar, with its glass box structure and outdoor terrace, featuring panoramic views over London, where sample innovative cocktails with its iconic green marble bar and dramatic views of the Thames.

311946.description: This luxurious hotel boasts a prime setting in Horley. Conveniently located just a few minutes' driving distance away from Gatwick Airport, this establishment is the ideal choice for discerning business and leisure travellers, as well as those seeking relaxation during their stopover. Steeped in history, culture and luxury, this 16th-century property greets visitors with the promise of an unrivalled experience, rich in comfort and relaxation. The inviting, stunningly-designed guest rooms showcase classical style and charm. First-class facilities and services are available to ensure that the needs of business and leisure travellers are fully catered for, to a high level of excellence. Hailed as one of the most disctinctive and welcoming hotels outide London, this property is sure to impress.

311963.description: Set in a Georgian crescent, The Judd Hotel offers guests traditionally styled rooms with modern amenities. The hotel is within a 10-minute walk to Euston station, and King’s Cross station. The bedrooms feature an en suite bathroom, air conditioning, tea/coffee making facilities and a flat-screen TV. Housed in 2 elegant town houses, The Judd Hotel overlooks gardens and tennis courts, which guests may use. Guests may be allocated a room in the Judd Hotel annex which is directly opposite the Judd Hotel. The hotel reception and breakfast room is located in the Judd Hotel. The Judd Hotel is a 20-minute walk from Regent’s Park, and guests can reach Oxford Street in 10 minutes via public transport. The West End is 20 minutes from the property, where guests will find theatres and a multitude of shops and restaurants.

311996.description: Make yourself at home in one of the 17 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Apollo Victoria Theatre - 0. 9 km / 0. 5 mi- Victoria Station Travel Information Centre - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- Westminster Abbey - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- The Oval - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Buckingham Palace - 1. 7 km / 1 mi- Houses of Parliament - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- St. James Park - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Green Park - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Sloane Square - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Big Ben - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Hyde Park Corner - 2 km / 1. 2 mi- Westminster Bridge - 2 km / 1. 2 mi- Battersea Power Station - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Hyde Park - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- St. Thomas' Hospital - 2. 2 km / 1. 4 mi. The nearest airports are: London City Airport (LCY) - 18. 6 km / 11. 6 mi Heathrow Airport (LHR) - 27 km / 16. 8 mi Gatwick Airport (LGW) - 65. 2 km / 40. 5 mi Luton Airport (LTN) - 56. 7 km / 35. 3 mi Stansted Airport (STN) - 66. 9 km / 41. 6 mi With a stay at Blades Hotel, you'll be centrally located in London, within a 5-minute drive of Westminster Abbey and Buckingham Palace. This hotel is 0. 6 mi (0. 9 km) from Victoria Station Travel Information Centre and 1. 2 mi (2 km) from Big Ben.

311998.description: Croft Mill guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 12 accomodation units.

312018.description: Indulge in massages and facials at this luxurious hotel, and enjoy amenities such as an indoor pool and fitness center. Stay connected with complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and benefit from concierge and babysitting services (surcharge). Dine at the Brumus Bar and Restaurant, featuring a bar/lounge, or order 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily (fee applies). The hotel also offers complimentary wired internet access, newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Each of the 50 individually decorated guestrooms features a minibar, LED television, Tempur-Pedic bed with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include designer toiletries and hair dryers. Located near Regent Street, Trafalgar Square, and the National Gallery, the hotel is conveniently close to London's top attractions. The nearest airports are London City (LCY), Heathrow (LHR), and Gatwick (LGW).

312022.description: The 40 welcoming units offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. The hotel provides 24-hour reception. The hotel may charge a fee for some services.

name.content: Canary Riverside Plaza London, Vignette Collection

312034.description:
Set against the historic quays and wharves of Canary Wharf, Canary Riverside Plaza London, Vignette Collection is a place with a story to tell. We offer a stay that feels personal, characterful and entirely your own. 

Each of our 141 rooms and suites is more than a place to rest – it is a calm riverside retreat, framed by sweeping views of the River Thames and the unmistakable London skyline. Whether you arrive for business or pleasure, every detail is considered to make you feel at home. 

Unwind in the adjoining Health Club & Spa, a tranquil sanctuary to restore body and mind. Or linger over vibrant Italian flavours at Quadrato, where the terrace and a celebrated afternoon tea invite you to slow down and savour the moment. 

In one of London's most spirited neighbourhoods, Canary Riverside Plaza London is your own quiet corner of the city – crafted with character, and waiting to be discovered.

312035.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this hotel.

312054.description:
The hotel consists of 40 rooms. The property offers Wi-Fi internet connection on-site. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception. Some services of George Hotel may be payable. 

Please note - THIS SMALL SINGLE ROOM ROOM IS SUITABLE FOR A SHORT STAY DUE TO LIMITED SPACE AND BED SIZE (75CM WIDE)

312079.description: The premises count with 21 welcoming guest rooms. West Cromwell offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. All guests staying at this property are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception. Some services of West Cromwell may be payable.

312082.description: In an elegant Victorian building, Brook Green Hotel is a traditional pub offering free Wi-Fi, real ales and home-cooked food. The hotel is just a 10 minute walk from the O2 Shepherds Bush Empire. The simple, stylish bedrooms at Brook Green have air conditioning and tea/coffee facilities. All rooms feature a flat-screen TV, suit press and a private modern bathroom with a hairdryer. Guests can enjoy a full English breakfast each morning, and hearty evening meals are also available. The cozy pub also features real open fires, leather sofas and a pretty terrace. Less than half a mile from Hammersmith Underground Station, The Brook Green Hotel is 1. 5 miles from Earls Court Exhibition Centre. Hammersmith Apollo is only half a mile away.

name.content: 100 Queens Gate Hotel, Curio Collection by Hilton

312099.description: Boasting a prime location in the prestigious Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, 100 Queen's Gate Hotel London, Curio Collection by Hilton, is on the doorstep of iconic cultural attractions including the Royal Albert Hall, Natural History Museum, Science Museum, and Victoria & Albert Museum. Enjoy a leisurely stroll from our historic, Victorian-style hotel to Harrods, Notting Hill, Kensington Palace, Hyde Park and the designer boutiques of Knightsbridge. Following a multimillion-pound refurbishment, guest rooms and suites at our Kensington hotel exude elegance and feature complimentary WiFi, electronic newspapers, 49-inch flat-screen HDTVs with Chromecast, and bathroom amenities by Floris London. Unwind in a stylish Deluxe or Luxury bedroom with upgraded amenities and additional space. For a unique experience, select a two-level Duplex suite, boasting a top-floor location. Enjoy a workout in our state-of-the-art gymnasium or host a small meeting in one of two elegant boardrooms. Enjoy classic Italian cuisine at our signature restaurant Cento, or unwind with a late-night drink in our concept cocktail bar ESQ. For a traditional Botanical Afternoon Tea or pre-theater drinks in a sophisticated atrium setting, visit Botanica. 100 Queen's Gate Hotel London offers 24-hour room service so you can dine in the comfort of your room or suite, day or night.

312112.description: The Darlington Hyde Park offers a convenient London location, just a short walk from Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. Enjoy a meal at the on-site restaurant, or take advantage of amenities such as the 24-hour front desk, laundry facilities and lift. Each of the 40 guestrooms features a flat-screen television, refrigerator, complimentary Wi-Fi, in-room safe, and work desk. Housekeeping is available upon request. Nearby attractions include Paddington Central, Marble Arch and Kensington Palace.

312113.description: The premises count with 44 welcoming units. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. The front desk offers 24-hour reception.

312114.description: Located in the Islington district in London, The Luxury Inn offers 3-star rooms with free WiFi. Among the various facilities are a garden and a shared lounge. Attractions in the area include Islington, 0. 9 mi away, or Emirates Stadium, set 1. 2 mi from the property. All rooms at this boutique hotel are equipped with a coffee machine. Every room is fitted with a flat-screen TV, and some rooms are equipped with a patio. Guests will have access to the shared lounge, kitchen and dining area provided. A continental self-serving breakfast is available daily at The Luxury Inn. Hoxton Square is 1. 2 mi from The Luxury Inn. London City Airport is 6. 2 mi from the property.

312117.description: This charming hotel is situated in Islington. The establishment comprises 41 cosy rooms. Islington Inn is an ideal base for business trips, long weekend breaks, sight-seeing trips, visits to London theatres, museums, galleries, historic buildings and all the other attractions that London has to offer. Those staying at this hotel may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. The property provides 24-hour reception. Pets are not allowed at Islington Inn. Hotel is not serving breakfast due to pandemic and until further notice.

312133.description: Royal London Hotel is a family run hotel only 10 minutes' walk from Hammersmith Underground and Bus station and 5 minutes from Shepherds Bush Underground station. Close to Westfield shopping centre or Shepherds Bush O2 Empire. Guests can enjoy a 3-star bed and breakfast accomodation, with easy access to many parts of London. All the rooms are en suite, with free Wi-Fi, a fridge, tea and coffee making facilities. There is a breakfast Lounge that guests can use to plan the day ahead in London. Lots of maps, tourist information and more is available on request. A continental breakfast is served in the morning.

312159.description: Next to Kings Cross Station and the Eurostar service at St Pancras Station, The Carlton Hotel is an ideally located budget hotel in central London, complete with free Wi-Fi internet. Just 656 ft down the road is The British Library, and restaurants and bars are also within walking distance. Oxford Street, Covent Garden and Leicester Square are all approximately 15 minutes away by Underground. Well-equipped rooms all include a TV, tea and coffee making facilities and a private shower room. Hairdryers and ironing facilities are available from reception. The Carlton Hotel has friendly service, luggage storage and a 24-hour reception for late arrivals. Guests at The Carlton have easy access to the London airports from Kings Cross Station, which is just a 3-minute walk across the road.

312238.description: Home to 130 guest bedrooms with invigorating en suite power showers, our affordable Ibis Budget Barking hotel sets you up with everything you need under one roof. Guests benefit from a choice of well-appointed triple, double and twin bedrooms, a friendly service around the clock, spotless attention to detail and nearby conveniences including a Tesco Superstore right next door.

312252.description: Ideally located on a tree-lined road just a short stroll from the International Conference Centre and Harrogate town center, this attractive guest house has a small terraced front garden and colorful hanging baskets overflowing with flowers at the entrance. Whether you are attending a local conference, shopping in Harrogate's wide range of shops, celebrating a wedding in a magnificent Yorkshire castle, or visiting the beautiful Yorkshire Dales, this property provides the perfect place to stay. Featuring a pleasant lounge/bar with a fireplace, guests can enjoy a relaxing atmosphere while reading a book, and the day kicks off with a substantial breakfast made with local products.

312257.description: Located a mere 500 meters from Paddington Station and a short 5-minute stroll from Hyde Park, this hotel offers convenient access to London's key attractions. The Victoria & Albert and Science Museums are less than 2. 4 km away, and direct trains to Heathrow Airport depart regularly from Paddington. The hotel features artistically decorated bedrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, along with an open-plan restaurant and bar serving traditional dishes and a full English breakfast each morning. Recently refurbished, each room boasts high-quality furnishings and an opulent artistic touch, reflecting the owner's passion for art. In-room amenities include a TV, complimentary wireless internet, tea/coffee making facilities, a refrigerator, and a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer.

312272.description: Located in the heart of London, The Fairway Hotel offers convenient access to top attractions like Trafalgar Square and Piccadilly Circus, both within a 10-minute drive. This hotel provides 30 comfortable guestrooms equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, desks, coffee/tea makers, and en suite bathrooms with showers and hair dryers. Guests can also enjoy amenities such as room service (limited hours), tour/ticket assistance, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Nearby attractions include University College London, Russell Square, and The British Museum.

312273.description: All guests staying at this property will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Moyles Hotel & Restaurant as it counts with a total of 12 guest rooms. The hotel offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. There is no 24-hour reception. Moyles Hotel & Restaurant may charge a fee for some services.

312309.description: With a stay at Abbey Point Cafe and B&B in London (Park Royal), you'll be a 5-minute drive from SSE Arena, Wembley and 10 minutes from Portobello Road Market. This bed & breakfast is 3. 5 mi (5. 6 km) from Wembley Stadium and 3. 8 mi (6. 2 km) from Westfield London Shopping Centre. Free self parking is available onsite. At Abbey Point Cafe and B&B, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Breakfast is available for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 19 guestrooms.

312345.description: In Horley, 5 minutes away from Gatwick Airport. Holiday parking is available. Well placed for Gatwick Airport, the Corner House Hotel Gatwick with Holiday Parking offers a friendly atmosphere in which you can completely relax. The Gatwick Corner House is 25 miles away from central London, which is easily accessible by train.

312350.description: This establishment offers a total of 25 units.

312372.description: This cosy accomodation guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 12 accomodation units. Everyone staying at this accommodation may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at The Lawn Guest House. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

312376.description: This modern bed and breakfast sits overlooking a private garden square, opposite Kings Cross and St. Pancras train station. The property is located in close proximity to a wide range of attractions in the area, enjoying ease of access to the centre of the city. This bed and breakfast is set in a Georgian townhouse. The property focus on offering comfortable accommodation in a convenient location. The tastefully-designed guest rooms are serviced daily, and come well equipped with modern amenities. Guests are invited to enjoy a sumptuous breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to explore everything that London has to offer.

312377.description: This cosy establishment guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 8 units. Norbury ApartHotel offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Norbury ApartHotel does not offer 24-hour reception. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

312417.description: Located in 25 acres on the banks of the River Thames at Teddington Lock, The Lensbury Resort provides an inspirational backdrop for your next stay. With a famous 100 years of sporting history, The Lensbury is host to leading leisure facilities, elegant hotel bedrooms and an abundance of local attractions. The Lensbury is conveniently located, as well as offering complimentary guest car parking. 155 bedrooms 25 acres on the banks of the River Thames Wide ranging leisure facilities including 22 tennis courts, state-of-the-art gym, swimming pool and fitness studios Lounge and Terrace Restaurant serving modern British menu and range of event menus Water sports centre with access to the River Thames including motor boats, kayaks, canoes and sailing boatsSpa treatment rooms offering a range of ELEMIS treatments

312425.description: Ideally located at the heart of London, this property is surrounded by ample opportunities for exploration and discovery. Convenient links to the public transport network can be found nearby. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to a host of attractions, as well as a wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. The hotel mixes traditional and contemporary decor, to reflect the elegance and charm of the city. The property accents refined comfort, offering luxurious accommodation options. The hotel provides a warm blend of elegance and comfort, making each and every stay memorable. Guests can indulge in the ultimate relaxation in the spa, with treatments and pampering to enhance the experience.

312439.description: Offering the ideal setting for explore the area, this family-run guest house is situated in Surbiton, Surrey. The property is ideally situated close to the A3, offering ease of access to Kingston Town Centre, Hampton Court, Chessington Zoo, Sandown and Epsom Race Courses. Guests are extended a warm, friendly welcome upon arrival. The guest rooms are well equipped and tastefully designed, offering comfort and style in a peaceful setting. This guest house provides an excellent standard of accommodation, customer service and comfort in a convenient location, making it a great choice for business and leisure travellers alike.

312462.description: Everyone staying at this accommodation will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Guilford House as it counts with a total of 12 guest rooms. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. Travellers can enjoy the convenience of 24-hour reception. Guilford House follows environmentally sustainable practices.

312465.description: Sanctum Soho Hotel is an oasis of comfort, style and sophistication in the heart of London's buzzing West End. Situated on Warwick Street, two beautiful Georgian townhouses have been converted into a sumptuous 30-bedroom boutique hotel with luxurious event spaces. Sanctum Soho Hotel is an oasis of comfort, style and sophistication in the heart of London's buzzing West End. Situated on Warwick Street, two beautiful Georgian townhouses have been converted into a sumptuous 30-bedroom boutique hotel with luxurious event spaces.

312490.description: Relax and unwind with massages, body treatments, and facials. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a hair salon. Grab a bite at Elliots Bistro, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and 7 meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 56 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

312501.description: A 10-minute walk from Hyde Park and 5 minutes' walk from Edgware Road Tube Station, OYO 24 Sussex, London Paddington offers bed and breakfast accommodation and free Wi-Fi in the heart of London. All rooms at OYO 24 Sussex, London Paddington have a flat-screen TV and tea/coffee making facilities. Most rooms feature an en-suite bathroom with a shower. Guests can enjoy breakfast every morning in the dining area. The hotel is a 15-minute walk from Paddington Station, reaching Heathrow Airport after just a 15-minute train journey. The shops of Oxford Street are a 13-minute stroll away. The world famous Madame Tussauds wax museum is less than 20 minutes' walk away. The West End, containing many of the city's major tourist attractions, shops and entertainment venues, is a 20-minute Tube journey away. Westminster Borough is a great choice for travellers interested in shopping, parks and city walks. Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9. 3 for a two-person trip. Note- A damage deposit of GBP 50 is required on arrival.

312513.description: 'Enjoy a relaxing stay at The Midland Hotel, a charming inn located in Leeds, a short drive from the First Direct Arena and the University of Leeds. Guest rooms feature flat-screen televisions, espresso makers, and complimentary Wi-Fi. The hotel offers a restaurant, coffee shop, bar/lounge, and free self-parking. Additional amenities include wedding services and tour/ticket assistance. Nearby attractions include Oulton Hall Golf Course and Thwaite Mills. '

312532.description: Stay at Premier Inn Hotel Loughton/Buckhurst Hill, and you'll be just up the road from some famous filming locations for The Only Way is Essex. Central London is just a tube ride away too, and there are plenty of great tourist venues, business centres and family days out just waiting for you. Visit Belles & Beaus or Pet Couture to see if they're filming TOWIE. Or get away from it all wandering through the tranquillity of Epping Forest. Go bargain hunting at Stratford City Shopping Centre, or catch sporting or music events at the Olympic Stadium. Then come back to the hotel to a lovely comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

312564.description: This Victorian hotel is centrally located in London, just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from Victoria rail and coach station. Buckingham Palace, Hyde Park and Harrods can be found just a short distance away. Guests are greeted with warm hospitality and excellent service. Stylish guest rooms offer comfort and convenience, featuring modern amenities. The hotel offers a wide range of facilities and services, attending to the needs of every type of traveller. Complimentary internet access is available, perfect for those who are eager to keep in touch with work or home. Complemented by excellent customer service, this hotel offers everything that guests will need for a comfortable stay.

312581.description: Situated in the city centre of London, this delightful hotel offers close proximity to many of the city's tourist attractions. Guests will find themselves just a short walking distance away from Buckingham Palace, Big Ben, Westminster Abbey and the Houses of Parliament. A treasure trove of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues can also be found nearby. Convenient links to the public transport network are readily accessible in the area. This charming property is perfect for business and leisure travellers alike. The guest rooms offer a high level of comfort and convenience. Guests are invited to avail of the many facilities and services that the property has to offer.

312590.description: The premises count with 50 welcoming units. Antoinette Wimbledon includes Wi-Fi internet connection in all public areas and rooms. The hotel provides 24-hour reception.

312655.description:
A stay at Hotel Earls Court places you in the heart of London, within a 5-minute drive of Stamford Bridge Stadium and Hyde Park. This hotel is 3. 6 mi (5. 8 km) from Buckingham Palace and 3. 8 mi (6. 1 km) from Piccadilly Circus. 
Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, tour/ticket assistance, and a vending machine. 
Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. 
Stay in one of 20 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have shower/tub combinations and hair dryers. Housekeeping is provided daily, and irons/ironing boards can be requested.

312660.description: Wake up just seconds away from the world's most iconic landmarks at our London Tower Bridge hotel. The hotel features our super comfy new generation bedrooms, with an impressive 40" flat screen TV, freshly-updated bathroom with large shower head, and kingsize Hypnos bed. After a great night's sleep and famous Premier Inn Breakfast, you'll be in sightseeing heaven within minutes - from the Tower of London and HMS Belfast to the Shard and Canary Wharf. Explore the history of the capital at world-renowned attractions. Discover new bars along the whole of the Southbank. Take to the river to get a fresh view of the city. And when you've ticked all the must-sees off your list, return to a top- notch restaurant and those extra-comfy beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

312714.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). English breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 1840 square feet (171 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 265 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.

312730.description: The Webster Covent Garden located on Lincoln’s Inn Fields and comprise 167 bedrooms. The Webster’s design has been brought to life by London-based architecture and interior design studio Red Deer. Guestrooms feature warm neutral palettes and textured plank flooring, alongside hand-knotted wool rugs and bespoke light fixtures of brass and alabaster. Nostalgic details include Marshall speakers, Jacob Jensen phones, classic alarm clocks, and hand-selected books, while bedrooms also feature bespoke artwork and custom-patterned drapery. Bathrooms feature terrazzo flooring and organic ceramic wall tiles in neutral tones, accented by brushed-nickel Kohler fixtures and softly illuminated mirrors. The Webster Covent Garden will offer a trio of dining and drinking destinations inspired by Italy. Italian-inspired restaurant and speakeasy, Carmelina’s, is located on the hotel’s lower level and features deep red velvets and a sculptural gold-hammered bar. Live jazz will also be offered during the evenings.

312741.description: Sydney House is a contemporary townhouse hotel, just a short walk from King's Road and Knightsbridge. Behind its listed Georgian façade lies a thoroughly modern hotel. Each of the 21 air-conditioned bedrooms is designed for comfort, featuring the finest linens, goose-down duvets, and sleek glass bathrooms. Individually designed, all rooms have discreetly integrated technology, including DVD players, flat-screen TVs, and Wi-Fi. With 24-hour room service and à la carte breakfast, Sydney House offers the experience of a 'Private Home in the City. '

312863.description: This apartment complex enjoys a prime London location, just 100 meters from St. Paul's Cathedral and a five-minute walk from St. Paul's Underground Station. The vibrant South Bank and Tate Modern are a short 10-minute walk away, placing guests near a wide array of shopping, dining, and entertainment options. This charming complex offers beautifully designed apartments, each exuding character and style. Modern amenities provide comfort and convenience for both business and leisure travelers. Please note: Due to the Coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic, this property is not currently accepting visitors.

312900.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at this Ealing hotel, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a picnic area. The 29 guestrooms offer flat-screen TVs with cable, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, coffee/tea makers, and bottled water. Free self-parking is available onsite. Located near the Thames River, Hotel 55 is a short drive from Wembley Stadium and Westfield London Shopping Centre. Heathrow Airport is the closest airport.

312922.description: The Corner House hotel is a newly refurbished property, re-opened for its guests in 2008. It is located in a residential area within easy walking distance of the world famous Camden Market and Regents Park, 5 minutes from both Kentish Town and Camden underground stations. A bus stop with links to all major attractions in London is conveniently positioned just opposite the hotel. The rooms are all of medium size and brightly decorated with cream walls, warm coloured fabrics, oil paintings, wooden furniture and new, solid oak wooden floors. All rooms are equipped with plasma televisions, hair dryer, telephone and tea/coffee making facilities. The small bathrooms are all tiled up to the ceiling and have been equipped with bath tubs and showers. Both the bedrooms and bathrooms are in excellent condition, having been completely rebuilt and renovated in March 2008. This lovely hotel is located on the Camden Road, just ten minutes away from central London, a short walk from Kentish Town underground station and a ten minutes bus ride from Kings Cross underground and railway station. 313215.description: This charming bed and breakfast is ideally situated in LONDON. Beautifully retaining its old-world charm, with original features, while also embracing contemporary style and convenience, this property is sure to impress. The guest rooms offer comfort, style and elegance. Guests will appreciate the property's 24-hour reception desk, which ensures that all needs are fully catered for at any time of the day or night. 313231.description: Situated in the heart of Bloomsbury in London's West End, The Academy comprises a collection of five Georgian townhouses combined into one charming luxury hotel. The comprehensive refurbishment was overseen by renowned New York-based designer Alexandra Champalimaud, who has created an engaging blend of modern and vintage with a nod to the lives and loves of the Bloomsbury Set who lived and worked in the area in the early 20th Century. This rejuvenated 50 bedroom/suite boutique hotel in Bloomsbury juxtaposes timeless glamour and traditional features with a modern, comfortable city style to create a contemporary take on townhouse living.

The property is just a 10 minutes' walk from Cartwright Gardens and the British Library. The University of London and Russell Square are also located just a short distance away. The nearby underground station provides convenient access to the city centre, where a wealth of attractions can be found. This property offers comfortable, tastefully-designed guest rooms. This property offers a wonderful breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day.

314713.description: Ideally located just 400 meters away from King's Cross and St. Pancras International Station, this hotel is ideal for every type of traveller. The stunning guest rooms feature spacious, streamlined designs, and come well equipped with modern amenities. Guests will be pleased by the high level of excellence and the exemplary facilities and services that this property has to offer.

314730.description: The hotel has everything you need for a couple of nights in town. The Blandford Hotel is ideally located in the heart of London, just a short walk from Madame Tussauds and the Sherlock Holmes Museum. The hotel features 34 comfortable guest rooms, each equipped with heating, a plasma television, and complimentary Wi-Fi.

The hotel is situated in a quiet residential area, just moments from the vibrant Baker Street, and only a one-minute walk from the nearest underground station, providing easy access to London's top attractions. 
Guests can also take advantage of amenities such as bicycle rentals, concierge services, and discounted Hop-on Hop-off sightseeing bus tickets, with stop very close to the hotel.

314756.description: Enjoy a luxurious stay at this Edwardian hotel, boasting a health club, indoor pool, and spa tub. Benefit from complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services. Walk to Hyde Park, Kensington Gardens, Little Venice and the iconic shopping destination of Oxford Street. Or catch the Tube to Buckingham Palace and fashionable Knightsbridge where Harrods and Harvey Nichols are situated. 314759.description: This luxurious boutique hotel is situated in the heart of the county of Kent, surrounded by gorgeous private grounds and just 20 minutes by car from the Eurostar's Ebbsfleet International Station and around 50 minutes from Ashford International Station, which is also an Eurostar station, allowing easy access to other interesting local and international destinations. 314769.description: Boasting a central location in London, this bed and breakfast is situated just a few steps away from King's Cross St. Pancras underground station. 315094.description:
Number 2 Chesham Street a former family residence was built by English master builder Thomas Cubitt in 1882. A prestigious Victorian house listed by her Majesty's Government as a building of architectural distinctions. 

The 2 Chesham Hotel Belgravia is a beautifully well-preserved Victorian Grade II listed building with a great location in the heart of Belgravia one of the most exclusive areas of London With exquisitely decorated 26 en suite rooms, the hotel offers friendly and personal service. All rooms have telephones, TVs, tea/coffee making facilities, hairdryers and bathroom accessories. Stay on top of your business and entertainment needs with our free Wi-Fi connection, available in all rooms and on multiple devices. 

The hotel has a great convenient location in a quiet residential area, just 5 minutes walk from Belgravia Square and close to the green spaces of Hyde Park and Buckingham Palace Gardens. The upscale streets of Belgravia are defined by elegant townhouse residences, foreign embassies and the world famous museums such as National History museum, Science museum, Victoria & Albert Museum etc. Traditional pubs, fine-dining restaurants and independent shops can be found on the streets north of Buckingham Palace Road. Bordering Belgravia, Chelsea, Sloane Square and Knightsbridge attract the well-heeled for luxury shopping such as Harrods, Harvey Nichols, Dior, Bvlgari, Burberry etc. 

All that London has to offer is within easy reach and the hotel's great location means it offers good access to London's transport networks. London Victoria Station is 15 minutes walking distance away and Sloane Square and Knightsbridge London Underground Stations are even nearer.

"Our Wirral Eastham hotel is ideal for shoppers looking for bargains on famous brands at Cheshire Oaks Designer Outlet. After some retail therapy, enjoy a stroll around peaceful Eastham Country Park or visit the model village of Port Sunlight.

Head over the Mersey to explore historic Albert Dock and Liverpool's vibrant centre. Families are spoilt for choice with Chester Zoo, Knowsley Safari Park, Blue Planet Aquarium and the Ness Botanic Gardens all within a short drive.

All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a wide variety of food and drink choices within a short car journey from the hotel."

Just a short walk from Notting Hill Gate Underground station, you'll have easy access to the vibrant Portobello Market and a wealth of shopping, dining, and entertainment options. 315151.description:
EXPERIENCE LONDON FROM ONE OF ITS MOST DISTINGUISHED ADDRESSES. 

At 54 Queen’s Gate, luxury is paired with the warmth and comfort of home—right in the heart of South Kensington, one of London’s most desirable postcodes. A short stroll from the peaceful edges of Hyde Park, this Grade II listed Edwardian townhouse has been beautifully transformed into an intimate boutique retreat where elegance, character, and relaxation come naturally. 

Offering more than a place to stay— it’s a luxurious home away from home. Expect attentive service, a calm boutique atmosphere, and the comfort of a space designed for both relaxation and exploration. Step outside and London’s finest attractions await: Hyde Park, Kensington Palace, the Natural History Museum, and the V&A are all within easy walking distance. The neighborhood’s stylish cafés, elegant bars, celebrated restaurants, and the world-class shopping of Knightsbridge—including the iconic Harrods—are right at your doorstep. 

Our 24 bedrooms offers a unique blend of comfort, style, and individuality. Arranged across four distinctive categories, every room is thoughtfully designed with décor inspired by some of Kensington’s most celebrated past residents. 

From Churchill to Coleridge, Eliot to Elgar, the rooms reflect the character and elegance of these iconic figures, creating spaces that are both sumptuous and wonderfully private. Perfect for discerning travelers, each room provides a tranquil retreat in the heart of West London. 

All rooms are equipped with modern conveniences to ensure a seamless stay, including en-suite showers, air-conditioning, high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs with streaming services, a hairdryer, ironing station, coffee and tea-making facilities, complimentary bottled water, a minibar with soft drinks, and a secure laptop safe. Every detail is designed to make your stay effortless, relaxing, and memorable.

315653.description: In the heart of Earl's Court, the Rushmore Hotel is an elegant Victorian town house with free Wi-Fi. Earl’s Court Underground Station is just 100 metres away. 315799.description: Situated in Liverpool's city center, Base at Duke Street offers easy access to key attractions. A short walk from Liverpool One, the historic Chinese Arch, and the Royal Albert Dock, it's also convenient for nightlife with Concert Square and the Baltic Triangle nearby. This aparthotel provides a range of two and three-bedroom serviced apartments, including luxurious penthouses with stunning city views. Each apartment features a stylish, fully equipped kitchen, laundry facilities, widescreen TVs, and comfortable living spaces. Modern interiors cater to families, leisure, and corporate travelers alike. Lime Street Station is a quick ten-minute walk away, and on-site parking is available. Complimentary welcome packs and toiletries are provided, with travel cots available upon request. Free high-speed Wi-Fi is standard in every apartment. 315845.description: Discover South London's rich history in the city's area of Greenwich where our St Christopher's Inn hostel offers modern accommodation with brand new bathroom facilities and a newly refurbished Belushi's bar where hostel guests receive an exclusive 25% off food and daily drinks deals! With fast transport links to Central London, our hostel is in the perfect place to explore the city whilst still enjoying the beauty of Greenwich. What's not to love?

315863.description: Situated in the exclusive Belgravia district of London, this property is just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from Victoria Station and the Gatwick Express. Many of the city's attractions can be found nearby, including the West End, with its shops and theatres. The Docklands and Olympic Park are within easy reach. This property occupies a traditional, Grade II listed townhouse, which beautifully embraces contemporary interior design, while respecting its old-world charm. The stunningly-designed guest rooms echo the eclectic mix of traditional and elegance styles, for which London is renowned. Guests are invited to dine in style in the mornings, with a hearty full English breakfast, for a great start to the day.

315918.description: Opened in 2011, the Russell Court Hotel remains a popular budget-friendly option. 315924.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. 315973.description:
The Leonard is recognised as one of London’s leading boutique hotels featuring quintessentially British designed rooms and suites. Conveniently located by Marble Arch, The Leonard Hotel and Apartments is just a few minutes’ walk from Hyde Park and situated in the heart of central London. 

After a day of shopping or exploring, unwind with a drink at our bar before dining at Seymour’s Restaurant, which serves modern British and Asian cuisine for breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, and dinner. We also offer 24-hour room service for all guests. 

A stay with us at The Leonard promises to offer a luxurious, yet traditional British experience – perfect for whatever your plans may be. 

Our central location is ideal for shopping, with Selfridges, Oxford Street, Bond Street, and Regent Street all within walking distance. If you’re looking to explore more boutique stores, we also recommend a visit to Marylebone High Street. Staying near Hyde Park allows easy access to the park’s tranquil spaces, boating on the Serpentine Lake, and various concerts such as BST Hyde Park, as well as Winter Wonderland – London’s most famous Winter attraction.

You'll be in the heart of London's East End, with Tower Bridge within walking distance and stylish Whitechapel and colourful Brick Lane close by. Or hop on a bus for the shops and attractions of the rest of London.

All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals.

Useful information

Due to the close proximity of this hotel to the Tower Gateway DLR, some external noise may be heard."

316236.description: Located in the heart of vibrant Shepherd's Bush in West London, close to Westfield London shopping center, this modern hotel, housed in a former 1920s movie theater, offers easy access to Notting Hill, Kensington, London's West End, and other major tourist attractions. Rooms have the option of balconies and air conditioning, whilst Sky Sports channels and free WiFi are in every apartment. There is secure underground parking on site. Relax in the elegant marble-clad foyer or cosy library, have a drink in the secluded inner courtyard or work out in the on-site gym. 316496.description: The Wardonia Hotel, located in a charming Georgian townhouse in central London, is just a 3-minute walk from King's Cross St. Pancras International and Eurostar stations. A short stroll away, you'll find Coal Drops Yard with its array of shops, cafes, bars, and restaurants, as well as King's Boulevard, home to a mix of independent stores, gyms, salons, and high-end brands. The hotel is also conveniently located near the British Museum, with easy access to other attractions such as Oxford Street, Covent Garden, Madame Tussauds, and Buckingham Palace. Guests traveling to events at Emirates Stadium, Wembley Stadium, The O2, or London Stadium will find the Wardonia a great base. 316528.description: A 5-minute walk from Baker Street Underground Station and 10 minutes from Oxford Street, this traditional London town house has free Wi-Fi throughout. In the heart of the West End, Marylebone Inn is surrounded by restaurants and shops, which can be reached in 5 minutes' on foot. Regent’s Park is also a 5-minute walk, and the city’s popular theaters are 15 minutes' away by underground train. With simple, modern décor, each room has a seating area and flat-screen satellite TV. Each also has a kettle and a bathroom with a hairdryer on request. All the rooms feature double glazed windows for noise insulation. 316541.description:
A friendly, contemporary Harlow hotel near Stansted Airport and trains to Central London

Set in the thriving town of Harlow on the border of Essex and Hertfordshire, Holiday Inn Express® Harlow hotel is 15 miles from Stansted Airport, with easy access to the M11 motorway. Harlow Town Station is a 20-minute walk away, where you can take a 35-minute train ride to London Liverpool Street Station or catch the Stansted Express to the airport. A major hub for buses and coaches, Harlow Bus Station is right next to the hotel. 

Corporate guests are less than 10 minutes' drive from Harlow Enterprise Hub, and the Harlow Business Exhibition is held in Town Park on the hotel's doorstep. Three elegant meeting rooms host up to 42 delegates, with audiovisual equipment and catering services. 

Popular attractions in Harlow include Gibberd Garden and Gibberd Gallery in the Civic Centre, and you can follow Harlow's Sculpture Trail as you shop along the pedestrianised Broadwalk. It's a five-minute stroll from the hotel to Harlow Leisurezone, and within 20 miles you can visit family-friendly attractions such as Broxbourne Paradise Wildlife Park and Hertford Castle. 

Wi-Fi and breakfast are included, you can tuck into traditional British food and beers in the lobby bar and restaurant. Friendly staff can recommend a good pub in Harlow or the West Essex countryside.

316573.description:
Welcome to The Goodenough Hotel, a beautifully restored boutique hotel in Central London, located in the heart of the historic Bloomsbury district. Just minutes from King’s Cross, St Pancras International, and the West End, our hotel offers a unique blend of classic Georgian charm and contemporary luxury. 

Set across five elegant 19th-century Georgian townhouses, The Goodenough Hotel provides a tranquil escape from the buzz of the city – perfect for leisure breaks, business trips, or romantic getaways. Whether you're visiting London for work or pleasure, The Goodenough Hotel is your ideal home base – offering boutique accommodation in Central London with easy access to major attractions, theatres, museums, and transport links. 

At The Goodenough Hotel, our story is rooted in heritage, education, and giving back. More than just a boutique hotel in Bloomsbury, we’re proud to be a not-for-profit hotel in Central London – with 100% of our profits going towards supporting Goodenough College, a renowned postgraduate residence and academic community. 

When you stay with us, you’re not only enjoying a peaceful escape in one of London’s most historic and culturally rich neighbourhoods – you’re also contributing to the future of some of the world’s most talented students – including those on low incomes or from challenging backgrounds. It’s a stay that feels good and does good. 

In early 2026, The Goodenough Hotel will be undertaking phased heritage restoration works to the front of the building. These works are carefully managed, with little expected impact on guest access, comfort, or enjoyment of Mecklenburgh Square. Any limited works will be planned to minimise noise, and a small number of rooms will be temporarily closed, allowing us to carry out light-touch refurbishments, including new carpets. 

Experience authentic London, support a worthy cause, and sleep well, knowing your visit makes a difference.

Wembley is also home to the London Designer Outlet, a must-visit spot for shopaholics thanks to its exciting range of stores, bars and restaurants.
