316961.description: This charming property is located at the heart of London. The establishment is situated just a 10 minutes' walking distance away from Queensway, Notting Hill, Hyde Park and Paddington Station. Guests can enjoy nearby, convenient links to the public transport network, which place many of the city's most prominent attractions within easy reach. A range of cosmopolitan, stylish restaurants and lively bars can be found close to the hotel. This wonderful property greets visitors with warm hospitality and excellent service. Stylish, tastefully-designed guest rooms offer a peaceful setting in which to unwind. This property is a great choice for business and leisure travellers alike.

316966.description: Located in Mayfair, No5 Maddox Street Hotel is a perfect starting point from which to explore London. Offering a variety of facilities and services, the hotel provides all you need for a good night's sleep. Facilities like free Wi-Fi in all rooms, daily housekeeping, 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, Wi-Fi in public areas are readily available for you to enjoy. All rooms are designed and decorated to make guests feel right at home, and some rooms come with television LCD/plasma screen, internet access – wireless (complimentary), non smoking rooms, air conditioning, heating. Access to the hotel's fitness center will further enhance your satisfying stay. For reliable service and professional staff, No5 Maddox Street Hotel caters to your needs.

316981.description: Overlooking its own 18-hole golf course and set amidst the gorgeous surroundings of the Roe Valley Country Park, the resort is the perfect place to enjoy a couples retreat, golfing break or a family getaway. Kids can splash into fun with slides and inflatable jet skis in the pool, climb, swing and explore the adventure playground, and enjoy endless laughs in the arcade and helter skelter, as well as trying their hand at driving our mini 4x4s. Choose from our 118 guestrooms or 3 dog-friendly residences. Home to a soothing spa, boasting a thermal suite, as well as a hot tub, sauna and steam room. Dine in the delicious Coach House restaurant, with Fratelli coming soon where kids can enjoy building their own pizzas. We look forward to welcoming you!

317006.description:
Gainsborough Lodge is less then 10 minutes drive from London Gatwick airport which can be easily connected by local bus number 20 & 100, train to Horley station which is less then 10 minutes walk and taxis. 
There are a total of 20 guest rooms on the premises which have flat screen tv, tea/coffee making facility, towels and toiletries. 
Gainsborough Lodge offers free Wi-Fi internet connection on-site. 
This guest house does not operate a 24-hour reception and have night arrangements for guest arriving after 21:00. 
There is on site parking available at an extra cost which needs to be reserved and also offers holiday parking at a discounted rate. 
Horley town is 10 minutes walk where you will find number of shops, restaurants, pubs and mini supermarket.

317011.description: This hotel is located in Liverpool, within easy access of the many attractions that the city and its surroundings have to offer. Liverpool One shopping district, Cheshire Oaks and Blue Planet Aquarium are a 15 minutes' drive away. Chester Zoo, Liverpool and Everton Football Clubs, and Deeside are also within easy reach. The property has been hailed as one of the largest spa resorts in the region. This luxurious property enjoys a mesmerising design, tempting visitors into a world of luxury and style. The stunningly-appointed guest rooms are sure to impress, offering unrivalled comfort and convenience. Guests can indulge in the ultimate relaxation in the calming surroundings of the spa. The property also offers a variety of dining options, including an award-winning 3 AA Rosette restaurant.

317035.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at this stylish boutique hotel in London's City Centre. Each of the 49 individually decorated guestrooms features a minibar, LCD TV, and private bathroom with a shower, hairdryer, and bathrobes. Safes and desks are also provided for your convenience. The hotel offers express check-in/check-out and dry cleaning/laundry services. Nearby attractions include the Tower of London, St. Paul's Cathedral, the Gherkin, and Sky Garden.

317046.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Arriva Hotel, centrally located in London, a short drive from the British Museum and Russell Square. Make use of complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and on-site dining at our restaurant. Our 75 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs with digital programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, and in-room safes and desks. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at reception.

317050.description: Set within an elegant Victorian building in London's West End, this 3-star hotel offers a convenient base just a few hundred metres from Marble Arch, Hyde Park, and the shops of Oxford Street. The property, once the residence of Lady Jennie Churchill, provides a historic setting for travellers. Rooms are equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi and tea/coffee making facilities for guest comfort. Available room types include single, double, twin, and larger family rooms, all with private bathrooms. A 24-hour front desk is available to assist with enquiries. For meals, a restaurant serves a continental breakfast, with a full English breakfast also available for an additional fee. The hotel is located 100 yards from Marble Arch Underground Station and is less than a mile from Madame Tussauds.

317052.description: Ideally located at the heart of London, this hotel lies just a short walking distance away from Victoria Railway and underground station. Enjoying ease of access to the many points of interest that this captivating city has to offer, the hotel is perfect for those who are eager to explore. Westminster Abbey, Big Ben, Buckingham Palace, the Tate Modern and the Apollo Theatre are within walking distance of the property. Surrounded by restaurants, cafes and pubs, this hotel boasts convenience and comfort. The guest rooms are superbly styled, featuring facilities to suit business and leisure travellers. An international, continental breakfast can be enjoyed in the mornings.

317055.description: Located just a 1 minute's walking distance away from Golders Green underground and bus station, this property is a great choice for every type of traveler visiting London. Located in Barnet-Cricklewood, this property is within easy access of the many attractions that the area has to offer. This wonderful guest house extends a warm, friendly welcome to visitors upon arrival. Comfort, convenience, and hospitality combined with a homely ambiance create the perfect option for every type of traveler. Tastefully-designed guest rooms offer a comfortable setting in which to unwind. The property ensures visitors a wonderful stay.

317064.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at Stanley House, a hotel in London's city centre, just a short drive from Hyde Park and Buckingham Palace. Our 40 guestrooms feature flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with showers and hair dryers. Desks and irons/ironing boards are available upon request. We offer convenient amenities such as a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, luggage storage, tour/ticket assistance, and a vending machine. Victoria Station is a mere 0. 3 miles away, providing easy access to London's attractions, including Westminster Abbey (0. 9 miles). Heathrow Airport is the preferred airport for our hotel.

317083.description: Ideal for your stopover in East London, Premier Inn London Beckton is handy for all the top locations. However you're travelling you'll be well connected, with nearby links to London City Airport, Beckton DLR Station and Beckton Bus Station, A13/A406, and even the cable car across to the O2 Arena. Discover live events at the ExCel Exhibition centre, snap up the latest styles at Westfield Stratford, or head back in time at the Tower of London, then take a well-earned rest in the quiet and calm of Beckton Premier Inn and Windsor House Brewers Fayre restaurant. Our spacious rooms and extra-comfy beds will make all the difference. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

317084.description: Enjoy a delightful stay at Hotel Cavendish, nestled in the heart of London. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast, and savor delicious meals at our in-house restaurant. We offer 33 well-appointed guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms. Take advantage of our convenient amenities, including concierge services and luggage storage. We're just a short walk from University College London, the British Museum, and a quick drive from Oxford Street.

name.content: Premier Inn Castleford Xscape - M62 J32

317087.description: Adventure and indulgence are top of the to-do list at Premier Inn Hotel Castleford (Xscape, M62, J32), with Xscape Yorkshire and J32 Outlet Shopping Village right on the doorstep. You could be hunting down bargains one minute and zooming down a 170-metre, real snow ski slope the next. Or if you're more into tracking down a business deal, then why not make use of our fully-equipped meeting rooms? And when you've ticked everything off for one day, rest up with our tasty restaurant and super comfy beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

317233.description: Manzanillo’s Port Area Hotel with Complimentary TransportationThe Holiday Inn Express® Manzanillo Hotel is strategically situated in the heart of the Manzanillo Fondeport Industrial Area and near the Customs Zone and Inner Port. We are beside Torre Puerto Business Center and in front of Manzanillo’s Port, making us convenient to all its Custom Agencies, Shipping Agencies and Foreign Trade Offices. Enjoy the best restaurants in the touristic area of this port city just five minutes away. Nearby, you will also find downtown, where the Pez Vela statue is located in honor of Manzanillo being the sailfish capital of the world. After a day of work, come back to modern and comfortable rooms fully equipped to help you stay productive and enjoy undisturbed resting time. Relax in the outdoor patio with pool and playground area for children and release the day’s stress at the Fitness Center. Use our complimentary transportation, prior reservation and between 7am and 7pm, to go to the airport and all other important places in the city. Start your mornings with the free breakfast bar served and comfortably keep up with work from the 24-hour Business Center.

318460.description: Nestled within 7600 km from the town centre, the hotel allows easy access to all this destination has to offer. Visitors will find the main entertainment areas at 8100 km away. Guests can find the nearest golf course within 7400 km from the property. Visitors can easily walk to the public transportation means. Travellers will find the airport within 25000 km. Capital O Parotas features a total of 32 rooms. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. The front desk offers 24-hour reception. Capital O Parotas provides parking for guests' convenience.

319922.description: Hotel was built in 1994. Hotel was refurbished in 2015. Hotel has an annexing building. The property has 2 annexes. The property consists of 98 rooms. The property consists of 26 single rooms, 4 suites, 3 disability-friendly rooms, 9 triple rooms, 1 quadruple room and 4 family rooms. This popular hotel provides the ideal base for exploring the area. The front desk offers 24-hour reception. A key collection service is available. The Hotel has mobile phone coverage. Guests can take advantage of room service to enjoy breakfast in bed. There is a laundry service. There is a launderette available for long-term stays. The Hotel is wheelchair-accessible. The on-site car park may be useful to those arriving by car. The Hotel provides guests with a secure parking area. The Hotel offers 24-hour security. The Hotel has a bellboy service.

320136.description: Located in the heart of San Pedrito Beach, Manzanillo, near Mexico's main harbor and just five minutes from the city center, this comfortable hotel is ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Spacious, light-filled guest rooms offer a relaxing stay with modern amenities, including flat-screen TVs and Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy a refreshing swim in the outdoor pool. With its convenient and inviting amenities, it's an excellent choice for experiencing this vibrant city. Pet-friendly rooms are available for 280 pesos per pet, per night.

322426.description: The Osborne Hotel in Newcastle-upon-Tyne's Jesmond neighborhood offers comfortable guestrooms and convenient amenities, including an outdoor tennis court, karaoke, a restaurant, and a bar/lounge. Enjoy breakfast for a fee and utilize the 24-hour front desk and luggage storage. Free self-parking is available onsite. You'll be a short drive from the University of Newcastle-upon-Tyne, St. James' Park, Quayside, and Beamish Open Air Museum.

322502.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and a fireplace in the lobby. Additional amenities at this hotel include tour/ticket assistance, a banquet hall, and a vending machine. Satisfy your appetite with Fusion cuisine at Shark Club Gastro Bar, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Make yourself at home in one of the 170 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and microwaves. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed. Wired and wireless internet access is complimentary, and flat-screen televisions with digital programming provide entertainment.

322512.description: Situated on Ocean Road, this 3-star guest house is located in the centre of South Shields and offers a welcoming base for visitors. The property is positioned a short walk from the town's sandy beaches, with Sandhaven Beach less than 1 km away. The guest house provides family-friendly accommodation with room types including single, double, twin, and family rooms. Each room is equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi and tea and coffee making facilities. Some rooms offer views over the garden. For convenience, laundry services and parking are available. Key local attractions are within easy reach. The Ocean Beach Pleasure Park is a 9-minute walk from the property, and two large parks, including South Marine Park with its yachting lake, can be reached in five minutes on foot.

322551.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden at Jesmond Dene House, a hotel offering complimentary wireless internet access, concierge and wedding services, and a cozy fireplace in the lobby. Savor local cuisine at Fern, the on-site restaurant with garden views, or enjoy room service during limited hours. Unwind at one of the two bars/lounges. Continental breakfast is served weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and weekends from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM (for a fee). The hotel also provides complimentary wired internet access, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free self-parking is available on-site. Each of the 40 individually decorated guestrooms features a refrigerator, flat-screen television with digital programming, and a private bathroom with designer toiletries and a hair dryer. Safes and desks are also provided, and housekeeping is daily. Located near Jesmond Dene Park, the hotel is also convenient to Freeman Hospital, Jesmond Cricket Ground, and Newcastle International Airport.

322628.description: Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless internet access and a vending machine. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include luggage storage and a vending machine. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 20 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Cable television is provided for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and fans, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Nuns Moor Park - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- ISKCON Newcastle - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Leazes Park - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- St. James' Park - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- Newcastle-upon-Tyne Discovery Museum - 1. 5 km / 0. 9 mi- Chinatown - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- University of Newcastle-upon-Tyne - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Eldon Square Shopping Centre - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- O2 Academy Newcastle - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- The Gate - 1. 9 km / 1. 2 mi- Life Science Centre - 2 km / 1. 2 mi- Royal Victoria Infirmary - 2 km / 1. 2 mi- Newcastle-upon-Tyne St. Mary's Cathedral - 2 km / 1. 3 mi- Grainger Market - 2 km / 1. 3 mi- Bigg Market - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi. The nearest major airport is Newcastle Intl. Airport (NCL) - 11. 5 km / 7. 1 mi With a stay at OYO The Bentleys Hotel in Newcastle-upon-Tyne (Elswick), you'll be within a 5-minute drive of St. James' Park and Quayside. This guesthouse is 0. 5 mi (0. 7 km) from Nuns Moor Park and 0. 5 mi (0. 8 km) from ISKCON Newcastle.

322705.description: One of our top picks in Hartlepool. OYO Douglas Hotel near Kirklandside Hospital is just a 5-minute walk from Hartlepool's Middleton Grange Shopping Centre and 1. 6 km from the town's Historic Quay and Marina. It is a 10-minute drive from the A19. Free WiFi is available. All rooms have a flat-screen TV, wardrobe and tea/coffee making facilities. Each room has an en suite shower or bath with a hairdryer. A freshly cooked breakfast can be provided for an additional fee. There is on-street parking surrounding the hotel and a car park adjacent to the hotel with free parking after 18:00. OYO Douglas Hotel near Kirklandside Hospital is 1 km from Hartlepool United Football Club, while Hartlepool's Maritime Experience is 1. 3 km away. Summerhill Country Park is 2. 3 km from the property. We speak your language!

322908.description: This cosy accomodation guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 15 guest rooms. All guests staying at this hotel can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the property. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception. Hardwicke Hall Manor Hotel may charge a fee for some services.

322977.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this accomodation.

323010.description: The Grainger House Hotel offers private accommodations within a Grade II listed historic building, nestled on two acres of lush lawns and trees. Guests enjoy en-suite or shared bathroom facilities, with complimentary toiletries provided in all bathrooms. Each room features a welcome tray with tea, coffee, cookies, milk, sugar, bottled water, and hand towels. A modern lounge area offers a coffee machine and two large-screen TVs with Sky Box, while most rooms include Smart TVs and free WiFi. Additional amenities comprise an ironing room, a ground-floor Rijo coffee machine, and ample free parking. Located under two miles from the city center and train station, and a mere ten-minute drive from Newcastle Airport, the hotel provides easy access to Newcastle's vibrant shops, restaurants, and nightlife. A bus stop is conveniently situated just outside the hotel, and taxis to the city center are available for under £5.

323082.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this property. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. This hotel does not offer 24-hour reception. Additional fees may apply for some services.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Newport South

323813.description: The Holiday Inn Express® Hotel Newport South is located right in the middle of the natural, scenic beauty of southern Appalachia. Just minutes from the neighboring towns of Gatlinburg and Pigeon Forge, and seconds off Interstate 40 at exit 435, our hotel is near the best Cocke County businesses and attractions. Our hotel is close to many corporations like ConAgra, Sonoco Products, Lisega, AeroPro, Duke Energy, Norfolk Southern, and Tennessee Valley Authority. Known as the Gateway to the Great Smoky Mountains, our hotel's location puts you near phenomenal attractions and activities. From whitewater rafting on the Pigeon River to experiencing the thrill of racing cars at the Newport Speedway, you'll never want for exciting things to do. Take time to enjoy a family-friendly adventure at Dollywood, escape to the banks of the French Broad River or tour historic sites like the Cocke County Courthouse, Elm Hill and Rhea-Mims Hotel. You're sure to feel at home at our 100% non-smoking property. Here in Newport, TN, you can stay your way with no stress, thanks to our terrific service.

323948.description: The York House Hotel, a 4-Star Guest Accommodation as graded by Visit Britain, is a family-run establishment offering quality bed and breakfast in the coastal town of Whitley Bay. All ensuite bedrooms are non-smoking and feature a high standard of facilities, including unique integral kitchenettes with fridges and microwaves. Spacious and comfortable accommodations range from single, twin, and double rooms to family rooms and a spacious family suite. Free Wi-Fi and on-site car parking are available. Overlooking Whitley Bay Park and just 200 meters from blue flag award-winning sandy beaches, the hotel is ideally located for exploring Tyne & Wear and Northumbria. It's just 15 minutes from Newcastle city center and 30 minutes from Newcastle International Airport. An excellent selection of restaurants and bars are within walking distance.

323979.description: Ideally located in the prime touristic area of City Center and Grainger Town, Grainger Hotel promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. Offering a variety of facilities and services, the hotel provides all you need for a good night's sleep. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, facilities for disabled guests, luggage storage, Wi-Fi in public areas are there for guest's enjoyment. Guestrooms are designed to provide an optimal level of comfort with welcoming decor and some offering convenient amenities like television LCD/plasma screen, towels, heating, desk, toiletries. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. Grainger Hotel combines warm hospitality with a lovely ambiance to make your stay in Newcastle-upon-Tyne unforgettable.

324512.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and tour/ticket assistance. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Brasserie, a restaurant which specializes in British cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in Newcastle-upon-Tyne? This hotel has facilities measuring 1259 square feet (117 square meters), including conference space. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 122 guestrooms featuring plasma televisions.

324629.description: A total of 28 accomodation units are available for guests' convenience.

324805.description: The  Hotel is situated in the heart of Jesmond, a quiet suburb of Newcastle upon Tyne. Located 1.5 miles from Newcastle city centre, Jesmond is ideally suited for people staying on business and/or pleasure. We are also a 2 minute walk from Jesmond Dene where you will find a lovely walk through the Dene. Our superb Italian restaurant Sebastian's offers contemporary and quality breakfast, lunch and evening meals with a specials and A La Carte menu available. The Dene Hotel is located in a quiet street but only 2 minutes walk from busy Osborne Road with its pubs, bars and restaurants. Shopping is available at nearby Acorn Road where amenities include banks, post office, supermarket, chemists, fashion boutiques and antique shops. Each room has been tastefully decorated for style and comfort.

325238.description: With a stay at Black Bull Inn in Wooler, you'll be within a 15-minute drive of Chillingham Castle and Pow Burn. This 4-star inn is 16. 5 mi (26. 6 km) from Bamburgh Beach and 17. 9 mi (28. 9 km) from Lindisfarne Castle. Enjoy the recreation opportunities such as an outdoor tennis court or make use of other amenities including complimentary wireless Internet access. Free self parking is available onsite. At Black Bull Inn, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Breakfast is available for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 13 guestrooms.

325308.description: The Best Western® Gibside Hotel, in the center of wonderful Whickham Village, has the location, location, location you are looking for - whether you are here on business or staying at your leisure. Built in 1982 and extended in 1990, the hotel has a reputation for relaxation. In a historic village setting, it is little wonder that many television productions have been filmed in the area. Our friendly staff, many of whom have been at The Best Western® Gibside Hotel for over 25 years, will give you a true home-away-from-home experience. Friendly and caring, they will make your comfort their top priority from the moment you check in.

325437.description: The Athena Guest House is a charming Victorian red-brick house located in Oxford. We offer comfortable double, triple, and family en-suite rooms, each equipped with a washbasin, toilet, bath, water filter, tea and coffee facilities, and a TV/DVD player. Both wired (RJ45) and wireless internet access are available, ensuring a stable connection regardless of your device. A public PC with free high-speed internet is also provided.

325599.description: Located on the bustling High Street in the Cotswolds village of Burford, this historic inn occupies a Grade II listed building dating back to the 16th century. The property offers 18 individually appointed guest rooms, including options with four-poster beds. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning, Wi-Fi, and tea and coffee making facilities. Guests have several on-site dining choices, including a restaurant and a bar. One of the unique dining experiences is a 10-seat restaurant centred around an open-fire grill. Free on-site parking is available for travellers exploring the region by car. The Tolsey Museum is located just a few minutes' walk from the property.

325602.description: All guests staying at this property will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at White Hart Nettlebed as it counts with a total of 12 units. The hotel offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas.

325839.description: With a stay at White Hart Hotel in Wallingford, you'll be 10. 6 mi (17 km) from University of Oxford and 11. 2 mi (18 km) from Ashmolean Museum. This hotel is 11. 4 mi (18. 3 km) from Covered Market and 11. 6 mi (18. 6 km) from Christ Church College. Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and a television in a common area. The front desk is staffed during limited hours. Free self parking is available onsite. Grab a bite at one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary English breakfast is served on weekdays from 7 AM to 9:30 AM and on weekends from 8 AM to 10 AM. Stay in one of 23 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Your bed comes with Egyptian cotton sheets, and all rooms are furnished with sofa beds. Complimentary wired Internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries.

325905.description: Beer, Bread, Blankets. These are the staples that historically, Witney is famous for. The Blue Boar redefines these symbols, providing a stylish bar, restaurant and rooms in which quality and comfort is paramount. Formerly known as The Marlborough Hotel, The Blue Boar has benefited from a £3m investment, and boasts 20 boutique style bedrooms and an elegant function room. Each of the 20 en-suite bedrooms is individually designed in boutique-style, with luxury bathrooms and of course, the famous Witney blankets. All of the rooms also feature iPod docking stations, flatscreen televisions, tea and coffee making facilities and free WiFi. Whether visiting the Blue Boar for business or for pleasure, the high quality finish of the rooms guarantees a warm and comfortable stay.

325907.description: Whether you are popping in for a quiet drink, a great lunch or looking for somewhere to stay, The Cherry Tree offers a warm, homely welcome. A superb place to spend your time whilst in the Medieval village of Steventon. The Cherry Tree is a beautiful 18th Century building and is still run as a traditional village pub, serving as the heart of its community. The low ceilings, oak beams and 3 open fireplaces are cosy in the winter whilst the large courtyard with giant umbrellas and heaters are perfect for those warm summer evenings. We are well known in the village and surrounding areas for our diverse selection of real ales, featuring 6 full time Wadworth brews and a further rotating guest ales. Come and join our regulars for a relaxing drink or bite to eat, or for a more lively visit pop along to our ever popular pub quiz each Monday night. The Cherry Tree is also a B&B and has 7 Comfortable, En-suite Bedrooms, convenient for The Milton Business Park or Harwell Science Park

325995.description: Constructed in 1874 and set in 133 acres of parkland, The Springs is a fine example of a Victorian Tudor style country house. The elegant reception halls still retain all their period features such as oak panelling, beams and stone fireplaces where you will be welcomed with crackling log fires through the winter months. Nearly all the bedrooms have recently been refurbished in neutral colours with modern white bathroom suites and many have balconies and enjoy picturesque views across the lake and beautifully manicured grounds. All rooms are non-smoking. The award winning AA Rosette Lakeside Restaurant serves excellent cuisine. Only the finest freshly sourced ingredients are used so the menu is updated daily. As the name suggests, the restaurant enjoys wonderful views across the lake through attractive floor to ceiling latticed windows. The hotel offers golf, weddings, conference and banqueting facilities. Also on site, there is a putting green, croquet lawn, coarse fishing on the River Thames, sauna and outdoor pool. The pool was installed by former owner rock star, Ian Gillan, from the band Deep Purple) and is often commented on by guests for its quirky design in the shape of a guitar. Located amidst the rural and peaceful setting of the Thames Valley countryside, historic market towns such as Wallingford, Henley, Abingdon and Dorchester are all close by. Other places of interest are Oxford, Windsor, the Cotswolds, Blenheim Palace and Basildon Park.

326062.description: This family-run hotel, a former 15th-century coaching inn, exudes traditional charm with its antique pine and dark oak furnishings, wallpaper, and carpets. Some rooms offer more contemporary decor. Located in the heart of a bustling Cotswold market town, the hotel is a minute's walk from restaurants, a charming theatre, and a boutique cinema. Please note there is no elevator/lift and the swimming pool is currently unavailable. Ground floor rooms can be requested upon booking. This historic inn boasts a rich past, once owned by legendary drummer Keith Moon of 'The Who, ' who frequently entertained celebrity friends like Roger Daltrey. Comedy icon Ronnie Barker was also a regular, with his shop just three doors down; some of the hotel's furnishings were even purchased from his store.

326128.description: Located in Wantage, The Bear Hotel is within a 15-minute drive of North Wessex Downs and Millets Farm Centre. This property is 7 mi (11. 2 km) from Uffington White Horse and 7. 1 mi (11. 5 km) from Uffington Castle. Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless Internet access and wedding services. Featured amenities include complimentary wired Internet access, a computer station, and a 24-hour front desk. At The Bear Hotel, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary breakfast is included. Make yourself at home in one of the 35 guestrooms.

326240.description: The Laurels Guest House guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 5 accomodation units. All guests staying at this property may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at The Laurels Guest House. The reception does not work around the clock. Some services of The Laurels Guest House may be payable.

326247.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden at The Falkland Arms, a charming upscale inn located in a rural setting near Chipping Norton. Start your day with a complimentary full breakfast served from 8:30 AM to 10:00 AM, and later savor a delicious meal at the restaurant or a refreshing drink at the bar/lounge. Free Wi-Fi and self-parking are available. The inn's six guestrooms feature flat-screen televisions, bathrooms with showers, coffee/tea makers, and complimentary bottled water. Daily housekeeping ensures a comfortable stay. Nearby attractions include Chipping Norton Golf Club and Fairytale Farm (within a 10-minute drive), Blenheim Palace (10. 7 mi), and Bicester Village (17. 1 mi).

Vienna is 31 mi away, and the Semmering, popular for skiing and hiking, is 16 mi from the Orange Wings. The Linsberg Asi Spa is 6. 2 mi away.

341979.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden, or unwind in the sauna at Hotel Lindenhof in Brienz. Start your day with a complimentary buffet breakfast (7:30 AM to 10:00 AM) and savor delicious meals at Restaurant Lindenhof. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. The hotel offers 29 guestrooms, each featuring a rooftop private spa tub, LCD TV, and a private balcony or patio. Satellite programming and complimentary Wi-Fi are also provided. For events, the hotel offers 1185 sq ft (110 sq m) of space, including conference space and two meeting rooms. Free self-parking, laundry facilities, and a safe deposit box at the front desk are available. Explore nearby attractions like Lake Brienz (a short walk away) and the Schweizer Holzbildhauerei Museum.

342004.description: Prime Location: Grand Hôtel du Parc in Crans-Montana offers a scenic setting with stunning mountain views. The hotel is situated near Crans-sur-Sierre Golf Club, a 17-minute walk away, and Mont Fort, 39 km from the property. Exceptional Facilities: Guests enjoy ski-to-door access, a spa and wellness centre, sauna, fitness centre, and a terrace. Additional amenities include a restaurant, bar, free WiFi, and free on-site parking. Comfortable Accommodations: Rooms feature private bathrooms with bathrobes, minibars, and balconies offering lake or mountain views. The hotel provides family rooms, a kids' club, and a games room, ensuring a pleasant stay for all guests. Local Attractions: Nearby activities include skiing, walking tours, and hiking. The surrounding area offers an ice-skating rink, providing additional entertainment options.

342136.description: Situated slightly above the centre of the car-free village of Wengen, this 3-star hotel offers panoramic views of the Jungfrau mountain and the Lauterbrunnen valley. The property is accessible only by train, and a complimentary station pick-up service can be arranged. Guests can dine at the on-site restaurant, which serves traditional Swiss dishes and offers al fresco dining on the terrace in good weather. The hotel features a games room with a pool table, a library, and ski storage facilities. A complimentary buffet breakfast is provided. Available accommodation includes double rooms with a balcony and Jungfrau views, as well as rooms that look out onto the forest. The hotel is located 0. 3 km from the Wengen-Männlichen Cable Car and a 10-minute walk from Wengen train station.

342173.description:
**La Val Hotel & Spa – Where Design Meets Nature**

Brigels is one of the few mountain destinations in Graubünden that has retained its authentic character. Sunshine, wide open spaces, generous slopes, and soothing tranquility define this village high above the everyday hustle and bustle. Here, the La Val Hotel & Spa welcomes its guests as a stylish hideaway for those who appreciate quality, space, and authenticity. 

At La Val, luxury is understood as conscious restraint. Natural materials, calming colors, abundant light, and clean design combine alpine tradition with contemporary comfort. Wood, stone, and high-quality textiles create a warm, timeless atmosphere. The service is personal, attentive, and pleasantly discreet. 

At the heart of it all are the spacious **"La Suita"** – stylish retreats for couples, families, and friends. Floor-to-ceiling windows bring the mountain scenery indoors, while reclaimed wood and natural stone create a cozy ambiance. 

After an active day of hiking, biking, golfing, skiing, or strolling, La Val offers a space to arrive and unwind. A crackling fireplace and balconies with mountain views create a special atmosphere. 

The **680 m² mountain spa** is the heart of relaxation. Saunas, steam rooms, an indoor pool, and a heated whirlpool with mountain views invite you to unwind. Massages and body and facial treatments with natural products complement the offerings. The relaxation zone provides space for meditation, a good book, or simply doing nothing. 

Culinary delights at La Val focus on regional products and honest, contemporary cuisine – seasonal, authentic, and exquisitely crafted. 

A haven for discerning connoisseurs: stylish, connected to nature, and refreshingly unhurried. A place where you arrive, breathe deeply, and wish you could linger.

name.content: Valaisia Crans-Montana, a Faern Collection Resort

342422.description: Valaisia Crans-Montana combines stylish alpine design with panoramic views of the Alps and a warm, inviting atmosphere for families and friends. Newly renovated in 2022, it offers modern 800 sqm wellness facilities, alpine-chic rooms, and delightful dining in our restaurants and bar. With direct access to Crans-Montana’s ski slopes, golf courses, and hiking trails, Valaisia is the perfect base for active yet relaxing getaways. Our guests love our hotel for its true ski-in/ski-out access, comprehensive wellness facilities, and stunning 180° alpine views. Perched on a high plateau in Switzerland’s renowned wine and cheese region, the lifestyle resort with alpine-chic design makes it the perfect spot for unforgettable mountain experiences and total relaxation.

342508.description: Located in the heart of Ormont-Dessus, Hôtel Les Sources offers ski-in/ski-out access and is just steps from Jorasse and a short walk from the Villars - Gryon Ski Area. This family-friendly hotel features 48 guestrooms equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, and safes. Enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant, unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge, or take advantage of room service during limited hours. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. Additional amenities include an arcade/game room, ski storage, dry cleaning/laundry services, and free self-parking. The hotel also boasts a conference center and four meeting rooms for events.

342579.description: Hotel Alpenland has a garden, shared lounge, a terrace and restaurant in Gstaad. This 3-star hotel offers a ski pass sales point, room service and free WiFi. The hotel features a sauna and a concierge service. The rooms at the hotel come with a seating area, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a safety deposit box and a private bathroom with a bath or shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer. Rooms come with a coffee machine, while some rooms include a balcony and others also feature mountain views. Guest rooms will provide guests with a desk and an electric tea pot. Hotel Alpenland has a playground. Guests at the accommodation will be able to enjoy activities in and around Gstaad, like skiing and cycling. Rochers de Naye is 28 miles from Hotel Alpenland. Geneva International Airport is 97 miles from the property.

342609.description: Located in Stansstad, next to the landing stage at Lake Lucerne, Hotel & Restaurant zum Beck offers a comfortable restaurant with a terrace, and rooms with free WiFi, only 1148 feet from Stansstad Station. It is a 2-minute walk from the beach. Free parking spaces are also available on site. The hotel restaurant serves regional specialties as well as meat and fish dishes with local ingredients. Guests can dine both inside and on the terrace in summer. All of the rooms at the Hotel & Restaurant zum Beck include cable TV and a work desk. Guests can enjoy water and fresh fruits available daily in the lobby. The town of Stans is less than 10 minutes away by car. The attractions of Lucerne including, the Richard Wagner Museum, Bourbaki Panorama and the Lion Monument, are 15 minutes away by car.

name.content: Boutique Hotel de la Croix Federale

342619.description: The Boutique Hotel de la Croix Federale offers a peaceful stay just 6 km from the airport. This recently renovated hotel (2021) features 10 rooms and provides complimentary Wi-Fi in all public areas and guest rooms. Guests are welcomed by a 24-hour reception service, and on-site parking is available for added convenience. Some services may incur additional charges.

342714.description: Enjoy a day on the slopes or rent bicycles to explore the area. Alpenhotel Schlüssel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, ski storage, and a vending machine. Start your day with a free buffet breakfast served from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Other amenities include a safe deposit box at the front desk and free self-parking. The 24 guestrooms feature espresso makers, flat-screen televisions with cable programming, and private furnished balconies. Private bathrooms include deep soaking bathtubs and hair dryers. Located next to a golf course in Andermatt, the hotel is within a 5-minute walk of Gütsch and the Andermatt Museum, and a short distance from Talabfahrt Gurschen - Andermatt and Gurschenalp Ski Lift.

342729.description: With a total of 14 accomodation units, this is a nice place to stay. The property offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. The reception does not work around the clock.

342771.description: Located in the mountain landscape of Tschappina, Gasthaus Alpina is a family-friendly guesthouse set away from the main traffic routes. The property, formerly known as Pension Alpina, offers a welcoming and informal atmosphere at the foot of the Piz Beverin mountain. Guests can dine at the on-site restaurant, which serves regional and traditional Swiss dishes. The guesthouse features a wellness area with a seasonal outdoor pool, a barrel sauna, and a hotpot. For younger guests, there is a petting zoo. The property provides free parking and Wi-Fi access. Accommodation consists of seven cosy rooms, some of which include a balcony with mountain views. Rooms have shared bathroom facilities. The guesthouse is situated at the base of the family-friendly Tschappina-Heinzenberg ski area.

342822.description: This establishment offers a total of 71 units. The property offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. The reception desk is not open throughout the day. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

342876.description: Die 30 einladenden Zimmer bieten Ihnen den perfekten Ort zum Entspannen nach einem langen Tag. Alle Gäste dieser Unterkunft können die WLAN-Verbindung in den öffentlichen Bereichen nutzen. Bitte beachten Sie, dass dieses Hotel keine 24-Stunden-Rezeption hat. Für einige Dienstleistungen können Gebühren anfallen.

342968.description: This lovely hotel is located in Zweisimmen. The 23 welcoming guest rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. Those who stay at this establishment may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Top Rinderberg Swiss Alpine Lodge. Top Rinderberg Swiss Alpine Lodge does not offer 24-hour reception. All units at Top Rinderberg Swiss Alpine Lodge are wheelchair-accessible. Parking facilities are available for guests' convenience. Visitors travelling for business purposes may take advantage of the property's business facilities. The hotel may charge a fee for some services. *ATTENTION* Limited front desk hours.

342984.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of Hotel Emmental, located in the heart of Thun. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served weekdays, and the on-site restaurant offers delicious meals. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi in one of the 14 guestrooms, each featuring a flat-screen TV and private bathroom. The hotel is a short drive from Thunersee and Thun Castle, offering convenient access to key attractions.

343030.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional features at this hotel include concierge services, shopping on site, and wedding services. Grab a bite at Rosemary Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge and a garden view. You can also stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available on request), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 78 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and coffee/tea makers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Stanton Country Park - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Arkells Brewery - 3. 2 km / 2 mi- Upper Stratton Public Library - 3. 5 km / 2. 2 mi- Pentylands Country Park - 3. 6 km / 2. 2 mi- Stratton St Margaret Parish Grounds - 3. 7 km / 2. 3 mi- Wrag Barn Golf & Country Club - 4 km / 2. 5 mi- Blunsdon Golf Course - 4. 1 km / 2. 5 mi- Penhill Library - 4. 6 km / 2. 9 mi- Blunsdon Abbey Stadium - 4. 7 km / 2. 9 mi- Clive Parade - 4. 9 km / 3 mi- Argus Green - 4. 9 km / 3 mi- Pinehurst Library - 5. 1 km / 3. 2 mi- Diamond Jubilee Park - 6. 5 km / 4 mi- Rodbourne Cheney Library - 6. 5 km / 4. 1 mi- Thames Path - 6. 9 km / 4. 3 mi. The nearest airports are: Oxford (OXF) - 52. 8 km / 32. 8 mi Bristol International Airport (BRS) - 90. 7 km / 56. 3 mi The preferred airport for Stanton House Hotel is Bristol International Airport (BRS).

343046.description: Centrally located in Aigle, Hotel du Nord is within a 10-minute walk of the Vine and Wine Museum and Aigle Castle. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a restaurant, snack bar/deli, and bar/lounge. Enjoy a daily continental breakfast and make use of convenient amenities such as concierge and ski storage services. The 24 guestrooms feature flat-screen TVs, minibars, and private bathrooms with showers.

name.content: Grand Hotel Les Endroits La Chaux-de-Fonds

343110.description: Located in scenic natural surroundings, 5 minutes by car from the center of La Chaux-de-Fonds, the Grand Hôtel Les Endroits features an award-winning gourmet restaurant. Awarded 13 Gault Millau points and recommended by the Guide Michelin, the restaurant serves a wide range of regional specialties. The Grand Hotel Les Endroits features on-site private parking. Some parking spaces are covered.

343125.description: After a day on the slopes, enjoy the hotel's sauna and fitness center. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, ski storage, and a TV in the common area. The Fiescherhof Restaurant serves delicious meals, and guests can unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available daily (7 AM to 11 AM) for a fee. For business travelers, the hotel offers a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. The hotel also has 1442 square feet (134 square meters) of event space, including a conference area and a meeting room. A complimentary train station pick-up service is available 24/7, and free self-parking is provided on-site. The hotel's 27 guestrooms offer complimentary Wi-Fi, bathrooms with showers and hair dryers, phones, safes, and desks. Located in Fiesch, near the ski lifts, Hotel Fiescherhof is within a 5-minute walk of Talegga and the Fiesch-Fiescheralp I Cable Car. This ski hotel is also conveniently close to the Fiesch-Fiescheralp II Cable Car, Ski Lift Firsch - Fiescheralp, and other area attractions.

343132.description: Boasting a privileged position in La Pineda, just behind a verdant forest with wonderful views to the sea, these apartments are the best option for a relaxing leisure experience in this part of Catalonia. Families with children might be interested in knowing that in the same street of the apartments, there is a fantastic water park and also a short ride away lies the popular and exciting Port Aventura theme park. In the surrounding area, guests will find supermarkets, shops, souvenirs, and a wide range of services dedicated to tourists. Moreover, all the apartments count with one or two bedrooms, as well as a cosy living room where guests will feel like at home. They also feature a fully equipped kitchen with oven and microwave for added comfort and convenience. Those travelling by car may use the payable car park available and there is also Internet available for a small charge.

343197.description:
When you stay at The Lansdowne Hotel in Calne, you'll be within a 10-minute drive of North Wessex Downs and Bowood Garden.  This property is 16.7 mi (26.9 km) from Swindon Designer Outlet and 7.1 mi (11.4 km) from Silbury Hill.
At The Lansdowne Hotel, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge.
Make yourself at home in one of the 24 guestrooms.

343222.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a sauna and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and ski storage. Enjoy Italian cuisine at Maya Caprice Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge and a garden view. You can also stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Make yourself at home in one of the 21 guestrooms featuring minibars. Rooms have private balconies. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have designer toiletries and bidets. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

343252.description: Just 2625 feet from the Flims Cable Car, Alpenhotel Flims offers a balcony overlooking the mountains in all rooms. Free Wi-Fi is available in public areas. The traditionally furnished rooms feature cable TV, a safe, and a bathroom. The daily breakfast buffet includes a variety of fresh local products. Guests of the Flims Alpenhotel can use a lobby with a bar. The next bus stop is just 328 feet away. The surrounding Swiss Tectonic Arena Sardona is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Chur is a 20-minute drive away.

name.content: Hostellerie Du Pas De L Ours

343277.description: Located in the heart of the Swiss Alps in Crans-Montana, this 5-star hotel is a member of Relais & Châteaux and is designed in a traditional chalet style. The property features stone walls, wooden beams, and open fireplaces. Guests have access to two swimming pools, including an indoor pool and one with a view, alongside a comprehensive spa and wellness centre. Dining options include the Michelin-starred L'Ours restaurant and the more casual Bistrot des Ours, both overseen by chef Franck Reynaud. Accommodation ranges from double rooms to multi-bedroom suites, with many offering balconies and views of the mountains. The hotel provides free Wi-Fi and private parking for guests.

343350.description: Located at 5. 9 feet above sea level, Berghotel Trübsee offers mountain views and direct access to the slopes. It can only be reached by cable car with a valid ski pass. The Trübsee Hotel features a restaurant and a sun terrace with views on Lake Trübsee. There is also a sauna where guests can relax. Free Wi-Fi is available. The Berghotel provides several facilities for children, including a playroom and a snow fun park right in front of the hotel. The cable car ride between the hotel and Engelberg lasts only 20 minutes. Parking is available next to the cable car station.

343370.description: Indulge in a relaxing stay at our 38-room hotel in Leukerbad, Switzerland, just steps from Alpentherme Thermal Baths. Enjoy our full-service spa with massages, body treatments, and facials. Stay active with our indoor tennis courts, indoor pool, and hot springs. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, an arcade/game room, a 24-hour business center, and both express check-in and check-out. We also offer room service during limited hours, a restaurant, and a bar/lounge for your dining and relaxation needs. For events, we have 3 square meters of conference and meeting space. A complimentary shuttle operates within 150 meters of the hotel, and self-parking is available (subject to charges). Each guestroom features heated floors, a safe, a desk, and a phone.

343489.description:
The 4-star hotel is one of the most romantic hotels in the Lower Engadine in a 400-year-old Engadine house with an Engadine gourmet restaurant. The GuardaVal offers direct access to the Engadin Bad Scuol. 36 individually designed rooms invite you to a romantic stay. 
Engadine tradition, Alpine modernity, authentic cuisine and warm hospitality await you at the first boutique hotel in Lower Engadine. 36 individually designed, romantic rooms, an Engadine gourmet restaurant, the cosy fireplace bar and an in-house wellness area have been designed and furnished with great attention to detail. Add to this the fantastic view of the Lower Engadine mountains and the unique ambience of the 400-year-old Engadine house in the upper village centre of Scuol. Enjoy a fantastic holiday in one of the sunniest regions of Switzerland and discover one of the most beautiful corners in Graubünden.

343651.description: Situated in Longton the Crown and Anchor offers a no frills budget accomodation and is an ideal place to stay for business travellers with easy access to the M6, M1, A500 and A50 but with Alton Towers, Trentham Estates, The Potteries and Fenton Manor all close by is also a good location for leisure guests. For football fans the hotel is situated just a 5 minutes drive from the Brittania stadium, home of Stoke City Football Club. All of the bedrooms in this victorian building, which still boasts many of its original features, are located on the first and second floor and all come with ensuite bathrooms, TV with freeview and tea/coffee making facilities. Free Wi-Fi is available in public areas and guests can make use of free on-site parking. The hotel offers great value food served daily in its Sizzlers Steakhouse restaurant and bar. Breakfast is served daily with both cooked and lighter option available.

343656.description: Set in a historic building in the centre of Engelberg village, Hotel Schweizerhof offers views of the Urner Alps. This 3-star, non-smoking hotel provides a comfortable base for exploring the region. Guests can enjoy a meal in the on-site restaurant, which features a traditional Fonduestübli, or relax with a drink in the house bar. For relaxation, the hotel includes a sauna and a fitness room. Winter sports enthusiasts benefit from a free ski shuttle, ski storage facilities, and proximity to the slopes. The property also provides free Wi-Fi and on-site parking. Accommodation options include modern and soundproofed single rooms, double rooms, and family suites. The hotel is conveniently located a 2-minute walk from the Engelberg-Titlis Ski Resort and an 8-minute walk from Engelberg Monastery.

343723.description: The « Bains de Saillon » and its 4* hotel complex offers a unique thermal experience in the heart of the Valais, on the right bank of the Rhône river. Our hotel complex has 148 rooms with a breathtaking view of the Alps, themed restaurants, studios and apartments to rent and a free outdoor parking. Most of our terraces are south facing to make the most of the sunshine. Contemporary and comfortable, your stay will be most enjoyable. At the thermal centre, relax in our pools heated to 34°, a semi-Olympic pool at 28°, a thermal river at 34°, Mayens du Bien-Etre with sauna and hammam, a Carpe Diem Spa area. In summer, a slide, a pentaglide and a paddling pool for children will allow them to have fun!

343748.description: A total of 55 rooms are available for guests' convenience. Visitors can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the accomodation. Wellnesshotel Stoos does not operate a 24-hour reception. At this hotel, there are plenty of health and wellness services which guests can take advantage of.

343771.description: Located in the centre of Sörenberg village, this family-friendly hotel offers modern rooms just a five-minute walk from the local ski lift and cable car. Guests can enjoy meals at the on-site restaurant, Restaurant Bäckerstube, which serves homemade pizzas, and relax on the sun terrace with panoramic mountain views. Accommodation options include double rooms, family rooms, and apartments, some of which feature a balcony. All rooms are equipped with free Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV, and a hairdryer. The hotel provides complimentary parking, a ski room with a boot warmer, and is situated for easy access to local hiking and biking trails.

343971.description: Situated in the car-free village of Saas-Fee, this 3-star superior hotel offers a welcoming base for active holidays, with ski-to-door access at the foot of the slopes. Guests can relax in the wellness oasis, which features a whirlpool, a Finnish sauna, and a steam room. The hotel also provides a fitness centre with modern equipment and a games room with billiards and table tennis. Dining options include a lavish buffet breakfast and a four-course evening meal, while the on-site bar is an ideal spot for unwinding. All double rooms feature a balcony with views of the Mischabel mountain range. For convenience, the hotel is located near the Alpin Express cable car station and provides a ski room with private lockers and boot warmers for every guest.

344054.description: The total number of rooms is 30. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Les Sources des Alpes offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. This hotel features a choice of different health and wellness facilities ideal for visitors to recharge mentally and physically.

344112.description: Located in the center of Grindelwald, a 5-minute walk from Grindelwald Train Station, the sports center, and the First Cable Car, Hotel Hirschen offers free WiFi and a restaurant serving cheese fondue, raclette and tarte flambée. It also features a new spa area. Elegantly decorated with oak wood furniture, the rooms at Hotel Hirschen - Grindelwald feature a HD satellite TV, a USB plug, a safe, and a bathroom with hairdryer. Some have a balcony overlooking the mountains. Spa facilities on site include a Finnish sauna, a herbal sauna, an infrared cabin, and 2 foot massage basins. The sauna is available at an additional cost. Sleighs and mountain bikes can be rented at the Hirschen Hotel’s reception. Guests get reductions for the several activities in the Grindelwald's sports center. In winter, the ski bus stops right in front of the hotel.

344160.description: Located in the village center of Sedrun, Hotel La Cruna is only 1312 feet from the train station of the Matterhorn-Gotthard Railway Line. It offers a sauna, steam bath, and traditional restaurant. The historic restaurant En Ca’nossa, dating from 1796, is listed in the Guide Michelin and serves regional specialties and creative dishes with a Mediterranean or classic Swiss touch. A wide range of fine wines and grappas is also available. The modern rooms at the La Cruna Hotel are individually furnished and offer panoramic mountain views, satellite TV, and a bathroom. Free private parking is available on site. The hotel’s own free shuttle bus takes you directly to the Andermatt-Sedrun Ski Area.

344199.description: Situated in the centre of the village, Viktoria Eden is a 4-star hotel in the mountain resort of Adelboden. The property features a restaurant that serves a combination of Swiss and Asian specialities, and guests can also enjoy a drink at the on-site bar. For relaxation, the hotel includes a spa and wellness centre with a sauna and a steam room. The hotel provides family rooms and offers complimentary Wi-Fi access. Its central location places it just 50 metres from the village centre and within a five-minute walk of the Adelboden - Tschentenalp Gondola Lift.

344211.description: Enjoy garden views at Tschuggen, a hotel in the heart of Grindelwald, a short walk from the Indoor Rope Park and Oberer Gletscher. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel offers 15 guestrooms with flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Amenities also include desks, electric kettles, free self-parking, express check-in/check-out, and multilingual staff. Bussalp and the First Cable Car are conveniently located nearby.

344246.description: The Romantik Hotel Schweizerhof & Spa is a Belle Époque hotel with timeless charm, characterized by more than 110 years of tradition and surrounded by the beautiful mountains of the Swiss Alps and the forest of Flims Waldhaus. The stylishly furnished rooms offer a spectacular mountain view and are mostly equipped with a balcony. Look forward to a holistic mountain and forest spa over three floors with a natural stone pool, sauna, steam bath, water world, massage, meditation and yoga offers and the wonderful forest room. Elegant lounges, a restaurant, an Art Nouveau patio and 3 seminar rooms complete the hotel's facilities. Swimming in nearby Lake Cauma or hiking are just some of the various summer activities. In winter, one of Switzerland's largest ski areas with 146 mi of slopes awaits you. The hotel offers a free shuttle to the cable-car station.

344247.description: This modern apartment complex is set next to Plaza Europa Square and a 5-minute walk from the famous Salou's beaches. Guests who are looking for a fun day out with the whole family should consider the Port Aventura Theme Park, which is reachable within 10 minutes on foot. The nearest airport is Reus at 11km. Aside from its string of beaches interrupted by rocky coves, and its landscaped promenade, the resort town houses a number of charming restaurants and shops, and the property is just a 5-minute walk from the centre and the seafront Passeig de Jaume. The fully-furnished apartments come with convenient kitchenettes that are a great option for guests who enjoy cooking, there is also a dining area and all units open to balconies.

344497.description: Located in Leukerbad, Weisses Rössli provides express check-in and check-out, nonsmoking rooms, a bar, free WiFi and a shared lounge. Featuring a terrace and ski storage space, this property is located 164 feet from Walliser Alpentherme Thermal Bath and 656 feet from Leukerbad Thermal Bath. At Weisses Rössli, each room includes a seating area. A continental breakfast is available daily at the accommodations. A variety of popular activities are available in the area around Weisses Rössli, including skiing and cycling. Nearby points of interest include Erli Tellerlift, Gemmibahn and Gemmi. The property is 3. 7 mi from Torrentbahn and 6. 8 mi from Schwalbennest. Daubensee is 1. 1 mi from the hotel, while Rinderhalde is 1. 5 mi away. The nearest airport is Bern-Belp Airport, 68 mi from Weisses Rössli.

344515.description: Eurotel Victoria Les Diablerets features a total of 101 accomodation units. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Those who stay at this establishment can enjoy the convenience of 24-hour reception.

344574.description: Enjoy recreational opportunities such as bicycle rentals, a terrace, and a garden. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and a banquet hall. Dine at Restaurant Holiday, savoring regional cuisine with garden views and alfresco options. Snacks are available at the coffee shop/cafe, and you can unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel features a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Each of the 59 guestrooms features a flat-screen television with cable programming and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms include bathtubs or showers and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Located in Thun's Dürrenast neighborhood, Hotel Holiday is within a 5-minute walk of Lake Thun and the Culture and Convention Center Thun. It's 18 miles from Mystery Rooms and 0. 5 miles from Schadaupark. Nearby attractions include the Schadaupark (0. 5 mi), Thun-Panorama (0. 6 mi), and Thun Castle (1. 5 mi). The preferred airport is Bern (BRN-Belp), 16. 5 miles from the hotel. "Reception is open from 07:00 – 22:00. "

344724.description: The premises count with 37 welcoming rooms.

344731.description: Overlooking Neuchatel's rooftops or Lake Neuchatel, Hotel Alpes & Lac is opposite the main train station. It offers comfortable rooms and free Wi-Fi. The city of Bern is only a 36 minutes away by train; Lausanne can be reached in 48 minutes. Lake Neuchatel is within easy walking distance. Hotel Alpes & Lac features a restaurant with a rich buffet breakfast including local products. You can also enjoy your meal on the terrace with panoramic views.

344752.description: The Hôtel des Trois Rois is a modern 3-star hotel in the center of Le Locle in the Canton of Neuchâtel, a 5-minute walk from the bus and train stations. The rooms at the Trois Rois offer cable TV, a mini-bar, and a bathroom, and are all reachable by elevator. Limited private parking is featured on site, and is available at a surcharge and upon prior reservation. Additional public parking is possible in the surrounding areas, also for a charge. Le Locle is known as the birthplace of Swiss watch making and offers several museums and other attractions. Guests receive a pass for free, unlimited use of all busses and trains in the Canton of Neuchâtel during their stay.

344803.description: The Blümlisalp is a popular family-run hotel in a beautiful setting at the foothills of the Blümlisalp mountain in Kandersteg, right by the bus stop. Enjoy fine regional cuisine in the à-la-carte restaurant, relax on the sunny terrace, play bowling or billiards and unwind in the sauna after a rewarding day. An internet corner is available free of charge in the Blümlisalp hotel. Free access to Wi-Fi is available in the entire hotel.

344900.description: The Lamb Inn offers individually decorated guest rooms in the heart of Marlborough. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, digital programming, and coffee/tea makers. Start your day with a full breakfast, and dine at the on-site restaurant and bar/lounge. The inn is a short drive from attractions like The Merchant's House, Silbury Hill, and Kennet & Avon Canal. It's also conveniently located near Avebury Stone Circle and the Alexander Keiller Museum. Southampton Airport (SOU) is the preferred airport for accessing the property.

344938.description: The 46 welcoming guest rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. Those staying at this hotel may keep updated thanks to the Wi-Fi access. Clients may contact the reception desk any time during the day. Additionally, a car park is available on the premises for guests' extra convenience. Those who wish to disconnect from daily routine may make use of the property's health and wellness facilities. Some services of Bernerhof Swiss Quality Hotel may be payable.

344971.description: The Hotel Alpenhof offers ski-in/ski-out access in the heart of Grindelwald, placing you within a 5-minute walk of Bussalp and Oberer Gletscher. Enjoy complimentary wired and wireless internet access, a daily buffet breakfast, and on-site parking. The hotel features 17 guestrooms with private balconies or patios, minibars, flat-screen TVs, and private bathrooms. Relax in the sauna after a day on the slopes or enjoy a meal at the restaurant and drinks at the bar/lounge. Additional amenities include ski storage and tour/ticket assistance. Nearby attractions include the Gletscherschlucht, Sportzentrum Grindelwald, and the Grindelwald - Wengen Ski Area.

344987.description: Pamper yourself at our full-service spa. After a round of golf, enjoy ski-in/ski-out access and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, an arcade/game room, and ski storage. Enjoy a meal at Bodmi's restaurant, with a complimentary buffet breakfast served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Multilingual staff, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk are available for your convenience. Free self-parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of our 23 guestrooms featuring espresso makers and flat-screen televisions with cable programming. Rooms have private furnished balconies and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries. Located in Grindelwald, Bodmi is 7. 7 miles from Kleine Scheidegg and 9. 2 miles from Eiger. This golf hotel is within 20 miles of Trummelbach Falls and Mystery Rooms.

345214.description: This elegant hotel is located only a 15-minute drive from Lucerne and a 2-minute walk from the train station. It offers modern wellness facilities, free parking and a large terrace. Chargeable charging station for electric cars is available. Wellness facilities of the Hotel Krone Sarnen include a Caldarium, a sauna and a steam bath. The rest area offers panoramic views of the Landen mountain. All rooms are equipped with high-quality furniture, flat-screen TV and wooden floors. Modern cuisine made from market-fresh ingredients and selected Swiss wines can be enjoyed in the restaurant of the Hotel Krone Sarnen. The lounge bar is a stylish place to sip an aperitif, a digestif or an aromatic coffee.

345236.description: This small family hotel Belmont in chalet style is located only a 5-minute walk from the cable car station Titlis and 3 minutes' walk from the center of Engelberg. The ski bus stops in front of the hotel. You can choose from nicely furnished rooms and suites, all featuring a balcony and a flat-screen cable TV, a safe and a private bathroom including a hairdryer. The Belmont hotel features a spa area with sauna, steam-bath and a Kneipp basin. Some rooms and suites have a kitchenette. Wireless internet access is available in the entire hotel free of charge.

345249.description: With a total of 11 accomodation units, this is a nice place to stay. Those staying at this establishment may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas.

345276.description: This hotel offers a total of 53 rooms. Those staying at this establishment may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. Bellevue Parkhotel & Spa does not operate a 24-hour reception. Guests staying at this hotel can take advantage of the property's wellness facilities available.

345278.description:
Welcome to Typically Swiss Hotel Altana
Your gateway to the Engadine, yet to be discovered!
The good news: our hotel is conveniently located by the cable car, train station and buses, making it the perfect choice for business travelers and vacationers alike. 
The better news: you, our guests, receive the Engadin Scuol Mobil card for free use of mountain railways, post bus, Raethian Railway as well as local buses from arrival day to departure day. 
At the Altana you will find nature, well-being, and excellent food all at fair prices and provided with genuine hospitality in a friendly and warm atmosphere. 
Our hotel is located just 1 minute away from the train station (terminal station) and the bus stop and is just 3 minutes from the cable car which will bring you to an altitude of 2100m above sea level. 
Looking forward to wellcome you 
Family Adrian M. + Wirinthip Lehmann

345343.description:
Hotel Adula is a stylish 4-star superior hotel located in the heart of Flims, one of Switzerland’s most beautiful Alpine destinations. Surrounded by spectacular mountain scenery and close to the UNESCO World Heritage Site Sardona Tectonic Arena, the hotel is the perfect base for outdoor activities throughout the year, including hiking and biking in summer and skiing in the renowned Flims Laax ski area during winter. 

The comfortable rooms and suites combine Alpine charm with modern amenities, creating a welcoming atmosphere for relaxation. Guests can enjoy a variety of regional and international culinary experiences in the hotel’s restaurants and bars. 

A highlight of the property is its extensive wellness and spa area featuring an indoor pool, outdoor whirlpool, saunas, steam bath, fitness facilities, and a wide range of wellness and beauty treatments. 

Whether for an active holiday, a wellness retreat, or a family getaway, Hotel Adula offers genuine hospitality, relaxation, and authentic Alpine living in an exceptional setting. 
den region.

345355.description: Indulge in relaxation at the full-service spa, where massages and facials await. Enjoy recreational amenities including an outdoor pool, indoor pool, and sauna. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. A complimentary ski shuttle whisks you to the slopes. Savor Italian cuisine at La Cucina, one of the hotel's two restaurants, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Start your day with a complimentary full breakfast, served daily from 7:30 AM to 11:30 AM. Amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Free self-parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 45 guestrooms featuring espresso makers and flat-screen televisions with cable programming. Bathrooms include showers, hair dryers, and bathrobes. Conveniences such as phones, safes, and desks are also provided. Located in Vals, on a river, Hotel Rovanada is within a 15-minute drive of Ski Lift Vals - Gadenstatt and Hora. This family-friendly hotel is also a short drive from Zervreilasee Lake and Val Lumnezia.

345360.description: The Salina Maris hotel, nestled in the heart of the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Swiss Alps Jungfrau-Aletsch region, offers a 2, 625 sq ft spa with a sauna and indoor pool. Guests enjoy free WiFi and complimentary transfers to/from Mörel Train Station upon arrival and departure. Spacious rooms feature balconies or terraces. Lunch and dinner are served at the partner restaurant, Aletsch, located 2, 625 feet away in the village center, accessible via a free shuttle service. The spa area includes a sauna, steam bath, fitness room, and indoor pool, all free of charge, with complimentary bathrobes. Massages, cosmetology services, and physiotherapy are also available. Guided hiking tours are offered year-round, and a tennis court is on site. Situated in the center of the Aletsch region, Breiten is an ideal starting point for hiking in Upper Valais and skiing at the Aletsch Arena Ski Area. The nearest cable car is a 10-minute walk or a 3-minute drive from the hotel. Cross-country skiing is available in nearby Goms, and a free ski shuttle operates during the winter. Interlaken is a 2-hour drive away.

345403.description: This lovely hotel is located in Brig Valais. Ambassador features a total of 27 guests rooms. Enjoy wonderful moments with your family and friends where Brig is most beautiful! In the unique Art Deco atmosphere, you can expect excellent, Gault&Millau award-winning traditional French cuisine. Our individually designed rooms have their own style that will enchant you.

345459.description: Enjoy a satisfying meal at Leone Ristorante serving guests of Lion & Swan Hotel. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 3 bars/lounges. A complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast is served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 21 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms with showers are provided. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes, as well as phones with free local calls. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.
