This hotel is 11. 5 mi (18. 5 km) from Peak District National Park and 4. 1 mi (6. 5 km) from Brereton Heath Country Park.

345518.description: Comfortable Accommodations: Hotel La Tour d'Aï in Leysin offers family rooms with private bathrooms, mountain views, and modern amenities. Each room includes a work desk, TV, and wardrobe, ensuring a pleasant stay. Dining and Leisure: Guests can enjoy a terrace, restaurant, bar, and free WiFi. The family-friendly restaurant serves American and local cuisines in a traditional and modern ambience. Additional facilities include a coffee shop, child-friendly buffet, and bicycle parking. Activities and Location: Located 32 km from Montreux train station and 29 km from Chillon Castle, the hotel provides access to skiing, walking tours, and hiking. Nearby attractions include Alimentarium (40 km) and Rochers de Naye (48 km).

345571.description: With a small number of only 13, this establishment is very convenient for a quiet stay. Clients can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the accomodation. This hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night.

345577.description: Experience the Belle Époque charm of this Engelberg hotel, offering complimentary Wi-Fi, ski storage, and wedding services. Enjoy international cuisine at one of the two on-site restaurants, including 'Yucatan music|food|events, ' or relax with room service. Unwind at the coffee shop or one of the two bars/lounges, and savor the complimentary local cuisine breakfast. The hotel boasts a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. For events, there's a 6, 458-square-foot conference center. Self-parking is available (charges apply). The 73 guestrooms feature iPod docking stations, minibars, premium bedding, flat-screen TVs with cable, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads. Located near Ski School Active Snow Team Engelberg and Engelberg-Titlis Ski Resort.

345619.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and ski storage. Additional amenities at this hotel include tour/ticket assistance, complimentary use of a nearby fitness facility, and a banquet hall. Stop by the hotel's restaurant for lunch or dinner, or grab snacks at the coffee shop/cafe. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 9:30 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Stay in one of 30 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. Conveniences include safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. The nearest major airport is Bern (BRN-Belp) - 67. 2 km / 41. 7 mi With a stay at Hotel Edelweiss Superior in Lauterbrunnen, you'll be in the mountains, just a 2-minute walk from Alpine Sports Centre Mürren and 6 minutes by foot from Allmendhubelbahn. 345645.description: The hotel consists of 19 accomodation units. Moreover, there is a wireless Internet connection at hand in communal areas. There is no 24-hour reception. Additional fees may apply for some services.

345654.description: Hotel Oreneta is located 1312 feet from the old town of Altafulla, 6. 2 mi from Tarragona. It offers free Wi-Fi, and rooms with cable TV. All rooms at the Oreneta Hotel have air conditioning and heating. They also come with a private bathroom. The Oreneta has its own restaurant with an outdoor terrace where guests can eat during the summer months. The 16th-century Sant Martí Church is just 1312 feet away from the Oreneta, and the beach is 0. 9 mi away. The hotel is located 10 minutes' drive away from AP7, which links Barcelona and Valencia. There is free public parking nearby and private parking on site for an extra cost.

345695.description: Offering panoramic mountain views, the family-run Hotel Simmenhof is 0. 6 mi from the center of Lenk in the Simmen Valley. It features an à la carte restaurant serving regional cuisine, a spa area with indoor and outdoor pools, and a free shuttle to the ski slopes and the city center. All rooms at the Simmenhof have a balcony, free WiFi access, satellite TV, and a private bathroom. The spa area features a sauna, a tepidarium, and a massage shower. Guests can play billiards in the bar, and enjoy the mountain views on the large sun terrace. For children, an indoor playroom and an outdoor playground are available, and there is a horse ranch next door. Cyclists can use a bicycle storage room free of charge, and washing and repair facilities are also provided. Free private parking parking is available on site. The garage can be used at an additional cost. Guests also receive a SIMMENTAL CARD, which includes the free usage of all bus routes at Lenk (except the Laubbärgli route) and discounts on certain summer activities. During winter season, all bus routes at Lenk, including ski bus ‘Lenk station – valley station Betleberg – valley station Metsch’, can be used free of charge and guests can benefit from further discounts for certain winter activities.

345780.description: Positioned 3 minutes from junction 16 of the M6, the Holly Trees Hotel offers pristine, light and airy accommodations with superior quality beds. A perfect size to ensure individual service, guests can enjoy a comfortable residents’ lounge and sociable licensed bar. The hotel is ideally located for Crewe, Nantwich and Stoke-on-Trent, and has a spacious car park.

345875.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden at Hotel Krone Buochs. Dine in our restaurant and savor a complimentary continental breakfast served daily between 7:00 AM and 10:00 AM. We offer free Wi-Fi, cable TV, and private bathrooms with bathtubs and hair dryers in each of our 16 guestrooms. Additional conveniences include desks, separate sitting areas, and daily housekeeping. Free self-parking, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, laundry facilities, and an elevator are also available. Located in Buochs, we're a short drive from Beckenried - Klewenalp and Klewenalp Cable Car, and just 5 km from Stanserhorn Cable Car. Zurich Airport (ZRH) is 88. 2 km away.

346074.description: Located a short 50-meter stroll from the town center, Das Hotel Panorama offers easy access to numerous attractions and entertainment venues. Convenient transport links are just 100 meters away, allowing guests to explore the surrounding area with ease. The hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi in public areas and a 24-hour reception for added convenience. Parking is also available, though some services may incur a fee.

346082.description: Situated on a high plateau in Crans-Montana, Ad'Eldorado is a traditional, family-run hotel offering a cosy atmosphere. Guests can unwind in the comfortable lounge with its open fireplace or relax in the on-site sauna. The hotel features a restaurant that serves regional specialities and a bar with wines from its own cellar. In summer, meals can be enjoyed on the terrace, which provides views of the surrounding mountains. Accommodation options include single, double, and junior suite rooms, many of which feature mountain views. All rooms are equipped with Wi-Fi and a television. The property is located within an eight-minute walk of the ski lifts and the golf course, and the resort centre is a five-minute walk away.

346165.description: This family-run, 3-star hotel offers a cosy base in the heart of Leukerbad, positioned 200 metres from the village centre. The hotel has an on-site restaurant and a bar, with guests able to enjoy a buffet breakfast. A terrace and ski storage are also available. Accommodation options include standard, superior, and deluxe rooms, some of which feature a balcony. Every room is equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi and a private bathroom. The hotel is located within walking distance of local attractions, situated 500 metres from the Leukerbad Therme water park and 800 metres from the Gemmibahn cable car.

name.content: Garni Hotel des Alpes by Bruno Kernen

346189.description: Set in Schönried-Gstaad and only 1640 feet away from the slopes of the Gstaad Ski Area, the stylish Garni Hotel des Alpes Superieur is run by the family of the former Swiss downhill world champion. Free WiFi is provided. The rooms at Des Alpes Hotel Garni are decorated with high-quality natural materials such as wood and wool and feature a refined earthy color theme. Amenities include a flat-screen TV and a state-of-the-art bathroom. A buffet breakfast is served daily in an elegant room which is paneled with ancient wood. There is also a modern lounge with a bar. The restaurants in Schönried can be reached by car within 5 minutes. The cosmopolitan center of Gstaad is a 10-minute drive away. Free on-site parking is provided.

346382.description: The Cabana is a cozy, family-run hotel with modern facilities ideally located only 1312 ft from the train station and center. The quiet, south-facing rooms and studios offer breathtaking views of the Eiger and the valley of Grindelwald. Facilities include a garden with deck chairs, a playground, a sauna and a gym with ping pong table, a microwave and electro grill. WiFi and parking is available with charge. In the morning a rich breakfast buffet with a wide selection of local and regional products awaits you. Hotel Cabana’s guest card includes free admission to the indoor pool and the skating rink of Grindelwald’s Sports Center, as well as the free use of the ski bus in winter.

346426.description: This comfortable hotel is situated in Emmental.

346560.description:
With a stay at Chalet d'Adrien in Verbier, you'll be next to a golf course, steps from Four Valleys Ski Area and a 2-minute drive from Verbier Ski Resort.  This 5-star hotel is 31.9 mi (51.4 km) from Ovronnaz Thermal Baths and 0.5 mi (0.9 km) from Verbier Golf Club.
Pamper yourself with onsite massages, body treatments, and facials. A spa tub and a sauna offer a relaxing way to wind down after a day on the slopes. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and babysitting/childcare (surcharge). Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the complimentary area shuttle.
Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.
Enjoy Italian cuisine at La Table d'Adrien, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee.
Make yourself at home in one of the 29 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. 36-inch flat-screen televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

346688.description: Allegra and welcome to the Hotel Belvedere Scuol, the traditional yet innovative 4-star superior hotel in the Lower Engadine. Scuol, also known as Schuls, is harmoniously nestled between gorges and mountain meadows, right in the middle of which lies our hotel, which has been delighting its guests since 1876. The generosity of the traditional Swiss hotel industry at the turn of the century merges with modern design and comfort.

346690.description: Our rustic-style 3-star hotel with 12 rooms enjoys an beautiful, sunny and quiet location on the edge of the village, offering superb panoramic views of the surrounding mountains. Make use of our secure and covered parking and keep in contact with friends and family via the free internet access. The center of the village is reachable within a pleasant 15-minute walk and in winter the ski bus brings you to the train and cable car station for free. The bus station is reachable on foot in 4 minutes. In winter, please take bus stop Heimat, in summer please take bus stop Brunni. Those bus stops also are the correct ones coming from the train station. The hotel offers a child-friendly garden, wireless LAN in the rooms and a PC with free internet access provided for guests' convenience.

346860.description: The hotel comprises 32 cosy accomodation units. There is no 24-hour reception.

346870.description: The 3-star superior Hotel Restaurant Bellevue au Lac is situated directly on the shores of Lake Thun in Hilterfingen, near Thun. Built in 1918, this charming hotel offers modern, renovated rooms with free WiFi, a minibar, and a fan. The adjacent Stella del Lago annex provides budget-friendly accommodations with city or lake views, also equipped with a minibar and a fan. Guests can enjoy breakfast and international cuisine at the Bellevue au Lac Restaurant. The hotel's garden features a lounge area, a sunbathing lawn, and a bathing jetty. Located a short 6-minute drive from Thun and 20 minutes from Interlaken, the hotel is conveniently close to public transport, with a boat pier and bus stop just 656 feet away. Upon arrival, all guests receive the Panorama Card, offering free local bus travel and various discounts.

346875.description:
A stay at Swiss Lodge Hotel Bernerhof Wengen places you in the heart of Wengen, steps from Mannlichen Mountain and Grindelwald - Wengen Ski Area.  This ski hotel is 4.4 mi (7.1 km) from Kleine Scheidegg and 5.9 mi (9.4 km) from Eiger.
Spend the day on the slopes, or enjoy other recreational amenities, which include ski-in/ski-out access. This hotel also features wireless Internet access (surcharge), ski storage, and shopping on site.
Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, multilingual staff, and luggage storage.
Satisfy your appetite with local cuisine at Bernerhof Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee.
Make yourself at home in one of the 23 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily.

350963.description: Enjoy stunning garden views at Lupton Lodge, a charming guesthouse in rural Glenbervie. A complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10 AM. Amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, an arcade/game room, a picnic area, and barbecue grills. The onsite Lupton Lodge Dining Room offers delicious meals. Each of the three individually decorated guestrooms features an iPod docking station, DVD player, a 32-inch flat-screen TV with satellite programming, and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hair dryer. Lupton Lodge is a 5-minute drive from Whangarei Falls and 10 minutes from A. H. Reed Memorial Kauri Park.

351344.description: With a total of 3 rooms, this is a nice place to stay.

A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available upon request), and free self-parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 12 guestrooms, each featuring a kitchenette with a refrigerator and stovetop, a private furnished patio, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable TV. 351946.description: Enjoy breathtaking views from the terrace and garden of this Paihia motel. Take advantage of complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and barbecue grills. Airport shuttle service is available (surcharge). The 29 individually decorated guestrooms feature kitchenettes with refrigerators and microwaves, comfortable beds with Egyptian cotton sheets, and private balconies or patios. Digital programming and complimentary Wi-Fi are also provided. The motel is conveniently located within walking distance of Paihia Wharf and Paihia Beach, and a short drive from Waitangi Treaty Grounds.

352065.description: Ideally located in the prime touristic area of Paihia, Sanctuary Palms Apartments promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. Featuring a complete list of amenities, guests will find their stay at the property a comfortable one. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, car park, safety deposit boxes, shuttle service, smoking area are just some of the facilities on offer. Guestrooms are fitted with all the amenities you need for a good night's sleep. In some of the rooms, guests can find closet, cleaning products, complimentary tea, humidifier, dressing room. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. Convenience and comfort makes Sanctuary Palms Apartments the perfect choice for your stay in Bay of Islands.

352090.description: 'Enjoy a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool or unwind in the spa tub at the Woodlands Motel & Conference Venue in Kerikeri. Located within a 5-minute drive of the Bay of Islands and Skindynamique Waxing & Skin Centre, this motel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a communal living room, and tour/ticket assistance. Room service is available during limited hours. For business travelers, a business center, luggage storage, and laundry facilities are provided. The motel also features conference space and a meeting room, ideal for events. Each of the 20 guestrooms includes complimentary Wi-Fi, a safe, and a bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hair dryer. Daily housekeeping is provided. Nearby attractions include St. James Anglican Church and the Kerikeri Mission House. '

352148.description: ASURE Cherry Court Motor Lodge offers high quality motel accommodation centrally located for visitors to Whangarei City, Barge Park, North Tech and Whangarei Hospital. It is an ideal place for business and holiday.

352392.description: The Hananui Lodge is located right on Russell's waterfront with unobstructed sea views and the Hananui Apartments are situated on Russell's main road, only 100 metres away from the water's edge.

352507.description: The Anchorage Motel in Paihia offers waterfront accommodation just steps from Paihia Beach and a short walk from the wharf. This upscale motel features an outdoor pool, spa tub, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each of the 15 air-conditioned rooms includes a microwave and private balcony or patio. Guests can also enjoy concierge services, a picnic area, and laundry facilities. The motel is conveniently located near the Bay of Islands, St. Paul's Church, and is a short drive from Waitangi Treaty Grounds and Waitangi Golf Club. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge, and free self-parking is provided onsite.

352936.description: Enjoy garden views at Aarangi Tui Motel in Paihia, equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. This motel also offers a picnic area and barbecue grills. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available for a fee. Luggage storage, laundry facilities, and free self-parking are provided. 364339.description: Centrally located in Segur de Calafell on the Costa Dorada and within easy walking distance of the beach, entertainment venues and centre of town, this small, intimate hotel is also within a short drive from the cosmopolitan city of Barcelona, 45 km away. Boasting modern décor and comfortably furnished rooms, each with a balcony, guests can enjoy refreshing dips in the small, outdoor pool and chill-out until listening to music while enjoying a drink from the bar. A continental buffet breakfast with Torradas bread begins the day which can be followed by a relaxing morning coffee on the property's front terrace.

name.content: Four Points Flex by Sheraton Edinburgh

364462.description: Located in Edinburgh's thriving Georgian New Town, just minutes from the city's famous Princes Street, Four Points Flex by Sheraton Edinburgh is ideal for a convenient stay in the Scottish capital. It is easy to walk to some of the city's top attractions, restaurants, and shops, including Edinburgh Castle, The Royal Mile and the historic Old Town. The 116 contemporary rooms and suites have been designed with comfort and simplicity in mind, and range from cozy and efficient doubles to generous suites. Add the friendly hospitality of our thoughtful team, and you'll feel right at home.

364837.description: Strategically situated at the heart of Scotland, this hotel is just a short driving distance away from Glasgow city centre. The property is with a 45 minutes' drive from Edinburgh and Glasgow international airports. The historical, medieval city of Stirling is just a 15 minutes' drive away, where guest will find themselves immersed in the rich culture and history of the city. Guests are greeted with warm hospitality upon arrival. The guest rooms offer modern amenities and a comfortable setting in which to unwind. The restaurant serves a variety of traditional dishes, which are sure to tempt even the most discerning palate. This wonderful hotel is a prime choice for business and leisure travellers alike.

365209.description: This hotel enjoys a charming setting in London. The hotel is situated close to a wealth of attractions in the area. Guests will find themselves in the perfect setting from which to explore this exciting city. The hotel is located just a short distance away from the many prominent points of interest that the city has to offer, making this a great option for business and leisure travellers. A wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment venues can be found nearby. The guest rooms are superbly designed in a classical style. Guests are invited to avail of the many facilities and services that this wonderful hotel has to offer.

365274.description: In the heart of the south Dublin suburb of Ballsbridge, an affluent and leafy area, this Victorian property, fully renovated in 2014, is a luxurious all-suite hotel. It is ideal for both short city breaks and longer stays and is within walking distance of fine restaurants, traditional Irish pubs and cafes. The RDS (Royal Dublin Society), hosting some of Ireland's main concerts and sporting events, the Aviva stadium, rugby clubs and foreign embassies are in Ballsbridge which is close to Sandymount Beach and 2 km away from Dublin's city centre. The DART rail line is within a 5 minute walk and there are frequent bus services almost outside the property. Amenities include parking, Wi-Fi, lounge with complimentary tea & coffee and gym. The suites have fitted kitchens, sitting area and elegant bathrooms with luxurious toiletries. Due to the latest Government restrictions, we are beyond disappointed to confirm that from Dec 27th to January 31st, we can only accommodate those staying for essential, non-social and non-tourist purposes. The only exception to this is if you are already staying with us or have a booking due to arrive between now and 26th Dec inclusive. If you are due to arrive for a leisure stay from 27th Dec onwards, we would ask you to please rebook your stay via the website or travel agent you booked with. You can also email the PREMIER SUITES team directly. We look forward to welcoming our leisure guests back from January 12th when hopefully restrictions will be lifted. We would like to thank you for your continued support and wish you a safe and peaceful Christmas.

name.content: Hotel Bristol Relais du Silence Superior

365523.description: The 3-star superior Hotel Bristol Relais du Silence offers south-facing rooms in a quiet location in the heart of Adelboden, 328 feet from the Tschentenalp Ski Elevator. A spa area and free WiFi are available. The spa area includes a hot tub, steam bath, bio sauna, and direct access to the carefully tended garden. Guests of the Bristol Hotel can enjoy a drink at the bar or in front of the fireplace in the stylish lobby. The restaurant offers a relaxed ambiance for dining. Limited garage parking is available upon request and availability, and parking is also possible outdoors. Both come at an additional cost. Positioned above the church, Hotel Bristol is located just 164 feet from the bus station and 4 minutes’ walk from the station of the main area, Sillerenbühl. Just around the corner is the main shopping road where you can find souvenirs, ski rental, pubs and restaurants.

365527.description: A 5-minute walk from the train station and cable car, Hotel Kreuz Lenk enjoys a quiet location in the center of Lenk in the Bernese Oberland. A complimentary train station shuttle is provided. The hotel's bright, nonsmoking rooms are individually designed, and some offer accessible features. All rooms include a bathroom and satellite TV, while select rooms also feature a seating area. Guests can unwind after a day on the slopes in the hotel's sauna, solarium, or indoor pool. A playground is available for younger guests during the summer months, and bicycles are provided free of charge. Guests receive a SIMMENTAL CARD, which includes free use of all bus routes in Lenk, free train travel between Lenk, Zweisimmen, Gstaadt, and Saanen, and discounts on select summer and winter activities. During the winter season, all bus routes in Lenk, including the ski bus from Lenk station to Betleberg and Metsch valley stations, are free of charge, and guests can benefit from additional discounts on certain winter activities.

name.content: Hotel The Originals Boutique Hotel du Pillon

365531.description: Historic Hotel du Pillon offers panoramic views of the Diablerets Glacier and the Alps. Located on a south-facing slope, it features a large art collection and offers free WiFi, free private parking, and a big sunbathing terrace. Historic Hotel du Pillon is a 12-minute walk or 2-minute drive away from the village of Les Diablerets. Thanks to its location above the village, it enjoys 1 more hour of sunlight both in the morning and in the evening. The rooms all feature a balcony overlooking the mountains. The restaurant serves traditional Swiss cuisine, Vaudois specialties, and vegetarian dishes. The breakfast buffet is available until 11:00. Historic Hotel du Pillon is located above Les Bovets Station, the last stop of the mountain train before its terminus in Les Diablerets. From June to October, guests of Historic Hotel du Pillon receive a Free Access Card for selected activities.

365599.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Melody, a restaurant which specializes in British cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Treat yourself to a stay in one of the 35 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring heated floors. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Eventim Apollo - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Olympia Conference and Exhibition Centre - 0. 7 km / 0. 5 mi- Kensington High Street - 0.

365933.address: 17 Homestead Road, Kerikeri, Bay Of Islands 0230, 17
365933.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an outdoor pool or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This motel also features complimentary wireless internet access, tour/ticket assistance, and a picnic area. Featured amenities include luggage storage, laundry facilities, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 37 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and microwaves. Rooms have private furnished balconies or patios. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Skindynamique Waxing & Skin Centre - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Fairy Pools - 1. 4 km / 0. 9 mi- St James Anglican Church - 2 km / 1. 3 mi- Kerikeri Mission House - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi- Stone Store - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi- Wharepuke Falls - 2. 4 km / 1. 5 mi- Bay of Islands - 2. 4 km / 1. 5 mi- Kororipo Pa - 2. 4 km / 1. 5 mi- The Kauri Workshop - 2. 5 km / 1. 6 mi- The Old Packhouse Market - 2. 5 km / 1. 6 mi- Makana Confections - 2. 5 km / 1. 6 mi- Rewa’s Village - 2. 6 km / 1. 6 mi- The Parrot Place - 3. 2 km / 2 mi- Rainbow Falls - 3. 9 km / 2. 4 mi- Marsden Estate - 4. 2 km / 2. 6 mi. The preferred airport for Kerikeri Homestead Motel & Apartments is Kerikeri (KKE-Bay of Islands) - 6. 1 km / 3. 8 mi With a stay at Kerikeri Homestead Motel & Apartments in Kerikeri, you'll be within a 5-minute drive of Bay of Islands and Skindynamique Waxing & Skin Centre. This motel is 1. 3 mi (2. 1 km) from St James Anglican Church and 1. 3 mi (2. 1 km) from Kerikeri Mission House.

366039.description: Located right next to Ilkley Riverside Garden, Ilkley Riverside Hotel offers rooms with attached bathroom with views of the River Wharfe and Ilkley Moor. With free parking and WiFi, this Yorkshire inn serves award-winning real ales and a full restaurant menu. Each room has a flat-screen TV, desk and tea and coffee facilities. All rooms have an en suite shower with hairdryer. A range of satisfying meals are served in the restaurant, including steak, mushroom and Guinness pie, and large Yorkshire puddings filled with roast beef, vegetables and gravy. There is also a selection of sandwiches, pizzas and vegetarian dishes. In the summer, you can dine on the patio overlooking the river, or in winter enjoy the warming open fire in the hotel bar. Ilkley Riverside Hotel is around 10 minutes’ walk from the town’s attractive center, home to the Ilkley Toy Museum and the King’s Hall Theater. Scenic walks can be enjoyed on the Dales Way, which covers 84 miles from Ilkley to Bowness-on-Windermere in Cumbria.

366597.description: These serviced apartments offer elegant accommodations in central Edinburgh, a 5-minute walk from Princes Street. Enjoy easy access to nearby bars and restaurants, as well as Edinburgh Castle, a mere 10-minute walk away. The Edinburgh International Conference Centre is less than a 5-minute walk from the apartments, and Haymarket Rail Station is a short 7-minute walk. Each apartment features a comfortable, modern lounge area with sofas and a flat-screen TV. The fully equipped kitchens and living areas boast stylish wooden floors. The décor is simple yet elegant, and all apartments include a spacious, tiled shower room. Heating and Wi-Fi are standard. Depending on the size of the apartment you choose, amenities such as a dining table, dishwasher, and washing machine may also be available. These are included in the more spacious 1-bedroom superior and 2-bedroom apartments. Please note there is no on-site reception. Kindly contact us one week before arrival to arrange check-in. Our phone number is +44 131 510 7707, and our email is stay@edinburghsapartments. com. We are available Monday to Friday, 10 am to 5 pm. Guests arriving without prior arrangements will need to call an emergency out-of-hours phone number (listed on the building door) and may experience a delay in gaining access.

367768.description: Quality accommodation in an unbeatable central location less than a minute from Kings Cross and St Pancras railway stations. This is the ideal base from which to explore London or stay over before heading to Europe on the Eurostar. Tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the nearby streets, this hotel is housed in four attractive Georgian townhouses and offers 60 en-suite rooms ranging from small singles to extra-large family rooms with a double bed and four singles. Furnished in contemporary style, the rooms have a TV, safe and top quality bathroom amenities. Although there is no lift, a member of the helpful staff is always on duty at reception to give guests a hand with their luggage. There is a lounge bar and terrace where guests can relax, and the hotel also serves a delicious breakfast, just the thing to prepare guests for a busy day exploring the UK capital.

368346.description: Located 2 minutes' walk from Chester vibrant city Centre, the apartment offer townhouse, self-catering accommodation. The railway station is half a mile away and Chester Racecourse is 5 minutes' drive from the property. Each 3-bedroom apartment boasts a fully equipped kitchen, a dining and living area, 2 bathrooms. There is also a private roof terrace or enclosed courtyard for guests to relax with exclusive use of a hot tub per apartment. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout. A wide range of restaurants, shops, and bars can be found within 2 minutes' walk from the Apartments. Conveniently situated to explore the North-West of England, the apartments are 27 miles from Liverpool and 50 minutes' drive from Manchester. Free parking is included for 1 no. car per apartment. Additional permits can be purchased if required, subject to availability.

368577.description: Located in Vila-seca's historic center, near Portal de Sant Antoni, City Hall, and San Esteve Church, this charming hotel was once a manor house. The renovated building offers cozy accommodations across four floors, blending comfort and modern design. Natural light floods the interior through a glass roof opening. The reception and a work/reading area are on the ground floor. The third floor features a bar/cafe for breakfast and access to a relaxing terrace with loungers, perfect for sunbathing. Guests enjoy access to Hotel Palas Pineda and preferred rates on its services. The front desk can provide information on local activities and attractions.

369136.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as an indoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center. This Residence Inn by Marriott also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a picnic area, and barbecue grills. Guests can purchase snacks at the on-site grocery/convenience store. Start your weekdays with a complimentary full breakfast, served from 6:30 AM to 9:00 AM. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-in. Planning an event? The hotel offers 420 square feet of conference and meeting space. Free self-parking is available. Relax in one of the 100 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a kitchen, refrigerator, and oven. Enjoy complimentary wired and wireless internet access and a 37-inch LCD TV with satellite programming. A desk, microwave, and phone with free local calls add extra convenience. The hotel is located near Coral Ridge Mall (0. 4 mi), the University of Iowa (1. 4 mi), and Xtream Arena & GreenState Family Fieldhouse (3. 2 mi). The preferred airport is Eastern Iowa Airport (CID), 18. 1 miles away.

369430.description: This wonderful hotel is situated in the heart of London, ideally located for exploring the vibrant West End and Piccadilly Circus. The Prince of Wales Theatre is a mere 100 meters away, and Chinatown is just 200 meters from the hotel. Heathrow International Airport is conveniently located 37 km away. This stylish hotel offers elegantly appointed guest rooms and excellent service, ensuring a memorable stay in the heart of London.

369432.description: This hotel sits amidst the bustle and charm of the central London district of Victoria. The property is just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from Buckingham Palace and the train station. Victoria underground station is located nearby, offering ease of access to other areas of the city. Local theatres can be found close by. This hotel occupies a converted Victorian townhouse, oozing sophistication and classical elegance, with a blend of architectural styles. The guest rooms blend traditional and modern elements. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available onsite, for the convenience of business and leisure travellers.

369443.description: The hotel has everything you need for a couple of nights in town. Concentrated style, an out-of-town price, and a prime location. The hotel is a designer conversion of an Old Printworks, with 104 bedrooms arranged around a central lightwell over ground and five upper floors. The hotel is situated in the heart of the city centre right next to George Square. You step into your Z Room, and suddenly the price makes perfect sense. You're staying in the city, where space is at a premium. But you're not paying a premium. You're going to stay a couple of nights, revel in Glasgow, sleep in a sumptuous bed and wake in generously designed surroundings. So, for a true Urbanite, your Z room is carefully considered. With en suite wet room, crisp bed linen, 39” TV with a huge selection of channels, Wi-Fi

369445.description: This stylish property features a prime position in the first city to be awarded the European Capital of Culture, Liverpool. It is situated in the financial heart of the city, offering easy access to some of the most important tourist attractions, such as Old Hall Street. Other attractions not to be missed include Albert Dock, Pier Head, Mann Island and the Echo Arena. Combining modernity, design and stunning views, the comfortable accommodation units are the ideal place where to unwind at the end of the day. They are predominantly over the top three floors, featuring magnificent views over the surrounding urban landscape, and all come with a large choice of excellent services and amenities for guests to feel right at home. Accessible rooms are also available. The onsite facilities include a bar, ideal to enjoy a refreshing beverage while sharing nice moments with friends or the family.

369617.description: Located in London's vibrant Tower Hamlets district, the Travelodge London Bethnal Green is a 3-minute drive from Brick Lane and 5 minutes from Liverpool Street. This hotel is conveniently located near several iconic landmarks, including the Tower of London (3 km) and Tower Bridge (3. 3 km). The closest airport is London City Airport (LCY), while Heathrow Airport (LHR) is the preferred airport for the hotel.

369950.description: This charming property enjoys immediate access to the international Eurostar service, the National Rail and the London underground. Its convenient location makes it a great choice for business and leisure travellers alike. The British Museum and the Bloomsbury area are just a short walking distance away. The British Library and the University of London, as well as the famous Madame Tussauds, can be found in the area. This hotel blends effortlessly with its charming surroundings. Tastefully-designed guest rooms offer comfort and style, featuring modern furnishings and parquet floors. Guests can enjoy a wonderful breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to explore this captivating city. Customers must pay security deposit by cash or card of £100 on arrival. Deposit will be returned on check out. If paid by card it will be returned within 5 working days.

371099.address: Komp. Penuin center Blok OB No 1-7
371099.description: A complimentary airport shuttle takes guests to this elegant hotel, very popular among the business travellers visiting the larger Singapore area. The complimentary Wi-Fi Internet access, the business centre and meeting facilities, the close proximity to various corporate headquarters and the convenient laundry, dry cleaning and ironing services are also highly appreciated by the busy work guests. The spacious air-conditioned rooms offer all the necessary comforts, so one can truly relax after a long day. In the morning, guests can enjoy the complimentary breakfast in the common area or in their own suite.

371464.address: Komplek. Tanjung Pantun Blok F No. 7-8 Sei Jodoh
371464.description:
Kireinn Hotel is an ideal place for fun and relaxation. It is located in the Nagoya area of Batam Island. Set 12.3 km from the excitement of the city, this 2-star hotel commands an excellent location and provides access to the city's biggest attractions. This modern hotel is in the vicinity of popular city attractions such as Ferry Terminal.

Kireinn offers impeccable service and all the essential amenities to invigorate travelers. Room service, car hire, elevator, 24-hour front desk, smoking area are just a few of the facilities that set Kireinn apart from other hotels in the city.

Guests can choose from 55 rooms, all of which exude an atmosphere of total peace and harmony. The hotel offers many unique recreational opportunities such as massage. Whatever your reason for visiting Batam Island, the Kireinn is the perfect venue for an exhilarating and exciting break away.

373303.description:
This property is located just 8 km away from central London. Situated at the heart of a peaceful neighbourhood, the complex lies just a short walking distance away from shopping opportunities, entertainment venues and offices. Ideal for business and leisure travellers alike, this property offers comfortable, fully-furnished accommodation options. The apartments offer a stylish home away from home, and come well equipped with modern amenities, providing everything that guests will need for a comfortable stay. This property has been designed to meet the lifestyle needs of every type of traveller visiting the area.
Due to Coronavirus (COVID-19), this property does not currently accept visitors.

373913.description: The Concierge Plaza San Rafael, a charming hotel nestled in the tranquil town of Cuyutlán, Colima, offers a relaxing getaway just steps from the beach. Known for its breathtaking Green Wave phenomenon from May to June, Cuyutlán boasts a wide, inviting shoreline. Explore the nearby Estero Palo Verde Ecological Reserve and 'El Tortugario' turtle sanctuary, both less than 800 meters away, or discover the unique Salt Museum, less than 500 meters from the hotel. Savor fresh seafood at local restaurants and unwind back at the hotel with its outdoor pool, garden area, and multipurpose palapa. Enjoy free Wi-Fi access in the main area. Comfortable rooms provide all necessary amenities for a restful stay after a day of exploring. Select rooms offer stunning ocean views and air conditioning.

376664.description: The hotel has 62 rooms and suites, all with luxurious bathrooms. Decorated in a contemporary, Valais-inspired style, they offer optimum comfort. The hotel also boasts a restaurant serving traditional and international cuisine, as well as a piano bar. In the heart of the Valais, land of the bisses (traditional irrigation canals) and authentic culture, the hotel offers a unique experience combining sport, fitness and relaxation. Before or after your meal, enjoy a moment of relaxation in the adjoining piano bar, which also has a smoking area for cigar aficionados.

378298.address: Shaw Ridge Leisure Park, Whitehill Way
378298.description:
Village Hotel Swindon is located in the middle of the North Wessex Downs and the Cotswolds and can be easily reached via the M4 at Junction 16 and A41.  Swindon train station is just 3 miles away making the hotel a perfect base for exploring Wiltshire and the surrounding areas.  Swindon has great shopping too including the popular Swindon Designer Outlet. 

 The hotel has everything you'd need under one roof including stylish bedrooms with big cosy beds, huge TVs and great showers, pool and state-of-the-art gym with all the latest tech and Village Pub and Grill where you can tuck into delicious food and drink. 

 Access to Leisure facilities is charged at £5 per day per room. Club Room guests receive access free. Parking is free.

378304.description: University Arms, Cambridge, offers 192 rooms and suites, with views over Parker’s Piece, historic Regent Street, and the hotel’s inner courtyard. Conveniently situated in the Cambridge City Centre district, this hotel is situated 300 metres from Museum of Archaeology and Anthropology. Guests can have a cocktail at the bar, or brasserie, Parker's Tavern. All the rooms are fitted with a flat-screen TV and have a private bathroom. Some rooms have a balcony. The daily breakfast offers continental, buffet or à la carte options. At the accommodation guests are welcome to take advantage of a fitness room. Staff at the 24-hour front desk can provide advice on what to do in the area. Cambridge Corn Exchange is 500 metres from University Arms, Autograph Collection, while St Catharine's College is a 6-minute walk away. The nearest airport is London Stansted Airport, 43 km from the property.

378307.description:
Village Leeds North is in the suburb of Headingley, 5 miles from Leeds city centre. The hotel is conveniently located near the A6120, around the corner from Headingley Stadium and the Beckett Park campus of Leeds Beckett University.   Leeds Train Station is 3 miles away and Leeds-Bradford Airport 15 miles.

Liverpool has a vibrant arts scene, legendary football clubs, fantastic shopping and fascinating maritime history. Village Hotel Coventry is 10 minutes from Coventry city centre, 20 minutes from Ricoh Arena.  There is easy access to the M42, M6, M5 and M40. Birmingham International Airport is 10 miles away and Coventry Train Station 2 miles.  Coventry is a fascinating city, at the heart of the Midlands, close to Leicester and the historic towns of Worcester, Leamington Spa and Stratford upon Avon. The hotel has everything you'd need; new look, fully refurbished bedrooms with big cosy beds, huge TVs, great showers, pool and state-of-the-art gym with all the latest tech. 378322.description: The establishment comprises a total of 92 snug rooms. There is Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. The Great Barr Hotel provides 24-hour reception. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

378328.description: Enjoy garden views from the terrace at this Victorian hotel, which offers complimentary Wi-Fi, wedding services, and tour/ticket assistance. A complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast is served daily. The on-site Brasserie features a bar/lounge and room service is available during limited hours. The hotel also provides a business center, multilingual staff, conference facilities, and free self-parking. Each of the 25 guestrooms includes a flat-screen television with digital programming, a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries, and conveniences such as a coffee/tea maker and a desk. Located near St Mary's Church, the hotel is also a short drive from Nungate Bridge and Lennoxlove Historic House. Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is the preferred airport.

name.content: Carden Park Hotel, Golf Resort and Spa

378355.description: Set within 1000 acres of Cheshire countryside, Carden Park Hotel, Golf Resort and Spa features a modern spa, 2 championship golf courses and luxury rooms with scenic views. Just 20 minutes’ drive from Chester, there is free parking and free Wi-Fi. The elegant rooms offer private bathrooms with free toiletries and showers. Rooms also feature plasma-screen TVs with Sky channels and tea and coffee facilities. The Spa at Carden features one of the UK's largest spa gardens, with hot tubs, a panoramic sauna and an outdoor pool. This facility is bookable as a separate experience to your stay at Carden Park and also contains a restaurant, treatment rooms and an extensive indoor thermal suite. In a 17th-century estate, Carden Park Hotel, Golf Resort and Spa has a fitness center with a swimming pool, gym, and treatment rooms. The Vines offers a gourmet dining experience featuring the very finest, fresh and locally sourced ingredients. In Redmond's you can expect a friendly and relaxed atmosphere in our brasserie-style restaurant. Morgan’s Bar serves afternoon teas, lunch and evening drinks. There is also Jack's Bar with great views over the golf course. Carden Park Hotel, Golf Resort & Spa is surrounded by beautiful countryside, and has a private vineyard. Just a 20-minute drive from Wrexham, the Welsh Border is 5 minutes away. Golf facilities at Carden Park are among some of the best in the North of England, along with the two highly-regarded championship courses there is a clubhouse with bar, driving range and PGA golf academy featuring an advanced custom fitting studio.

378356.description:
Village Hotel Chester St Davids is situated just off the M56 and a 15-minute drive from the centre of Chester.   Deeside Industrial Park and Chester Business Park are within 5 miles and Hawarden Train Station is 1 mile away.   The famous zoo is reason enough to visit the city, plus the scenic beauty of North Wales and the bustling city of Liverpool are both right on your doorstep. The hotel has everything you'd need; new look, fully refurbished bedrooms with big cosy beds, huge TVs, great showers, pool and state-of-the-art gym with all the latest tech. Village Pub and Grill with delicious food and drink. 

Access to Leisure facilities charges £5 per day per room. Club Room guests receive access free.

Travellers can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the property. The front desk offers 24-hour reception.

Everyone staying at this accommodation can enjoy the convenience of 24-hour reception. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

378417.description: An enchanting Cotswold retreat in the picturesque town of Burford, few could resist the rustic charm of this 16th century residence, whether it is for a leisure break, business trip or special occasion. Bay Tree won Small Hotel of the Year at the National Enjoy England Excellence Awards 2011. The hotel also has a Gold Award for Excellence from Enjoy England. The Bay Tree is steeped in history and awash with character, from the foundations of its mellow stone walls - clad with pinkish-purple wisteria blooms - to its wooden beam rafters. Oak-panelled public rooms, bare stone walls and original stone fireplaces, including an inglenook fireplace, provide a textured canvas upon which rich fabrics, woven tapestries and antiques have been laid down with exquisite flair. For your relaxation, you can select a good book from the hotel library, sink back into a comfortable chair and allow the stresses of everyday life to gradually seep away. In the summer months, the tranquillity of the walled gardens make for a relaxing haven where you can enjoy a refreshing drink on a warm evening.

Golf enthusiasts can enjoy the resort's 9-hole and 18-hole courses amidst ancient Caledonian pines, along the river bank, and against a stunning mountain backdrop. The resort offers a variety of self-catering accommodations, providing the freedom and flexibility you desire. Each unit, regardless of size, includes a fully equipped kitchen with a fridge-freezer, oven, and microwave. Spey Valley Resort is also pet-friendly, so your four-legged companions are welcome to join you and enjoy the extensive grounds and local walks.

This premier Scottish wedding and conference venue offers a traditional setting with elegant furnishings and decor, complementing the grandeur of the house and its expansive gardens. The hotel boasts ample car parking and provides dedicated wedding/event managers and a master of ceremonies. Whether you envision your ceremony indoors or within the romantic Secret Garden (suitable for up to 180 guests), Dalmeny Park provides a picturesque backdrop for your special day. 378659.description:
Surrounded by the cool bars, live music venues and designer boutiques of Aberdeen's Merchant Quarter, Carmelite Hotel matches the individual style and sophistication of its fashionable neighbours. 

This historic 19th-century building, creatively refurbished to bring it bang up to date, is full of character – with vintage coffee pots, Jenga blocks and a four-poster-bed dining table among its curiosities. 

The hotel is in the heart of Aberdeen, within walking distance of many of the city's attractions including Aberdeen Maritime Museum and Union Square shopping centre. We're just a 2-minute stroll from the railway and bus stations, as well as being close to Aberdeen Harbour and the ferry terminal. So, whether you're here for a sightseeing trip or a business meeting, we're in a great spot for getting around the city. 

Relax in our plush open-plan restaurant, bar and lounge area with a cheerful cocktail or a bite to eat from one of our many menus that showcase locally-sourced food. 

Our 52 guest rooms provide something for every occasion and budget. The third-floor standard rooms offer simplicity and everyday home comforts, while the designer rooms and suites on the first and second floors offer a step up in luxury. They come with super-king-size beds, extravagant baths, large smart TVs and complimentary snacks. Each suite has its own style – one has a circular bed and cherub ceiling painting, while another has a foosball table and huge corner bath.

383455.description: Our Birmingham Central Newhall Street hotel is a short walk from the center of Birmingham, Britain's second-largest city. Once an industrial hub, Birmingham is home to a bustling creative district on the site of an old custard factory and the iconic Selfridges center, part of the Bull Ring. You can learn more about the city's past at the vibrant Jewellery Quarter, with its museum telling the story of the artisans who once plied their trade here, or indulge yourself in the restaurants of the world-famous Balti Triangle. All rooms feature a comfortable king-size bed with four plump pillows and a cozy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serve breakfast and tasty evening meals. Useful Information: Due to the city center location of this hotel, some external noise may be heard.

383456.description: 'Our Birmingham Sheldon hotel is a top choice for visiting the area's sights and attractions. See some amazing vintage trains at the Tyseley Locomotive Works or admire the world's largest collection of British two-wheelers at the National Motorcycle Museum. Birmingham is just a short car journey away, where you'll find the National Sea Life Centre, Cadbury World and the Thinktank science centre. And for something special, head to the Baddesley Clinton manor, a 500-year-old house with its own moat. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a variety of food and drink choices within walking distance from this hotel. Useful informationPlease note there is no lift at this hotel. Situated in the heart of Baix Camp, the hotel is 10 km from Tarragona and within easy reach of attractions like the Tarraco archaeological site, the Costa Daurada's beaches, Salou's vibrant entertainment district, and Port Aventura theme park. 387386.description: Aloft Liverpool is just a few metres from the Moorfields Railway Station and half a mile from Liverpool Lime Street Station. 389340.description: The Holiday Inn Cardiff - North M4, Jct. 32 is conveniently located just off the M4 motorway, a 10-minute drive from Cardiff city centre. Free Wi-Fi and parking are also available.

390320.description: Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. 390868.description: Dream Apartments have been finished to the highest standard, with all the modern conveniences to ensure you have a delightful stay, including free Wi-Fi, Smart TV's and spacious living and dining areas. An energetic city, with a hip, youthful vibe, Belfast features splendid architecture, world-class culinary choices and a booming arts and music scene. Whether you are in this historic city for business, studies or a vacation with family and friends, Belfast's many ‘Quarters' (neighbourhoods) will charm you with their unique style and character. What could make your stay even more exceptional is the choice of over 100 spacious serviced apartments offered by Dream Apartments.

393165.description: Book a Bed Hostel is a budget-friendly hostel for travelers and backpackers in London. Our bright, fun, and recently refurbished space welcomes visitors from all over the world, located above The Royal Standard pub. All dormitories include free Wi-Fi, in-room lockers, and fresh linens. The hostel is conveniently located a short train ride from London Bridge in central London, 20 minutes from the Olympic Stadium in Stratford, and within walking distance of the Greenwich Mean Time and Meridian Line. Situated in West Greenwich, Book a Bed Hostel is close to three stations: Deptford Bridge (DLR), Deptford (National Rail), and New Cross (Overground), offering easy access to central London and attractions like the Royal Observatory, Cutty Sark, the Emirates Air Line, and the O2 Arena. We strive to ensure a great stay in a clean, comfortable, and safe environment. Book a Bed Hostel offers a unique and memorable London experience.

394145.description: Enjoy amenities like a 24-hour fitness center and terrace with city views. The hotel is located near Cromwell Road, just a short distance from Kensington High Street and the Olympia Conference and Exhibition Centre.

395490.description: These bright and stylish apartments feature modern kitchens and free WiFi, and are located a 15-minute walk from London Bridge station and the South Bank. All kitchens at Residence Inn by Marriott London Bridge are fully equipped with kitchen utensils, an oven and hob and a microwave for cooking. A dishwasher, refrigerator, and washing machine are also included. Living areas provide flat-screen TVs and modern wood flooring. Guests can relax with comfortable sofas and a dining area with a table and chairs. Bermondsey Street with its chic shops and galleries is 5 minutes away on foot. The fashionable South Bank area, with the Tate Modern Gallery, is a 25-minute walk.

Guests also have use of a modern kitchen for self-catering. Seven Sisters has direct links to King’s Cross/ St Pancras and Oxford Circus on the Victoria Line, both less than 15 minutes away. 399099.description: The Mercure Edinburgh Haymarket hotel is ideally located in the heart of Edinburgh, making it the perfect base for guests looking to explore this historic city. With easy access to the Edinburgh International Conference Centre (EICC) and Haymarket train station, the hotel is ideal for guests looking for style and convenience.

399299.description: Located in the heart of Aberdeen, just 5 minutes' walk from the City Centre and Aberdeen train station. The hotel has an unrivalled location in Aberdeen's leafy suburbs yet is only a short walk from Union Street, Aberdeen's shopping district. 402743.description: The Chedi Andermatt will captivate and move you. With its authenticity, the unusual liaison of Alpine chic and Asian expression. 403060.description: Holiday Inn Express London – ExCeL, conveniently located in the heart of East London, is perfectly suited for business or leisure stays. The hotel also boasts excellent transport links to Canary Wharf, the O2 arena and central London attractions. This stunning property boasts 204 bedrooms and three meeting rooms. The hotel is also within easy reach of both Westfield Shopping Centre and the Olympic Park at Stratford, in addition to the O2 arena at North Greenwich only a short distance away by train. For families, our Family room is ideal and consists of Double & Sofa bed allowing up to 2 Adults & 2 Children (under 12 years) to stay. Our Accessible Double rooms for perfect for guests requiring Wheelchair or step free access.

403423.description: Enjoy Dublin from The Dean Dublin Centre, located in the heart of the city, just a short walk from Grafton Street and St. Stephen's Green. 404338.description: Centred in the Jewellery Quarter, we’re near Snow Hill Station. Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery is less than a mile away and the Utilita Arena is just a seven-minute drive. The city centre’s shops, bars, and restaurants are within minutes and the NEC is only 13 miles from us. Enjoy our fitness centre, Wi-Fi and free breakfast to help fuel your day.

404481.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay and a convenient location at Hampton by Hilton Newcastle. The relaxed Hub bar/lounge area is open 24/7 and is the perfect place to enjoy a coffee, light meal or drink. 407649.description: Located just steps from the North Terminal check-in desks and a few minutes from the South Terminal via monorail, this hotel offers easy access to London, Brighton, and the South East, as well as nearby business hubs and attractions, including Crawley, East Grinstead, Redhill, Reigate, and Burgess Hill. 408930.description: In a quiet position high on the hill overlooking Paihia and the ocean, Allegra House is a wonderful place to stay in the heart of the Bay of Islands. It is only a five minute walk downhill in to the town, and it is also close to the passenger ferry across the historic town of Russell. The guest suites all have modern stylish furnishings, sunny seating areas and they all share a common lounge on the first floor. The top floor suites have an ensuite bathroom with shower, and a super king bed, whilst the island suite has a queen bed and an ensuite shower room. The self-contained apartment is spacious and light, and comprises of a king bedroom, bathroom, kitchen and dining area. The whole property faces the ocean, and all rooms open on to the decks, taking in the views and leading down to the gardens. Continental breakfast is included, and served in the first-floor dining area.

408944.description: Arcadia Lodge is a Bay of Islands landmark, a historic house dating from c1902. It sits in a magnificent position looking out over Russell's tranquil Matauwhi Bay so enjoys stunning water views. We have five rooms. Three spacious suites downstairs with private decks and magnificent views of the bay while upstairs are two more rooms, one with water views and one without. One of the downstairs can accommodate to four people by arrangement. The lodge has free car parking and is a short easy stroll to the village's restaurants, cafes, beaches and wharf.

408954.description: Relax and enjoy the recreational amenities at Averill Court Motel, including an outdoor pool and spa tub. Luggage storage, laundry facilities, and a safe deposit box at the front desk are also available. Free self-parking is available onsite. The 18 guestrooms feature kitchens equipped with full-sized refrigerators/freezers and microwaves. Cable programming and complimentary Wi-Fi are provided for your entertainment and convenience. Coffee/tea makers and daily housekeeping are also included. Averill Court Motel is located in the heart of Paihia, mere steps from the Bay of Islands and Paihia Beach. St. Paul's Church is just 0. 2 miles away, and Paihia Wharf is 0. 5 miles from the property. The nearest airports are Kerikeri Airport (KKE) and Auckland International Airport (AKL).

408966.description: Bellrock Lodge is on the hill overlooking the historic village of Russell in Bay of Islands, New Zealand. Just 450 metres from the waterfront, Bellrock Lodge offers studios with a private balcony and lovely bay and town views. Bellrock Lodge is 5 minutes walk from the town centre, which offers a variety of restaurants, cafes and pubs. It is 15 minutes walk from Flagstaff Hill Historic Reserve. Paihia is a 40-minute drive and Kerikeri Airport is 30km away.

The hotel is conveniently located near Bay of Islands Marina and Makana Chocolate Boutique, making it an ideal base for exploring the region.

409011.description: Cliff Edge by the Sea is situated at Port Opua, the Bay of Islands main Harbour and Marina, only 5 minutes from Paihia, and 10 minutes from Russell. Sitting on top of a promontory above Veronica Channel, the lodge is surrounded by a native bush reserve - and with no immediate neighbours house guests are assured total privacy. Cliff Edge by the Sea provides a unique accommodation experience in the Bay of Islands, combining the warmth and comfort of a private residence with the sophistication of a boutique hotel. The unparalleled water views from virtually every room are magnificent.

Wired and wireless Internet access is complimentary, while 32-inch flat-screen televisions with digital programming provide entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers.

409058.description: The Duke of Marlborough Hotel, a luxurious colonial waterfront hotel in Russell, offers stunning views of the Bay of Islands. Enjoy amenities such as a fitness center, a beachfront restaurant with alfresco dining, and 2 meeting rooms. The 38 guestrooms feature modern conveniences, including refrigerators, iPod docking stations, and plasma televisions. Free Wi-Fi and parking are available. Steps from Russell Beach and a short walk from the Russell Museum, this hotel is perfectly located for exploring the area.

409149.description: Sophisticated and elegant, Rosewood Kauri Cliffs has panoramic views across the Pacific Ocean. Tastefully designed by Virginia Fisher, the lodge is timelessly beautiful, offering space, comfort, and complete relaxation amidst the homeliness of soft furnishings, warm carpets, and blonde woods. Resting on an unspoilt coastline where high cliffs give way to three pristine private beaches, Kauri Cliffs is experiential travel at its best. Named the number one resort in Australia and New Zealand by *Travel + Leisure*, Kauri Cliffs is a leisure traveler’s dream. Activities abound with the David Harman–designed golf course, immersive local heritage tours, bountiful fishing, bush walks, mountain biking, quad biking, and a spa sanctuary hidden within the native forest. Accommodation is offered in 22 suites set in outlying cottages separate from the main lodge, as well as a two-bedroom Owner's Cottage. Each suite has its own private balcony, bedroom with sitting area and open fireplace, walk-in wardrobe, and bathroom. The cottages are nestled in native forest overlooking the golf course and the Pacific Ocean. Kauri Cliffs is a member of Relais & Châteaux and is a sister property to Cape Kidnappers and Matakauri Lodge.

name.content: Distinction Whangarei Hotels and Conference Centre

409155.description: Stop at Distinction Whangarei Hotels and Conference Centre to discover the wonders of Whangarei. Both business travelers and tourists can enjoy the hotel's facilities and services. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, restaurant, dry cleaning, coffee shop are just some of the facilities on offer. Television LCD/plasma screen, linens, towels, smoke detector, internet access – wireless can be found in selected guestrooms. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. A welcoming atmosphere and excellent service are what you can expect during your stay at Distinction Whangarei Hotels and Conference Centre.

409222.description: Opononi Hotel is a popular choice amongst travelers in Opononi, whether exploring or just passing through. Featuring a complete list of amenities, guests will find their stay at the property a comfortable one. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, casino, express check-in/check-out, luggage storage, Wi-Fi in public areas are just some of the facilities on offer. Television LCD/plasma screen, internet access – wireless, internet access – wireless (complimentary), non smoking rooms, air conditioning can be found in selected guestrooms. The hotel's peaceful atmosphere extends to its recreational facilities which include billiards, garden, games room. A welcoming atmosphere and excellent service are what you can expect during your stay at Opononi Hotel.

409278.description: Enhance your well-being at the Choice-branded Quality Hotel Oceans in stunning Tutukaka. We've implemented improved cleanliness protocols and products for your peace of mind. Overlooking the Tutukaka Marina, with Poor Knights Island a short cruise away, our hotel offers incredible access to scenic walks on Tutukaka Headland, Tane Moana, and pristine beaches. Enjoy amenities such as a heated outdoor pool, a BBQ area, and an in-house restaurant. A professional gym is also within walking distance. Guest rooms feature refrigerators, tea & coffee making facilities, flat-screen TVs, hair dryers, and irons with ironing boards. Children 12 and under stay free with parents/guardians using existing bedding. Book your value-packed stay at the Quality Hotel Oceans Tutukaka today!

name.content: Ramada Resort by Wyndham Reia Taipa Beach

409342.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and an outdoor tennis court. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and a picnic area. Enjoy local cuisine at Baywatch Restaurant, a beachfront restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge, take in the ocean view, and even dine alfresco. You can also stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Featured amenities include express check-out, laundry facilities, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Planning an event in Taipa? This hotel has facilities measuring 1808 square feet (168 square meters), including conference space. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 29 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Rooms have private patios.

411219.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Complimentary Evening Social, Fitness Center, On-site Restaurant(s), Pool, Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Concierge, Executive Lounge, Valet Parking. Featuring a stunning industrial design of bronzed metal, glass and layered brick, Hilton London Bankside places guests near trendy South Bank, Tate Modern and Borough Market. This new hotel is a short walk to Bankside, home of foodie festivals, popular bars and restaurants, and street artists. Attend a play at National Theatre, visit The Shard for spectacular city views, and stroll to Tower Bridge to watch the London Marathon. This unique split-level hotel offers an ideal vantage for New Year's Eve fireworks and River Thames events. Corporate visitors will appreciate the quick walk to the Financial District. Relax in a guest room detailed with contemporary furnishings and original artwork. For your comfort, all guest rooms feature air-conditioning, complimentary WiFi, interactive LCD TVs and a work desk with ample outlets. Upgrade to an executive room for access to the tranquil Executive Lounge, including refreshments and business services. Enjoy steaks and seafood with an innovative twist at OXBO Bankside, perfect for power lunches and after-work dinners. Unwind with a cocktail and light bites in The Distillery, a nod to the hotel building's heritage. Maintain your exercise routine with the heated fitness pool and fully equipped fitness center. With 1, 000 sq. meters of event space, this Bankside hotel is ideal for conferences and celebrations of up to 750 guests. Lead a seminar in one of eight meeting rooms, or treat wedding guests to dancing and catered dining in an elegant Ballroom.

411304.description: Avalon Resort is on a peaceful 7 acre property within walking distance of Kerikeri centre. It is situated in a little valley with native plants, streams, small lakes, waterfalls and wide views over the neighbouring golf course. Avalon Resort has four self-contained luxury cottages and an apartment. The cottages are well spaced offering plenty of privacy.

411315.description: Practice your swing on the golf course or soak up the sunshine on the private beach. This Colonial hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, an arcade/game room, and wedding services. Grab a bite to eat at the Carrington Restaurant, a restaurant where you can take in the garden view, or stay in and take advantage of room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and luggage storage. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and a meeting room. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 23 air-conditioned guestrooms. Rooms have private balconies. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.
