411579.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional features at this hotel include wedding services, a fireplace in the lobby, and a ballroom. At Weston Manor Hotel, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. This hotel has 2 meeting rooms available for events. Free self parking is available onsite. Treat yourself to a stay in one of the 29 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring heated floors and LED televisions. Your Tempur-Pedic bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Conveniences include phones, as well as complimentary bottled water and portable fans.

413084.description: Overlooking the iconic Wembley Stadium and set next to the historic Wembley Arena, this stylish and modern hotel is just 15 minutes from the city centre and 40 minutes’ drive from London Heathrow Airport. The hotel is also located adjacent to the London Designer Outlet, great for shopping and eating out. Check in to your bright and airy guest room and relax while watching a movie on the LCD TVs. Rooms also feature private bathrooms with free toiletries, desks, coffee and tea making facilities, mini bars, safes, hairdryers. The hotel has a bar and a restaurant and offers great value Italian and British cuisines. There is a business centre with contemporary equipment. Wi-fi is free of charge. Parking spaces available in our car park (upon request). Wembley Park (Jubilee Line and Metropolitan Lines) and Wembley Statium Station is a 7 minutes’ walk away. Bus stop at the hotel door steps.

416760.address: Hawthorn House, Forth Banks, Newcastle upon Tyne
416760.description: Smart central Newcastle hotel with refined meeting spaces and Gin BarJust steps from Newcastle rail station in the city centre, Crowne Plaza® Newcastle - Stephenson Quarter hotel offers upmarket style and gracious service. Newcastle Airport (NCL) is a 15-minute drive, and there’s paid parking in the multi-storey car park next door. A 10-minute walk takes you to Central Station for frequent Metro trains around the city. Corporate guests can host up to 400 people in 9 event spaces, and Completely Connected power access ensures you’re always productive. Conferences and concerts at the iconic Sage Gateshead cultural centre are less than a mile away. City centre shops are within a short walk, and football fans are 20 minutes by foot from Newcastle United’s St. James' Park. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- A 24-hour Business Centre- All Day DiningAfter a day of meetings or sightseeing, unwind in the spa, indoor pool or gym. Treat yourself to a massage, followed by cocktails in our Gin Bar. Savour brasserie-style British cuisine in Hawthorns restaurant – if you’re busy, Fast & Fresh menu selections help you stay focused. Our Sleep Advantage® programme ensures restful nights in stylishly decorated rooms with premium bedding and the option of Quiet Zone accommodation. For exclusive Club Lounge access, book a Club room.

417498.description: Nestled in Bo'ness' historical district, the Richmond Park Hotel offers a comfortable stay just a short drive from West Lothian Golf Club and Macdonald Inchyra Hotel Spa. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, on-site dining at The Copper Kiln restaurant and bar/lounge, and a daily full breakfast (available for a fee). The hotel's 45 guestrooms feature private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, electric kettles, and tea/coffee making facilities. Free self-parking and a 24-hour front desk are also available. Nearby attractions include Linlithgow Palace and Blackness Castle. Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is conveniently located 13. 3 miles away.

418761.description: These serviced apartments are centrally located in Edinburgh, with convenient public transport connections and popular destinations like Princess Street just two minutes away. The bright, spacious accommodations are tastefully designed and fully equipped, offering a relaxing haven from the city's hustle and bustle. Each apartment features a spacious open-plan lounge/dining area with a fully fitted luxury kitchen, a bathroom with a shower, and a comfortable bedroom. With studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom options available, there's an ideal choice for business travelers, families, or groups of friends. Check-in is available from 8:30 am to 7:00 pm, Monday to Friday, and 10:30 am to 7:00 pm on Saturday. Reception is closed on Sunday. For arrivals outside these hours, please contact The Spires reception. A £250 security deposit is required before arrival via our secure online payment portal. Please contact The Spires reception 48-72 hours before your arrival to provide your details.

name.content: ibis Styles Edinburgh St Andrew Square

419098.description: From the extensive continental breakfast spread each morning and 24-hour snack service, to the ever-cheery welcome at our on-site bar and restaurant, we work hard to make sure bellies are full and hearts are happy from sunup until well after sundown. And tucked away as we are in one of the prettiest districts of Edinburgh, your trip to this captivating Celtic charmer of a city is off to a braw start!

421259.description: Described by the New York Times as 'the most handsome inn in the world' the Feathers Hotel is one of Ludlow's most popular attractions. Set in a magnificent timber-framed building in the centre of picturesque Ludlow, 300 metres from Ludlow Castle and a 10-minute walk from the River Teme. The Feathers Hotel offers free car parking with limited spaces and free WiFi. Rooms at The Feathers Hotel Ludlow are elegantly decorated, and each has a private bathroom. All rooms have a hairdryer, flat-screen TV with a DVD player, and tea/coffee facilities. Room service is also available. The award-winning Feathers Restaurant serves a modern British menu using fresh, locally sourced produce. The Feathers Bar offers real ales, fine wines and afternoon tea/coffee.

name.content: King S Hotel Batam A Phm Collection

422796.address: Jl. Yos Sudarso Seraya Atas Batam Island
422796.description: Enjoy a wealth of amenities at Kings Hotel Nagoya Batam, including complimentary Wi-Fi and on-site parking. Stay warm on cooler days by the hotel's cozy fireplace. This smoke-free hotel offers designated smoking areas for guests' convenience. Start your day with a delicious breakfast and freshly brewed coffee at our in-house cafe. A variety of dining options are readily available throughout the day. Make sure to visit the hotel pool during your stay for a refreshing dip.

name.content: Sleep Inn & Suites North Liberty - Liberty City

424069.description: The smoke-free Sleep Inn hotel in North Liberty, IA will give you a simply stylish experience. We are close to attractions like the University of Iowa Research Park, Iowa Old Capitol Building and the Iowa City Municipal Airport. Enjoy free breakfast, free WiFi, a fitness center and guest laundry facilities. Your guest room offers warm, modern designs, and includes coffee makers, hair dryers, safes, irons and ironing boards. Upper-tier suites have even more amenities, such as sofa sleepers and a hot tubs. We also offer membership to the Choice Privileges Program, which gives members the opportunity to earn valuable rewards points toward airline miles, gift cards and free hotel room nights.

425579.description: The 4-star Pullman Liverpool Hotel is located at Kings Dock on Liverpool world famous waterfront. Pullman Liverpool offers 216 bedrooms - from Superior to Deluxe, Premium Deluxe to Suites - a bar, lounge and restaurant on-site, meetings and events space and fitness lounge, Pullman Liverpool is perfect for both Business and Leisure. Free Wi-Fi available throughout the hotel. Pullman Liverpool accepts card payments only throughout the hotel.

426278.address: Playa Miramar A38 y 39 Colonia Miramar, 1
426278.description: Situated on Manzanillo's finest beach, Miramar Beach, this exclusive hotel offers discerning guests tranquility and relaxation. Each of the six luxurious rooms boasts stunning ocean views and sunsets. Unwind with a massage under the gentle sea breeze or savor delicious cuisine and drinks at the palapa restaurant. Luxurious furnishings and amenities complete the experience.

431402.description: Our hotel is majestically situated in the middle of a park in a most beautiful and tranquil location just above the village centre of Wengen. Views of the Jungfrau and surrounding Alps are breathtaking. The village centre and the mountain railway station can be easily reached on foot. In less than a few minutes, you can be hovering over the «Männlichen – Kleine Scheidegg» ski and hiking paradise on the Wengen-Männlichen cable car. In winter, the practice slopes for children and beginners start right in front of the hotel. Over the last few years, we have renovated the hotel step by step and we are now classified as a 4-star superior hotel. All our guests feel at home here: singles, couples, and families with children – the young and young at heart. Personal assistance by the owners family Panoramic view over the mountains from all public areas 70% regular guests Large breakfast buffet with live cooking station for egg dishes Families are welcome: Spacious family rooms, indoor pool, playroom and playground From 1st May until 20th May 2020 and from 10th October until 17th October 2020 the hotel offers bed & breakfast only. The hotel offers a large breakfast buffet and egg dishes can be ordered freshly. The large swimming pool with whirlpool, the cosy sauna and steam bath area and the small gym are open and included in the room price. During the mentioned periods dinner, lunch, room service for food, massage and beauty treatments are not available. Bookings for the same day are possible until 8 pm. Check in is until 10 pm.

436381.description: The Temple Bar Inn is located in the heart of Dublin's history and culture. Surrounded by bustling cafes, bars and some of Dublin's best restaurants, the Inn is also walking distance to Trinity College, Dublin Castle, and The Guinness Storehouse. This prime location means our guests can fully immerse themselves in Ireland's capital city. The Inn's funky and fresh design throughout is complimented by bespoke Celtic art influences. With complimentary wi-fi, a 24-hour coffee station and a comfortable lounge area, the Temple Bar Inn perfectly suits the needs of a modern-day traveler. Each room includes everything you need for the most comfortable of stays such as a flat-screen TV, secure safe, mini-bar, tea and coffee making facilities as well as toiletries and fresh towels daily. Relax in our bright and modern rooms with views of the famous Temple Bar quarter below. Just step outside to find all Dublin has to offer, the Temple Bar Inn will ensure your stay is unforgettable.

439321.description: This delightful property is situated right in the heart of Bayswater, in the serene street of Craven Terrace. Both Paddington and Lancaster Gate tube stations are only moments away, offering direct links to all of London's famous sites and attractions. With extremely comfortable and relaxing ensuite bedrooms ranging from single to family rooms and equipped with flat screen televisions, as well as complimentary tea/coffee making facilities, the hotel’s main aim is to ensure guest satisfaction throughout their stay. Rooms range in size and present a combination of both style and function, in order to tender to our guests requirements. The property offers accommodation of exceptional comfort, with some rooms providing views of Craven Terrace peaceful surroundings, as well as a cosy breakfast room to start the best way possible with a warm coffee and an English breakfast.

443581.description: These upmarket serviced apartments are located in the heart of London's Kensington district, close to Harrods, the Royal Albert Hall, and the Victoria and Albert Museum. Ideal for corporate travelers, leisure visitors, and families, these single and double apartments feature a private kitchen with a washing machine, cooker, and other amenities, including a large flat-screen TV, safe, and Wi-Fi. Breakfast is served daily. The Presidential Apartments are within walking distance of the underground, serving both the Piccadilly and District lines. All apartments are serviced daily by a team of professional housekeepers, and a 24-hour desk is available to assist with any needs, such as taxi and laundry services, as well as theater bookings.

444161.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Satisfy your appetite for dinner at 1565 Bar & Terrace, a bar/lounge which specializes in local and international cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. This hotel has 11 meeting rooms available for events. Guests may use a train station pick-up service for a surcharge, and self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 253 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. 444522.description: Bloc Hotel Gatwick is ideally situated for both terminals, just a few short steps from the South Terminal Departure lounge. We offer our guests a new way to short stay through the ingenuity of our design and views of the world's most efficient single-runway airport. No other hotel will get you closer to your flight. Our rooms are efficient, sleek, and beautifully designed. The smallest details matter. Our sophisticated climate control system and Italian-tiled wet rooms with powerful drench showers mean you'll leave us refreshed and ready for your flight from Gatwick Airport.

444661.description: The Hotel Costa Brava welcomes you to Manzanillo, Colima, on Mexico's Pacific coast. Located in the tourist area on Miguel de la Madrid Boulevard, overlooking the Las Hadas golf course, our hotel offers 73 comfortable rooms equipped with Wi-Fi and cable TV. Enjoy our refreshing pool, wading areas, and snack bar, or dine in our specialty restaurant. We also provide ample parking and conference rooms for meetings and events. Experience an extraordinary stay with us.

446701.description: Discover London from The Lion and Key Hotel, located near the Olympic Village in Stratford and Westfield Stratford City, one of Europe's largest shopping centres. The hotel offers easy access to London's top attractions: the Natural History and Science Museums, Royal Albert Hall, and Kensington Palace are a 30-minute tube ride away. The West End and Knightsbridge are also within a 30-minute tube journey. The nearest tube station, Leyton (Central Line), is close by, and Leyton Midland Road Rail Station is a short walk away. The Lion and Key Hotel features 50 newly refurbished, modern rooms, each with a private bathroom, flat-screen TV, complimentary tea and coffee, free internet access, a hairdryer, and a minibar. Designed with the modern traveller in mind, each room offers a stylish and comfortable stay.

449552.description: These vacation apartments are perfectly situated in the center of Salou with the famous seaside promenade and sandy beach just a little over 100 yards (100 meters) away. Everything you could possibly want is within walking distance, including bars, restaurants, shops, water sports, and nightlife. The cities of Tarragona and Barcelona are both well worth a visit during your stay, while Salou's theme park, Port Aventura, is nearby and is another enjoyable day out. Many tourist amenties are seasonal. Perfectly situated just a short distance from Levante Beach and near Salou's commercial center, this resort has an outdoor pool and a children's pool.

449969.description: The Residence Panorama Villars is a charming chalet-style luxury resort located in the heart of the Alps. The middle name of this resort, 'Panorama', is an apt description of the incredible view of the Dents du Midi (The Teeth of Mid-day) mountains in the Alps. Residence Panorama Villars is an undiscovered gem with world-class skiing and brilliant white snow. Conveniences like a TV, telephone, and free WiFi access are included with all accommodations. A pool and billiards at the resort, and a nearby ice rink provide extra fun.

450702.description: Nestled on the outskirts of Carrbridge village near Aviemore, Lochanhully Resort offers a tranquil Scottish escape. These traditional woodland cabins encircle a serene lochan, providing a secluded base for exploring Cairngorm National Park and Moray Speyside. Cabins feature spacious open-plan kitchens and lounges. Many of the two-bedroom lodges also boast conservatories extending from the living areas, offering extra dining space and lovely woodland views. Kitchens are well-equipped with cookers, microwaves, and fridges, while living areas include TVs and sofa beds for additional guests. Your four-legged friends are welcome at Lochanhully.

452561.description: Hampton by Hilton Oxford is situated conveniently close to both the business and leisure areas of Oxford. We are only 15 minutes from the historic center and just an hour from Heathrow Airport. Oxford is the UK's oldest University City, where film fans explore the hallowed halls of Christ Church College, and punts glide gently along the River Cherwell. Our Oxford hotel is situated right next door to the Kassam Football Stadium and just 5 minutes’ walk to the Ozone Leisure Park's multiplex cinema, bowling alley, leisure club and restaurants. We are within easy reach of Oxford Science Park and only a mile from the BMW Mini plant, making our hotel a handy base for business travelers. Explore the pretty Cotswold villages and the rolling parkland of Blenheim Palace. Silverstone F1 racing circuit is 35 miles away and the famous Bicester village just 18 miles away but you do not have to go that far for retail therapy: Oxford’s newest shopping center, Westgate, home to over 100 brand new stores featuring the best of the British high street as well as prestigious global brands, is less than 5 miles away!Our inviting, air-conditioned guest rooms offer contemporary amenities including free WiFi, an ergonomic desk, a comfy bed and a 32-inch flat-screen TV. Refresh in the spacious bathroom, which features a walk-in shower or relax in our sunny hub.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel & Spa Liverpool

452564.description: Room packages including meals exclude children’s meal charges. Enjoy historic surroundings, a central location in the heart of Liverpool city center and a warm, chocolate chip cookie upon arrival when you stay at the DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel & Spa Liverpool. A Grade II listed building, this charming Liverpool hotel is just five minutes' walk from exciting shopping, dining and entertainment at Liverpool ONE, and offers easy access to the Business District and Liverpool attractions. All of our beautifully decorated guest rooms feature modern amenities designed to help you feel at home. Enjoy complimentary soft drinks and snacks from your mini-refrigerator as you watch the 40-inch TV or check emails using complimentary WiFi. Experience contemporary luxury in a spacious suite, offering additional space, amenities and original architectural features. Celebrate or hold a meeting for up to 220 people at this hotel in Liverpool with three grand banqueting suites and take advantage of useful services in the complimentary 24-hour business center. After a busy day, refresh in the inviting indoor swimming pool or energize in the fitness center. Indulge in a beauty therapy in the tranquil spa, offering six treatment rooms, a whirlpool, sauna and steam room. The spa is open daily for both non-residents and residents aged 16 and older. Savor afternoon tea in the luxurious ambience of the Library Lounge before treating yourself to a manicure in the nail bar. Meet with friends to sip cocktails in Layla Brasserie & Bar. A chic, lively restaurant in Liverpool's city center, the Brasserie features a tempting menu by TV chef, Simon Rimmer, offering classic and contemporary British dishes that showcase Liverpool's culinary heritage.

453161.description: The Lucky 8 Hotel in Ilford offers free WiFi and a 24-hour front desk. Each room features a desk, wardrobe, and private bathroom. Guests can enjoy a full English/Irish breakfast. The hotel also boasts a terrace. Central London is a 20-minute train ride away, and the historic Valentines Park is just 0. 6 miles from the hotel, conveniently located opposite Ilford rail station. London City Airport is 3. 7 miles away.

456081.address: Komplek Ruko Nagoya Hill Blok I No. 10-16, Jl., No. 16
456081.description: Once a densely forested area, Batam has transformed over the past three decades into a thriving industrial hub due to its proximity to Singapore and favorable trade agreements. While a key trade link between Indonesia and the world, Batam also offers visitors a variety of natural, historical, and religious attractions. Alltrue Lite Nagoya Hill Batam enjoys a prime location in the heart of Nagoya Hill Superblock, just 100 meters from Nagoya Hill Shopping Mall. It's conveniently located 30 minutes from Hang Nadim International Airport, 15 minutes from Batam Center Ferry Station, and 10 minutes from Harbour Bay Ferry Station. Guests are within walking distance of entertainment, spas, offices, banks, and a hospital. Designed for today's urban professional and leisure traveler, Amaris Hotel provides a stylish yet affordable experience, complete with modern amenities and professional service.

463002.description: Take to the sky well fed, well rested and ready for anything. Our Hot English Buffet Breakfast is available at a supplement of £14 per person per night. The on-site restaurant serves snacks all day and à la carte treats in the evening, plus our cosy, welcoming bar is a great place to kick back and contemplate the adventure ahead. We've got your every need covered throughout your stay, including free fibre Wi-Fi, a 24hr reception service. Airside Parking as well as EV charging now available please ask.

463282.description: Braid Apartments by Mansley incorporates 20 modern and stylish apartments with a range of studio, 1 and 2-bedroom options in a historical building in Edinburgh's New Town. Guests in north-facing apartments will benefit from fantastic views from the upper floors over the Firth of Forth and beyond. You are a short walk from so many of Edinburgh's most popular attractions, including Edinburgh Castle, The Old Town, Princes Street, Edinburgh New Town, and Edinburgh Art Galleries. Free WiFi is provided throughout the property. IMPORTANT CHECK-IN INFORMATION:At the Braid Apartments by Mansley, guests are required to complete the check-in process online, prior to arrival. Guests must contact the property 72h before arrival to receive arrival instructions. For Emergency assistance outside the opening hours: Please contact our customer service team at +44 1316 228 120.

name.content: Best Western Plus Grim's Dyke Hotel

463762.description: The Best Western Plus Grim's Dyke Hotel is a beautiful, secluded 19th century country house. Just 12 miles from the center of London and within easy reach of Heathrow, the magnificent former country residence of Sir William Gilbert is set in over 40 acres of beautiful gardens and woodlands. With 46 elegant rooms, housed in both the main hotel and lodge, a 2 AA rosette restaurant serving our own seasonal produce, this is the perfect British country retreat.

463805.description: Situated north of Glasgow city center, on the main tourist route to the Highlands, this 3-star Best Western hotel offers a comfortable retreat with a touch of retro charm.
