592035.description: Ideally located in the prime touristic area of Batam Center, Lovina Inn Batam Center promises a relaxing and wonderful visit. The hotel offers a wide range of amenities and perks to ensure you have a great time. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, taxi service, 24-hour front desk, 24-hour room service, express check-in/check-out are there for guest's enjoyment. Some of the well-appointed guestrooms feature complimentary tea, towels, slippers, complimentary instant coffee, television LCD/plasma screen. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. Friendly staff, great facilities and close proximity to all that Batam Island has to offer are three great reasons you should stay at Lovina Inn Batam Center.

592036.address: Jl. Teuku Umar Superblock Nagoya Hill
592036.description: Take advantage of recreational opportunities offered, including a health club, an outdoor pool, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Getting to nearby attractions is a breeze with the area shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 232 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

592037.address: Buana Vista Indah 1 Blok K No.100, Kota Batam
592037.description: The OS Hotel Airport Batam offers a comfortable stay for travelers exploring or passing through Batam Island. Each guestroom is fitted with amenities for a restful night's sleep, including towels, slippers, complimentary instant coffee, an LCD/plasma screen television, and a mirror. Guests can also enjoy a variety of recreational opportunities. Whether you are visiting Batam Island for business or leisure, the OS Hotel Airport Batam provides a welcoming home away from home.

592038.address: Ruko Limanda Blok D No. 1-3, Jalan Let. Jend
592038.description: The Sky Inn Hotel, conveniently located in Marina City, offers a high standard of service and amenities to suit every traveler. Enjoy 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi throughout, 24-hour security, and on-site parking. Guest rooms are well-appointed for a comfortable night's sleep, featuring amenities such as LCD/plasma televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, air conditioning, desks, and telephones. The hotel also provides various recreational opportunities, ensuring a welcoming atmosphere and excellent service throughout your stay.

592039.address: Komp. Palm Spring Business Trade Center B1 No
592039.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace at Sky View Hotel in Batam. Take advantage of complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. Dine at the on-site restaurant or enjoy 24-hour room service. Start your day with the complimentary buffet breakfast served from 7 AM to 9:30 AM. Amenities include express check-in/check-out, complimentary newspapers, and airport shuttle (surcharge). Free self-parking is available. Relax in one of the 61 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD TVs, cable programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, and bottled water. Bathrooms offer complimentary toiletries and slippers. The hotel is a short drive from Batam Centre Ferry Terminal and Grand Batam Mall, conveniently located near Nagoya Hill Mall and Harbour Bay Ferry Terminal.

592040.address: JL Yos Sudarso Bengkong Laut Batam Kepulauan
592040.description: Located in the business district of Batam, ibis Styles Batam Nagoya offers easy access to Harbour Bay ferry terminal 5-10 minutes car ride, Grand Batam Mall 10 minutes car ride. It features 187 contemporary rooms, a gym, swimming pool, spa and kids' park. Free WIFI for all guests. Perfect for leisure and business travelers.

592041.address: Jl. Teuku Umar No. 1, Kp Seraya Batu Ampar
592041.description: Stop at The Evitel Hotel Batam to discover the wonders of Batam Island. Featuring a complete list of amenities, guests will find their stay at the property a comfortable one. All the necessary facilities, including 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, fireplace, are at hand. Guestrooms are designed to provide an optimal level of comfort with welcoming decor and some offering convenient amenities like television LCD/plasma screen, carpeting, children's high chair, cleaning products, clothes rack. Take a break from a long day and make use of fitness center, massage, garden. The Evitel Hotel Batam is an excellent choice from which to explore Batam Island or to simply relax and rejuvenate.

name.content: Carberry Tower Mansion House And Estate

592266.description: One of the great Castle Mansion Houses of Scotland, Carberry Tower Mansion House and Estate is a place of intimate grandeur. And to arrive here, is to weave your own journey into a story that goes back to 1480 when our first foundation stone was laid. Since then, we have been a gathering place for Kings and Queens, Princes and Princesses and over the centuries the great and the good have also come to warm themselves by our fires and feast from our banqueting tables. And today, more strongly than ever, the banner that reigns over Carberry Tower continues to reflect the matchless values of excellence, abundance and grace - coupled together of course, with the very warmest of Scottish hospitality.

593370.description: Those staying at this hotel may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. Unfortunately, the front desk is not open 24 hours. There is a car park at Macbeth Arms Hotel. The hotel may charge a fee for some services.

594347.description: Welcome to Hampton by Hilton Aberdeen Airport. Our contemporary hotel offers an ideal location, right on the doorstep of Aberdeen International Airport and we are just 10 minutes from P&J live conference centre & exhibition, 20 minutes into the city centre, with excellent transport links close by. Nearby attractions include the P&J live Arena for concerts and weekend events & conferences, Golf courses, Whisky Distilleries, Castle Trail, Union Square shopping centre, Museums & Aberdeen Beach. Feel at home in your modern guest room, equipped with a comfy Hampton bed, free WiFi and an HDTV. Maintain your fitness routine in our 24-hour fitness centre or catch up with some work in our business hub area in the lobby. Each morning you’ll wake up to delicious waffles and cereals at Hampton’s free hot breakfast and we offer casual dining options 7 days a week, plus our 24-hour hub, serving sweets, snacks, drinks and travel essentials.

597771.description: Our beautiful aparthotel is located in Birmingham’s historic Jewellery Quarter. It’s stuffed with bars, restaurants and home to the iconic Jam House culture hub. Aston Villa FC and Cadbury World are just a short train ride away. Plus we’re just a 5 minute walk from central Brum and right beside the International Convention Centre. *Fancy a trip to a coffin-making museum? Victorian pens more your thing? Both museums are a 5 minute walk away! Our Staycafé is open 24/7 and serves a grab and go breakfast, snacks and pizzas (you can order these to go and enjoy them in your apartment if you prefer!), freshly ground coffee, bottled beer, cider, wine and soft drinks (note: sales of alcohol are restricted after 11pm).

597921.description: Experience the best of Dublin, from Viking history and bustling flea markets to trendy bars and leafy parks. Our aparthotel is nestled between Dublin's two iconic cathedrals, with Temple Bar and the Liberties on either side. Explore charming cafés, pop-up markets, and pizza bars, all within a 5-minute walk. Nearby, Thomas Street offers a taste of local life with street vendors selling flowers, fruit, and knick-knacks. Our modern apartments feature kitchens, living rooms, and free Wi-Fi. Please note: Stag/Hen parties are strictly prohibited and may result in refused check-in and forfeited refunds.

602005.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities, including a nightclub, an outdoor pool, and a fitness center. Additional features at this Mediterranean hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and free babysitting. Enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at Arena Buffet, one of the hotel's many dining establishments, which include 3 restaurants and a coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink from the poolside bar or one of the 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 136 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LED televisions. Rooms have private furnished balconies. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected.

name.content: Ibis Styles Glasgow Centre George Square

602032.description: Discover Glasgow's vibrant energy from our modern hotel, perfectly situated near iconic George Square. Explore the city's rich history, world-class shopping, and diverse culinary scene, from award-winning restaurants to traditional pubs. With easy access to train stations, the Subway, and airport shuttles, you can effortlessly explore all that Glasgow has to offer. Book your stay today and experience the city's unique charm firsthand.

602037.description: This hotel is located in a central location a short stroll away from the city centre and just a minute's jaunt from Cambridge Railway Station. The neighbourhood is both vibrant and lively, and the nearby Botanic Gardens offer guests the chance to discover plants from all over the world while enjoying 40 magnificent acres of tranquil greenery. The bustling Bar and Restaurant draws a crowd right through the day and evening until the early hours. The impressively majestic carved marble bar takes centre stage in the Brasserie-style dining room with its accents of soft leather, gleaming brass, and salvaged timber. Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification.

603209.description: Bright, modern hotel in the heart of Grimsby with free Wi-Fi and breakfast includedHoliday Inn Express® Grimsby hotel is in the centre of Grimsby, four minutes' walk from Grimsby Town station. From here you can catch direct trains to Sheffield, Manchester Airport (MAN) and Cleethorpes. The hotel is close to the A180 and A16 roads and has limited on-site parking. Humberside Airport (HUY) is 25 minutes' drive away. With a huge range of shops and eateries, Freshney Place Shopping Centre is six minutes' away by foot. Take in a live musical or comedy show at Grimsby Auditorium and enjoy the fresh air and scenic landscape at Grimsby Golf Club, both five minutes' drive from the hotel. Family-focused Grimsby Fishing Heritage Centre is less than a mile away. Conveniently situated for business guests, the hotel has a 22-person meeting room on the ground floor. Smart and brightly lit, this space is suitable for interviews, meetings and events. An informal bar and lounge area is right next to the meeting room. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel and all guests have use of a printer, copier and fax. Start the day right with an inclusive Express Start Breakfast, complete with hot dishes and a continental option. The hotel bar is a laid-back spot for a drink with friends at the end of the day or you can relax in your room, surfing cable channels on the flat-screen TV.

605701.description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at Hotel Star Manzanillo, a beachfront hotel near Manzanillo Bay. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast served from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM, and later dine at our onsite restaurant. The hotel features an outdoor pool, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and free self-parking. Each of our 41 air-conditioned guestrooms offers cable TV, a safe, a desk, and daily housekeeping. We're conveniently located a short drive from Playa Azul Salagua and Punto Bahía Shopping Center, with Playa La Audiencia and Playa Miramar also easily accessible.

606541.description: Located in Riccarton, Edinburgh, the Courtyard by Marriott Edinburgh West is a convenient base, a short drive from Heriot-Watt University and Edinburgh Zoo. This upscale hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a communal TV area, and access to a nearby fitness center. Each of the 160 air-conditioned rooms features a refrigerator, LCD TV, private bathroom with shower, complimentary toiletries, hairdryer, safe, and desk. Guests can dine at The Avenue restaurant, grab a snack at the deli, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. The hotel also provides a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and ample meeting space. Free self-parking is available on-site.

606546.description: Stay at the Residence Inn by Marriott Aberdeen, located in the heart of Aberdeen, a short walk from Union Square and Bon Accord shopping centers. This eco-certified aparthotel offers 126 guestrooms, each equipped with a kitchenette (refrigerator and stovetop), a 43-inch LED TV with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a laptop-compatible safe. Enjoy a complimentary on-the-go breakfast, weekdays from 6:30 AM to 9:30 AM and weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM. The hotel also features a 24-hour fitness center, grocery/convenience store, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Limited on-site parking is available. Nearby attractions include Provost Skene's House and the Aberdeen Art Gallery. Aberdeen Airport (ABZ) is approximately 6. 7 miles away.

name.content: Hilton Garden Inn Iowa City Downtown, IA

607203.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with **reduced service**: Fitness Center, Pool. The following services and amenities are currently **not available**: Valet Parking. Stay at Hilton Garden Inn Iowa City Downtown University and be near it all. We're a quick walk to restaurants, shops and nightlife as well as the University of Iowa campus and sports arenas. Four hospitals are a mile away, and major offices like Oral-B and Procter & Gamble are within 15 minutes. See a Hawkeyes game while you're here, or spend a day immersed in prairie life at the Amana Colonies. For your convenience, we offer shuttle service to destinations within 5 miles of the hotel. Don't miss Vue, our rooftop restaurant and outdoor patio offering views over downtown from 12 floors up. Our casual Garden Grille restaurant serves breakfast and lunch, and the Pavilion Pantry® is always open for snacks, drinks and frozen meals. Take a dip in our heated pool and whirlpool or burn calories in the fitness center. Along with a 24-hour business center, we have 2, 700 sq. ft. of Downtown Iowa City meeting space that's perfect for corporate events and wedding receptions.

607223.description: Welcome to our Hampton Inn Newport, TN hotel located in the middle of the natural, scenic beauty of southern Appalachia, minutes from Gatlinburg and Pigeon Forge, each with unique attractions and fun things to do. Directly off of Interstate I-40, you’ll find our hotel is in walking distance to restaurants and shops and convenient to the Smoky Mountains National Park. Hampton Inn Newport is close to many corporations if you are here on business. Stay in comfort and enjoy the convenience of our 24-hour business center with copy, fax and printing support. Our outdoor pool provides a great place to refresh after work or play. Get a good night’s sleep on your clean and fresh Hampton bed®. You’ll enjoy the convenience of having a mini-refrigerator in your room. All rooms include an HDTV and ample work space. With free hot breakfast daily, begin your day with a great start. If you need a meal on the go, grab a Hampton’s On the Run™ Breakfast Bag, available Monday through Friday. Our friendly staff are happy to offer recommendations for nearby restaurants.

name.content: Home2 Suites By Hilton Iowa City-Coralville

607228.description: Welcome to Home2 Suites by Hilton Iowa City Coralville. Conveniently located just off the I-80, our contemporary hotel offers the ideal option for extended stays in Coralville. Walk to nearby shops and restaurants and enjoy close proximity to Kinnick Stadium and the University of Iowa, as well as Coral Ridge Mall, featuring a 10-screen movie complex. You’ll feel right at home in a spacious studio or one-bedroom suite. Every room at this Coralville, IA hotel features a fully equipped kitchen and a living area with sofa bed and HDTV. Relax on the Serta Suite Dreams bed and stay connected with free WiFi access. Each morning you’ll enjoy a complimentary breakfast at our Inspired Table™, featuring artisan breakfast sandwiches, cereal, waffles and more. Our excellent amenities will help you make the most of your stay here in Iowa. Take a dip in the heated indoor pool and hot tub or run a load of laundry as you work out in our innovative Spin2Cycle laundry and fitness facility. Our Home2 MKT is also open 24-hours, offering a great selection of groceries, drinks and more.

607399.description: Stay at the SpringHill Suites by Marriott Coralville and enjoy easy access to local attractions. Located a short walk from Coral Ridge Mall and a quick drive from the University of Iowa, this hotel offers an indoor pool and fitness center. Each of the 102 air-conditioned rooms features a refrigerator, microwave, and Smart TV with cable. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is provided, along with designer toiletries and a safe. Start your day with the complimentary buffet breakfast and grab a bite at the snack bar/deli later on. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge after a busy day. The hotel also provides a business center and express check-out for your convenience. Free self-parking is available onsite.

607415.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Fairfield Inn & Suites by Marriott Coralville, conveniently located in the business district of Coralville, Iowa. A complimentary continental breakfast starts your day, followed by a refreshing dip in the indoor pool or a workout in the fitness center. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and wired internet access in your room, equipped with a refrigerator, microwave, safe, and desk. The hotel also offers a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers. Nearby attractions include the University of Iowa, Kinnick Stadium, and Coral Ridge Mall, all within a short drive.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Dublin City Centre

607762.description: Stay at the Holiday Inn Express Dublin City Centre, an IHG Hotel, and enjoy a central Dublin location just steps from O'Connell Street and a 14-minute walk from Trinity College. This hotel is conveniently located near Croke Park (1. 2 km) and Grafton Street (1. 1 km). Enjoy amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a vending machine. The hotel offers 198 guest rooms, each featuring a flat-screen TV with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with shower, complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer, a safe, and a desk. Dine at The Express Bar and Cafe, featuring a bar/lounge area and a coffee shop. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Additional amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. For events, the hotel offers 823 square feet (76 square meters) of conference space and three meeting rooms. Dublin Airport (DUB) is 13. 8 km from the hotel.

609161.description: The Mercure Thame Lambert Hotel is conveniently located just 10min from Thame & 15min drive from Oxford, making it a great place to stay for those looking to travel into the city. Set at the foot of the Chiltern Hills, an area of outstanding natural beauty, this hotel caters perfectly to both business and leisure stays. Guests can choose from standard and superior room options, all of which are comfortable with modern décor and luxurious touches.

609823.description: Welcome to DoubleTree by Hilton Hull, a new hotel in Ferensway. Once the site of the Lexington Avenue nightclub, our contemporary hotel is perfectly located for exploring city centre and beyond. Walk to St Stephen’s and Princes Quay shopping centres, the Ferens Art Gallery, local theatres, and Hull’s many free museums. Transportation is fast and convenient with bus and rail stations just steps away. Enjoy a warm chocolate chip cookie at check-in, and settle into a guest room with sumptuous beds and comforts like complimentary WiFi, a Smart TV, air conditioning and ergonomic workspace. Our corner-room suites offer a living area with sofa, a private bedroom, beautiful city views, and cozy bathrobes and slippers. Join us for breakfast, lunch and dinner in the stylish atmosphere of Marco Pierre White Steakhouse & Bar. Our lobby lounge is the perfect spot for casual meetings or afternoon tea, and the rooftop Electric Bar is sure to be a highlight of your stay. Call on room service anytime for a delicious meal delivered to your door. Plan a conference or celebration at our DoubleTree Hull hotel with flexible event space including a pillar-free ballroom for up to 1, 000 guests. Host a training session or social event in your choice of attractive boardrooms and meeting rooms. Our catering services, A/V technology and dedicated staff will ensure every event is a success.

609987.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with **reduced service**: Business Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s). The following services and amenities are currently **not available**: Fitness Center. Welcome to our bright Hampton by Hilton Edinburgh West End hotel, located in the heart of Edinburgh City Centre close to all attractions, shopping, business facilities and the Haymarket Train Station. We are situated just 7 miles from Edinburgh Airport (EDI) and within walking distance of Edinburgh International Conference Center, making our friendly hotel ideal for stay for business or leisure. Relax in one of our spacious rooms on a clean and fresh Hampton bed® and get work done at the large desk with ergonomic chair. Settle into the comfortable room and watch your HDTV in comfort. With hot breakfast included in Every Stay, start your day on the right foot. We have a 24-hour hub with refreshments and convenience items available at any time. Our friendly team members are ready to recommend excellent lunch and dinner options in Edinburgh. Our fully air-conditioned Hampton by Hilton Edinburgh West End hotel has 1 meeting room available for up to 6 people. We are a 100% non-smoking hotel with a 24-hour business center and free Wi-Fi throughout. We hope to see you soon.

612361.description: 'Our Aberdeen Bucksburn hotel is conveniently located in Bucksburn, which sits at the edge of Kirkhill Forest with its walking trails and mountain bike park. Also nearby you've got the River Don, a hot spot for anglers and walkers. You're in prime position here, between the historic port city of Aberdeen and the international connections of Aberdeen Airport, which is a few minutes' drive or short bus-ride away. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a variety of food and drink choices within easy walking distance from this hotel. 'This comfortable Hotel is in Aberdeen.

612369.address: MSA M40 Northampton Rd Cherwell Valley
612369.description: Our Bicester Cherwell Valley M40 hotel is perfectly placed for fashionistas shopping for designer brands at Bicester Village and visitors looking to explore nearby Banbury and Oxford or the beautiful Cotswolds. Discover the area's rich heritage at nearby Waddesdon Manor, Bletchley Park and the stunning Blenheim Palace, or rev up your engine for a short drive to Silverstone Circuit, the home of British motorsport. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a wide variety of food and drink choices within a short car journey from the hotel. Useful informationEnjoy 20% off selected food and drink at the nearby Moto services with your Travelodge key card. Ask our hotel team for more information.

612370.description: 'Shopaholic? You'll be in the right place to grab a bargain at our Birmingham Fort Dunlop hotel. It's just a short walk from the Fort Shopping Park, where you'll find plenty of big-name stores to tempt you. You've also got easy access to the rest of the city for the likes of the NEC, Birmingham Museum and Art Gallery and the Thinktank science centre, home to an incredible planetarium and a fascinating tribute to the Spitfire plane. This hotel has upgraded rooms that feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals. Useful informationDue to the roadside location of this hotel, some external noise may be heard. Due to building works taking place near to the hotel in order to improve the hotels car park, some external noise may be heard during the day until April 2017. '

612371.description: 'Our Birmingham Maypole hotel is ideal for visits to the University of Birmingham and sports fans are also perfectly located for Edgbaston Cricket Ground. If you're a chocoholic you're just a few miles from uncovering a world of chocolate delights at Cadbury World. Hop on a bus nearby and you can be in Birmingham centre within 25 minutes. The ICC conference venue and Symphony Hall are within easy reach, or combine shopping and history with a visit to The Jewellery Quarter. This new hotel features our upgraded rooms each with a comfy king size bed complete with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on site restaurant serves our full unlimited breakfast and 24 hour pizzas. '

612373.description: Our Bromborough hotel is next to the delightful and unique model village and gardens of Port Sunlight on the Wirral Peninsula, near to the historic and attractive town of Birkenhead. Visit the fascinating Lady Lever Art Gallery and the Williamson Art Gallery and Museum in neighbouring Birkenhead and stroll through the Priory and its lovely park. With Liverpool just across the Mersey there's no shortage of things to discover. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a wide variety of food and drink choices within easy walking distance from this hotel.

612380.description: 'Our Cardiff M4 hotel is located in a convenient spot outside the Welsh capital, just a short trip away from one the city's top attractions - the open-air National History Museum, which is set in 100 acres of beautiful parkland. Explore the Cardiff Castle or take in the buzzing Cardiff Bay area, where you can even journey through space and time at the Doctor Who Experience. On big match days, catch top-flight rugby and football at the Principality Stadium. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a variety of food and drink choices within easy walking distance from this hotel. Useful informationPlease note that the postcode for this hotel does not work on satellite navigation systems. Please contact the hotel directly for further information. '

612389.description: Our Crewe Barthomley hotel is in a handy spot close to some much-loved sights, including the Crewe Heritage Centre, where you can learn all about the area's engineering past, and the boutiques, antique dealers and craft shops of medieval Nantwich. You're also well placed for day trips into Stoke-on-Trent, with all its pottery shops and factories, or to Alton Towers, where you can test your mettle on some of the country's most nerve-wracking rides and rollercoasters. This hotel has upgraded rooms that feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a variety of food and drink choices within easy walking distance from this hotel.

612396.description: Our Dunfermline hotel sits near the abbey town of Dunfermline, close to Carnegie Conference Centre and Lynebank Hospital. It's also handy for the town of Cowdenbeath and exploring the Fife countryside. Head into central Dunfermline to explore Dunfermline Abbey and elegant Pittencrieff Park - look out for the resident peacocks - or travel over the famous Forth Road Bridge to enjoy the sights of Edinburgh, under an hour away. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a wide variety of food and drink choices within a short car journey from the hotel.

612399.description:
"Our Falkirk hotel is close to some of Scotland's most distinctive sights - the huge horse sculptures in Helix Park known as The Kelpies and Falkirk Wheel, the world's only rotating boat lift, which has to be seen to be believed.

You can admire the beautiful scenery along the John Muir Way hiking trail or hunt for bargains in Falkirk's traditional town centre. You're also roughly midway between Edinburgh and Glasgow, and close to top towns including Bo'ness and Denny.

All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a variety of food and drink choices within easy walking distance from this hotel.

Useful information

Due to the roadside location of this hotel, some external noise may be heard."

612402.description: The ibis budget Glasgow Cumbernauld hotel, just off the M40's junction 5 is ideal for both business and leisure. Guests can visit Broadwood Loch or enjoy the Broadwood Leisure Centre. Clyde Football Club is also nearby, a must-visit for sports fans. The hotel is ideally located for those visiting Glasgow City or Glasgow Airport, which can be reached easily by car. Local attractions also include, World of Wings or you can enjoy a round at Palacerigg or Dullatur Golf Course.

612403.description: 'You can't get much more central than our Glasgow Queen Street hotel. Situated a short stroll from Glasgow's main attractions, you're not far away from the must-see Gallery of Modern Art, a spot of shopping at St Enoch Centre or a visit to friends and family at the University of Strathclyde and Glasgow Caledonian. Sports fan? Our hotel is located only 4 miles from Hampden park and it's less than that to Ibrox Stadium, Celtic Park and the Emirates Arena. This new hotel features our upgraded rooms each with a comfy king size bed complete with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals. '

612410.description: 'Nature or nurture? Our Harrogate West Park hotel offers both with easy access to the Grade 2 listed Valley Gardens and The Stray, or a soothing visit to one of the area's famous spas. For those looking for culture, the Royal Pump Room Museum is half a mile away, while Harrogate's boutique shopping, local tea rooms and various country houses offer a taste of indulgent luxury. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals. '

612415.address: A63 Ebound Beacon Service Area South Cave
612415.description:
"Our Hull South Cave hotel is surrounded by quaint villages and East Riding's lovely countryside - perfect for gentle walks and pub lunches. Or dip your toes into the waters at inland dive site, Eight Acre Lake.

From the hotel, you can take trips to the majestic Humber Bridge, see sharks and other sea life at the Deep Aquarium or enjoy the museums of Hull city centre.

This hotel has upgraded rooms that feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a variety of food and drink choices within a short car journey from the hotel"

612454.address: A1/A19 Rdabt Fisher Ln Seaton Burn
612454.description: Our Newcastle Seaton Burn hotel is ideal for exploring both the local countryside and Newcastle itself. Near the hotel you'll find quad biking and paintballing centres, plus tranquil walks at Big Waters nature reserve. Head to central Newcastle to see the Tyne Bridge and sample the renowned Quayside nightlife, explore the medieval Newcastle Castle and visit some of the city's acclaimed cultural attractions like the Great North Museum and the Theatre Royal. This hotel has upgraded rooms that feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a wide variety of food and drink choices within easy walking distance from this hotel.

612455.description: 'Our Newcastle Whitemare Pool hotel is handy for just about everything locally - you're 5 miles from the quayside at Gateshead, across the Tyne from the vibrant culture of Newcastle, and a short drive from the centre of Sunderland. Experience cutting edge culture at Sage Gateshead and the BALTIC Centre for Contemporary Art, and cross the Millennium Bridge to explore the historic centre of industrial Newcastle. Don't miss a trip to see the Angel of the North - affectionately dubbed 'The Gateshead Flasher'. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a variety of food and drink choices within easy walking distance from this hotel. '

612463.description: Our Oxford Peartree hotel is the ideal starting point for visits to the historic university city of Oxford. Soak up the beauty of its many museums, galleries and buildings. Or explore Oxfordshire's lovely countryside and the Cotswolds AONB. Head into Oxford to visit the Ashmolean Museum and the University Museum of Natural History, and admire the exquisite Bodleian Library. Drive a short way north to visit gorgeous Blenheim Castle with its butterfly house and giant maze. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a wide variety of food and drink choices within a short car journey from the hotel.

612474.description: Located in the centre of the traditional seaside resort of Southport, this 3-star hotel provides a convenient base for exploring the town. The property offers Standard, Family, and Accessible guest rooms. In-room amenities include a television and a coffeemaker, and Wi-Fi is available. For convenience, a vending machine is located on-site. While there is no on-site restaurant, various food and drink options are a short walk away. Chargeable public parking is available nearby. The hotel is situated 0. 3 miles from the Southport Pleasureland theme park, and Southport Pier is approximately a four-minute walk from the property. Pets are permitted for an additional fee.

612477.description: Fancy a potter? Our Stoke Talke hotel is near the officially recognised World Capital of Ceramics. Visit The Potteries Museum & Art Gallery and have a go at making your own at the Gladstone Pottery Museum. Keep an eye out for fairies at the Trentham Estate, get your adrenaline flowing on the treetop Aerial Extreme or hang with macaques in the Monkey Forest. For more thrills, WaterWorld and the famed Alton Towers are both nearby. This hotel has upgraded rooms that feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a variety of food and drink choices within a short car journey from this hotel.

612481.description: 'Love to shop? Then you're perfectly placed at our Swindon Central hotel - it's just a few minutes' walk from all the busy high-street shops. And the train and bus stations are also nearby so you won't have far to trundle with heavy bags. The Swindon Designer Outlet Village is also close by with its exclusive discount shops. Next door is the STEAM museum where railway enthusiasts can pore over the displays of classic locomotives. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals. '

612482.description: 'Our Thame hotel is a short walk from the centre of this historic market town on the edge of the Chilterns AONB, with its popular market, quirky independent boutiques and numerous pubs and eateries. Visit nearby Waddesdon Manor and Blenheim Palace or head out for the day to explore iconic Oxford and attractions like the Ashmolean Museum, the Bodleian Library and the Botanic Gardens. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a wide variety of food and drink choices within easy walking distance from this hotel. '

612485.description: Stop at Travelodge Washington A1 (M) Northbound to discover the wonders of Washington. Offering a variety of facilities and services, the property provides all you need for a good night's sleep. Daily housekeeping, 24-hour front desk, car park, pets allowed, 24-hour check-in are on the list of things guests can enjoy. Guestrooms are designed to provide an optimal level of comfort with welcoming decor and some offering convenient amenities like flat screen television, towels, smoking policy – non-smoking available, heating, internet access – wireless (charges apply). The property offers various recreational opportunities. Friendly staff, great facilities, and close proximity to all that Washington has to offer are three great reasons you should stay at Travelodge Washington A1 (M) Northbound.

612489.description: Our Widnes hotel is conveniently located near the Catalyst Science Discovery Centre, perfect for a fun-filled day of exploration. Nature lovers will appreciate the nearby Spike Island Nature Reserve, a prime spot for birdwatching along the Mersey Estuary. Music fans can easily satisfy their Beatle-mania with a short drive to the museum at the Albert Docks and the Tate Liverpool. Or, follow in the footsteps of the Fab Four along trendy Mathew Street, home of the legendary Cavern Club. Each room features a comfortable king-size bed with four plush pillows and a cozy duvet. A variety of dining options are within easy walking distance. Please note: Due to nearby construction, some external noise may be heard between 8 am and 5 pm, Monday to Friday, until the end of April 2017.

615582.description: The hotel is located in Belfast's busy city centre. It is only 1. 5 km from Belfast Central Train Station and 17 minutes' walk from Belfast Botanical Gardens. George Best Belfast City Airport can be reached less than10-minute drive. Many popular attractions can be found within a short distance. From the hotel, Belfast Castle is 13 minutes' drive away and Belfast Zoo is a further minute away. The popular Titanic Quarter is also just 3 km away. For shopping, Victoria Square Shopping Centre is a 16-minute walk from the hotel. The hotel features rooms with suite bathroom, a flat-screen TV, a clothes rack and a work desk. In the morning, an unlimited continental breakfast is served in the dining room. Hot drinks, fruit juices, breads, cereals and dairy products are also available.

616760.address: blok VI, Jl. Pembangunan, Batu Selicin, Lubuk B
616760.description: Set in a prime location of Batam Island, Sahid Vanilla Nagoya Hotel Batam puts everything the city has to offer just outside your doorstep. The hotel offers a wide range of amenities and perks to ensure you have a great time. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, taxi service, 24-hour front desk are just some of the facilities on offer. Comfortable guestrooms ensure a good night's sleep with some rooms featuring facilities such as television LCD/plasma screen, free welcome drink, mirror, slippers, towels. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. A welcoming atmosphere and excellent service are what you can expect during your stay at Sahid Vanilla Nagoya Hotel Batam.

616961.description: This 4-star hotel, established in 2017, is located in Belfast city centre, near Blackstaff Square and Great Victoria Street station. The hotel features a restaurant and 237 rooms equipped with a hairdryer, safe, ironing set, and air conditioning. Enhanced sanitization procedures, rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, are in place.

617377.description: Our Aberdeen Airport hotel is a great base for travellers looking to explore the cultural attractions of the glittering 'Granite City' and its picturesque nearby beaches. Set beside the river Don, close to the airport, there are good transport links to Aberdeen's museums and galleries and it's only a short journey to scenic Duthie Park and stunning Balmedie beach. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a wide variety of food and drink choices within a short car journey from the hotel in Aberdeen city centre. Useful information Guests can enjoy food and drink at Bucksburn Manor which is 2. 1 miles away from the hotel.

617383.description: Well located in the heart of Dublin, Maldron Hotel Kevin Street provides buffet breakfast and free WiFi. Situated conveniently in the Dublin City Centre, the property is located a 5-minute walk from St Patrick's Cathedral. Grain and Grill restaurant serves an international cuisine and Maldron Hotels have developed its very own Vitality Breakfast . The nearest airport is Dublin Airport, 10 km from the property. Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification. Hotel has been accredited by Green Tourism, a certification program that provides a framework to achieve a sustainable business in the tourism industry.

617756.address: Jl. Sriwijaya No. 1, Kp. Pelita, Riau
617756.description: Aston Batam Hotel & Residence is a four-star hotel located in the center of Batam, a city where business and entertainment chime in harmony. The hotel is located only 25 minutes away from Hang Nadim Airport and only 8 minutes from Harbour Bay Ferry Terminal, making it one of the most strategic trading center in Indonesia. Aston Batam Hotel & Residence is pleasantly and stylishly designed with 232 rooms divided into four room types: Superior, Deluxe, Family, and Suite Room. All rooms are completed with modern room and bathroom amenities, and guests could enjoy high speed WiFi access inside their own room and throughout the hotel area. Diverse selection of facilities such as swimming pool, fitness center, and spa are available to pamper guests and ensure the most memorable stay in the city.

618283.description:
Situated in the heart of Dublin, Dublin Central Suites feature 22 elegantly furnished self-catering apartments with free WiFi, fully equipped kitchen, a dining area and a 24 hour reception desk. 

Located just off Dorset Street (N1), the serviced apartments are less than 15 minutes' (10km) drive from Dublin Airport and 10 minutes' walk from Dublin's main shopping and entertainment streets including Henry Street and Grafton Street which are ideal places to visit for the shopaholics. 

The nearest LUAS (Tram) stop at Parnell Square is also less than 10 minutes' walk (900m) away. Football fans will find themselves in the close proximity of Croke Park which is only 8 minutes' walk (700m) away. Airlink Express bus stop is also down the road from the apartments on Lower Gardiner Street. 

All apartments are fitted with large LED Smart TVs with large selection of satellite TV channels and feature a digital safe, fridge/freezer, kettle, toaster, cooker and a work desk. Private bathrooms feature power showers and free toiletries. Washing machines are available on site. 

Most apartments feature sofa beds and are ideal for families, larger groups or business travellers who seek privacy and comfort of home only an apartment can offer. 
Kindly note the accommodation is located on the upper floors, and is accessible via stairs only. Therefore it may not be suitable for guests with mobility impairment.

There are no parking spaces at the property however, there is ample street parking and a large car park is only 2 minutes' drive away. The car park costs €15 per day. 

Be aware that Dublin Central Suites is strictly NON SMOKING throughout all guest rooms, guest lounge, corridors and public areas. Also smoking is not permitted in the rooms that has access to outdoor areas. 

Dublin Central Suites will commence welcoming guests from 15 January 2018.

619301.description: Daily Mandatory Charge includes: Destination Marketing FeeAn undeniably local stay, Graduate by Hilton Iowa City combines hometown history and Hawkeye traditions with creative interiors and college nostalgia. Located on the downtown Ped Mall, within walking distance of the University of Iowa and Kinnick Stadium, it’s your perfect base for exploring. Enjoy inspired guest rooms, an on-site coffee shop and restaurant, and our signature Graduate touches.

619728.description: Europe's “first sustainable hotel”, this is an urban oasis just in the Dublin City Centre district of Dublin, a 4-minute walk from St. Stephen's Green. The hotel is contemporary modern in style, with a selection of rich wallpapers, touches of brass, gleaming mirrors, stylish tiled floors and lots of Navan-manufactured furniture. Guests staying in rooms at the side and back of the property will have great views of the Iveagh Gardens. Harcourt Street is an extremely busy street, but guests staying in the front of the hotel, where rooms form part of the Georgian facade, will be separated from the trams and partygoers by new triple-glazed windows.

619882.description: easyHotel Liverpool is situated in the Liverpool Shopping District district in Liverpool, a 2 minute walk from Liverpool One shopping centre and 10 minutes from the waterfront. The hotel is a 3-minute walk from Liverpool St. James Station. Each room includes an en suite bathroom fitted with a bath or shower. There is a 24-hour front desk at the property. easyHotels are room-only, however there is a wide range of restaurants and cafes surrounding the hotel. Directly under the hotel is an Italian restaurant who serve a mix of Venetian small plates, pastas and risottos. Liverpool's famous Cavern Club is a 3-minute walk from easyHotel Liverpool, while Royal Court Theatre is 500 m away. The nearest airport is Liverpool John Lennon Airport, 12 km from easyHotel Liverpool.

619922.description: Located between Newcastle's vibrant city center and picturesque Quayside, easyHotel Newcastle offers budget-friendly accommodations just eight minutes from Central Station. Explore the city's attractions, enjoy the lively nightlife, or focus on business with ease. A variety of restaurants, bars, and cafes are within walking distance. All rooms feature air conditioning, heating, en-suite bathrooms, Wi-Fi, and TVs, providing comfort and convenience without compromising affordability.

621001.description: Best Western Dolphin Hotel boasts (in its own humble way of course) 67 luxury bedrooms, a beautiful restaurant, bar areas and a wonderful location perched on the banks of the Great Ouse in the picturesque town of St Ives in Cambridgeshire. With spectacular views of beautiful meadows, the river and the amazing historic 15th Century bridge, you’ll have everything you need for a relaxing retreat.

622114.description: Hawkeye fans and road trippers love the homestyle comfort of AmericInn Lodge and Suites Coralville. We are located off I-80 just a short drive from the University of Iowa-and its Division 1 football team, the Hawkeyes and Kinnick Stadium. Nearby companies include aviation company Rockwell Collins, Integrated DNA Technologies, and Higher Learning. Top-notch healthcare options such as the University of Iowa Hospital, Stead Family Childrens Hospital and Iowa City Veterans Administrations Health Care System are just minutes away.

623396.description: Welcome to Hotel Indigo® Cardiff, where bespoke design meets classic Welsh heritage. Our boutique bedrooms reflect our vibrant city, with the themes Made in Wales, Welsh Industry and Music embodied in local art and natural materials. Many also offer wonderful views of the Cardiff skyline, and they all have free Wi-Fi and invigorating rainfall showers. Moments from our front door you can sing along with the fans at the home of Welsh Rugby, explore the historic Cardiff Castle with its fairy tale towers, or rock out to that famous local music at the Cardiff Utilita Arena. Our fully equipped fitness suite will keep you on your toes, and after a day of discovery, visit our rooftop restaurant & bar 'Lefel 6 at Dominions Arcade', which is the perfect place to relax, with private dining option and not to mention a fabulous roof terrace.

624445.description: A central location is the top priority for guests of a Dublin City Hotel. We ensure you have a relaxed atmosphere and a comfortable room to return to after a long day (or night) enjoying the buzzing metropolis. Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification. Rooms are compact but airy, and equipped with the comfiest beds, plumpest pillows and the softest linen, to help you get a great night's sleep. All rooms are air-conditioned and have a fridge, safe, ironing board and Nespresso machine. They also have a Smart Android TV with HDMI and USB connections. Hotel has been accredited by Green Tourism, a certification program that provides a framework to achieve a sustainable business in the tourism industry.

624815.description: Situated just off O'Connell Street in Dublin City Centre, Clifden Guesthouse Dublin City is conveniently close to all the major tourist attractions in Dublin. Whether you are a first time or regular visitor to Dublin, you'll find our central location the ideal base to discover all that Dublin has to offer. You'll have your choice of our en-suite Single, Double/Twin, Triple or, Family Rooms with comfortable duvets, satellite TV's and Free Wi-Fi. We want you to have the most memorable visit to Dublin by offering high quality Dublin City Centre Guesthouse accommodation, in a great location at superb value. Our accommodation near Croke Park makes it a great choice for those visiting the home of GAA for a concert or to see their favourite team in action.

625245.description: The HARRIS Resort Barelang Batam, a Tauzia Group hotel, is located near the iconic Barelang Bridge. This resort offers 176 rooms, including 168 HARRIS Rooms, 6 HARRIS Suites, and 2 HARRIS Villas, each with views of the garden, swimming pool, or the sea. Guests can enjoy a wide range of facilities including the HARRIS Cafe and Pizza with live cooking, a juice bar, Dino Kid's Club and water playground, an infinity pool and jacuzzi, a modern beach club with its own pool and jacuzzi, a boutique, the Bay House for weddings and parties, a spa, reflexology services, a fitness center, eight meeting rooms for up to 500 people, motorized and non-motorized recreation sports, jogging and cycling tracks, a business center, internet corner, mini-mart, an exclusive white sand beach and parking for 200 cars.

625561.description: Centrally located in Belfast, AC Hotels by Marriott Belfast is a 5-minute drive from Titanic Belfast and the Obel. This upscale hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a terrace with city views, and wedding services. The 188 air-conditioned rooms feature refrigerators, espresso makers, and LCD televisions. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Enjoy lunch or dinner at Novelli at City Quays, or order 24-hour room service. A bar/lounge and buffet breakfast (for a fee) are also available. Business travelers will appreciate the business center, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning/laundry services. The hotel also offers 1421 square feet of event space.

625563.description: Located in the heart of Glasgow's vibrant Merchant City, the Moxy Glasgow Merchant City hotel offers guests convenient access to top attractions like George Square and Buchanan Street (within a 15-minute walk). This modern hotel features 181 guestrooms equipped with LCD TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Guests can enjoy a daily buffet breakfast (for a fee), dine at the on-site restaurant, grab a snack at the deli, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A fitness center, 24-hour business center, and express check-in/out services are also available.

626302.description: Hastings Grand Central is more than a hotel. It's an ode to a city. Standing tall in Bedford Street, this impressive jewel fuses glamour and grandeur with a uniquely Belfast spirit. Perfectly placed in Belfast City. Just as Belfast is at the heart of the Grand Central, the Grand Central is at the heart of Belfast. Set in the up and coming Linen Quarter, the hotel is a spectacular hub for exploring Titanic Quarter's history or Cathedral Quarter's charming cobbled streets, pubs and eateries. Theatre buffs, shopaholics and historians alike will all be spoiled for choice, with a host of options right on their doorstep. Conveniently located for all transport access, the Grand Central is perfectly placed for every city centre endeavour – from business to leisure and everything in between.

627839.description: Do you dream of exploring Catalonia? Book a stay at the 4* Salou Suites Hotel located in the centre of Salou. A highly sought-after destination thanks to its beaches and its proximity to Port Aventura and Ferrari Land!Can't get enough of being in the water? The hotel boasts an outdoor pool and is located just 450 m from Capellans beach and 1 km from Levante beach. This hotel offers a large number of family rooms and boasts its own restaurant. Sportier types can discover seabed by doing some diving, explore the surroundings on horseback, or play tennis - all within striking distance of the residence.

name.content: Hampton by Hilton Belfast City Centre

627882.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Business Center, Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s). Located in central Belfast, Hampton by Hilton Belfast City Centre offers modern rooms with free WiFi and secure discounted parking adjacent to the hotel. Travelers of all types will appreciate our proximity to the main road networks and public transport hub making, Belfast City Airport (BHD) and SSE Arena within easy reach. Our hotel puts you within walking distance of the fashionable Victoria Square shopping centre and many of the city's attractions. The Grand Opera House and the Lyric Theatre are less than two miles away. Walk to Great Victoria Street railway station for easy access around the city and the surrounding areas. After a busy day, unwind in your spacious room with a clean and fresh Hampton bed. Start your day with Hampton's included hot breakfast, offered to guests staying at the hotel. Later in the day, dine at our lobby bar with plenty of drink options as well as light meals and snacks. For a quick snack, stop by the 24/7 snack hub offering soft drinks, snacks and some travel essentials.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Birmingham - City Centre

628341.description: Central Birmingham hotel with free Wi-Fi and Breakfast includedHoliday Inn Express® Birmingham - City Centre hotel is 10 minutes’ walk from Grand Central train station and Grand Central shopping mall. The hotel is 10 minutes’ drive from the M6 motorway, while Birmingham Airport (BHX) is a 15-minute train ride away. A short walk takes you to events at the International Convention Centre. You can host informal meetings in the hotel’s relaxed lobby lounge area before reaching companies like RBS and KPMG in the nearby Colmore Business District. Browse for designer fashion at the nearby Mailbox shopping centre, anchored by a Harvey Nichols department store. Selfridges, housed in a landmark futuristic building, is a quick stroll away at the Bullring mall, near the Hippodrome and New Alexandra theatres. At this hotel you can enjoy:- A hot Express Start breakfast buffet included in the room rate- Free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel- A Business CentreWelcoming rooms come with blackout blinds and pillow menus to help you get a good night’s sleep. Wake up to a power shower and enjoy the inclusive buffet breakfast in the bright Express Café and Bar. It’s just the place to chat with friends and colleagues over a coffee or a cold beer, and if you need a bite to eat, try the all-day menu of snacks and light meals.

name.content: Hampton Inn by Hilton Hailey Sun Valley

629021.description: Located in downtown Hailey, we are five minutes from Friedman Memorial Airport and a short drive from skiing at Sun Valley Resort. Enjoy our indoor pool and hot tub with mountain views, free WiFi, and complimentary hot breakfast. Our pet-friendly hotel features a 24-hour airport shuttle and easy access to Wood River Valley Trails.

629505.description: Situated in Edinburgh's prestigious New Town on George Street, Eden Locke occupies a stunning five-story Victorian building. This aparthotel offers self-contained apartments, each equipped with a kitchen including a dishwasher, oven, and microwave. Complimentary Wi-Fi and initial breakfast essentials are provided. Enhanced cleaning protocols are in place, including contactless check-in/out. While on-site restaurants and social spaces are currently closed, the surrounding area boasts a vibrant array of shops and restaurants. One dog (up to 30kg) is permitted in designated dog-friendly apartments, with charges applicable (excluding registered service animals). Weekly cleaning is included for stays of 7 nights or more, with additional cleaning available for a fee. Luggage storage is complimentary until 11:59 pm on the day of arrival/departure.

630039.description: The modern Mercure Blankenberge hotel offers comfortable, stylish rooms near the train station. All rooms feature minibars, safes, flat-screen TVs, telephones, tea/coffee making facilities, and AC. Privilege rooms include luxury amenities, docking stations, and Espresso machines. Guests can meet in the lounge bar to explore the wine menu or enjoy the heated rooftop pool (closed until 01/07/2020).

633582.description: The Clayton Hotel Charlemont, a stylish 4-star hotel, offers 192 spacious rooms in Dublin's city centre (Dublin 2). Conveniently located on the Luas Green Line, with easy access to Dublin Airport and major transport links, it caters to both leisure and business travellers. Enjoy panoramic views of the Grand Canal from the à la carte restaurant and bar. On-site amenities include meeting rooms and a fitness centre. The hotel holds accreditation from Green Tourism and follows enhanced sanitation procedures verified by Bureau Veritas.

634322.description: Located in the heart of downtown Ketchum only 6. 4 miles from Bald Mountain. Ketchum is more than our newest home. It is our kindred spirit. It is the big brother we never had. It helps remind us who we are - a hotel that threw the hotel rulebook out the window. And it has given us the freedom to get the important stuff right. It is a lounge that is slowly becoming the center of town a staff that holds Ketchums treasures close to its heart and a passion for making our guests feel as comfortable as the town has done for us. Limelight Hotel and Residences in Ketchum is slated to open in December of 2016 with 99 welcoming hotel rooms and 14 expansive residences. It is not a place of marble and brass meant to shelter those inside from the bustle. Instead it is a porous place of wood and glass that invites the mountains inside. The service is impeccable but casual the decor rustically modern and the attitude always warm and welcoming.

635406.description: Situated on the outskirts of Newcastle, Rooms Inn provides the perfect base for a classic Geordie city break. A ten-minute walk from the central train and metro station, you can explore the quayside, theatres, art galleries, restaurants, and bars with ease. There are also beautiful parks just a short walk away. When you’ve finished exploring, relax in the modern ensuite bedrooms, with flat screen TV’s, free Wi-Fi and tea and coffee making facilities. A 24-hour desk and parking (Chargeable) enables you to come and go as needed and you’ll receive a complimentary on-the-go breakfast bag each morning of your stay.

636447.description: Set in a prime location of Edinburgh, Linton Collection - Blackfriars Lofts puts everything the city has to offer just outside your doorstep. The property has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Take advantage of the property's free Wi-Fi in all rooms, kitchen, express check-in/check-out, luggage storage, family room. Some of the well-appointed guestrooms feature clothes rack, complimentary instant coffee, complimentary tea, linens, mirror. The property offers various recreational opportunities. Discover all Edinburgh has to offer by making Linton Collection - Blackfriars Lofts your base.

636622.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an outdoor pool or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a fireplace in the lobby. Stop by the hotel's restaurant for dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and room service is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 8:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 26 air-conditioned rooms featuring iPads and minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and complimentary bottled water, and housekeeping is provided daily.

637660.description:
Attractively located in the Liverpool City Centre district of Liverpool, Dream Apartments 8 Waterstreet is situated a few steps from Western Approaches Museum, 550 yards from Liver Building and 750 yards from Liverpool ONE. This 4-star hotel offers a concierge service. The accommodation features a fitness centre, free WiFi throughout the property and a 24-hour front desk.

Popular points of interest near Dream Apartments 8 Waterstreet include Royal Court Theatre, The Cavern Quarter and Albert Dock. The nearest airport is Liverpool John Lennon Airport, 9.3 miles from the accommodation.

Private parking is possible at a location nearby (reservation is needed) and costs GBP 15 per day.

name.content: Cricklade House Hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Be

638321.description: Set in 30 acres of secluded grounds in the glorious Wiltshire countryside, the Cricklade House Hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western is the ideal retreat for those in search of tranquility, relaxation and traditional home comforts. Located near the pretty Cotswold town of Cricklade between Swindon and Cirencester, this tastefully restored and extended country house has 45 spacious bedrooms, plus three function rooms perfect for weddings and business events. If you want to unwind, you can enjoy a leisurely lunch on the terrace, swim in the pool or enjoy a round of golf on our nine-hole course. You can also sun yourself in our wonderful Victorian-style glass conservatory that runs the entire length of the original building. With lots to enjoy in the hotel itself, we cannot blame you if you just want to stay put during your visit, but if you do fancy heading out and about, the historic town of Cirencester is only a 15-minute drive away. Also nearby are Cotswold Water Park, where you will find nature reserves, water sports, clay pigeon shooting and even a beach! Shoppers can pick up a bargain at the Swindon Designer Outlet Village and Orbital Shopping Park, while sports fans can enjoy speedway and greyhound racing at Swindon Stadium.

638880.address: 678 Puketona Road, Haruru Falls Paihia NZ
638880.description: Bay of Islands Holiday Park is a 4.2 hectare Holiday Park providing Paihia accommodation and is well located for exploring the Bay of Islands. Plenty of trees for shade and the Waitangi River running along one boundary for safe swimming and kayaking up to the Lilypond Falls and listen to the peace and quite of nature as you gently paddle upstream to a tarzan swing and waterfalls and great swimming hole. Bay of Islands Holiday Park has well-presented tourist flats and cabin accommodation, with level tent and power sites for campervans and caravans. Group bookings are catered for and backpackers are welcome. Ample parking for boats/trailers.

640221.description: Sierra Mar at Tesoro Manzanillo guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 10 units. This hotel was refurbished in 2015. Travellers may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Sierra Mar at Tesoro Manzanillo. Sierra Mar at Tesoro Manzanillo provides 24-hour reception. This property understands that accessibility is important to all guests. For this reason, it features wheelchair accessible units and is fully adapted for easy access. Travellers arriving by car will appreciate parking available at Sierra Mar at Tesoro Manzanillo. Corporate travellers may appreciate the meeting and business services and facilities available for added convenience. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

name.content: Villa del Palmar Manzanillo with Beach Club

640237.description: This peaceful hotel, fully refurbished in 2018, offers guests a tranquil escape just 100 meters from the beach and a short stroll from a golf course. Conveniently located near transportation links, exploring the surrounding area is effortless. While the hotel comprises only six units and doesn't offer 24-hour reception or cots, on-site parking and entertainment options are available. Some services may incur additional charges.

640642.description: This luxurious Hotel is set in Thun. Luxury Villa – Deltapark guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 3 guests rooms. The year of construction of this accommodation dates back to 2017. The Deltapark Vitality Resort is located on a 70'000 m2 plot, directly on Lake Thun, surrounded by beautiful nature and an adjoining a nature reserve. Main features:-106 hotel rooms of different categories (3* and 4* Superior) in two buildings, with panoramic lake or mountain views-3 lakeside villas (5* Superior) with direct lake access and full usage of the hotel-600 m2 of state-of-the-art event and seminar facilities in the main building and 200 m2 of seminar rooms in the adjacent Waldhaus: a total of 13 seminar and conference rooms, including 5 meeting rooms, 5 group rooms, 3 plenary rooms-4 restaurants, bar and lounge; library; roof terrace-over 2, 000 m2 of well-being & spa facilities with integrated «Deltavital Health Management» wellness concept including indoor natural salt pool, outdoor whirlpool, a swimsuit and a nude zone containing saunas, steam baths, experience showers, rest rooms, 3 private spas, as well as a wide variety of cosmetic and massage treatments-newly built main building with lobby, reception area and hotel piano bar

640701.description: With a stay at House Dublin, you'll be centrally located in Dublin, within a 10-minute walk of St. Stephen's Green and Grafton Street. This hotel is 0. 9 mi (1. 5 km) from Trinity College and 0. 9 mi (1. 5 km) from St. Patrick's Cathedral. Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a nightclub or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This Georgian hotel also features complimentary wireless Internet access and wedding services. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and an elevator. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the hotel's coffee shop/café. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 8 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 16 guestrooms featuring espresso makers and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily.

640995.description: This stylish hotel, featuring a relaxed bar and bistro, is conveniently located on leafy Botanic Avenue in the heart of Belfast's Queen's Quarter. Just a short walk (300m) from Belfast city center and The Waterfront Hall, it's also moments away from Queen's University (200m). The Odyssey Arena and Grand Opera House are easily accessible.
