Catering to both business and leisure travelers, our apartments offer a range of amenities and services, including LCD/plasma TVs, complimentary tea and coffee, and electric blankets. Enjoy on-site recreational activities such as massage and golf or explore local adventures like diving, fishing, and horse riding. Our dedicated staff is committed to providing professional and reliable service throughout your stay.

732538.description: Relax and enjoy the view from the garden or play a game on the outdoor tennis court at Doubtless Bay Villas. This luxury aparthotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. Additional amenities include express check-out and luggage storage. Free self-parking is available on-site. Each of the 20 individually decorated guestrooms features a refrigerator, an LCD television, and a 32-inch flat-screen TV with satellite programming. Bathrooms include a bathtub or shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hair dryer. Microwaves, electric kettles, and weekly housekeeping are also provided for your convenience. Doubtless Bay Villas is located near Cable Bay Beach, just a short drive from Taipa Beach and Coopers Beach.

733073.description: Stop at Waipu Cove Resort to discover the wonders of Waipu. The property features a wide range of facilities to make your stay a pleasant experience. Take advantage of the hotel's free Wi-Fi in all rooms, convenience store, laundromat, Wi-Fi in public areas, car park. Designed for comfort, selected guestrooms offer television LCD/plasma screen, electric blanket, linens, sofa, towels to ensure a restful night. Enjoy the hotel's recreational facilities, including hiking trails, wind surfing, snorkeling, surfing lessons, hot tub, before retiring to your room for a well-deserved rest. Friendly staff, great facilities and close proximity to all that Waipu has to offer are three great reasons you should stay at Waipu Cove Resort.

733074.description: Located in the heart of Whangarei, Bk's Pohutukawa Lodge is within a 5-minute drive of the Quarry Arts Centre and Whangarei Art Museum. This hotel offers 60 air-conditioned rooms with kitchenettes, including refrigerators, microwaves and stovetops. Each room features complimentary Wi-Fi and a 40-inch smart TV with digital programming. Enjoy convenient amenities such as express check-out, luggage storage, laundry facilities, and free self-parking. Daily housekeeping is also provided. Nearby attractions include Claphams National Clock Museum (1. 8 mi) and Town Basin Marina (1. 9 mi). Whangarei Airport (WRE) is 6. 1 miles from the hotel.

733075.description: Stop at Avenue Heights Motel to discover the wonders of Whangarei. The property features a wide range of facilities to make your stay a pleasant experience. Take advantage of the hotel's laundromat, facilities for disabled guests, luggage storage, car park, room service. Each guestroom is elegantly furnished and equipped with handy amenities. Recuperate from a full day of sightseeing in the comfort of your room or take advantage of the hotel's recreational facilities, including outdoor pool, garden. For reliable service and professional staff, Avenue Heights Motel caters to your needs.

733076.description: Chelsea House Bed & Breakfast is perfectly located for both business and leisure guests in Whangarei. The hotel offers a wide range of amenities and perks to ensure you have a great time. Facilities like free Wi-Fi in all rooms, Wi-Fi in public areas, car park, tours, shared lounge/TV area are readily available for you to enjoy. Some of the well-appointed guestrooms feature internet access – wireless, non smoking rooms, heating, balcony/terrace, alarm clock. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. Chelsea House Bed & Breakfast combines warm hospitality with a lovely ambiance to make your stay in Whangarei unforgettable.

733080.description: The 3-star Orana Motor Inn offers comfort and convenience for both business and leisure travelers in Kaitaia. The hotel provides a high standard of service and amenities to suit individual needs. Guests can enjoy free Wi-Fi in all rooms, a chapel, a convenience store, daily housekeeping, and fax machine access. Rooms are designed for comfort, and some include LCD/plasma screen televisions, carpeting, complimentary instant coffee and tea, and electric blankets. Recreational facilities include hiking trails, a hot tub, and an outdoor pool. The Orana Motor Inn offers a convenient and comfortable stay in Kaitaia.

name.content: Stay Kerikeri Boutique Apartments And Studios

733083.description: Enjoy a central Kerikeri location at Stay Kerikeri Boutique Apartments and Studios, just a short walk from Fairy Pools and Skindynamique Waxing & Skin Centre. This aparthotel offers an outdoor pool, bicycle rentals, and complimentary airport shuttle service. Relax in one of the 10 individually decorated guestrooms, each featuring a kitchen, memory foam bed with premium bedding, private patio, and a 32-inch flat-screen TV. Free Wi-Fi and room service are also available. Nearby attractions include St. James Anglican Church and the Kerikeri Mission House.

733361.description: Comfortable Accommodations: Agaró Cambrils Apartments in Cambrils offers family rooms with balconies and terraces. Each unit includes air-conditioning, a kitchenette, and a private bathroom. Guests enjoy garden or sea views and a work desk. Exceptional Facilities: The aparthotel features a sun terrace, garden, and a year-round outdoor swimming pool. Free WiFi is available throughout the property. Additional amenities include a lift, concierge service, and bicycle parking. Prime Location: Playa del Regueral is a 16-minute walk away. PortAventura and Ferrari Land are 12 km from the property. Reus Airport is 15 km distant. Guests appreciate the beach access, swimming pool, and convenient location.

733841.description: Located in the heart of the city, this adults-only hostel (18+ only, valid ID required upon check-in) offers modern facilities, including a large self-catering kitchen, private shower pods, and USB charging points/bed lights at each bunk. Enjoy free Wi-Fi, a daily city tour, and lively bar events. Security features include 24-hour reception, electronic key cards, CCTV, and security passes. Luggage storage is available before check-in. The hostel prides itself on cleanliness, with daily room cleaning and regular bathroom/kitchen maintenance. Friendly staff provide local tips, and discounts are available at the on-site bar (open 7 am-midnight).

734901.description: Hilton Garden Inn - Wiener NeustadtThe hotel is located near the center of Wiener Neustadt and just 350 meters from thetrain station. In the immediate vicinity of the city park are the historically uniquefortifications from the 16th century, the casemates, which are now used as a meetingand event center. Not far from the hotel you will also discover the castle where thefamous emperor Maximilian I was baptized and buried. Today, the world's oldestmilitary academy is housed here. The city center also offers a wealth of shopping, bars, restaurants and cultural attractions.

737301.address: Century Wharf Apartments, Off Dumballs Road, Dumballs
737301.description:
Century Wharf offers more in almost every area. With over 14 acres of landscaped grounds surrounding 700 luxury apartments, choice and style combine to produce one of Cardiff's most sought after accommodation addresses.
As a Bay destination, this development provides close access to the bustling entertainment area of Mermaid Quay, while being set alongside the peaceful river Taff, one of the cleanest rivers in Britain.
Would you like to go for a swim, or train in the Gymnasium during your stay?  Then take a stroll across to the Centurion Leisure Suite, Century Wharf's own fitness centre.  15 meter pool, sauna, showers, powered exercise machines, weights, break-out room, it's all there. And it's all free to our guests.

738632.description:
Located in the heart of Cardiff's stylish Mermaid Quay and directly opposite the stunning Wales Millennium Centre these spectacular apartments offer all the comforts of home in a superb modern environment. Perfect as a base for anyone wishing to visit the exciting and dynamic city of Cardiff.
Relax on chic furniture in beautifully designed apartments or go exploring with Cardiff's many diverse attractions being just a short stroll away.
Together with luxurious decor, cosy rugs and comfortable sofas, each living area includes 42" LCD TV with DVD player. With FreeSat HDR (similar to Sky+HD) available in Gold Award apartments, you have every creature comfort imaginable at your disposal.
Each modern kitchen is fully equipped for self catering, including an integrated over/hob, microwave, refrigerator, dishwasher and full set of kitchen cutlery and crockery.
Cardiff bay's fantastic Red Dragon Centre is a mere 5 minutes walk away whilst Mermaid Quay's many attractive bars and restaurants are right on your doorstep! For those wishing to explore the wider Cardiff area, Cardiff city centre is a 15 minute walk or a five minute drive and at nearby Cardiff Bay Rail Station.
Rail services include a shuttle service between Queen Street and Cardiff Bay station, while the M4 motorway provides fast access to Swansea and to Bristol, and for travel further afield Cardiff International Airport is just 11 miles away.

738633.description:
Our Park Lane Apartments are situated in the heart of the vibrant city of Cardiff and are directly opposite the National Museum.
Cardiff offers a range of unique attractions, top class entertainment and quality shoppingwith a diff erence. These boutique apartments
off er all the comforts of home in a premium modern environment. Our Studio Apartments offer a cost effective and a flexible alternative to hotel
accommodation. Perfect for those who prefer to explore the city and prefer a self-catered option.
St David's shopping centre has helped to elevate Cardiff into a world-class shopping destination. It has created attractive public
spaces for people to enjoy, alongside unique and exciting stores and cafes and is a mere 5 minutes' walk away. There are also many
attractive bars and restaurants right on yourdoorstep !

740351.description: Built in 1845, the Posthotel Rössli is the oldest hotel in Gstaad and is situated right in the pedestrianized centre of the village. It offers free parking on site and free WiFi in the entire building. Fine Swiss specialities are served in the hotel's 2 restaurants. Providing a typical Swiss ambience, the Posthotel Rössli's rooms feature Alpine-style wooden furniture. A summer programme is offered daily from June until September, including guided hiking and mountain bike tours, climbing for beginners and advanced, a visit to the rope park and to the Indiana Jones Trail on Hornberg mountain.

740617.description: Located in the heart of Calexico, California Suites Motel is within a 5-minute walk of Rockwood Plaza and San Diego State University Imperial Valley Campus. This motel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, free self-parking, and a business center. Each of the 27 air-conditioned rooms features a refrigerator, microwave, and coffee/tea maker. Cable programming is provided for your entertainment, and housekeeping is offered daily. Nearby attractions include the Calexico Community Center (0. 7 mi) and the International Border Line Mexico-USA (9. 5 mi). The nearest airports are El Centro, CA (IPL-Imperial County) and Mexicali, Baja California Norte (MXL-General Rodolfo Sanchez Taboada Intl. ), both approximately 30 km away.

740958.description: With a stay at Spannort Inn, you'll be centrally located in Engelberg, within a 10-minute walk of Titlis Glacier and Engelberg-Titlis Ski Resort. This ski pension is 0. 5 mi (0. 8 km) from Engelberg Abbey. Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. The complimentary ski shuttle makes getting to the slopes a breeze. Featured amenities include multilingual staff, luggage storage, and a library. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite. Satisfy your appetite at the pension's bistro, which features a bar/lounge. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/café. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 19 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms with showers are provided. Conveniences include safes and blackout drapes/curtains, and housekeeping is provided on request.

741076.description: Stay Metro Aparthotels - Glasgow offers contemporary one- and two-bedroom apartments with all the comforts of home. Choose from over 35 luxury apartments in Junior, Executive, and Premium standards, each thoughtfully designed with spacious bedrooms, a separate living room, and a fully fitted kitchen. Located in the heart of Glasgow City, within the affluent financial district (IFSD) and the renowned 'Style Mile' shopping district, Stay Metro is ideal for experiencing the best of Glasgow. Enjoy amenities such as a state-of-the-art Executive Lounge, a business center, and high-speed Wi-Fi. Premium Apartments feature Penhaligon's toiletries, while Executive Apartments offer White Company London products. Onsite parking, a continental breakfast pack, and a 55' 4K LED Smart TV are also included. Glasgow International Airport is a 20-minute drive, and major transport links, iconic streets, entertainment hotspots, and attractions like the SECC and SSE Hydro are within walking distance. Airport transfers and private city tours are available upon request. The property was renovated in 2021 and follows a robust 20-step SPG Clean Care protocol.

741279.address: Jl. Pelita IV, Baloi - Lubuk Baja, No 25-29
741279.description: Located in Batam, Hotel Pelita Terang is within a 5-minute drive of Nagoya Hill Mall and Grand Batam Mall. This hotel is 3. 7 mi (6 km) from Batam Centre Ferry Terminal and 2. 2 mi (3. 6 km) from Harbor Bay Ferry Terminal. This smoke-free hotel was built in 1997. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 46 air-conditioned guestrooms. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms with showers are provided. Conveniences include phones and complimentary bottled water, and housekeeping is provided daily.

741785.description: With a stay at Cobblestone Inn & Suites - Vinton in Vinton, you'll be a 5-minute walk from Kiwanis Park and a 2-minute drive from Frank G. Ray House. This hotel is 1. 4 mi (2. 3 km) from Vinton Courthouse and 4. 7 mi (7. 5 km) from Benton County Conservation Nature Center. Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless Internet access and a fireplace in the lobby. Featured amenities include complimentary wired Internet access, a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Free self parking is available onsite. Grab a bite from the grocery/convenience store serving guests of Cobblestone Inn & Suites - Vinton. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily. Make yourself at home in one of the 31 guestrooms featuring refrigerators and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

742520.description: Located 3. 6 miles from Forth Bridge, Gothenburg Hotel offers 2-star accommodations in Rosyth and features a shared lounge, a restaurant and a bar. The property is around 7 miles from Hopetoun House, 12 miles from Edinburgh Zoo and 14 miles from Murrayfield Stadium. The property provides entertainment staff and free WiFi throughout the property. All guest rooms at the hotel are equipped with a flat-screen TV and a kitchen. EICC is 14 miles from Gothenburg Hotel, while Camera Obscura and World of Illusions is 15 miles away. The nearest airport is Edinburgh Airport, 11 miles from the accommodation.

742534.description:
Attractively located in the OYO Queens Quarter district of Belfast, Kates BnB is set 400 m from The Belfast Empire Music Hall, a 15-minute walk from The Waterfront Hall and 1.3 mi from Odyssey Arena. The property is located 2 mi from Titanic Belfast and an 8-minute walk from Ulster Museum. Free WiFi is available.

The rooms in the bed and breakfast are equipped with a kettle.

St. George's Market is a 16-minute walk from Kates BnB, while Customs House Belfast is 1.1 mi away. George Best Belfast City Airport is 3.1 mi from the property.

742901.description: Alannia Costa Dorada is located in a natural setting with direct access to the beach of L'Almadrava, Tarragona. It is in a privileged geographical location between the sea and the mountains, a natural environment that you can enjoy, as well as the most important gastronomy, traditions, culture, leisure and entertainment centres of the coast. Situated in a natural setting, Alannia Costa Dorada is a unique paradise. In the complex you can stroll, swim and relax enjoying the facilities and more than 140 unique accommodations. Inside the facilities you will find everything you need to live an authentic experience: supermarket, bar, restaurant, mini club, laundrettes, gym, spa, swimming pools. . . If you are looking for peace and quiet, relaxation and family treatment, Alannia Costa Dorada is the ideal place to enjoy your holidays and quality time.

743067.description: Enjoy stunning garden views at the Opua Boutique Seaview Motel, where amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. Free self-parking is available on-site. Each of the three individually decorated guestrooms features a kitchen equipped with a refrigerator, stovetop, microwave, and coffee/tea maker. Housekeeping is provided upon request. Flat-screen televisions and complimentary Wi-Fi are also provided for your convenience and entertainment. Located in Opua's historic district, the motel is a short drive from the Bay of Islands Marina and Paihia Beach, offering a tranquil escape near popular attractions. The preferred airport, Kerikeri (KKE-Bay of Islands), is 17. 6 miles away.

743272.description: Discover the brand-new Holiday Inn Express in Yorkville, Illinois, conveniently located in Chicago's western suburbs near Sugar Grove, Aurora, and Naperville. Situated at the intersection of Routes 34 and 47, with easy access to I-88, I-355, and I-55, our hotel offers small-town charm with big-city access. We're a great choice for visitors to Waubonsee Community College, Stuart Sports Complex, Rush Copley Medical Center, and Aurora University, as well as attractions like the Chicago Premium Outlet Mall and Raging Waves Water Park. Enjoy our complimentary hot breakfast, indoor pool and hot tub, high-speed internet, fitness center, and business center. We also offer a board room for meetings. Nearby dining options include NCG Theater, Flight Tasting Room, Burnt Barrel Beer & Burger Bar, and Grace - A French Bistro, all within walking distance.

743987.description:
The Belvédère Strandhotel in Spiez is a charming four-star superior hotel located on a sunny hillside above Lake Thun, offering breathtaking views of the lake and the surrounding Swiss Alps. Combining elegant comfort with warm Swiss hospitality, the hotel provides an ideal retreat for both leisure and business travelers. 

Guests can enjoy stylish rooms and suites. The private lido and the infinity pool invite you to relax on warm days. At lower temperatures, you can recharge your batteries in the hotel's own wellness area. 

Thanks to its unique location in the heart of the Bernese Oberland, the Belvédère Strandhotel is the perfect starting point for exploring some of Switzerland’s most famous destinations, including Interlaken, the Jungfrau region, and the picturesque villages along Lake Thun.

743989.description: A total of 56 accomodation units are available for guests' convenience. The Alpina Gstaad includes Wi-Fi internet connection in all public areas and bedrooms. The Alpina Gstaad offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience. Moreover, The Alpina Gstaad has made important environmental improvements in order to minimize its impact on the environment and features the certification. Travellers may relax and rejuvenate in the property's wellness facilities. Those who stay at this establishment may enjoy the establishment's entertainment options.

743990.description: This charming hotel can be found in Engelberg.

744220.description: Featuring a bar, NYX Hotel Dublin Christchurch is located in the centre of Dublin, 90 metres from The City Hall. Among the facilities of this property are a restaurant, room service and a 24-hour front desk, along with free WiFi throughout the property. The property is non-smoking and is situated 400 metres from Dublin Castle. All units are equipped with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV with cable channels, a fridge, a coffee machine, a shower, free toiletries and a desk. All rooms include a private bathroom, a hairdryer and bed linen. A continental, Full English/Irish or vegetarian breakfast can be enjoyed at the property. Popular points of interest near the hotel include Chester Beatty Library, St Patrick's Cathedral and Gaiety Theatre. The nearest airport is Dublin Airport, 10 km from NYX Hotel Dublin Christchurch.

744910.description: Located directly at the lake in Lungern, between Luzern and Interlaken, Hotel Kaiserstuhl offers a restaurant and free WiFi in all areas. During summer, guests can relax on a sun terrace or in the on-site beer garden. Each room features a flat-screen TV, coffee machine and a desk. Some rooms come with a private bathroom and some share the bathroom facilities. Hotel Kaiserstuhl also features a bar, where guests can enjoy a wide range of drinks. A cozy lounge fitted with a fireplace, is another feature of the property. An array of activities can be enjoyed in the surroundings, including skiing, fishing and hiking. The ski elevators of the Hasliberg Ski Area are within 8. 1 mi.

745910.description: Located in the heart of Salou, a mere 5-minute stroll from the beach and a 20-minute walk from Port Aventura, La Siesta Salou Resort & Camping offers five swimming pools, diverse dining options, daily entertainment for all ages, and a relaxing spa. It's an unforgettable experience for those seeking relaxation and fun in a scenic, nature-filled setting.

746549.description: Antique boutiques, inviting whisky bars, and history etched into the very stones, Edinburgh's Grassmarket has gracefully evolved over the years into the stunning historic Old Town you see today. There is no finer way to explore this vibrant pocket of the city than by treading its time-worn cobblestones, where you can saunter to the evocative Greyfriars Kirkyard, meander Victoria Street's nooks and crannies, and, naturally, savour a hearty haggis amidst the bustling ambiance. Our prime position at the foot of Edinburgh Castle affords breath-taking views whilst being within walking distance of all the area’s top sights. PLEASE NOTE: Stag / Hen parties are not permitted under any circumstance Check in may be refused and refunds not permitted

746554.description: Wildflower parks, arcade shopping, church bells, castles*, Victorian pubs, religious paraphernalia, theatres, and Georgian architecture. Stay in Dublin’s vibrant, bustling centre in our stylish aparthotel. With Temple Bar, Trinity College, and the Guinness Storehouse just a hop, skip, and a pint away, you’d be hard pressed to find a more convenient location to explore the city. Plus, we're right next to Dublin Castle and only a short stroll from the city's main shopping and business districts. *Dublin got its name from Black Pool (Dubh Linn), a deep dark pool located in Dublin Castle.

746677.description: There is Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. The reception desk is not open throughout the day.

746822.description: With a stay at Hostal La Creu in Mora d'Ebre, you'll be within a 15-minute drive of Embarcadero de Miravet and Platja dels Illons de Púello. This pension is 29. 6 mi (47. 7 km) from Cambrils Beach and 5 mi (8 km) from Miravet Castle. Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. At Hostal La Creu, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10 AM. Make yourself at home in one of the 15 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and fans, and housekeeping is provided daily.

748185.description: Rentalmar Family Acantilados is located on Salou's Levant Beach, 500 m from the town centre and nightlife area. Each three-bedroom apartment features a private terrace with sea views. Apartments come with a living room with a double sofa bed. Each has 2 bathrooms with bath tubs. The kitchen and dining area includes a fridge and an oven. Currency exchange is available at the apartments. You will find lots of shops, bars and restaurants within a short walk.

748187.description: Rentalmar Aries Plus is set in Salou and offers a community garden. PortAventura is 1. 4 km from the property. The accommodation is air conditioned and features a seating and dining area. There is also a kitchen, equipped with a micorwave. Bed linen is available. Safes can be rented. Guests can use the swimming pool located at Rentalmar Los Peces, 100 m from the property. Ferrari Land is 1. 6 km from Rentalmar Aries Plus. The nearest airport is Reus Airport, 8 km from the property.

748201.description: Boasting a terrace and a 24-hour front desk, Rentalmar Atlantida Apartamentos is conveniently located in Llevant Beach district of Salou, 2. 8 km from Cala Font Beach and 1. 7 km from PortAventura. Guests staying at this apartment have access to a balcony. This apartment includes 2 bedrooms, a living room and a flat-screen TV, an equipped kitchen with a dining area, and 1 bathroom with a shower and a washing machine. Ferrari Land is 1. 8 km from the apartment, while House Of Illusion is 400 m from the property. The nearest airport is Reus Airport, 8 km from Rentalmar Atlantida Apartamentos.

Some services of INNSiDE by Melia Newcastle may be payable.

748270.description: Situated 1. 3 km from PortAventura, Rentalmar Salou Playa Family Suites features accommodation with a seasonal outdoor swimming pool, a terrace and a 24-hour front desk for your convenience. Each unit has a balcony, a fully equipped kitchenette with a dishwasher, a seating area, a flat-screen TV, a washing machine, and a private bathroom with shower and a hairdryer. A microwave and fridge are also offered, as well as a coffee machine. Ferrari Land is 1. 5 km from the apartment, while House Of Illusion is 1. 1 km from the property. The nearest airport is Reus Airport, 8 km from Rentalmar Salou Playa Family Suites.

748273.description: Guests will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Rentalmar Tarraco as it counts with a total of 3 accomodation units.

748464.description: This cosy property guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 10 guest rooms. Those who stay at this establishment may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas. The front desk offers 24-hour reception.

749643.description:
Great Western Hotel Aberdeen is a welcoming 22-room hotel less than two miles from Aberdeen city centre and 6. 5 miles from Aberdeen Airport. The location is ideal for exploring the Granite City, with Aberdeen Harbour, the Maritime Museum, and the historic University of Aberdeen campus all a short drive away. The beaches of Aberdeen's coastline and the scenic castles and countryside of Royal Deeside are also within easy reach, while guests travelling for work will find the city's business districts and industrial estates conveniently close. 

Every stay includes complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, and street parking is available near the hotel. The on-site Malacca seafood restaurant and bar serves freshly prepared dishes, and the spacious beer garden is the perfect spot to relax with a drink on a sunny afternoon. 

Please note that the latest check-in time is 10pm; guests arriving later should contact the hotel in advance to arrange their check-in.

Located in Antrim, Ballyharvey House B&B is in a rural location, within a 10-minute drive of Antrim Castle and Antrim Motte.  This bed & breakfast is 14.2 mi (22.9 km) from Crumlin Road Jail and 17 mi (27.4 km) from Belfast Castle.

Make yourself at home in one of the 3 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring refrigerators and LED televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless Internet access is available. Conveniences include coffee/tea makers and complimentary bottled water, and housekeeping is provided daily.

755685.description: With a stay at Banyers House in Royston, you'll be within a 15-minute drive of Imperial War Museum Duxford and RSPB Fowlmere Nature Reserve. This 4-star inn is 12. 8 mi (20. 6 km) from Addenbrooke's Hospital and 12. 9 mi (20. 8 km) from University of Cambridge. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and coffee/tea makers.

756058.description: Located in Castleford, a few steps from The Jungle, Wheldale Hotel features a bar, a shared lounge and a garden, as well as free WiFi and room service. At the inn, every room is equipped with a desk. A Full English/Irish breakfast is available daily at Wheldale Hotel. The accommodation offers a children's playground. 1022756.description: Apart Hotel Adelboden am Dorfplatz enjoys a location in Adelboden, 17 miles from Car Transport Lötschberg and 26 miles from Wilderswil. Private parking is available on site. Free Wifi is available throughout the property, as well as a terrace and a restaurant. The property also offers accommodation for disabled guests. The condo hotel provides guests with a balcony, mountain views, a seating area, satellite flat-screen TV, a fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher and an oven, and a private bathroom with walk-in shower and a hair dryer. A microwave, a toaster, and fridge are also available, as well as a coffee machine and a kettle. At the condo hotel, every unit comes with bed linen and towels. There is a coffee shop, and a mini-market is also available. Sightseeing tours are available close to the property. Skiing and cycling can be enjoyed nearby, while a bicycle rental service and ski storage space are also available on-site. Interlaken Ost Train Station is 26 miles from Apart Hotel Adelboden am Dorfplatz. EuroAirport Basel Airport is 103 miles from the property.

1022877.description: Astra Hostel features a total of 22 guest rooms.

1023717.description: The Holiday Inn Express Liverpool Central is located less than a mile from Liverpool Lime Street station and 8 miles from Liverpool John Lennon Airport. With close connections to the M62 Motorway and M53 Motorway. The hotel is located within the vibrant and historic Ropewalks district of the city, within walking distance of many of Liverpool’s city centre attractions, including The Royal Albert Dock, Shopping at Liverpool ONE, The Beatles Story and Liverpool Cathedral. It is conveniently located less than half a mile from the M&S Bank Arena, the home of Eurovision 2023. All guests can enjoy an inclusive Express Start Breakfast, with options including bacon, sausage, scrambled eggs, pastries, cereals, yoghurts and more. The hotel also offers lunch and dinner, where kids under 12 eat free, or relax with a drink in the Lounge Bar.

1023772.description: A Warm Welcome To Your Liverpool HotelThe Perfect 4 Star Hotel In Central LiverpoolIdeally located in the heart of the city centre, Maldron Hotel Liverpool is just minutes away from the city’s star attractions. The excellent transport links combined with the convenient central location make Maldron Hotel Liverpool an ideal choice for business trips or visiting family and friends. Liverpool Lime Street Station is less than 15 minutes’ walk, James Street and Liverpool Central Stations are an easy 10-minute walk and Liverpool John Lennon Airport is a short 20-minute drive. Culture vultures will love concerts, comedy, and sports at the M&S Bank Arena, whilst history buffs take in the rich stories of the Royal Albert Docks. The hotel is just a short walk from the retail paradise that is Liverpool One and Beatles fans will find loads of great attractions and famous sites within an easy walk of the hotel. Settle into any of our 268 modern, comfortable, and spacious rooms, or fit in a workout at the gym. Then head down to our warm, welcoming Grain & Grill bar and restaurant, open all day for moreish meals, satisfying snacks and delicious drinks.

1023774.description: Our very first Scottish location complete with 74 swanky serviced apartments (some with their very own balcony), and a terrace with breath-taking views over the city’s historic landscape. Just a short walk to Edinburgh Playhouse and Usher Hall and a short drive to Murrayfield Stadium. Roomzzz Edinburgh is located in the heart of St James Quarter – a hub for famous brand shops, high- end eateries and bars, a variety of fashion, fitness and beauty stores, luxury residential buildings, and home to the most famous elite brands. Choose from 74 striking apartments in prime location, with a terrace and balconies to appreciate breath-taking views of the city’s historical landscape.

1024012.description: Enjoy a central Glasgow location at V City Aparthotels, situated a short 5-minute drive from the OVO Hydro and the Scottish Exhibition and Conference Centre. This aparthotel offers individually furnished guestrooms with kitchens equipped with full-sized refrigerators/freezers, ovens, and microwaves. Relax on your memory foam bed and enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and a flat-screen TV. Weekly housekeeping and separate sitting areas add to your comfort. The aparthotel also features a business center and express check-in/check-out. Self-parking is available for a fee. You'll be just a short walk from Grosvenor Casino Glasgow Riverboat, and various attractions in Merchant City. Hampden Park is 2. 8 miles (4. 5 km) away.

1024103.description: Guests will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Apartamentos Sol Y Mar Segur 3000 as it counts with a total of 10 accomodation units. This apartment does not offer 24-hour reception.

1024623.description: The Chancery Hotel, located in the heart of Dublin 8 on Ship Street Great, offers guests a vibrant and unique neighborhood experience. Explore historic landmarks, local artisan food producers, and the studios of fashion designers and artists in this exciting up-and-coming area. The hotel, built in 2024, features 150 rooms and offers complimentary Wi-Fi in public areas. A 24-hour reception ensures guests' needs are met day and night. Some services may incur a fee.

1024878.description: Located in Miami Platja, one of the privileged areas of the Costa Dorada, ideal for relaxing and enjoying a family vacation. Villa California enjoys an excellent location in the tourist center of the city, 1km from the beautiful coves and beaches with calm and warm waters. The sunny and hot climate makes it one of the ideal locations to enjoy a sun, sea and beach holiday. At Villa California you can take a dip in your private pool or prepare a barbecue by the pool. In a very quiet area, away from noise and perfect to be isolated to rest. It has large outdoor spaces to walk or play sports. The Paseo Marítimo and Platja Cristall are located 2km from the villas, where you will find numerous restaurants, beach bars, playgrounds and a wide range of nautical activities. In addition, it is located close to other tourist places such as Cambrils (15km), Salou / Port Aventura (20km) and Tarragona (34km), making it an excellent option for those looking to explore the area.

1025007.description: Situated in Belfast, within 1. 1 km of The Belfast Empire Music Hall and 3. 7 km of The Waterfront Hall, The Harrison Chambers of Distinction features accommodations with a terrace and free WiFi throughout the property, as well as free private parking for guests who drive. The property is 4. 3 km from SSE Arena, 5. 2 km from Titanic Belfast, and 300 meters from the Ulster Museum. The accommodations offer room service, a concierge service, and tour organization. At the hotel, each room is fitted with a desk. Private bathrooms are equipped with a shower, free toiletries, and a hairdryer. Rooms also include bed linens and towels. The daily breakfast offers buffet, continental, or vegetarian options. Botanic Gardens Belfast is 700 meters from the accommodation, while St. Peter's Cathedral is 3. 1 km away. The nearest airport is George Best Belfast City Airport, 7 km from The Harrison Chambers of Distinction.

1025087.description: Situated in the center of Liverpool with stunning views of the city’s iconic Liver Buildings, Albert Dock, and the river Mersey, our waterfront apartments are the perfect place to stay if you are looking for a quiet and relaxing location. Just a short walk away, you will find yourself spoilt for choice at the variety of shops, bars and eateries in the heart of the city centre. This property do not have a front desk, in order to check in, please contact the property in advance enquiries@alurapartments. co. uk or +447517140529 & +441512038814

1025166.description: There are a total of 271 rooms on the premises. This hotel was constructed in 2024. Our newest hotel CABINN Plus Esbjerg is our new addition to our already existing hotel CABINN Esbjerg. Plus stands for larger rooms and more facilities. A modern hotel following a 20-year-old city plan. The hotel has the best location at Torvegade 27 on the old Rio plot close to the city square.

name.content: Ruby Molly Hotel Dublin by IHG

1025475.description: Ruby Molly offers 272 rooms and is conveniently located close to the River Liffey, ensuring easy access to Dublin's best. A quick 10-minute walk brings you to the lively Temple Bar area, while the Guinness Storehouse and Phoenix Park are just a 25-minute stroll away. Guests can start their day with a healthy breakfast buffet and enjoy signature cocktails and snacks. The Four Courts station is right around the corner, and the airport can be reached in 40 minutes by bus or tram.

1026124.description: With fifty-five uniquely designed units, The Leinster offers a delightful experience. From sky-high dining at Jean-Georges on the rooftop to enjoying martinis in The Collins Club, The Leinster provides exciting new spaces for locals and guests alike. Across four floors, each room features a harmonious blend of lavish velvets, detailed cabinetry, and bold colors, elegantly paired with graphic patterns. With a nod to a rich history, each room exudes a sense of simple beauty and provides every comfort.

1026291.description: Set in the heart of the Scottish capital, 100 Princes Street embodies the very best of Edinburgh and beyond, deftly fusing the Scottish capital’s intense history with 21st century hospitality excellence, in an utterly unique luxury townhouse hotel with uniterrupted views of Edinburgh Castle. We have rooms to suit every mood and occasion – and every type of relaxing escape. Whether you are stopping for a night or making 100 Princes Street your Edinburgh base for a leisurely cultural immersion, every one of our incredibly well-dressed guest rooms has been individually designed. Embark on a gastronomic journey like no other in hearty fare and exquisite flavours in The Wallace, or enjoy an intimate private gathering at Ghillie's Pantry surrounded by a curated collection of rare whiskies. Our dining and drinking venues are reserved exclusively for residents.

1026388.address: 11 Bow Lane East St Stephen's Green Dublin 2 D02 A
1026388.description: Marlin offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. This hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. Marlin has wheelchair-accessible common areas. Some services may be payable.

1027239.description: The Social Hub Glasgow is a modern, hybrid-hospitality hotel designed to cater to the needs of both travelers and locals looking for a dynamic and interactive environment. Situated in the vibrant city of Glasgow, this hotel combines comfortable accommodations with innovative social spaces that encourage interaction and networking. The property features a range of room options, from private suites to shared rooms, making it ideal for various types of visitors, including students, digital nomads, and tourists. What sets The Social Hub Glasgow apart is its emphasis on creating a community-centric experience. The hotel hosts regular events and workshops that facilitate cultural exchange and learning opportunities. Additionally, The Social Hub Glasgow is equipped with state-of-the-art facilities, including coworking spaces, a fitness center, and multiple dining options that cater to diverse tastes and dietary needs. The interior design is modern and welcoming, incorporating local art and sustainable materials, which reflect the city’s rich cultural heritage and contemporary ethos. This establishment not only offers a place to stay but also serves as a bustling social hotspot, making it a unique player in Glasgow's hospitality landscape.

1028163.description: When you step inside this historic monument from 1917, the personal, warm and cozy atmosphere will hit you immediately. Wherever you move around this house, you will experience that quality, aesthetics and charm are put in the front seat. Already on the trip up to our mountain paradise, you will recognize the feeling of lowering shoulders. Find your own favorite chair, and with the sound of crackling wood in the fireplace you allow yourself to be seduced and excited - of a good book, the beautiful view or the host's exciting stories about the cabin or from the surrounding area at Ustaoset. Soon you can smell the chef's preparations for the evening's mountain gourmet dinner. At 'Hallinghi' you can disconnect or connect, with the group of friends, the extended family or the management group.

1028429.description: Reial 1 Apartments, a newly constructed building (2021), enjoys a prime location in Tarragona. Just steps from the beach, the port, and the train station, it's also conveniently located near the Palace of Congresses and a short 5-minute walk from the city center. This 7-story building offers 30 apartments for stays ranging from two nights to eleven months. Each apartment features air conditioning, heating, and hot water, all powered by sustainable aerothermal energy. Excellent thermal and sound insulation ensures a comfortable stay. The one and two-bedroom apartments are fully equipped, and each room is outward-facing, providing exceptional natural light. Select apartments also include a terrace or balcony.

1029410.description: This property offers a total of 24 units.

1029437.description: Tgna Cervantes 8 offers city views and comfortable accommodations in Tarragona, less than 1 km from Playa del Miracle and 1. 9 km from Platja dels Cossis. This apartment complex features air-conditioned units with free WiFi and family rooms available. Select units include a satellite flat-screen TV, a fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher, and a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer. Some units are also soundproof. Guests can easily access sightseeing tours and enjoy the convenience of nearby attractions, including Marina Tarragona, Palacio de Congresos, and Sala Zero. The nearest airport is Reus, 9 km from the property, and a paid airport shuttle service is available. This intimate 14-unit property is ideal for a peaceful stay. Guests can also take advantage of Wi-Fi in public areas and wheelchair-accessible communal spaces. Please note that a 24-hour reception is not available.

1029617.description: Enjoy modern comfort and convenience at the Telegraph Hotel in Coventry City Centre. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi in your air-conditioned guest room, equipped with a safe, coffee/tea maker, and digital programming. The hotel features a restaurant, snack bar/deli, and bar/lounge for your dining and relaxation needs. Concierge services, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box are also available. Explore nearby attractions like the Coventry Transport Museum and Lady Godiva Statue, both within a short walk. The hotel is also a convenient base for visiting the University of Warwick and Resorts World Birmingham, both within a 15-minute drive.

1030088.description:
Plas Gwyn Halls, Cardiff Met offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. The reception desk is open all day long. Parking facilities are available for guests' convenience. Some services of Plas Gwyn Halls, Cardiff Met may be payable. 

Plas Gwyn is ideally situated to visit the city centre, many historic sites in and around Cardiff as well as the beautiful Welsh mountains and coastline. The city centre is a short walk along the Taff Trail or a bus ride away from where you can visit Cardiff Castle and the Millennium Stadium and shop in the old Victorian Arcades. Cardiff Bay, accessible by car or public transport, is where you will find many restaurants and cafés as well as the Millennium Centre and Norwegian Church. 

All rooms are Single Ensuite in flats of 8 with access to a shared kitchen. All rooms are provided with bed linen and 2 towels on arrival.

name.content: Kiki Beach Resort Batam By Zuzu

1030902.description:
Kiki Beach Resort, Batam provides the best in services and amenities to help make guests feel comfortable. Post your pictures and answer your emails whenever you want, with the hotel's free Wi-Fi internet access. Parking is always available, provided by the hotel for their driving guests. In-room conveniences include daily housekeeping, so you can enjoy your stay. 

Guestrooms are designed to provide an optimal level of comfort with welcoming decor and essential amenities. The hotel provides blackout curtains and air conditioning in some rooms for the benefit of guests. Some selected rooms at Kiki Beach Resort include a balcony or terrace, as part of the room design/

The hotel provides all the amenities that a guest expects, including free bottled water, instant coffee, toiletries and towels. Secure your stay today and begin your unforgettable adventure in the heart of Batam, Indonesia.

1031268.description: The hotel is located in the rural town of Gadmen, in the heart of the Swiss Alps. Gadmen belongs to the municipality of Innertkirchen. Gadmen is a beautiful hiking, climbing, mountain biking, skiing and cross-country skiing area. In February, Gadmen is the venue for the international sled dog race. With open passes, Valais and Ticino are an eventful stone's throw away. By car you can reach Innertkirchen in around 16 minutes and Meiringen in around 23 minutes. The Obermaad bus stop is right in front of the hotel. A bus leaves every hour in the direction of Innertkirchen, Grimseltor. The hotel is ideal for accommodating groups or individuals. Enjoy the convenience of complimentary parking during your stay, making your arrival and departure hassle-free at our hotel. Stay connected effortlessly with complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi throughout our hotel.

1032229.description: Guests are welcomed at the environmentally-friendly accomodation.

1033307.description: Located in the heart of Chester, The Hotel Chester offers luxurious accommodations within a 15-minute walk of Chester City Walls and Chester Racecourse. The hotel features 16 guestrooms equipped with kitchenettes (including stovetops and microwaves), Select Comfort beds, and 32-inch Smart TVs. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, minibars, and daily housekeeping. Concierge services and a cozy lobby fireplace add to your comfort. Chester Zoo is 3. 6 miles away, and Cheshire Oaks Designer Outlet is 6. 9 miles from the hotel.

1033356.description: Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. Unfortunately, the front desk is not open 24 hours. The hotel may charge a fee for some services.

Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is available, along with free self-parking. Each of the four guestrooms offers a comfortable retreat. A fee applies for breakfast. The Talkhouse is conveniently located within a 10-minute drive of John Radcliffe Hospital and the Headington Shark, and a short drive from Oxford city centre.

1033653.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and a fireplace in the lobby. This hotel also features a banquet hall and a vending machine. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli serving guests of Moxy Edinburgh Fountainbridge. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and electric kettles, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

1033682.description: The Glendale Hotel in Penarth offers 15 comfortable guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, en-suite bathrooms with bathtubs or showers, and convenient amenities such as coffee/tea makers and desks. Enjoy a delicious meal at the on-site restaurant and bar/lounge, with English breakfasts available daily for a fee. Located a short drive from Cardiff Bay and Cardiff University, the hotel provides easy access to local attractions such as the Turner House Gallery and Alexandra Gardens. A short drive from the hotel, you can find also the beautiful Cosmeston Lakes Country Park and several important landmarks related to the history of the city.

1033863.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Featured amenities include express check-in and express check-out. 1033871.description: Enjoy modern comforts like complimentary Wi-Fi and Smart TVs in each of the 32 guestrooms at the Crown Hotel Stone. Located in Stone, the hotel offers pillowtop beds with luxurious Frette Italian sheets and private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Savor lunch or dinner at Hollands Restaurant, grab a snack at the coffee shop, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A continental breakfast is available daily for a fee. Other amenities include wedding services, a fireplace in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, and free self-parking. Explore nearby attractions such as Trentham Monkey Forest and Trentham Gardens (within a 10-minute drive), World of Wedgwood, and Royal Stoke University Hospital.

1033885.description: Indulge in massages, body treatments, and facials at this luxurious Edinburgh hotel. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy the convenience of concierge services. Savor delicious meals at one of the two on-site restaurants, including SUSHISAMBA, or order from the 24-hour room service. Unwind at one of the two bars/lounges. The hotel offers express check-in/check-out and dry cleaning/laundry services. For events, there's 3, 046 square feet (283 square meters) of space, including conference space and five meeting rooms. Each of the 244 air-conditioned rooms features a minibar, LCD TV, and digital programming. Private bathrooms include hair dryers and bathrobes. Additional conveniences include phones, laptop-compatible safes, and electric kettles. Located in the heart of Edinburgh, the hotel is steps from St. James Quarter and a short walk from Princes Street, placing you near top attractions like George Street and the Edinburgh Playhouse Theatre. The preferred airport is Edinburgh Airport (EDI).

1033900.description: The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. The Lawrence does not operate a 24-hour reception. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

1033921.description: The Mad Hatter Oxford offers individually decorated guestrooms with minibars, LED TVs, and premium bedding. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, digital programming, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads. The hotel features a restaurant, bar/lounge, and banquet hall. Located in East Oxford, it's steps from the University of Oxford and a short walk from Christ Church College. Convenient express check-in/check-out is also available.

1034365.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as complimentary bicycles and a terrace overlooking the garden. This aparthotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a picnic area. Room service is available, and continental breakfast can be purchased. Additional amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Free self-parking is available onsite. The 12 air-conditioned rooms feature kitchenettes equipped with refrigerators and microwaves, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, phones, safes, and electric kettles. Located in the heart of Paihia, the Outrigger Motel is within a 5-minute walk of Paihia Wharf and Paihia Beach, and 1. 7 miles from the Waitangi Treaty Grounds. Other nearby attractions include the Bay of Islands, St. Paul's Church, and the Opua Forest. The preferred airport is Kerikeri (KKE-Bay of Islands), 14. 3 miles away.

1034597.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden at Ravelston House, a beachfront hotel in Musselburgh. Start your day with a complimentary English breakfast and savor a meal at the on-site restaurant and bar. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and relax in your room with a flat-screen TV and espresso maker. This hotel also offers wedding services and a banquet hall. You'll be within a 15-minute drive of Princes Street and the Royal Mile, with Edinburgh Castle and the University of Edinburgh easily accessible.

1034760.description: Enjoy a complimentary breakfast at the onsite cafe at Arthurs, a charming bed and breakfast in Hillsborough. The 13 guestrooms offer a comfortable home base for exploring the area. Nearby attractions include Hillsborough Fort (0. 8 km), St Malachy's Parish Church (0. 8 km), and Hillsborough Castle (4 km). You'll also be within a 15-minute drive of Queen's University of Belfast. For those flying in, Belfast City Airport (BHD) is 25. 8 km away, and Belfast International Airport (BFS) is 41. 4 km from the property.

1034811.description: Nestled near the ski lifts in Kandersteg, Hotel Ermitage offers stunning views of the Swiss Alps. Enjoy a complimentary buffet breakfast each morning, relax in the sauna, or unwind in the garden. The hotel features 18 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Free self-parking and ski storage are available onsite. Explore nearby attractions like Oeschinen Lake and the Oeschinensee Kandersteg Gondola, both within a 5-minute drive.

1034826.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at Merrion Square Studios, a guesthouse located in Dublin's City Centre, within a 15-minute walk of Trinity College and St. Stephen's Green. Our 12 guestrooms feature kitchenettes equipped with refrigerators, stovetops, and microwaves. A 40-inch Smart TV with satellite programming and complimentary Wi-Fi are also provided. Nearby attractions include the Grand Canal, Merrion Square, the National Gallery of Ireland, and the Bord Gáis Energy Theatre, all within a short distance. Dublin Airport (DUB) is 8. 6 miles away.

1034838.description: Set in Edinburgh and with Murrayfield Stadium reachable within 1. 6 km, Tynecastle Park Hotel offers concierge services, non-smoking rooms, a restaurant, free WiFi throughout the property and a bar. This 4-star hotel offers room service and a 24-hour front desk. The hotel has family rooms. The hotel will provide guests with air-conditioned rooms offering a desk, a kettle, a fridge, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a shower. All guest rooms feature a wardrobe. Tynecastle Park Hotel offers a buffet or Full English/Irish breakfast. Edinburgh International Conference Centre is 1. 8 km from the accommodation, while Edinburgh Castle is 2. 4 km from the property. Edinburgh Airport is 8 km away.

1034872.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace at Lymedale Suites in Newcastle-Under-Lyme. Make use of complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. The on-site Lymedale Bar & Dine offers delicious meals, and you can unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. The aparthotel provides luggage storage, laundry facilities, and a vending machine for your convenience. The 69 guestrooms feature kitchens equipped with refrigerators and stovetops, flat-screen televisions, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Desks and microwaves are also provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Lymedale Suites is a short drive from the New Vic Theatre and Keele University, and within easy reach of Royal Stoke University Hospital and Waterworld.

1034994.description: Enjoy a complimentary continental breakfast served daily between 8:30 AM and 10:00 AM at the Anelli Hotel, a golf hotel located in Southport, a short walk from the Southport Theatre and Floral Hall. Make yourself at home in one of the nine air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a Smart TV, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include rainfall showerheads and hair dryers. Free self-parking is also available onsite. Nearby attractions include the Thames Path, Wittenham Clumps, and Dorchester Abbey. Oxford Airport (OXF) is the nearest major airport.

Guests can enjoy conveniences such as desks and daily housekeeping. Bathrooms are equipped with showers. Free self-parking is available on-site, and the hotel provides designated smoking areas. Nearby attractions include Batam Center Shopping Area and Batam Centre. The preferred airport is Batam Batu Besar (BTH-Hang Nadim).

For smokers, designated areas are provided.

1062328.description: Enjoy ski-in/ski-out access at this mountain hotel, featuring outdoor tennis courts, complimentary Wi-Fi, ski storage, and a banquet hall. Dine at the on-site restaurant or grab a snack at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge after a day on the slopes. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Laundry facilities and a library are also available for guests' convenience. The hotel offers 19 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, cable programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include phones, desks, and electric kettles. Located in Lauterbrunnen, the Drei Berge Hotel is within a 5-minute walk of Allmendhubelbahn and the Alpine Sports Centre Mürren, and a short distance from Schilthornbahn and Via Ferrata.

1062576.description: Enjoy a complimentary continental breakfast at NO. TEN GUESTHOUSE, served daily between 7:30 AM and 9:00 AM. Housekeeping is provided daily. Located in Tain, the guesthouse is steps from Tain Through Time and Browns Gallery, 0. 6 miles from Tain Golf Course, and 1. 2 miles from Glenmorangie Distillery. 1062719.description: Enjoy garden views and amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at this charming inn. Private bathrooms include rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries, along with coffee/tea makers and complimentary bottled water. Located in a rural setting in Craigavon, Clenaghans is within a 15-minute drive of Oxford Island Nature Reserve and Hillsborough Fort. It's also conveniently close to Lisburn Leisure Park (8. 7 mi) and Lisburn Cathedral (9. 3 mi).

1063134.description: Located in Inverness City Centre, Rooms in Inverness is a charming guesthouse within a 15-minute walk of Inverness Castle and the Victorian Market. The hotel provides 40 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable programming. Each room includes a bathroom with a shower, complimentary newspapers, and a fan. Guests can also enjoy room service during limited hours, express check-in/check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and free self-parking.

1063727.description: This hotel offers 40 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each room includes a private bathroom with a shower. With a stay at Niche Living Dun Laoghaire in Dublin (Dun Laoghaire), you'll be within a 15-minute drive of Trinity College and Dublin Port. This aparthotel is 6. 8 mi (11 km) from St. Stephen's Green and 7. 9 mi (12. 7 km) from Croke Park.

1065127.description: Enjoy a central Oxford stay at Crown House, a charming bed and breakfast featuring nine well-appointed guestrooms equipped with Smart TVs and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can also appreciate conveniences such as desks and complimentary bottled water, with daily housekeeping provided. The front desk operates during limited hours. Located a short drive from the University of Oxford (2 minutes) and John Radcliffe Hospital (7 minutes), Crown House offers easy access to key attractions. Blenheim Palace is 10. 5 miles (16. 9 km) away, and Bicester Village is 14. 8 miles (23. 9 km) away. Nearby points of interest include Greyfriars Oxford, South Park, University & Pitt Rivers Museums, St Hilda's College, Magdalen College, Warneford Hospital, Iffley Road Track, Merton College, Oxford Brookes University, University Botanic Gardens, New College, University College, Examination Schools, and The Queen's College. The nearest major airport is Oxford (OXF), 9. 2 miles (14. 8 km) from the property.

Free self-parking, express check-in/out, and luggage storage are also available. Nearby attractions include Chester Zoo and Cheshire Oaks Designer Outlet.

At the hotel every room is equipped with air conditioning, a desk, a flat-screen TV, a private bathroom, bed linen, towels and a balcony with a city view. Guest rooms will provide guests with a closet and a coffee machine. Ferrari Land is 23 miles from Hotel Secrets Priorat, while Marina Tarragona is 28 miles away. The nearest airport is Reus, 21 miles from the accommodation, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

1067092.description: Located in Dunfermline, 8. 4 miles from Forth Bridge, The Inn At Charlestown provides accommodations with a garden, free private parking, a shared lounge and a restaurant. With free WiFi, this 3-star hotel offers room service. Guests can use a bar. Hopetoun House is 9. 2 miles from the hotel, while Edinburgh Zoo is 15 miles away. Edinburgh Airport is 12 miles from the property.

1067121.description: The Chieftain Hotel in Inverness offers bed and breakfast accommodations, within a 4-minute drive of the city center and train station. It’s also home to a lively sports bar and serves a wide selection of Scottish and world dishes throughout the day. Smartly decorated rooms at The Chieftain offer free Wi-Fi, and all have private bathrooms and a flat-screen TV. There is complementary tea , coffee and biscuits, as well as free parking. A cooked Scottish breakfast is served each morning, as well as cereals, yogurt and more. An extensive bar menu offers light meals and snacks, while mains include local specialties like Highland Chicken and Haggis, Neeps and Tatties. Inverness has plenty to see, with its museum and art gallery, cathedral and castle, and the surrounding area has swathes of unspoiled countryside for walkers to explore. Historic properties including Cawdor Castle and Fort George are less than 25 minutes’ drive from the hotel.

1067662.description: Comfortable Accommodations: Apartment Bergsonne in Samnaun offers family rooms with garden or mountain views. Each unit includes a kitchenette, private bathroom, and balcony. Free WiFi is available throughout the aparthotel. Wellness and Leisure: Guests can enjoy spa facilities, a sauna, and a sun terrace. The property features a solarium, steam room, and fitness centre. Additional amenities include a lounge, outdoor dining area, and bicycle parking. Dining and Services: A continental buffet breakfast with local specialities, fresh pastries, cheese, fruits, and juice is served daily. Private check-in and check-out, a tour desk, and luggage storage enhance the stay. Activities and Attractions: Ski-to-door access, ski storage, and a tour desk provide opportunities for skiing, walking, hiking, and cycling. Lake Resia is 35 km away, and the Public Health Bath - Hot Spring is 38 km from the aparthotel.

1067689.description: Hotel Plaça De La Font is situated in the centre of Tarragona’s Old Town, 500 metres from the sea. It offers rooms with air conditioning, a TV and private bathroom. The Miracle and Arrabassada Beaches are 10 minutes from the Plaça De La Font by car. Guests can find public parking 5 metres from the hotel. The bar-restaurant at Plaça De La Font offers a fixed price menu from Monday to Saturday. It features a terrace in front of the hotel in the square. City Park is a 10-minute walk from Plaça De La Font Hotel. Tarragona’s National Museum of Archaeology is 200 metres away.

1067751.description: The Alpenclub hotel in Engelberg offers you charming Alpine-style rooms combined with up-to-date facilities as well as tasty Swiss food. During winter time the Käsestube offers raclette, various cheese fondues and other cheese specialties. The Gadä bar of the Alpenclub hotel is a traditional Après-Ski meeting point in Engelberg. The summer terrace invites you to relax during the warmer months, while enjoying the beautiful mountain panorama. The stop of the free ski bus is reachable within 2 minutes' walk.

1067769.description: Set in the heart of Engelberg, boutique-hotel Ski Lodge Engelberg provides individually decorated rooms and gourmet cuisine close to the ski slopes and cable cars. WiFi is free of charge. Guests can enjoy a hearty breakfast with freshly squeezed orange juice every morning either indoors or on the sun terrace. The heated hot tub and the sauna in the garden can be used free of charge. All uniquely designed rooms of the Ski Lodge provide LCD cable TVs and bathrooms. International specialties ranging from roasted duck breast to homemade sorbets are served at the Engelberg. Guests can also enjoy a wide range of fine wines and locally brewed beer. Ski Lodge Engelberg is only a few steps from the train station. Zurich Airport is a 1. 5 hour car ride away and a shuttle service is provided upon request.

1067774.description: Offering direct access to the slopes of the Silvretta Arena Samnaun Ski Area, the newly-renovated Waldpark Hotel Garni overlooks the village of Samnaun and offers free WiFi in all areas and a modern spa area featuring a brine steam cabin and a relaxation room with panoramic mountain views. The cable car can be reached on skis. The rooms and suites were renovated in 2014 and come with modern Alpine-style furniture and views of the Piz Ot Mountain. They feature a flat-screen TV and a bathroom with bathrobes and hairdryer. A large breakfast buffet is served each morning in the Waldpark’s breakfast room, which was refurbished in 2014 and where guests can also enjoy views of the Alpine panorama. Waldpark Hotel Garni features a ski storage room with a ski boot dryer. In the afternoon, the Waldpark offers a transfer service back to the hotel with its own ski bus. Renovated in 2014, the spa area also features Finnish sauna, an infrared cabin and a salt water bath . Free private parking is possible.

1067835.description: The Hotel Bären welcomes you in the heart of Adelboden in the Bernese Oberland, just 150 meters from the bus station. Enjoy the various possibilities right in the village center. The cable cars can be easily reached by foot or by local bus. In the summer you benefit from the free railway pass (subject to availability). We would be happy to spoil you with culinary delights in our cosy restaurant or on our terrace. You can start your day with breakfast directly in our Restaurant Bären. Our small wellness facility is open on request from 3 to 6 p. m. and includes a sauna, a steam bath and a sanarium as well as a relaxation area. The cosy rooms are equipped with cable TV, a coffee machine, a safe and a modern bathroom, some with a rainforest shower. The use of the WiFi is free of charge. Most rooms have a balcony, and all are easily accessible by elevator. The studios are also located in the center about 200 m from the hotel, in the Vogellisi building where the Kiosk-Treff and the Vogellisibar are located. They have a kitchen, a dining table, a living room or a living area with cable TV and a modern bathroom with a shower. On request, parking spaces are available in our own underground car park.

1067911.description: Less than 10 minutes’ walk from Nairn’s coast, this hotel offers free, high-speed Wi-Fi access throughout. Each modern room has an en suite bathroom with a selection of free toiletries. Free off-road parking is provided and Nairn town centre is just a 5-minute walk away. Dolphins can be spotted off the coast and 2 championship golf courses are within 5 minutes’ drive of The Albert Inn. Inverness Airport is less than 10 minutes’ drive away and Inverness’ lovely city centre can be reached after a 20-minute drive. Guests can enjoy a full Scottish breakfast in Albert Inn's dining room and there is also an on-site bar to relax with a drink in.

1067913.description: The Cromore Halt is located in Portstewart and is less than 2 miles from a sandy beach. It offers rooms with free Wi-Fi, a restaurant and bistro and free parking. Rooms at Cromore feature bathrooms with power showers, satellite TVs and hairdryers. Safety deposit boxes, telephones and tea/coffee making facilities are also provided. The restaurant serves lunches and has an evening dining menu with vegetarian and gluten free options. The bistro offers modern cuisine in an informal dining environment. The Cromore Halt is less than a 20-minute drive from the famous Bushmills Distillery. Cromore is ideally placed to explore the Giant’s Causeway and the stunning North Antrim coastline.

1067929.description: Comfortable Accommodation: Gîte du Prilet in Saint-Luc offers a welcoming inn with ski-to-door access, a garden, terrace, restaurant, bar, and free WiFi. Guests enjoy a continental buffet breakfast with juice, fresh pastries, cheese, and fruits. Dining Experience: The family-friendly restaurant serves American, pizza, local, and European cuisines, including vegetarian, vegan, and dairy-free options. The traditional ambience creates a cosy atmosphere for meals. Activities and Surroundings: Guests can enjoy skiing and cycling in the surrounding area. The inn is 35 km from Crans-sur-Sierre Golf Club, 37 km from Sion and Crans-Montana, and 37 km from Crans-Montana. A restaurant is available nearby. Guest Satisfaction: Highly rated for its attentive staff and excellent service support, Gîte du Prilet is ideal for a ski trip. The convenient location enhances the overall experience.

1067934.address: Route Du Simplon 69 1958 St Lv Onard
1067934.description: Motel-Restaurant 13 Etoiles is set in the charming, small village Saint Léonard and is surrounded by vineyards and meadows. It offers modern rooms with a TV and free Wi-Fi. All rooms are functionally furnished with wooden floors, a work desk and private bathrooms with a hairdryer. A bar and restaurant are also on site. Traditional local dishes are served in the dining room or on the partly covered terrace in nice weather. Motel-Restaurant 13 Etoiles features a ski storage room. Crans-Montana and Anzère Cable Cars are a 25-minute drive away. Guests can explore Europe’s largest subterranean lake in Saint Léonard – the Lac souterrain St. Léonard. It is 400 metres away and guided tours are offered there. Free private parking is offered at the motel.

1068066.description: A 9-minute drive from Darlington, The Chequers Inn offers well-appointed rooms and a restaurant and bar. In the village of Dalton-on-Tees, it offers free parking and Wi-Fi. Each room has a flat-screen TV and tea and coffee facilities. An en suite bathroom has a bath, shower, hairdryer and complimentary toiletries. A full English breakfast is served daily, as well as lighter options. The restaurant offers a gastro-pub menu in the evening and classic pub options for lunch. This inn is a 4-minute drive from Croft Circuit, home of regular motorsport events. It is around 30 minutes’ drive from the North York Moors National Park.

name.content: Old Rose And Crown Hotel Birmingham

1068082.description: Old Rose and Crown Hotel is within 400 acres of the beautiful Lickey Hills, 5 minutes' drive from the M5 and M42 motorways, 15 minutes from central Birmingham. Originally a 300-year-old coaching inn, the Old Rose and Crown is part of the North Worcestershire Walkway and has en suite rooms with views across Lickey Park. With free Wi-Fi and parking, the hotel is next an 18-hole golf course, all-weather tennis courts and a bowling green. Whilst there is no restaurant in the hotel, there are various local eateries just a short walk away, including a Cantonese restaurant, a fish and chip shop, and a pizza takeaway. There is a popular gastro pub just a few minutes' drive away. The Old Rose and Crown Hotel is few minutes’ walk from great train and bus links. It is close to Cadbury World and the Sea Life Centre.

1114718.description:
Revolver Glasgow: Where Style Meets the Street

Forget everything you know about traditional hostels. Located in the heart of Glasgow’s trendy Merchant City, Revolver is a bold, inclusive, and lifestyle-led hotel-meets-hostel designed for the modern explorer. Housed in the historic Virginia House, we’ve blended the building’s original Victorian character with neon-drenched corridors, local queer art, and a high-energy social atmosphere. 


Whether you’re a solo backpacker, a couple on a city break, or a group ready to hit the town, we have a space for you:

Solo & Social: Choose from our sleek Japanese-style pods or premium dormitory bunks—all featuring privacy curtains, personal lockers, and integrated USB charging. 

Private Retreats: Upgrade to our Signature Double or King Rooms, many featuring en-suite bathrooms, high ceilings, and unique Ab-Fab inspired murals. 

Group Stays: Traveling with the whole squad? Our Multi-room Apartments sleep up to 8 and come equipped with private kitchens and lounge areas. 

The Location
You couldn't be more central. We are situated directly above the iconic Polo Lounge and steps away from the city's best nightlife. 

Transport: A 10-minute walk from Glasgow Central and Queen Street stations. 

Culture: Minutes from George Square, the Gallery of Modern Art (GoMA), and the luxury shops of Buchanan Street. 

Food: Surrounded by the Merchant City’s legendary dining scene, from Neapolitan pizza to high-end steakhouses. 

Good to Know

Adults Only (18+): We maintain a vibrant, grown-up atmosphere. 

The Soundtrack of the City: We are located in a bustling nightlife district. We provide complimentary earplugs for those who want to sleep, but we’re the perfect choice for those who want to dance.

1115883.description:
Set on St Andrew Square, Point A Edinburgh places you right in the city centre, just minutes from Waverley Station and within walking distance of iconic sights, shopping, cafés, and nightlife. 

Housed in a listed building of architectural significance, the hotel has been thoughtfully designed to honour its heritage, retaining original features like the dramatic helix staircase and marble-clad lobby walls. Inside, the atmosphere is calm and welcoming, with comfortable shared spaces to work or unwind. 

Rooms are compact yet modern, with smart lighting, streamlined interiors, and everything needed for a comfortable stay. 

Nearby highlights include:

Edinburgh Castle
The Royal Mile 
Princes Street Gardens
Arthur's Seat

1116107.description: Located in the heart of Salou, this hotel is just 300 meters from the beautiful Levante Beach and only a 10-minute drive from Port Aventura World. Perfectly situated in the city center, it offers comfortable rooms, free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and a refreshing outdoor swimming pool. Enjoy easy access to shops, restaurants, and the vibrant promenade. Ideal for families and couples seeking sun, sea, and adventure.

1116412.description:
Casa Roma is a boutique hostel designed to experience Tarragona with calm, inspiration, and authenticity. A space where the warmth of wood, natural light, and Mediterranean materials create a welcoming atmosphere from the very first moment. 

The building features two carefully designed floors. On the ground floor, rooms open onto an interior courtyard with a vertical garden that brings serenity and freshness throughout the day. On the upper floor, some rooms overlook the courtyard, while others face Avinguda Roma, connecting with the energy of the city. 

The common areas are the heart of Casa Roma: spacious lounge areas, the contemporary Casa Roma Restaurant, and fully equipped meeting rooms for working or finding inspiration. Every corner is designed to make you feel part of the space. 

Casa Roma blends design and functionality with a clear philosophy: to offer a peaceful stay, sustainable, and welcoming stay. A place to rest, experience, and discover Tarragona at your own pace.

The aparthotel Nonanteneuf Sierre is ideally located in the city center, within easy reach of the ski resorts of Crans-Montana and Val d’Anniviers. 

Our modern and spacious rooms are designed for your comfort and feature storage space, a TV, a workspace, and a private bathroom. Wi-Fi and television are included. 

An underground parking space is available for an additional fee (subject to availability). 

The ÀTABLE restaurant, located on the ground floor of the building and operated independently from the aparthotel, offers breakfast, half-board, and full-board options. These services are available at an extra cost and can be booked via our platform. 

*** IMPORTANT *** : 
The property operates entirely contactless, offering a smooth and flexible online check-in experience. While there is no on-site reception, our team remains available by phone or email throughout your stay. 

To complete your check-in, our support team will require your email address, please contact our team per email guest@nonanteneuf-hotel. ch to receive your online check-in link. Once check-in is done you will then receive a 5-digit access code granting entry to the building and your room. All essential information regarding your stay will be shared via email and accessible through our online guest guide. 

Bed linen and towels are provided and included in the final cleaning fee. For environmental reasons, they are not replaced daily; however, additional housekeeping services can be arranged upon request. For stays of 7 nights or more, a weekly cleaning service is included.
