1129216.description: Nestled between the magnificent mountains of Grindelwald, Hotel Restaurant Alpina is situated above the village with views of the Eiger Mountain, being very close to the Railway Station. All rooms boast picturesque views over the mountains. They are spacious and decorated with wooden elements. The homely restaurant serves delicious French and Swiss specialities, rounded off with fine desserts. Vegetarian meals are possible. The Alpina has a large garden where you can unwind, and the rustic lounge room is a cosy place with amazing views. The area around Grindelwald offers many ski and hiking tracks as well as viewpoints like the Sonnenbalkon First, the Kleine Scheidegg or the Jungfraujoch. The impressive glacier is worth seeing. You can also explore the glacier gorge.

1129317.description:
With a stay at Rossal House Apartments in Inverness (Lochardil), you'll be within a 5-minute drive of Inverness Castle and Bellfield Park. This vacation home is 0. 9 mi (1. 5 km) from Uilebheist Distillery & Brewery and 1. 2 mi (1. 9 km) from Inverness Museum and Art Gallery.

1129472.description: A 10-minute walk from the centre of Adelboden, Hotel Crea features a sauna. Free private parking is available on site, and free WiFi is provided in public areas. The bright rooms feature a flat-screen cable TV and a seating area. Some also have a balcony. Bathrooms are private or shared. Breakfast or half board can be arranged upon request at a partner hotel, 500 metres away from Hotel Crea. In the games room, guests can play billiards, table tennis, air hockey, and tabletop football. There is also an indoor playroom for children. The garden includes a sun terrace and a children’s playground. The Altersheim Bus Stop is just 100 metres away, and a cable car can be found within a 5-minute drive.

Comfortable Amenities: The property features private bathrooms with lake views, tea and coffee makers, hairdryers, and modern amenities. Additional facilities include a kitchen, dining area, and electric vehicle charging station. Dining Experience: The romantic restaurant serves international cuisine with vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and dairy-free options. Breakfast includes continental, full English/Irish, and vegetarian selections. Local Attractions: Located 29 km from Inverness Castle and 44 km from Inverness Airport, Foyers Lodge is near Caledonian Canal and Inverness Railway Station. Activities include cycling and tour desk services.

Certain rooms include a seating area for your convenience. There are shops at the property. Guests can play golf for free on some of SportsPark Blaavandshuk Golfcenter's par 3 and par 4 holes, 12 km from the property. Guests at the resort have free access to a fitness centre and a waterpark. There is also table tennis, football and badminton opportunities. Ribe is 45 km from SportsPark Blaavandshuk Resort, while Ho is 9 km from the property. The nearest airport is Billund Airport, 56 km from SportsPark Blaavandshuk Resort.

1133832.description: Comfortable Accommodation: Guesthouse Dusart in Hasselt offers a hotel experience with free WiFi, parquet floors, and city views. Each room includes a kitchenette, private bathroom, and a dining table. Modern Amenities: Guests can enjoy a tea and coffee maker, refrigerator, microwave, stovetop, electric kettle, and kitchenware. Additional features include a work desk, TV, and wardrobe. Convenient Location: Hasselt Market Square is an 8-minute walk away. Nearby attractions include Bokrijk (7 km), C-Mine (16 km), and Bobbejaanland (50 km). The reception staff speak English, French, and Dutch. Highly Rated by Guests: Guesthouse Dusart is highly rated for its excellent service and comfortable accommodations.

1133846.description: Housed in a renovated mansion from the 18th century, the Hôtel de la Poste Sierre is situated a few steps from the Sierre train station and offers you free internet access. 450 metres from the Hotel De La Poste you can find the stop of the funicular connecting Sierre with Crans Montana. The Hôtel de la Poste also features a nice restaurant and a bistro with a terrace. You can park your car in the public garage nearby. Such famous personalities like Goethe and Rilke already stayed in this historic building in Sierre, below Crans-Montana. The hotel is located 450 meters from the funicular railway linking Sierre to Crans-Montana, offering direct access to the resort.

1133848.description: Kettle's Country House Hotel is situated outside the town of Swords, just 10 km away from Dublin Airport and 22 km away from Dublin City Centre. Free parking is available. Each room has free Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV and tea/coffee-making facilities. Rooms also feature a hairdryer, a safe, ironing facilities, and a work desk with lamp. Kettles is within easy access of the M1, M50 and N2 motorways and is 20 minutes from Croke Park Stadium, the 3 arena, and Malahide Castle. ConcertExpress is a new service from Dublin Bus providing buses for all the Malahide Castle concerts in 2024. This service will stop in Kettle's Country House Hotel car park and bring you directly to any Malahide concerts. For more information, please visit ConcertExpress. The Inn Lounge serves breakfast and a wide selection of bar food, including a lunch-time carvery menu. There is live entertainment at weekends, including traditional music.

1133863.description: This refurbished inn has a modern style, a range of Real Ales and classic pub food. It is in Llandaff village, on the north-western edge of Cardiff. Maltsters has individually styled bedrooms with free WiFi, a bath and rain shower. Llandaff Cathedral is a 2-minute walk from Maltsters, and Cardiff city centre is about 2 miles away. Maltsters could be the oldest licensed pub in Cardiff, and there has been a building on the same site since 1310. Breakfast not included in room price but is available via the Pub.

1134999.description: Comfortable Accommodations: The Marine Hotel in Stonehaven offers family rooms with sea views, private bathrooms, and modern amenities. Each room includes a tea and coffee maker, hairdryer, work desk, and free toiletries. Dining Experience: Guests can enjoy British, Scottish, and seafood cuisines at the family-friendly restaurant. The restaurant provides vegetarian, gluten-free, and dairy-free options, catering to diverse dietary needs. Leisure Facilities: The hotel features a bar, outdoor seating area, and free WiFi. Additional services include daily housekeeping, menus for special diets, and an outdoor seating area. Prime Location: Located 30 km from Aberdeen Airport, the hotel is a short walk from Carron Beach. Nearby attractions include Aberdeen Art Gallery & Museum and Duthie Park, each 25 km away.

1135005.description: Whiston Hall is set in scenic Staffordshire countryside, just a 10-minute drive from Alton Towers. The 19th-century hotel has a leafy golf course, a modern bar area and elegant rooms with free Wi-Fi. The historic Whiston Hall estate features large grounds with ornamental fountains and 3 fishing lakes. The 9-hole (double teed to play 18) golf course has a putting green, and offers wonderful views of the nearby hills. The bright and airy bedrooms each have a private bathroom with free toiletries. All rooms feature cable TV and tea/coffee facilities. In the mornings, guests can enjoy Full English breakfast. In the quiet village of Whiston, this elegant hotel is just a 10-minute drive from the Peak District National Park and from Alton Towers. Free on-site parking is available, and Stoke-on-Trent is a 20-minute drive away.

Guests enjoy a sun terrace, garden, and outdoor fireplace, complemented by free WiFi throughout the property. Additional amenities include free on-site private parking, electric vehicle charging, and bicycle parking. Dining Experience: The traditional restaurant serves French cuisine with vegetarian, gluten-free, and dairy-free options. Breakfast includes local specialities, juice, cheese, and fruits. Activities and Location: Guests can enjoy skiing, hiking, and cycling. Located 152 km from Zurich Airport, nearby attractions include First (3. 3 km) and Mount Eiger (18 km).
